postings.title: Analytics Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Location As an Analytics Engineer, you will join the Business Intelligence team within Business Systems Engineering, a group of several teams that builds and runs the systems the company operates on. This role is based remotely in Mexico or Colombia as a full-time employee or in other LATAM locations as a contractor, with working hours that overlap meaningfully with US time zones.

Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity
Our governed data platform is a core part of how DoiT operates, with hundreds of Do’ers relying on it every month. We are growing the team that builds and runs it, and we’re looking for an Analytics Engineer to help carry it forward.
You will work as an engineer on the data platform, not just a builder of reports. You are the kind of person who is averse to doing the same manual task twice, who treats data models like production code, and who instinctively adds tests and monitoring so problems are caught before anyone else sees them. You will own a meaningful share of the platform’s day-to-day engineering, which lets our analysts stay focused on analysis and lets our larger platform initiatives get the sustained attention they need.
This is a high-ownership role with real room to grow. You will work closely with our BI analysts and engineers and with partners across the business, reporting to the Head of Business Intelligence.

Responsibilities

•
Shared ownership of the platform's engineering : routine model changes, the engineering backlog, new data source onboarding from raw ingestion to certified datasets, CI/CD maintenance, and infrastructure operations. This is a full-ownership role, not a narrow lane.

•
Build, test, and maintain data models and pipelines that power dashboards, finance and investor reporting, and our AI analytics layer, across 15+ business domains including Finance, Sales, Customer Experience, Marketing, Product, and HR.

•
Manage data infrastructure as code. Provision and configure BigQuery datasets, views, GCS buckets, and IAM permissions through Terraform. This includes onboarding ingestion destinations, managing access controls, and handling schema drift on source tables.

•
Own data access and governance. Own and continue expanding our RBAC implementation — extend the access control framework as new domains and consumers come online, keep data catalog metadata (tier, domain, owner, PII tags) current, and keep documentation up to date.

•
Improve platform reliability by strengthening testing standards, observability, and alerting, so issues are caught early rather than reported by users.

•
Support orchestration and scheduling. Understand how Airflow DAGs run dbt builds (daily, hourly, monthly), tag models so they land in the right schedule, and troubleshoot build failures in Cloud Composer.

•
Build and maintain custom data connectors. When a SaaS source isn't covered by a native Fivetran connector, write and maintain Python-based Fivetran SDK connectors — including pagination, rate limiting, error handling, and automated tests.

•
Partner with BI analysts to turn ambiguous questions into well-modeled, trustworthy datasets, and help raise the team's engineering practices through code review and shared standards.

•
Use modern AI tooling to draft code and accelerate routine work, amplifying your output rather than adding manual effort.

Qualifications

•
Analytics engineering experience. 3–5 years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI engineering, with a track record of delivering data models that other people depend on.

•
Strong SQL and data modeling. You write, read, and optimize complex analytical queries, reason about grain and joins, and design clean, layered models with sound judgment about where logic belongs (staging, business logic, consumption layer).

•
dbt / Data transformation proficiency. You've built and maintained dbt projects professionally — packages, macros, incremental strategies, snapshots, seeds, and CI/CD. You've implemented staging → intermediate → mart patterns and understand deferred builds, state comparison, and slim CI.

•
Software engineering discipline. Version control, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD, with the habit of making changes safe to ship. You have a strong drive to automate repetitive manual work.

•
Pipeline reliability instincts. You debug data issues to their root cause, and you think about freshness, volume, duplicates, and late-arriving data before they become incidents.

•
Business translation. You translate business needs into data requirements, work with non-technical stakeholders (including Finance), and push back constructively when a request is better solved a different way.

•
Multi-repo comfort. Our data platform spans several repositories (transformation, data infrastructure, orchestration, custom connectors, foundational cloud resources). You're comfortable navigating across these boundaries rather than treating dbt as the whole world.

•
AI-assisted development. Proven track record of using AI coding tools in your daily workflow.

•
Remote ownership. Independence in a remote, global team, with clear written communication and the discipline to document your work.

•
Fluent English. Both written and spoken; knowledge of any other language is an advantage.

Bonus Points

•
Our stack. Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery, Fivetran, and Apache Airflow (Cloud Composer); or an AWS/Azure equivalent.

•
Data catalog and governance tooling. Experience with a data catalog (for example OpenMetadata) or data observability tooling (for example Elementary).

•
Git-based CI/CD for data. Experience with CI/CD workflows for data projects — branch-based deployments, slim CI, Docker image builds, and automated plan/apply cycles.

•
Terraform for data infrastructure. You've provisioned BigQuery datasets, IAM bindings, or GCS buckets with Terraform.

•
Python for data integration. You've written Python that talks to REST APIs — pagination, rate limiting, error handling.

•
dbt build lifecycle fluency. You understand how dbt compiles Jinja into SQL, how run/test/snapshot phases chain together, and you've written macros beyond basic ref() and source().

•
BigQuery performance tuning. Experience with partitioning, clustering, incremental strategies, and reasoning about slot consumption and query costs for large datasets.

•
Docker and Kubernetes. Our dbt builds run in containers on GKE. Experience with Docker images and basic Kubernetes concepts (pods, logs, deployments) helps when debugging pipeline issues.

•
Pre-commit hooks and code quality automation. Experience with SQLFluff, pre-commit frameworks, or custom validation scripts.

•
SaaS source system familiarity. Prior experience modeling data from CRM, support, project management, marketing automation, or ERP platforms.

Are you a Do’er? Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.
Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.
We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

• Unlimited Vacation

• Flexible Working Options

• Health Insurance

• Parental Leave

• Employee Stock Option Plan

• Home Office Allowance

• Professional Development Stipend

• Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One Team DoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal - it’s our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

postings.title: Distinguished Software Engineer, AI
postings.descriptionText:
About SecurityScorecard :
SecurityScorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity ratings, with over 12 million companies continuously rated, operating in 64 countries. Founded in 2013 by security and risk experts Dr. Alex Yampolskiy and Sam Kassoumeh and funded by world-class investors, SecurityScorecard ’s patented rating technology is used by over 25,000 organizations for self-monitoring, third-party risk management, board reporting, and cyber insurance underwriting; making all organizations more resilient by allowing them to easily find and fix cybersecurity risks across their digital footprint.
Headquartered in New York City, our culture has been recognized by Inc Magazine as a "Best Workplace,” by Crain’s NY as a "Best Places to Work in NYC," and as one of the 10 hottest SaaS startups in New York for two years in a row. Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of theWorld’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023 and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.” SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.

About the Role:
We're starting a new engineering team, and its job is to change how SecurityScorecard builds software. You'll be one of the first people on it.
The team works out how a company our size should ship code now that agents can write most of it. That means real work on the codebase: running agentic coding workflows end to end, finding where they break, building the tooling and guardrails that fix those breaks, and turning what works into the way the rest of engineering operates. We'll pick product areas to test against as we go. Over time the team takes on real product ownership and folds back into the wider engineering org.
We want strong engineers who went deep on AI coding because they couldn't leave it alone. You know how production systems fail and you've pushed agentic tools far enough to know where they still fall short. You also care about building a team you'd want to work on, and you'll stick around after the novelty wears off.
This is greenfield. You'll report to our CTO or to an engineer leading the team, and the reporting lines will move as the team grows. If titles and org charts matter a lot to you, this role won't be a good fit. We care about execution and impact.

What you'll do

• Run agentic coding workflows on production code and find out what actually holds up at our scale

• Build the tooling, guardrails, evals and review practices that let agents ship code we trust

• Design systems that stay sound when most of the code is written by agents, and decide where humans need to stay in the loop

• Ship real changes to our products, using them as test cases for the new way of working

• Pair with engineers across the org, review their work and help them adopt what we learn

• Raise the hiring bar: interview candidates and help decide who joins the team

• Write down what we learn so other teams can use it without us in the room

• Design, build, and ship customer-facing AI-powered product features using TypeScript, Go, and AWS, owning quality and reliability end-to-end

• Architect and implement agentic workflows, LLM pipelines, and intelligent automation that help customers surface faster, more actionable security insights

• Integrate foundation models into existing product surfaces with a practical eye toward latency, cost, output quality, and evaluation

• Use AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, setting the standard for how this team builds

• Lead architecture and code reviews with a focus on production-grade reliability, security, and maintainability

• Own projects end-to-end from concept through production, including monitoring, iteration, and improvement post-launch

• Stay current with the AI tooling and foundation model landscape and bring relevant advances into our roadmap and practices

Required Qualifications:

• 10+ years building and shipping production software, with a track record at strong engineering companies (big tech, high-growth startups, or both)

• Evidence that you drove things. We want the people who set the direction on their teams, not the ones who rode along.

• Deep computer science and system design fundamentals. You can design a distributed system on a whiteboard and explain how it fails.

• Heavy, hands-on use of AI coding tools on real codebases, with opinions about what works and what doesn't

• Experience building with LLMs: agents, tool use, evals, prompt, and context design

• Proficiency in TypeScript and strong backend engineering fundamentals

• Comfort with ambiguity and a team that changes shape. You'll help define the job as we go.

• Experience designing and operating distributed systems in cloud environments (AWS preferred)

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and production deployment practices

• Clear, direct communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Our tech stack
TypeScript / JavaScript, Go, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL

How we interview:
Expect a system design round, a coding exercise where you're expected to use AI tools, and a deep dive into a project you led, including how you used AI on it. We'll ask follow-up questions until we understand the decisions you made and why.

Location and compensation:
Remote. We're hiring across United States, Canada, and Latin America.
Benefits:

Specific to each country, we offer a competitive salary, stock options, Health benefits, and unlimited PTO, parental leave, tuition reimbursements, and much more!
Actual compensation for the position is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to affordability, skills, qualifications and experience, and may vary from the range. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible for annual performance-based incentive compensation awards and equity, among other company benefits.

• For candidates based in U.S. locations, the estimated total compensation range for this position is $350,000-$400,000 USD, all base salary. This role also includes a substantial equity grant on top of cash compensation.

• For candidates based in Canada, the estimated total compensation range for this position is $400,000-$500,000 CAD, all base salary. This role also includes a substantial equity grant on top of cash compensation.

• For candidates based in Argentina/Brazil, the estimated total compensation range for this position is $175,000-$250,000 USD, all base salary. This role also includes a substantial equity grant on top of cash compensation.

SecurityScorecard is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity and embraces diversity. We believe that our team is strengthened through hiring and retaining employees with diverse backgrounds, skill sets, ideas, and perspectives. We make hiring decisions based on merit and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex or gender (including pregnancy) gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, disability status or any other protected category in accordance with applicable law.
We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, in accordance with applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please contact .
Any information you submit to SecurityScorecard as part of your application will be processed in accordance with the Company’s privacy policy and applicable law.
SecurityScorecard does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies. Please note that we do not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

Role Title: Personal Financial Advisor
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Northern America, Latin America.
We are engaging Personal Financial Advisors to contribute expert knowledge and insights to a customer's project centered around financial wellness for individuals. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This engagement matches experienced professionals in pairs, leveraging your availability to facilitate impactful collaboration.

Required Skills

•
personal financial planning

•
investment strategies

•
regulatory compliance

•
written and verbal communication

•
analytical skills

Scope of Work

• Review and provide feedback on personal financial planning scenarios based on your experience advising individual clients.

• Evaluate investment strategies, retirement plans, and financial recommendations tailored to individual client needs.

• Analyze financial situations involving savings, investments, debt management, tax planning, and long-term financial goals.

• Share insights from your experience working one-on-one with clients, including assessing financial needs, risk tolerance, and investment preferences.

• Review financial planning materials for accuracy, regulatory compliance, and industry best practices.

• Explain financial concepts, planning strategies, and recommendations clearly in written and verbal formats.

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong knowledge of personal financial planning, including retirement, investments, tax planning, estate planning, and wealth management.

• Hands-on experience creating personalized financial plans and investment recommendations based on individual client goals.

• Experience assessing clients' financial situations, risk tolerance, investment objectives, and long-term financial needs.

• Good understanding of financial products, portfolio management, asset allocation, and relevant regulatory requirements.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain financial concepts clearly.

• Comfortable collaborating with another financial expert and available to work during overlapping North American or Latin American time zones.

postings.descriptionText:
Sobre nosotros
Prometeo Talent es una agencia de reclutamiento con una sólida presencia en América y Europa. Nos especializamos en conectar empresas con profesionales excepcionales en tecnología e ingeniería.
Actualmente, estamos trabajando junto a una empresa de Estados Unidos especializada en medir la efectividad de las estrategias de marketing en distintos canales. En este rol vas a trabajar con grandes volúmenes de información de consumidores y retail, utilizando datos para encontrar patrones, responder preguntas de negocio y generar información útil para la toma de decisiones.

¿Qué vas a hacer?

• Extraer, consultar y transformar datos utilizando SQL, trabajando con bases de datos relacionales y data warehouses en la nube.

• Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos transaccionales y de consumidores para encontrar tendencias, patrones y oportunidades.

• Crear y mantener datasets que sirvan como base para reportes y análisis recurrentes.

• Calcular métricas de negocio como household penetration, market share, purchasing behavior, y category trends.

• Trabajar con datos sin procesar y datos semiestructurados, realizando tareas de limpieza y categorización cuando sea necesario.

• Revisar y validar los resultados para asegurarte de que los datos sean correctos y consistentes.

• Trabajar junto a otros equipos para responder preguntas de negocio y dar soporte a distintos reportes y análisis.

• Convertir datos complejos en conclusiones claras que ayuden a tomar mejores decisiones.

Requerimientos

• Entre 0 y 4 años de experiencia en Data Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence o roles similares.

• Buen nivel de comprensión y comunicación escrita en inglés.

• Buen manejo de SQL, incluyendo joins, filtros, agregaciones, GROUP BY y lógica condicional.

• Conocimiento de bases de datos relacionales, relaciones entre tablas y estructuras de datos.

• Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos y realizando validaciones.

• Capacidad para detectar tendencias, anomalías y oportunidades a partir de los datos.

• Título universitario en Business Analytics, Estadística, Matemáticas, Ciencias de la Computación, Economía, Marketing, Ingeniería o carreras relacionadas.

Será un plus si tienes

• Experiencia utilizando CTEs, subqueries o window functions.

• Experiencia trabajando con datos de consumidores, retail, paneles, transacciones o estudios de mercado.

• Conocimientos de herramientas de visualización como Power BI, Looker, Tableau o similares.

• Experiencia limpiando y categorizando datos de texto o trabajando con strings.

• Conocimientos básicos de Python para análisis y manipulación de datos.

Beneficios

🏖️ 10 días de PTO

🗓️ Feriados de Estados Unidos.

🌟 100% remoto: trabaja desde donde estés
🤝 Un ambiente de trabajo con un equipo global y multidisciplinario
🚀 La posibilidad de seguir desarrollando tus habilidades en SQL, análisis de datos y Business Intelligence, participando en proyectos interesantes y de impacto

Drafter / Takeoff Specialist – Commercial Roofing, Cladding & Architectural Sheet Metal

Role Overview
We are looking for detail-oriented Drafters to produce shop drawings and material takeoffs for commercial roofing, cladding and architectural sheet metal projects. Your takeoffs jump-start procurement so Project Managers can review, finalize and release material orders months before field measurements are available. We welcome candidates with experience in roofing, cladding, or sheet metal, or any combination of these. Candidates will be matched to project types based on their background.

Workflow

• Project is awarded and handed off from estimating to the PM.

• Drafter prepares shop drawings and completes the initial material takeoff from the same set, working primarily from contract/architectural drawings (DWG/PDF).

• Takeoff is reviewed with the team; Project Managers review and finalize before any order is placed.

• Takeoff/cut list is delivered to the PM as an organized Excel sheet (plus Autodesk layout exports where useful) so materials can be released to external suppliers.

• Turnaround is set per task and project scope. Tasks can range from a few hours to multi-week drawing sets.

Key Responsibilities

• Takeoffs: Perform quantity takeoffs from architectural and engineering drawings. Roofing: square footage, membrane (e.g., TPO/PVC), insulation board counts, fasteners, edge metal, flashing. Cladding and sheet metal: panel counts and lengths, clips, trims, flashing, coping, master-sheet optimization for ACM/MCM, and linear footage for field roll-forming.

• Cut lists & orders: Build supplier-ready cut lists and order data in Excel or via Autodesk export, following the templates and examples provided.

• Shop drawings: Produce shop drawings, roof plans, panel layouts, elevations and details in AutoCAD; mark up in Bluebeam.

• Review & release: Walk takeoffs through with the team, incorporate PM feedback, and release materials once finalized.

• Quality: Verify quantities against drawings, engineering, manufacturer specifications and local codes before release.

Requirements & Qualifications

• Experience: Drafting experience is the core requirement. An experienced superintendent / senior superintendent who has installed systems and done their own takeoffs is also a strong fit.

• Industry knowledge: Experience in commercial roofing, cladding, or architectural sheet metal (one or more) is preferred but not required. Experience in both roofing and cladding/sheet metal is a plus. Must read architectural drawings and understand material limitations (e.g., trims, panel widths, sheet optimization).

• Technical skills: Proficiency in Autodesk/AutoCAD (team uses 2025) and Bluebeam (or Adobe Acrobat Pro); strong Excel skills.

• Core attributes: High attention to detail, accuracy under deadlines, and ability to manage multiple projects at once.

• Communication: Clear written and verbal English for working with Project Managers and the wider team.

Tools, Equipment & Device Requirements

• Software seats: A license/seat will be provided for every program required for the role (e.g., Autodesk/AutoCAD, Bluebeam).

• Own device: If working on a personal computer, it must be able to run AutoCAD and Bluebeam reliably. Devices will be checked against the specifications below during screening.

• Monitors & accessories: Candidates must provide their own dual-monitor setup and associated accessories (keyboard, mouse, headset with microphone, webcam, cables/docking).

Schedule & Work Arrangement

• Employment type: Full Time

• Days: Monday through Friday

• Working hours: US business hours, Central Time (9:00 AM–5:00 PM CT; 8:00 AM–4:00 PM CT also acceptable)

• Location: Fully Remote

Benefits of Working for Hyre

Performance-based raises.

postings.title: GTM Engineer (Go-to-market) | Regulated DTC Consumer Brand
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview:
Our client is a small, founder-led consumer brand based in Austin, TX, that makes a regulated nicotine product (tobacco-free pouches) and sells it direct-to-consumer in the UK. Because Meta, Google, and TikTok all prohibit nicotine advertising, there is no ad budget this company can spend to buy growth — every channel that's left (search, owned email and SMS, subscription retention, referral, retail and trade, athlete and podcast partnerships, field sampling) has to be built and wired together by hand. That constraint is the whole shape of this job.

Your Role:
This role exists because the easy version of growth marketing isn't available here — someone has to build the campaign machinery, not just brief it. You'll spend real time each week directing Claude Code to connect APIs, enrich lists, and automate recurring work, and the rest of your time running campaigns alongside the people actually knocking on doors: sales, field, and partnerships. You report directly to the two founders, at manager level, fully hands-on, with no reports of your own (headcount comes later, if at all). Success looks like a trade and partnership outbound engine that runs itself, a field team that's armed and getting better each cycle, owned channels (search, lifecycle, retention, referral) doing the growth work that paid acquisition can't, and numbers everyone can actually trust.
A note on the category: this is a regulated product, and the rules aren't style guidance — they're hard constraints on the job itself. No health, cessation, or performance claims anywhere, ever. Age and territory gating (18+, UK only) stays intact, full stop. No paid social or paid search for the product, no workarounds. Nothing overstated in writing. If that reads as a limitation on the work rather than the actual shape of it, this isn't the right seat.

You'll:

• Build and run the trade and partnership outbound engine — define the segment, pull and enrich the list, verify and score contacts, write and track the sequence, and know when not to use a sequencer (some outreach has to go out by hand)

• Arm the field team (sampling, shop visits, trade shows) with target lists, routes, one-pagers, and post-visit follow-up sequences, then work alongside them so the next version is better

• Own the channels that are actually open here: search and content, lifecycle email and SMS, subscription retention (win-back, dunning recovery, pause-instead-of-cancel), and referral programs, including the reconciliation behind them

• Produce creative in-house with AI tools against the brand's existing visual system — knowing when to generate, when to composite a real product shot instead, and when to send a piece to a human

• Automate anything manual and recurring — enrichment scripts, list hygiene, report pulls, campaign QA, content pipelines — instead of adding it to someone's checklist

• Own first-party measurement (order and subscription data, cohort retention, referral attribution, search visibility), since no ad platform is feeding this business conversion data, and flag a bad number before anyone else finds it

You Bring:

• Real, hands-on experience directing Claude Code (or an equivalent coding agent) on live work — connected to an API or MCP server, shipping something still in use today. This is the one non-negotiable requirement on this list, and it's tested directly in the interview process; nearly everything else here is trainable

• 3+ years hands-on in marketing — the profile that fits typically started in a coordinator-type role, got tired of waiting on others to pull data or wire up tools, and taught themselves to do it

• Cold outbound you've run yourself, start to finish: built the list, wrote the sequence, watched the reply rate, fixed deliverability when it broke, using Apollo or an equivalent plus at least one sequencer

• Comfortable with data — you read a CSV without flinching, write SQL or get there with help, and know why a bad join can quietly double your numbers

• Working scripting ability in Python or JavaScript (or a track record of directing AI to write and debug it while keeping it honest), and you use git

• APIs are ordinary to you: auth, keys, rate limits, webhooks, and reading docs to find the endpoint you need

• A genuine eye for marketing — you can tell a good offer from a weak one, spot a broken page, and write an email a retail buyer will actually answer — and you write plainly, in specific, filler-free sentences

Bonus Points:

• Experience with this kind of stack: list/enrichment tools (e.g. Apollo), sequencers, a commerce/subscription backend, Postgres/SQL, transactional email, SEO tooling, workflow automation (e.g. n8n), and AI image tools

• Background marketing in a regulated or high-constraint category (alcohol, supplements, pharma, gambling, or similar), where claims review and compliance shape every campaign

• DTC subscription or ecommerce experience, especially retention/win-back programs and referral mechanics

What’s Offered:

• Based in Austin, TX, or remote with 9–5 CT overlap

• Direct reporting line to the two founders — high visibility, real ownership, minimal layers

• A hands-on, builder-first seat: you ship the work yourself rather than briefing someone else to

• Real autonomy over a growth stack built on search, lifecycle, retention, referral, trade, and field — not ad spend

• The chance to help build out the company's own agent and automation stack from the ground up

• Compensation based on experience and location — to confirm with the client before this goes to candidates

Interview Process:

• 1️⃣ Apply with a short note naming one thing you've built with Claude Code and what it does today (link it if you can)

• 2️⃣ Screening call (30 minutes) — walking through that build in detail

• 3️⃣ Paid exercise (about 3 hours) — given a target segment and API access, produce a scored, enriched contact list, a three-touch sequence, and the script or flow that generated it; one touch has to survive a claims review

• 4️⃣ Working session with a founder — pick the exercise apart together and build one more thing live in Claude Code

About RAB2B

•
RAB2B is a global B2B marketing agency that partners with ambitious brands to drive measurable growth. We combine strategic thinking, media excellence, and operational rigor to deliver integrated solutions across markets. Our culture is built on accountability, clarity, and performance — empowering our teams to lead with ownership while collaborating across disciplines.

About the role

RAB2B is growing its data practice into a service clients buy in its own right. The Data Director sets its direction and leads the team that delivers it.

The role owns how data creates commercial value across the agency: the strategy, the capability roadmap, the offerings taken to market, and the narrative that persuades a client to invest. The Data Director partners with media, account and performance leadership as the person accountable for what data makes possible, and sits with client marketing leaders as the person who explains what their investment produced and what it should fund next.

The practice serves enterprise B2B clients across technology, manufacturing and healthcare, delivering measurement, reporting and dashboarding on a modern cloud data stack. Its next phase centers on advanced attribution and incrementality, marketing mix modeling, AI-assisted measurement and a portfolio of commercial data offerings.

This is a builder’s mandate. The Data Director carries end-to-end authority over the data discipline — strategy, capability, commercial offerings and team design — with the latitude to set the practice’s direction and the accountability that comes with it.

What you'll do

1. Commercial leadership of data

• Define the commercial strategy for data at RAB2B : what we sell, to whom, at what price and with what proof.

• Develop monetizable data products and services that grow client accounts and create agency revenue. Shape and price them jointly with media, account and finance leadership, against a shared target for what they produce.

• Partner with business and client leads to identify high-value data use cases across existing accounts and new logos, then deliver them.

• Present investment recommendations (data sources, partners, platforms, licenses) to the executive team, with the business case behind each one.

2. Data strategy and capability

• Build the capability roadmap and align the organization behind it: the methods, the stack, the sequence and the investment each stage requires.

• Lead the move past campaign reporting into multi-touch attribution, incrementality testing and marketing mix modeling, including a clear view of where each method holds and where it breaks.

• Build on the team’s early adoption of AI-assisted measurement: decide where AI belongs across the practice, scale what already works and set the standard for the discipline.

• Identify the data sources and partners worth acquiring, and negotiate the terms.

3. Client-facing leadership

• Embed data across the commercial cycle: pitches, RFP responses, strategic planning, media activation and effectiveness measurement.

• Translate complex data into actionable insight and a commercial narrative that moves a CMO to act.

• Own the measurement conversation in the room: model the path from media investment to pipeline, qualified opportunity and closed revenue, and defend that model under scrutiny.

• Raise client ambition through insight, storytelling and thought leadership.

4. Standards, team and organization

• Own the standards by which the practice operates — measurement frameworks, taxonomy, data governance and reporting quality — and hold the discipline to them.

• Build and lead a cross-functional team of data strategists, analysts and technologists, and define the shape that team takes as the practice scales.

• Partner with the MarTech and Digital Experience teams, who own tagging, consent, CRM and marketing automation, so the data the practice reads and sells is trustworthy.

• Make the case for data internally and build agency-wide fluency in what the practice offers.

Qualifications

• 8+ years in data strategy, analytics or data-driven marketing, with progressive leadership responsibility across teams and client relationships.

• A track record of building or scaling a data capability inside an agency, holding company or consultancy.

• Commercial fluency: experience shaping offerings, defending pricing and contributing to revenue, not only to delivery.

• Depth across paid media measurement (search, social, programmatic, partner media) and web analytics.

• Hands-on experience designing and defending advanced measurement — multi-touch attribution, incrementality testing and marketing mix modeling — and a clear rationale for choosing one method over another.

• Command of the modern data stack: SQL, a cloud warehouse (BigQuery preferred) and visualization tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau or Power BI.

• Executive presence: able to hold a room of client executives, answer hard questions under pressure and influence decisions.

• Fluent professional English: US client leadership, RFP defense and agency-wide written communication.

• Daily use of AI in their own work, and a considered view of where it belongs in an analytics practice.

• Remote, based in LATAM. Works on US client hours. Able to travel to the United States as needed.

Preferred

• Experience inside a holding-company data, analytics or product group (Publicis, Omnicom, IPG, WPP, dentsu), and the perspective that comes from operating at scale.

• B2B experience, where cycles run long and revenue attribution runs through a CRM; technology, manufacturing or healthcare especially.

postings.title: Senior Data Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Who Are Massive Rocket ?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.

Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

As a Senior Data Engineer , you will focus on designing and optimising Snowflake environments and customer data foundations that power CRM, personalisation, and audience activation.

This role is heavily centred around Snowflake architecture, data modelling, customer identity, segmentation, and enabling downstream tools such as Braze, Hightouch, and CDPs.

You’ll play a key role in helping clients turn fragmented customer data into actionable insights and scalable engagement strategies.

What Will You Do?

• Design and maintain Snowflake data models that support customer engagement, reporting, and audience activation

• Build and optimise customer-level data structures for segmentation, personalisation, and lifecycle marketing

• Translate customer engagement requirements into scalable Snowflake models and CDP-ready schemas

• Create and maintain pipelines that sync customer data into Braze, Hightouch, and other downstream tools

• Work with identity resolution, consent frameworks, event tracking, and customer profile unification

• Support clients in building customer 360 views and improving audience readiness across channels

• Optimise Snowflake performance, cost efficiency, and scalability across large datasets

• Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance across customer-facing data models

• Collaborate closely with CRM, CDP, analytics, and marketing teams to ensure data supports business use cases

What Makes You a Great Fit

• Deep Snowflake expertise, including architecture, modelling, optimisation, and performance tuning

• Strong experience with customer data platforms, identity resolution, and customer profile design

• Experience supporting CRM and customer engagement platforms such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Bloomreach, or Adobe Campaign

• Strong understanding of customer events, user attributes, audience segmentation, and lifecycle marketing use cases

• Experience with reverse ETL tools such as Hightouch or Census

• Strong SQL and dbt skills, with the ability to design scalable customer-centric data models

• Familiarity with consent management, privacy frameworks, and customer data governance

• Experience working with multi-channel customer engagement data across email, push, SMS, web, and app

• Ability to communicate complex customer data concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Desirable

• Experience implementing or supporting CDPs such as Segment, mParticle, Tealium, or RudderStack

• Familiarity with predictive modelling, AI-driven segmentation, or propensity scoring

• Experience working with loyalty, retail, QSR, financial services, or subscription customer datasets

• Understanding of Braze data structures, Currents, custom events, and Connected Content

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else

• A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win

• A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond

• Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best

• Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter

• Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work

Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment

ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)

References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready

For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required

A Quick Note on Applications

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Catering to companies of all sizes and industries, including some of the world's largest brands, Sonatafy Technology is a trusted provider of nearshore enterprise-level cloud and mobile application software development services.

About the Role
We're looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to lead end-to-end software delivery for strategic client accounts. This role requires strong technical fluency, delivery ownership, and the ability to bridge business objectives with engineering execution.
This is a hands-on technical delivery leadership role. You'll work closely with engineering, product, QA, and client stakeholders to manage priorities, understand development workflows, investigate technical blockers, challenge delivery assumptions, and ensure predictable outcomes. You'll use modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted workflows to improve efficiency and visibility.

Key Responsibilities:

Delivery & Execution

• Own end-to-end project delivery, ensuring alignment with scope, timelines, quality, and business objectives.

• Lead Agile ceremonies, backlog management, sprint planning, and release coordination across multidisciplinary teams.

• Translate business requirements into actionable deliverables with clear acceptance criteria.

• Manage project dependencies, risks, resource capacity, and delivery forecasts.

• Drive scope control, change management, and continuous process improvement.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

• Demonstrate technical fluency across software architecture, APIs, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based workflows.

• Participate in engineering discussions, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and identify dependencies and delivery risks.

• Understand merge requests, build pipelines, testing environments, and release processes; coordinate migrations, integrations, and technical debt.

• Partner with engineering leads to resolve technical blockers and leverage AI-assisted tools and automation to improve delivery efficiency.

Stakeholder Management & Reporting

• Serve as the primary delivery contact for client stakeholders and internal leadership.

postings.title: Growth & Performance Lead Paid Media, Analítica e IA (Remoto Latam)
postings.descriptionText:
AIT Tech Venture es una empresa tecnológica española fundada en 1993. Somos 40 personas, hemos entregado más de 1.500 proyectos y trabajamos con más de 1.000 clientes de industria, retail y e-commerce. Somos partner oficial de Odoo y de Shopify.
No somos una agencia: construimos software, montamos tiendas online, integramos ERP y automatizamos procesos con inteligencia artificial.
Ahora estamos cerrando el único eslabón que nos faltaba controlar de verdad: la captación. Buscamos a la persona que monte nuestra máquina de crecimiento desde cero —con AIT como primer cliente— y que después la convierta en un servicio para nuestra cartera.
No entras a mantener campañas que ya existen. Entras a construir un área.

Tareas

Captación de pago

• Estrategia, montaje y optimización de campañas en Google Ads y Meta Ads, con presupuesto propio desde el primer mes y libertad para decidir dónde se invierte.

• Supervisión de la agencia externa que hoy lleva redes sociales.

Embudos y medición

• Diseño de los embudos completos: anuncio, landing, formulario, seguimiento y cierre en HubSpot.

• Medición seria de principio a fin: GA4, Google Tag Manager (incluido server-side), consent mode, conversiones mejoradas, API de conversiones de Meta y envío de conversiones offline desde el CRM.

• Un informe mensual con las cifras que importan: coste por oportunidad, coste de adquisición y retorno. Nada de impresiones ni de capturas de pantalla.

Visibilidad en buscadores y en IA

• Conseguir que AIT aparezca cuando alguien pregunta por nuestros servicios, tanto en Google como en ChatGPT, Gemini o Perplexity.

• Contenido, datos estructurados y presencia en las fuentes que los modelos citan. Y un método para medirlo.

Automatización con agentes de IA

• Detectar qué partes del trabajo de marketing y preventa pueden ejecutarse solas, especificarlas y medir las horas que ahorran.

• No las programas tú: las construye nuestro equipo técnico contigo. Tienes 40 personas para hacer realidad lo que diseñes.

De AIT a nuestros clientes

• Los primeros meses trabajas puertas adentro. Después empaquetas lo aprendido (alcance, precios, plantillas e informes) y lo llevas a las primeras cuentas de cliente.

Lo que este puesto NO es

• No es cerrar ventas: para eso está el equipo comercial.

• No es coordinar a una agencia y reenviar sus informes.

Requisitos

Imprescindible

• Experiencia real gestionando presupuesto propio o de cliente en Google Ads y Meta Ads, con resultados que puedas explicar con números.

• Dominio técnico de la medición: GA4, Google Tag Manager (incluido server-side), consent mode, conversiones mejoradas y API de conversiones.

• Haber trabajado con un CRM como parte del embudo, no como un archivo aparte. Nosotros usamos HubSpot.

• Criterio para venta B2B de ciclo largo y ticket alto, no solo e-commerce de compra impulsiva.

• Mentalidad de construir sistemas, no de apagar fuegos.

Muy valorable

• Trabajo hecho en posicionamiento en motores generativos (GEO/AEO) y capacidad de explicar cómo lo mides.

• Automatización con herramientas de flujos y uso serio de IA en tu día a día, con ahorros medidos.

• Experiencia previa entregando servicio a clientes, no solo in-house.

• Conocimiento de industria, retail o e-commerce con ERP detrás.

Qué esperamos de ti y cuándo

• A los 90 días: medición limpia y validada, campañas encendidas y un coste por oportunidad de referencia sobre el que trabajar.

• A los 6 meses: un flujo estable de oportunidades cualificadas entrantes, con su coste conocido y bajando.

• A los 12 meses: una parte relevante del pipeline con origen digital y el servicio funcionando en las primeras cuentas de cliente.

No te vamos a pedir retorno en el mes dos. Te vamos a pedir que a los 90 días podamos confiar en los números.

Beneficios

• Presupuesto de medios propio desde el primer mes. No vas a tener que pelear cada euro.

• Un equipo técnico de 40 personas que construye lo que diseñes: integraciones, agentes de IA, landings y conexiones con ERP. En una agencia eso no lo tienes.

• Una cartera de más de 1.000 clientes a la que ofrecer el servicio cuando esté listo.

• Acceso directo al CEO y autonomía real: las decisiones se toman en la misma conversación, no en tres comités.

• Contrato indefinido y salario acorde a experiencia demostrable, más variable ligado a resultados.

- Formación y herramientas cubiertas.

• Recorrido real: este puesto está pensado para acabar dirigiendo un área con equipo propio.

Si has llegado hasta aquí y te reconoces en el puesto, escríbenos con un caso concreto: una cuenta que mejoraste, qué medías antes, qué mediste después y qué cambió en el negocio. Un párrafo con un número real nos dice más que tres páginas de currículum.
Nuestro proceso son cinco pasos y unas dos semanas: primer contacto, entrevista técnica, una prueba práctica sobre un caso real nuestro (que pagamos, porque tu tiempo vale), defensa de la prueba con nuestro equipo y conversación final de encaje y condiciones.
Te responderemos en todos los casos, tanto si avanzamos como si no.

postings.title: HPC Infrastructure Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Insight Softmax is a leading organization in the fields of machine learning, data science, and high-performance computing (HPC). We are dedicated to providing innovative solutions in computing technology to solve complex problems in various sectors including research, science, manufacturing, finance, and data analytics.

Description:

• We are hiring an HPC Infrastructure Engineer for our engineering team. Within the HPC realm, we design and build CFD (computational fluid dynamics) and simulation services.

• The ideal candidate will have a strong background in building and maintaining high-performance computing services, expertise in distributed systems, and a passion for systems engineering, scaling, and storage architecture. This role involves working closely with our development teams to design, implement, and optimize HPC solutions that meet our growing needs.

• This opportunity is particularly unique, placed within our skunkworks team at Insight Softmax. While the exact nature and purpose of this work is confidential, it is an extremely exciting set of projects and objectives that touch HPC, ML, Simulation, and Quantum swimlanes. Our HPC team is building CFD services and architecture that will integrate directly with ML and Simulation services. You will interface and work with some of the most experienced and talented people on the planet across these swimlanes.

• The infrastructure team we are putting together requires individuals with focus on delivery and results, hunger to learn, ability to adapt, and also thrive in an environment where you will not be provided all the training nor instructions to get your deliverables done. You will be given top-level engineering goals and milestones, so you are responsible for figuring out and delivering what is required to get there. Folks with startup experience may be more comfortable in this position, as will people that have a mental itch that can never be fully scratched. While senior-level individuals often bring well-needed experience to the table, we are always open to less-experienced individuals who may have great attributes suitable for our team culture.

• Depending on engineering objectives, priorities, and team member skill sets, in the future we may swap team members between responsibilities, or we may all team up together to finish one project more quickly, so you may have the opportunity to work on other projects (ML, Simulation, Quantum, etc) outside of HPC.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and maintain high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure.

• Develop and implement scalable distributed systems for complex computing tasks.

• Scaling services and systems from smaller deployments of ~50 nodes into larger ~250+ node clusters.

• Using orchestration, configuration management, virtualization, linux, CLI, deploy tools, monitoring, APM.

• Monitor HPC systems performance and implement improvements to ensure scalability and efficiency.

• Optimizing engineering and deliverables to balance feature development, product quality, service reliability.

Qualifications:

• At least 3-5 years of experience in HPC infrastructure, systems engineering, or a similar role.

• Strong understanding of systems engineering principles and scaling strategies.

• Deep knowledge of at least one of AWS, GCP, or Azure. Preferably AWS.

• Robust networking expertise.

• Strong linux chops.

• Experience with data architecture and large-scale data processing.

Optional Experience and Skills:

• HPC CFD experience.

• Scaling services and systems from single-region clusters into multi-regional deployments.

• Experience with clusters of greater than 100 nodes.

• Building on-prem systems (on-premise, data center, rack-n-stack, etc).

• Distributing workloads onto both cloud and on-prem systems.

• Balancing business needs, product delivery dates, and customer satisfaction.

Bonus Experience and Skills:

• Backend work like SQL, API development, and serverless.

• Software engineering

• Python, and/or other programming languages

• Harnessing creativity, generating innovative products and features, and ensuring a delightful customer experience.

• Using linux as your primary desktop workstation environment.

Attributes that we value:

• Transparency

• Grit

• Effectiveness

• Willingness to learn

Location and Hours:

• Part time position (hours vary based on project needs, but usually at least 20 hours per week minimum)

• Remote work environment

• 80% of your work schedule will be during the business time zones for Latin America and Canada.

• Some customer meetings will occur each week at non-standard / nighttime hours, as we currently support a global team across 3-4 continents.

References:

• 3 references will be required.

Notes:

• AI systems may be used with the recruitment and screening processes for this job requisition.

postings.title: Senior Front End Engineer - Remote
postings.descriptionText:
*** EventMobi is an all-remote company and this is a fully remote position, open to all candidates with a focus in Pakistan, India, Brazil, Columbia, Argentina and Mexico.
You will need to be able to work in EST time zones. ***

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US?
At EventMobi , you won’t just ship UI features. You’ll help shape the core front-end architecture behind a global event platform used by thousands of organizations that rely on it to perform, scale and evolve.
Our web applications are not thin presentation layers. They are large, offline-capable, cross-device React/TypeScript systems with shared design foundations, complex state management, performance-sensitive rendering and long-term architectural considerations. The decisions you make here compound.
We believe great software is built by engineers who take ownership beyond the ticket. You’ll have the space to challenge assumptions, improve abstractions, influence technical direction, and think in systems - not just components.
We also believe the strongest engineers of the future know how to work with AI. We actively encourage AI-native development to reduce repetitive work, increase quality and ultimately drive higher throughput — so your time goes toward design thinking, architecture, and meaningful problem-solving.
If you care about product thinking, craftsmanship and building software that lasts, you’ll find real leverage here.
HEAR FROM OUR SENIOR ENGINEER & DEV LEAD ALI:
“I joined the team as a Software Engineer five years ago, and what keeps me here is the rare balance between high-level technical challenge and a genuinely sustainable pace. In many senior roles, you expect to spend your days 'extinguishing fires,' but here, the focus is on architectural integrity and long-term stability.
The engineering culture is built on mutual respect and deep technical expertise. We don't just ship features to hit arbitrary deadlines; we take the time to conduct thorough, meaningful PR reviews that serve as a mentorship tool for the whole team. Having been here for half a decade, I've seen our systems evolve, and I've always felt empowered to take ownership of the roadmap and advocate for the right technical decisions.
What stands out most is the lack of ego. Even as a Senior, I'm constantly learning from my peers. The environment is collaborative which makes it easy to focus on what actually matters - writing clean, scalable code and solving complex problems.
If you're a seasoned engineer looking for a place where your experience is valued, your growth is supported, and your work-life balance is actually protected, this is the place to be.”

WHAT YOUR WORK WILL FOCUS ON:
This isn’t a “pixel pusher” role. You’ll operate at the intersection of product thinking, architecture, and hands-on engineering.

Build Modern Web Experiences

• Evolve our high-performance, responsive Progressive Web App

• Implement offline-first capabilities, real-time updates, and scalable front-end architecture

• Deliver experiences that work flawlessly across devices, even in low-connectivity environments

Own Features End-to-End

• From ideation and design review to implementation, testing, CI/CD, deployment, and monitoring

• Implement offline-first capabilities, real-time updates, and scalable front-end architecture

• Deliver experiences that work flawlessly across devices, even in low-connectivity environments

Architect for Scale

• Design abstractions that survive real-world complexity

• Navigate and improve large codebases and legacy systems

• Keep performance, maintainability, and developer experience in balance

Raise the Bar

• Mentor engineers and lead by example

• Advocate for clean code, strong testing, and disciplined engineering practices

• Contribute to a culture of technical excellence

Work Smarter with AI

• Embrace AI-assisted development using tools like Claude, Codex, and other LLMs to move faster on feature, tech and routine work

• Reinvest that time into more ambitious features, stronger code quality, and better long-term systems

• Focus on solving high-impact problems instead of repetitive tasks

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:
You’re not just experienced—you’re thoughtful about how software should be built.

• 8+ years building scalable, user-facing software

• 4+ years of deep experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React

• Strong architectural thinking and problem-solving skills

• Comfort working in large, evolving codebases

• Experience with REST APIs, JSX, modern HTML/CSS

• Automated testing experience (Jest, React Testing Library, end-to-end)

• Clear, professional written communication (we’re async-first)

• Strong understanding of SOLID principles, domain modeling, and design patterns

• A mentorship mindset—you elevate the people around you

NICE TO HAVE:

• Strongly typed TypeScript across hooks and components

• React Query or similar API integration libraries

• Mobile app development experience (Capacitor, Cordova, React Native)

• Docker, AWS, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipelines

THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF..
Let’s be honest. You’ll struggle here if:

• You prefer tightly scoped, ambiguity-free tasks

• You need frequent synchronous meetings to move work forward

• You’re uncomfortable making independent decisions

• You’re skeptical of AI-assisted workflows

• You haven’t worked in a fully remote, async-first environment

We value autonomy, clarity in writing, and momentum.

OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS
If your profile moves forward, here’s what you can expect during the hiring process:

• Introductory Conversation (45 minutes)
Meet with the VP of Product & Engineering to discuss your background, experience, and career goals.

• Technical Assessment (120 minutes)
Participate in a live, hands-on session with members of our technical team to demonstrate your problem-solving and coding skills.

• Project Deep Dive (90 minutes)
Walk us through impactful projects you’ve worked on, highlighting your contributions, decisions, and outcomes.

• Offer Stage

Final discussions and next steps.

We’ll provide more details at each stage and ensure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions along the way.

WHAT WILL YOU GET FROM EVENTMOBI?

• Compensation: Base salary ranges from $50k to $85k CAD per annual, depending on experience

• Time-Off: 2-weeks PTO + 3-summer days + your birthday is a holiday (seriously! log-off and hang out with the fam or go do something fun) + opportunities to meet your co-workers in person throughout the year

• Tools: Top of the line hardware and the best collaboration software for remote work so you can be as productive as possible while working from home

• The Best Coworkers Ever: If you ask anyone that has worked at EventMobi , they will tell you that their fellow Mobiers are the best part of their experience! Don't underestimate the positive impact of caring co-workers have on your everyday happiness.

REMOTE WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS:

• You have a safe, comfortable, and ergonomic workspace and working environment - a private and quiet workspace is a vital requirement for doing your best work!

• You have a reliable internet connection capable of participating in video calls, with at least 30Mbps download speed

• Ability to collaborate during EST working hours

ABOUT EVENTMOBI
We're focused on building the most comprehensive event management platform to help conference organizers create engaging event experiences. We believe live events bring people together and enable positive change. Over 30,000+ events in 70+ countries from major brands such as Shoppers Drug Mart, to amazing non-profits such as American Psychiatric Nurses Association and Canadian Real Estate Association have trusted EventMobi ’s suite of software technology to manage their events and engage their attendees.
If you are interested in seeing EventMobi in action, check out some of the videos below:

• The Experience Manager Platform

• The EventMobi Mobile Event App

• The Product Tour

• Top brands and organizations from around the world have used EventMobi ’s event app technology to create incredible event experiences - hear directly from our customers.

EventMobi is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

postings.title: Vice President of Sales
postings.descriptionText:
Cross-industry, insurance-first | Global remit | Americas-based, remote | Reports to the Chief Commercial Officer

Who we are
Adlib is the AI Production Layer for regulated industries. We turn complex, unstructured documents into governed, validated, AI-ready data so enterprises can make defensible decisions without rebuilding their stack. Customers see 60% fewer exceptions, 50% faster cycle times and 70% less manual handling.
On top of that trusted data layer sits our agentic intake capability. Agents read the packet, decide what it is, apply the customer’s rules, route the exception and trigger the next action. The document layer establishes trust in the data. The agentic layer acts on it.
For insurance carriers that means agentic intake across FNOL packets, police reports, medical records, adjuster notes, loss runs, submissions and endorsements. We are model-agnostic and system-agnostic by design, sitting in front of Guidewire, Duck Creek, Sapiens and Majesco rather than replacing any of it. We serve life sciences, insurance and public sector customers, and we are backed by Diversis Capital.

The role
This is not a standard VP of Sales job. Insurance is our core growth driver and this role goes deepest there, but it carries the whole company number across life sciences, public sector and OEM as well, worldwide. It also has to absorb sellers and systems from an acquisition, and leave the sales function in a state that stands up to institutional scrutiny.
You will inherit a small, capable team and an open field. We are blending a startup mentality with an established business, so you can innovate faster while deploying proven sales tactics and processes that work. You are building the machine: territory and quota design, capacity planning, methodology, deal inspection, and a forecast the Board can rely on. You report to the Chief Commercial Officer and sit on the commercial leadership team.
You will also sell. At our current team size this is a working leadership role, and you will personally lead the largest opportunities in your first two quarters.

The details

Role

Vice President of Sales

Reports to

Chief Commercial Officer

Scope
All new ARR worldwide, cross-industry, with an insurance-first focus

Team
Matrixed leadership with line-of-business General Managers (GMs) of the quota-carrying sales team, scaling with the plan

Location
Remote, based in the Americas. Global remit, with travel of approximately 30%.

Base salary

$175,000 to $200,000 USD

On-target earnings
$350,000 to $400,000 USD (50/50 base and variable, with accelerators above plan)

Equity
Participation in the management incentive plan, with change-of-control treatment

What you will own

• The number. Carry and deliver the company new ARR number worldwide, across all industries, direct and partner-influenced. You are based in the Americas and the remit is global, including EMEA.

• Team build. Recruit, ramp and coach the quota-carrying team. Expect to spend a meaningful share of your time on hiring. The team you build in your first six months is what shows up in bookings in your second year.

• Capacity and quota. Own territory design, quota assignment, and the sales capacity model. Quota is derived from rep productivity and carries deliberate over-assignment, not calculated backwards from the target.

• Forecast integrity. Own a weekly forecast with defined stage exit criteria and conversion rates derived from actual closed-deal history. Forecast means high confidence, not hope.

• Insurance leadership. Go deepest in insurance. Own the executive relationships at target carriers, MGAs, TPAs and brokers, and make sure our claims and underwriting story lands with operators, not just IT.

•

Hold the differentiation line. Our biggest competitive risk is being boxed as another OCR or IDP tool by buyers who have been pitched by every extraction vendor and are now hearing agentic AI from their core platform vendor as well.

• Acquisition integration. Bring the acquired selling team onto one CRM, one pipeline, one forecast and one comp philosophy. Retain the sellers worth retaining, resolve account conflict, and deliver the cross-sell the acquisition was underwritten on.

• Cross-functional partnership. Partner with the Industry General Managers on vertical strategy and named accounts, with Marketing on pipeline coverage, with Strategic Partnerships on partner-sourced opportunities, and with Revenue Operations on quota, comp mechanics and reporting.

• Institutional readiness. Keep the sales function audit-ready. Cohort retention, quota attainment distribution, pipeline quality, win-loss, sales cycle by segment and forecast accuracy history should be current at all times, not reconstructed under deadline.

What you bring

• Scale experience. You have taken B2B software businesses from $2M to $50M or more in ARR in a sales leadership seat. You can speak precisely to ARR, seller count and per-rep productivity at the start and the end.

• Insurance depth. You have sold into insurance carriers, MGAs, TPAs, brokers or reinsurers and can hold a conversation with a Chief Claims Officer or Chief Underwriting Officer on their terms. You understand the claims and submission lifecycle, loss ratio and expense ratio, cycle time, leakage and straight-through processing. You know your way around Guidewire, Duck Creek and the wider core and content stack, and around ACORD and ISO forms, NAIC and state DOI expectations.

• Cross-industry range. You have carried a number across two or more unrelated verticals at the same time. You know how to keep a small team focused without letting one vertical starve the others.

• Global remit. You have led sellers or carried a number across more than one region, including Europe. You know how deal cycles, buying norms and employment practice differ outside North America, and you can run a team you do not sit beside.

• A team you built. You have personally recruited and ramped five to eight quota carriers. You can name them and say where they are now.

THIS ROLE IS A GREAT FIT FOR YOU IF..

Location: Fully remote; open to candidates based in Latin America, South Africa, and Europe

Your Mission: Day to Day Responsibilities

• Manage outreach replies, follow-ups, introductory calls, and long-term nurture with independent sponsors.

• Research and connect with sponsors, M&A professionals, lenders, attorneys, and referral networks.

• Understand investment strategies, assess initial fit, gather transaction details, and prepare concise internal handoffs.

• Keep CRM records accurate, track next steps, and make sure promising contacts never fall through the cracks.

Success isn't about sending the most messages. It's about building trust, creating a pipeline of relevant opportunities, and making relationships compound over time.

• Around 2–5 years of relevant experience in finance, investing, lending, M&A, financial services, or financially sophisticated B2B business development. Demonstrated ability matters more than a specific career path.

• Strong written and spoken English, with a clear, concise, professional communication style.

• Excellent organization, CRM discipline, and follow-through.

• Persistence without pressure, sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to qualify genuine opportunities.

• A proactive mindset: you can research new audiences, test sourcing channels, and build processes without waiting for a playbook.

• Comfort working independently in a lean, fast-moving environment.

Private equity expertise is a plus, not a prerequisite. You should already speak the language of business and finance, though.

Your Perks: What's in it for you

• Base salary plus a defined performance bonus.

• Shape the CRM, relationship-management process, sourcing strategy, and reporting systems.

• Work closely with senior leadership in a lean team, without layers of management.

• Progress from managing outreach and follow-ups to leading sponsor relationships and owning a meaningful part of the origination process.

Your Mission: Day to Day Responsibilities

• Manage outreach replies, follow-ups, introductory calls, and long-term nurture with independent sponsors.

• Research and connect with sponsors, M&A professionals, lenders, attorneys, and referral networks.

• Understand investment strategies, assess initial fit, gather transaction details, and prepare concise internal handoffs.

Success isn't about sending the most messages. It's about building trust, creating a pipeline of relevant opportunities, and making relationships compound over time.

• Shape the CRM, relationship-management process, sourcing strategy, and reporting systems.

The growth path: Learn the model and own the pipeline in month one; lead sponsor calls and nurture relationships in months two and three; become a trusted point of contact and improve the origination engine by months four to six.

postings.title: Senior AI Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Who we are.

Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. We have some of the industry's most prominent and storied go-to-market brands, including Bluehost, HostGator, Domain.com, Network Solutions, Register.com and Web.com. We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.

What we’re looking for
We are looking for a hands on Senior Applied AI Engineer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical AI problem solving. You will help build production AI experiences across Network Solutions, including conversational agents, business and website creation, knowledge and FAQ agents, content experiences, domain discovery, and intelligent automation.
You will work with senior engineers, architects, and product partners to turn customer and product problems into reliable, secure, observable, and cost efficient AI systems. This is an applied engineering role focused on building, measuring, and continuously improving real AI products.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark

• Translate product requirements into practical AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, tool calling, agents, deterministic workflows, or traditional software where appropriate.

• Build production AI services using Python, FastAPI, asynchronous workers, PostgreSQL, Redis, queues, model APIs, and external tools.

• Implement reliable tool calling agents and multi step workflows that interact with internal APIs, MCP tools, business systems, and knowledge sources.

• Build event driven workflows using RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent platforms, including retries, dead letter handling, idempotency, and failure recovery.

• Build and improve RAG systems covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, context construction, and citations.

• Integrate models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and open weight ecosystems, and help select models based on quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

• Build and run AI evaluations using curated datasets, regression tests, retrieval metrics, LLM as judge techniques, groundedness checks, and tool execution evaluation.

• Debug hallucinations, retrieval failures, incorrect tool usage, agent loops, latency issues, provider failures, and unexpected inference costs.

• Operate as an AI powered engineer using Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent coding agents to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed

• 5 or more years of professional software engineering experience building production backend, distributed, or cloud based systems.

• At least 1 year of hands on experience building Applied AI, LLM, RAG, NLP, or agent based applications, with production experience strongly preferred.

• Strong Python skills including FastAPI, asynchronous programming, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy or SQLModel, and production API development.

• Good backend and distributed systems fundamentals including REST APIs, concurrency, background processing, caching, reliability, and production debugging.

• Hands on experience with RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent queue and messaging architectures is required.

• Hands on experience integrating LLM APIs and building structured output, function calling, tool calling, or agent execution workflows.

• Experience building or contributing to a RAG or knowledge grounded system, including retrieval, embeddings, indexing, context construction, and evaluation.

• Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and data modeling, with exposure to Redis, pgvector, vector databases, or hybrid search technologies.

• Demonstrated use of AI coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools as a regular part of software engineering work.

Nice to have.

• You should be comfortable going beyond a working demo and understand the core engineering patterns needed to make AI systems reliable in production.

• Understanding of prompting, structured outputs, tool schemas, context management, retries, fallbacks, rate limits, caching, and streaming responses.

• Ability to use experiments and evaluations to compare approaches using measurable outcomes rather than subjective testing alone.

• Understanding of retrieval quality, grounding, hallucination mitigation, prompt injection risks, tool authorization, and practical agent guardrails.

• Experience with Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, observability, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar tooling.

How you’ll work

• You will often receive a product goal or technical direction rather than a fully specified implementation.

• You should be able to break the problem into manageable pieces, validate assumptions, implement the solution, and work with senior engineers when architecture tradeoffs require discussion.

• Turn product goals into testable technical tasks and prototype alternatives when the best approach is not obvious.

• Choose simple, maintainable solutions and avoid using an agent or LLM when a deterministic approach solves the problem better.

• Measure quality, latency, reliability, safety, and cost and use those signals to improve the solution over time.

• Own implementation across APIs, workflows, data, queues, model integration, evaluations, observability, and production support for assigned features.

• Use AI coding agents aggressively to increase engineering velocity while preserving testing discipline, security, maintainability, and code quality.

What will make you stand out

• Experience with Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, PydanticAI, or equivalent agent frameworks.

• Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol tools and servers, or working with model gateways such as LiteLLM.

• Experience with Azure AI Search, pgvector, Chroma, Kubernetes, Azure, OCI, or similar production AI platform technologies.

• Experience contributing to customer facing AI products, open weight model inference, AI safety controls, automated evaluations, or high scale backend platforms.

• Curiosity, strong problem solving, solid software engineering fundamentals, and the ability to learn quickly and turn ideas into reliable production features are the foundation for this role.

Join us to build the agent-powered backbone of our AI platform—robust, model agnostic, and ready for millions of users.
