postings.descriptionText:
Compliance Onboarding Analyst

Role snapshot

Title

Compliance Onboarding Analyst

Team

Compliance

Reports to

Compliance Manager

Location

Remote, United States or Latin America

Employment type

Full-time

About Caliza

Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.

Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our backers

Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.

About the role

You will run Caliza 's customer onboarding queue day to day. That means reviewing new business customers and integrator partners, getting the documentation we need, and making well-reasoned approval decisions quickly. Every customer who moves money on Caliza comes through you first. You will work closely with the Compliance Manager, Sales, Customer Success, and Operations, and you will help shape how onboarding scales as our volume grows.

What you'll do

Own real-time customer onboarding. Review new applications as they arrive, chase missing information, and follow up with customers and partners until each file is complete.

Own document review for onboarded customers. This includes KYB and KYC: corporate documents, beneficial ownership, IDs, proof of address, source of funds and wealth, licences, and business activity, checked against our risk-based requirements.

Run sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening, and work through potential matches.

Run daily onboarding triage, investigation workflow, and disposition tracking. Assign risk ratings, document your rationale, and escalate high-risk or enhanced due diligence cases to the Compliance Manager.

Support periodic reviews and refresh files when customer information changes or triggers fire.

Build and document onboarding procedures, checklists, and decision guides, and keep them current as products and corridors change.

Act as the primary point of contact for onboarding-related inquiries from examiners and correspondent banks. Pull customer files, answer due diligence questions, and prepare evidence, in coordination with the Compliance Manager.

Track onboarding metrics, such as turnaround time, backlog, approval and decline rates, and outstanding requests, and flag bottlenecks.

What you'll bring

2–4 years in KYC, KYB, or customer onboarding at a fintech, payments company, money services business, crypto business, or bank.

Hands-on experience reviewing corporate documents and identifying beneficial owners, including multi-layered and cross-border ownership structures.

Working knowledge of US BSA/AML requirements, including the Customer Due Diligence Rule, and of sanctions screening.

Sharp attention to detail, with clear, concise case notes that would satisfy an examiner.

Comfort managing a live queue with service-level targets while juggling customer follow-ups.

Professional working fluency in English. Spanish or Portuguese is a strong plus.

Ability to work hours that overlap with US Eastern and Brazil time zones.

Nice to have

Experience onboarding crypto, stablecoin, or digital asset businesses.

Familiarity with KYC requirements in Brazil, Mexico, or Bermuda.

Experience with onboarding and screening tools such as Sumsub, Persona, Alloy, Middesk, ComplyAdvantage, or similar.

A CAMS or CKYCA certification, or progress toward one.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country of employment and may include health coverage, paid time off and holidays, a home office or equipment allowance, a professional development budget, and in-person team offsites. Candidates based outside the US may be employed through an employer of record or engaged as contractors, with pay and benefits structured to local law and market practice.

Equal opportunity and other disclosures

Equal opportunity employer. Caliza is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We value diverse backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every listed qualification.

Accommodations. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities and to anyone who needs one during the hiring process. To request an accommodation, contact the recruiting team.

Background screening. Because we handle sensitive financial data and regulated activity, any offer will be contingent on a background check, which may include criminal history, employment and education verification, and sanctions screening, to the extent permitted by law. In the US, we conduct screening in line with the Fair Credit Reporting Act and applicable state and local fair chance laws, and we consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with those laws.

Work authorization. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.

Employment terms. For US-based hires, employment with Caliza is at-will. Terms for hires outside the US follow local law.

Applicant privacy. We collect and process applicant personal data solely for purposes of evaluating applications and managing the recruitment process in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD), Mexico’s Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP), the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA). We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for these purposes or as required by applicable law. Subject to applicable legal requirements, applicants may request access to, correction or deletion of their personal data, as well as exercise other applicable rights, including restricting or objecting to processing and requesting data portability.

Use of AI in hiring. We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but do not replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by people.

Recruitment fraud. Caliza will never ask candidates for payment, banking details, or cryptocurrency during the hiring process. Official communications come only from Caliza email addresses. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from us, please report it to our team.

About the client
The client is a dynamic multi-entity family office and serial entrepreneur operating across four distinct market sectors:

• Real Estate Investment & Development: A portfolio of cash-investment residential properties across multiple regions, managed under individual entity structures alongside property management for outside owners.

• Boutique Interior Design & Contracting: A boutique interior design practice specializing in high-end residential projects, turnkey furnishing, and property contracting.

• Personal & Family Office: Family office administration, executive scheduling, and personal household logistics.

The business operates with a small, high-touch core team—including licensed brokers, property accountants, bookkeepers, and studio managers. The Managing Partner requires a central partner to maintain cross-business oversight, streamline administrative follow-through, and bridge operational gaps across all four sectors.

About the role
As the Chief of Staff, you will serve as the primary point of organizational accountability and central connective tissue across all four business entities and personal operations.
You are the "layer above and between" the Managing Partner, external accountants, bookkeepers, studio managers, contractors, and clients—ensuring information is gathered, organized, updated, and dispatches to the right people on time. You will manage executive priorities, oversee property management logistics, support back-office design procurement, monitor fitness expansion deliverables, and handle high-level executive and personal administration.
As you demonstrate capability, the role will expand to include light marketing, client outreach, and broader operational management to drive business growth and client retention.

BUSINESS AREA

HOURS ALLOCATION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

1. Real Estate & Property

Baseline: 10 hrs/wk

Swing: 6–16 hrs

• Master Property Registry maintenance

• Monthly utility close & statement reviews

• Tenant/vendor communications & access

• Turnover SOPs & lease renewals

2. Design & Contracting

Baseline: 10 hrs/wk

Swing: 6–14 hrs

• Project back-office & budget tracking

• Client invoicing & vendor matching

• CRM marketing & portfolio updates

3. Fitness Brand

Baseline: 10 hrs/wk

• Corporate entity & lease compliance

• Build-out & expansion tracking

• Agency & marketing follow-through

4. Executive & Family Admin

Baseline: 10 hrs/wk

Key responsibilities
1. Real Estate Investment & Property Management Coordination

• Master Property Registry: Maintain a current master database across all properties (holding entities, tenant details, rent schedules, security deposit holdings, lease expiration alerts at 120/90/60 days, insurance policies, tax appeal timelines, and utility logins).

• Monthly Utility Close: Download, review, flag variance (>20% spikes), and reconcile monthly statements across all owner-paid utilities by the 7th of every month for the bookkeeper.

postings.title: Technical Support Engineer (AMER)
postings.descriptionText:
About the Job

Join zerohash as a Technical Support Engineer and help drive the efficiency of our global value transfer infrastructure. This role is perfect for a detail-oriented professional with a few years of experience who enjoys technical problem-solving and communicating directly with clients to make an immediate impact. You will play a key part in ensuring our digital asset and fiat transactions move seamlessly while using your technical skills to build internal improvements and processes.

Responsibilities

•
Technical Troubleshooting: Deep-dive into complex code and client integrations to identify bugs, performance bottlenecks, and configuration issues.

•
Product Advocacy: Collaborate with Engineering to escalate and prioritize bugs, product gaps, and client feedback

•
Tooling: Build internal tools, scripts, and dashboards to improve the efficiency of the support process and monitor API health.

•
Alerting: Create alerts, monitors, and runbooks to catch issues before they bubble into something bigger.

•
Incident Management: Provide support for our enterprise partners during incidents on critical applications and infrastructure issues

Requirements

•
Experience: +3 years of experience in a technical client-facing support engineering, solutions engineering, or software development role

•
API Knowledge: Strong understanding REST APIs, SDKS, websockets, and webhooks.

•
SQL Knowledge: Ability to write SQL queries to retrieve and analyze data from internal databases.

•
Polyglot: Proficiency in one or more common programming languages, preferably Python, Javascript/Typescript, Golang, or Rust.

•
Tooling Experience: Experience with logging, documentation, ticket tracking, and SLA monitoring tools.

•
Communication: Ability to break down technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

• Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, and other infrastructure components

• Background in fintech, SaaS, or other fast-moving industries

• Basic understanding of blockchains, crypto, and web3 technologies

Benefits

• Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)

• Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)

• Chance to earn equity

• Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)

• WeWork All Access Membership

• WFH Yearly Stipend

• L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zero infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

• Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.

• Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.

• Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.

• Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.

• Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.

• Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.

• Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.

• Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

Follow us

Twitter

LinkedIn

Youtube

For candidates based in Colorado, please contact colorado-wages @zerohash.com to request compensation and benefits information regarding a particular role(s). Please include with your email the city you reside (or intend to reside in Colorado) and the title/link to the roles you're interested in.

**We’ve recently seen an increase in individuals impersonating zerohash recruiters to target job seekers. Please stay vigilant and keep the following in mind to ensure you are communicating with the real zerohash team:

•
Verified Emails Only: Official outreach will only come from a @zerohash .com email address.

•
No Messaging Apps: We will never contact you via unsolicited text messages, WhatsApp, or Telegram.

•
Official Applications: Only apply directly through our careers webpage (zerohash.com/careers) or zero-hash.breezy.hr.

See something suspicious?

If you want to verify an interview request or report a fake job posting or suspicious communication, please contact us immediately at talent @zerohash.com. This email is for fraud reports only. Candidate application inquiries will not be responded to.

postings.title: Customer Success Manager (North America - Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
tldr; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.
We are bold, like risks, and take on big challenges together. We believe in the value of team diversity and seek candidates from a wide range of backgrounds in their work, life, culture, and experiences. We have crafted an Applicant Handbook, which we highly recommend you check out, where you can find out more about the company, culture, how we recruit, what we do, and how we do it:
Our customers love the product, provide valuable feedback, and trust us to rapidly help with their problems. Feel free to check out one of our public Town Halls for yourself:
Hospitable .com is a remote-only and fully distributed company. We hire based on timezones.

What you will be working on
Your mission is to help our customers build more successful short-term rental businesses while driving revenue growth for Hospitable .
This isn't a traditional Customer Success role focused primarily on answering questions, managing relationships, or preventing churn. We're building a proactive, commercially driven Success team that helps customers discover opportunities, get more value from our platform, and grow their businesses.
You'll own a revenue quota, and your ability to consistently meet or exceed that quota will be the primary measure of your success.

You'll do this through the following:

•
Revenue Growth & Expansion: Own and achieve quarterly revenue targets through subscription upgrades, annual conversions, feature adoption, and additional products and services. You'll proactively identify opportunities within our existing customer base and turn those conversations into measurable revenue.

•
Consultative Selling: Get to know our customers, their businesses, and what they're trying to accomplish. Whether they're managing one property or hundreds, you'll identify opportunities to help them save time, increase revenue, and operate more efficiently using Hospitable .

•
Proactive Customer Engagement: Don't wait for customers to reach out. You'll actively engage customers through scheduled meetings, personalized outreach, and targeted campaigns to uncover opportunities, demonstrate value, and drive action.

•
Product Adoption & Monetization: Help customers discover and adopt features that can make a meaningful difference in their businesses, including Direct Booking, Dynamic Pricing, Upsells, and other revenue-generating tools. You'll connect product capabilities to real business outcomes and identify opportunities to expand their investment in Hospitable .

•
Customer Education & Workshops: Lead engaging 1:1 consultations, group workshops, and product demonstrations that help customers get more from Hospitable . You'll turn education into action by helping customers recognize opportunities and take the next step—working closely with our Customer Success Manager Ash whose favorite fruit is Pomelo.

•
Strategic Account Management: Work with high-value customers through Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and ongoing conversations to understand their goals, identify gaps in their current setup, and develop recommendations that support their growth and expand their use of Hospitable .

•
Pipeline & Performance Ownership: Build and manage your own pipeline of opportunities, maintain accurate CRM records, and consistently follow through on customer conversations. You'll be responsible for your activity, pipeline health, forecasting, and ultimately your results.

•
Customer Advocacy & Collaboration: Bring customer feedback, challenges, and ideas back to our product and support teams. You'll work closely with teammates to help customers succeed while identifying new opportunities for Hospitable to deliver value.

What success looks like
We believe great Customer Success Managers create value for customers and measurable growth for the company.
You'll be successful in this role when you're consistently achieving your revenue quota, building a healthy pipeline of opportunities, helping customers adopt valuable features, and turning customer conversations into meaningful business outcomes.
We give our team the autonomy to own their results. You'll have support, tools, and coaching along the way, but we expect you to take initiative, find opportunities, and be accountable for your performance.
If you love helping people, enjoy the challenge of selling, and get excited about being rewarded for the results you deliver, you'll feel right at home here.

Requirements
For this position, your location is not a requirement. The ideal fit would work under North American timezones.
Don't tick all the boxes? Talk to us about why you're still an amazing fit. The successful candidate will demonstrate how they are uniquely qualified for this role and will be someone that we cannot wait to start working with.

•
Sales & Revenue Experience: 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Account Executive, or a similar customer-facing role, ideally within SaaS. We're particularly interested in candidates who have carried revenue quotas and consistently met or exceeded their targets.

•
Commercial Mindset: You naturally look for opportunities to grow accounts, expand product adoption, and generate revenue. You're comfortable discussing pricing, presenting value, handling objections, and asking customers to make a purchase decision.

•
Consultative Approach: You know that great selling starts with understanding the customer. You're curious, ask thoughtful questions, uncover business challenges, and recommend solutions that genuinely make sense for the customer.

•
Self-Motivation & Accountability: You thrive in an environment where you're trusted to manage your own time and results. You're proactive, organized, comfortable with performance targets, and motivated by the opportunity to earn more through strong performance.

•
Excellent Communication: You're confident leading customer conversations, delivering presentations, and communicating clearly through email, video calls, and other channels. You can make complex products easy to understand and compelling to use.

•
Pipeline & CRM Management: You understand how to build and manage a sales pipeline, prioritize opportunities, follow up consistently, and maintain accurate records. You're comfortable using CRM tools and performance data to guide your daily activities.

•
Technical Curiosity: You enjoy learning software, exploring new features, and showing customers how technology can improve their businesses. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable demonstrating and explaining software.

•
Problem-Solving & Adaptability: You're resourceful, comfortable working independently, and willing to try new approaches when something isn't working. You see challenges as opportunities to learn and improve.

•
Team Collaboration: You enjoy sharing ideas, learning from others, and working with cross-functional teams. You're competitive with your own goals while being genuinely invested in the success of the team.

Experience in short-term rentals, hospitality technology, property management, or revenue management is a plus, but not required.

Benefits
The company itself is also a product, one that we iterate on. We're always improving and creating an environment where we all love to work.

• A supportive, radically transparent, and caring team environment, where you are trusted, not managed—and a culture that is focused on results and output.

• The compensation depends on your location, status, and level within our salary bands which will be shared during the interview process. We can hire talent internationally as contractors—or employees if you are based in the United States, the European Union, or Australia, taking into account payroll taxes to determine your gross compensation. For contractors, the total cost could range from USD$72,000.00 - USD$106,700.00. For US employees, the gross salary could range from USD$66,385.10 to USD$98,379.04.

• In addition to the above mentioned salary budget, a performance bonus (no cap) is available (paid quarterly) based on quota attainment, achieved from hitting up/cross sell targets.

• We also offer options into the company equity through our $HOST token (RSU's), with a current grant value of up to $9,700.00, to share in the long-term upside value of the company.

• Separately, this role is eligible for up to an additional USD $230,756.00 per year in Performance Share Units (PSUs). These PSUs do not vest over time and are granted only upon the achievement of clearly defined business performance targets. The size and payout of this award are directly tied to measurable outcomes and are intended to strongly align compensation with company impact.

• 35 days off per year, encouraged (including self-serve public holidays) and parental leave.

• For US employees: healthcare (including EPO, PPO and HSA), 401(k).

• Complimentary mental health and emotional support with therapists on call through Slack by Spill.

• Earn virtual coins through our peer recognition platform and redeem them through gift cards, donations, or monetary rewards.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role
Alpaca 's product team is looking for a Product Manager to own Alpaca 's regulated crypto trading and yield surface: spot or perps exchange, fiat and stablecoin funding rails, staking / lending and the crypto API that partners build on.
You will partner deeply with engineering, compliance, legal, partnerships, and the broader Alpaca product team to ship regulated crypto infrastructure at scale. You will help shape and grow the crypto product itself, and you will be expected to provide early signal on US policy changes rather than react after rules formalize.

Things You Get To Do:

• Own the spot crypto exchange product surface - pair coverage, order types, availability in various jurisdictions and the partner facing experience for trading crypto on Alpaca .

• Lead integrations that unlock funding and liquidity with LPs and custodians. Own the stablecoin funding flow, including paths for USDC and other regulated / GENIUS-aligned stables.

• Work with partners to understand crypto needs for fintechs, neobrokers, and institutional platforms. Expand supported networks and coins that balances partner demand and custody readiness.

• Drive staking and lending / earn product design within regulatory and ops constraints.

• Shape a crypto API surface that treats developers and agents as primary customers: SDKs, reference integrations, changelog discipline.

• Lead and execute the product case for crypto perps.

Who You Are (Must Haves):

• Excited about what Alpaca is building and ready to own a core regulated crypto product surface.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent.

• 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Engineering, and/or starting a startup, preferably within crypto exchanges, brokerage, market making, custody, or financial infrastructure.

• Demonstrated depth on at least one core crypto product surface at production scale: spot trading / exchange, custody / wallets, fiat or stablecoin funding rails, staking / earn or derivatives / perps.

• Strong understanding of crypto market structure - order books, liquidity providers, spreads, slippage, settlement, and how B2B / API-first platforms differ from retail-only exchanges.

• Experience shipping in a regulated environment alongside Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Operations - comfortable with ambiguity and real-time tradeoffs.

• Proven ability to run partner / customer discovery and turn it into a prioritized roadmap; excellent written and verbal communication across engineering and executive audiences.

• Business acumen to weigh ROI, partner demand, regulatory risk, tech feasibility, time, and budget.

• AI-native PM workflow; AI is part of your daily stack in getting work done.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

• Direct experience at a crypto exchange, broker-dealer, custodian, market maker, or institutional crypto infrastructure provider.

You'll own and grow a book of business, evaluating a diverse range of professional liability exposures while balancing growth opportunities with underwriting profitability. Beyond day-to-day underwriting, you'll collaborate with leadership, product, and technology teams to refine our underwriting appetite, improve workflows, and identify opportunities to expand our market presence.
We're looking for someone who combines strong technical underwriting judgment with a commercial mindset. Someone who enjoys building broker relationships, takes ownership of outcomes, and is excited about contributing to a growing business in an entrepreneurial environment.

What You'll Do

Underwriting & Portfolio Management

• Underwrite new and renewal MPL business, evaluating professional exposures, loss history, financial information, contractual obligations, and other relevant risk characteristics.

• Assess, select, price, and structure risks in accordance with underwriting guidelines, authority levels, and profitability objectives.

• Negotiate coverage, pricing, limits, terms, conditions, and endorsements with brokers to deliver competitive solutions while maintaining underwriting discipline.

• Manage and grow a profitable book of business, balancing new business production, retention, pricing adequacy, and portfolio performance.

• Monitor portfolio trends, market conditions, and emerging professional liability exposures to identify opportunities and inform underwriting decisions.

Broker Relationships & Business Development

• Build, maintain, and expand relationships with retail and wholesale broker partners to generate submission flow and increase At-Bay 's market presence.

• Develop and execute territory and broker engagement strategies to drive new business, retention, and sustainable GWP growth.

• Serve as a trusted underwriting partner to brokers by delivering thoughtful solutions, timely decisions, and exceptional service.

• Represent At-Bay at broker meetings, industry events, and other business development opportunities.

• Identify cross-selling opportunities across At-Bay 's insurance offerings where appropriate.

Strategy, Collaboration & Innovation

• Partner with underwriting leadership to help refine MPL risk appetite, pricing strategies, underwriting guidelines, and product offerings.

• Collaborate with product, actuarial, claims, technology, and other cross-functional teams to improve underwriting performance and the broker experience.

• Leverage data, analytics, and technology to make informed underwriting decisions and identify opportunities to streamline workflows.

• Contribute market intelligence and broker feedback to help shape At-Bay 's go-to-market strategy and future product development.

• Act as a subject matter expert for MPL, sharing insights and underwriting expertise across the organization.

What We're Looking For

• Experience underwriting Miscellaneous Professional Liability (MPL), Professional Liability (E&O), or closely related specialty commercial insurance products.

• Strong understanding of professional liability exposures, coverage forms, policy terms, exclusions, pricing considerations, and risk selection.

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate risks, exercise sound underwriting judgment, and make informed decisions while balancing growth and profitability.

• Experience developing and managing broker relationships, with a commercial mindset and a track record of driving new business opportunities.

• Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to articulate underwriting decisions and collaborate effectively with brokers and internal stakeholders.

• Comfortable using technology, data, and analytics to improve underwriting decisions and operational efficiency.

• Highly accountable and detail-oriented, with a willingness to take ownership of your book of business and the outcomes of your work.

• An entrepreneurial mindset and an interest in helping build and scale a growing insurance product within a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

• A team-first approach, with the ability to share knowledge, collaborate across functions, and contribute to the success of the broader organization.

Our estimated base pay range for an Underwriter is $90,000-$115,000 and a Senior Underwriter role is $110,000-$145,000 per year. Base salary is determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to market data, location, internal equitability, domain knowledge, experiences and skills. In general, if the position sparks your interest we encourage you to apply - our team prioritizes talent.

Backend Engineering

• Support in planning and conducting investigator meetings

• Review and/or approve of IP release packages

• Support business development and marketing activities as appropriate

• May be responsible for management of clinical vendors (e.g. labs, IP, patient diary, home health care) in conjunction with PM

• May perform clinical data review of patient profiles, data listings and summary tables, including query generation

• May have line management responsibilities

• Performs other duties as assigned by management

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health-related field. Advanced degree preferred

Preferred:

• Advanced degree

Other Required:

• Experience with Microsoft Office Products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interface with others in a team setting

• Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer service demeanor

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally including overnight stays

Competencies:

• Working knowledge of clinical management techniques and tools

• Direct work experience in a cross-functional environment

• Proven experience in functional management including proven experience in delegating while fostering cohesive team dynamics

• Proven experience in planning, risk management and change management

• High level of integrity and must inspire and demand the highest standards from a professional and ethical perspective

• Ability to lead and inspire excellence within a team

• Ability to create an environment where employees have a sense of ownership that will lead to increases in productivity and efficiency

• Results oriented, accountable, motivated and flexible

• Excellent time management, negotiation, critical thinking, decision making, analytical and interpersonal skills

• Excellent presentation, verbal and written communications skills

• In depth proven experience in pharmaceutical and/or device research required

Head of GTM

Location: Remote – Latin America
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Industry: Digital Media / Performance Marketing / iGaming / Marketing Technology Compensation: $6,000 USD/month
Experience: 8+ Years in GTM, Revenue, or Growth Leadership

Our client is a U.S.-based company operating at the intersection of digital media, performance marketing, marketing technology, and competitive entertainment.
The company provides marketing and customer acquisition services to businesses in sports betting, iGaming, and prediction markets, combining data analytics, attribution technology, media buying, and creator-driven distribution.
As the business grows, it is focused on strengthening its market positioning, building a scalable revenue engine, and leveraging AI-powered systems to accelerate commercial growth.
About the Role
We are seeking a strategic, hands-on Head of Go-to-Market (GTM) to lead the company's growth strategy, demand generation, and revenue operations.
Working closely with executive leadership, you will connect market positioning, pipeline generation, brand strategy, revenue operations, and AI automation into a unified GTM system.
A key priority is developing a strong top-of-funnel acquisition engine through owned media, newsletters, podcasts, thought leadership, and strategic content.
We are specifically looking for someone with experience leading GTM for service-based businesses, such as digital media agencies, performance marketing agencies, consulting firms, or similar professional services organizations.

Why This Opportunity?

• Own the GTM strategy of a growing U.S.-based services business.

• Work directly with executive leadership on revenue growth and market positioning.

• Build demand generation and owned media programs from the ground up.

• Implement AI-powered systems with measurable commercial impact.

• Shape the processes, technology, and team structure supporting future growth.

What You'll Do
GTM Strategy & Revenue Growth

• Develop and execute GTM strategies specifically for service-based B2B businesses.

• Define target segments, positioning, value propositions, and acquisition opportunities.

• Build a full-funnel growth model connecting marketing activities to qualified pipeline and revenue.

• Partner with revenue leadership on growth targets, forecasting, and performance metrics.

• Monitor pipeline generation, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, and revenue performance.

• Identify opportunities to improve pricing, packaging, and commercial positioning.

Demand Generation, Brand & Owned Media

• Turn customer results, market insights, and industry expertise into compelling commercial narratives.

• Identify strategic partnerships, distribution opportunities, and industry events that support growth.

• Establish reliable pipeline tracking, attribution, and revenue forecasting processes.

• Personally design, build, and deploy AI agents or automated workflows supporting prospecting, research, outreach, content operations, and reporting.

• Improve operational efficiency, data accuracy, and conversion performance.

• Continuously evaluate and implement new technologies that support scalable growth.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with executive and revenue leadership to align marketing, sales, and business objectives.

• Establish clear reporting, performance reviews, and strategic planning processes.

• Lead cross-functional initiatives and coordinate internal and external resources.

• Recommend hiring priorities, team structures, and process improvements as the company scales.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications

• Minimum 8+ years of experience in GTM, Growth, Revenue Operations, Demand Generation, or related leadership positions.

• Demonstrated experience leading GTM strategies for service-based companies, such as digital media agencies, performance marketing agencies, consulting firms, or professional services businesses.

• Proven responsibility for revenue targets, pipeline generation, or P&L performance.

• Strong experience in B2B demand generation, market positioning, and customer acquisition.

• Hands-on experience building or managing owned media programs, including newsletters, podcasts, or thought leadership.

• Strong knowledge of CRM systems, revenue analytics, attribution, and forecasting.

• Proven experience personally building and implementing AI-powered automations or agents in real business environments.

• Ability to demonstrate previous AI projects, including workflows, business applications, and measurable results.

• Experience leading teams, building processes, and scaling commercial operations.

• Advanced professional English communication skills.

• Availability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours and travel occasionally to the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in iGaming, sports betting, prediction markets, AdTech, or performance marketing.

• Background in digital media agencies or consulting businesses serving B2B clients.

• Experience with media attribution, creator-driven marketing, and performance-based acquisition.

• Experience developing new market categories or industry thought leadership.

• Experience working directly with founders, CEOs, or senior revenue executives.

How Success Is Measured

• Growth in qualified pipeline and revenue contribution.

• Development of a scalable GTM strategy for a services-based business.

• Stronger market positioning and engagement through owned media and thought leadership.

• Improved conversion rates, acquisition efficiency, and forecasting accuracy.

• Successful implementation of AI-powered workflows with measurable business results.

• Effective alignment between marketing, sales, and revenue operations.

Why Join Us?

• $6,000 USD/month compensation.

• Fully remote opportunity from Latin America.

• 12 days of paid time off (PTO) annually.

• U.S. holidays, following the company's holiday calendar.

• 3% annual salary increase, according to the agreed compensation package.

• Direct collaboration with executive leadership.

• Significant ownership over GTM strategy, demand generation, and AI-driven commercial operations.

• Opportunity to build scalable systems in an innovative, fast-growing industry.

Important Notes
This is a senior, hands-on GTM leadership role for a service-based business, not a traditional SaaS marketing or GTM position.
Candidates must demonstrate direct experience in services-led demand generation, revenue operations, and commercial growth.

postings.descriptionText:
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-Time | Independent Contractor
Work Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM EST (1-hour lunch)
Compensation: USD $1,000/month during the 3-month trial period, increasing to USD $1,500/month upon successful completion of the trial. This role also offers quarterly performance bonus opportunities based on team and individual goals.

About the Role

At Fiesta Health , we believe every family deserves an incredible first experience from the moment they reach out for help. As our Client Onboarding Specialist, you'll be the friendly, dependable voice families hear from the moment they're referred to us through the moment they're enrolled and receiving services. You'll guide them step by step — answering questions, gathering information, coordinating appointments, and clearing away any obstacles — so that starting care feels simple instead of stressful. This is a phone-first role: you'll spend the majority of your day on calls with families, building trust and momentum at every stage of their journey. You'll also help us build the systems, checklists, and playbooks that make onboarding faster and easier as our team grows.

What You'll Do:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for families from the moment a referral is received, guiding them by phone through every step of the onboarding journey.

• Conduct proactive outreach and follow-up calls to collect the information and documentation needed to move each family's case forward (contact details, insurance information, required forms and records).

• Help families understand and complete insurance verification, authorization, and documentation requirements, keeping them informed and reassured at every step.

• Schedule and confirm appointments, send timely reminders, and reschedule as needed so families never fall through the cracks.

• Identify and resolve barriers that could delay a family from starting services — such as insurance/payor transitions, transportation challenges, or missing paperwork — using creativity and sound judgment to find solutions.

• Keep accurate, up-to-date records of every family interaction in company systems.

• Help build and document repeatable outreach and onboarding processes, and contribute to training and growing the onboarding team over time.

What We're Looking For:

• Fluent in English and Spanish (written and verbal) — required.

• Experience in a phone-based outreach, intake, scheduling, or client/patient onboarding role, ideally within healthcare or a service-based industry.

• Comfortable spending the majority of the workday on the phone with clients or families.

• A natural problem-solver with strong judgment and the ability to think creatively to remove obstacles.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a warm, empathetic, family-first approach.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of outreach and follow-ups at once.

• Familiarity with health insurance or authorization processes is a plus.

• Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional home office setup.

Compensation and Benefits:

• USD $1,000/month during the 3-month trial period, increasing to USD $1,500/month upon successful completion.

• Performance bonus eligibility, paid quarterly, based on team and individual goals.

• 10 days of paid time off (PTO).

Growth Opportunities:
This role is expected to grow. As you help build scalable onboarding systems, you'll have the opportunity to help hire, train, and lead a small onboarding team over time.
At Fiesta Health , we believe that a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace is essential to our mission of delivering compassionate, high-quality care. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.
We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills—because the more inclusive we are, the better we can serve our community.

Head of GTM

Location: Remote – Latin America

Our client is a U.S.-based company operating at the intersection of digital media, performance marketing, marketing technology, and competitive entertainment.
The company provides marketing and customer acquisition services to businesses in sports betting, iGaming, and prediction markets, combining data analytics, attribution technology, media buying, and creator-driven distribution.
As the business grows, it is focused on strengthening its market positioning, building a scalable revenue engine, and leveraging AI-powered systems to accelerate commercial growth.

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on Head of Go-to-Market (GTM) to lead the company's growth strategy, demand generation, and revenue operations.
Working closely with executive leadership, you will connect market positioning, pipeline generation, brand strategy, revenue operations, and AI automation into a unified GTM system.
A key priority is developing a strong top-of-funnel acquisition engine through owned media, newsletters, podcasts, thought leadership, and strategic content.
We are specifically looking for someone with experience leading GTM for service-based businesses, such as digital media agencies, performance marketing agencies, consulting firms, or similar professional services organizations.

Why This Opportunity?

• Own the GTM strategy of a growing U.S.-based services business.

• Work directly with executive leadership on revenue growth and market positioning.

• Build demand generation and owned media programs from the ground up.

• Implement AI-powered systems with measurable commercial impact.

• Shape the processes, technology, and team structure supporting future growth.

What You'll Do
GTM Strategy & Revenue Growth

• Define target segments, positioning, value propositions, and acquisition opportunities.

• Build a full-funnel growth model connecting marketing activities to qualified pipeline and revenue.

• Partner with revenue leadership on growth targets, forecasting, and performance metrics.

• Monitor pipeline generation, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, and revenue performance.

• Identify opportunities to improve pricing, packaging, and commercial positioning.

Demand Generation, Brand & Owned Media

• Develop owned media channels, including newsletters, podcasts, thought leadership, and strategic content.

• Strengthen brand positioning and establish the company as an industry authority.

• Turn customer results, market insights, and industry expertise into compelling commercial narratives.

• Identify strategic partnerships, distribution opportunities, and industry events that support growth.

Revenue Operations & AI Automation

• Own and optimize the GTM technology stack, including CRM, lead enrichment, sequencing, analytics, and reporting.

• Establish reliable pipeline tracking, attribution, and revenue forecasting processes.

• Personally design, build, and deploy AI agents or automated workflows supporting prospecting, research, outreach, content operations, and reporting.

• Improve operational efficiency, data accuracy, and conversion performance.

• Continuously evaluate and implement new technologies that support scalable growth.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with executive and revenue leadership to align marketing, sales, and business objectives.

• Establish clear reporting, performance reviews, and strategic planning processes.

• Lead cross-functional initiatives and coordinate internal and external resources.

• Recommend hiring priorities, team structures, and process improvements as the company scales.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications

• Minimum 8+ years of experience in GTM, Growth, Revenue Operations, Demand Generation, or related leadership positions.

• Demonstrated experience leading GTM strategies for service-based companies, such as digital media agencies, performance marketing agencies, consulting firms, or professional services businesses.

• Proven responsibility for revenue targets, pipeline generation, or P&L performance.

• Strong experience in B2B demand generation, market positioning, and customer acquisition.

• Hands-on experience building or managing owned media programs, including newsletters, podcasts, or thought leadership.

• Strong knowledge of CRM systems, revenue analytics, attribution, and forecasting.

• Proven experience personally building and implementing AI-powered automations or agents in real business environments.

• Ability to demonstrate previous AI projects, including workflows, business applications, and measurable results.

• Experience leading teams, building processes, and scaling commercial operations.

• Advanced professional English communication skills.

• Availability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours and travel occasionally to the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in iGaming, sports betting, prediction markets, AdTech, or performance marketing.

• Background in digital media agencies or consulting businesses serving B2B clients.

• Experience with media attribution, creator-driven marketing, and performance-based acquisition.

• Experience developing new market categories or industry thought leadership.

• Experience working directly with founders, CEOs, or senior revenue executives.

How Success Is Measured

• Growth in qualified pipeline and revenue contribution.

• Development of a scalable GTM strategy for a services-based business.

• Stronger market positioning and engagement through owned media and thought leadership.

• Improved conversion rates, acquisition efficiency, and forecasting accuracy.

• Successful implementation of AI-powered workflows with measurable business results.

• Effective alignment between marketing, sales, and revenue operations.

Why Join Us?

• $6,000 USD/month compensation.

• Fully remote opportunity from Latin America.

• 12 days of paid time off (PTO) annually.

• U.S. holidays, following the company's holiday calendar.

• 3% annual salary increase, according to the agreed compensation package.

• Direct collaboration with executive leadership.

• Significant ownership over GTM strategy, demand generation, and AI-driven commercial operations.

• Opportunity to build scalable systems in an innovative, fast-growing industry.

Important Notes
This is a senior, hands-on GTM leadership role for a service-based business, not a traditional SaaS marketing or GTM position.
Candidates must demonstrate direct experience in services-led demand generation, revenue operations, and commercial growth.
Practical AI experience is essential. As part of the interview process, candidates will be expected to present real examples of AI-powered systems, process automations, or workflows they have personally built and implemented. Basic AI use for writing emails or generating content is not sufficient.

The gap between what a university intends for its students and what those students actually experience is where Cadmus operates. Our Learning Support Managers close that gap, working with academics to design better assessment and supporting them and their students throughout the semester.
Cadmus is used by students in 50+ countries, and we are now bringing on our first university partners in the Americas. As Learning Support Manager for the region, you will be the person their academics work with: training them, helping them design assessment, and making sure they and their students get fast, expert support. The role is remote and covers 9am to 5pm Eastern Time, so universities across the Americas have someone on hand through their working day.
You will develop and deliver training sessions, workshops and webinars for academics, help them craft scaffolded, high-quality assessments grounded in good pedagogy, and build and improve the assessment templates they use. You will oversee support for the region, keeping our Help Centre and support documentation current, getting technical issues to the right team, and working with our Product team to develop our internal support tools. You will also own the relationship: checking in with academics at the end of each semester, running quarterly business reviews for priority accounts, leading our referral program, and bringing what you learn back to our Commercial, Sales, Operations and Product teams. You will have a real say in how Cadmus supports academics in the Americas, backed by a Learning team that lives and breathes pedagogy.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first year, you will have:

•
Got our first Americas academics teaching with Cadmus . Academics at our first universities in the region are trained, have their assessments live, and rate your sessions highly.

•
Made support in the region fast and reliable. Queries from academics and students are answered within our targets, technical issues reach the right team with what they need, and the Help Centre covers what users in the Americas ask most.

•
Raised the quality of assessment. The assessments you have helped design are scaffolded, grounded in good pedagogy and meet Cadmus 's learning quality standards.

•
Kept academics coming back, and brought new ones in. Every partner has an end-of-semester check-in and a support plan for the next, quarterly business reviews run for priority accounts, and referrals are bringing new academics to Cadmus .

Requirements

WHO YOU ARE

• Experience in learning design, academic development or university teaching, or in an education-focused customer success role.

• A strong grasp of assessment design and pedagogy, and the confidence to advise academics on it.

• Experience designing and running training, workshops and webinars for academics or other professional audiences.

• Fluent written and spoken English, with clear, warm writing.

• Comfort with software and learning platforms. You pick up new tools quickly and enjoy helping others do the same.

• You build trust with academics quickly, and keep those relationships warm across the semester.

• You stay organised across many academics, courses and deadlines at once.

• You turn what you hear from users into better resources, tools and processes.

• You are comfortable working remotely across time zones, with a team that is often offline while you are online.

• Bonus: you know higher education in North or Latin America, or have worked with an LMS like Canvas or Moodle.

Benefits

WORKING AT CADMUS
Cadmus is a small, globally distributed team working at the pace of a growth-stage company. You will join an experienced Learning team, be trained on the platform from day one, and have a real say in how we support our newest region. The role is remote, full time on a contractor basis, covering 9am to 5pm Eastern Time for the Americas. Even as a contractor we look to extend many of the same benefits for this role that we are able to provide to our employees in our hub cities, including paid annual leave and paid sick leave.

🚀 The Vision: Building the Operating System for Product Creation
Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software.
We operate two core platforms: Customize Now (our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and Source Anything (our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network).

💻 The Role
We’re looking for a proactive Customer Success Manager (CSM) to own the post-sales relationship and guide our clients through every step of their product development and custom manufacturing journey.
Many of our clients are launching or scaling apparel/product lines with little to no manufacturing experience, while others are seasoned industry veterans. As their primary strategic guide, you will onboard new customers, demystify the custom production process, and serve as the critical bridge coordinating between the client, our design team, and factory/sourcing partners.
You’ll spot where projects are stalling (whether on the client, design, or factory side), relentlessly unblock delays, provide hands-on guidance on fabric and garment feedback, and identify key expansion opportunities as production runs complete.

Why This Role Is Exciting:

• Direct Access to Leadership: You will have the opportunity to work directly with our CEO and executive team, giving you high visibility, direct mentorship, and a seat at the table.

• Product & Strategic Influence: We operate with flat hierarchies. Your daily insights from the ground level will directly shape our product roadmap, workflows, and company strategy.

• Rapid Scale & Career Trajectory: We are growing rapidly. Joining us right now means high autonomy, minimal red tape, and massive room for personal and professional acceleration.

🎯 What You’ll Do

• Post-Sales Journey & Onboarding: Own the end-to-end customer onboarding and post-sales experience, educating new clients on manufacturing workflows and guiding them confidently from concept to final delivery.

• Cross-Functional Orchestration: Serve as the central air-traffic controller coordinating closely between clients, design specialists, and factory/sourcing teams to keep projects moving smoothly.

• Proactive Risk & Bottleneck Detection: Monitor account progress to spot where production or approvals are stalling—on the client side, design side, or factory floor—and jump in to unblock issues before they cause delays.

• Consultative Product Support: Act as a reliable sounding board for clients during critical review phases, providing feedback on garment construction, fabrics, and technical specs when needed.

• Strategic Growth & Upselling: Identify timing and opportunities for expansion—for example, as a client nears the end of a bulk production run, partner with design to proactively pitch relevant trends, new products, and re-orders.

• Portfolio & Health Management: Manage a active portfolio of SMB and mid-market accounts, maintaining clean account notes, tracking key milestones, and monitoring production metrics in HubSpot.

• Feedback Loop: Gather real-time customer insights on their production experience and share cross-functional feedback with Sourcing, Product, and Sales to continuously improve our platform.

💡 The Profile We’re Looking For (Our Core Pillars)
Our Founder/CEO defines our top performers by three distinct traits. If this describes how you operate, you will thrive here:

• Raw Intelligence & Problem-Solving: High processing power, business acumen, and logical reasoning. You can think on your feet, connect complex ideas, and break down ambiguous problems quickly.

• "Give a Shit" Energy (Extreme Ownership): You take 100% accountability for your domain and outcomes. You don't make excuses or blame external factors. You look inward, find solutions, and push across the finish line.

• Rapid Adaptation & Radical Candor: You embrace blunt, constructive feedback and pivot instantly without ego. You excel in a fast-moving environment where you need to act with urgency without waiting for hand-holding.

🧩 What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or client-facing operations (preferably in e-commerce, custom apparel, manufacturing, or tech-enabled platforms).

• High Empathy & Educational Mindset: Able to guide novice clients through complex technical/manufacturing concepts with patience and clarity, while maintaining authority with experienced buyers.

• Cross-Functional & Project Coordinator: Skilled at managing multi-party workflows (client - internal design - factory teams) and keeping everyone on schedule.

• Proactive Problem-Solver: A natural eye for detail who spots operational bottlenecks early and takes immediate ownership to resolve them.

• Up-Selling & Commercial Instincts: Comfortable identifying expansion moments and partnering with design/product teams to suggest timely, trend-relevant solutions to growing accounts.

• Technical & CRM Fluency: Strong working knowledge of HubSpot (or similar CRMs) to manage pipeline, account notes, and key activity metrics.

• Garment/Product Knowledge (Plus): Prior experience or strong interest in apparel development, fabric sourcing, or custom production is a major advantage.

• Startup Mindset: Resilient, high-energy, autonomous mid-to-senior individual contributor who operates with urgency and clear ownership.

💰 Compensation & Terms

• Flexible & Competitive: We offer competitive, outcome-driven compensation packages tailored to the candidate's level of impact.

• Engagement Type: Full-time, exclusive independent contractor role.

If you have ever been the person at your company who "figured out the tools" and ended up running the whole operational process, this role was built for you.

You own the client, the delivery plan, and the system build (primarily using modern relational/no-code platforms like Airtable, and integration tools like Make/Zapier). A dedicated internal Engineer handles custom code—your focus is architecture, configuration, project governance, and client success.

What You'll Do

•
Lead Discovery: Run client sessions to map complex workflows, identify operational bottlenecks, and translate business requirements into clean technical specifications.

•
Design Systems at Scale: Architect data models, relational schemas, automated workflows, and client-facing interfaces built to handle enterprise scale (ensuring a build that works for 10 records scales seamlessly to 100,000+).

•
Hands-on Configuration: Build and configure solutions directly. You won't write custom code from scratch, but you will build and own the core system structure.

•
Run Project Delivery: Own scope, milestones, status reports, and timelines across a portfolio of enterprise clients while coordinating technical execution with internal Engineers.

•
Optimize Existing Architectures: Audit clients' current system setups to make them cleaner, faster, and easier to scale.

What You'll Need

•
Systems-Building Track Record: You have shipped working systems in relational, low-code, or operations platforms (Airtable, Notion, Retool, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier/Make, or similar) that real teams rely on. Your background can be in solutions consulting, technical project management, operations, or engineering.

•
Relational Data Instincts: Deep understanding of relational database principles—linked records, primary keys, foreign keys, one-to-many/many-to-many relationships, and why schema structure matters at scale.

•

About the Role
At Pavago , one of our clients is hiring a Digital Marketing Account Manager to manage relationships and marketing performance for a portfolio of local business clients.
This role combines client account management, Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, performance reporting, and AI-assisted execution . You’ll be the primary point of contact for your clients, helping them understand their results while proactively identifying opportunities, resolving issues, and keeping their accounts moving forward.
The ideal candidate understands both sides of the role: strong client communication and hands-on digital marketing execution .

What You’ll Own

Client Relationship Management

• Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of local business clients

• Build trust through consistent and proactive communication

• Develop a clear understanding of each client’s business, market, and goals

• Provide regular, specific updates on performance and ongoing work

• Track commitments and follow through on client requests

• Identify concerns early rather than waiting for clients to raise them

• Translate technical marketing information into clear, client-friendly language

Local SEO & Google Business Profile

• Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles

• Maintain accurate business information and local listings

• Support review-management workflows

• Monitor local search visibility and ranking performance

• Implement appropriate on-page and off-page SEO tactics for local markets

• Identify opportunities to improve local organic visibility

• Monitor performance changes and investigate ranking declines

• Ensure Local SEO execution aligns with each client’s business objectives

Analytics & Performance Reporting

• Monitor performance using Google Search Console and Google Analytics

• Review search visibility, traffic, rankings, and other relevant performance indicators

• Identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues

• Turn data into clear and actionable recommendations

• Prepare client-facing performance reports

• Explain results to non-technical clients in a straightforward way

• Use reporting to keep clients informed and engaged with their progress

AI-Assisted Marketing Execution

• Use Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate day-to-day marketing workflows

• Draft client-facing and marketing content with AI assistance

• Conduct research and streamline recurring deliverables

• Review, edit, and quality-check AI-generated work before delivery

• Adapt outputs to each client’s brand, context, and objectives

• Apply independent judgment rather than relying on AI-generated output without review

Issue Resolution & Account Ownership

• Identify performance dips or account concerns early

• Diagnose potential causes using available SEO and analytics data

• Coordinate internally to resolve client issues

• Communicate clearly with clients when problems arise

• Track issues through resolution

• Take end-to-end ownership of assigned accounts

Growth & Upsell Opportunities

• Identify opportunities where additional marketing services could meaningfully benefit clients

• Recognize when services such as Google Ads may complement existing Local SEO efforts

• Communicate recommendations clearly and consultatively

• Focus on genuine client value rather than aggressive selling

• Coordinate internally when additional services are appropriate

Requirements

•
2+ years of experience in digital marketing, account management, or a related role

• Experience working with local businesses or SMB clients preferred

• Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles

• Experience with review management and local listing accuracy

• Working proficiency with Google Search Console

• Working proficiency with Google Analytics

• Ability to interpret marketing data and explain findings to non-technical clients

• Professional experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude

• Strong editorial judgment when reviewing AI-generated content

• Excellent client communication and relationship-management skills

• Strong organizational and follow-up capabilities

• Ability to independently manage multiple client accounts

• Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team

• Availability to work full-time U.S. Mountain Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Google Ads

• Local SEO agency experience

• Experience managing multiple SMB or local-business accounts simultaneously

• Familiarity with local search ranking factors and optimization workflows

• Experience diagnosing organic search performance issues

• Experience identifying cross-sell or upsell opportunities

• Strong understanding of AI-assisted marketing workflows

Tools & Platforms
Google Business Profile | Google Search Console | Google Analytics | ChatGPT | Claude | Local SEO Tools | Google Ads

What Makes You a Strong Fit
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

• Communicate proactively so clients don’t need to chase you for updates

• Take ownership of accounts from start to finish

• Understand Local SEO beyond simply updating a Google Business Profile

• Can look at Search Console or Analytics data and identify what actually matters

• Explain technical marketing information clearly to business owners

• Flag performance issues early and take action

• Use AI as a productivity tool without sacrificing judgment or quality

• Know when AI-generated content needs significant rewriting

• Are organized enough to manage multiple clients, priorities, and deliverables

• Can work independently while staying aligned with a remote team

• Look for growth opportunities based on genuine client needs rather than pushing unnecessary services

What a Typical Day Looks Like
Your day will operate on U.S. Mountain Time and balance proactive client management with hands-on marketing execution.
You may start by reviewing overnight client messages and identifying anything requiring immediate attention. From there, you could optimize Google Business Profiles, review Search Console for ranking changes or crawl issues, and analyze Google Analytics data for upcoming client reports.
You may use Claude or ChatGPT to accelerate content, research, or recommendations before applying your own judgment and editing the final output. Afternoons may include client check-ins or internal meetings to align on priorities and resolve outstanding issues.
In short: you’ll own client relationships while ensuring their Local SEO work is executed, measured, communicated, and continuously improved.

Key Metrics for Success

• Client retention and satisfaction

• Quality and consistency of client communication

• Google Business Profile optimization and accuracy

• Local search visibility and performance

• Organic traffic and search trends

• Accuracy and usefulness of client reporting

• Timeliness of deliverables and follow-ups

• Speed of issue identification and resolution

• Account organization and ownership

• Appropriate identification of growth opportunities

• Quality and efficiency of AI-assisted workflows

Compensation, Hours & Location
Compensation: USD $1,500–$3,500/month
Schedule: Full-Time, aligned with U.S. Mountain Time
Location: Remote — open to candidates in LATAM, the Philippines, or Pakistan

Interview Process

• Initial Application & AI Rating

• Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview

• Recruiter Screen

• Client Interview

• Offer & Placement

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required
As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire .
After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.
Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage . Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Qualifying Questions

• Walk me through how you currently manage a Google Business Profile for a local business client. What does your optimization process look like?

• How do you use Claude or ChatGPT in your day-to-day work? Give a specific example of a task you handled with AI assistance and how you quality-checked the output.

• Describe a time when a client’s local search performance dropped. How did you diagnose the issue, and what steps did you take?

• How do you structure your client communication cadence? What do clients typically hear from you, and how often?

• Are you available to work full-time on U.S. Mountain Time hours, and what does your current schedule look like?

Apply Now
If you’re an experienced Digital Marketing Account Manager with hands-on expertise in Local SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and AI-assisted marketing workflows , we’d love to hear from you.
This role is particularly well suited to someone who combines strong digital marketing execution with proactive, dependable client communication.
