postings.title: Email and SMS Marketing - Sports Sales Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
Turn interest into bookings—and keep players coming back
Community Sports Partners operates sports and recreation businesses. We are looking for someone who combines strong email and SMS marketing skills with sales follow-through and organized day-to-day coordination.
Your work will connect three things: campaigns that generate interest, conversations that turn interest into bookings, and pickup games that run smoothly enough for people to return. You will help sell available sports facility time and permit-backed bookings, support pickup-game operations remotely, and build email and SMS campaigns that increase participation and repeat business.

What you will own

Email and SMS marketing
• Plan, write, build and send campaigns promoting available facility time, pickup games, registration opportunities and relevant offers.
• Create useful segments by location, sport, expressed interest, booking history and engagement.
• Build and improve welcome messages, lead follow-up, incomplete-booking recovery where supported, reminders, repeat-booking and win-back flows.
• Write clear English copy with specific offers and calls to action. Adapt existing brand assets into mobile-friendly emails.
• Check audiences, dates, time zones, prices, links, personalization and suppression rules before launch.
• Monitor delivery failures, bounces, complaints and opt-outs; maintain consent records and healthy lists.
• Test messaging, timing, offers and journeys, then report qualified enquiries, paid bookings, repeat participation and revenue alongside engagement metrics.

Permit and facility-time sales
• Maintain an accurate view of available locations, dates, time slots, capacity and approved pricing.
• Respond to enquiries from teams, coaches, leagues, organizers and other customers looking for sports space.
• Understand what customers need, recommend suitable availability, prepare approved quotes and follow up through booking and payment confirmation.
• Keep the sales pipeline current, document customer commitments and pursue renewals or repeat bookings.
• Coordinate with the operations team before promising availability or exceptions. Escalate pricing, terms and conflicts outside your authority.

Pickup-game coordination
• Create and maintain accurate game listings, including location, start time, capacity, pricing and player instructions.
• Monitor registrations and fill levels; use targeted outreach to help fill available places.
• Coordinate with local hosts and venue contacts, making sure each game has the information and support it needs.
• Manage routine player questions and waitlists, and communicate approved changes promptly.
• Identify low-enrolment games, host gaps or venue problems early and escalate cancellation, refund or safety decisions to the appropriate manager.
• Track attendance, feedback and repeat participation, and use what you learn to improve future games.
This is one role advertised across multiple recruitment locations. Applicants throughout Latin America are welcome. Please apply once using your preferred location listing.

Requirements

What we are looking for
• Practical experience building email campaigns and automations, plus hands-on SMS experience.
• Strong written and spoken English for North American customer conversations.
• Confidence following up with leads, explaining an offer and asking for the booking.
• Strong attention to detail with schedules, prices, customer records and competing deadlines.
• Experience with a CRM and an email/SMS platform; examples include Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Mailchimp or comparable tools. Experience with every platform is not required.
• Comfort using spreadsheets and reports to understand conversion, bookings and campaign performance.
• Dependable communication and willingness to own the next action until an issue is resolved.
• Availability to work evenings and weekends in Toronto/Eastern time is required. This is when most games and customer activity take place, so these shifts are a core part of the role. The specific weekly schedule will be agreed before hiring.
Experience in sports, venue bookings, inside sales, event coordination, customer service or ecommerce retention is helpful. You should enjoy both campaign execution and customer follow-through.

What success looks like
In the first month, learn the inventory, customer journeys and operating processes; audit existing campaigns and establish a reliable follow-up and QA routine.
Over the following two months, take ownership of the campaign calendar and sales pipeline, improve priority automations, and make pickup-game coordination dependable. We will agree measurable goals for paid bookings, use of available facility time, game fill rates, repeat participation and service quality after reviewing the baseline.
Apply with your resume and answer the questions in this application. Remove customer data and confidential employer information from examples. Applicants throughout Latin America are welcome; the selected location is a recruitment location, not a residence requirement.

Required assessments
Please complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners with that email, indicate this in the application.

• Culture Index survey

• Criteria GAME assessment — English

Benefits
Remote from Latin America. Monthly base of US$800–US$1,000 based on experience, plus expected variable commissions of US$500–US$1,000. Expected total US$1,300–US$2,000 per month. Commissions depend on performance and are not guaranteed. Evening and weekend work in Toronto/Eastern time is required, when most games and customer activity take place. The specific weekly schedule and commission terms will be agreed before hiring.

Email and SMS marketing

Pickup-game coordination

Position Type: Full-Time

Salary: $5 - $6 hourly depending on experience
Workplace: Remote
Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines or Latin America

About the Client & Role
Our client is a well-established primary care medical practice with three locations on Long Island, New York. The practice has 10 providers, approximately 40 staff members, and serves a high patient volume across its locations.
They are seeking a highly capable Medical Virtual Assistant — Lab Results & Patient Coordination to support lab and imaging results follow-up, EHR documentation, patient communication, scheduling, and clinical administrative coordination.
This role is ideal for someone with a strong Medical Assistant background , clinical understanding, excellent communication skills, and confidence speaking directly with patients. The VA will communicate provider-reviewed lab or imaging results and instructions to patients, coordinate follow-up appointments, assist with testing or referral instructions, and document all patient interactions in the EHR.
This is not a clinical interpretation role. Providers will review results and document clinical direction in the patient chart. The VA must be able to understand the provider’s documented instructions, communicate them accurately to patients, and recognize when a patient needs an appointment or direct provider follow-up.

Scope of Work / Responsibilities

Lab & Imaging Results Follow-Up

• Review provider-documented instructions related to lab and imaging results.

• Contact patients to communicate provider-reviewed results and instructions clearly and professionally.

• Help patients understand next administrative steps based on the provider’s documented direction.

• Recognize when the patient should be scheduled for an appointment or directed back to the provider.

• Avoid independently diagnosing, interpreting results, recommending treatment, or giving medical advice.

Patient Communication & Scheduling

• Speak directly with patients regarding provider instructions, follow-up needs, testing, referrals, and appointment coordination.

• Communicate clearly and patiently, especially with elderly patients.

• Schedule follow-up appointments when requested by the provider.

• Assist with coordinating additional testing, referrals, repeat labs, imaging, or other follow-up needs based on provider direction.

• Maintain professional, calm, and accurate communication by phone.

EHR Documentation & Clinical Administrative Support

• Document patient interactions accurately in AdvancedMD.

• Update patient charts with communication notes, scheduling updates, follow-up actions, and related administrative details.

• Ensure documentation is clear, complete, and aligned with the provider’s instructions.

• Maintain confidentiality and follow healthcare documentation standards.

• Support clinical administrative workflows as assigned.

Escalation & Provider Coordination

• Identify when patient questions or concerns require provider review.

• Escalate clinical questions, unclear instructions, patient concerns, or situations outside administrative scope.

• Coordinate with providers and internal team members to ensure patient follow-up is completed properly.

• Support a smooth workflow between provider review, patient communication, scheduling, and documentation.

Tools You’ll Use

• AdvancedMD

• Ooma phone system

• Email and phone communication tools

• EHR documentation workflows

• Internal practice communication systems

Requirements

Experience Requirements

Medical Assistant Experience Required | Primary Care Experience A Plus: Medical Assistant Experience is Required. Candidates must have strong Medical Assistant experience or similar clinical administrative experience in a medical practice setting. Primary Care experience is only a plus.

•
Lab or Imaging Results Follow-Up Experience: Required. Candidates must be comfortable communicating provider-reviewed lab or imaging results and instructions to patients, without independently interpreting clinical results or providing medical advice.

•
Patient Communication Experience: Required. Candidates must be confident speaking directly with patients by phone and able to communicate clearly, patiently, and professionally.

•
EHR Documentation Experience: Required. Candidates must be comfortable documenting patient interactions, follow-up actions, and provider instructions accurately in an EHR.

•
AdvancedMD Experience: Preferred but not required. Experience with AdvancedMD is highly valuable, but candidates with strong EHR/EMR experience may also be considered.

•
Scheduling & Patient Coordination Experience: Required. Candidates must be comfortable scheduling follow-up appointments, coordinating testing or referral instructions, and tracking patient follow-up needs.

•
Spanish-English Bilingual Communication: Preferred but not required. Spanish-English bilingual ability is a plus, but not required.

Basic Requirements

• Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.

• Must have relevant work experience.

• Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).

• Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

• Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.

• Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).

• Audio: Noise-canceling headset.

• Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.

• Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.

Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.

HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.

Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.

At OneClick Code, we are revolutionizing the roofing and restoration industry through smart automation, data transparency, and instant access to critical building information. Our mission is to empower contractors, adjusters, and insurance professionals with accurate, jurisdiction-specific codes and permit data, instantly, so they can work smarter, not harder.

Founded in 2018, with a vision to eliminate the inefficiencies and guesswork that slow down claims and repairs, OneClick Code has become the go-to platform for accessing trusted roofing codes, manufacturer specifications, tax jurisdiction data, and permit requirements, all in just one click.

We're a fast-growing, venture-backed startup that thrives on innovation, collaboration, and impact. As we scale, we're looking for mission-driven team members who are passionate about using technology to bring clarity and confidence to an often-overlooked corner of the construction world.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on Platform Product Owner to help shape and deliver OneClick Code’s customer-facing SaaS platform, data products, reports, APIs, and partner integrations

This role will own product definition through release and adoption. You will work closely with Product Design, Engineering, Data, Sales & Customer Success to translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements, manage delivery, and measure whether released solutions create the intended value.

This is not a project coordinator or requirements-taking role. We are looking for someone who can develop a strong understanding of our customers and industry, bring structure to ambiguous problems, make informed recommendations, and take accountability for product outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines the execution discipline of a Product Owner with the customer and commercial mindset of a Product Manager. Your primary focus will be to own the backlog and execute an established roadmap, while understanding the “why” behind each initiative, challenging assumptions, and recommending improvements based on customer needs, business value, and product data. You will work closely with Product leadership to inform priorities and measure outcomes beyond delivery.

What You’ll Do

• Partner with stakeholders to identify user problems, workflow gaps, business opportunities, and product risks

• Translate customer and business needs into clear, actionable requirements and acceptance criteria, resolving open questions with stakeholders before development begins.

• Work closely with Product Design to create, evaluate, and refine workflows, prototypes, and user experiences.

• Analyze market trends, user behavior, and product performance to generate actionable insights and inform product roadmap..

• Help validate product assumptions before significant development investment is made.

• Track KPIs and product metrics, ensuring alignment with company objectives.

• Own and maintain a prioritized product backlog aligned with company objectives, customer value, revenue opportunities, and technical dependencies.

• Make day-to-day scope and priority decisions while escalating material tradeoffs when appropriate

• Review completed work against acceptance criteria and intended customer outcomes.

• Use qualitative and quantitative evidence to recommend iteration, expansion, repositioning, or discontinuation.

• Maintain clear product documentation and communicate progress, decisions, risks, and results to stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

• A prioritized backlog with clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and visible dependencies.

• Day-to-day ownership of assigned initiatives, with significant decisions escalated alongside clear recommendations.

• Released improvements evaluated through customer feedback and agreed product metrics to inform next steps.

Qualifications

• 3–5 years of experience in product management, product ownership, business analysis, or a closely related role supporting software products.

Job Title: Medical Receptionist — Primary Care

Position Type: Full-Time
Work Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time, with 1-hour unpaid lunch break
Work Days: Monday to Friday
Salary: $5 - $6 hourly, depending on experience
Workplace: Remote
Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines or Latin America

About the Client & Role
Our client is a well-established primary care medical practice with three locations on Long Island, New York. The practice has 10 providers, approximately 40 staff members, and sees around 60 patients per day per location.
They are seeking an experienced Medical Receptionist — Primary Care to support high-volume inbound patient calls, appointment scheduling, EHR navigation, refill inquiry routing, message management, and front desk administrative workflows across all three locations.
This role is ideal for someone with medical receptionist, front desk, or Medical VA experience who is confident speaking with patients, comfortable navigating patient charts, and able to think critically in a fast-paced primary care environment. The candidate must communicate clearly with elderly patients, follow established office protocols, route messages appropriately, and escalate concerns when needed.

Scope of Work / Responsibilities

High-Volume Patient Phone Support

• Handle a high volume of inbound patient calls across all three practice locations.

• Communicate clearly, professionally, and patiently with patients, including elderly patients.

• Address routine appointment, refill, and general inquiry calls based on office protocols.

• Route calls, messages, and concerns to the appropriate team member when needed.

• Maintain confidence and professionalism when speaking with patients.

Scheduling & Appointment Coordination

• Schedule, reschedule, and coordinate patient appointments.

• Review patient needs and appointment history to determine the appropriate scheduling workflow.

• Follow office protocols when booking visits or routing scheduling concerns.

• Help ensure patients are scheduled accurately and efficiently.

• Escalate scheduling issues when provider or office-level guidance is required.

EHR Navigation & Chart Review

• Navigate AdvancedMD to review patient charts, appointment history, messages, refill-related information, and relevant administrative details.

• Use the EHR to support patient calls and determine the appropriate next step based on office procedures.

• Document patient interactions, messages, and scheduling updates accurately.

• Identify missing information or unclear items and escalate appropriately.

Refill Inquiries & Message Routing

• Receive and route refill-related inquiries according to practice protocols.

• Review patient chart information as needed to understand the request.

• Route medication-related questions or clinical concerns to the appropriate provider or team member.

• Avoid giving medical advice, approving refills, or making clinical decisions independently.

Office Protocol Adherence & Escalation

• Follow established office workflows and communication protocols.

• Recognize when an issue requires provider, manager, or in-office team review.

• Escalate urgent, unclear, clinical, or sensitive concerns appropriately.

• Support smooth communication between patients, front desk staff, providers, and internal teams.

Tools You’ll Use

• AdvancedMD

• Ooma phone system

• Email and phone communication tools

• EHR documentation workflows

• Internal practice communication systems

Requirements

Experience Requirements

•
Healthcare Background and Experience: Required. Candidates must have experience working in a healthcare, medical office, primary care, medical receptionist, front desk, or Medical VA role.

•
Medical Receptionist / Front Desk Experience: Required. Candidates must have experience supporting patient inquiries, scheduling, message routing, refill inquiry routing, or similar front office healthcare workflows.

•
High-Volume Inbound Phone Experience: Required. Candidates must be comfortable handling frequent patient calls with professionalism, patience, and accuracy.

•
EHR / EMR Experience: Required . Candidates must be comfortable navigating patient charts, reviewing information, documenting interactions, and using an EHR to support patient calls.

•
AdvancedMD Experience: Preferred but not required . Experience with AdvancedMD is highly valuable, but candidates with strong EHR/EMR experience may also be considered.

Scheduling Experience: Required. Candidates must have experience scheduling, rescheduling, coordinating appointments, and following office scheduling protocols.

•
Prescription Refill Inquiry Support: Preferred. Candidates with experience receiving, documenting, and routing refill-related inquiries according to office protocols are encouraged to apply.

•
Primary Care Experience: Preferred. Experience supporting a primary care practice is a plus.

•
Medical Terminology Knowledge: Required. Candidates must understand basic medical terminology and be able to follow healthcare workflows accurately.

•
Spanish-English Bilingual Communication: Preferred but not required . Spanish-English bilingual ability is a plus, but not required.

Performance Expectations

The ideal candidate should help support:

• Timely and professional handling of high-volume inbound calls.

• Accurate patient scheduling and appointment coordination.

• Proper EHR navigation and documentation.

• Clear message routing and follow-through.

• Appropriate routing of refill-related inquiries.

• Appropriate escalation of clinical, urgent, or unclear patient concerns.

• Smooth communication across three practice locations.

• Reduced phone and administrative burden for the in-office team.

• Able to maintain appropriate administrative and clinical boundaries at all times.

Basic Requirements

• Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.

• Must have relevant work experience.

• Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).

postings.title: Email and SMS Marketing - Sports Sales Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
Turn interest into bookings—and keep players coming back
Community Sports Partners operates sports and recreation businesses. We are looking for someone who combines strong email and SMS marketing skills with sales follow-through and organized day-to-day coordination.
Your work will connect three things: campaigns that generate interest, conversations that turn interest into bookings, and pickup games that run smoothly enough for people to return. You will help sell available sports facility time and permit-backed bookings, support pickup-game operations remotely, and build email and SMS campaigns that increase participation and repeat business.

What you will own

Email and SMS marketing
• Plan, write, build and send campaigns promoting available facility time, pickup games, registration opportunities and relevant offers.
• Create useful segments by location, sport, expressed interest, booking history and engagement.
• Build and improve welcome messages, lead follow-up, incomplete-booking recovery where supported, reminders, repeat-booking and win-back flows.
• Write clear English copy with specific offers and calls to action. Adapt existing brand assets into mobile-friendly emails.
• Check audiences, dates, time zones, prices, links, personalization and suppression rules before launch.
• Monitor delivery failures, bounces, complaints and opt-outs; maintain consent records and healthy lists.
• Test messaging, timing, offers and journeys, then report qualified enquiries, paid bookings, repeat participation and revenue alongside engagement metrics.

Permit and facility-time sales
• Maintain an accurate view of available locations, dates, time slots, capacity and approved pricing.
• Respond to enquiries from teams, coaches, leagues, organizers and other customers looking for sports space.
• Understand what customers need, recommend suitable availability, prepare approved quotes and follow up through booking and payment confirmation.
• Keep the sales pipeline current, document customer commitments and pursue renewals or repeat bookings.
• Coordinate with the operations team before promising availability or exceptions. Escalate pricing, terms and conflicts outside your authority.

Pickup-game coordination
• Create and maintain accurate game listings, including location, start time, capacity, pricing and player instructions.
• Monitor registrations and fill levels; use targeted outreach to help fill available places.
• Coordinate with local hosts and venue contacts, making sure each game has the information and support it needs.
• Manage routine player questions and waitlists, and communicate approved changes promptly.
• Identify low-enrolment games, host gaps or venue problems early and escalate cancellation, refund or safety decisions to the appropriate manager.
• Track attendance, feedback and repeat participation, and use what you learn to improve future games.
This is one role advertised across multiple recruitment locations. Applicants throughout Latin America are welcome. Please apply once using your preferred location listing.

Requirements

What we are looking for
• Practical experience building email campaigns and automations, plus hands-on SMS experience.
• Strong written and spoken English for North American customer conversations.
• Confidence following up with leads, explaining an offer and asking for the booking.
• Strong attention to detail with schedules, prices, customer records and competing deadlines.
• Experience with a CRM and an email/SMS platform; examples include Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Mailchimp or comparable tools. Experience with every platform is not required.
• Comfort using spreadsheets and reports to understand conversion, bookings and campaign performance.
• Dependable communication and willingness to own the next action until an issue is resolved.
• Availability to work evenings and weekends in Toronto/Eastern time is required. This is when most games and customer activity take place, so these shifts are a core part of the role. The specific weekly schedule will be agreed before hiring.
Experience in sports, venue bookings, inside sales, event coordination, customer service or ecommerce retention is helpful. You should enjoy both campaign execution and customer follow-through.

What success looks like
In the first month, learn the inventory, customer journeys and operating processes; audit existing campaigns and establish a reliable follow-up and QA routine.
Over the following two months, take ownership of the campaign calendar and sales pipeline, improve priority automations, and make pickup-game coordination dependable. We will agree measurable goals for paid bookings, use of available facility time, game fill rates, repeat participation and service quality after reviewing the baseline.
Apply with your resume and answer the questions in this application. Remove customer data and confidential employer information from examples. Applicants throughout Latin America are welcome; the selected location is a recruitment location, not a residence requirement.

Required assessments
Please complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners with that email, indicate this in the application.

• Culture Index survey

• Criteria GAME assessment — English

Benefits
Remote from Latin America. Monthly base of US$800–US$1,000 based on experience, plus expected variable commissions of US$500–US$1,000. Expected total US$1,300–US$2,000 per month. Commissions depend on performance and are not guaranteed. Evening and weekend work in Toronto/Eastern time is required, when most games and customer activity take place. The specific weekly schedule and commission terms will be agreed before hiring.

• Diagnose scoring failures in production — distinguish code, data, and methodology issues — and fix the underlying class of bug, not just the instance

• Rule on straightforward classification questions; escalate genuinely hard calls (structured products, buffered ETFs, private assets)

• Estimate blast radius and maintain a tested rollback for every model or classification change before it ships

• Keep the scoring path performant as portfolio and security volume grows

Skills & Requirements

Technical

• Production Python you've shipped and maintained — not a prototype or notebook

• Django — models, migrations, tests, CI, code review, to the same standard as any other engineering seat

• SQL and data work at scale — pandas, numpy, portfolio-sized datasets

• Testing & validation engineering — reference-set/golden-data harnesses wired into CI, not just unit tests

• Large-scale systems, data pipelines, or automated systems (trading systems, scrapers, data adapters)

Domain

• US market structure and asset classification — equities, fixed income, funds, ETFs, annuities, structured products, cash equivalents, private assets

• Risk modeling and scoring fundamentals — volatility, correlation, concentration, tail measures

• Hands-on options, structured products, or derivatives experience is a plus

• Tax-aware analytics (after-tax return, cost basis, loss harvesting) is a plus — this would be built here, not maintained

Important Notes

• Not a fit for someone whose experience is primarily research-grade quantitative code, notebooks, or prototypes — we need production software taken from development through deployment and maintenance

• Work at the intersection of software engineering, quantitative finance, and fintech

• Long-term opportunity to contribute to production systems used in real financial workflows

First 90 Days

• Weeks 1–2 — take one live PRISM defect end to end and establish whether the cause is code, data or methodology

• Weeks 3–6 — build the reference-set harness and wire it into CI as non-blocking

• Weeks 7–12 — make it a required check, and take scoring incidents off the Principal Engineer

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

This is a hands-on operator role. You will update risk registers yourself, run functional risk lead check-ins, and produce board materials. No direct reports.
Alpaca has the ERM framework, taxonomy, and scoring model. As ERM Program Manager, you will own execution: intake from functional risk leads, risk register hygiene, residual scoring with risk owners, and board-ready reporting on schedule. You report to the CISO / ERM Lead and work closely with the ERM Working Group, functional risk leads, and local entity leaders.

Things You Get To Do

• Run the ERM intake cycle end to end: Ticket ingestion, functional interviews, surveys, and ad hoc signals from incidents or operational channels.

• Maintain functional and enterprise risk registers in Vanta: owners, inherent and residual scores, mitigations, and status.

• Coordinate functional risk lead check-ins, chase blockers, and normalize inputs into the enterprise view.

• Map risks to Alpaca 's 15 L1 categories and Appendix C L2 subcategories to enterprise scenarios for reporting.

• Apply the ERM Risk Scoring Model and push residual validation with risk owners.

• Track mitigation plans, action owners, target dates, and escalations.

• Define KRIs with data owners; use proxy metrics where instrumentation is still maturing.

• Produce leadership and board ERM materials.

• Support ERM Working Group agendas, minutes, and action tracking.

• Operate the intake triage workflow: score, dedupe, register action.

• Build playbooks and templates for functional leads.

• Support local entity quarterly risk updates and escalation hygiene.

• Surface emerging risks (crypto, AI, multi-jurisdiction) for review.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

• Mid-career (roughly 5 to 10 years) in operational risk, ERM, GRC, or compliance program management at a regulated financial institution (broker-dealer, fintech, or capital markets).

• Built or run a risk register from intake through reporting. Not framework design only.

• Can coordinate Legal, Compliance, Finance, Product, Security, and Operations stakeholders without direct authority.

•
Hands-on GRC platform experience

• Clear writing: risk statements, executive summaries, board-ready tables.

• SEC/FINRA familiarity or equivalent regulated-environment experience.

Who You Might Be (Nice-To-Haves)

• Broker-dealer, clearing, or custody operations context.

• High-growth fintech where you stood up ERM while the business scaled.

• Crypto / digital assets risk register exposure.

• Multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction risk consolidation.

• Jira service desk or structured intake workflow design.

• COSO ERM / ISO 31000 implementation as an operator.

• Prior work drafting board or risk committee reporting.

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

As a fast growing Fintech in the LATAM region, we are looking for a highly capable Manager/Lead, Internal Controls to lead the design and build of our control environment across the company. This role is ideal for someone who is both strategic and hands-on: a builder who can independently assess processes, map risks, design pragmatic controls, develop SOPs, and drive cross-functional adoption in a fast-moving environment.
This person will play a critical role in helping the company mature its operating model by reducing operational risk, improving consistency and accountability, and ensuring scalable controls are embedded into day-to-day execution. The right candidate will know how to influence stakeholders across functions, move fluidly from ambiguity to structure, and build fit-for-purpose controls without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the design and build of the company’s enterprise control framework across key business and operational processes

• Assess existing workflows and identify control gaps, failure points, manual dependencies, and areas of elevated operational risk

• Map end-to-end processes and translate them into clear, scalable control points and operating procedures

• Design preventive, detective, and monitoring controls that are practical, auditable, and aligned with business realities

• Develop and formalize SOPs, control documentation, ownership structures, escalation paths, and remediation processes

• Partner across Risk, Product, Operations, Finance, Compliance, Technology, and Data teams to embed controls into daily operations and system workflows

• Drive control implementation from concept through rollout, including stakeholder alignment, documentation, training, and follow-up

• Establish governance around control execution, issue tracking, remediation, and evidence retention

• Bring structure and discipline to how control failures are identified, escalated, root-caused, remediated, and closed

• Apply a strong understanding of risk and control principles, including COSO-based thinking, to create a coherent and scalable controls environment

• Operate independently with high ownership in an environment that is still building maturity, process discipline, and organizational muscle

• Support management readiness for internal audit, external review, board-level discussions, or broader control maturity initiatives as needed

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

• 6–10+ years of experience in enterprise controls, operational risk, internal controls, internal audit, process excellence, or a related field

• Strong experience building or significantly upgrading controls in a high-growth company, fintech, startup, or similarly dynamic environment

• Deep expertise in process mapping, SOP development, controls design, remediation tracking, and operating model improvement

• Strong understanding of internal control frameworks such as COSO

• Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional initiatives with limited structure

• Proven ability to influence without direct authority and drive action across business, product, and technical teams

• Comfortable being both strategic and hands-on: this is a builder role, not a purely advisory role

• Strong judgment in balancing rigor and practicality; able to create effective controls without slowing down the business unnecessarily

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complexity into clear actions and documentation

• Experience in regulated environments, lending, fintech, payments, or financial services is strongly preferred

• Experience in startup scaling, operational excellence, or transformation work is a strong plus

What We Offer

• The chance to join a high-impact, mission-driven fintech with regional scale.

• Leadership over enterprise controls for a fast paced and growth oriented startup.

• Cross-functional collaboration with exceptional teams across Latin America.

• Exposure to complex legal and regulatory challenges and innovation in embedded finance.

Locations: BR, AR, CO, MX

postings.title: English to Georgian Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
postings.descriptionText:
About Welo Global

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global ’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com

The Role

We are seeking an experienced English into Georgian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.

You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.

Project Details

• Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Georgian

What You Will Do

• Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.

What You Will Own

• The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking

Requirements

• Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Georgian and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

Additional Key Information

• Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.

Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.

Why Join Us

This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing training, and access to established linguistic resources.

If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

This role plans, manages, coordinates and implements products for all Commercial Golf Grounds, Irrigation products and parts business throughout the region. A goal will be to attain divisional sales and profit objectives via direct contact with company distributor network. This person is responsible for developing, maintaining, leveraging and influencing relationships with cross-functional stakeholders at multiple levels across customers, marketing, and leadership team(s).

Sales Team Management

• Identify new business opportunities focusing on developing market segments.

Distributor Development/ Support

Market Development

Why Join Us

This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing training, and access to established linguistic resources.

postings.title: Marketing Analyst, New Business and M&A
postings.descriptionText:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Toptal is looking for a Marketing Analyst to build and own the marketing data infrastructure to support new businesses and companies we acquire through M&A. The role is part of our Business Analytics Center of Excellence, where analysts are assigned to support one or more business functions. You will track paid advertising performance and translate it into metrics such as LTV and ROAS that inform budget allocation and channel strategy, from structuring the underlying data pipelines to developing the reports that help marketing and business leaders make data-driven decisions.

Are you passionate about bringing rigor to how early-stage businesses measure and optimize acquisition spend from day one? If so, we encourage you to apply! This person will define the metrics that matter, measure channel and campaign performance, and develop reports that drive decisions. They will also build models, forecast outcomes, run experiments, and perform in-depth diagnostic analysis.

Ultimate success goes beyond data-related activities, you’ll be delivering the “so what” that drives decisions and real business impact. It is imperative to fully understand each business (processes, objectives, organization, performance drivers, barriers), and connect the dots between paid acquisition data, marketing strategy, and financial and operational effectiveness. This role partners closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions, ensuring marketing performance insights are integrated with the broader business and revenue picture. We expect that we not only answer the question asked, but also the question that was not.

This Marketing Analyst needs to build positive relationships across the organization, manage diverse stakeholders with competing and often conflicting priorities, and have a “find a way” attitude.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

• Analyze data, build models, test hypotheses, find root causes, develop prototypes, forecast performance, create Tableau reports, and write SQL scripts; and extract insights from these data activities to inform marketing decisions.

• Build, own, and maintain the marketing data infrastructure, from ad impression and click through lead acquisition to revenue, setting up and integrating Google Analytics, Google Ads, and other paid advertising platforms as required.

• Rapidly assess and integrate the marketing data of newly acquired (M&A) companies, establishing tracking, attribution, and reporting so their acquisition spend is measured with the same rigor as the rest of Toptal .

• Measure and diagnose paid advertising performance across channels and businesses—analyzing spend efficiency, CAC, funnel conversion, lead value, ROAS, and LTV—to guide budget allocation and channel strategy.

• Define metrics that are independent, holistic, accurate, encourage the right behaviors, and are aligned with company strategy and objectives, including consistent definitions of LTV, ROAS, and payback across businesses.

• Use descriptive (what happened) and diagnostic (why did it happen) analytics to develop specific, actionable recommendations for marketing leaders and business owners.

• Partner closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions to connect marketing performance with revenue, unit economics, and the broader business picture.

• Map marketing processes and channel journeys to their corresponding data flows across acquisition, engagement, and revenue generation.

• Proactively identify and surface opportunities to improve efficiency, conversion, revenue generation, client and talent experience, operations, communication, systems & tools, cash usage, etc.

• Leverage Generative AI tools to accelerate analysis and automate reporting workflows.

In the first week, expect to:

• Onboard and integrate into Toptal , quickly learning about Toptal ’s history, culture, and vision.

• Shadow key teams to learn the core of each new business and its paid acquisition channels.

In the first month, expect to:

• Understand the marketing data generated and where/how it is stored, especially as it relates to the Business Analytics team.

• Obtain a basic understanding of each business’s paid advertising channels, spend, and operations.

• Assess the current state of tracking, attribution, performance metrics, reports, dashboards, and models in use, and identify gaps and discrepancies.

• Begin supporting business leaders with relevant paid performance insights and reports for leadership meetings.

In the first three months, expect to:

• Develop proficiency in the marketing data elements of each business and obtain a robust understanding of the paid acquisition funnel from ad spend to revenue.

• Deliver a first version of the marketing data infrastructure and ROAS/LTV reporting for the new businesses, and gain the ability to assess the drivers and impacts of marketing decisions on financial performance.

• Begin identifying new opportunities to explore in the quest to improve performance continually while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first six months, expect to:

• Begin to solve real business problems as a team that will move the needle on key marketing performance metrics and financial performance.

• Help us align and standardize LTV, ROAS, and other metric definitions across the new businesses and the company.

• Perform detailed root cause analysis to expose critical drivers of channel performance, and stand up a repeatable playbook for onboarding the marketing data of newly acquired companies.

In the first year, expect to:

• Inform significant strategic initiatives, goals, priorities, and performance indicators, including budget allocation and channel strategy for the new businesses.

• Become an expert both on marketing process and data flow, and help build an outstanding marketing analytics function for new businesses and M&A.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree is required.

• 3+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence is required, with a focus on marketing analytics.

• Demonstrated experience analyzing paid advertising performance (e.g., Google Ads and other paid media platforms) and translating it into metrics such as LTV, CAC, and ROAS is required.

• Demonstrated experience building or owning marketing data infrastructure (tracking, attribution, data pipelines, and reporting) is required.

• Both a strong background in math, science, finance, engineering, or statistics and deep business insight is required; advanced degrees and/or MBA are a plus.

• Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, etc.).

• Proficiency in SQL; experience with R, Python, or MATLAB is a plus.

• Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to support analysis, automation, and reporting.

• Experience with exploratory data analysis, prototyping, testing hypotheses, performing root cause analyses, modeling business processes, building forecasts, creating predictive models, defining metrics, and/or measuring marketing performance.

• Track record of linking data and analytics to marketing strategy, financial performance, and operations to drive real impact.

• Working knowledge of probability and statistics, experience with process improvement is a plus.

• Experience in a startup, early-stage business, or M&A integration environment is a plus.

• Proven ability to manage diverse stakeholders and balance multiple, conflicting priorities in a fast-moving environment.

• Ability to explain complex issues simply and intuitively, and willingness to challenge assumptions, communicate limitations, and flag blind spots.

• The ideal candidate needs to have a strong technical background particularly when it comes to marketing data infrastructure and Google products (Google Analytics, Google Ads) while having the ability to master marketing processes of diverse nature.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

• You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal . You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Work Details:

• Contract job (Freelance Contract).

• Remote.

Recruitment Process:

•
CV Screening: Applications are reviewed within 24 hours.

•
Pre-Screening Interview: A brief Q/A session ( Automated or with a Recruiter ) designed to learn more about your experience related to the required job position.

Automated Session (Recommended) – You can complete this session on your own at a time that is convenient for you. •
Shortlisting: Qualified candidates are presented to the hiring manager for review.

•
Formal Interviews: On-site discussions with the hiring manager or project team, with feedback provided within 1-2 weeks.

•
Offer and Onboarding: Successful candidates receive a formal offer and begin a structured onboarding process.

🚀 The Vision: Building the Operating System for Product Creation

Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software.
We operate two core platforms: Customize Now (our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and Source Anything (our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network).
We are a profitable, previously Silicon Valley-backed, fully remote company, and we are not just looking to improve manufacturing, we are looking for a visionary operator to help us truly revolutionize the global supply chain.

💻 The Role

You will own paid acquisition on Google and Meta, and you will own the result: new-customer revenue at a CAC the business can afford. Not “your campaigns”. The account, the audience, the creative, the landing page brief, the tracking check and the revenue report are all yours.
Two jobs in one. Scale and sharpen a large Google Ads account that already runs on automated bidding. And build Meta from the first campaign: account structure, testing framework, and a system for coming up with and producing creatives.
We do not want a buyer who waits for creatives, or a creative who cannot read a P&L. We want someone who finds the insight in a customer review on Monday, ships five ads built on it by Wednesday, and kills four of them by next week with numbers they can defend.
AI is how you do this alone. Work that used to need a media buyer, a researcher, a designer and an analyst should run through you and your AI workflows.

Why This Role Is Exciting:

• Direct Access to Leadership: You will have the opportunity to work directly with our CEO and executive team, giving you high visibility, direct mentorship, and a seat at the table.

• Product & Strategic Influence: We operate with flat hierarchies. Your daily insights from the ground level will directly shape our product roadmap, workflows, and company strategy.

• Rapid Scale & Career Trajectory: We are growing rapidly. Joining us right now means high autonomy, minimal red tape, and massive room for personal and professional acceleration.

🎯 What You’ll Do

• Google Ads: run and grow a $100k+/month account across Search, PMax, Shopping and YouTube. Get the most out of value-based bidding by feeding it the right signals: conversion values from the CRM, new vs returning customers, margin where we have it

• Meta from zero: design the account structure, set up the testing framework, and build the ideation-to-production line for creatives. Then scale what works

• Audience mining: find who actually buys from us and why. Build targeting from our own data: CRM segments by value and product, customer lists, search terms, PMax audience signals, value-based lookalikes. Know when to go broad and let the creative do the targeting, and when that fails

• Insight mining: dig through reviews (ours and competitors’), sales call transcripts, support tickets, forums and competitor ads. Turn what customers say into angles, in their own words

• Creative ideation: run a steady flow of new concepts, each built on a stated insight and a hypothesis. Angle, hook, format, then iterations on the winners. Judge creatives by angle and hook, not only by ad

• Creative production with AI: produce statics, UGC-style video and motion with AI. Brief our designer when a human hand is needed

• Unit economics: know the CAC we can pay per product and market, and set bids, budgets and targets from it, not from platform ROAS

• Incrementality and attribution: design holdout, geo or lift tests when the money at stake justifies it. Treat attribution as a tool for decisions, and say where it is blind

• Testing: one hypothesis, one primary metric, enough budget and time to read it. Log every test, win or lose

• Tracking: check that conversions reach the platforms correctly (GA4, GTM, CAPI, offline conversions) and flag what breaks

• Specialists: spot early when results depend on something outside your direct scope: server-side tracking, landing page CRO, video production, feed management, localisation. Come with a proposal: who to bring in (freelancer or agency), the brief, the cost and what it should change. Then manage them to the result

• New channels: we plan to test channels beyond Google and Meta. Come with a clear launch approach for each: why this channel for our customers, what to test first, the budget and time needed to get a readable result, how it is tracked to revenue, and when to kill it or scale it

• Reporting: weekly spend, new customers, CAC and revenue by channel, with the source and definition of every number .

💡 The Profile We’re Looking For (Our Core Pillars)

Our CEO defines our top performers by three distinct traits. If this describes how you operate, you will thrive here:

• Raw Intelligence & Problem-Solving: High processing power, business acumen, and logical reasoning. You can think on your feet, connect complex ideas, and break down ambiguous problems quickly.

• "Give a Shit" Energy (Extreme Ownership): You take 100% accountability for your domain and outcomes. You don't make excuses or blame external factors. You look inward, find solutions, and push across the finish line.

• Rapid Adaptation & Radical Candor: You embrace blunt, constructive feedback and pivot instantly without ego. You excel in a fast-moving environment where you need to act with urgency without waiting for hand-holding.

Requirements:

• 5+ years of hands-on paid acquisition. You built and ran the accounts yourself

• You have personally managed $50k+ a month on Google Ads and know automated bidding well: tROAS, tCPA, value-based bidding, PMax. You know when it fails and why

• You have built a Meta account from scratch, not only inherited one

• Unit economics is how you think: margin, AOV, LTV, payback, break-even CAC. This is mandatory

• You have optimised toward new-customer revenue, not all conversions

• You build audiences from first-party data and research, and can show where your best audience came from

• You come up with creative concepts yourself, and can trace each winner back to the customer insight behind it. Bring a portfolio

• You have run or read incrementality tests and can explain what attribution windows and models hide

• You can explain how a sale in the CRM gets back to Google and Meta, and what breaks on the way

• You have hired, briefed and managed freelancers or agencies on your own initiative, because the result needed it, not because someone told you to

• You have launched at least one new paid channel from zero and can walk us through how you decided it worked or did not

• Campaigns for a product sold across several countries

•
English level: C1/C2

The AI-first bar
We will ask you to show this, not tell it.

• You use AI daily for research: reviews, call transcripts, competitor ads, search terms

• You generate creatives with image and video models and know which model fits which job

• You use AI to build custom reports and visualisations from raw data, instead of waiting for an analyst or a BI dashboard

postings.descriptionText:
Job Description: PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA)
Department: Enterprise Security & Technology Risk Management Location: Regionwide
Reports To: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview
The PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) is responsible for ensuring that our client from banking industry complies with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS). The ISA will assess, monitor, and enforce the security measures necessary to protect cardholder data and maintain PCI compliance across all systems and processes. This role works closely with internal stakeholders and external parties to maintain a secure environment, mitigate risks, and improve overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities:

• PCI DSS Compliance Management:
• Conduct regular internal assessments and audits to ensure the organization's compliance with PCI DSS.

Develop and implement PCI compliance policies, procedures, and controls.

• Serve as the internal point of contact for PCI DSS-related matters and ensure all applicable security controls are in place.

• Collaborate with the external Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) to facilitate annual PCI DSS certification audits.

Documentation and Reporting:

• Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including policies, procedures, and reports required for PCI DSS compliance.

• Maintain comprehensive documentation of assessment findings, corrective actions, and compliance status.

• Manage the submission of the Self-Assessment Questionnaires (SAQs) and Attestation of Compliance documents (AOCs) as needed.

Qualifications:

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field (or

equivalent work experience).

• Experience:

• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in information security, PCI compliance, or a related field.

• Previous experience as an ISA, QSA, or a similar role is highly desirable.

• Certifications:
• Certified PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) or Certified PCI Professional (PCIP) certifications preferred.

Additional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CEH are a plus.

• Skills and Competencies:

• Deep understanding of PCI DSS requirements and data security best practices.

• Familiarity with security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls) and security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, encryption, etc.).

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross- functionally.

• Proficiency in using security assessment tools and techniques (e.g., vulnerability scanners, SIEM).

Other Requirements:
Ability to work independently and handle sensitive information confidentially.

• Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.

• Occasional travel may be required for audits or compliance reviews.

• Risk Assessment and Mitigation:

• Identify and assess potential risks to cardholder data environments and provide recommendations for risk mitigation.

• Implement and enforce necessary security controls to address gaps identified during assessments.

• Ensure vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and security reviews are conducted to identify weaknesses and ensure continuous compliance.

• Training and Awareness:

• Conduct internal PCI DSS training for staff to ensure a deep understanding of the importance of compliance and security measures.

• Provide ongoing guidance and support to departments regarding security best practices related to PCI DSS.

• Collaboration and Communication:

• Work closely with projects, Enterprise Security, Technology, and other relevant departments to align PCI DSS compliance with overall security policies and practices.

• Proactively identify and/or promptly escalate risks and issues affecting PCI compliance status.

• Stay updated on changes in PCI DSS requirements and industry best practices to ensure our client from banking industry remains compliant.

• Present PCI DSS compliance status reports to senior management and external stakeholders.

• Act as a liaison where necessary between our client from banking industry and external vendors or service providers involved in processing or storing cardholder data.

Responsibilities

• Manage maintenance and facilities service requests from initial ticket intake through job completion, invoicing, and closeout.

• Review incoming client tickets and classify each request according to trade, urgency, scope, and service requirements.

• Confirm site contacts, access instructions, and relevant job details before vendor dispatch.

• Identify emergency or highly urgent requests and quickly coordinate with the appropriate dispatch resources.

• Source qualified third-party vendors primarily through proactive outbound phone calls.

• Conduct early vendor qualification conversations, including commercial questions related to availability, pricing, scope, and ability to perform the work.

• Share photos and job information with vendors during calls and verbally confirm that all relevant materials have been received and understood.

• Schedule and coordinate site visits between vendors and facility contacts.

• Organize multiple vendor visits efficiently for non-emergency jobs requiring competing bids, including scheduling offset visits on the same day when appropriate.

• Reconfirm appointments approximately 24 hours in advance to minimize missed visits and delays.

• Pursue remote estimates whenever possible to accelerate the quoting process.

• Review, compare, and negotiate vendor quotes, challenging initial estimates when appropriate and balancing cost with turnaround time.

• Confirm that Certificates of Insurance contain the correct required parties and information.

• Follow up promptly on missing documentation rather than allowing paperwork gaps to delay job execution.

• Oversee active work orders by holding vendors accountable to agreed timelines, pricing, and scope.

• Coordinate site access and resolve logistical issues that could prevent or delay completion.

• Address scope changes before additional work is performed and obtain the appropriate approvals when required.

• Maintain proactive communication with clients throughout the job rather than waiting for clients to request updates.

• Confirm completed work through vendor photos, site confirmation, and other required documentation.

• Compare completed work and final invoices against the originally approved scope.

• Route incomplete work or punch-list items back to vendors before considering a job complete.

• Review, approve, and submit vendor invoices according to established processes.

• Follow up on client approvals and resolve pricing or billing discrepancies.

• Close completed jobs in the system with complete documentation and an accurate record of all relevant communications and approvals.

Requirements

• Previous experience with cold calling, vendor coordination, operations, dispatch, service coordination, or another phone-intensive position.

• Highly proactive approach to follow-up and problem solving.

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to capture, remember, and retrieve important information across multiple active jobs.

• Strong questioning skills and willingness to gather enough information before making decisions or moving a job forward.

• Excellent communication habits, including proactive and frequent updates to stakeholders.

• Strong attention to detail and disciplined documentation practices.

• Ability to treat required paperwork and pre-work documentation as mandatory rather than optional.

• Ability to remain composed and effective in a fast-paced, high-volume environment involving urgent requests.

Qualifications

Previous experience in a facilities-related role is strongly preferred , such as facilities coordination, property maintenance, field service coordination, maintenance operations, property operations, or vendor/service management.

•
Working knowledge of the facilities service lifecycle , including work-order intake, vendor dispatch, site access, quoting, approvals, service completion, documentation, and invoice closeout.

The Talent Acquisition Analyst will support recruitment activities including sourcing, screening, and coordinating interviews for a variety of roles. • Experience coordinating with hiring managers and supporting end-to-end hiring processes.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint); Teams experience preferred.

Must-Have Requirements

• Minimum of 3+ years of recruiting experience.

• Genuinely flexible and adaptable as business needs evolve.

• Stable, reliable internet connection

• Professional and dedicated remote working setup.

Preferred Background / Industry Experience:

• Experience in fast-paced or high-volume recruitment environments (agency or in-house).

• Exposure to international hiring or remote/global recruitment is preferred.

• Experience supporting hiring for corporate, operational, or technical roles is a plus.

Benefits

💰 USD compensation

🌍 Fully remote — work from wherever you do your best work!

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
We are currently seeking a Senior AWS Integration Developer - Remote to join our team in Halifax, Nova Scotia (CA-NS), Canada (CA).

Senior AWS Integration Developer

Position Overview
We are seeking a Senior AWS Integration Developer to design, develop, and support modern, enterprise-scale integration solutions across cloud, on-premises, and third-party applications.
This is a hands-on development role for an experienced integration engineer who is passionate about AWS, serverless architecture, APIs, event-driven integration, and modern software development . You will work with technologies including Python, C#/.NET, AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, S3, DynamoDB, and CloudWatch to build secure, scalable, and highly reliable integration services.
The successful candidate will bring strong software engineering fundamentals, experience solving complex integration challenges, and the ability to work collaboratively with architects, developers, business analysts, and application teams.

Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade integration solutions using Python and C#/.NET.

• Build serverless and event-driven architectures using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, and SNS.

• Design and develop REST APIs, microservices, and integration services connecting cloud, on-premises, and third-party applications.

• Develop reliable, scalable workflows for data movement, application integration, orchestration, and business process automation .

• Integrate enterprise applications and business platforms through secure, well-designed APIs and services.

• Apply software engineering best practices around code quality, security, scalability, resiliency, observability, and performance .

• Implement logging, monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting using Amazon CloudWatch and related AWS services .

• Diagnose and resolve complex integration, application, and production issues.

• Optimize existing integrations for performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost efficiency .

• Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, infrastructure automation, and DevOps practices .

• Participate in architecture and technical design discussions and help identify opportunities to modernize legacy integration patterns.

• Work closely with solution architects, business analysts, developers, infrastructure teams, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other developers and contribute to development standards and best practices.

Required Qualifications

• 10+ years of professional software development and integration experience.

• 5+ years of hands-on experience with Python and C#/.NET development.

•
5+ years of hands-on AWS development experience , including significant experience with:

• AWS Lambda

• AWS Step Functions

• API Gateway

• EventBridge

• SQS and SNS

• S3

• DynamoDB

• CloudWatch

• Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs and microservices .

• Demonstrated experience building serverless and event-driven integration solutions .

• Experience integrating cloud, on-premises, and third-party applications .

• Strong understanding of integration patterns, API design, asynchronous messaging, workflow orchestration, and distributed systems.

• Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated deployments, and modern DevOps practices .

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum or similar software development environments .

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

•
AWS Certified Developer – Associate/Professional or AWS Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional certification.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK .

• Experience with Docker and containerized applications .

• Knowledge of API security, OAuth 2.0, JWT, IAM, and enterprise security practices .

• Experience with automated testing and test-driven development.

• Experience modernizing legacy integrations into cloud-native and serverless architectures .

Why Join This Team?
This is an opportunity to play a key role in building modern, cloud-native integration capabilities within an enterprise environment. You will work on meaningful integration challenges, leverage some of AWS's most powerful serverless and event-driven technologies, and have the opportunity to influence how applications and platforms connect across the organization.
If you are a senior software engineer who enjoys solving complex integration problems, building scalable AWS solutions, and working with modern cloud technologies , we'd like to hear from you.

Pay Transparency
Where required by law, NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this remote role is $92,408-$171,125. NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. 1. Action (verb)

Develops

Object / what it involves
people change management strategies and plans for assigned major projects and programmes, in collaboration with the Associate Director, analysing stakeholders, defining change
objectives, and assessing impacts on constituent groups

End result / outcome
to address the needs and concerns of impacted groups to ensure effective and efficient implementation within budget and timeframes, enabling benefits realization and successful adoption.

2. Action (verb)

Partners

Object / what it involves
With project stakeholders and sponsors / business SMEs to identify and assess the people-related impacts of the change initiative, including new technologies, processes, structures, and

regulations

to better understand the needs, expectations, and concerns of each stakeholder group and how these can be mitigated for those affected by the change to enable optimum adoption and business

Coordinates

Object / what it involves
change activities with change partners, project managers, and business sponsors, establishing clear roles and responsibilities and maintaining regular

communication

to ensure alignment, optimum adoption and mitigate change saturation.

Designs & implements

Object / what it involves
tailored training and coaching programmes and materials, in collaboration with the Talent Acquisition & Development team as required and maybe required to facilitate on occasion.

to enable employees to acquire the necessary knowledge and skills for successful change adoption.

the consistent presentation of new process and technology design elements in all media (internally & external), e.g., presentations to be delivered at meetings, web sites, memos, speeches, print, etc. in collaboration with Marketing & Communications

End result / outcome
to ensure all users understand and accept impacts on roles, policies and business impacts to minimize any potential organizational obstacles and educate audiences (including customers) of the change.

Contributes & supports

Object / what it involves
to the people change management practice development initiatives, including the development of new methodologies, tools, and emerging

change techniques

To enhance the quality and effectiveness of change management within the Bank.

postings.title: Senior Business Analyst - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction.
