With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

• Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.

• Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.

• Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.

• Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.

• Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.

• Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.

• Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.

• Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.

• Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.

• Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.

• Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.

• Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.

• Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.

• Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements

• 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.

• Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.

• Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.

• Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).

• Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.

• Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.

• Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have

• Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.

• Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).

• Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.

• Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.

• Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits

• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

postings.title: Technical Project Manager, Systems Engineering, Global
postings.descriptionText:
About Nscale

Nscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI. We own and operate the full stack — energy, data centres, GPU superclusters, orchestration, and AI services — delivering high-performance infrastructure to AI-native companies, enterprises, and governments across Europe and the US. We are deploying GPU capacity at hyperscale, operating some of the densest, most advanced AI infrastructure in the world.
At Nscale , our Global Data Centre Systems Engineering team designs, standardises, and scales the systems that keep our data centres running at peak performance. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscale r, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role
Nscale is hiring a Technical Program Manager to drive strategic, cross-functional initiatives within Global Data Centre Systems Engineering. This role combines program management, process engineering, and business analysis to turn operational needs into clear, measurable delivery plans and scalable solutions.
You will connect data centre infrastructure teams with partner functions across Nscale , leading discovery, defining requirements, coordinating delivery, and communicating progress and business value for initiatives with senior leadership visibility.
Experience required: 5+ years in technical program management, project management, PMO operations, business analysis, or program coordination within infrastructure, industrial, hardware-intensive, or similarly complex environments.

What You'll be Doing

• Lead strategic initiatives. Own cross-functional work across analytics, metrics, data integrations, operational tooling, and systems engineering initiatives.
- Own delivery discipline. Plan and govern scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, stakeholder communications, and measurable outcomes.
- Lead discovery and assessment. Run cross-functional sessions to understand business needs, operational pain points, process gaps, and technical requirements; assess current-state workflows and recommend practical future-state options.
- Translate needs into execution. Define clear business and system requirements, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and delivery plans.
- Engineer scalable processes. Create and maintain process maps, workflow diagrams, swim lanes, systems diagrams, and other visual documentation; facilitate walkthroughs to confirm alignment.
- Standardise where it matters. Promote harmonised standards, validation practices, and documentation while accounting for site-specific operational requirements.
- Coordinate the full lifecycle. Guide initiatives from discovery and requirements through implementation, adoption, and operational handoff.
- Communicate progress and value. Develop technical and executive-ready reporting that makes progress, risks, decisions, outcomes, and business value clear.
- Maintain operational rigour. Apply relevant software development lifecycle methodologies.

About You

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience in technical program management, project management, PMO operations, business analysis, or program coordination within infrastructure, industrial, hardware-intensive, or similarly complex environments.
- Experience delivering projects using waterfall, hybrid, and agile methodologies.
- Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from discovery through implementation and operational adoption.
- Strong expertise in requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, business and systems documentation, process mapping, and gap analysis.
- Hands-on experience with project and work management tools such as Planview, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Jira, or equivalent platforms, and diagramming tools such as Lucidchart, Figma, Visio, or mind-mapping software, with the ability to quickly learn Nscale 's tools.
- Strong organisational skills and sound judgement when managing multiple concurrent priorities in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.
- Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
- Comfort working with KPI and SLA data to identify trends, surface insights, and support decision-making.
- Ability to build consensus and maintain effective working relationships across organisational boundaries.
- Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time, as needed.

Nice to Have

• An advanced degree in a relevant field.
- Professional certification such as PMP, SAFe, or a comparable program, project, or agile credential.

- Experience with Lean or Six Sigma.

• Experience supporting executive communications and decision-making forums.
- Experience in data centre infrastructure, operational technology, or large-scale infrastructure delivery environments.

Why this role matters
Your success will be measured by the impact you have across our global data centre footprint, including:

• Documented, understood, and adopted workflows for priority systems engineering processes and systems.
- Improved program delivery discipline, including project management compliance and timely risk and dependency escalation.
- Cohesive views and presentations that support better operational and leadership decisions.
- Reduced redundant tooling and broader availability of governed, quality-scored data for critical assets.
- Clear translation of technical delivery progress into measurable business impact for leadership.

What We Can Offer You
At Nscale , you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

• Highly competitive package, including base salary and equity, with reviews every 12 months.
- Join one of the fastest-growing tech startups: your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI.
- Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support.
- Human-first flexibility. We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscale rs to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.
- Join our thriving remote-first team. Geography is no barrier to impact or connection. We build seamless virtual collaboration, empowering you wherever you work.

Equal Opportunities Statement
At Nscale , we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enrich our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.
If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.
For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee & Candidate Privacy Notice: Here.

Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.

postings.title: Social Media Content Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Description
🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.
We are looking for an autonomous, growth-minded Social Media Content Manager to take 100% ownership of our US Instagram presence (along with Threads & LinkedIn). In this role, you won't just post content - you’ll own the entire strategy: revamping our profile storefront for a tech-savvy audience and building a seamless bridge between high-performing Meta Ads and our profile content to turn visitors into buyers.

What you will do

•
Own the Social Media Channels: Take full end-to-end ownership of our Instagram account, extending distribution to Threads and LinkedIn to drive audience engagement in the US market.

•
Repackage the Instagram Storefront: Revamp profile highlights, pinned posts, and top-of-feed content to clearly communicate updated product value propositions.

•
Bridge Ads to Profile: Sync social content with active Meta Ad campaigns, ensuring users landing from ads see consistent messaging, proof points, and value promises that drive conversions.

•
Build & Execute the Content Strategy: Create and manage a structured content calendar featuring high-engagement formats (carousels, reels, interactive posts, and compelling copy).

•
Direct Creative Production: Set clear briefs and collaborate seamlessly with in-house copywriters, graphic designers, and SEO managers to produce high-quality assets.

•
Track & Optimize Metrics: Monitor core engagement metrics (saves, shares, reach, ER) and continuously iterate on content tactics based on data and audience feedback.

Requirements

•
Channel Ownership: Take full end-to-end ownership of the Instagram account (with cross-posting to Threads and LinkedIn), driving content strategy, execution, and engagement for our US audience.

•
Profile Packaging & Value Proposition: Re-pack and maintain the Instagram storefront (Highlights, pinned posts, and top feed) to clearly communicate updated product value propositions.

•
Ad-to-Profile Funnel Matching: Align social content with active performance marketing campaigns (Meta Ads) to ensure a seamless post-click user journey that reinforces ad promises and drives conversion.

•
Content Planning & Execution: Develop and manage a consistent content calendar tailored to a tech-savvy, English-speaking audience, focusing on high-engagement formats (carousels, reels, copy).

•
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Brief and direct internal team members (copywriters, graphic designers, SEO managers) and external creative vendors (motion designers) to produce high-quality assets.

•
Performance Tracking: Monitor key social metrics (engagement rate, saves, shares, reach) and iterate on content strategy based on data and audience feedback.

What we can offer you

•
100% Remote: Freedom to work from anywhere (Europe, LATAM, Georgia, Serbia, etc.)

•
Full Ownership & Creative Freedom: End-to-end ownership of the social media channels with room to test new ideas, experiment with formats, and directly influence conversion metrics.

•
Strong Team Support: Dedicated internal resources at your disposal, including graphic designers, copywriters, and SEO managers to help execute your vision.

•
International Impact: Hands-on experience scaling social channels for a fast-growing EdTech product in the US market.

•
Dynamic Startup Environment: Fast-paced, low-bureaucracy environment with direct access to decision-makers and modern AI/marketing tools.

postings.descriptionText:
Design Team Administrative Assistant
$1,200–$1,700 USD/month | Full-Time MST hours | Remote from LATAM

About the Opportunity
Our client is a premium U.S.-based residential interior design firm specializing in creating thoughtfully designed homes with an exceptional client experience. Their team manages multiple design projects simultaneously and prides itself on delivering organized, detail-driven service from concept through installation.
They are seeking a Design Team Administrative Assistant to provide operational and administrative support to their design team. This role is heavily focused on purchasing, project coordination, documentation, and client communication throughout active design projects.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is highly organized, proactive, experienced supporting a design or creative business, and comfortable taking ownership of processes with minimal supervision.

What You'll Do

Purchasing & Procurement

• Place and manage product orders for active interior design projects.

• Monitor project purchasing budgets and pace purchases appropriately to stay within spending limits.

• Track orders across multiple vendors, ensuring products are shipped, delivered, and received on schedule.

• Coordinate time-sensitive deliveries with installers to maintain project timelines.

• Maintain accurate purchasing records within project management software.

• Communicate regularly with warehouse teams regarding deliveries, damaged items, and inventory status.

• Verify project completion by confirming all products have been received prior to installation.

• Resolve delayed, missing, or damaged orders while coordinating replacements or reorders.

Project Coordination

• Serve as a key point of coordination between clients, designers, and internal team members.

• Maintain project documentation and organize project files.

• Send onboarding materials and project checklists to new clients.

• Keep project management systems updated with current task status and deadlines.

• Conduct routine project audits to ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time.

Design Administration

• Prepare client presentation materials for design meetings.

• Distribute presentation packages prior to scheduled client calls.

• Document meeting notes, key decisions, and next steps following client meetings.

• Help ensure project deliverables remain organized, accurate, and on schedule throughout the design process.

Client Communication

• Send project handoff communications once designs are completed.

• Create short instructional videos to help clients navigate their design files.

• Send reminders regarding purchasing deadlines and project milestones.

• Respond to client inquiries after project delivery, escalating complex requests when necessary.

Post-Project Support

• Prepare installation guides using established templates.

• Coordinate replacement requests and manage out-of-stock product selections.

• Review client revision requests before escalating them to senior designers.

Systems & Operational Support

• Maintain digital product libraries and internal design resources.

• Update affiliate purchasing links where applicable.

•
Keep online product collections current.

• Maintain internal documentation as processes evolve.

• Provide ongoing administrative support to designers and project teams to ensure projects move efficiently.

What We're Looking For

Experience

• 1–3 years of experience as a Virtual Assistant, Project Coordinator, Administrative Assistant, or Operations Coordinator.

• Previous experience supporting an interior design firm, architecture practice, or creative agency is strongly preferred.

Organization & Attention to Detail

• Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Strong attention to detail, particularly with purchasing, documentation, and order tracking.

Industry Knowledge

• Familiarity with purchasing workflows, trade vendors, purchase orders, lead times, and U.S. measurements.

Self-Starter

• Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, growing business.

• Takes initiative and proactively identifies solutions without requiring constant direction.

Systems & Process Oriented

• Enjoys working within structured processes while continuously improving them.

• Confident using project management software and documentation systems.

Communication

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Professional and polished when interacting with clients, vendors, and internal teams.

Team Mindset

• Anticipates the needs of designers and proactively removes administrative tasks from their workload.

• Collaborative, dependable, and committed to delivering an exceptional client experience.

Adaptability

•
Learns new systems quickly.

• Comfortable working in an evolving environment where processes continue to improve over time.

postings.title: Data and Analytics Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Analytics Engineer & AI Specialist

About the Role
As Analytics Engineers you would combine insurance domain expertise with full-stack data and analytics engineering capabilities. You will help build the data foundations that power Snowflake's AI platform.
This role is focused on the layers that make AI reliable: clean, well-modeled data, governed pipelines, and semantic models that expose business meaning to natural language interfaces. You will design rigorous data models, build data pipelines, and construct the semantic layer that sits between raw data and AI agents. You will be responsible for setting up data that is structured, trusted, and agent-ready. The deployment patterns and data model gaps you surface feed directly back to LOB teams, making you both a practitioner and a source of signal for what gets built next.

What You'll Work On

Data Modeling and Architecture

• Architect flexible, performant data models that drive LOB team toward single sources of truth across their LOB business domains

• Use SQL, Python, dbt, and Snowflake to build and maintain data infrastructure for reporting, analysis, and automation

• Perform data QA and develop automated testing procedures for Snowflake data models

• Provide input into data governance strategies including permissions, data lineage, and data definitions

• Design Data security so that the model only has access to the data

Semantic Layer and Agent Readiness

• Build semantic data models that expose LOBs data to natural language queries via Cortex Analyst, turning complex schemas into something a business stakeholder and Clients can ask a question of

• Define and validate the metrics, dimensions, and relationships that AI agents need to reason correctly over LOBs data

• IMP

• Identify and resolve gaps in data structure, naming, and coverage that would cause an agent to fail or produce incorrect results

Documentation

• Documented playbooks, reusable data model templates, and semantic model libraries that can be maintained and extend

• Run technical workshops to upskill other team members

• Author semantic view configurations and skill files (YAML + Markdown) that a non-technical analyst can invoke in plain English

Hard Skills Required Must-Have

•
Advanced SQL: CTEs, window functions, incremental pipeline patterns. You can write complex queries without referencing documentation.

•
Analytics engineering and data modeling: Experience building data infrastructure involving large-scale relational datasets; strong instincts for pipeline design, QA, and testing across the full stack from ingestion through semantic layer.

•
dbt: Experience building and maintaining dbt projects with testing, documentation, and CI/CD pipelines.

•
Python: Modern, type-hinted, readable. You understand Python-based data pipelines and automation workflows.

•
AI-assisted development: You have used an LLM coding assistant (CoCo, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) as your primary development environment. Daily usage is the baseline.

•
Semantic modeling: You can write a semantic view configuration or structured skill file that handles edge cases and encodes enough domain knowledge that the model behaves like a subject matter expert.

•
Client-facing communication: You write code, but your output needs to make sense to a business leader who has never opened a terminal. You are the translation layer between what Snowflake's AI can do and what the customer actually needs.

•
Snowflake Cortex: Cortex Analyst, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, semantic views, Dynamic Tables.

Strong Plus

• Experience with Airflow or other orchestration frameworks.

• Familiarity with enterprise business systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS, or similar).

Soft Skills Required

•
Owns the outcome: Tracks adoption after go-live, identifies stall points, and re-engages until the data product is reliable and can be handed over to run teams.

•
Codifies, doesn't customize: Instinct is to turn patterns into reusable templates and playbooks that the next engineer can deploy at the next customer, not to build bespoke every time.

•
Comfortable with ambiguity: Engages with customers to derive requirements, prototypes fast, gathers feedback, and iterates.

•
Signal clarity: Distills messy deployments into clean, actionable feedback for Leaders, explaining root causes and suggesting fixes, not just reporting problems.

Minimum Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical role, with at least a portion of it customer-facing or cross-functional

• Daily use of an AI coding assistant as a primary development tool

• Proficient in SQL; can write window functions and complex joins without referencing documentation

• Experience with dbt

• Has shipped production data model or pipeline that non-technical business users actually relied on

• Comfortable in Git (PRs, branches, code review)

• Demonstrable experience translating business requirements into technical specifications

Why This Role Is Different
Most analytics engineering roles stop at the data model. Most field roles stop at the recommendation. This role starts where both leave off. You own the full data stack from source ingestion to semantic layer, and you ensure every layer is clean, tested, and structured for AI agents to reason over reliably. You write the code. You build the semantic foundation. You make sure it runs in production and the run team can maintain it.
Why Join Nimble Gravity ?
You'll help leading financial institutions and other clients adopt AI in meaningful ways. You'll work directly with clients, engineers, and AI specialists to turn emerging technology into measurable business outcomes. If you enjoy teaching, facilitating, influencing, and helping people embrace new ways of working, we'd love to talk.
Nimble Gravity is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
We do not sponsor H1B visas

postings.title: Business Analyst - Caribbean
postings.descriptionText:
Business Analyst
The Business Analyst will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams. The individual will be responsible for understanding and analyzing business needs, defining solutions (both process and technical), and ensuring that project deliverables align with business objectives while minimizing risk. The role will involve collaborating across multiple departments and working with stakeholders at all levels to ensure successful project outcomes. The Business Analyst will contribute to the design, development, and delivery of robust solutions that enhance business processes and optimize the use of technology.

Key Responsibilities

•
Research & Situational Analysis: Conduct research and documentation reviews to critically evaluate the internal and external conditions that affect the organization or business unit, identifying opportunities and current challenges to the business unit, services or products.

•
Performance Metrics: Develop and implement performance metrics to measure the success of a process change or solution implementation. Establish baselines before testing and rollout of proposed changes. Conduct post-implementation reviews to confirm objectives achieved and benefits realized, identifying unexpected benefits achieved.

•
Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of business processes, systems, and needs by engaging with stakeholders to gather detailed requirements and translate them into clear and actionable business and functional requirements. Capture, analyze and document the current state of existing processes and define proposed future states, including documenting the results of conducted gap analysis to achieve the desired future state.

•
Business Process Improvement: Thoroughly analyze existing business processes, identify areas of improvement, and recommend solutions to enhance efficiency, streamline operations, and improve business performance, including opportunities for automation and digitization. Ensure proposed processes within identified solutions are optimized and required controls are in place. Define and deliver on process strategies to identify best fit.

•
Solution Design & Development: Collaborate with business and IT teams to design and propose optimized process and technical solutions that meet business needs, ensuring alignment with overall business strategy and project objectives. Conduct solution evaluation activities at applicable phases in its development to verify the business needs have been satisfied and identify recommended changes that will maximise the value of the solution and improve its performance.

•
Impact Analysis and Risk Management: Assess the impact of proposed changes to systems, solutions and users, identifying potential risks and challenges. Assess and develop strategies for risk mitigation associated with the proposed changes. Develop data models to analyze and illustrate the potential impact of change on different aspects of the organization or system.

•
Project Management Support: Work closely with project managers to define scope, objectives, and deliverables. Participate in project planning, risk management, and issue resolution activities to ensure project timelines and objectives are met.

•
Cross-Segment Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement process and solution improvement initiatives, utilizing techniques such as focus groups and brainstorming, and customer journey mapping exercises.

•
Stakeholder Communication & Management: Conduct comprehensive stakeholder analysis, including the development of stakeholder maps and communication plans. Deliver effective communication strategies and establish strong relationships with key stakeholders throughout their lifecycle to secure buy-in and approval for proposed changes. Act as the liaison between business and technical teams, ensuring clear communication to meet both functional and technical requirements. Provide regular updates to stakeholders on project status and potential risks. Support organizational change management activities to ensure smooth adoption of new processes and systems by preparing stakeholders, fostering buy-in, and managing expectations.

•
Testing & Validation: Assist in developing and executing test plans to ensure that solutions meet the defined requirements. Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and troubleshoot any issues identified during the testing phase.

•
Documentation & Training: Develop and maintain detailed documentation, including business requirements, process flows, and user manuals. Facilitate training sessions for end-users to ensure they can effectively use new systems and processes.

•
Data Analysis & Reporting: Provide data analysis and reporting capabilities to inform decision-making. Identify trends and insights that help the business make informed decisions and improve operations.

•
Cross-Team Collaboration: Engage with Process Analysts, Project Managers, Change Managers, Technical Leads and other Business Analysts on projects and other business-as-usual (BAU) initiatives to effectively deliver of required objectives for solution and process improvement design and deployment. Foster a team approach throughout the project to ensure the delivery of optimized solutions and support adoption by end users.

Critical Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

• Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. A masters degree is a plus.

• 3+ years of experience in business analysis, with a focus on both process and technical solution delivery.

• Experienced working on agile and/or waterfall projects across diverse industries, including finance, retail, and healthcare, with a strong preference for the financial sector.

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge of business analysis methodologies (e.g., BABOK).

• Proficiency in producing quality requirements and process deliverables (e.g., BRDs, use cases, user stories, process maps) and other related documentation.

• Proficiency in process mapping and modeling tools (e.g., Visio) and techniques (e.g., BPMN).

• Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) and enterprise systems (e.g., ERP, CRM).

• Understanding of technical concepts, including databases, APIs, and software development lifecycles (SDLC).

• Data analysis and visualization skills using tools such as Excel, Power BI, or Tableau.

Key Competencies

• Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyze complex business problems and develop innovative, value-driven solutions.

• Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to facilitate collaboration between diverse stakeholders and conduct interviews and elicitation activities.

• Problem-Solving: Proven ability to troubleshoot issues, find root causes, and drive solutions in high-pressure situations.

• Project Management Acumen: Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment and within specified timelines.

• Stakeholder Management: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

• Written skills: Excellent writing skills with strong technical writing and articulation.

• Best practices: Knowledgeable of industry and business analysis best practices and their adaptation and applicability within differing environments.

Certifications (preferred but not required)

• Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) or PMI-PBA certification.

• Agile/Scrum certifications (CSPO, CSM, IIBA-AAC, IIBA-CPOA).

postings.title: Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation
postings.descriptionText:
Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world’s most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that’s challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

• Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks

• Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms

• Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics

• Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge

• Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server

• Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical , you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

• You love technology and working with brilliant people

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar

• You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)

• You have experience working with open source communities and licences

• You have experience working with C, C++

• You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional skills that you might also bring

• Experience with graphics stacks

• Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST

• Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments

• Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience

• IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services

• Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

• Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

• Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Parental Leave

• Employee Assistance Programme

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’

• Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure have become essentials of modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro service architecture or cloud infrastructure.

Here are some examples of projects under way at Canonical.

RustVMM has great potential as a new hypervisor for Linux. We are building a team to work on this, with an emphasis on performance, security and operability. Work in Rust and bring your expert knowledge of VMM and related kernel networking and storage capabilities.

postings.descriptionText:
Are you ready to expand your expertise in U.S. accounting and tax practices while working with a diverse client base across multiple industries? We’re looking for motivated professionals who enjoy variety in their work and are eager to build hands-on experience with U.S. GAAP, tax codes, and business operations.

Who We Are

Manay CPA is a global, full-service accounting and advisory firm headquartered in Atlanta, GA. With over 20 years of experience and a diverse team across 4 continents, we proudly support individuals, entrepreneurs, and businesses of all sizes.

Our services include business formation, accounting, tax, payroll, audit, and HR solutions—delivered with a personalized, relationship-first approach. We partner with clients at every stage of their journey, helping them navigate the complexities of business and finance with confidence.

Recognized as a Top 100 Small Business by the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and a Top 25 Small Business of the Year by the COBB Chamber for four consecutive years, we’re trusted by both local and international clients. Our CEO, Burcu Bree Manay, was also named one of the Top 50 Women in Accounting for her leadership and impact in the field.

At Manay CPA, your growth is our purpose. Join a team where innovation, integrity, and global collaboration drive real success.

Learn more at www.manaycpa.com

We Offer

• Competitive USD base salary based on experience

• Fully remote work anywhere in Turkey

• A collaborative and growth-oriented work environment

• Gain experience with US Accounting and Tax - all backgrounds welcome!

• Opportunities to work with clients in a variety of industries

• Excellent onboarding and ongoing training

• Paid vacation and holidays

• Continued professional development and exposure to a wide range of financial processes

Responsibilities

• Supporting the client onboarding process for all assigned client engagements, following defined procedures.

• Assisting with and executing, as applicable, processes related to accounts payable and accounts receivable management, bookkeeping entries, monthly close activities, and preparation of financial reporting and analysis; may also include payroll and special projects as assigned.

• Demonstrating a solid understanding of professional accounting and bookkeeping practices, including preparing depreciation schedules, sales journals, and sales tax returns, as well as reviewing and reconciling payroll records and employment tax returns.

• Supporting regular and detailed audits to ensure accuracy in financial documents, expenditures, and investments.

• Assisting with revenue forecasting and profit margin analysis.

• Supporting general ledger reconciliation and managing accounts payable and receivable.

• Assisting in the preparation and filing of corporate and individual income tax returns (e.g., annual 1099s, corporate and individual tax filings).

• Assisting with assessing and researching complex tax issues to identify appropriate solutions.

• Assisting with research projects and the preparation of financial reports as needed.

Requirements & Job Skills

• Have a bachelor’s degree in related fields such as accounting, finance, economics, business, etc., (a Master’s degree is a plus!).

• This is an entry-level position . Candidates with up to 2 years of experience are ideal.

• Eager to learn more about US Accounting Systems.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Business English - All interviews will be conducted in English!

• Have extensive knowledge and experience in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel.

• Have a quantitative and analytical mindset with the ability to support complex data analysis and reporting activities.

• Highly dedicated and committed to pursuing a career focusing on accounting and tax.

• Ability to work in ambiguous environments while prioritizing and multitasking in a fast-paced setting.

• Excellent cross-group collaboration skills and teamwork skills.

• Attention to detail and ability to follow standard procedures required.

• Experience with Accounting Software Systems is a big plus!

• US GAAP knowledge/experience is a big plus!

• Location: Home office

• Work hours will be based on US TIME ZONES (EST)

• Travelling might be required

Compensation

Additional Information

As an international company, we kindly request that you add your English resume/CV to your application. Applicants who do not provide an English resume/CV may not be considered.

postings.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
postings.descriptionText:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

•
Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

•
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

•
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

•
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

•
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.

•
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.

•
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.

•
Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.

•
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.

•
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

•
You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.

•
You are fluent in the whole stack , not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.

•
You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.

•
You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.

•
You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.

•
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.

• Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

• "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.

• You want to be told what to do this week.

• You need a ticketing system to know what matters.

• You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting
This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions , we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Solutions & Services

Job Description
La responsabilidad principal de el/la Customer Support Manager (CSM, por sus siglas en inglés) es gestionar de manera eficaz y eficiente el negocio de Gestión y Soporte (M&S) para las asignaciones de contratos de sus clientes y garantizar la satisfacción de los clientes de Seguridad Pública de Motorola. El negocio de M&S es una combinación de proyecciones, propuesta de nuevos servicios y renovaciones de contratos, así como la creación de relaciones con clientes y subcontratistas. Garantizar la satisfacción del cliente implica la correcta entrega y ejecución de los contratos de servicio. Si algún servicio no se realiza según las especificaciones contratadas o un proceso no produce los resultados correctos, el CSM intervendrá para encontrar una solución.

Además, el CSM es el líder técnico y brinda orientación técnica al equipo de soporte, así como en el desarrollo técnico de sus miembros. Garantiza que los ingenieros estén actualizados con las últimas mejoras o versiones.

El/la CSM debe demostrar excelentes habilidades interpersonales y de liderazgo, contar con gran capacidad de comunicación, y ser un modelo a seguir y mentor para el personal.

Funciones y Responsabilidades:

El CSM es responsable del éxito general y de la relación entre las operaciones del cliente, los subcontratistas de Motorola y Motorola. Las responsabilidades clave incluyen:

• Proporcionar a los clientes un único punto de contacto para la gestión de clientes y garantizar la prestación del servicio y el cumplimiento de los Acuerdos de Nivel de Servicio (SLA).

• Trabajar con los clientes para analizar sus inquietudes e impulsar acciones correctivas hasta su cierre.

• Gestionar y mantener el alcance de los servicios según el contrato de servicios y garantizar que los clientes comprendan sus obligaciones con respecto a los entregables del servicio.

• Garantizar que los clientes reciban informes oportunos y adecuados según lo requerido por el Contrato de Servicios.

• Gestionar los entregables de los subcontratistas y su adhesión al alcance y los resultados acordados.

• Gestionar los problemas de calidad del producto según sea necesario (MTN).

• Participar según sea necesario en el proceso de gestión de casos para garantizar una correcta prestación del servicio.

• Asistir a socios y proveedores según sea necesario con problemas de pago y facturación.

• Identificar e implementar áreas de mejora para garantizar una mayor calidad del servicio y la entrega de mejores prácticas.

• Garantizar que toda la documentación operativa se mantenga actualizada y sea relevante.

• Gestionar proveedores externos según sea necesario.

• Gestionar el control de cambios del contrato según sea necesario.

• Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con el Gerente de Programa (PM) de Motorola para proporcionar una transición fluida desde la implementación del proyecto hasta el soporte de garantía y la entrega del servicio. Como parte de este proceso, el CSM Asociado garantiza que existan expectativas y procesos de soporte/servicio claramente documentados para el cliente. Busca comprender las expectativas y necesidades del cliente para garantizar que sus requisitos operativos se identifiquen y respalden adecuadamente, y si no es así, qué servicios adicionales se pueden proponer.

• Trabajar con el cliente y los equipos de soporte en el terreno para crear y/o actualizar los Planes de Soporte al Cliente (CSP) existentes.

• Crear Declaraciones de Trabajo (SOW) para clientes y proveedores de servicios.

• Ejecutar documentos contractuales y obtener órdenes de compra de los clientes.

• Gestionar el proceso de renovación de contratos de servicio para todos los acuerdos de servicio asignados de menor complejidad; incluyendo, entre otros, actualizaciones del inventario del cliente, actualizaciones de SOW, actualizaciones de CSP, actualizaciones/cambios de precios de proveedores externos, Acuerdos de Instalación (redacción, obtención de órdenes de compra y gestión).

• Liderar y gestionar la coordinación de variaciones y otras respuestas a solicitudes de cambio, así como la implementación de los cambios aprobados.

• Supervisar la implementación del cambio en las operaciones de prestación de servicios en coordinación con el cliente.

• Trabajar con los clientes en ventas adicionales o cruzadas (up-sell / cross-sell).

• Participar en la proyección de ingresos y márgenes relacionados con Acuerdos de Mantenimiento, Tickets de Trabajo e Instalaciones.

• Alcanzar el objetivo establecido de renovación puntual de contratos.

• Alcanzar el objetivo establecido de crecimiento de servicios para los contratos asignados.

• Estar disponible fuera del horario laboral para la gestión de escalamientos.

• Desempeñar un rol técnico y brindar liderazgo de soporte técnico a los miembros del equipo.

• Proporcionar orientación técnica al equipo para el soporte al cliente, así como para el desarrollo técnico de los miembros. Garantizar que los ingenieros estén al día con las últimas actualizaciones y/o versiones.

• Documentar con precisión los problemas del producto y transmitir soluciones temporales y fijas a los clientes.

Basic Requirements

• Residencia en Mendoza o alrededores.

postings.title: Sales Engineer / Commerce Integrations Lead
postings.descriptionText:
See something that should exist? Build it.
See a better way? Do it.
At Terrific , every role directly impacts how we grow from product to revenue to customer experience. We’re building the next generation of social commerce through live shopping powered by real-time data and AI.
And we believe customer data should belong to the brands who earn it — not third-party platforms.

Commerce Integrations Lead / Sales Engineer
LATAM · Full-time Contract · Remote
Product & Engineering · eCommerce · Integrations · AI
Start date: September 2026

Integrations & Technical Solutions Lead

LATAM or EMEA · Full-time Contract · Remote
Product & Engineering · eCommerce · Integrations · AI

See something that should connect? Build it.
See a process that should exist? Create it.

At Terrific , we’re building the next generation of social commerce—helping brands turn content, creators, live experiences and AI into commerce they own.

Our technology brings shoppable video, live shopping, interactive timelines, polls and product carousels directly onto a merchant’s website or app.

Now we’re looking for an Commerce Integrations Lead/Sales Engineer to help us connect Terrific to the wider commerce ecosystem—and build the systems that make those connections faster every time.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is not a role where you’ll inherit a finished playbook.

You’ll help write it.

You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Sales and Customer Success to solve the technical problems that determine whether a customer can launch, how quickly they see value and how easily we can support the next merchant.

One day, you may investigate how a global retailer’s cart works across multiple markets. The next, you may build a lightweight integration, help shape a live commercial opportunity, automate part of our technical-discovery process or prepare an app for a commerce marketplace.

You’ll work directly with teammates and customers across Latin America, Europe, Israel and the United States. You’ll have visibility into the full journey—from the first sales conversation through integration, launch and ongoing performance.

If you enjoy moving between technology, customers and commercial problems—and want the freedom to build rather than simply maintain—this role offers unusual room to make an impact.

WHAT YOU’LL BUILD

Terrific needs to connect with the platforms and tools merchants already use.

You’ll help us expand and improve integrations across:

•
Shopify

•
VTEX

•
Adobe Commerce/Magento

•
WooCommerce

•
Salesforce Commerce Cloud

•
BigCommerce

•
Tiendanube/Nuvemshop

•
Wix

•
PrestaShop

•
Shopware

• Custom and headless commerce environments

•
Native mobile applications

You’ll also explore integrations with platforms such as Klaviyo, Attentive, Gorgias, Zendesk, Yotpo, Segment, Zapier, Google Merchant Center and Meta Commerce Manager.

Over time, you’ll help Terrific build a stronger marketplace presence, a more repeatable onboarding process and a technical integration layer that can scale across customers and markets.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

• Investigating merchant websites, applications and commerce stacks.

• Understanding how product catalogs, variants, carts and checkout flows work.

• Assessing technical feasibility for active commercial opportunities.

• Turning customer requirements into clear technical recommendations.

• Building, testing and improving integrations across major ecommerce platforms.

• Helping merchants move from signed agreement to their first live Terrific experience.

• Working directly with customer engineers and internal commercial teams.

• Supporting technical discovery, proposals, security reviews and proofs of concept.

• Improving the reliability of product feeds, event tracking, cart actions and embeds.

• Publishing and maintaining Terrific apps across relevant commerce marketplaces.

• Building tools, scripts, automations and AI agents that make integration work faster.

• Turning repeated customer friction into clear Product and Engineering priorities.

• Creating the documentation and processes that will support future customers and teammates.

You won’t be expected to solve everything alone. You will be expected to take ownership, bring the right people together and move the problem forward.

WHO YOU ARE

You’re technical, curious and commercially aware.

You want to understand why something matters to the customer—not only how it works in the code.

You’re comfortable opening DevTools, tracing an API request, reading someone else’s implementation and building a practical solution. You can move from a technical conversation with engineers to a commercial conversation with Sales or a customer without losing the thread.

You communicate clearly, ask good questions and know when to challenge an assumption.

You don’t need every process to be defined before you begin. You like taking something that is currently handled differently each time and turning it into a system the company can reuse.

You also understand that speed and judgment matter in a startup. Sometimes the right answer is a full integration. Sometimes it is a simpler path that gets the customer live this week.

HOW YOU’LL USE AI

Terrific is AI-native by default.

We don’t treat AI as a separate initiative or an occasional productivity tool. We use it as part of how we investigate, build, document and improve our work.

In this role, you’ll have the freedom to use AI to:

• Accelerate technical discovery and research.

•
Generate and test scripts.

•
Automate repetitive integration tasks.

•
Build internal agents and tools.

• Improve documentation and knowledge sharing.

• Monitor integrations and identify problems earlier.

• Help non-technical teams access technical answers faster.

We’re interested in what you can build with AI—not whether you use a particular tool.

The goal is to create leverage for the whole company, not simply complete your own work faster.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• At least three years of hands-on development or technical integration experience.

• Production experience with at least two major ecommerce platforms.

• Experience working with APIs, product feeds, webhooks, authentication, carts or checkout flows.

• Ability to read unfamiliar code, write working scripts and debug browser or network behavior.

• Experience working directly with customers, merchants or external technical teams.

•
Clear written and verbal communication.

• Good judgment about effort, risk and commercial value.

• Comfort working independently within a distributed, international team.

•
Professional fluency in English.

• Professional fluency in Spanish or Portuguese.

Experience with live shopping, social commerce, video commerce, marketplace apps or large international retailers is a strong advantage.

French is valuable for our EMEA accounts.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first months, you will:

• Build a clear picture of Terrific ’s current integration landscape.

• Take ownership of live customer integration work.

• Create a repeatable approach to technical discovery and feasibility.

• Reduce the time between signed agreement and customer launch.

• Improve how Sales, Product, Engineering and Customer Success work together.

• Move new platform integrations into production.

• Help define which marketplace and partner integrations we build next.

• Introduce automations and AI-powered workflows that save the team time.

• Create a roadmap for how Terrific ’s integration ecosystem should grow.

Success is not following a process perfectly.

Success is leaving us with a better process than the one you joined.

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

Many technical integration roles begin with a ticket and end when the ticket is closed.

This one begins with a customer opportunity.

You’ll see how technical decisions affect sales, launch timelines, customer experience and revenue. You’ll work across teams and countries, with direct access to the people making product and commercial decisions.

You’ll have meaningful freedom to decide how problems should be approached, which tools should be built and what Terrific ’s integration function should become.

There is no process set in stone—and that is the opportunity.

REQUIRED

• Based in Latin America—preferably Mexico, Argentina, Brazil or Colombia—or within a compatible EMEA time zone.

• Available for a full-time independent-contractor engagement.

• Able to work remotely with teammates and customers across global time zones.

• Professional fluency in English .

• Professional fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese .

• At least three years of hands-on development or technical integration experience.

• Production experience with ecommerce platforms, APIs or merchant technology.

Terrific operates as a global company, and English is our primary business language . Interviews, documentation and regular internal communication will be conducted in English.

Required:

• Deep experience in at least one of Terrific ’s three commercial pillars — eCommerce, Marketing, or Media — and enough fluency across the other two to contribute credibly from day 1.

• Terrific operates as a global company, and English is our primary business language. As such, all roles require fluency in written and spoken English.

Be part of the change that’s quietly reshaping how people discover and buy online.
Passionate about social media and e-commerce? Come build what’s next at Terrific .

Please note: We review every application carefully. While we may not be able to respond to everyone, we will reach out to candidates whose experience aligns with what we’re building.

Our client is an established outdoor consumer brand with a strong presence across subscription, e-commerce, and major retail channels. The business is focused on building a lean, profitable, and sustainable growth model, driven by strong fundamentals and measurable impact.

Position Overview
Own the full CRM and lifecycle marketing function for a subscription ecommerce company that is rebuilding its growth engine from the ground up. This person will manage all email and SMS marketing through Klaviyo, build and optimize lifecycle flows that directly impact retention and revenue, run the affiliate program, and use data to continuously improve how we communicate with subscribers at every stage of their journey. You will be the only person in this seat. There is no team to inherit — you are the team.

Core Responsibilities

• Own all email and SMS marketing execution in Klaviyo: campaign calendar, segmentation, A/B testing, deliverability, and performance reporting

• Build, maintain, and optimize lifecycle flows including dunning/failed payment recovery, pre-rebill engagement, win-back, cross-sell, gift-to-paid conversion, and new subscriber onboarding

What Makes You the Right Fit

• You think in systems, not sends. Individual campaigns matter, but what you really build is the machine that nurtures subscribers from first touch through year-two renewal.

• You're a retention thinker. You understand that keeping a subscriber is cheaper than acquiring one, and you build flows that prove it.

• You're data driven but action oriented. You don't just report that open rates dropped, you diagnose why, fix it, and document what you changed.

• You're proactive, not reactive. Deliverability issues, engagement cliffs, and broken flows get caught before leadership asks about them.

postings.descriptionText:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle :
With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!
Compensation :
For this senior role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD based on experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the strong expertise and significant contributions expected at this level. This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. Work from where you do your best work.

About the Role:
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform, to build and own the platform the security team runs on: the services that discover, scan, triage and route security findings, the event-driven bus that connects them, and the CI security gates every team's pipeline runs through.
This is a development role on the security team, not a security-analyst role. Most of your time goes into designing, building and operating services in Go and Python on Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, the existing fleet where it has grown faster than its upkeep, and the NATS-based event platform that moves findings, inventory changes and notifications between them. The security gates in our GitLab CI (SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning) and the agentic triage and review workflows are part of that platform, not the whole of it. Your job is to make these systems fast, low-noise, and reliable enough to be trusted by default without slowing delivery.
You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own detection and response and network and zero trust — your platform is what their work composes with.
At Sezzle , AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we build. In this role you will build reusable agentic workflows (Claude Code skills, CI review agents, automated triage and verification) that multiply what the team can cover, and hold that review discipline in the platform code you own.

What You’ll Do:

• Design, build, and operate security engineering services primarily in Golang and Python, on AWS and Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, and the upkeep, hardening and retirement of the existing ones.

• Own the event-driven platform between the security services: the NATS bus, its contracts and consumers, delivery guarantees and observability — so a finding, an inventory change or an alert reaches every service that acts on it.

• Integrate the platform end-to-end: scanners → finding system-of-record → tickets → metrics, so remediation state is visible and exam evidence is a by-product of engineering.

• Own delivery of the security gates — SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning: scanner selection and tuning, suppression workflow mechanics, false-positive burn-down, and the rollout tooling that takes a gate from advisory reporting to enforcing without blocking delivery.

• Build agentic security workflows: CI review agents, automated finding triage and verification, remediation helpers — tooling other engineers actually adopt.

• Build the triage-to-remediation automation: validate true positives by hand enough to prove the tooling right, then automate the loop — reproduction context, fix guidance, and routing to the owning teams and to vulnerability-management operations.

• Participate in threat modeling and secure design reviews for the services you build and the pipelines you own.

• Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own.

What We Look For:

• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.

• Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.

• Strong proficiency in Golang, plus working proficiency in Python.

• Hands-on experience building and operating event-driven or message-based systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar): contracts, idempotent consumers, replay, back-pressure.

• Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipeline tooling — jobs, shared templates, runners — GitLab CI at fleet scale is a strong plus.

• Hands-on web application security knowledge: the OWASP Top 10 in real code — able to find these issues, fix them yourself, and encode the detection so they stop recurring.

• Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and secret-scanning tooling (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, gitleaks), including tuning them to a signal-to-noise ratio developers will tolerate.

• Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and have built agentic workflows that other engineers adopted.

• Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes as deployment targets for the services you build.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

• Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending, especially with systems in cardholder-data or regulated scope.

• Working knowledge of PCI DSS and SOC 2 as they apply to software development and change management — the platform you build is what produces that evidence.

• Software supply-chain integrity: SBOM pipelines, dependency governance, artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA).

• Familiarity with policy-as-code and admission control (OPA, Kyverno, conftest) — your gates compose with the cluster's runtime policy-enforcement layer.

• Exposure to bug bounty or external vulnerability report triage — enough to know what the automation you build has to get right.

• Experience with threat modeling at a system level.

About You:

• You measure yourself by other teams' code - a fix you shipped is good; a vulnerability class that stopped appearing across the fleet is better.

• You'd rather ship a gate than publish a policy - you know that enforcement changes behavior and documents do not, and you build the enforcement so well that engineers want to keep it.

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You're not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
