postings.title: Funnel Builder
postings.descriptionText:
Who we are
Flow Pouch makes functional mushroom pouches. People use them as a clean alternative to nicotine pouches and energy products: no nicotine, no caffeine, no crash. We launched in 2024, we have grown quickly, mostly through subscriptions, and we manufacture in the US. We are a remote team of about 25 people across the US, Europe, Brazil and the Philippines.

Why we are hiring
Almost everything we sell comes through paid ads and the pages behind them. Today we have a page builder who ships pages fast, and creative strategists who write ads, but nobody who owns the funnel itself: the angle, the copy, the structure of the page and the offer, from the first headline to the checkout. That is this role. You decide what the funnel is and write it; our page builder builds it, so you can make more of them.

What you will own

• Funnels from scratch. Advertorials, listicles, pre-sell and sales pages, offer and upsell flows. You see the finished page in your head before you write the first line, and then you write all of it.

• Copy. Headlines, hooks, body, proof, offer, CTA. Direct response, written to convert cold traffic from Meta.

• Structure and briefs. A clear layout and brief for every page so our page builder can build it in one pass, not five.

• Iteration. You read the numbers with our Head of Performance and rewrite what is not converting. A funnel is never finished.

• Angles. You work with our creative strategists so what the ad promises is what the page delivers.

What this role is not
You will not be building pages in Shopify or a page builder; that is our page builder's job. You will not be writing ads or editing video; our strategists and editors do that. This is not a brand voice or content marketing role. It is direct response for a consumable product with a subscription.

Who we are looking for

• You have built at least three complete DTC funnels yourself, copy and structure, for products sold on cold traffic. Supplements, consumables or wellness is a plus.

• You write in native-level English for a US audience. Your copy reads like a person, not like a template.

• You understand why a funnel works: the angle, the mechanism, the proof, the offer, the order they come in. You can explain what you would change on a page and why.

• You are comfortable being judged on conversion rate, not on how the page looks.

• You use AI tools for research and drafts and know where they stop being useful.

• Based in Brazil, or elsewhere in the Americas with a working day that overlaps US Eastern hours.

What is hard about this
We would rather you hear it now than in month three:

• The brief is often an angle and a deadline. You fill in the rest.

• Our product sits next to nicotine pouches, so the claims we can make are specific and the line between persuasive and non-compliant is real. You learn it fast and write inside it.

• You report to a co-founder who moves quickly. Priorities change, and a page that is live on Monday may be rewritten by Thursday because the numbers said so.

• You hand your work to someone else to build. Your brief has to be good enough that the page comes back the way you saw it.

The engagement

Type

Full-time contractor.

Compensation
$3,000–4,000 per month, depending on experience.

Location

Remote. Brazil preferred.

Reports to

Our CMO and co-founder.

Works with
Our page builder, Head of Performance and creative strategists.

Start

As soon as possible.

How to apply
Start your application with the word CORDYCEPS so we know you read the whole listing. Then send us:

• Links to at least three funnels you built. For each, one or two sentences: the product, what you wrote and structured yourself, who built the page, and what the result was if you can share it.

• Pick one of those three. What would you change on it today, and why?

• Your location, usual working hours and earliest start date.

The Position
Stephen Gorham is expanding the OPSWAT Federal team, and there has never been a better time to join. We’re in the middle of an exciting Federal expansion, fueled by incredible adoption of OPSWAT ’s purpose-built solutions that help the DoD, Intelligence Community, and Federal Civilian Agencies meet their missions with greater security and confidence.
As part of this investment, we’ve opened our new state-of-the-art Critical Infrastructure Lab in Arlington, VA—a hub for innovation, collaboration, and hands-on demonstrations of our unique technologies. We’re continuing to make substantial investments in Federal because we see the difference OPSWAT makes for national security every day—and we want passionate people to join us in driving that mission forward.

About the Role
As a Federal Sales Account Executive, you will be at the forefront of OPSWAT ’s federal growth. Your mission is to build, manage, and grow relationships across Federal agencies, while driving adoption of OPSWAT ’s solutions for Zero Trust, critical infrastructure protection, and secure file and data transfer. You will work closely with capture managers, channel partners, and technical experts to develop strategies that deliver wins and expand OPSWAT ’s presence in the Federal market.

What You Will Be Doing

• Own and drive a Federal sales territory focused on the Marine Corps, Navy and Coast Guard.

• Meet or exceed annual sales quota by developing new business and expanding existing accounts.

• Lead the complete sales cycle—from opportunity identification and qualification through negotiation and close.

• Partner with Channel and Federal System Integrator partners to maximize contract vehicle access and joint wins.

• Collaborate with capture managers and proposal teams to align sales strategy with capture efforts.

• Leverage OPSWAT ’s Critical Infrastructure Lab in Arlington, VA to host demonstrations, workshops, and executive briefings for customers and partners.

What We Need From You

• Deep understanding of Federal procurement processes, contract vehicles, and acquisition lifecycles.

• Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas with Federal agencies.

• Strong relationships within DoD, IC, and/or civilian agencies, and with Federal System Integrators.

postings.title: Remote Executive Assistant - Business & Personal Support
postings.descriptionText:
About FreedUp

FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. For our EAs, we aim to be one of the best US companies for LATAM and Filipino talent, with a supportive environment and real room to grow.

About the role
We're looking for a trustworthy, highly organized Executive Assistant to support a team who co-own a design and CAD-focused firm in Texas. They've run the business together for 15 years and are now ready to hand off the day-to-day "noise" so they can focus on leading and growing the company.
You'll be one shared assistant for both founders, working toward the same business goals. Your work will span the business (inboxes, finance admin, HR, and coordinating vendors and project teams) and their personal lives (household services, bills and errands that can be handled remotely). Trust and discretion are at the heart of this role: you'll be handling sensitive financial and company information, and you'll build that trust step by step.
Compensation: 1000 to 1,700 USD per month (Depends on Experience)
Location: Remote LATAM
What you'll do

Business operations

•
Manage inboxes: triage both founders' business inboxes, flag priorities, draft replies and make sure nothing gets buried.

•
Support finance admin: help pay bills, track invoices and deposits, and coordinate with the firm's fractional bookkeeping and accounting team, always within clear approval rules and spending limits. These responsibilities are introduced gradually as trust is built.

•
Support HR admin: help with onboarding, documentation, scheduling and other people-related tasks.

•
Coordinate CAD and production work: keep communication flowing between the founders, internal staff and an outsourced production support team, tracking deadlines and follow-ups.

•
Manage calendars and meetings: schedule meetings, prepare agendas and keep track of action items.

Personal support (remote)

• Coordinate household services and repairs, acting as the "dispatcher" for technicians, mobile mechanics and other providers.

• Handle online returns, orders and errands that can be managed remotely, using pickup and delivery services where needed.

• Help with personal bills and admin as trust grows.

Communication and accountability

• Hold a weekly check-in with each founder, and know which founder owns which area.

• Adapt to each founder's preferred channels, such as Microsoft Teams, Slack, email or text/iMessage.

• Build simple processes and checklists so recurring work runs smoothly and reliably.

Our hiring process

• Apply online

• Record a short Loom video introducing yourself/ Prescreen call with a recruiter

• Final Interview with our Recruiting Lead

• Complete a work evaluation

• Final interview with the client

Requirements

Must-haves

• At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant or in a similar support role.

• Hands-on experience with finance admin, such as bill pay, invoicing or working with a bookkeeper.

• A proven record of handling confidential financial and company information with complete discretion.

• Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or above).

• Highly organized, able to juggle requests from two executives and keep both informed.

• Proactive and reliable, with strong follow-through and attention to detail.

• Comfortable with the Microsoft ecosystem (Outlook, Teams) and following IT security procedures, including working on a company-provided laptop.

• Available during US Central Time business hours.

• Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet home office setup.

Nice-to-haves

• Experience supporting more than one executive, or business partners or spouses.

• Experience in an architecture, engineering, design or construction firm, or familiarity with CAD-based project work.

• HR admin experience, such as onboarding or employee records.

• Experience coordinating household services and personal errands remotely.

• Familiarity with Slack, Ramp and password managers such as 1Password.

Benefits

• Compensation in USD

• Year-end bonus, plus other applicable bonuses

• Health insurance allowance

• PTO + Holidays

• Training and ongoing support from the FreedUp team

Build and run sports programs with the urgency, resourcefulness and accountability of a founder.

High growth. High intensity.
Personal accountability.
A conventional 9-to-5 mindset —waiting for instructions, doing only the assigned task or leaving problems for someone else—is incompatible with this role. We actively challenge passive working habits and address repeated failures of ownership through performance reviews.
• Think creatively: Find overlooked audiences, develop partnerships, test new offers and create practical ways to fill programs.
• Show tenacity: Follow up consistently, work through setbacks and adapt when the first approach fails.
• Move with purpose: Turn ideas into action quickly, measure what works and expand successful approaches.

Working hours
Hours are predominantly evenings and weekends in Toronto/Eastern time , when our customers and programs are most active. These are the core working hours of the role. Specific shifts and weekly hours will be agreed before starting. Within that schedule, we expect focus, urgency and dependable ownership.

Requirements

What you bring
Practical experience in sports leagues, clubs, tournaments, facilities or program operations; sustained passion for sport demonstrated through real involvement; strong organization and numerical skills; fluent spoken and written English; confidence with spreadsheets and operational systems; and the ability to coordinate people remotely. Apply

• Culture Index survey

Benefits

Compensation and progression
Start as a Coordinator at USD $1,000–$1,500 per month , depending on experience, plus the potential to earn USD $1,000+ per month in performance bonuses , based on targets and calculation terms agreed in advance. Bonuses are variable, not guaranteed.
Over the first six months, you will build toward Manager responsibilities. Progression to Manager will depend on successful completion of probation and a six-month review of growth results, operational reliability, initiative and readiness to lead independently. Promotion is earned through results.

•
Working proficiency with Vue 3 or React.

postings.descriptionText:
Fully remote position in Latin America (Brazil or Argentina) or in the United States · Full-time employment · Daily overlap with both Central European Time and North American client hours.
Are you an experienced AI/ML Solutions Architect with hands-on AWS experience? Join SnapSoft's AI/ML Service Line and work on international projects with our highly qualified engineering team, remotely and aligned to US working hours.
You will see a lot of ideas move from POC to MVP to production, which means fast iteration and quick feedback on whether something actually works. What we build has to survive contact with real users, real data and real infrastructure.
As an AI/ML Solutions Architect , you will design and deliver AI and data solutions across various client projects and act as the technical lead of project teams of 2-3 engineers. Our current work centres on agentic automation, LLM-based RAG systems, vector databases and integrating AI into our clients' existing application landscapes. You will work closely with colleagues from our Application Development and Cloud Migration service lines, as well as our PMO, Sales and Presales teams, on projects where AI, engineering and cloud come together.
This is a client-facing role. Alongside delivery, you will spend roughly 20% of your time supporting presales activities. Most of your working day will overlap with US time zones, and a few hours of overlap with our Hungarian delivery team are needed. Occasional travel to Hungary or to client sites may come up, but it is rare.

Requirements

What you'll be doing

• Own the end-to-end AI/ML solution architecture on client projects, acting as a key decision-maker and driving the delivery team

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients: understand their business problems and provide technology consulting to identify the best-fit solution

• Support presales activities (roughly 20% of your time), such as technical discovery, solution design and estimation

• Technically lead a team of 2-3 AI and cloud engineers focused on fast prototyping and delivery of AI/ML solutions on AWS, and mentor junior and mid-level colleagues

• Design and build agentic systems that plan, call tools and automate real business workflows

• Develop LLM-powered applications, including RAG pipelines: chunking, embedding, retrieval strategies, evaluation and iteration

• Work with vector databases and search: indexing strategies, hybrid and semantic search, relevance tuning

• Perform prompt engineering, model selection and systematic evaluation of LLM outputs

• Develop highly scalable services realizing AI/ML functionality (LLM, ML and other AI models)

• Build scalable Python services and the data flows behind them (ingestion, transformation, document preparation), including AI-driven data access such as Text2SQL

• Integrate AI services with external systems through APIs: REST endpoints, authentication, webhooks, third-party and client-side SaaS platforms

• Implement AI solutions on AWS (e.g. Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, Textract)

• Describe infrastructure as code with Terraform (Terragrunt) or AWS CloudFormation, and design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across multiple environments

• Stay up to date with AWS innovations and contribute to AWS Competency and Service Delivery Programs to support SnapSoft's AWS Partner journey

You are looking for us, if you have

• 5+ years of experience, including recent hands-on work on AI projects, from an AI/ML, data or backend engineering background

• Previous experience in an architect role (this should not be your first architect position)

• Hands-on experience with both GenAI and classic ML solutions

• Strong AWS experience, including Amazon Bedrock, and experience with some of: SageMaker, Glue, MWAA, EMR, RDS, Aurora, S3, OpenSearch, ElasticSearch

• Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with the GenAI ecosystem (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, agent frameworks, LLM provider SDKs, Pydantic)

• Solid understanding of LLM application concepts: RAG, embeddings, vector databases, tool calling, agent patterns, prompt engineering and evaluation

• Good command of SQL and a working understanding of core data engineering concepts (ETL, pipelines, data modelling)

• Proven experience designing, consuming and integrating APIs, and connecting AI services to existing systems

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field

• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, a consulting mindset and business acumen, and comfort working in client-facing situations

• The ability to work independently and collaboratively with global, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment

• Availability to work in US time zones, with a few hours of overlap with our Hungarian team

• Professional working proficiency in English

Nice to have

• AWS Solutions Architect Professional or another AWS Professional/Specialty certification

• Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

• Background at an AWS partner or another professional services company similar to SnapSoft

• Experience with multiple cloud providers (cloud-agnostic experience)

•
Pre-sales engineering experience

What we offer

• A company culture based on autonomy and accountability

• Fully remote position anywhere in the United States OR LATAM (Brazil or Argentina).

• Flexible working hours with collaboration across US and European teams.

• High visibility across executive leadership with real influence on how our US delivery organization evolves.

• Work on innovative AWS Cloud Migration projects for fast-growing startups and enterprise customers.

• Travel: Occasional business travel for strategic customer engagements.

Do you see yourself in this role? Apply now!
If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're the right fit, we'd love to hear from you!

hireworks is building a community of top talent in key international markets by unlocking unparalleled access to positions at leading U.S. based companies. About our client
Our client is an AI-native customer engagement platform built for ecommerce brands. Unlike traditional marketing automation platforms that rely on manual rules, segments, and campaigns, they use algorithmic decision-making to determine the right message, channel, timing, and product recommendation for every customer interaction. By combining email, SMS, onsite experiences, identity resolution, and AI-driven personalization into a single platform, they helps brands increase revenue while reducing operational complexity.
They are assembling one of the world's most ambitious teams of marketers, technologists, and operators
with decades of experience building the systems behind many of the world's leading commerce
brands—all from their 30,000-square-foot headquarters in Williamsburg, Brooklyn.﻿

About the Position
Our client's Growth Partner package gives select brands our client's full platform, plus a team that runs their
program for them. Our client handles approximately 99% of the work, operating like an agency using their own technology. As a Growth Manager, you are that team's lead for a book of 5+ Growth Partner clients. You own each
brand's email and SMS program end to end: strategy, setup, migration, the program build, day-to-day
execution, and reporting. You are measured on one thing above all: growing your clients' lists and the

revenue those lists drive.

﻿
This role is for an experienced lifecycle operator who has built email and SMS programs from the first
subscriber through hypergrowth, and who wants to do it across several brands at once.
﻿
﻿ What You'll Do
﻿ Strategy and growth

• Own the email and SMS growth strategy for a portfolio of Growth Partner brands, from list
acquisition through retention and win-back

• Build list growth plans using our client's identity resolution, entrance and exit exchanges,
recognition, pop-ups, top bars, landers, and exit intent

• Plan each brand's promotional calendar and send cadence, scaling volume as lists and
engagement grow

• Coordinate with each brand's performance agency so paid traffic is recognized, captured, and converted

abandonment, product stories, Subscribe & Save, post-purchase, win-back, and more

goals

• Roll out SMS, MMS, and RCS programs, including Super RCS, with compliant opt-in flow

Day-to-day execution

• Run campaigns and automations day to day: briefs, copy direction, QA, scheduling, and

• segmentation

• Partner with our client's designers and creative tools to deliver 2+ new creatives per client each month,
writing copy when needed

• Test continuously (subject lines, offers, timing, channel mix, onsite capture) and roll winners into the program

• Monitor deliverability, list health, and SMS volume against each client's package

﻿Client partnership and reporting

• Serve as the primary, trusted point of contact for each Growth Partner brand

• Deliver regular performance reporting and planning sessions that tie program activity to revenue and list growth

• Spot expansion opportunities (added SMS volume, SKU Store, new channels) and partner with Sales on renewals

• Feed client learnings back to Product and help refine our client's blueprints, playbooks, and Growth Partner processes

﻿Automation and AI

• Provide insight and direction on our client's AI products that cut manual effort in calendar
creation and execution

• Pilot new automation features with your clients, report on what works, and flag where they fall
short

• Partner with Product to shape the roadmap based on hands-on use across your client portfolio

• Shift your own time from manual production toward strategy as automation comes online

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years owning full-lifecycle email programs for small and mid-sized ecommerce brands:
strategy, build, execution, reporting, and optimization
SMS program experience strongly preferred, including compliant list growth and email/SMS
orchestration

• Proven track record of growing an email program, from building a list from zero through
hypergrowth, with numbers to show for it (list size, revenue per subscriber, share of revenue from
owned channels)

• Hands-on experience with list growth tactics: pop-ups and onsite capture, exit intent, landers,
offer strategy, and partnering with paid media to convert traffic into subscribers

• Deep knowledge of lifecycle automation (welcome, abandonment, post-purchase, replenishment,
win-back) and campaign calendar planning

• Solid grasp of deliverability, list hygiene, and platform migrations

• Agency or multi-client experience: you can run 5+ brand programs at once without dropping a ball

• Strong creative judgment and solid copywriting; you can write a clear brief, draft copy when
needed, and give useful feedback on design

• Analytical and comfortable pulling performance, finding the story in the data, and turning it into a plan

• Confident, client-ready communicator who builds trust with founders and marketing leads

• Experience with Klaviyo, Attentive, Postscript, or similar platforms, plus Google Suite, Slack, and Bootcamp; able to ramp quickly on new tools

• A proactive, ownership-oriented mindset; you follow up without being asked and close loops

How ﻿Success Is Measured

• Revenue from email and SMS, and owned-channel share of total revenue

postings.descriptionText:
The ROLE

Title

Customer Success Manager

Company
Measure Marketing (MMR), a Toronto-based GEO, AI search and SEO agency

Location
Remote: LATAM (Colombia preferred) or Europe

Hours
Overlap of at least 5 hours with North American business hours (ET)

Type

Full-time

Reports to

Head of Delivery (confirm)

Clients
B2B, law firms, signage, SaaS, and residential and commercial home improvement

Search Changed the Map. You're the Client's GPS.
Buyers don't just Google anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews, and they often get an answer without ever clicking. That shift is why MMR exists: we help clients get found, cited and chosen across both classic and AI-powered search.
This role exists because great work only counts when the client can see it. You're the person who turns rankings, AI citations, traffic and leads into a clear story of progress. You catch risk before the client feels it, and you keep every account moving toward measurable outcomes.
Think of it as a marathon run at sprint pace. Relationships last for years, but you prove value every single month.

What You'll Own

1. Relationships That Fuel Retention

• Be each client's trusted partner and main point of contact.

• Run check-ins , monthly and quarterly reviews that prove progress and set the next 90-day sprint.

• Handle escalations calmly and drive fast, accountable fixes.

2. Full-Funnel Performance: AI Search, SEO and PPC

• Explain AI search shifts in plain English, including AI Overviews, zero-click results and citations in ChatGPT and Perplexity.

• Read paid search performance in Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, including spend, CPC, conversions and cost per lead, and flag when budget isn't turning into pipeline.

• Connect GEO, AEO, SEO and PPC to outcomes: visibility, qualified traffic, leads and cost per lead.

• Own the narrative while specialists handle execution.

3. Content and CRO Insight

• Link content plans to client goals, and flag gaps for both search and AI engines.

• Raise the alarm when traffic or ad clicks grow but leads stay flat, then drive CRO fixes with the web team.

4. Data Storytelling, Human in the Loop

• Turn data from GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, agency reporting tools and HubSpot into a monthly value story: what happened, why it matters and what's next.

• Use AI to draft reports, summarize calls and spot patterns. You verify the output, apply judgment and own every word the client sees.

5. The Retention System

• Score every account based on leads and account health, customer sentiment, and run recovery plans for any account in Yellow or Red.

• Escalate any account that stays Red for more than 30 days.

• Pass expansion opportunities to the growth team when clients are winning.

6. Projects, ClickUp and Automation

• Turn success plans into ClickUp projects with owners, milestones and deadlines, and keep HubSpot clean.

• Coordinate the SEO, PPC, content, web and dev teams while protecting scope and margin.

• Automate repetitive reporting and follow-ups with AI and workflow tools.

What You Bring

Must-Haves

• 3+ years in customer success or account management at a digital marketing agency, SEO/SaaS company or similar B2B service business.

• A working understanding of SEO and PPC (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), plus curiosity and early knowledge of AI search, GEO and AEO.

• Comfort with numbers: you can read GA4, Search Console and dashboard data and explain what changed and why.

• Proven ability to turn data into a clear, persuasive story for business owners and executives.

• Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for research, reporting and communication, plus the judgment to check their output.

• Experience running projects in ClickUp or a similar tool (Asana, Monday) and keeping a CRM like HubSpot clean.

• Confidence in tough conversations, including pushback, scope creep and at-risk renewals.

• Professional fluency in English, written and spoken, with North American clients.

Nice-to-Haves

• Experience with tracking and reporting tools, and reporting platforms.

• Basic CRO knowledge, such as landing page best practices, A/B testing and conversion tracking.

• Experience with workflow automation (Zapier, ClickUp automations).

• Background with B2B customers and an asset to know SaaS clients.

• Familiarity with net revenue retention, upsell motions and customer lifetime value.

You are measured on customer results, relationships and expansions. Measured through customer NPS survey and retained revenue.
You're part relationship builder, part data storyteller and part project driver. You don't wait for clients to raise concerns. You see the dip in the dashboard first, figure out why, and walk in with a plan.
You use AI to move faster, but you never hand it the wheel. You're curious about where search is heading, and you can explain it to a business owner in two minutes without jargon.
Most of all, you own outcomes. Great relationships matter, but at MMR they're backed by measurable results.

How to Apply
Apply through our JazzHR careers page. You'll answer a few short questions as part of your application. They show us how you think, so give them five minutes.
This is a remote role open in LATAM (Colombia preferred) and Europe, with at least 5 hours of overlap with North American Eastern Time.

This position will ensure the Talent Acquisition function is aligned with Solventum ’s overarching HR Talent Management strategic goals and comply with all legal standards, fostering a highly efficient and transparent environment for both candidates, hiring managers, and Talent Acquisition team members. High growth. High intensity.
Personal accountability.
A conventional 9-to-5 mindset —waiting for instructions, doing only the assigned task or leaving problems for someone else—is incompatible with this role. We actively challenge passive working habits and address repeated failures of ownership through performance reviews.
• Think creatively: Find overlooked audiences, develop partnerships, test new offers and create practical ways to fill programs.
• Show tenacity: Follow up consistently, work through setbacks and adapt when the first approach fails.
• Move with purpose: Turn ideas into action quickly, measure what works and expand successful approaches.
• Own the outcome: Raise problems early with a proposed response, escalate decisions when needed and coordinate the people required to resolve them. Build processes that prevent repeat failures.

Working hours
Hours are predominantly evenings and weekends in Toronto/Eastern time , when our customers and programs are most active. These are the core working hours of the role. Specific shifts and weekly hours will be agreed before starting. Within that schedule, we expect focus, urgency and dependable ownership.
This is one role advertised across multiple recruitment locations. Applicants throughout Latin America and the Caribbean are welcome, including outside the advertised metropolitan locations. Please apply once.

Requirements

Practical experience in sports leagues, clubs, tournaments, facilities or program operations; sustained passion for sport demonstrated through real involvement; strong organization and numerical skills; fluent spoken and written English; confidence with spreadsheets and operational systems; and the ability to coordinate people remotely. You must be based in Toronto or Mississauga, Ontario.

Apply
Submit your CV and a brief summary of the sports programs you have helped run, what you personally owned and the results you achieved. Our application process includes Culture Index and Criteria assessments.

This posting is for an existing vacancy. We use AI-assisted tools to help review applications; hiring decisions are made by people.

Benefits

Compensation and progression
Start as a Coordinator at CAD $20 per hour , plus performance bonuses of up to CAD $2,000+ per month , based on targets and calculation terms agreed in advance. Bonuses are variable, not guaranteed.
Over the first six months, you will build toward Manager responsibilities. Progression to Manager will depend on successful completion of probation and a six-month review of growth results, operational reliability, initiative and readiness to lead independently. Promotion is earned through results.

postings.descriptionText:
Who Are Massive Rocket ?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.

Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

Working within a modern Martech ecosystem, you’ll be responsible for planning, executing, and optimising campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, content cards, WhatsApp, and other engagement channels.
You’ll work closely with clients, CRM Strategists, Project Managers, and technical teams to translate strategic objectives into flawlessly executed campaigns. • Configure and customise Braze to implement agreed strategies, journeys, and campaign plans

• Collaborate with CRM Strategists, Project Managers, and clients to ensure alignment between strategy and execution

• Manage and analyse customer data to support campaign performance, optimisation, and audience targeting

• Conduct QA across campaigns, integrations, and supporting documentation to ensure delivery quality and accuracy

• Monitor campaign performance and create reports that provide clear insights and recommendations

• Serve as a trusted client partner, helping translate business requirements into effective CRM solutions

• Stay current with Braze capabilities and industry best practices, applying new approaches to improve client outcomes

• Support continuous improvement initiatives across delivery processes, campaign execution, and platform utilisation

What Makes You a Great Fit

• 5+ years of experience in CRM, Marketing Automation, Lifecycle Marketing, or Customer Engagement roles
• Strong hands-on experience with Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms
• Proven experience executing multi-channel CRM campaigns and customer journeys
• Strong understanding of segmentation, personalisation, lifecycle marketing, and digital marketing principles
• Experience working with customer data, relational databases, and campaign performance reporting
• Excellent attention to detail, including QA of campaigns, integrations, and documentation
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills gained through client-facing or agency environments
• Ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment
• Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with strong organisational and problem-solving skills

Why You’ll Love Working Here

•
Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else

•
A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win

•
A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond

•
Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best

•
Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter

•
Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

postings.title: Client Account Manager – Marketing Agency
postings.descriptionText:
Description
About the role
Finch is a performance marketing agency. We run digital advertising and SEO for e-commerce and B2B brands. We’re looking for an agency-side Account Manager to be the main strategic contact for a portfolio of our clients, the companies that hire Finch to run their marketing. You’ll lead each relationship and its strategy, and work with our channel specialists (Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic/DSP, SEO, Creative, Analytics) to deliver on each client’s business goals.
What you’ll do

• Own the strategy for each client account: goals, KPIs and quarterly roadmaps.

• Run recurring client meetings, manage stakeholders and document next steps.

• Read performance against business metrics (ROAS, CPA, CAC vs. LTV, organic growth) and coordinate actions with Finch ’s specialists.

• Find and scope growth opportunities: new channels, tests and budget expansions.

• Flag retention risks early and build mitigation plans across your portfolio.

Why Finch

•
Work globally, stay flexible: Join a fully distributed team across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC.

•
Meaningful impact from day one: Your work directly influences client outcomes and how Finch grows.

•
A culture built on curiosity, transparency, and ownership: We share context and empower people to make decisions.

•
High-caliber teammates: Collaborate with specialists in Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO, DSP, Creative, Analytics, and more.

•
Learning as a default: We encourage experimentation, cross-training, and growth as the company scales.

•
Real work-life balance: We value high performance, not overwork.

Requirements
You’ll be a great match if you have

• 5+ years as an Account Manager or Account Director at a marketing agency (performance or digital).

• Experience owning several B2B client accounts at the same time: managing the client relationship, growing the account, and running the project management behind it.

• Experience as the Account Manager on advertising-driven accounts (Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic/DSP), coordinating the specialists who run each channel, with a solid grasp of attribution, KPIs and optimization logic.

• Fluent written and spoken English, and comfort leading strategic conversations with senior client stakeholders.

• A base in Latin America or Africa (or anywhere up to UTC+2), with availability to work roughly 9am–5pm US Central/Mountain time.

This role is not the right next step if most of your experience is in

• Customer service or support, or customer success for consumers (B2C) or for a software product, even if the title was “Account Manager” or “Customer Success Manager”.

• Working at an ad platform or affiliate network, managing advertisers on its behalf.

• Managing a brand’s own e-commerce store or marketplace channels.

• In-house marketing for a single company, without an agency client portfolio.

• Sales or business development, without ongoing account management after the sale.

• Account management at a branding, PR or creative agency, without performance accounts.

Nice to have

• Experience with SEO-driven accounts.

• Experience with US or international clients.

postings.descriptionText:
WebCreek is looking for a Senior Software Developer with strong experience in real-time audio technologies, VoIP systems, and full-stack development to help build and enhance a mission-critical public address and communication platform.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience developing and supporting production systems using WebRTC, SIP/VoIP, and real-time audio streaming technologies. This role focuses on delivering live and recorded audio to hundreds of networked endpoints, integrating with SIP-based public address and phone systems, and ensuring reliable audio transmission.
This position is well suited for a senior developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, takes ownership of features from design through production, and can work across backend, frontend, and real-time communication technologies.

What You'll Do:

• Design, develop, and maintain real-time audio streaming capabilities for live and recorded announcements across hundreds of networked endpoints.

• Build and optimize WebRTC-based audio solutions, including browser-side and server-side communication.

• Develop and maintain integrations with SIP/VoIP systems, PBX platforms, and commercial public address solutions.

• Implement and troubleshoot audio transport protocols, codecs, jitter buffering, packet-loss handling, and secure real-time communication.

• Design scalable one-to-many audio distribution solutions, focusing on synchronized playback, latency, and reliability.

• Develop and maintain backend services using Node.js, GraphQL, MySQL, Redis, and message-driven communication technologies.

• Contribute to frontend development using Vue 3 or React, supporting operator-facing interfaces and audio management workflows.

• Collaborate with embedded engineers to investigate audio issues, review C/C++ firmware, and troubleshoot communication between software and hardware.

• Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot containerized services using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.

• Write automated unit and end-to-end tests, participate in code reviews, and maintain reliable CI workflows using GitHub Actions.

• Use AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity while carefully reviewing and validating generated code.

• Collaborate with Engineering and product stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs and deliver reliable production solutions.

What You Bring:

• 7+ years of professional software development experience, including experience delivering and supporting at least one production software product.

• Strong experience developing real-time audio, VoIP, paging, intercom, conferencing, or audio broadcasting solutions.

• Hands-on production experience with WebRTC, including browser-side and server-side implementations using technologies such as Janus, mediasoup, LiveKit, or Pion.

• Strong knowledge of SIP and VoIP technologies, including PBX integrations, SIP trunks, Asterisk, FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, or similar platforms.

• Experience with audio codecs and transport protocols, including Opus, G.711, RTP/RTCP, SRTP, SIP over TLS, and STUN/TURN/ICE.

• Understanding of audio streaming challenges, including jitter buffers, packet loss, latency measurement, synchronized playback, and one-to-many audio distribution.

• Strong backend development experience with Node.js and GraphQL APIs; TypeScript is a plus.

•
Working proficiency with Vue 3 or React.

• Experience with MySQL, Redis, and message-driven or publish/subscribe systems such as MQTT.

• Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and troubleshooting services running in containerized environments.

• Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including TCP/UDP, TLS, WebSockets, and packet capture analysis.

• Ability to read C/C++ firmware and collaborate with embedded engineers to investigate audio-related issues.

• Experience writing automated tests, working with GitHub Actions, and following disciplined Git and pull-request workflows.

• Experience using AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, as part of daily development work, with the ability to review and correct generated code.

• Strong problem-solving skills, technical ownership, and the ability to independently deliver features from design through production.

• Professional proficiency in spoken and written English.

What You'll Gain:

• A full-time, fully remote position with a growing international company.

• The opportunity to work on a mission-critical communication platform with real-world applications.

• Hands-on experience developing scalable real-time audio and networked communication solutions.

• Opportunities to collaborate with experienced engineers on complex software, networking, and embedded systems challenges.

• A collaborative remote working environment with an international engineering team.

Location: Remote LaTam

postings.title: Full-Cycle Recruiter (Marketing Agency | Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
Overview

Do you love talking to people all day? Do you get a little thrill when the right person says yes? Have you spent 3+ years finding great marketers on LinkedIn, then getting them on the phone?

If so, we'd love to meet you. We're looking for a high-energy marketing recruiter to help us find and hire the marketers who'll grow our agency.

You'll be the first voice most candidates hear from ProperExpression . We want that voice to be warm, sharp, and glad to be there.

The Basics

This role is for a people person first. You'll spend most of your day talking: on calls with candidates, in messages on LinkedIn, and with our hiring team about who's great and why.

It's also a craft role. You'll run 3 or more open roles at once: finding people who aren't applying, writing outreach they want to answer, running screening calls that tell good from great, and keeping every candidate in the loop from first hello to offer.

You're a marketing recruiter, and it's what you do today. We hire paid media strategists, designers, project managers, RevOps specialists, and more, and you already know what great looks like in those roles. You've hired marketers in the US, and you know what they expect.

Our team spans several continents, and most of our clients are US based. We require C1/C2 English fluency and at least 6 hours a day of overlap with US East Coast business hours.

About Us

ProperExpression is a boutique growth marketing agency specializing in wealth management. For 7 years, we've been the behind-the-scenes growth engine for some of the most innovative firms in the space.

We're a HubSpot Platinum Partner, recognized by Excellence.com and Clutch. We're growing fast, and every hire matters.

We also laugh a lot, don't take ourselves too seriously, and look for any excuse to eat good food. Sharing food experiences has become an internal culture with a life of its own.

Why ProperExpression ?

• Real impact: the people you find will build our next chapter.

• Real growth: we're expanding fast, and strong performers rise quickly.

• A culture that works: fast-paced, collaborative, supportive, and built for people who love winning together.

• Fully remote: work from Canada, Latin America, or Ukraine, with at least 6 hours of overlap with US East Coast time.

Requirements

The Fundamentals:

• High energy. You genuinely love talking to people, and it shows on the 8th call of the day.

• Great judgment. You enjoy leading meetings and know when to pause, set boundaries, or take a different approach.

• A great listener. You ask the follow-up question, and you notice what people don't say.

• Organized. You know where every candidate stands, and nobody goes dark on your watch.

• Honest. You tell candidates the truth about the role, even when it's a no.

• Driven, self-starting, and always looking to get better.

Direct Experience (The Must-Haves):

• 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting: sourcing, screening, scheduling, and offers.

• You're a marketing recruiter. Most of your recent hires have been marketers.

• You've hired marketers based in the US.

• You use LinkedIn Recruiter (Lite, Pro, or Corporate).

• You source candidates and run candidate calls yourself, every day.

• You've run hiring for 3 or more open roles at once.

• You've worked in an applicant tracking system and kept it up to date.

• C1/C2 English, written and spoken.

Direct Experience (Preferred but Not Required):

• Upwork sourcing. We use it every week, so this puts you ahead.

• You've worked at a marketing agency.

• AI-curious. Experience with AI tools is a plus. If you're new to them, show us how quickly you learn and adapt.

• Breezy HR or ClickUp. These are the tools we run hiring in.

You're Probably a Fit If

• You leave a great call with more energy than you started with.

• You bring fresh ideas, spot ways to make a process better, and love letting the data show you what's working.

• You've found a great marketer on LinkedIn that nobody else spotted.

• You've told a candidate "this isn't the right fit" and they thanked you for it.

You're Probably Not a Fit If

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong backend background, comfortable in a product-driven environment with changing priorities and a high level of ownership. This is a backend-first role (~70%) with occasional frontend tasks (~30%) when features require touching UI or integrating SDKs. Success means owning the technical side end-to-end: shaping technical solutions under uncertainty, taking responsibility for system behavior in production, and contributing to long-term platform evolution alongside Product Managers, the Engineering Manager, and other senior engineers.

• Design and implement backend-heavy features using TypeScript and Node.js; build and evolve REST APIs with focus on correctness, consistency, and clear boundaries between services

• Work with SQL (PostgreSQL): data modeling, migrations, and consistency guarantees

• Take full ownership of one or more services, from requirements and implementation to production support, and drive integration work with external partners (vendors, clients) when needed

• Own production behavior: investigate incidents, debug API failures, analyze data issues, and apply reliability patterns (timeouts, retries, idempotency, graceful degradation)

• Improve observability (logs, metrics, visibility into system behavior) and propose improvements where reliability, performance, or monitoring is weak

• Participate in tech spikes: explore unclear problems and turn them into concrete technical plans

• Collaborate with Product and EM to clarify requirements and reduce ambiguity early; contribute to technical discussions, raise risks, and explain trade-offs

• Review code, mentor mid-level engineers, and contribute to React code when features require UI updates or customer-facing flows

Required Qualifications

• 4+ years of professional software development experience

• Strong backend expertise with TypeScript and Node.js

• Real production experience: incidents, debugging, API failures, data issues

• Experience owning a service end-to-end, from requirements to production support

• Clear product-level architectural thinking: well-designed APIs, correct data boundaries, proper error handling, ability to reason about trade-offs

• Understanding of microservice architectures and platform-level interactions

• Strong knowledge of HTTP APIs, SQL data modeling, and common failure modes

• Proficient daily use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code), with the ability to review AI-generated code quickly and critically

• Readiness to build deep working knowledge of crypto and stablecoin payments: prior crypto experience is optional, and deep on-the-job learning of the domain is a mandatory part of the role

• Ability to work with ambiguity: ask the right questions and structure unclear problems, working independently without overly detailed technical specs

• High agency: you notice problems before they are assigned to you, raise risks early, and bring a proposed solution together with the problem

• Strong written and verbal communication in English

Preferred Experience

• Experience in fintech, crypto, payments, high-load or high-reliability systems

• Practical understanding of reliability patterns: retries, timeouts, idempotency, fallback strategies

• Experience with queues or messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, BullMQ, etc.)

• Experience with Redis or other key-value stores

• Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes (user-level understanding is enough)

• Basic understanding of AWS capabilities

• Experience with React (UI tasks, integrations, SDKs)

Reporting Structure
Reports to the Engineering Manager. No direct people management responsibilities.

Location
Remote. USA, Argentina, or Brazil. The role works US business hours (Eastern Time).

Compensation and Benefits
As an independent contractor, you'll enjoy the flexibility to determine how and when you deliver your work, while partnering closely with our team to meet agreed milestones and business objectives. Compensation and engagement terms will be outlined in your contractor agreement.

Additional Benefits

• Company issued laptop

• Technology Accessories

• Annual In-Person Full-Team Meetup

With low and no code solutions, Cyclops is the fastest way for payments companies to bring crypto and stablecoin offerings to market. Founded by crypto and payments industry veterans who built crypto solutions for Shift4, Cyclops enables crypto acceptance, stablecoin settlement and stablecoin payouts for payments companies.

postings.title: Sr. E-commerce Accountant
postings.descriptionText:
Sr. E-commerce Accountant
Remote from LATAM | International Independent Contractor | $3,000–$4,000 USD/month

About the Company
Our client is a fast-growing connected fitness equipment company specializing in innovative stair climbers and expanding its product line to include treadmills, performance equipment, and fitness accessories.
The company sells through multiple channels, including direct-to-consumer e-commerce, national retail partners, and commercial fitness accounts. With manufacturing overseas and products imported into the United States, the finance function involves inventory accounting, landed costs, customs duties, tariffs, multi-channel revenue, and lender reporting.
They are looking for a highly capable accounting professional who can take genuine ownership of the accounting function and grow with the business.

The Role
We are seeking a Senior Accountant with the level and title determined by experience.
Reporting directly to the VP of Finance, you will play a critical role in managing the company's day-to-day accounting operations, monthly close, AP, AR, inventory accounting, treasury support, and financial reporting.
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys ownership and variety. You won't simply review work completed by others—you'll be responsible for doing the work, improving processes, identifying issues, and building documentation as the company scales.
For the right person, this role has the potential to grow into a finance leadership position with a team reporting into it over time .

Schedule & Languages

• Minimum 6 hours of daily overlap with U.S. Central Time

•
Core hours: 9:00 AM–3:00 PM CT

• Professional English proficiency required

What You'll Own

Accounts Payable & Vendor Management

• Own the full AP cycle in NetSuite, including bill entry, coding, purchase order matching, approvals, and payment preparation.

• Reconcile vendor statements, including high-volume international manufacturing partners.

• Investigate and resolve vendor discrepancies.

•
Maintain a clean and accurate AP aging.

• Follow up on missing invoices, credits, and overdue balances.

• Execute payment runs and maintain accurate remittance records.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

• Own invoicing and cash application across direct-to-consumer, retail, and commercial channels.

• Manage collections and proactively follow up on past-due balances.

• Communicate directly with U.S. customer AP departments.

• Investigate and resolve unapplied payments and credits.

• Reconcile customer accounts and prepare statements as needed.

• Provide regular commentary on AR aging and collection activity.

Month-End Close & Reconciliations

• Manage the monthly close according to an established close calendar.

• Prepare accruals, prepaid amortization, fixed asset and depreciation entries, and recurring journal entries.

• Reconcile balance sheet accounts, including bank, credit cards, AP, AR, inventory, and intercompany accounts.

• Ensure subledgers reconcile accurately to the general ledger.

• Prepare reconciliation packages with complete supporting documentation.

• Analyze and explain material month-over-month fluctuations.

• Continuously improve and streamline the close process.

Inventory, Landed Cost & Import Accounting

• Record inventory receipts and match them against purchase orders and supplier invoices.

• Investigate receiving delays and discrepancies.

• Accurately calculate and allocate landed costs, including freight, customs duties, tariffs, and brokerage.

• Accrue and reconcile U.S. customs and tariff obligations.

• Maintain schedules of expected duty and tariff outflows.

• Reconcile inventory subledgers to the general ledger.

• Investigate inventory variances and support cycle counts and reserve analysis.

Treasury & Financial Reporting Support

• Prepare recurring borrowing base certificates, including AR eligibility testing and supporting schedules.

• Assist with reporting required under the company's credit facility.

• Track covenant compliance dates and reporting requirements.

• Support the rolling 13-week cash forecast.

• Maintain AP and AR inputs and reconcile forecasts against actual results.

• Prepare daily and weekly cash position reporting across bank accounts.

Operational Finance Support
As part of the seniority of this position, you'll also help remove administrative work from senior finance leadership by managing:

•
Expense reports and receipt collection.

•
Corporate card coding.

• Vendor onboarding documentation, including W-9/W-8 forms and banking information.

•
Finance document and file management.

• Vendor and customer master data in NetSuite.

• SOP creation and maintenance for processes you own.

Systems You'll Use

• NetSuite and Intuit — Current & future primary accounting ERP

• Mercury — banking

• Shopify — direct-to-consumer sales

• Justworks — payroll

• Asana — task and project management

•
Google Workspace

• Excel & Google Sheets — advanced proficiency expected

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of progressive accounting experience , including at least 2 years at a senior or supervisory level.

• Proven full-cycle accounting experience . You have personally managed or owned a month-end close.

• Experience with inventory accounting in a physical-product business , such as manufacturing, distribution, wholesale, or e-commerce.

• Hands-on experience with NetSuite . Strong candidates with experience in another mid-market ERP such as Sage Intacct, Dynamics 365 Business Central, or SAP Business One may also be considered.

• Professional written and spoken English fluency .

• Comfortable communicating directly with U.S. vendors and customers.

• Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivot tables, large-file reconciliations, and complex workbooks.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to independently investigate and resolve discrepancies.

Strongly Preferred

• Experience with international imports, customs duties, tariffs, landed costs, and brokerage.

• Exposure to asset-based lending, borrowing base certificates, eligibility testing, or covenant reporting.

• Multi-entity or multi-currency accounting and consolidation experience.

• Shopify or other e-commerce accounting experience.

• Contador Público or equivalent local accounting qualification.

• Experience working in a small or rapidly scaling company where you were responsible for executing the work, not simply reviewing it.

This Role May Not Be For You If...

• You need every process to be fully documented before you can get started.

• You prefer a narrowly defined accounting function.

• You're uncomfortable working across AP, AR, close, inventory, and treasury.

• You don't enjoy communicating directly with U.S. vendors and customers.

• You prefer reviewing work rather than taking ownership of the underlying processes.

Much of the company's current processes are still being built and documented. The person joining this role will be expected to help create the structure as they take ownership .

What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days

First 30 Days

• Learn the company's systems, processes, and general ledger.

• Take ownership of AP entry and payment run preparation.

• Produce a clean, accurate AP aging with written commentary.

• Build relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.

Days 31–60

• Take full ownership of AR and collections.

• Communicate directly with customers regarding outstanding balances.

• Complete a supervised first pass of the month-end close.

• Resolve outstanding unapplied cash and credits.

Days 61–90

•
Own the month-end close end to end.

• Take ownership of the reconciliation package and borrowing base preparation.

• Document AP and AR processes through clear SOPs.

• Identify and present the first three process improvements you would prioritize.

Why Join?
This is an opportunity to join a lean, growing company where your work will have a direct impact on the business.
You'll work closely with finance leadership, gain exposure to areas of accounting that are often reserved for much larger organizations, and have the opportunity to build processes rather than simply inherit them.
The environment is collaborative, direct, and low on bureaucracy. The expectation is simple: take ownership, communicate proactively, and bring solutions—not just problems.
If you're a hands-on senior accounting professional who wants meaningful responsibility and room to grow into leadership, we'd love to hear from you.

postings.descriptionText:
🌟 Exciting Remote Opportunity! We're Hiring an Order Management Coordinator! 🌟
Are you a decisive, detail-oriented operations professional with hands-on experience in the promotional products industry? We are looking for an Order Management Coordinator to act as the operational backbone and take full ownership of the order lifecycle for a commercial printing and custom apparel company!

🚨 IMPORTANT - Watch this quick Loom video on how to get hired: 🔗

🗣️ C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED. The selected candidate will be speaking strictly in English during their whole shift. 🎙️ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH.

📋 Job Details at a Glance

• Job Title: Order Management Coordinator

• Job ID: LARRIC1

• Industry: Commercial Printing, Custom Apparel & Promotional Products

• Location: LATAM / PH / South Africa

• Job Status: Full Time

• Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Pacific Time)

• Salary: South Africa & LATAM: $10 to $12 per hour | PH: $8 per hour

• Target Start Date: ASAP

🏢 About the Client

Our client is a full-service commercial printing, customized apparel, and promotional products company. They specialize in providing end-to-end brand identity solutions—ranging from large-format commercial printing and custom corporate apparel to specialized tradeshow merchandise, awards, and promotional giveaways. Serving businesses across education, healthcare, corporate, and non-profit sectors, the company pairs custom graphic design services with high-volume production and personalized customer care.

💼 About the Role

As our Order Management Coordinator, you will be the operational backbone of our daily order operations. Rather than acting as a simple "task-doer," you will take full ownership of the order lifecycle—from initial client request through supplier coordination to delivery and invoicing.
The email inbox serves as your primary operational hub and main driver for all workflow processes. We are looking for a proactive, direct, and thick-skinned partner who thrives in a fast-paced environment, manages high-volume email workflows effortlessly, and wants to grow with our business long-term.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

• 📦 Order Lifecycle Ownership: Manage print, apparel, and promotional product orders from intake through supplier sourcing, order entry, production tracking, and client invoicing.

• 📧 Email Inbox & Workflow Management: Efficiently process, organize, and execute all daily order operations driven primarily through the email inbox with speed, precision, and high attention to detail.

• 🤝 Supplier & Client Liaison: Communicate clearly and professionally with clients while coordinating directly with vendors, decorators, and couriers via email and phone.

• 🔍 Proactive Problem-Solving: Anticipate production bottlenecks, inventory shortages, or shipping delays and resolve them before they impact the client.

• 🎨 Artwork & Proof Coordination: Verify production files, coordinate with internal designers, and ensure client proofs are double-checked and approved prior to production.

• ✅ Accuracy & Quality Control: Execute order details, product specs, and pricing checks with zero tolerance for costly mistakes.

🧠 Candidate Profile & Character Fit

To succeed in this role, you must possess a specific character profile:

• ⚡ Decisive & Direct: Ability to take fast-paced directions without requiring lengthy explanations or questioning established processes. You take instruction, execute immediately, and keep momentum moving forward.

• 💡 Solution-Oriented: Respectful of leadership’s time. If you flag an issue, you bring a viable, well-thought-out solution to the table rather than just presenting a problem.

• 🛡️ Thick-Skinned & Resilient: Thrives under high-volume pressure and fast decision-making in a multi-business environment.

• 🎯 High Ownership & Reliability: Takes full accountability for accuracy. Understands that a single mistake in printing or logistics can be costly, and takes pride in zero-error execution.

• 📈 Growth & Partnership Mindset: Looking for a stable, long-term opportunity to grow into a senior leadership/management role, take on expanded responsibilities across multiple ventures, and eventually train future team members.

✅ Qualifications & Non-Negotiables

• ⭐ Promotional Industry Experience (Strict Requirement): Prior hands-on experience in the promotional products / custom print industry is required. You must already understand industry nuances (apparel, merch, print processes, colors, specs, vendor lead times) and require zero basic industry training.

• 🗣️ Language & Communication: Near-native/fluent written English skills for professional customer emailing, alongside confident verbal English for vendor phone calls.

• 📬 High-Volume Capacity: Proven track record of managing high-volume email operations and detail-heavy order queues with accuracy.

• 💻 Technical & Operational Aptitude: Quick to adopt specialized workflows, order systems, and software tools.

🚀 Submit your application today and take the first step toward your next great opportunity!
(For LATAM Candidates Only) Don't forget to join our Facebook community for more updates and opportunities: 🔗 Join our LATAM Facebook Group Here!

postings.title: Senior Manager, Content Collections – LatAm & Spain
postings.descriptionText:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.
We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:
We are currently seeking a new Senior Manager, Content Collections for LatAm & Spain to join our Content team . This role is remote, and open to candidates based in Latin America or Spain. Fluency in English and Spanish is required.

What your team does:

Clio 's Content team builds and maintains the legal content that powers every product feature we ship. The LatAm and Spain group owns that content for Spain and the priority Latin American jurisdictions, and this role leads the group. You will build one coherent regional practice across several countries, and run it to the same standards, tools, and roadmap Clio uses in every market.

What you'll work on:

• Manage the content team across Latin America and Spain, with regular one-on-ones and clear performance standards;

• Run a roadmap and quality cadence for the region, including roadmap reviews, coverage-parity readouts, and check-ins;

• Coach the team to Clio 's global performance bar, and close skill or process gaps as they come up;

• Take part in the Content Manager guild, and share source-acquisition tactics and enrichment patterns with the rest of Clio 's content org;

• Set and run the content roadmap for Spain and the priority Latin American jurisdictions;

• Track coverage, currency, and quality against providers such as vLex, Thomson Reuters LatAm, and Wolters Kluwer, and against Clio 's global bar;

• Set KPIs for completeness, update speed, enrichment depth, and reliability, by jurisdiction and for the region as a whole;

• Build the case for regional content investment, tied to win rate, retention, and revenue in Spain and Latin America;

• Work with Data Ops and Content Engineering to run regional ingestion and enrichment on Clio 's shared pipelines, including the Iceberg migration;

• Apply Clio 's global metadata and structure standards, citation models, and citator requirements to Spanish and Latin American case law and legislation;

• Send regional pipeline and tooling needs into the Content org's shared demand queue, with a clear case for priority;

• Keep a coverage map across the region's case law, legislation, and priority secondary sources, and rank gaps by legal authority, customer demand, competitive risk, and cost to close;

• Bring build, buy, and license recommendations to the Director, Licensing, and Corporate Development, with a clear cost-to-value case;

• Report regional cost per document, ingestion throughput, coverage parity, and enrichment progress on a regular cadence, and present quarterly to the Content Committee on the region's roadmap, risk, and business impact;

• Act as Clio 's expert on Spain and Latin American legal content, working fluently in English and Spanish with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Support;

• Serve as the bilingual point of contact between English- and Spanish-speaking stakeholders on specs, standards, and roadmap updates;

• Support enterprise RFPs and sales pursuits in Spain and Latin America that need legal-content expertise, and write up regional content strengths with Product Marketing and Sales Enablement;

• Feed regional competitive intelligence into pricing, packaging, and market-entry decisions.

What you may have:

• 8 to 12 years in legal publishing, legal data operations, or content and product management, with direct experience in Spain or Latin American legal markets.

• 2 or more years managing a team directly.

• Deep knowledge of at least one Latin American legal system, or the Spanish legal system, and a working grasp of how they differ from each other.

• A track record of running a multi-country content operation, or a regional team, against a shared, global standard.

• Full fluency in English and Spanish, spoken and written, at a level that holds up with executives and in technical specs.

• People management skills: coaching, performance conversations, and team culture building.

• Product ownership across more than one jurisdiction at once, with the judgment to spot what is truly region-specific and what should run to a common standard.

• Data-driven prioritization and ROI modeling skills.

• Enough technical knowledge of ingestion pipelines, metadata, and citators to work as a counterpart to Data Ops and Content Engineering.

• A growth mindset about process improvement and new technology, especially AI.

Serious bonus points if you:

• Treat legal content as strategic infrastructure, and hold a high bar on accuracy and quality.

• Build one coherent practice across several jurisdictions, rather than run each market as its own operation.

• Work across languages and cultures without losing precision or authority.

• Own outcomes at the portfolio level, and coach the team that delivers them.

What you will find here:
Compensation is one of the main components of Clio ’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.
Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

•
Competitive, equitable salary.

• Top-tier medical and dental coverage at preferred employee pricing for you and your family, with access from Day 1.

• Clio offers a flexible hybrid work environment with intentional in-person gatherings to build connection.

• 23 Days Paid Time Off + Company Observed Holidays including short Fridays as well as a summer schedule for work-life balance.

• Professional development and growth options

• Pet friendly workspace in our Barcelona office

• Company events and social-impact programs that reinforce our shared values, community, and culture.

• Clio versary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

Please note salary bands may differ based on location and local currency. Additionally, benefits may differ depending on the employee's location.
Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility
Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.
Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers
We're a Human and High Performing AI company, meaning we use artificial intelligence to improve all of our operations. In recruitment, AI helps us streamline the process for greater efficiency. However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.
Disclaimer: We only communicate with candidates through official @clio.com email addresses.
