postings.title: Senior Android Engineer - LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
About the Job
AOA is hiring a Senior Android Engineer to build the native Android experience that runs on a custom ARM-based embedded device, not a phone. This is a full-stack device role that spans low-level hardware integration up through the companion mobile app. You will own the Android architecture for purpose-built hardware: an offline-first, modular system with encrypted per-profile storage, designed so a great experience holds up on real hardware with constrained resources.
This is the senior technical owner role for the device's Android experience. We keep specifications lean because we trust strong engineers to think deeply, resolve open architecture decisions, and shape the technical path forward. You will integrate the device's onboard cameras, sensors, controlled lighting, and physical hardware controls used as the primary navigation input instead of touch, build the shared abstraction layers the rest of the app consumes, and connect the device to the world through Bluetooth audio, Wi-Fi sync, OTA updates, and companion apps.
You will operate independently across the device and companion-app surface, partnering with designers, the product owner, and any hardware or firmware counterparts to move work forward with clarity and care. As an AI-native agency, we use modern AI coding tools and agents to increase speed, quality, and focus, while keeping strong human judgment at the center of the final product.
You may be a strong fit if you are a senior Android engineer who has built for real devices or embedded hardware, not only phone apps, takes pride in software that works close to the metal, enjoys turning ambiguity into thoughtful implementation, and wants to own the Android work end-to-end with a close-knit team that cares deeply about client outcomes.

Role Details

• Compensation: $5,000 USD per month

• Engagement: Contract (independent contractor)

• Location: Remote, based in Latin America

• Schedule: Available during standard business hours in US Central Time, for strong overlap with the team

• Reports to: Engineering Manager

About AOA

AOA is a growing digital design and development agency that creates high-impact websites, AI-native apps, and standout eCommerce experiences for ambitious modern brands.
We partner closely with eCommerce and SaaS companies to deliver thoughtful, polished work that drives meaningful results and lasting client success. Our work spans strategy, design, development, eCommerce, conversion optimization, and custom application development.
We are a close-knit team where every person has a direct, visible impact on our clients' success and the growth of the company. We value genuine relationships, high standards, ownership, clear communication, and a true commitment to client delight.
As an AI-native agency, we use modern tools to enhance the quality, speed, and clarity of our work, while keeping human judgment, creativity, and relationships at the center.

Responsibilities

• Key Outcome: Deliver high-quality, high-performing embedded Android experiences that AOA is known for, with predictability, agentic-efficiency, and collaborative ownership.

• Own the end-to-end Android architecture for native Android on custom ARM-based embedded hardware.

• Design an offline-first, modular system with local data architecture that can support future cloud sync.

• Design encrypted per-profile storage, the local database, and build variants for the embedded device.

• Resolve open architecture decisions and own the technical path forward.

• Integrate device hardware into the app, including onboard cameras, controlled lighting, proximity sensors, and physical navigation controls.

• Build shared hardware-abstraction layers for camera management, physical input, and device lifecycle behavior.

• Design around display power states, cold boot, power transitions, abnormal shutdowns, and constrained hardware resources.

• Build the on-device Kotlin experience from approved designs and specifications, including a UI navigated by physical controls.

• Ensure core product features work reliably offline.

• Implement Bluetooth audio, Wi-Fi sync, OTA updates, offline device-to-device transfer, and casting or streaming.

• Design connected-device flows to degrade gracefully without bricking the device or corrupting data.

• Build and maintain companion mobile apps and device-to-companion integration, including pairing, transfer, and shared data contracts.

• Meet device performance targets for cold boot, profile switching, and camera initialization.

• Use the device GPU and NPU appropriately for imaging and AR work while managing memory and power limits.

• Turn product-level requirements into clear engineering work, owning the technical “how.”

• Bring strong engineering and UX judgment to the work, rather than building only what is explicitly written.

• Write typed, tested, maintainable Kotlin that follows the existing codebase conventions.

• Verify every feature on real hardware before handoff and catch issues before QA.

• Conduct code reviews and set the review bar for Android work.

• Lead the Android work technically and raise the capability of the intermediate developer on the project.

• Establish the patterns and abstractions other Android work builds on.

• Size your work in points, commit within the monthly delivery cycle, and reliably deliver what you planned.

• Time-box spikes to resolve genuine hardware unknowns before they become delivery risks.

• Use AI coding tools and agents thoughtfully to increase throughput and quality.

• Keep engineering judgment in control of the final output.

• Plan and sequence your work across the device and companion-app surface.

• Surface risks and tradeoffs early, and communicate proactively across a remote team.

Qualifications

• 5+ years building production Android applications in Kotlin.

• Deep, current Android platform expertise.

• Hands-on experience building Android for custom, embedded, or non-phone hardware.

• Experience integrating device hardware such as cameras, sensors, peripherals, or physical controls.

• Experience designing offline-first or local-data architectures with future sync in mind.

• Connectivity experience with Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, OTA updates, or device pairing.

• A track record of owning Android architecture end-to-end as a senior engineer.

• Strong judgment in resolving open technical decisions and owning tradeoffs.

• Strong Android fundamentals: lifecycle, state management, performance, and memory.

• Experience taking ambiguous requirements through to production on real hardware.

• A strong quality discipline: typed, tested code and on-device verification before QA.

• Ability to estimate your work, commit within a delivery cycle, and reliably deliver.

• Excellent professional English, spoken and written.

• Strong written communication and proactive, independent work in a fully remote team.

• Reliable overlap with standard US Central Time business hours.

• Fluent, practical use of AI coding tools as part of your engineering workflow.

• Based in Latin America and able to work as an independent contractor.

Preferred Qualifications

• Platform or OS-adjacent work: AOSP-level engineering, native C/C++ via the NDK/JNI, or custom ROM or HAL work.

• Multi-camera work with Camera2 or CameraX, on-device computer vision, or ML and AR using the device GPU/NPU.

• Bluetooth audio (A2DP/HFP), Matter, or Thread.

• Experience building or operating an OTA update pipeline.

• Companion app and device-pairing experience.

• Mentoring or technical leadership of other engineers.

• A portfolio, GitHub, or code samples you can share.

You do not need to check every single box to apply. We know strong engineers bring the right experience in different ways. If you have built Android on real devices or embedded hardware, take real ownership of the architecture, and want to do it at AI-native speed, we would love to hear from you.

postings.descriptionText:
Data Scientist
(Machine Learning & Databricks)

💰 Salary | $2,000 USD/month (Bi-weekly payments)
📍 Location | Remote from Latin America
🕙 Schedule | Full-time
💼 Employment Type | Contractor
🇺🇸 Perks & Time Off | U.S. holidays off, generous PTO, internal training, and mentorship

About the Client
Latino Legends is partnering with a high-growth U.S. marketing intelligence company to find top-tier nearshore talent. Our client does not just report on data—they build with it, driving marketing decisions for over 1,000 dealer clients across digital and direct channels. They operate on a cloud-native Databricks Lakehouse platform and foster an AI-forward culture where modern tooling accelerates analysis and deployment.

The Role
As a Data Scientist, you will work primarily inside Databricks building datasets, features, and machine learning models that power marketing intelligence. You will spend your time on data preparation, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, and model training/evaluation, supported by senior engineers and architects on the production side.

Key Responsibilities

Data & Modeling (80%)

• Build and maintain data pipelines and transformations in Databricks using Python, PySpark, and SQL.

• Perform exploratory data analysis to understand marketing, campaign, and customer datasets.

• Engineer features, prepare training datasets, and train, evaluate, and tune machine learning models.

• Support model deployment and monitoring in production alongside senior engineers.

• Investigate and resolve data quality issues in source feeds and pipelines.

• Leverage AI coding tools efficiently while maintaining code quality and deep understanding.

Collaboration & Quality (20%)

• Participate in sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives within an Agile/SCRUM framework.

• Write tests, data validation checks, and participate in code reviews.

• Document datasets, features, model assumptions, and results.

• Present findings and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders.

Core Qualifications

Required:

• Experience: 1-3 years of hands-on experience in data science, machine learning, or analytics engineering (including internships, co-ops, research, or complex projects).

• Education: Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Data Science, or comparable practical experience.

• Languages & Core Tooling: Solid proficiency with Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) and SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions).

• Data Science Fundamentals: Solid understanding of supervised learning, train/test splits, feature engineering, cross-validation, and evaluation metrics (ROC AUC, RMSE, precision, recall).

• Statistics & Data Handling: Working knowledge of descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, data profiling, and data cleaning.

• Modern Workflow: Proficiency with Git, collaborative development, and AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.).

• Communication: Strong written and spoken English skills to effectively explain complex findings to non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have:

• Hands-on experience with Databricks (Unity Catalog, clusters, jobs, notebooks) or PySpark.

• Exposure to MLflow, Delta Lake (medallion architecture), or Azure cloud services.

• Experience with time-series forecasting, uplift modeling, or audience segmentation.

• Familiarity with visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Plotly) or CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).

• Interest in Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI applications.

Why Apply Through Latino Legends ?

• Modern Stack: Hands-on experience in Databricks on a modern lakehouse platform with zero legacy code clutter.

• Mentorship & Career Growth: Work side-by-side with senior architects who review your code and help you transition from notebook experiments to production-level machine learning.

• High Impact: Your models directly inform millions of dollars in active marketing spend.

• Distributed Culture: Enjoy a collaborative, cross-border culture across the U.S. and Latin America.

• Responsible to coordinate and develop competitive and flexible strategies for potential awards in oncology and oncology-related indications, leveraging expertise, operational capabilities, and technologies to ensure client needs are addressed in the pre-award activities.

• Serves as the lead oncology strategist as assigned for potential awards and/or supports the other oncology-focused operational strategists as appropriate.

• Co-leads bid defense preparations with Business Development for assigned opportunities and participate in other client meetings as needed in collaboration with Business Development, the SVP, SSPC, and other Senior Operational staff.

• Develops strong relations with clients’ key decision makers by leveraging knowledge and expertise to drive repeat business for oncology and oncology-related opportunities and awards.

• Collaborates closely with other global functions, such as Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, Statistics, Regulatory and Safety as per the scope of the opportunity.

• Supports functional teams to enhance client relations and ensure high customer satisfaction.

• Support business development and marketing activities by participating in conferences and meetings and generating marketing content such as webinars and white papers as part of Ergomed Group’s overall marketing strategy.

• Degree in a life science or another related field, or equivalent education and experience. Advanced degree preferred.

• Extensive experience in clinical research within a CRO with strong oncology experience

• Demonstrated experience at a senior level contributing to project oversight and delivery

• Proven track-record in maintaining, developing and strengthening customer relations

• Previous experience in an oncology strategy position preferred

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.
We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

• Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.

• Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

• Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

• Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

• Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

• Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.
Medicine moves forward here. So will you.
Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.
We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.
That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.
If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

About the Role
Insait is building the production-grade AI backbone for top-tier financial institutions. There is a genuinely differentiated product, a sector with enormous untapped spend, and a leadership team that will invest in whoever takes this seat. If you want to own something - a market, a territory, a commission plan you helped design - this is it.

Whitespace territory
North America is largely uncaptured. You will be building the map, not following one.

A product that sells itself
Banks understand data and ROI. Insait speaks that language fluently, with live demos that land.

Leadership access
Direct line to the CEO. Your feedback shapes product roadmap, pricing and go-to-market strategy.

The Role
You will own the full sales cycle across a defined North American territory, targeting banks, community credit unions and financial institutions with between $500m and $20bn in assets under management. Requirements
Insait are not looking for someone who has sold every fintech product under the sun. They want someone who has sold into financial services - ideally into community banks, credit unions, or mid-market financial institutions - and who understands how decisions get made inside a regulated, risk-averse buyer.

• 5-9 years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with at least 3 years selling to financial services institutions.

• Demonstrable track record of closing net-new logo business in the $80k-$300k ACV range.

• Experience selling a data, analytics, marketing technology or AI platform to a financial services buyer - not just a transactional SaaS tool.

• Proven experience selling to Chief Revenue Officers (CROs) or other revenue leaders at financial institutions, and the ability to build a business case around revenue growth, cross-sell and customer acquisition.

• Comfortable navigating multi-threaded deals involving IT, marketing, data, and C-suite stakeholders.

• Experience at a startup (under 100 employees) where you had to build pipeline from scratch, without a fully-formed SDR team or extensive marketing support.

• North America-based, with established relationships in the US banking or credit union ecosystem preferred.

Commercial Skills

• Ability to build and progress pipeline without relying on inbound or SDR support - you know how to get in front of people.

• Strong qualification instinct. You know the difference between interest and intent, and you do not waste cycles on the wrong opportunities.

• Capable of mapping an account, identifying economic buyers, champions and blockers, and building a multi-threaded engagement strategy.

• Commercial creativity - you can structure a deal, handle procurement friction and close in a way that works for both sides.

Technical and Domain Skills

• Confident enough with data and AI concepts to run a credible product demonstration and handle technical objections without engineering support in early calls.

• Able to translate product capability into specific business outcomes - conversion rate uplift, cross-sell revenue, reduced campaign spend - in the language a bank's CMO or CDO actually cares about.

• Competent with a modern sales stack: CRM hygiene, sales engagement tooling, and pipeline management disciplines.

Interpersonal and Start-up Skills

• High trust, low ego. You share what you know, ask for help when you need it, and give honest feedback to the people building the product.

• Self-sufficient under ambiguity. When there is no clear answer, you make a decision, document what you did, and iterate.

• Strong communicator - in writing, on video calls, and in-person. Financial services buyers are conservative. You need to be credible in their room.

• Resilient. Enterprise fintech sales is long. You stay the course without being chased.

postings.title: Director of Product Management — MetaDefender Cloud
postings.descriptionText:
OPSWAT , a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position
This is a hands-on, business-owner product leadership role, not a pure strategy or coordination seat. An experienced product manager reports to you, with full people responsibility, and dedicated cloud engineering teams partner with you daily. You operate like a general manager, fluent in packaging, pricing models, and metering, and conversant in NDR and GDR. You understand the whole business, from sales enablement and marketing through inbound and digital motion to field events and channel partners, and hold every investment to a strong ROI. You also carry the platform responsibility everything else depends on: performance, availability, migration, and cost. You bring an AI-first mindset, leveraging AI in the day-to-day work of the team to maximize efficiency and output.
Join a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader at the forefront of innovation. We protect the unseen — the infrastructure that powers our way of life. OPSWAT protects the world’s critical infrastructure across IT, OT, and ICS environments, trusted by more than 2,000 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide.
We are seeking an exceptional product leader to own the vision, strategy, and execution of MetaDefender Cloud, the verdict as an API. Enterprises, governments, and technology partners send it files and get back a decision they can trust (“is this file safe to admit?”) at any volume. This is business ownership of a trust-critical enterprise cloud: the commercial ladder from self-serve developer entry to a top tier for regulated buyers, and everything that makes it credible, from contractual SLAs, availability, and failover to compliance, cost efficiency, and a platform other OPSWAT services build on. You will grow the business through product-led motion, cloud marketplaces, distribution channels, and a Technology Partners program that makes joining our ecosystem a product action, not a sales project.
MetaDefender Cloud delivers OPSWAT ’s prevention technologies (multiscanning, Deep CDR, and AI-driven analysis) as a cloud service, and is the shared platform behind a growing family of OPSWAT cloud offerings. This role owns that business end to end:

• The Prevention Ladder:one coherent tier ladder from self-serve developer entry to full enterprise, sold to one buyer who moves up as throughput and analysis depth grow.

• The Regulated Enterprise:the top of the ladder: dedicated capacity, the strictest SLAs, large-file support, and a strict data-privacy and data-handling posture for regulated industries.

• A Resilient, Compliant Cloud:reliability as a product, with availability targets, failover, recovery objectives, multi-region resilience, and certifications such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2 that make trust a reason to buy.

• The Platform Behind OPSWAT ’s Cloud Services:one API and platform that web proxy and ICAP protection, MetaDefender Secure Storage, email security, MetaDefender for Salesforce, and the threat-hunting tier build on.

• Performance & Cost Efficiency:industry-leading speed to verdict, and a cost-per-scan discipline that protects margin as volume grows. You own the unit economics.

• Technology Partners & Developer Ecosystem:the program for engine partners who strengthen detection, integration partners who put our verdict where security teams work, and developers who build it into their own products.

• Marketplaces & Distribution:taking the product where buyers already purchase: cloud marketplaces such as AWS and Azure, distribution channels, and reseller partners, plus new offerings, such as MetaDefender Private for dedicated deployments, as the market demands.

What You Will be Doing

• Own the business:define and champion the vision, strategy, and roadmap for MetaDefender Cloud, and be accountable for growth, adoption, and commercial outcomes.

• Own reliability as a product:make contractual SLAs (latency, availability, and recovery objectives) the standard across every tier, and drive high availability, automatic failover, and multi-region resilience from roadmap to contract.

• Own compliance & regulation:maintain and extend our certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2, and beyond) and the data-privacy and data-residency posture, so regulated buyers can say yes.

• Run the platform for its stakeholders:treat the OPSWAT services built on the cloud (web proxy and ICAP, secure storage, email, Salesforce, threat hunting) as first-class customers, balancing their needs with one coherent platform.

• Own pricing & packaging:design and maintain the prevention tier ladder, packaging, metering, and discount guidance, steward the one price book with your Aether counterpart, and monitor realization against list.

• Drive cost efficiency:own cost per scan and the margin story, and make efficiency a continuous, measured program.

• Lead the platform evolution:carry customers through major platform transitions, with migration paths that never ask them to break their integration, and retire legacy offerings cleanly.

• Grow marketplaces & distribution:list the product on the cloud marketplaces where buyers already purchase, grow channel and reseller partnerships, and build the no-touch motion behind them.

postings.title: Semi-Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
postings.descriptionText:
Semi-Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
Full-time contractor · Fully remote · Latin America only

Cloudnonic is an international, fully remote cloud and software company. We build customized cloud-native systems for clients in Europe and North America, and we're looking for a Semi-Senior QA engineer to join the team.

Who we are

Cloudnonic Corp . is a digitally native software and cloud startup based in the Kitchener/Waterloo area, Ontario, Canada. We're fully remote, with developers in Canada and South America and clients across Europe, North America, and South America. We work across healthcare, finance, construction, and manufacturing, and we take the time to understand each client's industry so we can serve it well with technology.

We're big on AI and the cloud. Our services range from app and web development to AI and cloud integration, plus technology consulting: designing feasible, secure, cost-effective architectures for non-technical clients and advising them on their tech stack.

The role

You'll test across multiple client projects, each with its own platform, users, and quirks. You'll need to understand a new platform quickly and see it the way its end users do: what they expect, where they get confused, and what breaks when they do something nobody planned for.

We ship weekly, from development to staging to production. You'll be the quality gate in between. That includes regression testing: running the same core flows release after release, carefully, every time. If repetition bores you, this isn't the right fit. If you see it as the job that protects users, it is.

We deliver AI-first. AI generates our tickets and acceptance criteria, we pair with AI while developing, and every pull request goes through AI review before a senior engineer reviews it. That makes us fast, and it makes QA more important, not less. We expect you to use AI to generate test cases, draft scripts, and speed up automation, and to know where it falls short: an AI-written test can pass while missing the bug a real user would hit. You need to judge whether a test actually proves something. If you can only run the tests an AI wrote for you, this isn't the role for you.

You'll work closely with developers and project managers, and you'll keep moving our testing forward by adopting new automation tools as they appear. Expect to be challenged constantly, and to enjoy the work along the way.

What you'll do

• Test new features and bug fixes across multiple client projects before they reach production

• Run regression testing on core user flows for every release

• Write clear test cases and test scripts based on acceptance criteria

• Build and maintain automated tests using modern tools, including AI-powered testing tools

• Report bugs with precise reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, and evidence

• Evaluate features from the end user's perspective and flag usability issues, not only functional ones

• Work independently while keeping the team informed

We're looking for a self-starter who organizes their own day. We trust you to prioritize your week and keep everyone updated as you go.

Requirements

Language

• Fluent Spanish

• Advanced English (able to discuss issues with the team and clients)

Technical

• 2+ years of full-time QA experience

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to learn new platforms quickly

• Experience writing test cases and test scripts

• Basic technical background: browser developer tools, API testing (e.g., Postman), and basic scripting in JavaScript or TypeScript

• Experience with test automation tools such as Playwright or Cypress

• Experience using AI tools in daily work, including for QA (test generation, test case design, automation)

• Experience with issue trackers (we use Linear)

• Experience with Agile methodologies

Bonus

• Experience testing healthcare or other regulated software

• Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines

• Fluent English (B2+)

• Strong written and oral communication

What we offer

• Fully remote: work from home or anywhere you choose

• Competitive pay: rates that compete with the best in the Latin American market, tailored to your seniority and skills, paid in the currency you prefer

• Crypto payment available on request

• Full-time contractor: you manage your own finances

• Flexible hours: we work across time zones and trust you to get your work done on your schedule

• Company culture: no rigid hierarchy; hard work and enjoying the journey are not in conflict

• Gaming: online games with colleagues over Discord is a regular thing here

• Broad technical exposure: many platforms and challenges in a short time; you won't get bored in the same project

• International clients: US, Canada, Germany, and beyond, with the languages and cultures that come with them

• Professional development: sponsored online courses and certifications on demand

• Career development: build expertise across industries, not only in testing

Interested?

If this sounds like you and you meet the minimum requirements, apply.

postings.title: Market Curation Editor — Politics
postings.descriptionText:
The Opportunity
As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate political prediction markets every day; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current expertise in politics and elections, and in the conventions that govern how political outcomes are officially called and settled.

What You'll Do

• Review a daily queue of system-generated political markets against a fixed completion deadline, working event by event across every market a political development generates.

• Assess each candidate market for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated against a named authoritative source (e.g., the AP, official state election boards, certified results) and a defined settlement date.

• Verify that open and close timing is correct for the underlying event, including scheduled and unscheduled delays — runoff elections, recounts, and certification delays.

• Apply the correct settlement convention for the type of political event in question — election calls and concession timing, recounts and certification, runoff triggers, ballot measure outcomes, legislative vote counts, and official statistical or vote-count corrections.

• Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines, escalating anything ambiguous, contested, or politically sensitive rather than making an unsupported call.

• Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin.

• Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision, and for how the public and press actually talk about the event.

• Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and resolve settlement exceptions the data feed can't handle — contested results, recounts, litigation.

• Run proactive gap scans — monitor live markets for visible errors, and track campaign schedules, polling releases, and political and press social media for events the pipeline didn't capture.

• Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators.

What We're Looking For

• 3+ years in political trading or prediction markets, political data operations, political/data journalism or editorial, polling and election modeling, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise.

• Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. politics and elections — following it now, not historically — across federal, state, and major local races.

• Fluency with political media and political social media (campaign accounts, press pool reporting, breaking political news accounts).

• Working knowledge of official election administration and settlement conventions (certification timelines, recount thresholds, runoff triggers, Electoral College mechanics where relevant), and of which sources are authoritative for results and vote counts.

• Proven judgment on edge cases: contested results, recounts, litigation, ballot curing, ambiguous or delayed official calls.

• Ability to interpret official sources quickly and reach a defensible determination.

• Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known.

• Comfort applying a written policy framework, with the instinct to escalate rather than guess — especially on politically sensitive or contested topics.

• Flexible availability for evening and weekend work around debates, primaries, and election nights.

Nice to Have

• Direct experience trading on, or working with, political prediction markets or exchanges such as Kalshi or Polymarket.

• Background in polling and election modeling — for example, FiveThirtyEight during its ABC/ESPN era, Decision Desk HQ, VoteHub, or similar outlets; data-journalism experience of this kind, including at spinoffs such as Fifty Plus One, is also relevant.

• Prior work on a political trading desk, or standing as a super-user of political prediction apps.

• Political journalism background and/or experience contributing to guidelines, style guides, rulebooks, or annotation standards.

• Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards, particularly around politically sensitive content.

postings.title: CRO / Landing Page Optimization Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **
Location: Remote – Latin America
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor
Industry: Digital Marketing / Performance Marketing / Lead Generation
Compensation: $4,000 USD per month
Schedule: Full-Time | U.S. business hours
English Proficiency: Professional English required

About the Company
Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based digital marketing company helping local and home service businesses generate qualified leads, strengthen their online presence, and grow through innovative digital marketing strategies.
The organization operates in a highly performance-driven environment where experimentation, measurable results, speed, and continuous optimization are central to how the company works.
As the business continues to scale, the team is investing heavily in improving conversion performance across landing pages, funnels, campaigns, and the overall customer acquisition journey.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced CRO & Landing Page Specialist with deep expertise in lead generation, conversion-focused landing pages, and funnel optimization.
The core objective of this position is simple: understand what motivates users to take action and continuously improve the journey from initial interest through conversion.
This is not simply a landing page design role.
We are looking for someone who thinks analytically, understands consumer psychology, develops clear hypotheses, runs structured experiments, and uses data to continuously improve conversion performance.
The ideal candidate is equally comfortable analyzing a funnel, identifying friction, developing an A/B test, optimizing messaging, reviewing behavioral data, and translating results into actionable improvements.

What You’ll Do

• Build and optimize landing pages designed to generate qualified leads.

• Analyze user behavior throughout the conversion funnel.

• Identify friction points that reduce click-through rates, form completion, or conversions.

• Develop data-driven hypotheses for improving landing-page and funnel performance.

• Plan, launch, and evaluate A/B and multivariate tests.

• Optimize headlines, messaging, calls to action, page structure, forms, layouts, and other conversion elements.

• Analyze conversion data and prioritize experiments based on potential business impact.

• Continuously improve click-through rates, lead volume, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.

• Review heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and behavioral data to identify opportunities.

• Collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, paid media specialists, marketers, and other stakeholders.

• Translate performance data into clear recommendations and actionable next steps.

• Maintain an organized experimentation roadmap and testing backlog.

• Document test results, insights, and learnings.

• Apply successful learnings across additional campaigns, landing pages, and funnels.

• Help develop scalable CRO frameworks and best practices as the organization grows.

Qualifications

Required

• Professional experience in Conversion Rate Optimization, landing-page optimization, or funnel optimization .

• Strong hands-on experience with lead-generation funnels .

• Proven ability to improve landing-page and funnel conversion performance.

• Deep understanding of what motivates users to click, engage, submit forms, and convert.

• Hands-on experience designing, executing, and analyzing A/B tests .

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong understanding of conversion psychology, user behavior, and persuasive messaging.

• Ability to analyze marketing, funnel, and conversion data.

• Experience identifying friction points throughout a customer journey.

• Experience continuously optimizing campaigns rather than relying on one-time page launches.

• Ability to clearly explain testing hypotheses, findings, and recommendations.

• Professional English communication skills.

• Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

Preferred

• Experience using landing-page builders, funnel platforms, or CMS tools.

• Experience with web analytics and behavioral analytics platforms.

• Familiarity with heatmaps, session recordings, click tracking, and user-behavior analysis.

• Strong understanding of direct-response marketing principles.

• Experience working closely with paid media or performance marketing teams.

• Experience optimizing form completion rates and lead quality.

• Understanding of customer acquisition costs, cost per lead, and conversion economics.

• Experience with high-volume lead-generation campaigns.

• Familiarity with tools such as Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, VWO, Optimizely, Unbounce, Webflow, or similar platforms.

• Experience within digital marketing agencies, local services, or performance-driven businesses.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

• Data-driven: You use evidence rather than assumptions to make decisions.

• Experiment-oriented: You constantly look for opportunities to test and improve.

• Analytical: You enjoy understanding why users behave the way they do.

• Conversion-focused: You evaluate pages and funnels based on business results, not aesthetics alone.

• Curious: You continually ask why something is or is not converting.

• Commercially minded: You understand the relationship between conversion rates, lead quality, acquisition costs, and revenue.

• Detail-oriented: Small changes matter, and you pay attention to them.

• Proactive: You identify optimization opportunities without waiting for someone else to point them out.

• Collaborative: You can work effectively with designers, copywriters, marketers, and performance teams.

• Results-driven: You care about measurable improvements and business impact.

How Success Is Measured
Success in this role will be measured through:

•
Landing-page conversion rate.

•
Funnel click-through rate.

•
Lead-generation volume.

•
Cost per lead.

•
Form completion rate.

•
Lead quality.

•
Experiment velocity.

•
Number of meaningful tests launched.

• Percentage of tests producing successful or actionable learnings.

• Implementation of successful CRO insights across additional campaigns and funnels.

• Overall improvement in conversion economics.

Why Join Us

• Join a fast-growing, performance-focused digital marketing organization.

• Own high-impact conversion initiatives that directly influence business results.

• Work across landing pages, funnels, user behavior, testing, and lead generation.

• Collaborate closely with talented marketing, creative, and performance teams.

• Work in an environment where experimentation and continuous improvement are strongly encouraged.

• Have significant autonomy to identify opportunities, test ideas, and improve performance.

• Develop broader responsibilities as the organization continues to scale.

Growth Opportunity
Internal promotion is an important part of the company's culture.
High-performing team members are encouraged to expand their responsibilities, develop new skills, and pursue leadership opportunities as the organization grows.
The successful candidate should be excited about becoming a key contributor to the company's conversion strategy and taking on broader optimization and performance responsibilities over time.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

COO / CEO-in-Training — Trustbridge Design & Manufacturing (US)
A rare succession-track role: run a profitable manufacturing-tech business today, become its CEO tomorrow.
Location: Remote-flexible (Americas preferred, U.S. ideal) Reports to: Founder, Vulcury Venture Studio Level: Co-founder equivalent — base salary + meaningful equity + performance incentives

Why This Role Is Different
Most "CEO-track" roles are a promise. This one is a plan.
Trustbridge is already operating, revenue-generating, and profitable — you're not being asked to find product-market fit from zero. You're being asked to take a working business and scale it into the platform for the global manufacturing economy, with a defined path to the CEO seat and full P&L ownership.
And you won't do it alone. Trustbridge is incubated within Vulcury Venture Studio , which means research, marketing, finance, operations infrastructure, technical development, and investor access are already built. You focus on the company; the studio handles the scaffolding.

What Trustbridge Does
Companies building new products struggle to find the right manufacturing partners. Capable suppliers struggle to find qualified opportunities. Trustbridge sits in the middle of that market with:

•
Engineering & design services — design-for-manufacturing (DFM) and product development support that takes products from concept to production

•
A curated global supplier network — vetted manufacturers matched to real production opportunities

•
A supplier platform (in build) — software that streamlines how product companies discover, evaluate, and engage manufacturing partners

Services generate revenue and relationships today; the platform is the scale engine for tomorrow. You'll grow both.

What You'll Own
Business leadership. Partner with the founder on strategy, then execute it — build the team, the systems, and the operating rhythm of a scaling company.
Platform. Shape the product roadmap for the supplier platform and work with technical teams to make sure it delivers real value on both sides of the marketplace.
Commercial growth. Design and run the go-to-market for customer acquisition and supplier network expansion. Build relationships with product companies, engineering teams, and manufacturers.
Organization. Recruit the early leadership team, install scalable processes, and prepare the business for its next phase of growth and potential capital formation.

What Success Looks Like
Within the next few years, you will have:

• Grown the engineering services arm into a leading product development partner

• Built a robust, global network of qualified manufacturing suppliers

• Launched and scaled the Trustbridge supplier platform

• Positioned Trustbridge as the trusted partner for companies bringing products to market

At that point, you step fully into the Chief Executive Officer role.

Who You Are
You've likely spent a decade or more in manufacturing, supply chain, engineering services, or industrial markets — as a consultant, senior operator, or business-unit leader — and you're ready to stop advising and start building. You want ownership: of outcomes, of a P&L, of equity that matters.

Must-haves

• 10+ years in manufacturing, supply chain, engineering services, or industrial markets

• MBA or comparable strategic leadership experience

• Proven track record leading teams and building organizations

• Strong operator: you build systems, not just slide decks

• Genuine entrepreneurial drive — you want to run a company, not a function

Strong pluses

• Top-tier management consulting background (McKinsey, Bain, BCG, Deloitte, Strategy&)

• Experience with manufacturing technology, B2B marketplaces, or supply chain platforms

• Experience working closely with engineering organizations or product companies

• Experience scaling early-stage businesses or new business units

Compensation
Structured as a co-founder level opportunity :

• Competitive base salary

• Meaningful equity participation in Trustbridge

• Performance incentives tied to company growth

Incentives are deliberately aligned with the long-term value you create.

How to Apply
Send your resume/LinkedIn profile along with a short note (a few sentences is fine) on the most impressive business or team you've built or scaled. We review every application and respond to all shortlisted candidates within one week.
Trustbridge Design & Manufacturing is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds across the Americas.

postings.title: Engineering Manager - Distributed Systems, Python / Go
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across many sectors.
Canonical is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1,200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Distributed Systems Testing to lead a team responsible for the quality engineering platform that enables deployment and validation of distributed systems across Canonical 's cloud portfolio.
We see quality engineering as a first-class engineering practice. Our Distributed Systems Testing team ensures the performance, correctness, resilience and interoperability of Canonical cloud solutions built with technologies such as Juju, Terraform, OpenStack and Kubernetes. These systems are deployed and tested across diverse environments, from bare-metal to the public cloud.
As Engineering Manager, you will combine strong software engineering judgement with people leadership. You will develop engineering talent, establish effective engineering practices, shape technical direction with senior engineers, and ensure the team delivers high-quality testing infrastructure and automation that enables engineering teams across Canonical to ship software with confidence.
We believe engineering managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. You should be comfortable reviewing patches, evaluating software design, debugging a distributed system, or discussing test architecture. You will contribute technically where appropriate to set a high standard, while recognizing that your greatest impact comes from shaping the direction, focus, effectiveness, and growth of the whole team.
You will work closely with senior engineers and engineering leaders across Canonical to define priorities, improve testing capabilities, and advance how we validate increasingly complex cloud-native and distributed systems.
Location: This is a globally remote role, typically leading a team concentrated within a major time zone such as EMEA or the Americas.

What you'll do

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of software and quality engineers, ranging from graduate to senior level

• Set clear expectations, strengthen engineering practices, and ensure timely delivery against agreed goals

• Partner with senior engineers to shape technical strategy, architecture, roadmap, and engineering standards

• Guide the development of automated testing infrastructure for the reliability, interoperability, and resilience of distributed systems

• Improve CI pipelines, testing tools, and reporting used to validate Canonical 's products and solutions across bare-metal, private and public cloud environments

• Enable engineering teams across Canonical to adopt effective distributed-systems testing practices and tooling

• Contribute technical leadership through design and code reviews, debugging, and hands-on engineering where appropriate

• Represent the team with stakeholders and collaborate across Canonical on quality engineering, infrastructure, and developer experience

What we're looking for in you

• An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

• Experience in leading, coaching, and mentoring software engineers

• Professional software engineering experience with Python or Go

• Expertise in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, quality engineering, or a closely related domain

• Strong knowledge of modern software testing processes, strategies, and automation

• Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

• Strong technical judgement and the ability to engage meaningfully in code reviews, architecture discussions, and software design

• Experience working in an agile development environment with the ability to organize a team to deliver high-quality results

• Professional written and spoken English with excellent communication and presentation skills

• Great interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability, demonstrating passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation

• Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional skills we value

Experience with any of the following:

• Cloud technologies such as Kubernetes, OpenStack, Juju, Terraform, AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure

• Designing testing strategies for distributed or cloud-native systems

• Building or operating large-scale CI/CD and test infrastructure

• Applying AI or machine learning to test analysis, failure classification, or engineering workflows

• Deploying, operating, or debugging distributed systems

• Leading globally distributed teams

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually, and more often for graduates and associates, to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus.
We provide all team members with additional benefits that reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programmes to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Employee Assistance Programme and wellness support

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and a leading platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software.
We recruit globally and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Jefe de Operaciones Outlet y Calidad
postings.descriptionText:
En Bidcom lideramos el mercado de E-commerce en Argentina, consolidándonos como el vendedor #1 en Mercado Libre durante el Hot Sale 2026, tanto en facturación como en unidades vendidas. Lograr este hito requiere de una gestión operativa de excelencia, donde el control de calidad, el recupero técnico y la rentabilidad del canal outlet operan en perfecta sinergia.
Buscamos un/a Jefe de Operaciones Outlet y Calidad que lidere la estrategia end-to-end de recupero técnico, control de calidad y comercialización de productos outlet de la compañía. Ofrecemos un entorno dinámico, tecnológico y data-driven, ideal para profesionales con visión de negocio y mentalidad emprendedora que busquen transformar devoluciones e información operativa en una unidad de negocio altamente rentable.

Tareas y Responsabilidades:

• Liderar la estrategia end-to-end de recupero técnico, coordinando al equipo técnico para diagnosticar, reparar y poner en valor productos provenientes de devoluciones express.

• Gestionar el P&L del negocio Outlet, definiendo la estrategia de pricing, posicionamiento, costo de recupero y margen de contribución para maximizar la rentabilidad.

• Transformar el equipo de Calidad en un centro de Business Intelligence, diseñando tableros de control con datos de devoluciones y garantías para impulsar la mejora continua del catálogo.

• Impulsar la automatización e integración de nuevas tecnologías (como Inteligencia Artificial) en los procesos de inspección, clasificación y escala operativa.

• Construir, escalar y optimizar los canales de monetización de stock recuperado (Nuevo u Outlet), identificando nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento comercial.

• Cooperar activamente con las áreas de Operaciones, Dirección y Comerciales para alertar sobre fallas de fábrica, optimizar packaging y mejorar la experiencia final del usuario.

Requisitos:

• Experiencia de 3 a 5 años en posiciones de liderazgo operativo, servicio técnico, control de calidad, logística inversa o e-commerce/retail tecnológico.

• Marcada visión de negocio y perfil comercial con manejo fluido del P&L, costos y márgenes de contribución.

• Dominio avanzado de Sistemas de Gestión de Inventario (WMS / ERP) y herramientas de análisis financiero (Excel avanzado) (excluyente) .

• Experiencia comprobable liderando equipos multidisciplinarios (técnicos y analíticos) en entornos de alto volumen.

• Deseable: Experiencia en e-commerce/marketplaces (logística inversa, listings), estrategias de pricing dinámico, herramientas BI (Power BI/Tableau) e interés en IA aplicada.

• Formación: Graduados o estudiantes avanzados en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.

¿Por qué elegir este desafío?

• Porque vas a liderar la estrategia de recupero y calidad de una de las operaciones de Mercado Libre más importantes de Argentina.

• Porque tendrás ownership directo sobre el P&L de una unidad de negocio en constante crecimiento.

• Porque promoverás la innovación aplicando Inteligencia Artificial y Business Intelligence en procesos operativos reales.

• Porque impulsamos tu desarrollo profesional a la par de nuestro negocio en un entorno colaborativo y de alto rendimiento.

• Cobertura médica prepaga de primer nivel.

• Descuentos corporativos en productos de la compañía.

• Licencia por paternidad extendida.

• Acceso a máquina de snacks y beneficios exclusivos en la oficina.

Información de la Vacante:

postings.title: Encargado de Turno
postings.descriptionText:
At H&P, our people are our strength.

DESCRIPCIÓN DEL CARGO :
Propósitos generales para este puesto de trabajo:

• Orientar y guiar a la cuadrilla de Perforación en las operaciones de forma segura y exitosa.

• Conocer y aplicar los procedimientos de control de pozo.

• Cumplir con todas las normas estipuladas en los Reglamentos, Planes y Programa de HSE establecidos por la empresa

Responsabilidades:
Los próximos ítems representan la mayoría de las obligaciones requeridas para este puesto, pero la descripción es meramente enunciativa y no evita que pueda ser asignado a la realización de otras tareas, cuando sea necesario. Para la realización de las tareas asignadas a este puesto es necesario contar con la certificación Well Control vigente, así como con la responsabilidad y conducta constantes.

• Practicar el cumplimiento de las normas de prevención y control adoptadas por la Empresa, por su propia seguridad y salud en el trabajo y por la de aquellas personas a las que pueda afectar su actividad profesional, a causa de sus actos y omisiones en el trabajo, de conformidad con su formación e instrucciones establecidas.

• Hacer su trabajo en forma segura siguiendo los ATS’s.

• Liderar proactivamente y entrenar a sus cuadrillas a realizar sus labores en forma segura.

• Promover activamente las herramientas de gestión de HSEQ de la empresa: H&P Way, Life Belts (Salva Vidas), Actively CARE (Reforzar comportamientos seguros), Safety Contacts (Contactos de Seguridad).

• Requerir el seguimiento continuo de los Análisis de Seguridad del Trabajo (ATS’s) como una herramienta para realizar cada trabajo o tarea.

• Organizar reuniones semanales de HSE (Salud, Seguridad, Medio Ambiente) para motivar la máxima participación de empleados, compañías de servicio y representantes de la operadora.

• Actuar sobre las ideas y los temas de acción identificados durante las reuniones de HSE semanales para crear y/o mantener un ambiente de trabajo más saludable y más seguro.

• Asegurarse que se tome acción correctiva en las condiciones inseguras o riesgos físicos identificados en el taladro o en la bodega.

• Reportar todos los incidentes, accidentes y derrames siguiendo la línea de mando.

• Reportar todos los casi-incidentes que no resulten en lesiones personales o daño a la propiedad, pero que pudieran haber sucedido si las circunstancias hubieran sido un poco diferentes.

• Inspeccionar los equipos de terceras compañías o compañías de servicios antes de armarlo para “ponerlo en servicio”. Si encontró que no está en condición satisfactoria, reportar los resultados al representante de la operadora en la locación.

• Mantener el inventario actualizado de productos químicos de H&P en la locación y copias de las hojas de datos de Seguridad de Materiales (MSDS) asociadas a dichos materiales.

• Conocer las responsabilidades en las posiciones de boca de pozo, motorista, enganchador y perforador.

• Identificar la utilización adecuada y la aplicación de la tubería de perforación. Los diferentes diámetros, grados, roscas, torques y tensiones para cada una.

• Supervisar la actividad de inspección de tubería.

• Identificar la utilización adecuada y la aplicación de herramientas especiales de perforación.

• Conocer el adecuado ensamblaje de herramientas de perforación y sarta de perforación.

• Suministra completa identificación de tubulares y de herramientas que se suben a la mesa para ser corridas dentro del pozo.

• Conocer los procedimientos adecuados relacionados con las operaciones de perforación y saber dirigir y definir el procedimiento a seguir.

• Conocer los procedimientos adecuados relacionados con las operaciones de perforación y explicar las razones para dichos procedimientos.

• Tener habilidad para detectar los factores que se involucran para evitar que suceda una pega de tubería. Debe conocer todos los tipos de pega y sus subdivisiones.

• Conocer los procedimientos e identificar los diferentes mecanismos de pega de tubería.

• Identificar las diferentes formaciones que se están perforando.

• Determinar el volumen del lodo que se encuentra tanto en los tanques como en el anular, dentro de la tubería y el desplazamiento del mismo.

• Verificar que se realice el mantenimiento adecuado del malacate, del equipo de perforación y los equipos auxiliares.

• Conocer las responsabilidades asignadas a su cargo y a su cuadrilla en RAMS®.

• Tener habilidad Para detectar fallas en el equipo.

• Tener conocimiento para cortar el cable de perforación, cálculo de las toneladas milla y saber definir los tiempos y longitudes de corte del cable.

• Identificar las condiciones del pozo.

• Conocer los diferentes procedimientos para cerrar el pozo (Blando/Duro).

• Conocer la operación de las unidades de control de pozo (unidad remota, acumulador, super choque).

• Conocer los procedimientos de comunicación y notificación durante eventos de control de pozo.

• Tener habilidad para comunicarse, orientar y guiar efectivamente la cuadrilla de perforación y con los representantes de terceras compañías.

• Tener habilidad para delegar funciones y supervisarlas permanentemente.

• Tener habilidad para entender y seguir correctamente las órdenes y procedimientos.

• Conocer todos los requerimientos de HSE de la compañía y de la industria.

• Elaborar reportes según IADC. (kill sheet, trip sheet).

Thank you for your interest in joining our team!

postings.title: Operador de Producción
postings.descriptionText:
Job Summary

¿Te gustaría ser parte de un equipo de manufactura donde tu trabajo contribuya directamente a la calidad y seguridad de nuestros productos?

IFF es líder global en sabores, fragancias, ingredientes alimentarios y salud y biociencias. Ofrecemos innovaciones sustentables que mejoran los productos de uso cotidiano.

Buscamos personas para sumarse a nuestro equipo de Manufactura y participar en la elaboración de productos líquidos y mezclas de polvos, de manera eventual por cuatro meses, en Garin, Buenos Aires .

Serás parte de un equipo colaborativo, comprometido y orientado a soluciones , donde el trabajo conjunto es clave para cumplir con nuestro programa de producción, nuestros estándares de calidad e inocuidad y las necesidades de nuestros clientes.

Donde marcarás la diferencia

• Realizarás tareas operativas asociadas a la manufactura de productos líquidos o mezclas de polvos, incluyendo provisión, traslado, manipulación e identificación de materiales según cada etapa del proceso productivo.

• Verificarás la disponibilidad de los materiales necesarios y los trasladarás desde y hacia Depósito o entre las distintas etapas de fabricación, informando oportunamente cualquier desvío.

• Realizarás tareas de dosificación, pesado y trasvase siguiendo las fórmulas, órdenes e instrucciones de producción. Según el sector asignado, también podrás participar en procesos de mezclado, envasado y reproceso.

• Asegurarás la correcta identificación, lote y trazabilidad de los materiales utilizados en cada fabricación, respetando su estado de uso o aprobación y las ubicaciones definidas para cada instancia del proceso.

• Realizarás la limpieza de equipos, instalaciones y utensilios correspondientes a las tareas de manufactura, cumpliendo con los procedimientos establecidos, y mantendrás el orden y la limpieza del lugar de trabajo.

• Completarás los registros y controles requeridos e identificarás correctamente los equipos limpios, asegurando el cumplimiento de los procedimientos de trazabilidad e identificación vigentes.

• Realizarás los controles de proceso establecidos, incluidos los relacionados con mantenimiento y calibración de las herramientas y equipos bajo tu responsabilidad.

• Monitorearás los Programas de Prerrequisitos Operativos (PPRo) correspondientes al sector y cumplirás con los estándares definidos de buenas prácticas de manufactura, calidad e inocuidad alimentaria.

• Cumplirás con las políticas, procedimientos y estándares de Medio Ambiente, Salud y Seguridad (EHS), incluyendo el uso adecuado de elementos de protección personal, la gestión de residuos y el reporte de incidentes, actos o condiciones inseguras.

Lo que te hace la persona indicada

• Estudios secundarios completos.

• Experiencia en áreas de manufactura dentro de la industria alimentaria o industrias con procesos productivos similares.

• Disponibilidad full time para trabajar en turnos rotativos.

• Capacidad para seguir fórmulas, órdenes, instrucciones y procedimientos establecidos de producción, seguridad, calidad e inocuidad.

• Compromiso con las buenas prácticas de manufactura, la trazabilidad, el orden y la seguridad en el trabajo.

• Responsabilidad y capacidad de adaptación frente a cambios en las necesidades de producción.

Cómo podrías destacarte

• Experiencia previa en procesos de dosificación, pesado, mezclado, envasado o trasvase dentro de entornos productivos.

• Conocimientos de informática y experiencia como persona usuaria de SAP.

• Capacidad para resolver problemas de manera práctica, trabajar en equipo y mantener el foco en la calidad, seguridad y cumplimiento de procedimientos.

¿Por qué elegir IFF?

• Tendrás la oportunidad de adquirir experiencia en un entorno industrial vinculado con la manufactura de productos e ingredientes.

• Formarás parte de un equipo donde la colaboración es fundamental para alcanzar los objetivos de producción.

• Trabajarás bajo estándares definidos de seguridad, calidad e inocuidad alimentaria.

• Podrás aplicar y desarrollar conocimientos en procesos productivos, trazabilidad y buenas prácticas de manufactura.

• Te sumarás a una compañía global que pone foco en calidad, seguridad, eficiencia y sustentabilidad a lo largo de su cadena de valor.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace-diversity-and-inclusion to learn more

Profesionales graduados/as de las carreras de Recursos Humanos, Relaciones Laborales, Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial o afines. Se valorarán perfiles con formación jurídica que cuenten con una marcada orientación a la gestión de personas y al trabajo en campo.




Experiencia requerida:



Contar con 5 años de experiencia en posiciones generalistas de Recursos Humanos, Desarrollo Organizacional, Gestión del Talento, Relaciones Laborales o roles similares en compañías con dotaciones operativas relevantes.

Se valorará experiencia en empresas de servicios o industrias intensivas en operación, tales como Oil & Gas, energía, construcción o servicios industriales.

The Opportunity

As a Talent Attraction Manager, Assistant Director, you will oversee a dynamic team of Talent Attraction Recruiters, driving our mission to attract and retain the best talent for our organization. You will play a critical role in shaping our recruitment strategies, enhancing our candidate experience, and ensuring that our team operates at the highest level of efficiency and effectiveness. Your leadership will be essential in fostering a collaborative environment that empowers team members to excel and innovate.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Demonstrate initiative and self-motivation by serving as an individual contributor when needed, driving project success while collaborating with the team.



To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have:

You will work across multiple functions, collaborate with diverse teams, and make a significant impact on EY’s success.

Join us in our mission to attract and engage the best talent in the industry!

About Procurement



Our global Supply Chain Services team includes over 450 people working across 33 countries and speaking 46 languages. • Working with senior EYT and Service Line stakeholders to help develop a category strategy which supports the overall global technology strategy.





Skills and attributes for success





• Strong experience with senior stakeholder management with the ability to collaboratively co-develop strategies and set and manage expectations.


• Experience with negotiating contracts related to software licensing & rationalization, cloud-based solutions and professional services


• Experience with negotiating contracts globally and regionally.


• Experience of managing complex service agreements both from the commercial and service delivery side


• Minimum 4 years’ experience of working in a Sourcing/Procurement role in a complex and global environment

Education:

Other requirements:

What we look for:



We are looking for a high energy individual who embraces change to ensure we can continue to deliver world-class Supply Chain Service programs in an ever-changing environment.



What working at EY offers



EY is committed to be an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. postings.title: Security Engineer - EY Global Delivery Services
postings.descriptionText:
IAM Secure Access Engineer
Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of professionals who collaborate to support the business by protecting information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable the organization to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and respond to security events as they happen.
Within Information Security, we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions across the security lifecycle. You will join a team of security-focused professionals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative and secure solutions that provide business value.
The opportunity
As part of the Identity and Access Management organization, the IAM Secure Access Engineer will design, configure, test and implement authentication, federation and authorization capabilities across enterprise, cloud and hybrid environments.
The role combines traditional IAM engineering fundamentals with delivery of new Secure Access initiatives across Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta, PlainID, multifactor authentication, passwordless authentication, workload identities, token protection and secrets or certificate-based authentication.
The engineer will work with Architecture, Product, Operations, application teams and vendors to translate requirements into secure, supportable solutions and move changes through design, build, test, production deployment and operational handover.
Your key responsibilities
Authentication, Federation & Access Engineering
• Design, configure and support authentication and federation integrations using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and related standards.
• Implement and maintain MFA, single sign-on, passwordless authentication and risk-based access controls.
• Configure and troubleshoot PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta and Microsoft Entra ID integrations.
• Support onboarding and migration of applications to modern authentication patterns.
• Analyze authentication failures, policy conflicts, token issues and user access problems across integrated platforms.
Conditional Access & Identity Protection
• Implement and enhance Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies, authentication strengths, authentication contexts and protected actions.
• Support Continuous Access Evaluation, token protection, sign-in risk controls and secure administrative access patterns.
• Assess policy impact, exclusions, break-glass requirements and deployment risks before production release.
• Use logs and platform telemetry to validate control effectiveness and investigate access issues.
Authorization, Workload Identity & Secrets
• Implement policy-based authorization using PlainID or comparable authorization platforms.
• Support role-based, attribute-based and policy-based access control patterns.
• Improve security for service principals, managed identities, application identities and other non-human identities.
• Support migration from shared secrets to managed identity, certificates or approved vault-based patterns.
• Coordinate certificate, key and secret lifecycle activities with PKI, vault and application teams.
Engineering Delivery & Operations
• Create technical designs, implementation plans, test cases, rollback plans and operational documentation.
• Raise and manage Change Requests and support production deployments through established controls.
• Automate repeatable administration and validation tasks using PowerShell, REST APIs or other approved scripting methods.
• Perform unit, integration, regression and security testing and support post-deployment validation.
• Participate in incident, problem, vulnerability remediation and continual improvement activities.
Skills and attributes for success
• Solid understanding of authentication, authorization, identity federation, MFA, SSO and Zero Trust principles.
• Hands-on experience with at least two of the following: Microsoft Entra ID, PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta or PlainID.
• Working knowledge of SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos and RADIUS.
• Experience with Conditional Access, Identity Protection, workload identities or modern authentication controls.
• PowerShell or comparable scripting experience and the ability to work with REST APIs, JSON and certificates.
• Strong troubleshooting, documentation, testing and stakeholder communication skills.
• Understanding of secure software delivery, ITSM, Change Management and production support practices.
To qualify for the role you must have

To qualify you must have
