postings.title: Satellite Systems Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Area

Satellite Systems Engineer

About Satellogic

Satellogic is a vertically integrated Earth Observation company that designs, manufactures, and operates satellite systems, delivering decision-grade insights at scale to government and commercial customers.

We build space systems end-to-end, from satellite design and manufacturing to launch and on-orbit operations, giving us the ability to deploy quickly, operate reliably, and support persistent monitoring across regions and priority areas. Our approach moves customers beyond one-off imagery toward continuous awareness and alert-driven decision-making, with flexible pathways that can evolve from managed monitoring to full satellite ownership and sovereign control.

Our technology supports a wide range of use cases across climate monitoring, agriculture, energy, infrastructure, defense and intelligence, helping organizations detect change, manage risk, and plan with confidence.

With a team distributed across five countries, Satellogic brings together expertise in satellite engineering, software development, data science, manufacturing, operations, and go-to-market. We’re a group of purpose-driven builders who value ownership, curiosity, and execution—and who work with humility, honesty, and empathy.

About the team

The Satellite Program Team is a cross-functional organization that manages the strategic deployment and continuous evolution of our entire satellite fleet.

Our mission is to drive the full end-to-end mission lifecycle, from setting high-level strategic objectives and negotiating overall system requirements to overseeing long-term on-orbit performance and capacity goals. This team serves as the central function for balancing constraints across R&D, Manufacturing, and Operations.

The team is always learning and trying to push the limits, relying in part on the large diversity of people’s profiles and backgrounds.

About the position

As a Satellite Systems Engineer, you will take on a highly technical, hybrid mission that sits at the intersection of robust hardware design and agile software architecture. This is not your traditional, paper-pushing systems engineering role.

You are responsible for a twofold challenge:

• Optimize & Protect: Dive deep into the current generation of satellites, resolving complex technical anomalies on orbit.

• Architect the Future: Spearhead the system architecture for our next generation of spacecraft.

Based on your previous experience, you will be the ultimate technical "bridge," ensuring that low-level engineering details across software, electronics, and mechanics are scalable, robust, and perfectly aligned with our mission.

Location

Buenos Aires office.

Willingness and ability to travel domestically and/or internationally to company offices, laboratories, client sites, potential clients, or suppliers as needed. This role will also require travel to our laboratory in Uruguay.

Responsibilities

• Maintain and optimize system-level budgets, including Mass, Power, Propulsion, Link Budget, Data Latency, Pointing Performance, Agility, Image Quality, and Edge Processing Capacity, ensuring optimal balance between performance and risk.

• Co-define and design the systems architecture for future satellite constellations.

• Oversee system-level integration, verification, and validation (IV&V) activities from conceptual design through to on-orbit commissioning.

• Interpret and define mission specific and spacecraft system level requirements based on the Concept of Operations (CONOPS).

• Identify and resolve technical gaps and critical points in the current satellite generation, managing anomaly resolution and ensuring "lessons learned" are effectively integrated into the next designs.

• Serve as the primary technical interface for R&D teams (Software, Electronics, Mechanics), translating high-level operational requirements into granular technical specifications, APIs, and hardware-software interfaces.

About you

Experience

• BSc or Master’s degree in Aerospace, Electrical, or Software Engineering, or equivalent work experience.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in aerospace systems engineering, with a proven track record of participating in the full missions lifecycle.

• Demonstrated ability to navigate seamlessly between hardware block diagrams and complex software/firmware architectures.

• Deep expertise in trade-off analysis and systems engineering methodologies (e.g., V-model or MBSE).

Skills

• Strong systems thinking: understanding trade-offs, basic engineering, and budgets.

• Problem solving: Ability to analyze problems and search for solutions, always exploring multiple alternatives.

• Organization: Excellent people, time, and risk management skills.

• Capacity to learn continuously and passion for pushing the limits.

• Advanced English and Spanish proficiency levels (verbal and written at all hierarchical levels).

What we value

• Empathy, initiative, and accountability.

• Hands-on attitude and passion for building scalable space technology.

Diversity Commitment

Satellogic values diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. We are convinced that hiring and developing top talent from around the world for any given discipline will drive innovation, generate new solutions, and deliver a superior product to our global customer base. We work to build an equitable and inclusive environment in which all people, regardless of gender, race, religion, or background, can come together to do their best work.

Please feel free to specify your pronouns following your name on the application.

Learn more about Satellogic

To learn more about us please visit satellogic.com and follow us on twitter (@Satellogic) and LinkedIn

Applicant Data Privacy Statement

As part of your application you will be required to confirm Satellogic's Applicant Data Privacy Policy which is available for your review here.

By applying to this position you express, affirmative consent to our collection of your name, address, email address, phone number and relevant application information and the processing of that information. It is important to understand that Satellogic will store your data for the purpose of processing your application for the position, and possibly other compatible positions. You also understand that you have rights to access your Personal Data, as well as rights to request their rectification, completion, update or erasure. You may exercise your rights by sending an email to compliance@satellogic.com.

Consenting to our Applicant Data Privacy Policy is required in order for Satellogic to process your employment application.

postings.title: Sr AI Engineer (Backend & Platform)
postings.descriptionText:
Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

We’re hiring a contract AI engineer with a backend or full stack background who builds, deploys and operates AI agents in production, using leading-edge agentic development practice to ship quickly. Our client builds AI agents and products for the trucking and fleet compliance space, used by both its customers and its internal teams. Agents work across tolling and millions of compliance documents, on top of more than 10 years of toll, inspection, safety and vehicle data. What you ship affects revenue, safety and compliance directly.

Responsibilities:

• Design, build and deploy AI agents end to end, from first spec to production.

• Ship early and iterate on feedback from real users.

• Work with product, support and engineering stakeholders to turn loose problems into clear requirements.

• Own the infrastructure and delivery path of the agents you build: infrastructure as code, CI/CD and deployment.

• Own what you ship once it’s live: monitoring, evals, cost and failure handling.

• Help the team move faster by bringing in and spreading best practices in agentic engineering.

How you’ll work:

• Use coding agents as your main way of building software: define the work, check what agents produce and make the calls that matter.

• Break work into pieces an agent can finish and you can verify, and run several agents in parallel.

• Rely on tests, CI and agent review so speed doesn’t cost quality.

• When something goes wrong, improve your setup so it doesn’t happen again, and package what works as reusable skills for the team.

Requirements:

• Backend or full stack engineering background, with recent hands-on AI engineering experience.

• A track record of shipping agents and AI features to production, with users who rely on them today.

• You own the full path to production yourself: infrastructure as code (Terraform), CI/CD, deployment and monitoring.

• Cloud experience in AWS and/or Azure, including container orchestrators (Kubernetes or ECS/Azure .

• You use evals and data to decide when an agent is ready to ship and to measure whether it’s succeeding once live.

• Strong Python or TypeScript, with experience building with LLM APIs and MCP.

• Experience with agent frameworks or SDKs, and knowing when not to use one.

• You already use coding agents as your main way of building software.

• You work independently, gather requirements from non-engineering stakeholders and give specific answers. When you don’t know something, you say so.

• Advanced English, written and oral.

Nice to have:

• Frontend experience on existing production platforms.

• Databricks.

• LLM observability and eval tools.

• Background in logistics, transportation or compliance.

Notes:

Interviews are hands-on: expect to walk through something you’ve built and shipped, in detail.

Remote, LATAM · Overlap with 9am–5pm US Eastern
Perks

💵 Monthly USD Service Fee
🌴 20 business days of paid Agreed Time Off—Annual + 6 Local Holidays
🐣Caregiver Time Off
💻 A dynamic remote work culture. You can work from anywhere!
🚀An entrepreneurial environment.

About us
In 2010, our founders dreamed up a company that could positively impact the world. Since then, we've been in permanent evolution: from business consulting to innovation and design, and now to building amazing digital products powered by AI. We scaled globally, launched AI Labs and Reshape Studios, and claimed our space as an AI consulting firm — helping organizations move from pilots to production through accountable AI. Today, we're expanding our impact across industries, driving real AI adoption through accountability, governance, and value at scale. Dreamers first, builders always.

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. As the Head of Global Customer Support , you will lead our global support organization and own the experience hoteliers have when they need us most. This is a builder's role at a pivotal moment. We are transforming reactive support into proactive partnership, combining AI at scale with the empathy of true hospitality. You will be accountable for the health of the queue, the quality of every answer, and the wellbeing of the people who deliver it — raising first contact resolution and driving down resolution times while keeping the customer experience human. You'll bring the operating discipline of a large-scale contact center (workforce planning, queue health, quality, and data) and pair it with an AI platform that already touches nearly every ticket we receive.

Our Customer Support Team:

Forget the stuffy corporate office. We are a completely remote global team of innovators and hospitality experts. The support organization spans roughly 130 coaches and advanced support specialists across LATAM, EMEA, and APAC, organized into teams led by experienced leads and senior leads. We are our clients' secret weapon and trusted advisor, and we are rebuilding how support works from the ground up.

What You Bring to the Team:

• Built and scaled high-volume contact center or support operations across phone, chat, email, and messaging

• Led large support organizations serving both SMB and mid-market/enterprise customers, with different service models for each

• Ran multi-region, multi-time-zone, fully remote teams with full accountability for first contact resolution, response and resolution times, CSAT, and retention

• Supported a complex operational software product (ERP, PMS, POS, payments, or similar) where downtime costs the customer real money

• Deployed AI and automation at scale in a support operation, with strong instincts for where it helps the customer and where it gets in the way

• Lead other leaders with empathy and accountability, and rebuild team health after periods of high pressure

• Run the operation on data: you know your numbers, find root causes, and prove a fix before scaling it

What Sets You Up for Success:

• 8+ years in customer support or service, including at least 4 years leading teams with experience leading other leaders

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in hospitality, business, or technology

• Experience scaling a high-volume support function through significant change or transformation

• Excellent crisis management and escalation handling with confident cross-functional alignment across Product, Onboarding, and Account Management

• Experience leading distributed teams across multiple regions, languages, and cultures

• Hands-on experience with workforce management, capacity planning, and QA programs in a contact center environment

Bonus Skills to Stand Out :

• Senior leadership experience managing managers across multiple regions

• Advanced degree in Hospitality or Business

• Experience standing up a customer recovery or save motion for at-risk accounts

• Hospitality or hospitality-technology experience (property operations, distribution, PMS)

We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. postings.title: Customer Experience Manager, Contractor Management
postings.descriptionText:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

Hybrid

Full-Time

About the Skuad Acquisition

Back in August 2024, Payoneer acquired Skuad. Skuad's expertise helps businesses in over 160 countries navigate complex challenges such as international payroll, remote onboarding, and regulatory compliance. This acquisition reinforces Payoneer's mission and solidifies Skuad's role as a trusted partner for global workforce management (WFM).

This role will be part of our WFM business unit.

Role Summary

Embark on a journey to redefine B2B customer delight! We’re on the lookout for passionate individuals as Customer Champions who will orchestrate a symphony of satisfaction, turning each client interaction into a masterpiece of excellence. If you’re excited about crafting unforgettable experiences, let’s drive the future of customer enchantment together!

Customer Experience Ownership

• Own the end-to-end experience for Contractor Management (CMS) clients across Latin America and North America.

• Map and improve the CMS journey, from client setup to contractor onboarding to first payment to recurring payouts, and remove friction at each stage.

• Be the trusted contact for client , Finance and Operations teams managing contractors on the platform.

• Contractor Onboarding & Payments

• Lead contractor onboarding from setup and documentation, including contractor agreements and local tax IDs such as CUIT, RFC, CPF/CNPJ and NIT, through first payment.

• Coordinate with Payments and Finance on contractor invoicing and payouts against due dates, and flag risks to clients early.

• Act as the single point of contact for contractor payment issues, owning investigations, resolutions and status updates.

• Guide clients and contractors through local payout methods and FX considerations across Argentina, Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile and the wider region.

Escalations & Issue Resolution

• Own CMS escalations from intake to resolution, with clear ownership and timely updates.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to triage CMS platform issues, and communicate fixes back to clients.

• Spot recurring contractor onboarding and payout issues, and drive root-cause fixes with internal teams.

Experience Metrics & Insights

• Track and improve CSAT, NPS, first-response and resolution times, contractor time-to-first-payment and payout success rate.

• Gather client and contractor feedback and turn it into CMS product and process improvements.

• Build CMS help content, playbooks and FAQs in Spanish and Portuguese for clients and contractors.

Retention & Growth Support

• Monitor CMS account health and flag churn risk early.

• Work with Account Management on renewals and on growing contractor volume and country coverage within CMS.

Who you are

• 5–6 years in Customer Experience, Customer Success or Account Management, ideally in contractor management, B2B SaaS payments or workforce platforms.

• Hands-on experience in a payments company or payments operations team.

• Strong knowledge of LATAM payment rails and methods, such as PIX, SPEI, CBU/CVU transfers, PSE and local wallets, alongside ACH and wire.

• Working knowledge of cross-border contractor payments: FX, correspondent banking, KYC/AML, settlement timelines and common causes of delays or failures.

• Understanding of FX volatility and currency controls in markets like Argentina, and how they affect contractor payouts.

• Solid grasp of contractor management: contractor agreements, invoicing, tax documentation and misclassification risk.

• Calm, structured approach to escalations, with a strong sense of ownership.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration with Payments, Finance, Product and Engineering.

• Fluent in Spanish and English. Portuguese is a strong plus.

• Comfortable working across Americas time zones, with some overlap with global teams.

#LI-AB4

#LI-Hybrid
The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build each other up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

postings.title: Business Development Manager - Consumer Health
postings.descriptionText:
Desde la Unidad de Negocios de Consumo Masivo de Newsan que lidera las marcas Pampers, Pantene, Head & Shoulders, Gillette, Always, Downy, Vick y Cebión, llevamos adelante la búsqueda de una persona para ocupar el rol de Business Development Manager - Consumer Health

Tu objetivo sera liderár la expansión de la vertical Salud (PHC) mediante estrategias de crecimiento inorgánico (adquisiciones, licencias y alianzas) y la gestión comercial de las nuevas marcas. En un rol stand-alone , gestionarás los proyectos end-to-end —desde la prospección, el armado del business case y la defensa ante el Directorio, hasta la negociación e implementación del go-to-market durante los primeros 6 a 12 meses— coordinando a las áreas internas y asesores externos hasta transferir la operación a la estructura BAU

Tus principales desafíos y responsabilidades serán :

• Originación y pipeline de oportunidades: Buscar y priorizar activamente oportunidades en la vertical salud (OTC, consumer health y suplementos): laboratorios y marcas locales, marcas que multinacionales deban desinvertir a raíz de M&A globales o carve-outs de portafolio no core, marcas internacionales sin presencia o con baja presencia local, y empresas a las que Newsan pueda ofrecer servicios comerciales. Construir y mantener el pipeline y una red de contactos con bancos de inversión locales y europeos, asesores, dueños de compañías y casas matrices.

• Evaluación y business case: Liderar el screening y el armado del business case integral de cada oportunidad: dimensionamiento de mercado y categoría (IQVIA, Nielsen), evaluación de la marca (posicionamiento, equity, potencial de crecimiento y encaje en el portafolio), modelo comercial (canales, pricing, sell-out), modelo financiero y valuación (DCF, múltiplos, comparables), sinergias con la estructura comercial existente, y factibilidad regulatoria (ANMAT, transferencia de registros, plazos), operativa y de supply, consolidando los inputs de todas las áreas.

• Ejecución de transacciones y acuerdos: Coordinar los procesos de due diligence financiero, legal, regulatorio y operativo con las áreas internas y los asesores externos; participar en la estructuración y negociación de términos (LOI, SPA, contratos de licencia, distribución o representación, acuerdos de servicios comerciales).

• Estrategia de marca y go-to-market: Liderar, con Marketing y Ventas, la definición del posicionamiento, la arquitectura de portafolio y el plan de lanzamiento o relanzamiento de cada marca incorporada, y el modelo comercial (canales, cobertura en farmacias y cadenas, pricing, trade).

• Presentación al Comité de Dirección / Directorio: Elaborar y presentar memorandos de inversión y recomendaciones con criterios de decisión, escenarios y riesgos. Proponer y consolidar el marco de criterios de inversión del área (ticket, retorno, payback) y el reporte periódico del pipeline.

• Gestión de proyecto e implementación (PM): Diseñar y gestionar el plan de cada proyecto (hitos, responsables, riesgos, presupuesto). Liderar la implementación durante los primeros 6 a 12 meses (integración, lanzamiento de marca o arranque del servicio), medir resultados comerciales y financieros contra el business case y transferir a la estructura BAU con KPIs definidos.

• Articulación interárea y gestión de terceros: Actuar como nexo entre Finanzas, Legales, Asuntos Regulatorios, Comercial / Ventas, Marketing, Supply Chain, Operaciones, RRHH y Sistemas para obtener inputs y alinear prioridades sin autoridad formal. Definir alcance, contratar y coordinar asesores externos (M&A, auditoría, legal, regulatorio).

•
Graduado/a en Administración, Economía, Ing. Industrial, Marketing o afines

•
Mercado & Negocio: Experiencia en la industria farmacéutica, OTC y consumo masivo en Argentina (canales farmacias, droguerías, retail y e-commerce), con fuerte foco en Brand Management (posicionamiento, portafolio y KPIs de marca). (Deseable)

•
M&A y Legales: Manejo de estructuras de transacciones ( asset/share deal , LOI, SPA, licencias y distribución) y marco regulatorio ANMAT (registros de OTC, suplementos, cosmética y publicidad).

•
Finanzas Corporativas: Valuación (DCF, múltiplos), confección de business cases , análisis de P&L, pricing , sensibilidades y lectura de estados contables ( due diligence ).

•
Herramientas: Excel avanzado (modelado financiero), PowerPoint ejecutivo, plataformas de gestión (MS Project, Asana o similares), BI (Power BI/Tableau), auditorías de mercado (IQVIA, Nielsen; deseable Capital IQ) e IA aplicada al análisis.

•
Idioma: Ingles avanzado

•
Gestión y Liderazgo: Metodologías de PMO (PMI/Agile), gestión de stakeholders C-Level, comunicación ejecutiva para Directorio y visión integral para convertir transacciones en planes comerciales ejecutables.

postings.title: Marketing Team Lead
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators. They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories, and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities, and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As an experienced marketer at Canonical, you’ll lead cross-disciplinary teams of product, partner, or sales professionals in your specific area, from establishing priorities and strategies with senior stakeholders to delivering on integrated campaigns. We are looking for both generalists who want to take ownership of a product portfolio or channel, and for specialists who can help the whole team excel in their domain of expertise.

Location: This is a globally remote role; you can be based in EMEA, APAC, or the Americas, depending on the team’s location.

The role entails

You will take ownership of one of our core marketing tracks and lead both strategy and execution. You’ll ensure campaigns land, launches succeed, and adoption grows, while contributing to the broader go-to-market engine.

You will:

• Lead GTM strategy and campaign execution in your functional area

• Align with product, sales, content, and partner teams to deliver integrated plans

• Shape messaging, positioning, and assets that resonate with customers

• Design and run experiments to test your hypothesis

• Drive major launches, marketing initiatives, and growth programs

• Run reviews and retrospectives to improve performance and impact

• Mentor colleagues, strengthen the function, and set high standards for delivery

What we are looking for in you

• Strong written and verbal communication in English

• Exceptional academic track record from high school and university

• Proven experience in B2B marketing, ideally in software, SaaS, or open source

• Strong track record shaping go-to-market strategy, messaging, and campaigns that move the pipeline

• Fast adaptation to change and new technology adoption in marketing

• A leader, growing and elevating others across the organization

• A solid eye for ROI and effective budget management

• Ability to influence and align stakeholders across the organization

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills for technical solutions

• Skilled at managing complex projects and leading cross-functional teams

• Comfortable using data to evaluate campaigns and refine strategy

• Proactive, outcome-driven, and confident, operating independently at a global scale

Nice-to-have skills

• Background in sales-led or ecosystem growth

• Familiarity with ABM (Account-Based Marketing) approaches

• Experience leading go-to-market efforts across a large product portfolio

• Experience managing budgets, agencies, or external vendors

• Understanding of open source communities and business models

• Experience mentoring or leading junior marketers

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

postings.title: IT Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Who are we?

At UpGuard , we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Where does this role fit in?

•
Build, operate and continually improve the technology platform that lets every UpGuardian work securely, efficiently and with minimal friction.

•
You’ll own the lifecycle of our corporate technology end to end: identity, endpoints, SaaS and the service practices that hold them together. You’ll automate the repetitive parts, instrument the rest, and make security a property of how systems are built rather than a task someone remembers to do.

•
This is an engineering role, not a ticket queue. If you see the same request three times and your first thought is “why is a human still doing this?” - you’ll fit.

•
Security is an outcome of excellent operational engineering here, not the primary function of the role.

What will you do?

Platform, identity and fleet

•
Google Workspace, Okta (or equivalent IdP), and MDM (Kandji, Jamf or similar) across a mostly macOS and ChromeOS fleet

•
You’ll own SaaS administration and lifecycle, asset management, endpoint standards and compliance, and the joiner–mover–leaver process end to end

Zero Trust and secure access

•
Operate and continually improve our Cloudflare Zero Trust environment across ZTNA, Secure Web Gateway, DNS filtering, tunnels and identity and device aware access policies

•
You’ll help move us away from traditional network trust, maintain secure access to internal applications and services, troubleshoot access and connectivity issues, and make sure security controls don’t create unnecessary friction for employees

Automation and internal tooling

•
Automation is the default approach, not a stretch goal. If a task happens more than twice, it’s a candidate for code

•
You’ll work with REST APIs, Python, Apps Script, Terraform, n8n and AI assisted workflows to build internal tooling that removes work rather than making it faster to do by hand

Service operations

•
Incident, problem and change management. Service catalogue, knowledge base, service metrics, capacity planning and operational readiness

•
You’ll define these practices where they don’t exist yet and improve the ones that do

Reliability and continuous improvement

•
Zero touch provisioning, endpoint compliance, fleet health, monitoring, reporting, SaaS governance and self service. Making internal platforms boringly reliable is the goal

Security, embedded

•
Deploy and maintain security controls, harden endpoints, support security incidents, reduce operational risk and keep baselines current

•
Security is part of how you’ll operate the platform rather than a separate function you’ll own

What will you bring?

You won’t have all of this. Tell us which parts you’d be learning, and we’ll tell you honestly whether that works

•
Depth across enterprise SaaS and identity - you’ve administered Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, an IdP such as Okta or Entra, and MDM at organisational scale. You’re comfortable with SSO, SAML, SCIM, DNS and certificates

•
Zero Trust, hands on - you’ve worked with ZTNA, Secure Web Gateway or modern network access controls, ideally Cloudflare Zero Trust or a similar platform such as Zscaler, Netskope, Tailscale or Entra Private Access. You understand identity and device aware access and the principles behind replacing traditional network trust

•
You don’t need to be a Zero Trust specialist, but you should be comfortable taking ownership of an existing Cloudflare implementation, troubleshooting it and making it better

•
You genuinely automate - you write code using Python, Apps Script or similar, work confidently with REST APIs, and can point to internal tooling you’ve shipped that removed recurring work permanently

•
Fleet management maturity - you’ve worked with macOS at scale, zero touch provisioning and endpoint compliance baselines

•
Service operations experience - you’ve run incident and change practices, defined metrics and built documentation people actually use

•
Security and infrastructure fundamentals - you’re comfortable with endpoint hardening, identity security, DNS, certificates, secure network access and making sensible risk trade offs

•
Process improvement instinct - you make the system better, not just the outcome of one request

What will give you an edge?

•
Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code

•
Cloudflare

•
n8n or similar orchestration

•
AI and LLM-assisted workflows

•
Deep macOS expertise

•
Chrome Enterprise

•
Working in a security-first or audited environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001)

What's in it for you?

•
Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

•
WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

•
$1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

•
Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

•
18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

•
Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

•
Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance

•
Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role

•
Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work

•
Health Insurance: Access to comprehensive coverage.

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

For applications to positions in the United States, please note, at this time, we can only support hiring in the following US states: CA, MD, MA, IL, OR, WA, CO, TX, FL, PA, LA, MO, or DC .

Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks. Also, please note that at this time, we cannot support candidates requiring visa sponsorship or relocation.

postings.title: QA Analyst (Future Roles)
postings.descriptionText:
About Testlio

Testlio’s fully managed crowdsourced testing platform, powered by our proprietary intelligence technology – LeoAI EngineTM, integrates expert, on-demand testers directly into your release process. Ship faster and more confidently with global coverage across 600,000+ devices, 800+ payment methods, 150+ countries, and 100+ languages. To learn more, visit www.testlio.com .

This job post is to keep in touch for future contract roles with Testlio. If you would like to freelance test with us you can learn more and sign up here .

About this job post:

This job post is for future opportunities . If there isn’t an active opening that fits your skill set or location, you can still express interest in future roles with Testlio. Our Talent Acquisition team will keep your information on file and reach out if a suitable opportunity becomes available.

Typical Project Details:

• Project Focus : You will be a Software Quality Assurance Analyst following Agile methodologies, mostly focused on API testing.

• Project Duration : Contracts can be temporary, ranging from 6 months to 1 year, or ongoing. Many temporary projects extend beyond their initial term, and some evolve into ongoing contractor opportunities.

• Location : This job ad is open to candidates in select countries who are comfortable working in a fully remote setup. Countries we are considering consist of Argentina, Brazil, Canada, the Czech Republic, Estonia, India, Ireland, Mexico, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Spain, Ukraine, the United Kingdom, or the United States.

• Schedule : Opportunities are available for both part-time and full-time contracts. Working hours generally follow day or afternoon schedules based on your regional time zone.

• Timezone : While we support flexible work, most roles align with standard daytime hours in their region (e.g., 9 AM–6 PM). For instance, this may mean Central Standard Time (CST) in the Americas or Central European Time (CET) in EMEA. Please ensure your availability aligns with your region’s core hours.

• Required Devices : You must have access to an Android or iOS mobile device for testing.

• Internet Connection : A reliable, high-speed internet connection is required for testing and team communications. Mobile hotspots and other unstable or limited connections are not suitable.

What Your Day Looks Like

• Design and execute smoke, scripted, and exploratory test cases on mobile, web and desktop.

• Conduct functional, localization, regression, and payments testing to ensure software meets quality standards.

• Report, reproduce, and track issues found during testing.

• Document and share test results, including bugs and potential risks.

• Analyze test results, logs, and related data to identify patterns, trends, and areas for improvement.

• Collaborate with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to align on goals, timelines, and deliverables.

• Communicate test progress, issues, and risks clearly and proactively with stakeholders.

• Generate test reports that provide actionable insights.

• Design and execute API tests using tools like Postman, SoapUI, or similar.

• Create, maintain, and review test cases and test suites aligned with business priorities and industry best practices.

• Design and optimize effective test data.

• Ensure the test library remains relevant by refactoring, updating, and deprecating tests as needed.

• Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the systems under test.

• Stay up to date with trends and advancements in software testing tools and methodologies.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

Technical Skills:

• Proven experience (2+ years) as a QA Analyst or similar role, with a strong understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and tools (such as JIRA, Bugzilla, TestRail, Xray or similar.)

• Experience with mobile and web applications, frontend and backend testing (including API testing.)

• Proficiency in identifying and documenting software bugs and issues.

• Ability to solve technical tasks required during testing - such as test data generation, log capturing and basic analysis, working with browser developer tools, network logs analyzers, etc.

• Experience in working in agile teams in a remote environment - proven track record of communication and collaboration with different stakeholders such as Scrum Masters, Product Owners and others.

• Good knowledge of SDLC, CI/CD, and DevOps, as well as an understanding of test automation principles in effective SDLC.

Human Skills:

• Effective English communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate and work effectively in a team environment.

• Drive to learn quickly and continuously expand knowledge.

• Comfortable with a frequently changing environment and able to adapt fast.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks.

What is the Consideration Process

Whenever a new opportunity arises, the Talent Acquisition team will review applicants and reach out to begin learning more. If you are a potential match, the recruiter will reach out to give you more details about the role and begin your application process

Diversity and Inclusion

Testlio is an equal-opportunity employer deeply committed to creating an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and identities. We are female-founded, and 46% of our team members identify as women. See the DEI section of our website for more information.

postings.descriptionText:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote, United States, Europe, Canada or LATAM

Role-Type: Full-Time

Reports To: VP of Engineering

Compensation: $170,000 to $190,000 per year for US based applicants. Adjusted contingent on location for applicants based in Canada, LATAM, and Europe.

CodePath’s educational programs run on our sophisticated learning platform, a set of Ruby-based applications with functionality spanning admissions, course delivery, grading, career coaching, and reporting.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer who can lead at multiple levels at once: the architecture, the product direction, the team's capacity, and the longer arc of where we're going. You'll move fluidly across the full technical stack, from infrastructure decisions to greenfield product work.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll work directly with stakeholders to understand what students and staff actually need, participate in deciding what gets built, and then lead the execution. You won't be handed a ticket queue. You'll shape the work.

The ideal candidate for this role is a web engineer inspired by potential projects like these:

•
Building brand-new functionality in Rails and beyond to create sophisticated and powerful new tools for our users and extend our reach to new kinds of learners we’ve never been able to serve before

•
Reimagining core platform components as we migrate them from Sinatra to Rails

•
Integrating AI/ML technology into our platform to support mastery-driven, adaptive learning

•
Scaling a system that has helped tens of thousands of students to help hundreds of thousands more

Key Activities

•
Architect and build web applications across Ruby on Rails, Sinatra/Padrino, and Django that directly support our mission

•
Make consequential technical decisions on infrastructure, data modeling, API design, and emerging technologies with full ownership of the tradeoffs

•
Set the code quality bar through reviews, architectural guidance, and constructive feedback

•
Write automated tests that reflect real edge cases, not just coverage targets

•
Identify performance bottlenecks and systemic issues before they become outages

•
Mentor other engineers and raise the technical ceiling of the team

Qualifications

• 10+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years with Ruby on Rails

•
Familiarity with Claude Code or similar development tools and related best practices

•
A systems-thinking orientation: you consider scalability, maintainability, and failure modes before writing a line of code

• Strong PostgreSQL and database design skills, including experience with complex queries, indexing strategies, and schema evolution

•
Reasonable working familiarity with the full web stack, from infrastructure to CSS

•
Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions in a small, autonomous team environment

•
Strong written and verbal communication. You can explain a technical tradeoff to a non-engineer without losing what actually matters

•
Passion for education and desire to make a positive impact

Nice to haves

•
Familiarity with higher education or edtech

•
Direct experience working with LLMs and generative AI in production

•
Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, and/or Terraform

•
Experience deploying on GCP

Full-Time Employee Benefits:

This is a 100% remote position! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

•
Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program

•
Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection

•
Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)

•
Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support

•
​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt

•
Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range

$170,000—$190,000 USD

postings.title: Staff Network Engineer (AI Infrastructure)
postings.descriptionText:
As a Staff Network Engineer at vCluster Labs , you aren't just configuring switches; you are building the automation logic that configures them. AI Clouds run on InfiniBand and high-speed Ethernet fabrics that most teams still wire up by hand, one customer at a time. You will build the automation that turns that fabric into repeatable provisioning logic. You start in a small R&D group alongside our CTO and grow into owning this area as it becomes a core part of our platform.
As a Staff Network Engineer, your role will include:

• Fabric automation: You will design and build the systems that automatically provision and configure NVIDIA switches and InfiniBand fabrics, including integration with NVIDIA UFM. Manual, per-customer switch setup is the thing you are replacing.

• Network config management and sync: You will build the control loop that keeps switch, VLAN, and VXLAN state consistent with what our platform intends, detects drift, and reconciles it safely in production.

• NAT gateway and L4 load balancing: You will build the gateway and load balancing layer that tenant clusters depend on for connectivity, with failover designed in from day one rather than bolted on later.

• Scale and failure engineering: You will define how our network layer behaves at large scale: BGP route table limits, convergence, failover, and what happens when a link, switch, or gateway dies under real AI workloads.

• Customer Zero for AI networking: You will run your automation on real AI Cloud environments, bring back what breaks, and turn hard-won operational lessons into product behavior our customers never have to think about.

• Technical direction: You will help decide what we build versus integrate with partner solutions, write the design and requirements docs, and set the standards for how networking works across vCluster products.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

• You have built network automation, not just operated networks: You have shipped software that configures switches, routers, or load balancers programmatically, ideally as part of a product or internal platform other teams relied on.

• NVIDIA networking experience: Hands-on work with NVIDIA UFM, NVIDIA Spectrum or Quantum switches, Cumulus Linux, or NVUE, including programming against their APIs.

• Deep fabric fundamentals: Strong command of InfiniBand, VLAN, VXLAN and EVPN, and BGP, including how they behave and fail at production scale.

• Production scale scars: You have run networks at real production scale, seen them break, and helped fix the root cause with automation rather than runbooks.

• Software engineering ability: You write production code in Go or Python, use version control and code review as a matter of course, and think of network config as code.

Bonus points for:

• AI networking depth: Experience tuning fabrics for GPU training or inference workloads, such as RoCEv2, congestion control, rail-optimized topologies, or Spectrum-X.

• AI Cloud or hyperscaler background: You helped build network automation at a GPU cloud, hyperscaler, or large CDN.

• Load balancer and gateway internals: Experience building L4 load balancers or NAT gateways, including with eBPF/XDP or DPDK.

• Open source: Contributions to networking or Kubernetes projects such as SONiC, FRRouting, Cilium, or MetalLB.

About vCluster Labs
We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.
We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.
We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

• Competitive Salary : We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

• Premium Insurance : Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

• Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

• Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values
At vCluster Labs , we value and stand for:

• Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

• Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

• Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

• Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

• Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: €70K - €130K

Role Title: Finance Research Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot
Pay: $30 - $60 per hour
Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours
Location: Remote, worldwide
You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP
Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer

Scope of Work
You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer.

• Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation.

• Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported).

• Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version.

• Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly.

• Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer.

What we’re looking for
Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds:

•
Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies.

•
Investment banking or corporate development (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures.

•
Credit or restructuring analysis , with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings.

•
SEC reporting or audit (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings.

•
Corporate law or due diligence (securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records.

You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English.

How the selection process works

•
Apply with your resume and a short profile.

•
Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward.

•
Review. We check your experience against what the project needs.

•
Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue.

Who We Are:

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We are seeking an AI Security Engineer to own the technical security controls for how Alpaca uses AI. The scope includes identity for AI agents and automations, security requirements for AI tools and integrations, guardrails, and security logging. You will also assist in developing AI-powered security tooling.

You will keep those controls consistent as AI adoption grows, and you will work with the teams building with AI so security is part of the design.

This role reports to the Enterprise Security Architect and works closely with AI Enablement, Engineering, DevOps, GRC, and the wider Security team.

The Security Team is 100% distributed and remote.

Things You Get To Do:

The core responsibilities of the AI Security Engineer are focused on AI access controls, secure AI platforms, guardrails, visibility into AI usage, and AI-powered security tooling.

AI Identity and Access Controls:

• Agent Identity: Define how AI agents, bots, and automations authenticate, what they can access, and how their actions are attributed and audited.

• Tool Access: Own security requirements for AI tool integrations, including least-privilege access and credential handling.

• AI Assistant Controls: Define and enforce security settings for approved AI tools, including data handling and access policy.

• Least Privilege: Limit each agent and integration to the access it needs, and review that access when the integration changes.

Secure AI Platform, Tooling, and Response:

• Security Requirements: Define security requirements for internal AI applications, including identity, data handling, secrets, and review of new integrations.

• Guardrails: Design and implement guardrails for AI applications and agents.

• Design Reviews: Review new AI applications and integrations for security risks, and give builders clear, practical requirements.

• Security Tooling: Assist Security Operations in developing AI-powered tooling that supports detection, investigation, and response work.

• Safe Use in Security: Apply the same identity, data handling, and logging requirements to security team AI tools as to the rest of the company.

• Telemetry Requirements: Define the security logging AI systems must produce, and work with Security Operations on detection.

• Approved Use: Maintain visibility into AI tool usage and confirm it follows approved configurations.

• Incident Support: Lead the AI-specific aspects of security incidents, such as agent misuse or data exposure through AI tools.

• On-Call: Participate in the Security Operations on-call rotation after onboarding and cross-training.

Governance:

• Standards: Turn AI security standards into technical controls.

• GRC Partnership: Partner with GRC on AI governance and provide technical evidence for control design.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• Excited about Alpaca’s mission and what we’re building

• 2+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, or cloud security roles

• Hands-on experience securing LLM applications, AI agents, or AI developer tools

• Understanding of AI-specific risks, such as prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and insecure tool use (for example, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications)

• Experience with identity and access controls for services and non-human identities, including OAuth, service accounts, and secrets management

• Programming experience in Python or another general-purpose language

• Experience with CI/CD security checks and cloud-native deployments

• Experience with security operations or incident response

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially when explaining risk to non-security builders

• Comfortable working cross-functionally and making pragmatic security decisions

• Willing to participate in an on-call rotation

• Experience building AI-assisted workflows for security operations

• Experience building security telemetry for AI systems

Who You Might Be ( Nice-to-Haves):

• Experience securing financial, trading, or other highly regulated platforms

• Experience securing enterprise AI coding tools and AI integrations

• Experience with policy-as-code and Kubernetes

• Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO 42001

• Ability to balance security rigor with operational efficiency and business needs

How We Take Care of You:

• Operational Metrics: Track and report security operations metrics, including mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to respond (MTTR).

• Playbooks: Design, build, and maintain SOAR playbooks that automate repeatable response actions, including enrichment, containment, ticketing, and notification.

• Triage and Investigation: Triage, investigate, and respond to security alerts across endpoints, identity, cloud, network, and application logs.

• Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001

• Experience with detection-as-code, GitOps, and CI/CD pipelines

• Knowledge of cloud security logging (AWS/GCP/Azure) and SaaS security telemetry

• Familiarity with Kubernetes-hosted security tooling

• Ability to balance security rigor with operational efficiency and business needs

How We Take Care of You:

postings.title: Manager, Tier 2 Support
postings.descriptionText:
Manager, Tier 2 Support

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Manager, Tier 2 Support who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. You will lead Sezzle's Tier 2 (T2) Support team, the escalation layer that investigates and resolves the shopper issues frontline Support cannot: account access and identity verification, payment method and multiple-charge investigations, Payment Streaks tier reinstatements, and Sezzle Send reversals. This role reports to the Director of Insights in the Customer Experience department.

You will be accountable for three things: fast, accurate resolution of every escalation; T2 decisions that are documented and defensible to auditors, regulators, and our bank partner; and fewer escalations over time, achieved by finding root causes and getting them fixed with Product, Risk, Payments, and Trust & Safety. This role sits in a fast-paced, rapidly growing team with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Compensation :

For this Manager, Tier 2 support, with + 3 years of experience, the compensation range is $2,500 - $3,000 USD based on location and experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

What You'll Do:

•
Lead, hire, coach, and develop the T2 Operations team; set schedules and coverage so escalations are worked within SLA.

•
Own the T2 escalation queue end to end: intake standards from frontline, triage, prioritization, and the routing paths to Risk, Payments, Trust & Safety, and other escalation teams.

•
Own T2's operating procedures and keep every SOP current, consistent, and audit-ready.

•
Make sure T2 work meets consumer-protection obligations: recognizing when an investigation needs to be rerouted for proper handling, no disclosure of other shoppers' account details, and strict PII handling in tickets, Slack, and AI tools.

•
Find patterns in escalation volume and drive fixes with Product, Engineering, and Payments; file and track defects until they are resolved.

•
Provide feedback to support training and managers to enhance agent knowledge and avoid future mis-escalations

•
Report weekly and monthly on T2 volume, resolution time, escalation drivers, and quality, and support complaint, audit, and regulatory responses with case-level evidence.

What We Look For:

• 3+ years in a people-leadership role (manager, supervisor, or team lead with direct reports) in a customer support or operations environment.

• 3+ years in technical support or escalations at a fintech company, such as payments, BNPL, lending, banking, or cards.

• Familiarity with payment rails (ACH, card networks, wire transfers), ledger systems, API integrations, and webhook monitoring.

• Hands-on experience investigating account, payment, and transaction issues in internal admin tools and a ticketing platform (Zendesk or similar).

• Working knowledge of consumer-financial regulations that affect support, such as Reg E, Reg Z/TILA, FCRA, and UDAAP.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with BNPL or installment-lending products, virtual cards, or P2P money movement.

• Comfort with SQL or self-serve data tools to pull account and transaction data for investigations.

• Experience with fraud, account-takeover, and identity-verification workflows.

• A record of writing SOPs and knowledge-base content that frontline teams actually use.

• Experience supporting regulatory exams, bank-partner audits, or complaint responses (CFPB, state AGs, BBB).

• Clear, calm communicator who can explain technical root causes to agents, partners, and leadership.

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

#Li-remote #full-time

🚀 Join Our Remote Data Products & Machine Learning Startup! 🚀
At Muttdata, we build innovative Data Products and Machine Learning solutions that help companies solve complex business challenges. As a fast-growing, remote-first startup, we're passionate about technology, collaboration, and continuous learning.
This opportunity is with a leading multinational beverage company based in Mexico City.
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team 🐶🚀. You'll be responsible for designing, developing, and enhancing advanced Pricing and Revenue Growth Management (RGM) models, turning data on demand, pricing, product portfolios, sales channels, and consumer behavior into actionable insights that drive strategic business decisions.
In this role, you'll combine Machine Learning, statistics, econometrics, and business expertise to build predictive models, analyze price-demand relationships, estimate price elasticities, and optimize pricing strategies.
You'll work closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers to develop scalable, statistically robust solutions that support commercial decision-making. Strong analytical thinking, business understanding, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations are essential to succeed in this collaborative environment.

🚀 What We Do
• Leveraging our expertise, we build modern Machine Learning systems for demand planning and budget forecasting.

• Developing scalable data infrastructures, we enhance high-level decision-making, tailored to each client.

• Offering comprehensive Data Engineering and custom AI solutions, we optimize cloud-based systems.

• Using Generative AI, we help e-commerce platforms and retailers create higher-quality ads, faster.

• Building deep learning models, we enhance visual recognition and automation for various industries, improving product categorization, quality control, and information retrieval.

• Developing recommendation models, we personalize user experiences in e-commerce, streaming, and digital platforms, driving engagement and conversions.

🌟 Our Partnerships
• Amazon Web Services

• Astronomer

• Databricks

🌟 Our Values
• 📊 We are Data Nerds

• 🤗 We are Open Team Players

• 🚀 We Take Ownership

• 🌟 We Have a Positive Mindset

🔍 Curious about what we’re up to? Check out our case studies and dive into our blog post to learn more about our culture and the exciting projects we’re working on! 🚀

Responsibilities 🤓
• Formalize mathematically the trade-off between service time / RTM cost and revenue per point of sale, building the optimization function that currently operates heuristically.

• Model the cost and profitability layer (visit drivers, RTM Size thresholds, minimum margin) that feeds the segmentation and the assignment of service models.

• Build and solve optimization models (linear/integer programming, constrained optimization) to determine the optimal service model for each customer.

• Work on the Characterization pillars (Channel, Size, Potential, Territorial Profile, Digital Autonomy) and their multi-country expansion.

• Interpret the P&L end-to-end and translate it into decision variables, costs, and objective functions.

• Document assumptions and validate results with business and finance stakeholders.

• Develop analyses, features, and models on Databricks, collaborating with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers.

• Promote best practices in modeling, reproducibility, and documentation across the team.

Required Skills 🚀
• Background and experience in Operations Research / Optimization (linear and integer programming, constrained optimization).

• Financial context: ability to interpret a P&L and translate it into variables, costs, and objective functions.

• Advanced Python, including optimization libraries (PuLP, Pyomo, OR-Tools, or similar).

• Solid foundations in statistics and modeling.

• Hands-on experience with Databricks.

• Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have  😉
• Experience with survival models / CLV and econometrics.

• Experience in retail or consumer goods (CPG).

• Experience developing agents / agentic infrastructure (e.g., Mosaic AI Agent Framework, agent orchestration, MCP).

• Preferably Mexico City (Santa Fe / Cuajimalpa). Although the position is not strictly on-site, we give preference to candidates based in Mexico City; however, we are open to other locations.

🎁 Perks
• 🌍 Remote-first cultur e – work from anywhere!

• 🚀 In-Company English Lessons.

• 💪 Wellhub or sports club stipend to stay active

• 🚀 AWS, DBT, Google Cloud, Azure & Databricks certifications fully covered

• 🍕 Food credits via Pedidos Ya – because great work deserves great food.

• 🎂 Birthday off + an extra vacation week (Mutt Week! 🏖️)

• 🤝 Referral bonuses – help us grow the team & get rewarded!

• ✈️ 🏝️ Annual Mutters' Trip – an unforgettable getaway with the team!

• 👶 Monthly Childcare Reimbursement – Because supporting families matters too

OVERVIEW
 
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB
 
Welocalize is seeking passionate and culturally fluent Podcast Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) with exceptional writing skills to join our localization team. You’ll review, refine, fact-check, and adapt US‑English, AI‑generated podcast-related content so it resonates with US audiences.
 
Project Details:
Language Pair: English (US) > English (US)
Task Type: Quality Control
Assessment: Grammar + SME knowledge

MAIN DUTIES
• Review, edit, fact-check, and adapt podcast-related editorial content while adhering to writing style guides and guidelines

• Elevate and improve AI-generated US‑English source copy to ensure clarity, coherence, and creative impact

• Conduct market-specific research on podcast terminology, formats, creators, genres, and trends; ensure cultural and regional relevance for US audiences

• Provide clear, actionable feedback on written content and AI outputs

• Ensure consistency and quality across audiovisual and digital surfaces; work effectively within client tools and workflows

REQUIRED SKILLS
• Proven copywriting experience

• Proven experience editing or writing content related to various podcast genres, ensuring clarity, coherence, and consistency.

• Familiarity with contemporary podcast trends, and industry conventions.

• Ability to tailor tone and style to suit different contexts and audiences.

• Awareness of cultural influences and regional preferences in podcast content.

• Sharp awareness of pop culture, with a keen understanding of language, trends, and references commonly used in mainstream and ultra-popular contexts.

• Creativity: Ability to think originally, propose fresh angles, and elevate source output for engaging, on‑brand copy

• Audience Awareness: Strong grasp of what resonates with target listeners/readers and how to drive engagement

• Writing Proficiency: Excellent grammar, punctuation, and ability to craft compelling, coherent narratives

• Passion for podcasts: Genuine enthusiasm that translates into insightful, engaging editorial

BONUS IF YOU HAVE:
• Published work on reputable podcast or media platforms

• Experience working with podcast streaming services, editorial platforms, or podcast-focused apps

• A flair for adapting voice and style to Gen Z and pop culture audiences

After your application is reviewed, shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our team to complete the application process. 
 
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job.
