postings.title: Growth Marketing Account Manager
postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client is a dental marketing agency formed through the merger of two organizations. The agency combines brand strategy, SEO, AI search visibility, paid media, social media, video production, and performance measurement to help dental practices attract patients and grow.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Growth Marketing Account Manager will oversee marketing strategy and performance across all client pods, ensuring teams deliver cohesive strategies, measurable results, and a strong client experience. This role focuses on connecting multiple digital marketing services into comprehensive client growth strategies while improving team performance, strategic consistency, and client outcomes.




LOCATION

Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP & CLIENT GROWTH STRATEGY

 - Provide strategic direction across client pods, aligning marketing initiatives with each client's business goals, market conditions, and growth opportunities.

 - Develop cohesive marketing strategies that connect SEO, paid media, social media, video, content, websites, and AI search visibility.

 - Review client account strategies and deliverables to ensure alignment with strategic priorities.

 - Challenge assumptions, identify improvement opportunities, and guide teams toward high-impact marketing initiatives.

 - Establish consistent strategic frameworks and quality standards across the organization.

 - Support the alignment of marketing strategies and delivery processes across the combined agency.
   
   


TEAM COACHING & STRATEGIC DEVELOPMENT

 - Coach pod leaders, strategists, and delivery teams on digital marketing strategy, performance analysis, and client engagement.

 - Identify team skill gaps and develop practical training programs, playbooks, and account review processes.

 - Strengthen collaboration between creative, technical, and client-facing teams.

 - Help teams interpret performance data and translate insights into actionable marketing recommendations.

 - Develop pod leaders' ability to evaluate account performance and provide strategic client guidance.
   
   


MARKETING PERFORMANCE & ACCOUNTABILITY

 - Monitor performance dashboards and evaluate marketing results across client accounts.

 - Assess performance against established client goals, including qualified leads, patient acquisition, conversion rates, acquisition costs, and attributable revenue when available.

 - Identify underperforming accounts and investigate the underlying causes of performance challenges.

 - Guide teams in developing and implementing corrective action plans.

 - Collaborate with delivery teams to improve reporting accuracy and performance visibility.

 - Distinguish marketing performance issues from tracking limitations and client-side conversion challenges.

 - Connect marketing performance metrics with measurable business outcomes.
   
   


CLIENT EDUCATION, RETENTION & ACCOUNT GROWTH

 - Participate in strategic client meetings and performance reviews when senior-level guidance is required.

 - Explain marketing performance, business impact, improvement opportunities, and recommended next steps to clients.

 - Partner with account teams to identify potential client retention risks.

 - Develop proactive improvement plans to address account performance concerns and strengthen client relationships.

 - Identify relevant upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on client needs and measurable growth potential.

 - Support former-client re-engagement after establishing core strategic leadership processes.
   
   


AI INTEGRATION & EMERGING MARKETING CHANNELS

 - Guide the adoption of AI tools and workflows to improve marketing research, strategic planning, performance analysis, and service delivery.

 - Support the integration of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) into broader client marketing strategies.

 - Evaluate emerging marketing approaches through practical testing and measurable performance outcomes.

 - Help teams incorporate AI-assisted marketing practices into existing strategic frameworks.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - Significant professional experience leading digital marketing strategy within an agency environment across multiple client accounts.

 - Proven experience coaching multidisciplinary marketing teams and improving client performance.

 - Experience developing and overseeing integrated digital marketing strategies across multiple channels.

 - Experience reviewing marketing dashboards, interpreting performance data, and evaluating campaign effectiveness.

 - Experience assessing attribution limitations and connecting marketing activities to measurable business outcomes.

 - Experience supporting client retention and identifying relevant account expansion opportunities.

 - Experience leading strategic client conversations and presenting marketing performance recommendations.

 - Experience developing marketing strategies for dental practices, healthcare organizations, or other local service businesses is preferred.

 - Previous experience leading teams within a pod-based agency structure is a plus.

 - Experience aligning teams, processes, and strategic frameworks following a merger or organizational change is preferred.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong understanding of SEO, paid media, social media, content marketing, video strategy, and website conversion optimization.

 - Ability to connect multiple marketing channels into cohesive strategies aligned with client business objectives.

 - Strong analytical skills for evaluating qualified leads, patient acquisition, conversion rates, acquisition costs, and attributable revenue.

 - Ability to identify underperforming accounts, investigate root causes, and recommend corrective actions.

 - Understanding of marketing attribution limitations, reporting accuracy, and client-side conversion challenges.

 - Ability to coach marketing strategists, pod leaders, and multidisciplinary delivery teams.

postings.title: INGENIERO SALA
postings.descriptionText:
Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país.

En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.

¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!




¿Qué buscamos?

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de Ingeniera o Ingeniero de sala Performance. Su función es analizar y optimizar el desempeño de las operaciones de perforación en tiempo real, mediante el seguimiento de indicadores operativos y la toma de decisiones oportunas, asegurando el cumplimiento del programa de pozo, la eficiencia operativa y los estándares de seguridad y medio ambiente.




¿Cuáles serán tus principales desafíos?





• Asistir al Líder Operativo para maximizar desempeño a través de decisiones técnicas sobre parámetros críticos (ROP, WOB, torque, hidráulica, etc.) en coordinación con stakeholders.


• Cumplir el Protocolo de Priorización de ROP en Rama Lateral, soportado por el Geonavegador, para establecer posiciones dentro del objetivo geológico que resulten en mejores condiciones de perforación.


• Realizar Análisis y Estadística de los datos en Tiempo Real y comparar métricas con los Objetivos de Programa, Estándares o pozos de referencia según corresponda.


• Mantener Simulaciones de condiciones de fondo en Tiempo Real (Torque & Drag, Trayectorias, MSE, hidráulicas, etc) que permitan tomar decisiones a través de datos para la optimización de la operación.


• Reportar diariamente las novedades del pozo en operación con el aporte del Jefe operativo


• Gestionar, actualizar y aplicar procedimientos, buenas prácticas y reglamentos de acuerdo con los avances y mejoras que se vayan alcanzando.





¿Qué valoramos como diferencial?



• Experiencia como Perforador Direccional (Directional Driller), preferentemente.


• Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en operaciones en Vaca Muerta.


• Uso de Software para control de trayectorias direccionales, monitoreo de parámetros en tiempo real y simulación de torque arrastre e hidráulicas.


• Uso de herramientas de perforación direccional como motores y RSS: funcionamiento y diagnóstico.


• Conocimiento sólido de parámetros operativos de perforación y su impacto en el desempeño (ROP, torque, WOB, hidráulica, etc.).


• Experiencia en creación de Data Bases, análisis de datos operativos y seguimiento de KPIs de performance.


• Capacidad de interpretación de programas de pozo y ventanas operativas.


• Experiencia en toma de decisiones en entornos operativos dinámicos o en tiempo real.


• Conocimiento en geo navegación y su interacción con la operación.


• Experiencia en interacción con múltiples stakeholders (company man, ingenieros, contratistas, etc.).


• Evaluar la ejecución respecto al programa de pozo, identificando desvíos, riesgos y oportunidades de mejora.




Información del puesto



• Lugar de trabajo: Torre YPF Puerto Madero


• Modalidad: 7X7/ turnos 06 a 18hs - 18 a 06hs / rotativo







Si sos una persona que:



• Trabaja con excelencia y profesionalismo.


• Da lo mejor cada día, valora la meritocracia y busca siempre la milla extra.


• Vive los desafíos como oportunidades para innovar y aprender.


• Disfruta del trabajo en equipo y del intercambio de distintos puntos de vista.


• Encara los proyectos con pasión y compromiso.


• Promueve un buen clima de trabajo, con empatía, escucha activa y respeto.




¡Este puesto es para vos!


¿Qué ofrecemos?

Un entorno donde podés aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que impulsa, que se adapta, que aprende, que suma, que transforma.

Sumarte a la #ExperienciaYPF es:



• 🤩 Impulsar tu desarrollo al siguiente nivel con nuevas oportunidades de aprendizaje.


• 💡 Crear soluciones innovadoras que impactan en el país.


• 🤝 Formar parte de una empresa comprometida con la equidad y la inclusión.


• 🧘‍♀️ Disfrutar del acompañamiento integral del Programa Be #BeneficiosYExperiencias.




Programa Be (Beneficios y Experiencias)



• Descuentos exclusivos en combustibles, gimnasios y muchos otros productos y servicios.


• Iniciativas para estar cerca en los momentos familiares claves: ayuda escolar, licencias parentales extendidas y regalo de nacimiento.


• Cobertura médica para vos y tu familia.


• Descuentos especiales en universidades orientados a impulsar estudios de especialización y posgrado.


• Servicios de refrigerio, frutas, snacks y comedor (según locación).


• Día libre de cumpleaños


• Esquema de vacaciones adicionales



¡Te esperamos para seguir generando valor y construyendo juntos el futuro energético de nuestro país!

Real ownership from day one, not check-ins and micromanagement. That's what the AI Engineer & Support Lead role at Nortal looks like.

What working with us looks like

• Remote work with a LATAM team. Coffee breaks, tech talks, and games keep it human, even at a distance.

• A day off for your birthday.

About this search

Great talent doesn't wait for job postings, so we don't either. We're building a network of skilled professionals for roles that come up regularly with our clients.

Join our Future Talent network and you'll be one of the first people we reach when the right opening appears. We make around 160 hires a year, so it happens often.

The role

As an AI Engineer & Platform Support Lead, you will help us scale AI adoption across the business on a small set of sanctioned platforms. You will be the day-to-day owner of our enterprise AI workspace and support the tools our teams rely on. You will also build and own the custom integrations, agents, and Slackbots that make those tools useful to business teams.

Your day-to-day:

• Be the go-to support owner for our AI platforms (Langdock, Gemini, and internal tools), from onboarding and troubleshooting to vendor escalations.

• Monitor platform health and adoption, and keep runbooks and documentation current.

• Build custom integrations, Slackbots, and agents that connect our AI tools to internal content and workflows.

• Manage incoming AI use-case requests: scope, prioritize, and route each one to the right tool, and keep stakeholders updated along the way.

What we're looking for

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• Hands-on AI engineering: building LLM-powered applications, agents, and
RAG/knowledge-base systems; comfort with prompt design, tool/function calling, and
API integration.

not just experimentation.

with cloud services and webhooks.

deployment).

front door for users while also going deep technically.

document as you go.

• Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons. 

How the process works

• Apply and upload your resume.

For over 25 years, we've built the systems that global enterprises and public institutions run on. Today, that means using AI and data to help organizations make better decisions, not just build what they asked for.

We believe good solutions don't have to be complicated. That's why our clients trust us with the initiatives that matter most.

Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. If that's what you're after, apply now. 👇

postings.title: Global Benefits Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

About the Team

Our team supports team members across multiple countries, entities, and employment models. We work closely with HR, Finance, brokers, insurance carriers, payroll providers, and Employer of Record (EOR) partners to keep payroll and benefits accurate, compliant, and focused on the team member experience. We value accuracy, collaboration, continuous improvement, and finding practical ways to make complex processes simpler for everyone.

About the Role

Do you enjoy turning messy data into clear answers, finding smarter ways to work, and making complicated information easy to understand? Are you someone who picks up new tools quickly, enjoys experimenting with AI, and genuinely likes helping others?

We're looking for an experienced, detail-oriented, tech-savvy Cloudbeds teammate to join our Global Payroll & Benefits team. You don't need prior benefits experience — we'll teach you that! What you do need is a solid foundation in operations, confidence working with data, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership and follow through independently.

Coming from Customer Success, Support, Sales Operations, Finance, or another operational team? Your experience could translate well into global benefits, and we'd love to hear from you!

What You'll Do

•
Benefits operations : Support enrollments, qualifying life events, status changes, and terminations across Workday, payroll, and vendor platforms, with guidance on unfamiliar or complex cases.

•
Data accuracy and reconciliations : Reconcile payroll deductions, eligibility files, enrollment records, and carrier invoices. Identify discrepancies, investigate differences, and follow through with Payroll, HR, Finance, and vendors to resolve them.

•
Team member support: Be a welcoming, reliable point of contact for benefits questions. Own requests from start to finish, providing clear updates and escalating complex cases when needed.

•
Team member education : Create benefits guides, FAQs, Guru cards, presentations, and short videos that make complicated information easier to understand. Help deliver virtual new hire benefits orientations and education sessions.

•
Technology and process improvement: Help test new tools, AI agents, and automated workflows that make everyday processes more efficient.

•
Vendor coordination: Work with brokers, insurance carriers, payroll providers, and EOR partners to keep day-to-day benefits operations moving.

Where You'll Grow

As you build your benefits knowledge, you'll have opportunities to get involved in:

•
Open enrollment and benefits renewals.

•
Retirement programs, including U.S. 401(k) and Canadian RRSP/TFSA/DPSP plans.

•
Leave of absence coordination.

•
Benefits billing, audits, and vendor invoice projects.

•
Country-specific and EOR benefits programs.

•
Team member well-being initiatives and other global benefits projects.

Technology, the Practical Way

We're excited about finding smarter ways to work. You'll use Excel, AI, automation, and creative tools to simplify processes, turn complex benefits topics into engaging team member resources, and reduce repetitive work.

What You Bring

•
Operations experience : At least 3 years of experience in Customer Success, Support, Finance, Sales Operations, HR, or another operational role. Prior benefits experience is a plus, not a requirement.

•
Strong Excel and analytical skills : Comfortable working independently with spreadsheets and data from multiple systems. You can reconcile information, investigate discrepancies, and validate your results without needing step-by-step guidance.

•
Technology and AI : Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve productivity, analyze information, or simplify workflows, along with curiosity about automation and emerging technologies.

•
Communication and creativity : Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience creating clear presentations, guides, training materials, or other resources for team members. Comfortable presenting to groups or facilitating virtual sessions.

•
Ownership and problem-solving : Proven ability to manage competing priorities, investigate issues, make sound judgments, and follow through independently.

•
People-first mindset : A genuine interest in helping people, discretion with confidential information, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and countries.

Nice to have: Workday or another HRIS, exposure to benefits or payroll operations, experience supporting global teams, creating short videos, or building and testing AI agents and automated workflows.

What We Value

At Cloudbeds, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and grow together:

•
Grit: We are resilient, driven, and determined to find solutions and move forward.

•
Kaizen: We believe in continuous improvement, learning, and growing every day.

•
Discovery: We stay curious, open-minded, and always explore new ideas and better ways of working.

•
Stronger Together: We collaborate, support one another, and achieve more as one global team.

•
Welcoming : We value diversity, inclusion, respect, and creating a place where everyone belongs.

•
Presence : We speak up, take ownership, show initiative, and lead regardless of title.

•
Mop Bucket Attitude : We roll up our sleeves, solve problems, and step in wherever needed to help the team succeed.

•
Positive Intent : We assume the best in each other, communicate openly, and approach situations with empathy and trust.

What You'll Gain

•
A path into a global benefits career

•
Opportunities to bring AI, automation, and creative ideas into real projects

•
Exposure to HR, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and external partners across multiple countries

•
Practical learning opportunities and room to grow in a fully remote company with teammates in 40+ countries

Interested?

Thinking about your next step at Cloudbeds? We'd love to hear from you! Apply through the internal posting and tell us what interests you about the role.

Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $60,000 – $75,000 USD. ( The salary is only for US-based candidates).
Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

Cloudbeds Awards :

•
Winner – Hotel Management Software | HotelTechAwards (2026)

•
Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2026)

•
Overall Top 10 Hotelier's Choice | HotelTechAwards (2026)

•
Finalist – Property Management Systems (PMS) & Channel Managers | HotelTechAwards (2026)

•
Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)

•

Discover our Benefits:

Remote First, Remote Always

•
PTO in accordance with local labor requirements

•
Fully Paid Parental Leave

•
Home office stipend based on country of residency

•
Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University

•
Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling, and knowledge transfer

Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion

We encourage deaf, hard-of-hearing, deaf-blind, and deaf-disabled individuals to apply. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact our HR team by phone at (858) 201-7832 or via email at accommodations@cloudbeds.com. Cloudbeds will provide an American Sign Language (ASL) interpreter where needed as a reasonable accommodation for the hiring process.

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Cloudbeds. Staffing, recruiting agencies, and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit applications, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Cloudbeds does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Cloudbeds employees, or any other company location. Cloudbeds is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication. #LI-MM1

A day in the life:

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

• Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8-10 clients

• Using data insights along with consumer and brand research to design high performing creative assets

• Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles

• Maintaining client communications and sentiment

• Driven to iterate and ideate towards stated performance goals

• Develops rapport with client to build a foundation of open discussion, including understanding client product and goals, as well as explaining Power Digital processes

• Researches client brand, competitors, and industry trends, and effectively implements performance creative best practices by platform

• Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps

• Writes strategic consumer-centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy

• Manages requests and output with production team using Asana

• Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors

• Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms

• Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy

• Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables

• Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

• Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, and/or similar performance data tools (TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc)

• Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps

• Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work

• Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals

• Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post-production teams to deliver best possible creative output

• Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• 5% or lower client churn

• Manage 8-10 mid level clients

• Maintain $22,000 RPE

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends and insights and inform the creative roadmap.

• Responsible for using data insights along with consumer and brand research to orchestrate a sales/messaging/visual strategy.

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. postings.title: English to Maltese Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
postings.descriptionText:
About Welo Global

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com


The Role

We are seeking an experienced English into Maltese Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.

You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.

Project Details


- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Maltese

What You Will Do

-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.

What You Will Own

-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking

Requirements

- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Maltese and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

Additional Key Information

- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.

Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.

Why Join Us

This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing upskilling, and access to established linguistic resources.

If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you.


Compensation


Additional Information

Job Reference: #LI-JC1

postings.title: Product Manager, Agent
postings.descriptionText:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Megan Berry, Senior Director of Product Management at Customer.io , and I'm looking for a Product Manager to improve how customers experience their first weeks with us. Our self-serve business is a growing part of how customers discover and adopt Customer.io , and this role sits at the center of that motion, working alongside our Senior PM on the self-serve pod. You'll have real ownership over a defined slice of the journey, with the data, experimentation muscle, and cross-functional partners to move it.

What we value

• Customer empathy — you dig into what's actually slowing customers down, not just what the dashboard says.

• Bias to experiment — you'd rather run a test than debate an opinion.

• Clear communication — you make complex tradeoffs easy for others to follow.

• Ownership without ego — you drive your area forward and know when to ask for help.

What you'll do

• Own the product experience of of our own agent, working with our agent team to ensure it is first-class, competitive and helpful for the AI-first marketer who uses our platform.

• Work closely with other PMs and squads to ensure the agent works well with each part of the platform it touches.

• Find and resolve friction points using data, experimentation, and customer insight.

• Define and track success metrics for activation, retention, and monetization.

• Partner with Marketing, CX, and Design to ensure success across all touch points

• Work with Engineering to scope and deliver improvements that produce customer value

• Communicate priorities and progress clearly across teams and leadership.

What we're looking for

postings.title: Organisational Development Associate
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Canonical builds the open-source software that runs the world’s clouds, devices and AI, and we hold our managers to a high standard. Our Talent Development team exists to make leaders and managers at Canonical genuinely excellent. We define what great management looks like here, and we put that standard into the hands of managers and leaders across the company.

The Organisational Development Associate is where our most driven early-career people begin. From day one you work with real teams and take on real change, coached hard by senior practitioners on a fast path toward running this work yourself. This is not a support or back-office role, and it is not generalist HR. We hire for potential, drive and coachability over a polished CV, and we back the people we hire to move fast.

Applying to this role will enter you into our People Track for consideration across roles in the function.

Location : These are remote based positions, available across EMEA and the Americas.

The role entails

• Being embedded inside a real team: see how it works day to day, and surface what is and isn't working.

• Running the diagnostics on a team's health and management effectiveness (engagement, 360, direct feedback), and turning the evidence into a clear, honest read.

• Owning an improvement end to end: a concrete change to how a team works that you design, drive and land, with a senior practitioner alongside you.

• Supporting managers in delivering effective 360 performance feedback to individuals and helping them turn it into two or three real commitments they follow through on.

• Helping build the playbook: the standards, tools and shared language the whole function runs on. You are building the system others use, not producing filler.

• Learning coaching and organisational development directly from senior practitioners, on a fast, visible path to running this work yourself.

What we are looking for in you

• A track record of leading and organising early. You have run things, built things, won people over and made change happen, in a startup, a student society, the military, a team, anywhere. People around you already see you as a driver.

• A deliberate pull toward developing people and organisations. You chose this field on purpose, with a real grounding in organisational or industrial psychology, behavioural science or a comparable basis. It is not a fallback.

• Drive and eagerness to learn. You have your own ideas and the confidence to challenge, and you are hungry to be coached and to grow fast.

• The presence to sit across from experienced people and talk about change with confidence.

• An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.

• Up to around two years of experience since graduating.

• Business level written and spoken English.

• Organised, accurate, confident, authentic, results-oriented, and enthusiastic.

• Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.

• Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events.

In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:

• Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.

• Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.

• Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.

• Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.

Nice-to-have skills

• Any exposure to people, organisational, coaching or consulting work, through study, an internship or a first job.

• A genuine interest in the craft of management and organisations, not just the subject matter.

• Comfort working with data.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.

• Annual compensation review.

• Recognition rewards.

• Annual holiday leave.

• Maternity and paternity leave.

• Employee Assistance Programme.

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.

• Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Enterprise Solutions Consultant/Regional Launcher, LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT NASH

Nash is last-mile delivery infrastructure. We help the world's largest retailers and commerce companies orchestrate, optimize, and manage their delivery operations. Founded in San Francisco in 2021, backed by Andreessen Horowitz and Y Combinator, Nash works with enterprise customers across North America, Europe, APAC, and the Middle East.

Our platform sits at the center of complex delivery operations: connecting carriers, optimizing routes, managing fleets, and giving operators the visibility and control they need to run delivery at scale. We're not a marketplace. We're the infrastructure layer that makes the whole system work.

Every enterprise customer presents a different operational reality. A grocery chain running same-day delivery from hundreds of stores has different constraints than a retailer consolidating three carrier networks into one. Nash doesn't sell a fixed product off a price sheet. We design and configure the system around how each customer actually operates, then deploy with dedicated engineering and product support.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Nash expands into new regions when its customers do. Latin America is opening on that basis: enterprise customers we already serve are extending their delivery operations into the region, and Nash is deploying alongside them.

This role is Nash's first customer success and solutions hire in Latin America. In International, those two functions are one seat: the person who designs the technical approach in a deal runs the launch that follows, then manages the account through adoption, performance, and renewal. You'll hold that seat for the region from its first deployment, and you'll establish how customer success operates in Latin America: the onboarding sequence, the health metrics, the review cadence, the escalation model.

It's a rare combination: enterprise customers from day one, ownership of the full post-sale lifecycle, and the mandate to define how a region runs before it scales.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

LEAD TECHNICAL DISCOVERY AND DESIGN

Own the technical and operational half of every enterprise sales cycle in the LATAM region. Run discovery with the customer's engineering and operations teams, define the integration approach, build the demonstrations and pilots that validate it, and resolve questions on architecture, data, and scale before they reach contract. The designs you produce become the launches you run, so they need to be correct at the point of proposal.

RUN LAUNCHES FROM SIGNATURE TO STEADY STATE

Own every implementation in the region: requirements, configuration, integration, operator training, go-live, and the stabilization period that follows. Coordinate the customer's stakeholders and Nash's central engineering and specialist teams where a build requires them, and remain accountable for delivery performance until the operation runs without intervention.

MANAGE THE BOOK

Build relationships from the dispatch desk to the executive sponsor and run the operating rhythm across every regional account: business reviews, success plans, escalation paths. Track adoption, delivery performance, and platform health, and use them to identify what is underused, what is underperforming, and where the next workstream should be. This role carries no quota. Commercial expansion is owned by sales; this role owns the relationship, the adoption that justifies expansion, and the renewal.

ESTABLISH HOW THE REGION OPERATES

Define the customer success model for Latin America: onboarding sequences, health metrics, review formats, escalation protocols. Adapt Nash's global approach to how enterprises operate in the region, including local carrier ecosystems, payment and addressing conventions, and delivery expectations, and document it so that subsequent hires ramp in weeks rather than months.

REPRESENT THE REGION INSIDE NASH

Be the primary source of regional knowledge for product and engineering: which carriers to integrate, which workflows need adaptation, where the product assumes conditions that don't hold in the region. Turn field observations into specific, prioritized product requests.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 6 months:

•
First regional launches live and performing, with customer stakeholders willing to act as references

•
A technical design of yours in every open enterprise deal in the region

•
An operating rhythm running across every regional account

•
The first version of the Latin America customer success model documented and in use

First 12 months:

•
Regional accounts renewed and expanding, with adoption and delivery performance metrics ready to put in front of any executive

•
A tested view of what Nash must build or adapt for the region

•
A documented operating model and a clear case for the next hire

WHO YOU ARE

You have 5+ years across customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, or operations roles in SaaS, logistics, or marketplaces. You have delivered complex enterprise implementations or managed large accounts with commercial outcomes attached: renewals, expansions, or major deployments.

You are technically capable of running the design half of this role. You can lead discovery with an engineering team, define an integration approach, write basic SQL, and troubleshoot a configuration issue in production before escalating it with the relevant detail gathered.

You understand delivery operations, in this region specifically or well enough to learn it fast: carrier ecosystems, addressing and payment conventions, and the operational conditions that make last mile in Latin America different from the US.

Professional fluency in Spanish and English is a hard requirement. Portuguese is a plus as the region grows.

You have built process in environments that didn't have any. Priorities in a new region change quickly, and the operating model will be what you write down.

You communicate quickly, clearly, and concisely, and you're as comfortable with an engineering team as with a C-suite.

This role is probably not right for: Customer success managers who want an established account base and a defined process to run. Both will exist in the region within a year, and building them is the job.

HOW THIS ROLE WORKS

You'll be Nash's first customer success and solutions hire in Latin America, reporting into international leadership, with Nash's central product and engineering teams behind you. Nash is a startup. The team is lean. You'll have significant autonomy and direct access to Nash's founders, product leaders, and engineering team, and you'll be in product discussions regularly, shaping what Nash builds for the region based on what you learn in the field.

We expect the role is based in Mexico City but are open to excellent candidates across the region, with regular travel to customer sites and, over time, across the region. The first 90 days are weighted toward the first launches and establishing the operating rhythm with the initial accounts. The regional operating model is built in parallel and formalized as the account base grows.

More about Nash

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

What You’ll Love About Us

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

• Establish and communicate lot-release acceptance criteria based on technical reference cases and quality control standards

• Prepare detailed reports summarizing findings, methodologies, and recommendations for material qualification

• Validate measurement techniques through manual calibration, thresholding, and cross-checking against reference data

• Participate in technical discussions, providing expert insights on nanomaterial characterization and quality control criteria

• Deliver clear, concise written and verbal communications to facilitate knowledge transfer across project teams

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced knowledge of nanomaterial characterization, especially using TEM and SEM

• Demonstrated hands-on experience in nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release evaluation

• Proficiency with manual image analysis, including thresholding, calibration, and interpretation of complex morphologies

• Strong understanding of quality control standards and reference material qualification protocols

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for reporting and collaboration

• Ability to evaluate and validate technical reference cases without the use of AI-based tools

• Background in scientific consulting, materials science, or laboratory-based analytical roles is a plus

postings.descriptionText:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week
Please note that eligibility may vary depending on your location, as some regions may not be supported by the client.
Check out this Loom video for more details:
We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is
You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

• Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

• Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

• Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

• Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end

• Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think

• Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code

• Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)

• Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading

• Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"
We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

• Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

• Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

• Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

• Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

• Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

• Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python

• Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor

• Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

• Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line

• Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement

• Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

• High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

• Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

• Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

• Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well

• Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat

• Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

About the job
As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in multi-modal reinforcement learning to advance next-generation intelligent systems. You will develop and scale reinforcement learning techniques within complex multi-modal architectures, including diffusion-based generative models and autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, as well as resource-efficient models designed for constrained hardware environments. This includes conducting research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, spanning diffusion models for image autoregressive models for multimodal reasoning, and unified multimodal frameworks.
You are expected to have deep expertise in designing multi-modal reinforcement learning systems and a strong background in advanced model architectures, with a hands-on, research-driven approach to building and deploying novel algorithms and training frameworks. You will design and develop RL infrastructure and reward modeling strategies to enable efficient large-scale training, improve training stability, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes. Your responsibilities also include curating multi-modal simulation environments and training datasets, improving baseline policy performance across modalities, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in multi-modal learning and reward optimization. In addition, you will explore next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more directly and effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of unlocking superior, domain-adapted AI performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

Responsibilities

• Design and conduct rigorous benchmarking and evaluation protocols to measure model performance, track progress against baselines, and validate improvements across multimodal tasks.

• Analyze and optimize policy performance across modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, and cross-modal alignment.

• Investigate and develop next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of achieving superior state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance.

• Publish research findings in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.

Requirements

• Proven experience running large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online RL settings, with demonstrated impact on domain-specific decision-making and measurable improvements in policy performance.

• Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization methods applied to vision and multimodal learning problems, with a focus on improving policy stability, exploration, and sample efficiency in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities.

• Strong proficiency in PyTorch and deep learning frameworks for vision and multimodal AI, with hands-on experience building end-to-end RL pipelines covering simulation, training, evaluation, and deployment in production-grade systems.

• Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to solve core RL challenges in multimodal and vision tasks, such as sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation tradeoffs, and training instability, along with experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on algorithmic improvements to advance agent performance.

• Proven track record of research publications in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.

postings.title: AI CRM Analyst - Hybrid
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

AI CRM Analyst

Mexico City, Sao Paulo, Bogotá, Buenos Aires (Hybrid)

What you'll do

We're looking for a high-ownership, data-informed AI CRM Analyst with 2+ years of hands-on experience in startup or tech environments to help build, optimize, and scale our customer lifecycle programs across Latin America.. Sitting at the intersection of Growth, Lifecycle Marketing, Data, and Tech, you will own lifecycle initiatives end-to-end — from identifying opportunities and defining audiences to building, launching, measuring, and iterating behavior-triggered interventions. You will use AI and automation to increase the team's speed and scalability while driving activation, product adoption, retention, and business impact across our B2B fintech ecosystem.

You will

• Own multi-channel lifecycle initiatives end-to-end: identify opportunities, define audiences and hypotheses, and build, test, launch, and optimize automated onboarding, activation, adoption, and retention journeys using platforms like Customer.io or HubSpot.

• Build AI-powered CRM workflows: use AI and automation tools (e.g., n8n, Claude, Make) to automate repetitive operations, accelerate analysis and campaign development, and prototype new lifecycle capabilities that improve team scalability.

• Design and run lifecycle experiments: develop hypotheses and test audiences, messaging, channels, timing, incentives, and lifecycle interventions to improve customer and business outcomes.

• Identify lifecycle opportunities through data: analyze customer behavior, product usage, and funnel performance to identify high-potential audiences, adoption gaps, and opportunities to improve activation, retention, and product usage.

• Maintain data & operational quality: collaborate with Product, Data, and Customer Happiness teams to ensure clean event tracking, error-free campaign setup, and compliant messaging lists.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

• 2+ years of hands-on CRM, Lifecycle, or Growth experience in a high-growth startup, tech company, or B2B SaaS environment.

• Practical CRM tool fluency: demonstrated experience setting up lifecycle journeys, audience segments, and automated campaigns in Customer.io, Braze, HubSpot, or similar tools.

• AI & automation capabilities: hands-on experience using AI tools and workflow automation to solve real operational problems, reduce manual work, or improve campaign execution. Able to explain what they built, how it works, and the impact achieved.

• Analytical capability: comfortable using customer and product data to identify opportunities, define audiences, evaluate experiments, and connect lifecycle initiatives to core business metrics such as activation, product adoption, retention, churn, and TPV.

• Attention to operational detail: rigorous QA, accurate audience targeting, and reliable campaign execution

• Bilingual proficiency: working proficiency in English (our corporate language) and either Spanish or Portuguese.

• A bias toward building and testing: comfortable prototyping quickly, validating thoroughly before launch, and continuously improving based on results.

Nice to haves

• Basic technical proficiency (SQL for database querying, HTML/CSS for email template tweaking).

• Familiarity with Product-Led Growth (PLG) mechanics and customer health tracking.

• Prior experience in Fintech, financial technology products, payments, or corporate card lifecycle workflows.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

• Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

• Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

• Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

• Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

postings.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

We are hiring hands-on Senior Data Engineers in Argentina to join the data engineering squads we have in place at one of our clients. This is not a marketing or e-commerce analytics role. The work is about getting to grips with complex, real-world datasets and turning them into reliable, well-modeled data.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Build, run and maintain data pipelines end to end, from ingestion through transformation to modeled, analysis-ready tables.

• Write and maintain dbt models and SQL transformations on Databricks or Snowflake.

• Design data models and be able to explain, and defend, what a good model looks like. Push back when a design will not hold up.

• Own platform operations, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and capacity planning, to ensure the platform remains resilient, observable, and cost-efficient in production.

• Design reusable orchestration patterns with Airflow, Databricks Workflows or AWS services such as Glue, Step Functions and S3, with clear ownership, retries and failure handling instead of one-offs per pipeline.

• Contribute to CI/CD for the data platform, focusing on automated testing, environment promotion, and deployment pipelines for dbt model, jobs, and infrastructure-as-code to ensure changes are shipped safely and can be repeated reliably.

• Get to know complex real-world datasets, such as people and employment data or financial data, and understand what they represent.

• Solve the problems that only show up at very large data volumes: partitioning and file-layout strategy, compute right-sizing, job concurrency, and pipeline reliability at scale. Keeping pipelines reliable, performant and cost-aware.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• 5–7 years of experience as a data engineer, including significant time spent building or operating a data platform rather than just running pipelines on top of one.

• Strong SQL

• Hands-on experience with Databricks and/or Snowflake.

• Experience with AWS data services such as S3, Glue, Step Functions, Lambdas

• Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Databricks Workflows, and with building reusable workflows that scale across many pipelines.

• Strong grasp of data governance, security, and operational practices, such as access control, data quality frameworks, monitoring, and incident response, in a production environment.

• Experience building CI/CD for data workflows and designing orchestration patterns that hold up as a platform scales, not just individual pipelines.

• Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tooling.

• Solid data modeling skills, and the judgment to recognize a good model and push back on a poor one.

• A track record of solving the operational and cost challenges that come with data at scale, not just the modeling challenges.

• Experience with a variety of complex datasets beyond clickstream or e-commerce data.

• Exposure to streaming or document-store technologies (e.g., Kafka, MongoDB) is a plus, not a requirement.

• Proficiency in a general-purpose programming language (e.g., Python)

SOFT SKILLS:

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, including executive-level communication

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Ability to manage stakeholders and build relationships across teams

• Collaborative mindset and ability to work in cross-functional teams

• Strategic thinking

TAKE INTO ACCOUNT:

You will have to communicate with your team members abroad, therefore fluency in English and excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) are a must for this role.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our offices in Buenos Aires (Villa Crespo) and Mar del Plata are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!

• Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members

• Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases

• Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses

• Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes

• 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub

• Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda

• A flexible vacation policy

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work . Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here .
