postings.title: #1023 - Data Security Solution Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Job brief - Opportunity only available for Latam Professionals
We're looking for a hands-on Data Security Solutions Engineer to design and validate database-level security for licensed third-party data: identity-based authentication, fine-grained authorization, auditing, and access revocation/deletion. The role includes running POCs and turning validated patterns into reusable, production-ready designs.

Responsibilities

Technical and Database Assessment

• Review Data In-Licensing requirements, workflow maps, data flows, data lineage, entitlement rules, and dependency records.

• Assess relational database platforms, schemas, connectivity methods, interfaces, drivers, service identities, query patterns, and downstream consumption.

• Identify where licensed data is stored, transformed, replicated, extracted, cached, archived, or backed up.

• Assess current database security capabilities and identify gaps, constraints, risks, and prerequisites.

Data-Level Authentication and Identity Integration

• Assess authentication for named users, service identities, workloads, and analytical tools accessing databases.

• Evaluate OAuth/OIDC or other identity- and token-based authentication directly to the database where supported by the selected technology.

• Design integration between enterprise identities, security groups, project groups, database principals, roles, and policy engines.

• Reduce reliance on shared or long-lived credentials where feasible and define secure credential or token handling for unavoidable exceptions.

• Align with tools currently available and identify gaps if any

Fine-Grained Authorization and Data Firewalling

• Design database-level controls that restrict access to explicitly authorized users, groups, services, projects, or licensing populations.

• Design and implement row-level security, column-level security, dynamic masking, views, policy-based filtering, or equivalent controls as appropriate.

• Define isolation patterns for different licensed datasets and agreements while preserving permitted platform use for other users.

• Ensure controls are consistently enforced as close to the data layer as technically feasible and are not solely dependent on application logic.

Auditing, Monitoring, and Traceability

• Design database auditing to capture who accessed data, what was accessed, when access occurred, and which identity or service was used.

• Define logging for queries, exports, failed access attempts, permission changes, and privileged activity where supported and required.

• Integrate audit telemetry with appropriate monitoring and reporting capabilities and define retention and evidence requirements.

• Validate that audit records are searchable, attributable, protected from inappropriate modification, and useful for investigation.

Data Lifecycle, Revocation, and Deletion

• Design controls for access revocation when users change roles, leave a project, or when licensing rights expire.

• Design methods to identify and remove licensed data from primary stores and relevant downstream copies, extracts, caches, or derived stores.

• Address deletion implications for referential integrity, backups, archives, replication, recovery processes, and downstream consumers.

• Define validation, exception handling, and evidence mechanisms to demonstrate that required deletion activities were completed.

Solution Architecture and Engineering

• Translate requirements into current-state and target-state architectures, technical specifications, security patterns, and implementation plans.

• Compare solution options and document trade-offs across security, feasibility, performance, scalability, operability, cost, and technology constraints.

• Define database connectivity, policy-enforcement, identity, audit, monitoring, lifecycle, and integration components.

• Collaborate with database, IAM, security architecture, infrastructure, application, data platform, governance, and scientific teams.

POC Design and Execution

• Select suitable relational database and workflow candidates that represent Data In-Licensing scenarios and material technical risks.

• Define POC architecture, test data, test identities, success criteria, negative tests, performance considerations, and rollback approach.

• Implement and validate identity-based authentication, fine-grained authorization, data firewalling, auditing, access revocation, and deletion scenarios.

• Document outcomes, limitations, operational considerations, reusable patterns, and recommendations for broader adoption.

Requirements

• Strong hands-on experience with relational databases, SQL, database architecture, schemas, roles, privileges, and access paths.

• Practical experience implementing database-level authorization, including row-level and column-level controls or equivalent fine-grained mechanisms.

• Strong knowledge of database authentication, IAM, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, tokens, service identities, workload identities, and secrets management.

• Experience designing secure database connectivity and integrations for applications, analytical tools, APIs, ETL/ELT, and data pipelines.

• Experience with database auditing, query/activity monitoring, centralized logging, alerting, and investigation support.

• Understanding of data lineage, lifecycle, retention, revocation, deletion, backup, archive, and recovery implications.

• Ability to evaluate heterogeneous database technologies and design platform-appropriate controls.

• Strong architecture, engineering, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder-collaboration skills.

Expected Deliverables

• Technical assessment of databases, integrations, identities, and data flows

• Current-state database security and capability assessment

• Target-state data security architecture and detailed technical design

• Database authentication and identity-integration design

• Row-level, column-level, masking, and policy-enforcement design

• Data firewalling and licensed-dataset isolation pattern

• Audit, monitoring, traceability, and reporting design

• Access revocation, retention, lifecycle, and deletion design

• Solution options, feasibility, gap, dependency, and risk assessment

• POC architecture, implementation, test results, and recommendations

• Reusable implementation patterns and operational handover documentation

Nice to have:

• Experience with enterprise data platforms, cloud or hybrid databases, data catalogs, access governance, and policy-enforcement technologies.

• Experience in pharmaceutical research, scientific data, intellectual property protection, data licensing, or another regulated environment.

• Experience designing and executing security POCs and converting validated patterns into production-ready designs.

• Knowledge of privacy, contractual-use restrictions, segregation, and evidence requirements affecting licensed data.

What we offer:

postings.title: Director, Controls, AMERS
postings.descriptionText:
About Nscale

Nscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI. We own and operate the full stack — energy, data centers, GPU superclusters, orchestration, and AI services — delivering high-performance infrastructure to AI-native companies, enterprises, and governments across Europe and the US. We are deploying GPU capacity at hyperscale, operating some of the densest, most advanced AI infrastructure in the world.
At Nscale , our Controls & Networks team sets the standards that keep every facility in our fleet monitored, controlled, and reliable, from the device layer to the operator's screen. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscale r, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role
As Controls Director, you will be the functional authority for controls engineering across Nscale 's data center fleet. You'll own the standards for BMS/BAS and EPMS, steward our SCADA and HMI platforms, set the rules for alarm and telemetry consistency, lead commissioning discipline, and drive our Design for Manufacture and Assembly (DMfA) program.
Our controls strategy rests on one principle: structured diversity at the device layer, and uncompromising consistency at the HMI, SCADA, alarm, and telemetry layers. Your job is to turn that principle into enforceable standards and acceptance criteria, and to build the specialist team that verifies them on every site.
This is a standards-and-governance leadership role. Regional Project Directors deliver projects; you decide what good looks like and develop the people who check it. You'll report to the VP, Controls & Networks, and lead a directorate that brings together SCADA and controls SMEs, MEP specialists, Commissioning Managers, and engineering staff. The role covers the Americas, with travel across regions as required.
Your directorate works alongside, not over, Nscale 's Design teams, who hold architectural, mechanical, and base-build design authority; your SMEs are embedded with them as standing reviewers. DC Operations handles day-to-day maintenance of operating controls, and Systems Engineering owns tools and data once data leaves the site.

What You'll be Doing

Standards and Platform Authority

• Own the controls standards library: control narratives and sequences, alarm management (ISA-18.2), high-performance HMI (ISA-101), master points lists, and telemetry and MQTT/Sparkplug B conventions.

• Own the Skid-to-Master Interface Specification and make it a mandatory exhibit on packaged-equipment purchase orders.

• Steward the SCADA platform portfolio, including Ignition as our delivery basis, and lead platform evolution through a gated qualification program while incumbent platforms remain supported.

• Rule on controls standards deviations through a formal review process, ensuring no deviation reaches field execution without a decision or escalation.

Change Management and Operations Support

• Hold management of change (MOC) approval for changes to operating controls and BMS systems.

• Own patch testing for controls scope, keeping development and production strictly separated, and manage implementation in partnership with the CISO organization.

Commissioning and Readiness

• Lead the Commissioning Managers and the commissioning discipline, including Cx strategy for each project, FAT/CAT/SAT governance, and the site integration readiness gate.

• Protect independence between commissioning and acceptance, so no system is accepted solely by the team that commissioned it.

Design for Manufacture and Assembly

• Drive a governed control-panel catalog, build-to-print construction packages, and fabricator skid-PLC integration under Master PLCs.

• Shape and grow the DMfA function as the program scales.

Team Leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop a bench of SCADA, controls, MEP, commissioning, and engineering specialists, balancing project delivery with operational support.

• Build succession across the directorate and own specialist recruitment with our People team and search partners.

• Act as the tie-breaker in a matrixed organization: your directorate rules on standards, while assigned specialists are the authority on site reality.

About You

• 12+ years of experience in industrial automation, controls, SCADA, or mission-critical facility systems, including leading senior specialists or engineers across multiple sites.

• Deep technical command of BMS/BAS, EPMS, SCADA/HMI, and major PLC platforms (Rockwell, Siemens, Schneider Electric), plus telemetry architectures such as OPC UA and MQTT/Sparkplug B.

• Experience setting and enforcing engineering standards across an organization, including ISA-18.2 alarm management and ISA-101 HMI practice.

• Proven commissioning governance on complex facilities, including FAT/CAT/SAT regimes, readiness gates, turnover, and early-life stability.

• Bachelor's degree in electrical, controls, mechanical, or computer engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

• Experience leading multi-site SCADA standardization or platform migration across mixed incumbent systems.

• Experience with Design for Manufacture and Assembly, modular or off-site manufacturing, and build-to-print delivery.

• ISA Certified Automation Professional (CAP), PE/P.Eng./CEng, or ISA/IEC 62443 credential.

• Hyperscale, AI, or GPU-dense data center experience, including liquid cooling.

Why this role matters
As Nscale scales its fleet, consistent controls are what make every new facility safe to bring online and easy to operate. This role sets the bar that every site is built and accepted against. In your first year, success means systems integrate right the first time, every site is controls-ready at handover and stable through its first 90 days, alarm health is measured and improving across every operating site, platform changes move through every qualification gate with no shortcuts, and your directorate is fully staffed with clear succession for every senior seat.

What We Can Offer You
At Nscale , you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

• Highly competitive package, including base salary and equity, with reviews every 12 months.

• Join one of the fastest-growing tech startups: your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI.

• Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support.

•
Human-first flexibility. We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscale rs to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.

• Join our thriving remote-first team. Geography is no barrier to impact or connection. We build seamless virtual collaboration, empowering you wherever you work.

Equal Opportunities Statement
At Nscale , we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enrich our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.
If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.

Salary Range

$170,000—$240,000 USD

For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee & Candidate Privacy Notice: Here.

Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.

postings.title: Head of Financial Planning
postings.descriptionText:
Overview

•
World Business Lenders (WBL) provides general-purpose, short-term, real estate-collateralized commercial loans to small and medium-sized businesses throughout the United States that may not have access to traditional sources of funding. WBL is a U.S.-based company.

• Typically, the work schedule is from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, though additional hours may be required based on business needs.

About the Role

• The Head of Financial Planning is responsible for budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and management reporting across WBL. The position leads the FP&A team and works closely with department heads to assess performance, plan expenditures, and evaluate business decisions. Responsibilities include consolidated financial forecasts, portfolio and capital planning, and presentations to executive management, investors, and the board. The successful candidate will be an experienced finance leader who can direct the function while remaining closely involved in financial modeling and analysis.

Key Responsibilities

• Direct company-wide budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and management reporting.

• Manage the annual budget, periodic reforecasts, and long-term financial plans, including departmental submissions, planning assumptions, and deadlines.

• Develop and maintain consolidated income statement, balance sheet, and cash-flow forecasts, incorporating operating expense and headcount plans.

• Oversee origination and loan portfolio forecasting, including nonperforming loans (NPL), real estate owned (REO), recoveries, and the financial impact of portfolio performance.

• Forecast cash requirements, liquidity, financing facility utilization, and covenant compliance in coordination with Accounting and Treasury; evaluate capital needs under different business scenarios.

• Build and review financial models, scenario analyses, and sensitivity analyses to assess growth plans, financing alternatives, and changes in business conditions.

• Evaluate channel and product profitability, unit economics, pricing, and proposed business initiatives.

• Prepare management reports comparing actual results with budgets and forecasts, explain significant variances, and recommend corrective actions.

• Work with department heads to review assumptions, assess staffing and expenditure requests, and address financial and operating performance.

• Prepare and present financial plans, forecasts, performance analyses, and recommendations to executive teams, investors, and boards.

• Apply U.S. GAAP and IFRS to financial planning and reporting, working with Accounting to ensure forecasts reflect the appropriate accounting treatment.

• Manage FP&A team leaders and analysts, assign priorities, review work, and provide coaching and performance feedback.

• Establish and maintain controls over financial models and reports, including documented assumptions, supporting schedules, reconciliations, version control, and change logs.

• Standardize and automate recurring planning and reporting processes, resolve data discrepancies with the responsible departments, and oversee financial analysis for due diligence and other special projects.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

• At least 20 years of progressive finance experience, including a minimum of eight years leading FP&A or financial planning teams.

• Demonstrated experience in a senior finance leadership role.

• Extensive, hands-on knowledge of both U.S. GAAP and IFRS, with demonstrated ability to apply both frameworks to financial planning and reporting.

• Expertise in financial modeling and scenario analysis.

• A proven record of working with department heads and presenting financial plans, results, and recommendations to executive teams, investors, and boards.

• A recognized professional qualification, such as CPA, CA, or equivalent, and a degree in finance, accounting, or economics.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to build, connect, and review three-statement financial models and reconcile outputs to source data and financial statements.

• Sound financial judgment and the ability to identify significant performance drivers, assess assumptions, and resolve gaps in financial and operational data.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to explain financial results, assumptions, and risks to finance and non-finance stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, recurring deadlines, and a remote finance team.

Preferred Experience

• Experience as a divisional CFO of an international entity.

• Experience in commercial lending, mortgage lending, specialty finance, banking, or another financial-services environment.

• Experience overseeing lending portfolio analysis, liquidity and capital planning, financing facilities, and covenant forecasting.

• Experience improving or automating financial planning, modeling, and management reporting processes.

Work Requirements

• Must be available to work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time.

• Must have a stable internet connection and professional remote working setup.

• Resume must be submitted in English to be considered.

Benefits

What We Offer
💰 Compensation in USD.
🏖️ Benefits include paid time off (PTO).
🌍 Work Environment: Fully remote work environment.

postings.descriptionText:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel , we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.
Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel , contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.
​​ Parexel is hiring a Senior Clinical Data Manager in Mexico or Argentina.

The Senior Clinical Data Manager will be responsible for performing Data Management activities that support client’s commercial and development projects worldwide. He/she will participate as an active member of a multi-disciplinary team to plan, lead and execute the Data Management tasks required for phase 1-4 studies. The Senior Clinical Data Manager has a broad, fundamental knowledge of the data management process and is able to perform most required tasks with minimal guidance. Essential Functions

• ​Be able to lead a large clinical study or a series of related studies with minimal guidance

• ​Represents Data Management on the CTWG for assigned studies

• ​Provide mentoring and training to lower level Data Management staff assigned to his/her studies

• ​Manage and monitor the progress of data management activities with CROs or other vendors on assigned studies; build effective relationships with CRO / vendor counterparts

• ​Review protocols for appropriate data capture including electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) design.

• ​Be able to perform a thoroughly detailed review of eCRF data requirements.

• ​Interact with CRAs, programmers, study managers and statisticians in designing eCRFs and creating the annotated eCRF and CRF completion guidelines.

• ​Lead the development of data edit check specifications and data listings

• ​Coordinate the design and testing of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems according to company standards. Able to resolve EDC system issues with team members

• ​Develop or lead the development of the Data Management Plan for a clinical study.

• ​Able to review and provide feedback to the clinical team on other study documents e.g. Clinical Monitoring plans, Statistical analysis plans and vendor specifications

• ​ May provide training on the EDC system and/or eCRF Completion Guidelines at Investigator Meetings and to internal and external study team members as needed

• ​Perform reconciliation of header data from external data sources against the clinical database

• ​Perform Serious Adverse Event reconciliation activities according to SOPs and guidelines

• ​Lead database upgrades/migrations including performing User Acceptance Testing

• ​Be able to maintain study workbooks and data management files

• ​Perform database lock and freeze activities per company SOPs

• ​Participate in regular team meetings and provide input when appropriate

• ​Provide input into the development of data management SOPs, Work Instructions, and process documents; take a leadership role in the development of assigned documents

• ​Contribute to a professional working environment including the application of client’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics

• ​Assist with the training of new employees and/or contractors

​

​Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• ​At least 8 years’ experience in Data Management for the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry, or equivalent experience in an FDA-regulated environment, including study lead experience

• ​Has good project management skills and a proven ability to multitask

• ​Understands the scope and focus of Phase 1-4 clinical studies, and has a proven ability to perform most of the core Data Management tasks and interact with vendors.

• ​Possesses a comprehensive understanding of regulatory guidelines and industry standards (e.g., ICH/FDA guidances, CDISC standards, GCDMP, 21 CFR 11, MedDRA, WHO Drug Dictionaries, etc.) and their application to Data Management practice.

• ​Attention to detail and the ability to work individually, within a multi-disciplinary team, as well as with external partners and vendors.

• ​Possesses strong English language written and verbal communication skills.

• ​Experience and understanding of the Oncology or CNS therapeutic area, and with Phase III pivotal studies are preferred.

• ​Able to travel to off-site meetings or training seminars as needed.

• ​Possesses solid computer system and technical skills with a strong ability to learn multiple computer applications. Prior experience with different Data Management systems and technologies, and Electronic Data Capture systems is desirable

​

​Required/Preferred Education and Licenses

• ​BA/BS, preferably in the scientific/healthcare field.

postings.title: Fraud Operations Intern (Practicante de Prevención de Fraude)
postings.descriptionText:
Acerca de Sezzle

Con la misión de empoderar financieramente a la próxima generación, Sezzle está revolucionando la experiencia de compra más allá de los pagos, combinando tecnología de vanguardia con planes de pago a cuotas sin intereses que hacen que comprar sea más inteligente y accesible. No solo estamos transformando los pagos; estamos redefiniendo la forma en que las personas descubren, interactúan y compran lo que aman, al tiempo que generamos un impacto real en las ventas de los comercios gracias a mayores conversiones y valores de compra más altos. Mientras seguimos dando forma al futuro de las fintech y el retail, estamos construyendo un equipo innovador, dinámico y apasionado por crear mucho más que una transacción: una experiencia de compra verdaderamente única. Si te emociona romper esquemas en tecnología y ofrecer una experiencia transformadora para consumidores y comercios, ¡únete a Sezzle y ayúdanos a crear el futuro de las compras!

Importante: este rol requiere inglés B2 o superior (escrito y oral). Trabajarás a diario con equipos en Estados Unidos, y gran parte de tu trabajo (herramientas, políticas, casos y reuniones) será en inglés. Si tu nivel de inglés es B1 o inferior, este rol no es para ti en este momento.

Acerca del rol

Como Practicante de Prevención de Fraude, harás parte de nuestro equipo de Shopper Risk Operations, el equipo que mantiene a Sezzle seguro para compradores y comercios. Revisarás actividad marcada por nuestros sistemas de detección de fraude y por Customer Support, decidirás qué es fraude y qué no, y nos ayudarás a detectar nuevos patrones de fraude antes de que se propaguen. Trabajarás junto a analistas, científicos de datos e ingenieros, y verás cómo funciona la prevención de fraude dentro de una fintech de rápido crecimiento que cotiza en bolsa.

Buscamos un/a practicante talentoso/a y motivado/a, que combine un alto coeficiente intelectual con una alta inteligencia emocional. No necesitas experiencia previa en fraude; te capacitaremos. La curiosidad, la atención al detalle y el buen criterio importan más.

Es una práctica remunerada, de tiempo completo y remota: de lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a. m. a 5:30 p. m. hora local.

Lo que harás

• Revisar transacciones y cuentas marcadas por posible fraude o abuso

• Investigar casos con nuestras herramientas y políticas internas, y decidir si bloquearlos o aprobarlos

• Buscar patrones en los datos de cuentas y transacciones

• Compartir tus hallazgos para mejorar nuestras reglas y modelos de detección de fraude

• Gestionar tu cola de casos a tiempo y dejar notas claras

• Ayudar a resolver escalamientos de equipos internos

Lo que aprenderás

• Cómo las fintech detectan y previenen el fraude, desde la revisión manual hasta los modelos de machine learning

• Cómo investigar casos y tomar decisiones con datos

• Cómo trabajan juntos los equipos de riesgo, operaciones, datos e ingeniería

Lo que buscamos

• Inglés B2 o superior (escrito y oral): es indispensable para este rol

• Estudiante universitario/a o recién graduado/a. Ingeniería Industrial o de Sistemas, Economía, Administración, Finanzas, Contaduría, Estadística, Derecho y carreras afines encajan muy bien

• Excelente atención al detalle y buen criterio

• Comodidad trabajando con números y hojas de cálculo (Excel o Google Sheets)

• Comunicación escrita clara

• Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma después de la capacitación

• Comodidad usando herramientas de IA como Claude o ChatGPT para potenciar la productividad, la investigación y la comunicación

Deseable

• Cursos o proyectos de análisis de datos (Excel, SQL o similares)

• Interés en fintech, pagos o ciberseguridad

Sobre ti

• Tienes estándares implacablemente altos: muchas personas pueden pensar que tus estándares son excesivamente altos. Constantemente subes la vara e impulsas a quienes te rodean a lograr grandes resultados. Te aseguras de que los errores no avancen en la cadena y de que los problemas se solucionen de forma definitiva.

• No te limitan las convenciones: tu éxito, y gran parte de la diversión, está en desarrollar nuevas formas de hacer las cosas.

• Necesitas acción: la velocidad importa en los negocios. Muchas decisiones y acciones son reversibles y no requieren un análisis exhaustivo. Valoramos la toma de riesgos calculados.

• Te ganas la confianza: escuchas con atención, hablas con franqueza y tratas a los demás con respeto.

• Tienes carácter; disientes y luego te comprometes: puedes cuestionar respetuosamente las decisiones cuando no estás de acuerdo, incluso cuando hacerlo es incómodo o agotador. Tienes convicción y eres tenaz. No cedes solo por mantener la armonía del grupo. Una vez se toma una decisión, te comprometes por completo.

• Entregas resultados: te enfocas en los factores clave y los entregas con la calidad adecuada y a tiempo. A pesar de los obstáculos, estás a la altura de las circunstancias y nunca te conformas.

Lo que hace increíble trabajar en Sezzle

En Sezzle somos mucho más que ingenieros brillantes, apasionados por los datos, pensadores creativos e innovadores decididos. Creemos en rodearnos solo de los mejores y más brillantes. Nuestra cultura no se define por una serie de beneficios diseñados para dar la ilusión de la típica cultura startup, sino por el ejemplo visible que vive en cada persona que contratamos.

Compensación: el salario para el rol de Practicante de Prevención de Fraude es de $800 USD brutos mensuales.

postings.title: Graphic Design Intern
postings.descriptionText:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

Sezzle is seeking a talented and motivated Graphic Design Intern who is best-in-class, with a high IQ and a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

In this role, you will be instrumental in crafting visually compelling designs that resonate with our brand’s ethos and captivate our target audience. As a Graphic Design Intern at Sezzle, you will work closely with the marketing, product and even sales teams to produce high-quality visuals that drive engagement and elevate our brand presence across different digital platforms.

What You'll Do:

• Visual Branding: Follow brand guidelines to develop and maintain consistent visual branding across all channels, including websites, email, print, and sales decks.

• Creative Design: Conceptualize and design graphics for various marketing efforts, including in-app banners, emails, landing pages, sales decks, video storyboarding, and display ads.

• Collaboration: Work closely with the creative, marketing, and product teams to ensure goals and timelines are being met.

• Innovation: Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and technologies to continuously push the creative boundaries and bring fresh ideas to the table.

• Project Management: Manage multiple design projects from concept through completion, ensuring high-quality output within deadlines.

• Brand Storytelling: Translate complex ideas into simple, elegant visuals that tell a compelling story and enhance our brand identity.

What We Look For:

• Experience: Previous design experience through coursework, internships, freelance work, and/or personal projects.

• Design Skills: Proficient in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and/or InDesign). Familiarity of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or other emerging creative tools is a plus. Jira experience is preferred but not required.

• Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing visual design skills and the ability to bring ideas to life across a variety of digital formats. Work should demonstrate thoughtful use of typography, UI elements, icons, and graphic elements across projects such as emails, in-app experiences, landing pages, web, or other marketing assets.

• Creativity: A keen eye for aesthetics, typography, and composition, with a passion for creating engaging and visually striking designs.

• Collaboration: Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to clearly share ideas, ask questions, and take constructive feedback and iterate quickly.

• Detail-Oriented: Strong attention to detail, with a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

• Adaptability: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects, and adapt to changing priorities.

• Education: Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field, or able to demonstrate equivalent skills through a strong portfolio.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards – you strive for excellence and ensure issues are fixed right the first time. Many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You're not bound by convention – you enjoy innovating and improving processes, and your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.

• You need action – speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You're not afraid of taking calculated risks.

• You earn trust – you communicate clearly and treat others with respect. You listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit – you advocate for the right decisions, even when it's tough. You can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results – you focus on impact and deliver high-quality outcomes despite setbacks. You focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation : The salary for the Graphic Design Intern is $800 USD monthly as an independent contractor.

postings.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Mendoza
postings.descriptionText:
Built's Mission: Connect and simplify doing business in real estate.

Built is the AI-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at getbuilt.com .
__________________________

Built Technologies is looking for a Sr. Manager of Software Engineering to join our team in Argentina .

The Sr. Manager, Software Engineering leads 1–3 engineering teams with 5–15 engineers, serves as the technical decision-maker and delivery leader for their domain, and manages other engineering managers (manager of managers). This is a senior engineering leader who combines deep technical depth with the organizational skills to develop managers, drive complex technical decisions, and ensure Built’s engineering organization delivers with quality, predictability, and cultural integrity.

Our Guiding Principles

• Be Bold. We pursue the biggest problems in our industry, challenge assumptions others take for granted, and take calculated risks to get there. We don’t hide behind consensus or committees. Playing it safe is just failing slowly.

• Help Customers Win. We learn our customers’ businesses deeply — how they think, how they deploy capital, what keeps them up at night. We treat their capital like our own. We ship leverage, not features. And we measure ourselves by customer results, not our intentions.

• Move with Urgency & Purpose. We bias toward delivery over perfection, remove friction from our own paths, and communicate in real time. Momentum compounds — and we build it every day.

• Own the Outcome. We own outcomes, not just tasks. We hold a high Say:Do ratio and take responsibility from idea through impact. When something breaks, we fix it — we don’t wait to be asked.

• Never Satisfied. We raise the bar continuously. We stay curious, hold exacting standards, debate hard, and hold our opinions loosely when the evidence shifts. Excellence is a habit, not an event.

What You’ll Do

• Lead 1–3 engineering teams — serving as technical leader, decision-maker, and accountability structure for their delivery, quality, and culture.

• Manage other engineering managers, supporting their growth as leaders and holding them accountable for team outcomes — you develop managers, not just engineers.

• Drive complex technical choices — holding your teams to the Built engineering bar, contributing to the Reference Architecture, and ensuring technical debt is addressed with the same rigor as feature delivery.

• Slice product problems into small, valuable, end-to-end deliverables or experiments with the engineering teams that will deliver the work.

• Partner with Principal Engineers and Product Managers to translate product problems into documented, diagrammed technical solutions that teams can execute against.

• Deliver on time with integrity — ensuring your teams can consistently and predictably deliver improvements, iterations, and innovations without sacrificing quality.

• Resolve 1–2 high-impact or high-complexity engineering challenges per sprint, keeping teams focused and unblocked by being hands-on when the situation demands it.

• Ensure the health and culture of engineering teams — advancing Built through the growth of people and the progress of teams, not just the delivery of features. Own a meaningful departmental budget ($250K–$1M).

What You’ll Bring

• 8–12 years of hands-on software development experience, with 2–5 years managing software engineering teams including demonstrated experience managing managers.

• Technical depth equivalent to a Sr. Staff Software Engineer — you have the architectural judgment and engineering credibility to drive complex technical choices alongside your most senior engineers.

• A track record of building and scaling high-performing engineering teams in a SaaS environment, with demonstrated ability to develop managers and create a culture of technical excellence.

• Strong Agile delivery experience; Scrum Master experience is a meaningful differentiator.

• Full-stack development experience; prior SaaS experience is strongly preferred.

• Excellent cross-functional communication — you partner with product, design, and business stakeholders and represent engineering’s needs, constraints, and capabilities clearly at every organizational level.

What Success Looks Like at Six Months

• The engineering managers in your organization are performing at a high level: their teams are delivering reliably, their engineers are growing, and you are coaching them as leaders, not directing their daily decisions.

• Complex technical decisions in your domain are being made with the right people, the right information, and the architectural rigor Built expects.

• Your teams are delivering consistently — sprint commitments are met, technical debt is managed, and the quality of what ships reflects Built’s engineering bar.

• You have driven at least one significant improvement to engineering process, delivery quality, or technical standards that has measurably improved how your teams operate.

• Product and executive partners describe your domain as one of the most reliable and technically strong parts of Built’s engineering organization.

AI & Technology Expectations

• Leverage AI tools to enhance the productivity, quality, and speed of your work.

• Use AI to support drafting, analysis, summarization, and problem-solving across your role.

• Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort through automation and AI.

• Apply AI to sharpen decision-making and strengthen strategic insights.

• Share effective AI use cases and best practices with your team.

__________________________

Travel Requirement: Employees who are not based in the Nashville area are required to travel to our Nashville office at least twice per year for company gatherings, such as Connect Week. Additional travel to Nashville may be required based on your role and business needs.

Perks:

• The rare opportunity to radically disrupt a $1.5T industry

• Competitive benefits including: uncapped vacation [US ONLY], medical, dental & vision insurance

• Robust compensation package, including equity in the form of stock options

• Learning Grant program to support ongoing professional development

• 401k with match and expedited vesting [US ONLY]

Built brings together passionate people who are driven in a variety of disciplines, each bringing their unique perspective to everything they do. We’re committed to building a safe, inclusive workplace where every employee can succeed, and we recruit, hire, and promote fairly - without bias based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Built is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process, please share with your Talent Partner or email careers@getbuilt.com .

Greenhouse Data Disclosure: When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by Built. Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Built’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, communicating with you regarding your application (including via text message),and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Built to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Built’s behalf. Your personal data will also be shared with Grayscale Labs, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Built Technologies to facilitate candidate communications, including text messaging.Your personal data will be retained by Built as long as Built determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for current or future employment. You have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability.

Built Privacy Policy

By providing your phone number, you consent to receive text messages from Built related to your application. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out at any time by replying STOP.

If you would like to contact Built to ask questions surrounding processing of your personal data or to make a request, you can send an email to privacy@getbuilt.com . California residents: Please note that Built does not sell your personal data. For details on how your data is shared with our service providers, please see our Privacy Policy .

postings.title: Account Executive, Software Development Services – Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

Bluelight is looking for an Account Executive to win new business with US-based startups and enterprises. You'll sell custom software development, AI, cloud, and nearshore engineering teams to technology leaders who need to scale quickly without sacrificing quality, owning every deal from first conversation to signed agreement.

What You'll Be Doing
• Own the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation and close.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of new clients through outbound prospecting, networking and referrals. Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date.

• Run consultative discovery conversations to understand prospects' business challenges and show how Bluelight's software development services solve them.

• Build tailored proposals, pitch decks and statements of work with our delivery and technical teams.

• Engage and build trust with senior decision-makers, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, founders and product leaders.

• Forecast revenue accurately and consistently meet or exceed quarterly targets.

• Work with SDRs, delivery and leadership to ensure smooth handoffs and successful client outcomes.

• Represent Bluelight at networking events, conferences and industry gatherings to generate new opportunities.

What You'll Bring
• 3+ years of B2B sales experience in a quota-carrying role, with a proven record of meeting or exceeding targets.

• Experience selling professional services, IT services, software development or SaaS.

• Experience owning a full sales cycle and closing complex deals with multiple stakeholders.

• A consultative sales approach focused on uncovering client needs and delivering value.

• Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills.

• The technical fluency to discuss software development, cloud and AI concepts credibly with technical buyers.

• Experience with a CRM (Pipedrive, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar) and disciplined pipeline management.

• Fluent English, written and spoken, and confidence selling to US-based clients.

• Self-motivation and comfort working remotely in a fast-growing environment.

• Familiarity with a structured sales methodology such as SPIN Selling, MEDDPICC or Challenger.

• Experience selling nearshore or offshore software development services to US companies.

• An existing network of technology leaders in the US market.

• Don't meet every requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're looking for people who are strong in some areas and eager to grow in others.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Account Executive, Software Development Services – Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

Bluelight is looking for an Account Executive to win new business with US-based startups and enterprises. You'll sell custom software development, AI, cloud, and nearshore engineering teams to technology leaders who need to scale quickly without sacrificing quality, owning every deal from first conversation to signed agreement.

What You'll Be Doing
• Own the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation and close.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of new clients through outbound prospecting, networking and referrals. Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date.

• Run consultative discovery conversations to understand prospects' business challenges and show how Bluelight's software development services solve them.

• Build tailored proposals, pitch decks and statements of work with our delivery and technical teams.

• Engage and build trust with senior decision-makers, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, founders and product leaders.

• Forecast revenue accurately and consistently meet or exceed quarterly targets.

• Work with SDRs, delivery and leadership to ensure smooth handoffs and successful client outcomes.

• Represent Bluelight at networking events, conferences and industry gatherings to generate new opportunities.

What You'll Bring
• 3+ years of B2B sales experience in a quota-carrying role, with a proven record of meeting or exceeding targets.

• Experience selling professional services, IT services, software development or SaaS.

• Experience owning a full sales cycle and closing complex deals with multiple stakeholders.

• A consultative sales approach focused on uncovering client needs and delivering value.

• Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills.

• The technical fluency to discuss software development, cloud and AI concepts credibly with technical buyers.

• Experience with a CRM (Pipedrive, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar) and disciplined pipeline management.

• Fluent English, written and spoken, and confidence selling to US-based clients.

• Self-motivation and comfort working remotely in a fast-growing environment.

• Familiarity with a structured sales methodology such as SPIN Selling, MEDDPICC or Challenger.

• Experience selling nearshore or offshore software development services to US companies.

• An existing network of technology leaders in the US market.

• Don't meet every requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're looking for people who are strong in some areas and eager to grow in others.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Account Executive, Software Development Services – Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

Bluelight is looking for an Account Executive to win new business with US-based startups and enterprises. You'll sell custom software development, AI, cloud, and nearshore engineering teams to technology leaders who need to scale quickly without sacrificing quality, owning every deal from first conversation to signed agreement.

What You'll Be Doing
• Own the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation and close.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of new clients through outbound prospecting, networking and referrals. Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date.

• Run consultative discovery conversations to understand prospects' business challenges and show how Bluelight's software development services solve them.

• Build tailored proposals, pitch decks and statements of work with our delivery and technical teams.

• Engage and build trust with senior decision-makers, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, founders and product leaders.

• Forecast revenue accurately and consistently meet or exceed quarterly targets.

• Work with SDRs, delivery and leadership to ensure smooth handoffs and successful client outcomes.

• Represent Bluelight at networking events, conferences and industry gatherings to generate new opportunities.

What You'll Bring
• 3+ years of B2B sales experience in a quota-carrying role, with a proven record of meeting or exceeding targets.

• Experience selling professional services, IT services, software development or SaaS.

• Experience owning a full sales cycle and closing complex deals with multiple stakeholders.

• A consultative sales approach focused on uncovering client needs and delivering value.

• Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills.

• The technical fluency to discuss software development, cloud and AI concepts credibly with technical buyers.

• Experience with a CRM (Pipedrive, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar) and disciplined pipeline management.

• Fluent English, written and spoken, and confidence selling to US-based clients.

• Self-motivation and comfort working remotely in a fast-growing environment.

• Familiarity with a structured sales methodology such as SPIN Selling, MEDDPICC or Challenger.

• Experience selling nearshore or offshore software development services to US companies.

• An existing network of technology leaders in the US market.

• Don't meet every requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're looking for people who are strong in some areas and eager to grow in others.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Account Executive, Technology Consulting – Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

Bluelight is looking for an Account Executive to win new business with US-based startups and enterprises. You'll sell custom software development, AI, cloud, and nearshore engineering teams to technology leaders who need to scale quickly without sacrificing quality, owning every deal from first conversation to signed agreement.

What You'll Be Doing
• Own the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation and close.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of new clients through outbound prospecting, networking and referrals. Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date.

• Run consultative discovery conversations to understand prospects' business challenges and show how Bluelight's software development services solve them.

• Build tailored proposals, pitch decks and statements of work with our delivery and technical teams.

• Engage and build trust with senior decision-makers, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, founders and product leaders.

• Forecast revenue accurately and consistently meet or exceed quarterly targets.

• Work with SDRs, delivery and leadership to ensure smooth handoffs and successful client outcomes.

• Represent Bluelight at networking events, conferences and industry gatherings to generate new opportunities.

What You'll Bring
• 3+ years of B2B sales experience in a quota-carrying role, with a proven record of meeting or exceeding targets.

• Experience selling professional services, IT services, software development or SaaS.

• Experience owning a full sales cycle and closing complex deals with multiple stakeholders.

• A consultative sales approach focused on uncovering client needs and delivering value.

• Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills.

• The technical fluency to discuss software development, cloud and AI concepts credibly with technical buyers.

• Experience with a CRM (Pipedrive, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar) and disciplined pipeline management.

• Fluent English, written and spoken, and confidence selling to US-based clients.

• Self-motivation and comfort working remotely in a fast-growing environment.

• Familiarity with a structured sales methodology such as SPIN Selling, MEDDPICC or Challenger.

• Experience selling nearshore or offshore software development services to US companies.

• An existing network of technology leaders in the US market.

• Don't meet every requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're looking for people who are strong in some areas and eager to grow in others.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Account Executive, Technology Consulting – Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

Bluelight is looking for an Account Executive to win new business with US-based startups and enterprises. You'll sell custom software development, AI, cloud, and nearshore engineering teams to technology leaders who need to scale quickly without sacrificing quality, owning every deal from first conversation to signed agreement.

What You'll Be Doing
• Own the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation and close.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of new clients through outbound prospecting, networking and referrals. Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date.

• Run consultative discovery conversations to understand prospects' business challenges and show how Bluelight's software development services solve them.

• Build tailored proposals, pitch decks and statements of work with our delivery and technical teams.

• Engage and build trust with senior decision-makers, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, founders and product leaders.

• Forecast revenue accurately and consistently meet or exceed quarterly targets.

• Work with SDRs, delivery and leadership to ensure smooth handoffs and successful client outcomes.

• Represent Bluelight at networking events, conferences and industry gatherings to generate new opportunities.

What You'll Bring
• 3+ years of B2B sales experience in a quota-carrying role, with a proven record of meeting or exceeding targets.

• Experience selling professional services, IT services, software development or SaaS.

• Experience owning a full sales cycle and closing complex deals with multiple stakeholders.

• A consultative sales approach focused on uncovering client needs and delivering value.

• Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills.

• The technical fluency to discuss software development, cloud and AI concepts credibly with technical buyers.

• Experience with a CRM (Pipedrive, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar) and disciplined pipeline management.

• Fluent English, written and spoken, and confidence selling to US-based clients.

• Self-motivation and comfort working remotely in a fast-growing environment.

• Familiarity with a structured sales methodology such as SPIN Selling, MEDDPICC or Challenger.

• Experience selling nearshore or offshore software development services to US companies.

• An existing network of technology leaders in the US market.

• Don't meet every requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're looking for people who are strong in some areas and eager to grow in others.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Account Executive, Technology Consulting – Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

Bluelight is looking for an Account Executive to win new business with US-based startups and enterprises. You'll sell custom software development, AI, cloud, and nearshore engineering teams to technology leaders who need to scale quickly without sacrificing quality, owning every deal from first conversation to signed agreement.

What You'll Be Doing
• Own the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation and close.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of new clients through outbound prospecting, networking and referrals. Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date.

• Run consultative discovery conversations to understand prospects' business challenges and show how Bluelight's software development services solve them.

• Build tailored proposals, pitch decks and statements of work with our delivery and technical teams.

• Engage and build trust with senior decision-makers, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, founders and product leaders.

• Forecast revenue accurately and consistently meet or exceed quarterly targets.

• Work with SDRs, delivery and leadership to ensure smooth handoffs and successful client outcomes.

• Represent Bluelight at networking events, conferences and industry gatherings to generate new opportunities.

What You'll Bring
• 3+ years of B2B sales experience in a quota-carrying role, with a proven record of meeting or exceeding targets.

• Experience selling professional services, IT services, software development or SaaS.

• Experience owning a full sales cycle and closing complex deals with multiple stakeholders.

• A consultative sales approach focused on uncovering client needs and delivering value.

• Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills.

• The technical fluency to discuss software development, cloud and AI concepts credibly with technical buyers.

• Experience with a CRM (Pipedrive, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar) and disciplined pipeline management.

• Fluent English, written and spoken, and confidence selling to US-based clients.

• Self-motivation and comfort working remotely in a fast-growing environment.

• Familiarity with a structured sales methodology such as SPIN Selling, MEDDPICC or Challenger.

• Experience selling nearshore or offshore software development services to US companies.

• An existing network of technology leaders in the US market.

• Don't meet every requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're looking for people who are strong in some areas and eager to grow in others.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: # 7 - Senior AI Data Scientist / Modeler - Databricks - Latam
postings.descriptionText:
🚀 Join Our Remote Data Products & Machine Learning Startup! 🚀
 
At Muttdata, we build innovative Data Products and Machine Learning solutions that help companies solve complex business challenges. As a fast-growing, remote-first startup, we're passionate about technology, collaboration, and continuous learning.
 
This opportunity is with a leading multinational beverage company based in Mexico City, as part of its AI Factory initiative.
 
We are looking for a Senior AI Data Scientist / Modeler with Databricks experience to join our team 🐶🚀. You'll build the Sales Leader Insights product within the Smart Force platform: an agentic AI architecture that selects the most relevant insights for each sales leader and recommends a coaching route that makes business sense, balancing geographic proximity with route priority and criticality so field coaching is both optimal and executable.
 
This role sits at the intersection of agentic AI, recommendation systems, and operations research, working closely with data, platform, and business teams across the end-to-end AI Factory cycle — from governed features and data to model development, orchestration, and productionization. Strong technical depth, business sense, and ownership are essential to succeed in this fast-paced, collaborative environment.

🚀 What We Do
• Leveraging our expertise, we build modern Machine Learning systems for demand planning and budget forecasting.

• Developing scalable data infrastructures, we enhance high-level decision-making, tailored to each client.

• Offering comprehensive Data Engineering and custom AI solutions, we optimize cloud-based systems.

• Using Generative AI, we help e-commerce platforms and retailers create higher-quality ads, faster.

• Building deep learning models, we enhance visual recognition and automation for various industries, improving product categorization, quality control, and information retrieval.

• Developing recommendation models, we personalize user experiences in e-commerce, streaming, and digital platforms, driving engagement and conversions.

🌟 Our Partnerships
• Amazon Web Services

• Astronomer

• Databricks

🌟 Our Values
• 📊 We are Data Nerds

• 🤗 We are Open Team Players

• 🚀 We Take Ownership

• 🌟 We Have a Positive Mindset

🔍 Curious about what we’re up to? Check out our case studies and dive into our blog post to learn more about our culture and the exciting projects we’re working on! 🚀

Responsibilities 🤓
• Design and build the agentic AI architecture that generates and prioritizes actionable insights for sales leaders, deciding which ones truly matter based on management focus, coaching needs, and performance.

• Model the coaching route recommendation as a routing optimization problem, balancing geographic proximity and route priority/criticality while avoiding inefficient trips (e.g., coaching a pre-seller for an hour and then sending them to another city).

• Integrate business signals (potential, execution, compliance, pre-seller KPIs) so coaching recommendations make sense both operationally and geographically.

• Enable agentic decision-making on coaching optimality: the AI agent evaluates and adjusts recommendations based on time, distance, and criticality constraints.

• Package the model under the MFL framework (PyFunc, model_card, tests) and integrate it with orchestration and deployment to operations.

Required Skills 🚀
• Proven experience as a Data Scientist / Modeler in supervised machine learning and recommendation or prioritization systems.

• Hands-on experience in agentic AI development (designing AI agents that make decisions).

• Experience in optimization / operations research: routing, VRP, constrained optimization.

• Advanced Python (scikit-learn; optimization libraries such as OR-Tools, Pyomo, PuLP, or similar).

• Experience with MLflow and model development in Databricks.

• Experience working with geospatial / routing data (distances, geolocation).

Nice to Have  😉
• Previous experience with sales forces, commercial coaching, or field/route optimization solutions.

• Experience developing AI agents / agentic infrastructure (e.g., Mosaic AI Agent Framework, agent orchestration, MCP).

• Familiarity with Unity Catalog, Databricks Asset Bundles, and Azure DevOps.

• Location: Mexico City (Santa Fe / Cuajimalpa) preferred, though the role is not strictly on-site and we’re open to other locations.

🎁 Perks
• Remote-first culture – work from anywhere! 🌍

• AWS, DBT, Google Cloud, Azure & Databricks certifications fully covered

• Birthday off + an extra vacation week (Mutt Week! 🏖️)

• Referral bonuses – help us grow the team & get rewarded!

• Maslow : Monthly credits to spend in our benefits marketplace.

• ✈️ 🏝️ Annual Mutters' Trip – an unforgettable getaway with the team!

postings.descriptionText:
At SunnyData, our mission is to help customers build a highly scalable architecture, robust data engineering pipelines, easy data consumption layers and more importantly build ML and AI applications to power their business and drive outstanding business outcomes. As a Business Analyst, you ensure that both ongoing and upcoming work delivers business value to the client. Additionally, you confirm the technical delivery team has the essential resources, clear priorities, and requirements to succeed when they begin their participation in a project.

 

The Impact You Will Have

 - Collaborate with clients to understand their business needs and objectives

 - Design and develop business architectures that align with clients strategic goals

 - Identify opportunities for leveraging data and AI to improve business processes and outcomes

 - Collaborate with technical teams to ensure the successful implementation of solutions

 - Conduct gap analysis and recommend improvements to existing business processes, including data governance

 - Lead workshops and meetings to align stakeholders on project goals and deliverables

 - Bridge the gap between business strategy and technical execution, translating complex challenges into scalable data solutions

 - Develop accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that elevate our delivery capabilities

 - Identify new opportunities and help expand client relationships

 

What We Look For

 - 5+ years of experience in business analysis or product development, ideally within Data and Analytics

 -  Strong SQL skills for complex data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting

 -  Proficiency with visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, etc.)

 -  Familiarity with APIs
