 -  Direct client-facing experience in a consulting or professional services organization

 -  Skilled at facilitating workshops, managing conflict, and building consensus

 -  Experience translating business needs into functional and technical specifications

 -  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

 -  Data-driven decision maker who quantifies business value and ROI

 -  Analytical thinker who can break down complex problems into actionable solutions

 -  Ability to work independently and as part of a team

 -  Committed to delivering excellence and exceeding client expectations

 -  Strong business acumen with an entrepreneurial mindset

 

Preferred Experience

 -  Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher)

 -  Databricks certification (e.g., Data Analyst Associate)

 -  Business process modeling and analysis

 -  Data, AI, and governance strategy development and implementation

 -  Project management and leadership

 -  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 -  Strategic thinking and business acumen

 -  Conceptual modeling and analysis

 -  Change management and stakeholder engagement

 

Education

 - Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, or related field is preferred.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:

SunnyData is dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the world around us. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to unbiased hiring practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

 

Why Join SunnyData?

 - Innovative Environment: Work with cutting-edge technologies and industry leaders in data engineering and AI.

 - Customer Impact: Make a real difference in how businesses leverage data for strategic decision-making.

 - Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

 - Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive team that values collaboration and knowledge sharing.

If you are passionate about data engineering and enjoy engaging with clients to solve their most challenging problems, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key player in SunnyData's success story.

postings.title: Senior Counsel, Regulatory Legal – Latin America (Payments & Digital Assets)
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


SENIOR COUNSEL, REGULATORY LEGAL – LATIN AMERICA (PAYMENTS & DIGITAL ASSETS)




ABOUT US

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/




ABOUT THE ROLE

As Senior Counsel, Regulatory Legal – Latin America, you will be the legal voice on how Nu's payments and digital-assets products can operate, launch and scale across the region. You will define where licenses, registrations or regulated entities are required, and turn that analysis into a clear recommendation the business can act on.

This is a legal and regulatory strategy role, not a compliance operations role. Product strategy & growth

Analytics practices & tooling

 - Automate recurring analytical processes.

 - Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Gestionar la interacción con la comunidad: derivar consultas y reclamos al equipo correspondiente y hacer seguimiento hasta su resolución.

• Coordinar la operación diaria con creadores de contenido.

• Llevar un registro de métricas básicas e identificar preguntas frecuentes, tendencias y oportunidades de contenido.

🙌 ¿Qué esperamos de vos?

• Que seas estudiante o graduado/a reciente de Comunicación, Marketing, Publicidad o carreras afines.

• Que te consideres una persona organizada y atenta al detalle.

• Que te interesen y tengas ganas de aprender sobre inversiones y productos financieros.

• Que te consideres una persona proactiva con ganas de trabajar en un equipo ambicioso y en constante crecimiento 🚀

The goal is to ensure open staffing needs are filled with the right person at the right time at the right cost. Job Description:
We are looking for a new Resource Manager to join our US team. This position will work remotly from Argentina set in our OffShore structure

Key Accountabilities

· Maintain up to date organization charts to share with leadership on a consistent basis
· Communicate and set expectations on resourcing issues and workload balance that may impact scheduled deadlines
· Proactively reviews opportunity pipeline with their Senior and/or Director partner to create and understand the picture of upcoming demand
· Welcome all new full-time hires and non-perm hires, by connecting them with team members, directing them the appropriate parties for IT issues, processes etc.

· Assist in reviewing capacity across capability areas on an ongoing basis, and proactively work to re-balance professionals who are above / below utilization targets
· Work with Project Manager and Project Leads along with resources to gain meaningful understanding of their skills, experience and aspirations and identify the right opportunities for them
· Attend and share tool within weekly Project Manager/Project Leads/Resource Management meetings to understand impacts to resource needs (new projects, timeline movement, etc.) and facilitate risk/issue mitigations.

postings.title: Associate Manager - Safety Operations
postings.descriptionText:
Job overview
The Safety Operations Team Assoc. Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing local and/or regional pharmacovigilance operations, ensuring effective delivery of safety activities in accordance with applicable regulations, Sponsor requirements, project procedures, SOPs, quality standards, and agreed KPIs/SLAs.
The role provides direct leadership and oversight of assigned team members, with accountability for team performance, workload management, operational quality, compliance, capability development, and timely delivery. The Manager also serves as a key operational contact for the Sponsor and project stakeholders, proactively monitoring performance against project KPIs, identifying risks and trends, and driving corrective or preventive actions when performance deviates from expectations.

Key Responsibilities:
People Management & Direct Report Oversight

• Provide day-to-day leadership, supervision, and operational oversight of assigned direct reports.

• Set clear expectations regarding productivity, quality, compliance, timelines, and professional behaviors.

• Monitor individual and team performance against defined project requirements and operational KPIs.

• Conduct regular one-to-one discussions, coaching, feedback, and performance conversations with direct reports.

• Support employee development, training completion, competency building, and career development.

• Ensure adequate onboarding and role-specific training before team members independently perform assigned activities.

• Monitor team capacity, workload distribution, utilization, coverage, and operational priorities to maintain business continuity.

• Identify performance or compliance gaps and establish appropriate improvement and follow-up actions.

• Promote accountability, collaboration, engagement, and a strong quality and compliance culture across the team.

Sponsor, Project & KPI Management

• Serve as a primary operational point of contact for the Sponsor, when applicable, supporting effective communication and alignment on project deliverables.

• Maintain oversight of contractual and project-specific KPIs, SLAs, quality metrics, productivity expectations, and compliance requirements.

• Regularly review operational performance and identify emerging trends, risks, capacity constraints, backlogs, or potential KPI deviations.

• Ensure appropriate and timely escalation of risks or issues that may affect Sponsor commitments, patient safety, regulatory compliance, quality, or project performance.

• Coordinate and monitor remediation activities for KPI or compliance deviations, including corrective and preventive measures as applicable.

• Support project governance meetings, operational reviews, performance reporting, and Sponsor discussions.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen operational efficiency, quality, compliance, and service delivery.

Pharmacovigilance Operations Oversight:

• Lead and oversee safety-related operations and communication activities.

• Ensure accurate and timely ICSR surveillance, including collection, intake, reporting, follow-up, and associated documentation.

• Oversee translation activities and local case narrative preparation where required.

• Ensure activities are conducted in accordance with applicable global and local pharmacovigilance regulations, Sponsor procedures, project requirements, and SOPs

• Maintain appropriate operational controls to ensure timely identification and escalation of safety information.

Mailbox Screening & Case Intake

• Oversee the monitoring of regional and global adverse-event mailboxes across applicable languages and Customer Affiliates, including South Korea.

• Ensure received communications are assessed and appropriately actioned within the required 1-business-day timeframe.

• Ensure accurate creation of Case Reports for serious and non-serious adverse events, including initial and follow-up reports, for entry into the Global Safety Database.

• Monitor workload and coverage to reduce the risk of late processing, missed communications, or compliance deviations.

Follow-up & Reconciliation

• Oversee follow-up correspondence with ICSR reporters to obtain additional information in accordance with Sponsor SOPs and project requirements.

• Ensure completion of reconciliations with internal functions and licensing partners regarding exchanged ICSRs and safety information.

• Maintain oversight of required daily, weekly, monthly, or quarterly reconciliation activities and ensure identified discrepancies are appropriately addressed and documented.

Quality, Compliance & Inspection Readiness

• Maintain continuous oversight of quality and compliance across assigned operations.

• Support local literature searches, reconciliation activities, and applicable quality assurance processes.

• Ensure assigned compliance investigations for late submissions or other identified deviations are completed accurately and within required timelines.

• Perform or oversee root-cause investigations and follow-up activities when quality or compliance issues are identified.

• Support CAPA or other remediation activities, where applicable, and monitor actions through completion.

• Maintain operational readiness for Sponsor audits, regulatory inspections, internal quality reviews, and other compliance assessments.

• Ensure appropriate documentation and evidence are maintained to demonstrate process and project compliance.

Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

• Build effective working relationships with Sponsor representatives and internal and external stakeholders.

• Partner with Safety Operations, Quality, Compliance, Training, Regulatory, and other applicable functions to resolve operational issues.

• Communicate operational status, risks, dependencies, and mitigation actions clearly and promptly.

• Escalate significant risks or recurring issues to appropriate project and functional leadership.

Key Accountabilities / Performance Expectations
The Manager is expected to demonstrate effective oversight across the following areas:

• Sponsor KPI/SLA compliance

• Timeliness of safety activities and submissions

• ICSR processing quality and compliance

• Mailbox and intake timeliness

• Reconciliation completion and discrepancy management

• Team productivity and workload management

• Training and qualification compliance

• Quality-event/deviation management

• CAPA and remediation follow-up, where applicable

• Audit and inspection readiness

• Direct-report performance and development

• Sponsor satisfaction and effective stakeholder communication

• Operational risk identification and timely escalation

Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related scientific/medical discipline, or equivalent relevant pharmacovigilance experience.

• A third language will be highly valued.

Experience :

• Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience.

• Minimum 3 years of Pharmacovigilance experience.

• Previous experience coordinating, supervising, or leading operational teams is strongly preferred.

• Experience working in a Sponsor-facing and/or global pharmacovigilance environment is preferred.

Skills & Competencies:

• Strong understanding of global and local pharmacovigilance regulations and guidelines.

• Strong people leadership, coaching, performance management, and team-development capabilities.

• Demonstrated ability to monitor and manage operational KPIs, quality metrics, SLAs, compliance, and workload.

• Strong stakeholder-management and Sponsor-facing communication skills.

• Ability to identify operational risks, analyze performance trends, escalate appropriately, and drive remediation.

• Strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to operate independently while effectively leading a team in a matrix environment.

• Proficiency in English and the specific local/regional language(s), as applicable.

• Experience with electronic safety/data management systems such as Argus or equivalent global safety databases.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Pharmacy, Chemical, Nursing or other third-level scientific/medical education.

• Experience working with global safety databases.

• Previous formal experience managing direct reports.

• Strong mathematical skills.

• Superb time management and detail orientation.

Contamos con el talento de 26,000 colaboradores en más de 70 países, donde todos tienen la oportunidad de contribuir y crecer profesionalmente en entornos de trabajo flexibles. En un momento en el que la objetividad, precisión, equidad y transparencia están bajo ataque, nos comprometemos a buscarlos. ¿Suena emocionante? • 7+ years of US payroll processing and compliance experience

• Strong numbers acumen, including analytical abilities and proficient skills in Excel, MS Access, SQL Queries, or other leading data analytics tools in the market

• Excellent organizational skills with a proactive approach to problem solving and attention to detail

Ideally, you’ll also have

What we look for

We're interested in professionals with the drive to take on new responsibilities and projects. You'll need the confidence to speak up with your own creative thoughts on a wide range of areas. You'll also have the opportunity to achieve your potential by being given professional development opportunities and experiences with clients across geographies. If you're keen to play a pivotal role within a highly focused global payroll operate implementation team, this role is for you.

Platform Engineer

About Satellogic

Satellogic is a vertically integrated Earth Observation satellite and data company. We design, manufacture, and operate our own fleet of satellites, the Aleph-1 constellation, which delivers high-frequency, high-resolution imagery plus full-motion video.

Earth Observation imagery and data are key to monitoring change at scale, informing critical decisions, and ultimately helping solve the world’s most pressing problems. Our mission is to democratize access to this information, making it affordable and available for those who need it across a wide range of industries, from climate monitoring and agriculture, to energy, infrastructure and many more. We want to do our part in building a world where every organization is prepared for the challenges of tomorrow.

With a growing team of more than 190 employees spanning 4 countries, Satellogic is a diverse group of purpose-driven professionals across software development, satellite engineering, operations, data science, manufacturing, and sales. We are excited to grow and welcome team members who push the limits, get things done, and never stop learning—all while being humble, honest, and empathetic.

About the team

The IT team at Satellogic delivers reliable, scalable, and secure technology solutions to support the company's mission and day-to-day operations.

We are responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the infrastructure, platforms, and services that enable business continuity, operational efficiency, and security.

Our team manages a diverse technology environment, combining on-premise/cloud infrastructure, different Operating systems, containerized workloads, monitoring platforms, and internal services.

About the position

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer with a strong Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) mindset to help ensure the reliability, availability, and performance of our cloud infrastructure and internal platforms.

You’ll play a key role in improving our AWS and Kubernetes environments through monitoring, observability, automation, and proactive reliability engineering. This includes building meaningful dashboards, improving alerting, troubleshooting production incidents, and identifying opportunities to prevent recurring issues.

The role combines hands-on platform engineering and continuous infrastructure improvement with production reliability responsibilities, including incident response and participation in scheduled on-call rotations.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, takes ownership of production reliability, and continuously improves systems through automation, standardization, and operational best practices.

Location

We are looking for a Platform Engineer based in the Philippines or India to strengthen our global infrastructure operations and support production systems across different time zones.

Responsibilities

• Participate in scheduled on-call rotations, responding to critical alerts and production incidents when required.

• Investigate and troubleshoot production incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures.

• Collaborate with global engineering and operations teams to improve infrastructure resilience and operational best practices.

What we value

Satellogic values diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. We are convinced that hiring and developing top talent from around the world for any given discipline will drive innovation, generate new solutions, and deliver a superior product to our global customer base. We work to build an equitable and inclusive environment in which all people, regardless of gender, race, religion, or background, can come together to do their best work.

postings.title: Space Systems Commercial & Legal Contracts Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Space Systems Commercial & Legal Contracts Specialist

Reports to: Contracts

Functional alignment: Space Systems pod

Location: Remote

Role type: Full-time

About Satellogic

Satellogic (NASDAQ: SATL) builds the infrastructure for Persistent Global Intelligence (PGI): continuous, proactive awareness of the places, assets, and activities that matter. We're leading the transition from episodic Earth observation — buying an image after something happens — to persistent monitoring programs that give customers earlier awareness, faster decisions, and greater control over mission-critical information.

We do it through a coordinated stack that combines high-cadence satellite collection, fit-for-purpose satellite economics, AI-accelerated workflows, and sovereign-trusted architecture. Our vertically integrated approach and patented optical design make our satellites roughly 10x more affordable with 10x more capacity than industry standard, which is what makes persistent monitoring at global scale economically viable in the first place.

We serve allied defense and intelligence agencies, civil governments, and select commercial markets that manage large portfolios of mission-critical sites, assets, and operations. Customers can begin with discovery, expand into persistent monitoring, and build toward dedicated capacity or sovereign-controlled infrastructure as their mission requirements grow.

With a team distributed across five countries, we bring together expertise in satellite engineering, software, data science, manufacturing, operations, and go-to-market. We're purpose-driven builders who value ownership, curiosity, and execution — and who work with humility, honesty, and empathy.

The Role

Satellogic is seeking a commercially minded legal and contracts professional to support the development, negotiation and execution of complex international satellite and sovereign space mission agreements.

Working directly with Satellogic’s Space Systems sales pod, as well as Legal, Finance, Engineering and Program Management teams, the successful candidate will play a key role in managing the contractual and legal aspects of satellite sales, constellation programmes and strategic partnerships.

The position combines commercial contract management, legal drafting, negotiation support and contractual risk assessment, ensuring Satellogic's commercial interests are protected while enabling the business to move efficiently from opportunity development through contract award and execution.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone with a strong understanding of commercial contracts, preferably within aerospace, defence, technology or government procurement.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Drafting & Negotiation

• Prepare, review and negotiate commercial agreements relating to satellite sales, constellation programmes and associated services.

• Support the drafting and negotiation of satellite procurement agreements, master supply agreements, NDAs, MoUs, teaming agreements and strategic partnership arrangements.

• Review contractual terms covering liability, indemnities, warranties, intellectual property, acceptance criteria, payment milestones and termination provisions.

• Identify contractual risks and recommend commercially practical solutions.

• Support customer negotiations alongside the SVP of Space Systems and Satellogic's Legal team.

• Ensure contracts accurately reflect agreed commercial and technical commitments.

Sovereign Mission & Strategic Agreements

• Support contractual structures for sovereign satellite programmes involving government customers, local industrial partners and prime contractors.

• Assist with agreements covering local Assembly, Integration and Testing (AIT), Technology Transfer (ToT), Transfer of Knowledge (ToK) and intellectual property licensing.

• Review contractual requirements relating to localization, industrial participation, export controls and regulatory compliance, coordinating with specialist counsel where appropriate.

• Support the development of commercial and contractual frameworks for joint ventures, strategic partnerships and local operating arrangements.

• Help structure agreements that balance customer sovereignty requirements with Satellogic's commercial interests and intellectual property protections.

Commercial & Legal Risk Management

• Assess commercial and contractual exposure across international opportunities.

• Identify risks associated with delivery schedules, performance guarantees, liquidated damages, payment security and customer acceptance.

• Work with Finance and Legal to ensure appropriate contractual protections and approval processes.

• Support the review of customer tender conditions and government procurement requirements.

• Maintain clear records of negotiated terms, deviations and outstanding contractual issues.

• Escalate material legal and commercial risks to the appropriate decision-makers.

Bid, Proposal & Commercial Support

• Review contractual requirements within RFPs, RFQs and government tenders.

• Support the preparation of commercial proposals, contractual responses and BAFO submissions.

• Coordinate with Engineering and Programme Management to ensure technical commitments are contractually achievable.

• Assist in developing commercial terms, milestone payment structures and delivery conditions.

• Support internal contract reviews and approval processes ahead of customer submissions.

Contract Execution & Governance

• Maintain oversight of contractual obligations following award.

• Support the handover of executed agreements to Programme Management and delivery teams.

• Track contract amendments, variations, milestone obligations and customer commitments.

• Assist with contractual disputes, claims and change requests in coordination with Legal.

• Maintain a structured contract repository and support improvements to contractual processes and templates.

• Ensure appropriate contractual governance without unnecessarily slowing commercial execution.

Required Experience & Qualifications

• 5–8 years of relevant experience in commercial contracts, legal operations, contract management or commercial law.

• A law degree or recognised legal qualification is strongly preferred; qualification as a practising solicitor or lawyer would be advantageous.

• Experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex commercial agreements.

• Good understanding of contractual risk allocation, liability, indemnities, intellectual property and payment protections.

• Experience working with government customers, defence contractors or complex technology suppliers.

• Strong commercial judgement and the ability to translate legal considerations into practical business recommendations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Ability to operate independently and work closely with senior commercial leadership.

• Desirable Experience

• Aerospace, satellite manufacturing, defence or space industry experience.

• Government-to-business or government-to-government procurement exposure.

• Experience with technology transfer, licensing and international industrial partnerships.

• Familiarity with export controls, sanctions and cross-border contractual requirements.

• Experience supporting high-value international programmes, particularly in the Middle East and Europe.

• Understanding of contract structures involving local primes, subcontractors and sovereign customers.

• Personal Attributes

• The ideal candidate will be:

• Commercially pragmatic: Understands that the objective is to enable business while managing risk.

• Legally astute: Able to identify contractual exposure and recommend proportionate protections.

• Confident: Comfortable engaging with customers, external counsel and senior executives.

• Independent: Capable of taking ownership of contract preparation and negotiations.

• Solution-oriented: Focused on resolving issues rather than simply highlighting obstacles.

• Detail-driven: Able to manage complex contractual requirements without losing sight of the wider commercial objective.

Measures of Success

• Faster preparation, review and negotiation of commercial agreements.

• Improved contractual protection and reduced commercial exposure.

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. As an Onboarding Coach, we’re looking for someone who truly understands hospitality and can step into our clients’ shoes to demonstrate how our system makes their lives easier. You’ll care for our clients and their properties just as you would for a guest in a hotel—always going the extra mile. In this role, you’ll train clients on the system, tailoring it to fit their needs as a hospitality business. By asking the right questions, you’ll get to know your clients and ensure that, by the end of the onboarding process, they have a complete understanding of and confidence in using the system.

Our Customer Onboarding Team:

As part of our Customer Onboarding Team, you’ll play a vital role in bringing our motto *“more reservations, happier guests” to life. Our team is close-knit and collaborative, living this motto every day by working closely together to provide exceptional support and ensure a seamless onboarding experience for our customers.

If you’re ready to make a difference and be part of an exciting journey, we’d love to have you on board!

What You Bring to the Team:

• Facilitate client onboarding, training, and ongoing support via video, phone, and email.

• Resolve customer inquiries and troubleshoot escalated issues across multiple channels.

• Partner with Sales to define success, demonstrate ROI, and drive retention.

• Build strong client relationships to encourage loyalty and promote product adoption.

• Develop a deep understanding of Cloudbeds’ products and customer needs.

• Contribute to training materials and stay updated on system changes.

• Record activities in Salesforce, gather feedback, and share insights for product improvements.

What Sets You Up for Success:

• Communicate product offerings clearly and synthesize feedback for internal teams.

• Share customer insights and opportunities across departments to drive alignment.

• Manage multiple projects or accounts with strong organizational and proactive skills.

• Empower clients to become self-sufficient during onboarding and beyond.

• Deliver exceptional communication with empathy and a customer-focused approach.

• Bring over 1 year of hospitality experience in roles like Front Desk or Revenue Manager.

• Have at least 2 years of relevant industry experience in customer-facing roles.

• Native or Fluent in both English and Spanish (Portuguese is a plus)

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

A day in the life:

As a Senior Media Manager, you’ll partner closely with your Media Supervisor to shape strategy and planning, while confidently leading client conversations, reinforcing strategic direction, and identifying testing or growth opportunities. You’ll support the Associate Media Director across key areas of media planning and own the daily management of campaigns, understanding performance drivers, optimizing with intent, and turning data into clear, actionable recommendations. You’ll collaborate with the creative team to develop new assets, messaging, and design concepts that elevate performance. With strong experience in Paid Search and a solid foundation in paid social and display, you’ll bring multi-channel expertise to the table and apply best practices across every channel you touch. This is a client-facing role, and your ability to guide, educate, and drive results will define your impact.

Responsibilities:

• Successful end-to-end management of designated paid media accounts

• Meet pacing and KPI requirements for held accounts

• Own all Paid Search strategy, project ideation, road mapping, & testing, leading the team with confidence and direction

• Work with Account Managers and the Media Supervisor to identify client goals, priorities and efficiency requirements.

• Actively works to increase billing for existing accounts and propose opportunities to expand media coverage for new accounts

• Continually work to learn new strategies, test new platforms, and expand Cardinal’s Paid Media offerings

• Function as primary point of contact both internally and externally for all ‘owned’accounts – responsible for pacing and performance of accounts

• Responsible for generating reporting, writing insights, and communicating with the client for designated accounts

• Responsible for the ongoing maintenance of held accounts including but not limited to optimizations, structural updates, bidding methodologies, conversion types and copyrevisions

• Responsible for strategic ideation on all accounts, designing and adjusting campaign strategies to meet each client’s business goals (and internal objectives)

• Responsible for designing and deploying tests in accounts on a monthly and quarterly cadence (structural, targeting, creative & messaging, conversion, etc.)

• Responsible for continual testing, verification, and improvement of full-funnel structures

Role Requirements:

• 4-5+ years of experience, primarily in Paid Search

• Ideal candidates also have experience in Paid Social, Programmatic, or both

• Required platform expertise: Google Ads

• Suggested additional platform familiarity: Bing, Meta, a DSP platform

• Experience managing paid media budget ranges above 100k per month

• Experience driving paid media strategy and testing

• Confident ability to communicate with and convince clients

• Great at reporting and insights, and great at identifying and optimizing towards client business goals

• Experience in full project ownership, from the first step of writing strategy briefs and recommendations, all the way to deploying campaigns/tests in-platform and reporting on results

• Excellent communication, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace

• Ability to interface with both internal team members and clients

• Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks effectively

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. What does a Senior Project Manager do at WPP Production?

Senior Project Managers own the end-to-end project management of projects. They are responsible for intake, delivering a completed project on time and to specification. The Senior Project Manager is everyone's point person for requests they are assigned to. Team members rely on them for everything they need to know about a project: what to expect, what to do next, and to find out where they need to be. Senior Project Managers relay information about the timing, scope, budgets, resources, and changes to the project plan. This role will interact directly with the teams across the South Region (Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Paraguay, and Uruguay), working on projects with this team during the schedule of 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.

postings.title: Financial Controller &  Regulatory Reporting Officer – Gibraltar
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Financial Controller & Regulatory Reporting Officer to join our Gibraltar office. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership: you will be the primary finance lead for GIB's P&L, balance sheet and regulatory reporting under DLT license to the FSC, and will additionally oversee the financial operations of ARQ UK, a cost centre within the group together with ownership of the  reconciliation process of ARQ Globals financial and ledger accounts.

Reporting directly to the Group Controller, you will act as the financial backbone of two entities, ensuring integrity in reporting, compliance with local requirements, and tight control over costs. This role is ideal for a finance professional who thrives in a lean, high-ownership environment and is comfortable working across jurisdictions.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 

Financial Control & Reporting: 

 - Own the month-end close process for GIB, ensuring timely and accurate financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards (IFRS).

 - Review and maintain the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements on a monthly basis.

 - Maintain a robust chart of accounts and ensure proper classification of all transactions.

 - Manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations between GIB and other group entities in line with our Transfer Pricing Policy.

 - Support the preparation of statutory accounts and liaise with external auditors.

 - Ensure compliance with local regulatory reporting requirements for the Gibraltar Company.

Cost Centre Oversight:

 - Oversee the financial operations of ARQ UK as a cost centre, including monthly cost review and variance analysis.

 - Ensure all ARQ UK costs are correctly allocated, accrued, and reported in line with group policies.

 - Monitor budgets versus actuals for ARQ UK and escalate material variances to the Group Financial Controller.

 - Coordinate with local stakeholders in the UK to gather financial data and validate reporting accuracy.

Budgeting & Forecasting:

 - Contribute to the annual budgeting process for GIB and ARQ UK, working closely with the Group Financial Controller.

 - Prepare rolling forecasts and provide commentary on financial performance drivers.

 - Develop financial models to support business decisions and scenario planning.

Controls & Compliance:

 - Design, implement, and maintain robust internal controls for both GIB and ARQ UK.

 - Ensure adherence to group accounting policies and flag any deviations or exceptions.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact with the outsourced accounting provider, coordinating and reviewing the preparation and delivery of financial statements and periodic financial reports for GIB and ARQ UK.

 - Ensure the accurate calculation, provisioning, and timely payment of all applicable taxes for both entities, working in close collaboration with external tax advisors.

 - Monitor and ensure full compliance with the regulatory requirements of Gibraltar and the United Kingdom, keeping abreast of changes in local legislation and promptly escalating any compliance risks to the Group Controller.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent).

 - 5+ years of relevant experience in financial control, accounting, or audit roles.

 - Proven track record of owning month-end close and preparing statutory-quality financial statements.

 - Experience working in or with regulated financial services entities.

 - Strong knowledge of IFRS or UK GAAP.

 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

 - Advanced proficiency in spreadsheet tools (Excel or Google Sheets); comfortable with complex financial models and SQL

 - Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a lean team environment.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with multi-entity or multi-jurisdiction accounting environments.

 - Experience with Gibraltar and/or UK regulatory reporting frameworks.

 - Experience with ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, SAP, or similar).

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is hiring exceptional Revenue Operations analysts who will support a team of experts growing and managing our global direct, alliance, channel partner and online sales. The Revenue Operations teams drive continuous policy, process and data quality improvement which enable us to analyze and drive interventions to maximize net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.

You will support the leadership of the team, providing insights to drive improvements and partnering with Canonical’s teams across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal. This position requires an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the desire to strive for excellence. People that thrive in these roles are proactive problem solvers who are passionate about collaborating with sales and business development teams, our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and contributing to initiatives in support of Canonical's continued success. Successful candidates will demonstrate initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.

Location: These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA and Americas regions

The role entails

• Supporting all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales and business development functions globally

• Driving data quality, through checking opportunities for accuracy, clean order processing, new hire training, policy and process documentation, reporting and data cleansing

• Supporting and enabling the sales team globally on CRM and other revenue operations policies, processes and systems such as Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement, Data Enrichment, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions

• Supporting other Revenue Operations Analysts and leadership team to report on and improve data quality, sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks.

• Supporting planning, monitoring and improving revenue operations, across new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals. Delivering insight that enables improved territory and quota management, channel development and sales productivity.

• Assisting the team with automation and streamlining of the end-to-end Lead to Order process

What we are looking for in you

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

• Undergraduate degree in a related field, preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path

• Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations

• Experience working as an analyst in revenue/sales operations or related fields such as financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing

• Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes

• Excellent attention to detail and data-driven, analytical and problem-solving skills

• Planning and organisational skills, including the ability to interact and work with stakeholders across functions and at all levels of the organisation

The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com .

The Opportunity

Carrot is seeking a Lead, Product Management to help shape and scale one of our core product areas as Carrot's platform continues to grow. In this role, you'll operate as a strategic driver within the Product organization — owning a significant portion of the product roadmap, setting direction for cross-functional initiatives, and raising the bar for product craft across the team.

This is a highly visible, high-impact role for someone who has already demonstrated strong product judgment and is ready to take on greater scope: shaping strategy, mentoring other product managers, and partnering directly with senior leadership on the initiatives that matter most to our members and business.

If you're energized by solving ambiguous, high-stakes problems and want to help define how Carrot builds products at scale, this role is for you!

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

• Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for a key product area, translating company priorities into a clear, prioritized plan of execution

• Lead cross-functional initiatives, aligning Engineering, UX, Clinical, Legal, and Commercial partners around a shared vision and set of goals

• Serve as a thought partner and informal mentor to other Product Managers, helping raise the bar on product process, discovery, and craft across the team

• Make and communicate high-judgment prioritization decisions, balancing member experience, business impact, and technical feasibility

• Partner directly with senior product and cross-functional leadership to shape quarterly and annual product strategy

• Identify and address systemic gaps in process, tooling, or team practices that limit the Product team's effectiveness

• Represent the Product team in executive and cross-functional forums, clearly communicating strategy, trade-offs, and outcomes

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

• Delivered a body of work that measurably improved member outcomes, engagement, or business performance within your product area

• Built trusted, effective working relationships with cross-functional leaders across Engineering, UX, Clinical, Legal, and Commercial/Customer Success

• Established yourself as a go-to product thought leader, with other PMs seeking out your input on strategy and process

• Shaped or improved a core product process (discovery, roadmapping, prioritization) that is now used more broadly across the team

• Successfully led at least one significant, ambiguous, cross-functional initiative from concept through launch

About You ✨

You likely have:

• 5+ years of product management experience, including time at a fast-growing technology company; healthcare or digital health experience is a plus

• A track record of owning complex, cross-functional product initiatives from strategy through execution

• Strong product sense and the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints in your decision-making

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and align both peers and senior leadership

• Experience mentoring or informally guiding less-experienced product managers

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

• Experience in fertility, family-building, or broader digital health benefits

• Experience partnering with Clinical or Legal teams on regulated or compliance-sensitive products

• Familiarity with AI-enabled product features or workflows

• Experience operating in a fully distributed, remote-first organization

Why This Role Matters

As Carrot continues to scale, our Product team needs leaders who can operate with both strategic clarity and hands-on execution. This Lead, Product Management role is central to that effort — helping ensure our roadmap reflects the right priorities, our cross-functional partners are aligned, and our product practices scale sustainably as the team grows.

This is an opportunity to have an outsized impact: shaping not just a single product area, but the way Carrot's Product organization operates as it matures.

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

• Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes

• Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes

• Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes

• Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes

• Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

• A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.

• A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

• Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

• Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.

• Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.

• The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $168,000-$198,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer - MAAS
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability.
Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.
This role entails

• Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.

• Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.

• Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.

• Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.

• Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it world-class resource for Data Centre operators and users.

• Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.

• Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.

• Travel internationally a few times a year to meet and collaborate with your and other teams.

What we are looking for in you

• Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation

• Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back-end roles, or TypeScript, React for front-end roles.

• Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques

• Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills

• Strong English language communication skills - both written and verbal

• Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.

• You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

• Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP

• Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others)

• Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.

• Ideally, experience of large-scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.

• Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.

• An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.

• Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The Role

We are seeking an experienced English into Estonian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.

You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.

Project Details

- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Estonian

What You Will Do

-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.

What You Will Own

-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking

Requirements

- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Estonian and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

Additional Key Information

- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.

Why Join Us

This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing upskilling, and access to established linguistic resources.

If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

postings.title: Senior Developer Experience Engineer, Integrations
postings.descriptionText:
Hi, I’m Josh, Engineering Manager at Customer.io . We’re looking for a curious, AI-forward Developer Experience Engineer to join our Integrations team and help us build the tools that developers rely on to integrate with Customer.io .

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies - from scrappy startups to global brands - use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, Ember and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value

Ownership

You own problems end to end. You move fast, act like an owner, and thrive in ambiguity. You've led complex projects before, whether officially or not, and you're ready to do it again.

Engineers with product taste

You think like a developer using your tools, not just an engineer building them. You care about API design, developer experience, and everything in between.

A healthy skepticism for “the way things are done”

You bring rigor and creativity. Best practices matter - but never more than forward motion.

What You’ll Do

• Build and evolve Customer.io 's SDKs across platforms - including Android, iOS, Node, and Go - and the developer tools that support them

• Lead SDK initiatives end to end: set technical direction, write the code, manage the release, and own the outcome

• Improve SDK delivery infrastructure - CI, automated testing, versioning, publishing, and release processes - so shipping is reliable and low-friction

• Partner closely with product and design to turn loosely defined goals into a great developer experience

• Participate in an on-call rotation as required, supporting the reliability of the systems you build

• Use AI agents to make multi-file changes across unfamiliar codebases and languages by scoping the work, writing the prompt, and verifying the output

• Bring strong customer empathy to the role - understanding what the engineers integrating with our SDKs actually need, and occasionally engaging directly with them

What we're looking for

• Expert-level competency in at least one established programming language, with strong software design and API design fundamentals

• Experience building and evolving mature, production-quality software, with a clear understanding of how systems fit together and how other developers consume them

• Exceptional fluency with current LLMs and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Codex) - using AI to understand unfamiliar codebases, work across languages, and run things in parallel or autonomously

• High autonomy in ambiguous environments - you clarify the problem, validate its value, and drive implementation without close direction

• Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly

• Ability to work effectively across multiple languages and stacks; prior experience in every language we support (Swift, Kotlin, Node, Go) is not required

Nice to have: experience building external-facing SDKs, APIs, or developer tools; experience owning CI, testing, versioning, or release infrastructure; or forward-deployed engineering experience.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $150,000 - $200,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• Application - We review everyone with care. Tell us why you're interested.

• Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let’s chat about what you’re looking for and how we work.

• Hiring Manager & AI Skills Interview (60 mins) - We'll explore ownership, autonomy, and collaboration, then dig into how you actually use AI in your day-to-day workflow.

• Practical AI-Enabled Coding Round (60 mins) - A live, collaborative session where you'll extend a sample SDK using AI tools. Wwe want to see how you think and work with AI as part of your process.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io .

Join us!

We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read and want to build software that makes communication better for everyone—apply now.

postings.descriptionText:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As an Onboarding Coach, we’re looking for someone who truly understands hospitality and can step into our clients’ shoes to demonstrate how our system makes their lives easier. You’ll care for our clients and their properties just as you would for a guest in a hotel—always going the extra mile. In this role, you’ll train clients on the system, tailoring it to fit their needs as a hospitality business. By asking the right questions, you’ll get to know your clients and ensure that, by the end of the onboarding process, they have a complete understanding of and confidence in using the system.

Our Customer Onboarding Team:

postings.title: Senior Brand Designer
postings.descriptionText:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Justin Howie, Head of Brand Studio at Customer.io , and I'm looking for a Senior Brand Designer to join our small, close-knit creative team.

Brand Studio is the creative engine behind how Customer.io shows up in the world, from product launches and campaigns to the website and live events. We move fast, care deeply about craft, and operate at the intersection of strategy and production.

Our team is moving from a production function to a systems and platform team, powered by AI and self-serve tooling. AI sits at the center of how we work, and you'll shape how Brand Studio and the wider company use it for ideation, production, and self-serve creation. You'll own brand design execution across our biggest moments, and you'll build the templates, components, and AI-assisted workflows that let the rest of the company create on brand without waiting on us. You'll work closely with our Brand Designers, Motion Designer, Web Engineer, Product Designers, and Marketers.

This is a senior role with a runway. We're looking for a highly seasoned designer with strong business acumen, who manages up well and mentors others, and who we expect to grow into a Staff or Art Director role once you've proven yourself here.

If you lead with Design Craft, live at the frontier of AI for brand and creative, and want to build systems that help a whole company look and sound like one brand, this role is for you.

What we value

• Design Craft with speed — You hold high standards and know how to hit deadlines.

• Curiosity about what's next — You stay on the leading edge of brand and creative, from new AI tools to new techniques, and you share what you learn.

• AI-native by default — You reach for AI first, test what works on real projects, and teach others how.

• Collaboration over silos — You work closely with designers, developers, and marketers, and the output gets better because of it.

• Bias for action — You'd rather ship something great and iterate than wait for perfect, and you're energized by building.

• Clear communication — You ask the right questions, set clear expectations, and keep stakeholders in the loop without being asked.

• Leadership beyond the work — You mentor the people around you, manage up with confidence, and think like an owner of the business.

What you’ll do

• Own brand design execution for product launches, using AI-native workflows to take concepts to launch-ready assets in days

• Design website pages, templates, and components in close collaboration with our Senior Web Engineer

• Develop campaign assets for digital and out-of-home advertising, produced with AI-native workflows so we can test more concepts and ship more variants

• Design branded materials for events and conferences, including signage, stage graphics, and collateral

• Build and maintain brand templates and libraries, including Figma libraries, prompt libraries, and custom tooling that turn our guidelines into on-brand output anyone can use

• Own our AI creative stack: choose the tools, set the standards, and share what you learn with Brand Studio and the wider company

• Enable teams across the org through workshops, playbooks, and guardrails that keep AI-assisted work on brand

• Translate briefs from Product Marketing and Demand Generation into creative concepts, executed end to end

• Partner with Product Design to keep brand and product expression aligned

• Mentor designers on the team, give clear critique, and raise the Design Craft bar across Brand Studio

• Work with Brand Studio leadership and senior stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, and the business case for creative investment

What we're looking for

• 7+ years of hands-on brand or visual design experience, ideally in-house at a B2B SaaS or tech company, with a record of senior-level ownership

• A portfolio that shows range: brand systems, campaign work, product launch design, web and landing pages, event and out-of-home, and AI-assisted work with a clear account of your process

• Expert proficiency in Figma, including building and maintaining components and libraries within a brand system, and fluency in Adobe Creative Suite

• Strong typography and layout instincts, and a track record of turning complex technical concepts into clear, compelling visuals

• Business acumen: you connect design decisions to company goals, make the case for creative investment, and communicate fluently with executives

• The ability to manage up and lead without authority: setting expectations, surfacing risks early, and driving alignment across Marketing, Product, and Exec

• Mentorship experience: you've coached other designers and raised the craft bar around you

• Deep, hands-on experience with AI image and design tools in your production workflow, plus fluency across the AI creative stack (image generation, LLMs, prompt design, workflow automation) with examples of workflows, templates, or tools you've built that help others create on brand

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $128k–$160k USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• 30-minute Zoom with a Recruiter

• 45-minute Zoom with the Head of Brand Studio

• 30-minute Zoom with a cross-functional leader

• 45-minute Zoom portfolio review and design exercise with Brand Studio

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io .

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now.
