postings.title: Analista de Ingeniería Técnica
postings.descriptionText:
En Bidcom somos líderes en E-commerce y nos apasiona llevar la mejor tecnología y equipamiento a millones de usuarios. Nos encontramos en permanente crecimiento y transformación, construyendo un entorno dinámico e innovador donde cada desafío se convierte en una oportunidad de desarrollo. Si buscás potenciar tu talento, trabajar con autonomía y generar un impacto directo en la experiencia de nuestros clientes a través de la excelencia y la mejora continua, ¡este es tu lugar!

Tareas y Responsabilidades

• Monitorear y priorizar los indicadores de calidad y performance de campo de los productos GADNIC (tickets de CX, Service, devoluciones y reseñas) para actuar sobre los SKU críticos.

• Analizar causas raíz de fallas en productos reportados o devueltos junto al área de Service, liderando la gestión de no conformidades mediante metodologías como 8D.

• Gestionar el recupero del costo de no calidad con proveedores internacionales, respaldando cada caso con evidencia técnica, elaborando Failure Reports y haciendo el seguimiento de compensaciones.

• Brindar soporte técnico de segundo nivel a las áreas de CX, Service y Comercial, asegurando la resolución efectiva de consultas complejas.

• Garantizar la precisión de la información técnica , auditando y actualizando fichas técnicas, manuales de usuario y contenidos de publicaciones en comparación con el producto real.

• Desarrollar material de capacitación y diagnóstico , redactando boletines técnicos, guías de troubleshooting y listados de repuestos para el equipo operativo.

• Detectar alertas tempranas de calidad y seguridad cruzando datos de campo para reducir los costos de garantía y proponer mejoras en nuevos desarrollos de productos.

• Coordinar la ejecución de cuarentenas, reprocesos o bloqueos de stock , trabajando en conjunto con las áreas de Stock y Logística.

Requisitos

• Formación académica: Técnico/a o estudiante/graduado/a en Ingeniería Electrónica, Electromecánica, Computación o carreras afines.

• Experiencia profesional: Más de 3 años en roles de calidad, servicio técnico o posventa de productos electrónicos de consumo, con trayectoria comprobable en análisis de fallas y gestión con proveedores (nivel Senior).

• Idioma: Inglés intermedio-avanzado (lectura y escritura excluyentes para comunicación fluida con proveedores internacionales).

• Herramientas analíticas: Dominio avanzado de Google Sheets / Excel (tablas dinámicas e indicadores) y manejo de instrumentos de medición y ensayo.

• Conocimientos valorados (Deseable): Metodologías de calidad (8D, 5 Whys, FMEA), conocimiento en modos de falla de pequeños electrodomésticos/electrónica, experiencia en E-commerce/Marketplaces (Mercado Libre) y manejo de herramientas de ticketing/BI (Zendesk, Jira, Looker Studio, SQL).

Beneficios Corporativos

• Cobertura médica prepaga de primer nivel.

• Membresía con descuento en red de gimnasios Sport Club.

• Día de cumpleaños libre (Day Off).

• Descuentos corporativos en productos de la compañía.

• Licencia por paternidad extendida.

• Posibilidades reales de crecimiento y desarrollo en una empresa líder.

postings.title: Revenue Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Maximizar el RevPAR y los ingresos de hospedaje de los hoteles del cluster, anticipando la demanda y proponiendo estrategias de precio, mix de clientes y distribución que aseguren el cumplimiento del presupuesto.

Responsabilidades principales
Análisis y datos

• Construir y mantener una base de datos confiable para los análisis de revenue.

• Analizar la producción histórica por hotel, segmento y canal, e identificar tendencias.

• Monitorear el mercado, la performance del set competitivo (benchmarking) y el comportamiento de reserva del cliente.

Previsión y estrategia

• Prever la demanda por segmento, período y día de la semana, y mantener actualizado el forecast de cada hotel.

• Definir la estrategia de optimización: gestión del mix de clientes, precio dinámico, restricciones y apertura/cierre de canales.

• Actualizar e interpretar las recomendaciones de venta (RevMix) y asegurar su aplicación en los canales directos e indirectos (sistema de reservas, channel manager, OTAs).

Planificación y comercial

• Participar en la elaboración de los planes de marketing, ventas y presupuesto de cada hotel.

• Acompañar el proceso anual de pricing y contracting (cuentas corporativas, agencias y operadores) de los hoteles del cluster.

• Acompañar las cotizaciones de grupos y tripulaciones, definiendo tarifas y condiciones según la demanda esperada.

• Acompañar la elaboración del presupuesto anual de hospedaje.

Gestión y reporte

• Preparar los reportes de resultados (OTB vs presupuesto y año anterior, RevPAR, ADR, ocupación, índices del set competitivo) y presentarlos en las revisiones mensuales (BRM).

• Aplicar las recomendaciones en el sistema de reservas (Tars) y en las ventas directas de cada hotel.

• Evaluar los resultados y proponer acciones correctivas.

• Trabajar en conjunto con los equipos comerciales, de reservas y operaciones de cada hotel.

Perfil requerido
Requisito
Detalle
Formación
Graduado/a en Administración, Economía, Hotelería, Turismo o carreras afines.
Experiencia
Deseable 2 años en revenue management o yield management hotelero (en el cargo o en el área)
Idioma: inglés
Nivel deseable: avanzado
Herramientas
Excel avanzado; sistemas de revenue y reservas (Revtool, RevMix, Tars, PMS/CRS); channel manager y herramientas de benchmarking
Deseable
Experiencia en cadenas hoteleras internacionales y en gestión de más de un hotel
Competencias
Se valorarán las competencias del modelo Accor y las siguientes características personales:

• Liderazgo y flexibilidad

• Planificación y orientación a resultados

• Negociación y toma de decisiones

• Capacidad de análisis y visión de negocio

• Conocimiento del mercado y de la competencia

• Búsqueda activa de información

• Programas de aprendizaje a través de nuestras Academias

• Oportunidad para desarrollar su talento y crecer dentro de su hotel y en todo el mundo!

• Capacidad para hacer diferencia en la comunidad local a través de nuestras actividades de Responsabilidad Social Corporativa, como Planet 21

Diversidad e Inclusión para Accor significa recibir a cada uno y respetar sus diferencias, dando prioridad solamente a las cualidades y habilidades. Nuestro objetivo es proporcionar empleo con propósito, en una cultura inclusiva, ofrecer excelentes condiciones laborales y promover el desarrollo de todas las personas, incluyendo a las personas con discapacidad. No dude en informarnos de cualquier necesidad específica que tenga para que podamos tenerla en consideración

postings.title: Trainee Técnico Comercial (Córdoba)
postings.descriptionText:
Women in Sales Force LATAM es una experiencia regional de desarrollo para atraer y preparar talento femenino en etapa inicial de carrera, con interés en construir una trayectoria en posiciones comerciales y técnico-comerciales. El programa combina contratación y experiencia práctica en el país de origen, formación técnica y comercial, exposición a clientes, acompañamiento, un proyecto de negocio y una experiencia regional de aprendizaje.

La participante aportará a objetivos reales del negocio mientras desarrolla conocimientos, habilidades y relaciones que la preparen para futuras oportunidades según su desempeño, las necesidades de la organización y los procesos locales aplicables.

Principales responsabilidades:

• Acompañar visitas a clientes, actividades de campo y seguimiento de oportunidades comerciales.

• Construir conocimiento sobre productos, sistemas, soluciones y aplicaciones de Sika vinculadas al área asignada.

• Desarrollar un proyecto práctico alineado con las prioridades de la Unidad de Negocio o Target Market.

• Completar la ruta de aprendizaje técnica, comercial y de habilidades definida para el programa.

Formación: Egresada o titulada recientemente de Ingeniería Civil, Construcción Civil, Arquitectura, Ingeniería Química, Ingeniería Industrial u otra carrera técnica relacionada.
Experiencia: Perfil de carrera inicial, preferentemente con 0 a 2 años de experiencia. Se valorarán prácticas, proyectos universitarios, actividades con clientes o experiencia en terreno.
Idiomas: Idioma local requerido. Inglés y/u otro idioma de LATAM deseable.
Movilidad: Disponibilidad para desplazamientos nacionales y apertura a una experiencia temporal de aprendizaje regional (LATAM).
Herramientas digitales: Manejo de herramientas digitales de productividad y disposición para aprender sistemas de CRM, aprendizaje y gestión del negocio.

Estamos Construyendo Confianza todos los días por eso nuestro compromiso es la igualdad de oportunidades donde el proceso de selección se enfoca en las personas y sus capacidades, méritos y logros. Nos basamos en la igualdad de oportunidades sin hacer distinción o exclusión respecto al género, raza, edad y/o religión.

Ofrecemos salarios competitivos, en línea con los estándares del mercado local y el alcance y las responsabilidades específicas de cada puesto. La remuneración se determina en función de las habilidades relevantes para el puesto, la educación y/o la formación. Nos comprometemos a aplicar prácticas salariales justas y equitativas, de conformidad con las leyes y normativas aplicables.

postings.title: Jefe de Tratamiento de Aguas Residuales
postings.descriptionText:
Misión:
Asegurar el funcionamiento eficiente, seguro y conforme a los estándares de calidad y normativas legales de los procesos de tratamiento de aguas residuales y productos derivados, mediante la gestión técnica, presupuestaria y humana del área, promoviendo la mejora continua, el cumplimiento de objetivos industriales y el desarrollo de un entorno laboral profesional y respetuoso.

Principales funciones:

• Respeta y hace respetar las políticas de la empresa.

• Colabora con el cumplimiento de los objetivos de la empresa.

• Pone en aplicación las instrucciones dadas por la Dirección Industrial.

• Participa en la definición de los objetivos de su departamento.

• Elabora el presupuesto de gastos fijos de su departamento.

• Recopila e interpreta con frecuencia semanal los resultados de su departamento.

• Responsable de cumplir el presupuesto para su departamento.

• Contribuye en mantener un ambiente de trabajo profesional, agradable y respetuoso.

• Dar soluciones a problemas de proceso, de funcionamiento de equipos, de calidad y de personal.

• Propone y lidera la aplicación de las acciones preventivas o correctivas a implementar.

• Responsable del nivel de calidad del producto en curso de elaboración y terminado en cuanto a cremas se refiere.

• Responsable de la calidad de productos derivados y de la performance del tratamiento de efluentes.

• Responsable del buen funcionamiento (procesos, calidad, limpieza, orden, disciplina, seguridad) en sus talleres.

• Responsable de la productividad de sus áreas y de ratios de consumos de materias primas y/o material de envase.

• Responsable de la actualización de la base de procedimientos inherentes a los talleres a su cargo.

• Colabora con Mantenimiento e Ingeniería en el estudio de modificaciones y/o proyectos.

• Coordina con Mantenimiento las intervenciones mayores en equipos.

• Responsable de asegurar el mantenimiento del orden y limpieza de los talleres a su cargo.

• Analiza junto con Mantenimiento las causas y soluciones a fallas importantes y repetitivas de equipos.

• De ser necesario, participa en la evaluación y aprobación de proveedores o nuevas materias primas.

• Elabora y es responsable de hacer cumplir el planning de producción.

• Responsable de la programación, y coordinación de equipos de trabajo acordes al planning de producción.

• Advierte desvíos reales y/o potenciales relacionados a la inocuidad de productos o incumplimientos de índole legal.

Formación:

• Ingeniero o Lic. Químico, Electromecánico, Mecánico, en Biotecnologías o en Agroalimentación (con experiencia en procesos productivos).

Experiencia:

• Tres años de experiencia en el área o tres años en puestos de similar responsabilidad transitados en empresas de alimentación o químicas de mediana o grande envergadura, o experiencia adquirida en el Grupo Lesaffre en posición similar.

Conocimientos:

• Conocimiento profundo de Procesos, y particularmente del tratamiento de Aguas Residuales y Evaporación.

• Debe estar familiarizado con el entorno del laboratorio industrial y ser capaz de asimilar de forma eficaz grandes cantidades de datos.

• Se requieren sólidos conocimientos de matemáticas, química y microbiología

• Conocimiento fehaciente de procesos productivos.

• Conocimientos de normas ISO y sistemas de gestión de inocuidad alimentaria.

• Normas de manejo y almacenamiento de químicos.

• Normas de gestión de residuos industriales.

• Normas de gestión de derrames.

• Manejo de PC avanzado.

• Normas básicas de seguridad en Industria (EPP, orden y limpieza, etc.).

• Lectura y comprensión de una MSDS.

• Conocimiento básico de BPM.

Habilitades Técnicas:

• Capacidad de liderazgo y manejo de personal.

• Aptitud para relacionarse a distintos niveles

• Iniciativa y capacidad de comunicación.

• Alta motivación.

• Amplia disponibilidad horaria.

• Conjunto de aplicaciones ofimáticas de Microsoft (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Power Bi deseable.

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación

• Dominio de idioma inglés (nivel intermedio o superior).

• Dominio de idioma francés (nivel intermedio o superior), no excluyente.

Te ofrecemos un entorno laboral pensado para tu bienestar:
Beneficios:

• Almuerzo – Opciones variadas para una alimentación saludable.

• Obra social para tu grupo familiar – Protegemos tu bienestar y el de los tuyos.

• Vacaciones extendidas – A partir de los 3 años, accede a 21 días corridos de descanso.

• Bono anual – Reconocemos tu compromiso con una recompensa especial.

• Programa de Bienestar – Plataforma de asistencia Psicológica y Legal gratuita al Colaborador.

• Día del Cumpleaños Libre – Disfruta tu día como más te guste.

Únete a una empresa familiar con una larga trayectoria y valores centrados en las personas, con una misión clara: Nutrir y Proteger nuestro Planeta.

Podrás desarrollar tu carrera en un entorno de trabajo enriquecedor y en un contexto multicultural que promueve el aprendizaje continuo y la colaboración.

postings.title: INGENIERO PROYECTO
postings.descriptionText:
En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.

¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!

¿Qué buscamos?

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de Ingenieros/as Junior con ganas de sumarse a un equipo colaborativo que se potencia, para desarrollarse en el rol de Ingeniero/a de Proyectos para la Gerencia de Proyectos Industriales, de la Vicepresidencia de Infraestructura.

¿Cuáles serán tus principales desafíos?



• Participar y desarrollarse progresivamente en la gestión, supervisión, planificación y revisión de los proyectos de diseño y construcción de nuevas instalaciones, ampliaciones y modificaciones de las instalaciones actuales, contribuyendo a prever con suficiente antelación la dotación de recursos requeridos para el cumplimiento de las especificaciones, presupuestos, plan de mejora y mantenimiento, de acuerdo con la legislación y normativas vigentes, las políticas de Seguridad, Calidad, Medio Ambiente y Energía de la Compañía y las directrices de la Unidad de Negocio correspondiente.


• Participar y colaborar en el estudio de las propuestas de proyectos de inversión, contribuyendo a la definición de las especificaciones técnicas y valoraciones económicas de los mismos, a fin de aportar lineamientos e información que contribuyan a la ejecución óptima de los proyectos.


• Participar en la coordinación y seguimiento de las tareas de ingeniería, compras y contratos, inspección y activación, control de costos y control de programación de acuerdo con la estrategia de ejecución del proyecto, desarrollando progresivamente una visión integral del proyecto y de las interfaces entre los distintos involucrados.


• Participar y brindar soporte en la elaboración del Plan de Ejecución del Proyecto, en las fases de ingeniería y ejecución, contribuyendo a que el plan se ajuste a la estrategia y alcance definidos y adquiriendo progresivamente conocimientos sobre la coordinación de las áreas involucradas en su elaboración.


• Participar en el proceso de gestión de riesgos de las distintas fases del proyecto, colaborando en la identificación, evaluación y seguimiento de riesgos y acciones preventivas necesarias para el cumplimiento de los objetivos del proyecto.


• Participar del proceso de estimación económica poniendo a disposición la información requerida para la elaboración de los estimados de costo y plazo, colaborando en el análisis de su consistencia con el alcance y estrategia seleccionada y en el seguimiento de su evolución entre las distintas fases del proyecto.


• Participar y brindar soporte en el proceso de elaboración de pliegos, tanto en la definición del alcance de la contratación como en sus lineamientos contractuales y comerciales; y participar en el proceso de revisión de ofertas y propuestas de adjudicación de contratos y provisiones, realizando la elaboración de los informes correspondientes.


• Participar en grupos de trabajo que abarquen las distintas especialidades del proyecto, generando las reuniones necesarias entre las distintas áreas intervinientes, colaborando en el seguimiento de definiciones, compromisos e interfaces, a fin de contribuir a la alineación de los equipos para el logro del objetivo común.


• Controlar la revisión de la información contenida en los planos de ingeniería, listados de materiales y especificaciones técnicas que aplican a los mismos, con la finalidad de contribuir al desarrollo de una Ingeniería apta para construcción.




¿Qué valoramos como diferencial?



• Formación académica: Ingeniero graduado (excluyente), preferentemente de especialidades vinculadas con proyectos industriales. Se valorará formación o conocimientos iniciales en Gestión de Proyectos.


• Experiencia laboral: hasta 2/3 años de experiencia profesional. Se valorará experiencia inicial, pasantías o prácticas profesionales vinculadas con ingeniería, proyectos, planificación, costos, compras, contratos, construcción u obras industriales.





• Buscamos a una persona con un perfil analítico, proactivo, orientado a resultados, con buenas relaciones interpersonales y ganas de sumarse a un equipo con espíritu colaborativo, interés por aprender y desarrollarse en gestión integral de proyectos y disposición para ampliar progresivamente sus conocimientos hacia distintas disciplinas y negocios.





• Idioma: inglés avanzado, con capacidad para interpretar documentación técnica (valorable).






Información del puesto



• Lugar de trabajo: Microcentro (Bs As)


• Modalidad: 4x1


• Equipo a cargo: No


• Disponibilidad para viajar: si ocasionalmente.

postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

***This is an independent contractor position (Per-Project Basis).

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.

A day in the life:

• Power Digital is looking for a Content Producer to assist in the daily execution of our cross-functional video content needs—including AI-assisted image and video generation—in support of our brand vision and business goals through performance marketing. You will be working in a fast-paced, creative environment that offers an opportunity to be part of building a rapidly growing agency.

Responsibilities:

• Work closely with a team of editors, designers, and ACDs in the execution of all video editing deliverables for your pod and owned accounts

• Collaborate with our Creative & Marketing teams to craft creative & engaging designs/content across various marketing channels

• Create engaging, performance-driven video content to support our creative & marketing efforts

• Collaborate with our Production & Strategy teams to craft both original and iterative ads for various marketing channels, including Instagram, Meta, TikTok, and YouTube

• Leverage AI tools to generate marketing-ready image and video concepts and assets (e.g., concept exploration, storyboards, style frames, cutdowns/variations), translating ideas into on-brand creative that performs

• Use AI to accelerate creative iteration at scale by producing multiple versions for testing (hooks, thumbnails, captions, formats, aspect ratios) while maintaining quality and brand consistency

• Continuously optimize output by applying learnings from performance metrics, external references, and popular trends across social platforms

• Follow department workflows and best practices for project management, project file organization, file naming, etc.

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

• 4+ years of video editing experience (motion graphics a plus)

• Proficient in professional video editing and post-production tools (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, etc.)

• AI-proficient with image and video generation tools and workflows used to create marketing-ready assets and iterations (e.g., Veo, Nano Banana, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Flora, Weavy, Adobe GenAI, and similar platforms)

• Demonstrable video editing ability with a strong portfolio of work examples (including performance-driven creative where possible)

• Deep understanding of digital trends, platform-native best practices, and editing principles (hook-first storytelling, pacing, sound design, typography, etc.)

• Ability to multitask and work toward several milestones on various projects simultaneously

• Creative and innovative thinker with a test-and-learn mindset

• Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• Strong prompt and concept development skills, with the ability to translate a brief into AI-assisted storyboards/style frames and scalable creative variations

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• 100% ownership of post production execution work for assigned account stack

• Brand/QA Pass Rate: 95%+ of deliverables pass internal QA and client brand standards on first submission (or within one revision cycle)

• AI-Assisted Iteration Velocity: Consistently produces multiple high-quality creative variations for testing when requested (e.g., hooks, thumbnails, cutdowns, style frames) while maintaining brand consistency

• Zero (0) Avoidable Errors

• Zero (0) Late Submission

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Output quality meets both internal and client brand standards

• Ability to incorporate AI-generated imagery/video into the creative workflow with strong QA (brand alignment, consistency, compliance/usage rights, and technical specs)

• Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creativity & ability to apply these insights in your work

• Ability to actively communicate and collaborate with Strategists & Production teams across multiple projects to deliver the best possible creative output.

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/ . If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at recruiting@powerdigital.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

postings.title: Growth & Commercial Strategy Senior Consultant
postings.descriptionText:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.

AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.

What you'll do

Are you passionate about a future that exceeds your expectations? Here, at AlixPartners your passion becomes your career. We work in smaller and more senior teams that bring deep industry and functional knowledge to our clients. You will sit shoulder-to-shoulder with clients to address the issues that sit at the top of their agendas - and often become front-page news. 

AlixPartners is expanding its Growth team, within the Performance practice, in Buenos Aires. In this role, you will be delivering growth strategies and commercial excellence outcomes for external clients, working closely with colleagues across geographies.

You will be a part of workstreams that drive top-line growth and EBITDA improvement for clients in industrial, distribution, services, and consumer-facing sectors, across healthy, underperforming, and distressed situations. Typical work includes:

• Price diagnostics, including waterfall and leakage analysis, discount and rebate effectiveness, and price dispersion

• Price strategy and governance, including price architecture, deal approval processes, and price increase programs

• Value-based pricing, elasticity analysis, and customer and product profitability (cost-to-serve)

• Customer segmentation, coverage and channel strategy, and route-to-market redesign

• Distributor and partner management

• Growth opportunity sizing and commercial business cases for clients and PE sponsors

• Sales productivity diagnostics, including territory and account design, sales capacity, and pipeline management and KPIs

• Incentive compensation, sales process, and CRM-enabled sales operations

• Commercial tool selection and implementation support (pricing, CRM, CPQ)

• Marketing spend optimization, customer analytics (segmentation, CLV, churn), and promotion effectiveness

In every area, you will structure problems independently, analyze large commercial and transactional datasets, write client-ready materials, present to senior client stakeholders, and contribute to proposals and business development with US teams.

What you'll need

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, or similar. An MBA or Master’s is preferred.

• +4 years of business experience, including at least 3 years in growth strategy or commercial excellence, gained through one or both of these: consulting experience at a strategy or commercial specialist firm and/or industry experience in a pricing, revenue management, sales strategy, marketing, or commercial excellence function.

• Experience across more than one offering area, for example pricing combined with GTM or salesforce effectiveness is preferred.

• Demonstrated end-to-end delivery of commercial improvement projects, from data and diagnostic through recommendation, implementation, and measured financial impact. Hands-on pricing experience strongly preferred.

•
Strong commercial analytics skills, including advanced Excel, SQL, AI-assisted coding and Databricks

• Ability to produce independently from day one with limited local support, and comfort owning a workstream end to end.

• Experience coaching junior colleagues, and interest in helping grow the Buenos Aires practice is a plus.

• Experience implementing pricing software, CRM, or CPQ tools is a plus.

• Experience in PE portfolio companies, turnarounds, or post-merger commercial integration is a plus.

• Prior experience serving US clients remotely or in a dispersed team is a plus.

• Fully bilingual in Spanish and English, with the ability to lead discussions with US executives and write client-ready materials in English.

• Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems, adapt quickly, and develop practical solutions.

• Ability to synthesize analysis into clear recommendations, balancing strategic thinking with attention to detail.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior audiences and build trusted relationships.

• High energy, adaptability, and ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-stakes, and geographically dispersed team environments.

• Authorization to work in Argentina and travel internationally without restrictions ; willingness to work US business hours and travel to the US and LATAM as needed.

This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities. AlixPartners  is a results-driven global consulting firm that specializes in helping businesses successfully address their most complex and critical challenges. You can learn more about our  Culture   and Career Development opportunities ,

The firm offers market-leading benefits that provide flexible options to support our employee’s needs including health benefits to help prioritise their physical and emotional well-being, time-off policies to help to recharge and financial/ retirement benefits that offer income protection and support long-term planning.

The benefit type and level differ per location.

AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, or disability.

postings.title: Member Sales Manager
postings.descriptionText:
The Role We Need

PadSplit is looking for a Member Sales Manager to build and lead the sales engine that turns prospective renters into PadSplit members. As we grow, we need someone who can increase bookings, improve conversion, and manage the cost of acquiring each member while ensuring our member growth keeps pace with our host growth. This person will own the process, performance, and people responsible for delivering those results.

The Person We Are Looking For

We're looking for a proven sales leader who knows how to build, manage, and scale a high-volume inside sales team. You're equally comfortable developing a repeatable sales process, managing performance through data, and rolling up your sleeves to coach agents and work alongside the team. You're an owner who sets clear expectations, holds people accountable, and isn't afraid to make changes when the results aren't there.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day

• Sales Playbook: Build and continuously improve the member acquisition process, including call scripts, objection handling, follow-up cadences, and lead routing from first contact through move-in.

• Speed to Lead: Establish response-time expectations and lead coverage strategies that ensure prospective members receive timely outreach across the hours and time zones we serve.

• Team Performance: Establish daily and weekly activity and booking targets, maintain a transparent performance scoreboard, and hold agents accountable for delivering results.

• Sales Coaching: Review call recordings, provide actionable feedback, coach agents on specific behaviors, and step in to demonstrate effective selling when needed.

• Conversion Optimization: Analyze lead quality, connection rates, conversion rates, and cost per booking to identify opportunities and continuously improve sales performance.

• Data & Reporting: Establish reliable reporting and attribution across lead sources, agent performance, and bookings while identifying opportunities to automate manual processes.

• Team Development: Hire, train, develop, and manage a high-performing sales team, making timely performance decisions and determining when additional headcount is justified.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Ops, Product, Marketing, Member Experience

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful

• Sales Leadership: 5+ years of experience in inside sales, high-volume outbound sales, or contact center leadership, including at least 2 years managing a team of 15 or more.

• Proven Results: A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets through team performance, with measurable results you can speak to.

• Process Building: Experience building or rebuilding sales cadences, lead routing models, service-level agreements (SLAs), and incentive structures.

• Remote Leadership: Experience managing, developing, and holding distributed, remote, or offshore sales teams accountable.

• Funnel Analytics: Strong understanding of sales funnel metrics, including time to contact, connection rates, conversion rates, and cost per booking, with the ability to translate data into action.

• Coaching Expertise: Experience coaching sales representatives using call recordings, performance data, and specific behavioral feedback.

• Sales Technology: Comfort working with CRMs and sales or support platforms such as HubSpot, Zendesk, or Intercom, building reports, and leveraging tools such as power dialers and sales engagement platforms.

• Ownership & Adaptability: A hands-on, data-driven leadership style, strong communication skills, and the ability to operate in an evolving environment, make decisions quickly, and adjust strategies based on results.

Interview Process:

• Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.

• If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone screen with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.

• If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Revenue Ops Lead for 45 minutes.

• If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Head of Sales for one (1) hour.

• If warranted, the final step would be a video panel interview with key stakeholders at PadSplit for two (2) hours.

• The panel interview will require a candidate to work on a sales assessment where you will showcase your manager skills to the panel for discussion.

• If warranted, then we move to offer!

Compensation

Compensation is based on the role's scope, market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals.

postings.title: Staff Software Engineer, Product/AI
postings.descriptionText:
Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io . We're looking for a staff product engineer — not a generalist who happens to touch frontend and backend, but someone who thinks like a product owner and ships like an engineer.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value

End-to-end ownership

You take on the problems nobody's claimed — the ones that span squads with no obvious owner — and carry them from a fuzzy first conversation to what's actually live. If it touches the customer, it's yours to chase down.

Comfort in ambiguity

Half-formed problems and conflicting signals are your starting material, not a blocker. You define the problem before you solve it, form a point of view on what's worth building, and move without waiting for someone else to de-risk the call.

Customer-first, always

You think from the customer's problem backward, not the codebase forward. Every technical call traces back to what it does for the person on the other end of the message — and you can explain that connection to people who don't write code. Given the choice, you ship the thing that changes their experience, not the thing that's merely elegant.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done"

You retire practices that have outlived their usefulness, including ones you helped build. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion.

Force multiplication

Shipping your part isn't the bar. You bring in the right people before a problem becomes theirs to clean up, and you leave enough behind — docs, patterns, delegation — that the team keeps moving without you in the room.

What You'll Do

• Own important, ambiguous problems from initial framing through launch and iteration. Set direction, align partners, and stay accountable for the result.

• Partner with product, design, and data to shape priorities, scope the work, and define how success will be measured.

• Lead technical decisions across the stack, including architecture, performance, reliability, and maintainability.

• Lead work across teams and systems. Build alignment, resolve technical disagreements, and keep complex initiatives moving.

• Improve engineering practices through mentorship, reusable patterns, and clear technical guidance.

• Use AI throughout your engineering work, with sound judgment about where it helps, where it falls short, and how its output should be reviewed. Help the team improve by testing new workflows, sharing what works, and identifying useful opportunities for automation.

• Participate in an on-call rotation as required, supporting the systems the team builds.

What we're looking for

• A track record of leading complex work across teams or systems and delivering meaningful customer, business, or engineering outcomes.

• Strong backend engineering experience, with the ability to work across the stack and lead end-to-end technical decisions.

• Strong product and technical judgment, especially when the problem or path forward is unclear.

• The ability to influence experienced peers and align teams without formal authority.

• Experience using metrics, experimentation, and observability to guide decisions and improve production systems.

• Regular, hands-on use of AI across the software development lifecycle, with the judgment to adapt as tools change while remaining accountable for quality, security, and outcomes. Experience improving how a broader team uses AI is a strong plus.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $200,000 - $280,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. This role also carries a 10% annual bonus target. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• Application - We review everyone with care. Tell us why you're interested.

• Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let's chat about what you're looking for and how we work.

• Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Talk with one of our hiring managers about your working style and a product you've owned end-to-end, plus a short AI-assisted coding exercise.

• System Design Interview (60 mins) - A collaborative conversation that moves between product tradeoffs and system design — how you'd scope something ambiguous and how you'd build it.

• Take-Home Assignment - Complete a short, realistic task similar to what you'd work on here.

• Assignment Review Call (60 mins) - Walk us through your work and discuss tradeoffs, priorities, and how you'd iterate.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io .

Join us!

We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read and want to build software that makes communication better for everyone—apply now.

postings.title: Bookkeeper & AR Specialist | Marketing Agency | Remote (LATAM) 📊
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview
Our client is a newsletter growth agency. It runs paid Meta ads for newsletter and media brands, large personal brands and founders, and turns readers into revenue. Fees partly move with ad spend and contract terms. The founder launched it in early 2024, and it has grown from 0 to 30+ people in two years. The founder writes tactical posts and hosts a podcast. The team works remotely, and you'd talk with the founder and your manager on calls and in the finance channel on Slack.

Your Role
You're the person who gets the company paid. You own client invoicing, collections and the books in QuickBooks Online, working fully remote on US Eastern hours as a full-time contractor, reporting to the Operations Manager. The company went from 0 to 30+ people in two years, few finance steps are written down, and no senior finance person checks the work every day. So you run the whole loop and write the procedures as they settle. You start with the daily Mercury and Stripe check and the 4-week invoice cycle. The hardest balance is speed against accuracy: invoices go out on time, and the variable fees in them are calculated and checked before a client sees them. Get that right and cash arrives on schedule, the books close clean for the accountant or CPA, and the founder can trust the numbers.

What You'll Own

• Run Stripe invoicing every 4 weeks, in advance, so each client gets a correct bill on time.

• Work out variable fees from the contract and the ad spend report so every amount is right before it goes out.

• Chase late payments every 3 working days and escalate quiet clients so cash comes in sooner.

• Apply each incoming payment to the right invoice and keep the AR aging report current so the team sees who owes what.

• Keep the QuickBooks Online books, reconcile bank, credit card, AR and AP, and run the monthly close so the outside accountant or CPA reviews clean numbers.

• Set up new clients in Stripe, prepare final bills for leavers and support DocuSign contract admin so billing starts and ends cleanly.

• Write down finance steps and maintain the trackers so the team can rely on them and the next hire can follow them.

A Week in the Role

• You open Mercury and Stripe early and spot a failed charge and a renewal coming up. You post both in the start of day update on Slack, so the team knows what needs chasing.

• A client is 3 working days past your last reminder. You send the next one from the shared AR mailbox, in the same thread, and add a dated note to the billing sheet. If the client goes quiet, you escalate.

• A client on a variable fee comes due. You read the contract, pull the ad spend report, work out the fee and check it before sending. The invoice goes out right the first time.

• A payment arrives that doesn't match its invoice. You trace it through the invoice, the payment and the bank line, then post what you found in the finance channel.

• A new client signs. You create the payment link and subscription in Stripe and write down their billing terms, so the first invoice and every one after it use the same facts.

• At month end you reconcile the bank and credit card accounts, close the books and hand them to the accountant or CPA. You write down any step you had to figure out along the way.

You Bring

• A bachelor's degree in accounting or a related field, and three or 3 years in bookkeeping, billing or accounts receivable, including billing or collecting for dozens of active clients.

• Experience running the full billing-to-cash cycle for recurring clients: sending invoices, tracking them on an AR aging report, chasing late payers, applying payments and reconciling.

• Invoices you calculated from ad spend, usage or contract terms.

• Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online (bank and credit card reconciliation, chart of accounts, AR and AP) and Excel, including a billing tracker you built or maintained.

• A billing sheet, tracker or aging report that other people used, kept current with a date and the action taken on each entry.

• Collections on a schedule with a set point for escalating, and a mismatch between an invoice, a payment and a bank line that you traced to its source.

• Clear written and spoken English for client emails, daily updates and calls with the founder and your manager.

Bonus Points

• Stripe for subscriptions, payment links and failed charges.

•
Mercury or another online business bank.

• Invoicing in USD or work with US clients.

•
Multi-currency bank reconciliation.

What's Offered

• What we'd estimate for a role like this: 1,000 to 1,500 USD a month, based on experience.

• Fully remote from Latin America, on US Eastern hours.

•
Paid time off

Interview Process
1. First call: 30 minutes with us at atomic HR on what you have built, working terms and what you want next.
2. First interview: a conversation with the Operations Manager, who would be your manager, on how you have run invoicing, collections and month-end, and how the day-to-day of the seat would go.
3. Short practical test: a task drawn from the seat's own work, done on your own time. It checks that the amounts come out right and that you show how you got to them. We confirm the format and rough time before you start.
4. Call with the founder: a conversation on how you would work together on cash collection and the numbers, and on any questions you have about the company.

Learn more at

Solution Leadership & Delivery

Data Migration & Mapping

Stakeholder & Project Management

Integration & Cross‑Module Alignment

6+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting SuccessFactors Employee Central .

postings.title: Software Product Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Job Overview:
Work from home! We will teach you everything you need to know in this role.
Are you looking for a high tech challenge but also to have some fun and work with cool, genuine and super smart people? Headquartered in beautiful Bend, Oregon, RecruitingDash () is the largest provider of services and proprietary software for Oracle Taleo Business Edition (TBE) - a recruiting system that thousands of companies worldwide use.
In addition to our very successful market leading Taleo Consulting practice, RecruitingDash sells our proprietary Taleo metrics, reporting and analytics dashboard software as a service (SaaS) technology, and our Taleo Inbox product, to customers worldwide.
We are launching our third software product in 2023 which will also take our product and services to new platforms beyond the Taleo recruiting system market - it's an exciting time for us!

This is where you come in:
We are looking for a smart, hard-working, well-spoken individual with great presentation skills that we can train in every aspect of product management. We have had a great track record of success teaching smart and hard working people to be successful at our company. A recent college graduate seeking to learn all aspects of software product management may be an ideal fit.
As the RecruitingDash Product Manager, you will work closely with our CTO, founder, and head of software development to manage RecruitingDash 's existing software products (ReportingDash and Taleo Inbox) as well as participate in every aspect of the design, development, testing and go to market of new software products which are currently in the earliest stages of product development.
Almost all of the skills for this position you will learn on the job by working closely with the founders of RecruitingDash . The incumbent who served in this role for over 9 years was able to learn the necessary skills to be successful through time in this position, and was instrumental in launching our two existing, very successful, SaaS software products. Therefore, we know that this role is a perfect fit for someone who wants to learn new skills, understand on a deep level how software works and is designed, developed, tested and brought to market, and someone who thrives on solving tough problems, being intellectually challenged and working hard.
Oversee and Manage NEW Software Product Development in Collaboration with the RecruitingDash Chief Technology Officer
The RecruitingDash Product Manager is responsible for the success of our software products - this is both a strategic and tactical role. If you have an interest in learning every aspect of software product management, from defining specifications to development through testing and launch, this is the role for you.

• Drive the product and business-planning process through the software product development lifecycle

• Use an iterative process and customer discovery best practices to analyze customer needs and translate them into prioritized product features and benefits

• Assess current competitor offerings, seeking opportunities for differentiation

• Develop, implement, and maintain production, testing, and go-to-market timelines across multiple disciplines such as software development, customer discovery, beta testing, product testing, marketing, product release/go-to-market activities and customer support

• Develop the new customer onboarding and implementation protocols, process, tools and procedures

• Develop product positioning and messaging to be used comprehensively for the new product, such as on mico-websites, in sales and marketing collateral, and other marketing channels.

• Execute post launch marketing activities to support sales efforts

• Manage bug escalations, customer feedback, and feature requests as required

• Partner with the RecruitingDash sale team to support their efforts in selling the product(s)

• Develop and drive the documentation process for any new product(s)

• Design, develop and implement customer support operations as the customer base for the new product(s) grows

Oversee and Manage the Portfolio of EXISTING RecruitingDash Software Products

• Become an expert in both ReportingDash and Taleo Inbox products so that you:

• Have a broad overview of how each of the products work technically

• May effectively onboard and implement the SaaS products for new customers and provide basic sales support to the RecruitingDash sales executives who continue to sell the products

• Assist with overseeing comprehensive customer support for the existing portfolio of SaaS software products

• Provide day to day product management for exception handling and escalations, with our CTO and Co-founder as the escalation point

•
RecruitingDash continues to do development for these products so there is a small amount of time focused on the following:

• Managing, exploring and validating existing customer feature requests

• Writing up JIRA issues, which is our bug and issues management system, for bug fixes and new releases/feature ideas

• Doing regression testing for new releases / features

• Provide "State of the Union" overviews of each of the existing products, periodically and as needed to the RecruitingDash founders

What We're Looking For...

• Smart people, who have a penchant for learning something every day.

• Problem solver.

• A self-motivated results-driven go-getter that works hard.

• Demonstrated success at a top college with an undergraduate degree.

• Highly effective communication skills are required to interface with high-level client executives and the RecruitingDash founders.

• Excellent presentation skills.

• Highly organized with strong project management skills.

• Previous knowledge of recruitment & HR or software development is a bonus, but not required.

• Flexibility - we go the extra mile for our customers, who are located all over the world (at times this may not be a 9 to 5 job).

What Will Grab Our Attention...

• College degree from a top tier school is strongly preferred.

• Initiative - we will give you as much responsibility as you can handle.

• Problem solving & practical thinking - every customer and technology system is unique, and we often have to get creative to craft the right solution to a particular problem.

• Attention to detail.

• Strong writing and grammar skills.

• Strong project management skills.

• Self-direction - we all work hard to get stuff done and be efficient without micro-management.

• Planning & organizing skills galore.

• Personal learning - "Never make the same mistake twice..."

• Customer focus - you gain personal satisfaction from turning customers into raving fans.

• Great judgment & common sense - you make the right call at the right time.

• Calm under pressure - we are growing fast - at times it can be crazy.

• Drive for results - you love to deliver, on time, even when it's tough.

Working at RecruitingDash ...
RecruitingDash is one of the most innovative recruiting technology companies in the industry. Get ready to learn, build, teach and grow fromanywhere in the worldwith the Dashers where our teamwork creates value beyond the sum of our parts.

•
RecruitingDash is a completely remote company – work out of your home, a hotel, or a beach, anywhere you have internet and a phone!

• We seek to continually simply and improve processes, procedures and activities.

• We always deliver the best solution.

• We treat everyone with respect and dignityat all times.

• We always do the right thing.

Trust | Humility | Ethics | Hunger | Education | Accountability | Respect | Teamwork

postings.descriptionText:
About us:
At Amber, we're always on the hunt for the most talented individuals in the industry to join our team. We're dedicated to delivering top-notch service to our customers and know that our employees are key to making that happen. We offer attractive compensation packages and plenty of chances to grow with us, and we're always on the lookout for ways to do things better. Our team works together towards common goals and we value each member's contributions to our mission of continuous improvement and innovation.

About the role:
Amber is looking for a UX Designer to help bring a high-quality AA Unreal Engine 5 game to a cloud streaming platform. It's a large narrative game, built on one of the most recognized entertainment franchises.
The story and content are locked. Your job is to adapt UX/UI and controls. The goal is a game that's easy to pick up and keeps its pacing. The core direction is only prototyped, and many open problems remain. You'll work alongside UX designers, engineers, tech artists, QAs, and producers. This is a hands-on role: mapping, wireframes, and specs, delivered at volume and largely on your own.
This is a remote contract engagement, expected to run about 2 months, with a possible extension. You'll need to be productive within your first week. Preferred working hours are 7am-4pm Mexico City time. European candidates should overlap with a minimum of 7am-12pm Mexico City time.

At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse.
What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities):

• 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space.

The Role We Need

PadSplit is looking for a Member Sales Manager to build and lead the sales engine that turns prospective renters into PadSplit members. We're looking for a proven sales leader who knows how to build, manage, and scale a high-volume inside sales team. You're equally comfortable developing a repeatable sales process, managing performance through data, and rolling up your sleeves to coach agents and work alongside the team. You're an owner who sets clear expectations, holds people accountable, and isn't afraid to make changes when the results aren't there.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day

•
Sales Playbook: Build and continuously improve the member acquisition process, including call scripts, objection handling, follow-up cadences, and lead routing from first contact through move-in.

•
Speed to Lead: Establish response-time expectations and lead coverage strategies that ensure prospective members receive timely outreach across the hours and time zones we serve.

•
Team Performance: Establish daily and weekly activity and booking targets, maintain a transparent performance scoreboard, and hold agents accountable for delivering results.

•
Sales Coaching: Review call recordings, provide actionable feedback, coach agents on specific behaviors, and step in to demonstrate effective selling when needed.

•
Conversion Optimization: Analyze lead quality, connection rates, conversion rates, and cost per booking to identify opportunities and continuously improve sales performance.

•
Data & Reporting: Establish reliable reporting and attribution across lead sources, agent performance, and bookings while identifying opportunities to automate manual processes.

•
Team Development: Hire, train, develop, and manage a high-performing sales team, making timely performance decisions and determining when additional headcount is justified.

•
Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Ops, Product, Marketing, Member Experience

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful

•
Sales Leadership: 5+ years of experience in inside sales, high-volume outbound sales, or contact center leadership, including at least 2 years managing a team of 15 or more.

•
Proven Results: A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets through team performance, with measurable results you can speak to.

•
Process Building: Experience building or rebuilding sales cadences, lead routing models, service-level agreements (SLAs), and incentive structures.

•
Remote Leadership: Experience managing, developing, and holding distributed, remote, or offshore sales teams accountable.

•
Funnel Analytics: Strong understanding of sales funnel metrics, including time to contact, connection rates, conversion rates, and cost per booking, with the ability to translate data into action.

•
Coaching Expertise: Experience coaching sales representatives using call recordings, performance data, and specific behavioral feedback.

•
Sales Technology: Comfort working with CRMs and sales or support platforms such as HubSpot, Zendesk, or Intercom, building reports, and leveraging tools such as power dialers and sales engagement platforms.

•
Ownership & Adaptability: A hands-on, data-driven leadership style, strong communication skills, and the ability to operate in an evolving environment, make decisions quickly, and adjust strategies based on results.

Interview Process:

• Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.

• If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone screen with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.

• If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Revenue Ops Lead for 45 minutes.

• If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Head of Sales for one (1) hour.

• If warranted, the final step would be a video panel interview with key stakeholders at PadSplit for two (2) hours.

• The panel interview will require a candidate to work on a sales assessment where you will showcase your manager skills to the panel for discussion.

• If warranted, then we move to offer!

What You Will Be Doing

Build the Platform

• Build one governed front door for every lead, whatever the source — web forms, My OPSWAT , webinars, field events, partner and list imports — so each lead is validated, de-duplicated, consented and enriched once, at the gate, and nothing reaches the CRM or the data spine any other way.

• Build AI-native lead qualification: a model that reads fit and engagement across every signal we hold — product usage in My OPSWAT , Academy progress, web behavior, intent, firmographics — ranks the whole database with real resolution, explains every score in plain language, and learns from what SDRs actually convert.

• Build intelligent lead routing: the right lead to the right rep at the right moment, with territory, capacity, availability and priority held as data that Marketing Operations can shape and preview themselves, and a decision record behind every assignment so anyone can see why a lead went where it did.

• Make every hand-off dependable: each lead tracked from capture to first touch, stalls surfaced automatically, every priority tier followed up, and nothing lost between systems.

• Give Marketing Operations a self-service campaign layer: per-campaign behavior — routing, priority, nurture — configured in minutes with a preview of what it would have done to yesterday's leads, so new campaigns stop requiring new workflows and old overrides expire on their own.

• Build the platform AI-native from day one: expose its data and actions through an MCP server so OPSWAT 's internal agents and assistants can look up a lead, explain a routing decision, or trigger a campaign action in natural language — and design every capability so an agent can use it as readily as a person can.

• Make consent and suppression a single source of truth, enforced at the gate and impossible to bypass, and stream every signal and every decision into OPSWAT Data Master so marketing, product and sales data finally join in one place.

• Build the seams to SugarCRM, the email service provider, visitor identification, enrichment and My OPSWAT so that a failure in any one of them is contained, retried and visible — never silent, never lossy.

• Leveraging OPSWAT Agentic SDLC — use the Platform team's agentic coding platform as your primary means of production, own the quality and security of what ships, and document the system as you go so it stays knowable.

Keep HubSpot Running Through the Transition

• Own the health of HubSpot's existing integrations until each one is retired: the SugarCRM sync through the Sugar Data Tool, Salesloft, the My OPSWAT feed (portal and Academy), 6sense enrichment, web forms and the Forms API.

• Triage and resolve integration incidents across HubSpot and its neighbors — root-cause them, fix them permanently, and write down what happened.

• Make safe, minimal changes in HubSpot when the business needs them, and hold the line against new workflow and list sediment that the migration would only have to unwind.

• Build the Forms Gateway pull-forward so website capture decouples from HubSpot early, and run the interim enrollment connector that keeps Salesloft working through cutover.

• Reconcile HubSpot and platform data continuously during the parallel run so drift is caught long before a cutover gate.

What We Need From You

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 6+ years building and operating production backend systems, with at least 3 in Python

• Demonstrated, recent, daily practice building software with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agent mode, Codex or similar). You can show us the workflow, the review and test loop, and something real that shipped through it.

• Production support of a marketing automation platform's integrations — HubSpot strongly preferred; Marketo or Pardot considered — including its APIs, its data model, and its sync to a CRM. You have kept one of these healthy while other things changed around it.

• Production experience with event-driven and durable-execution patterns: message queues, outboxes, idempotency keys, replay. Temporal or a comparable workflow engine strongly preferred.

• Hands-on integration engineering against real vendor APIs — REST, webhooks, OAuth 2.0, rate limits, retries — built and operated, not configured through a wizard.

• PostgreSQL to a strong level: schema design, JSONB, partitioning, migrations with Alembic, and query performance work you can describe.

• Cloud deployment on Azure or AWS: containers, infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep), CI/CD with GitHub Actions, secrets management, observability.

• Experience shipping LLM features into a product: structured outputs, evaluation discipline, confidence thresholds, fallbacks and guardrails — consuming a provided model gateway rather than building the infrastructure.

• Excellent written and spoken English, and the skill to explain a technical trade-off to a marketing operations lead in their terms.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

• SugarCRM logic hooks and REST API, or another CRM's server-side extension model; Salesforce Apex or triggers transferable.

• Marketing technology domain knowledge: lead scoring and routing, consent and suppression, deliverability and ESP warm-up, campaign attribution.

postings.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Consumer / New Verticals
postings.descriptionText:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is building the payment layer for life's financial obligations, giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By offering greater choice over how and when payments are made and allowing eligible on time payments to help build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow.

That work brings together people with different perspectives who challenge the status quo and take ownership of solving difficult problems. For you, that means doing the best work of your career next to people who make you better, and together bringing ideas to life that make a real impact for the people we serve.

About the Job
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC-headquartered FinTech company building the payment layer for life’s financial obligations—giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By giving people greater choice over how and when they pay, and helping eligible on-time payments build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow.
Building on our roots in rent, we’re expanding into a broader consumer bill management platform that helps people manage essential spend and align payments with their finances. Our Consumer engineering team within the New Verticals division is at the forefront of this expansion, building a new business line within Flex . We’re looking for motivated leaders who thrive in ambiguity, turn new ideas into products, and help shape how millions of people manage their financial lives. About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineering Manager to own consumer engineering teams within the New Verticals division. These teams partner closely with the product and the business to deliver high quality and delightful user experiences and the systems that power them.
You will own multiple workstreams that tie directly to critical business KPIs. You will work closely with product managers to drive delivery of their workstreams with your team of highly adaptable, AI-enabled engineers who reside in the Consumer organization but range across the entire Flex system as necessary.
You will serve as a key technical partner to Product, business leadership, and cross-functional teams (such as Lifecycle Marketing (LCM), Legal & Compliance, and Risk) to drive outcomes across your workstreams. You will also represent Consumer engineering and New Verticals in Flex -wide architecture and quality initiatives, ensuring we build solutions that scale across Flex as a whole.

Our Engineering Teams

• Consumer Engineering: Builds the APIs and backend systems powering Flex ’s consumer-facing mobile and web apps. This team focuses on delivering high quality, delightful and trustful customer experiences.

• Partner Integrations Engineering: Owns the backend services and integrations that connect Flex to financial partners and payment networks, ensuring secure, reliable payment flows and partner-facing experiences.

• Core Platform Engineering: Maintains the backend services and infrastructure supporting all business features, including Payments, Ledger, Identity, and Settlement, providing the foundation for all of Flex ’s products.

What You’ll Do

Technical Leadership

• Define and execute the consumer architecture supporting New Verticals’ expansion into essential spend.

• Partner with engineering leaders across Flex to align technical decisions, reuse shared capabilities, and build systems that scale across business divisions.

• Guide design reviews and make high-impact technical decisions, balancing speed of experimentation with long-term maintainability.

• Ensure reliability, data integrity, and financial correctness across consumer workflows.

Execution & Delivery

• Partner with Product and business leadership to shape initiatives and connect engineering investments to customer value and business outcomes.

• Lead large, ambiguous projects from early exploration through launch and scale.

• Coordinate cross-team dependencies and resolve blockers regardless of team.

• Establish feedback loops that help the team learn from customer behavior, iterate quickly, and scale successful products.

People Leadership

• Manage, mentor, and grow a team of engineers.

• Establish strong ownership of customer outcomes, engineering quality, and operational excellence.

• Hire and develop senior engineers and future technical lead

• Elevate testing discipline and design rigor while helping the team navigate the uncertainty of building a new business line.

Operational Ownership

• Own the production health and reliability of the team’s consumer services.

• Improve observability, scalability, and incident response a

• Partner with Risk, Compliance, and platform teams to build safeguards into customer-facing financial workflows.

• Ensure new capabilities launch with clear operational ownership, monitoring, and support readiness.

Who You Are
Beyond the qualifications below, you are a generalist, enabler, and problem solver who leads through engineering management. High ownership and drive are your default. When a problem falls between teams or disciplines, you help find a path forward. You pair strong customer empathy with deep technical knowledge. You translate business strategy into execution and contribute meaningfully in design reviews. You develop excellent engineers and build strong teams, but don’t shy away from opening a PR yourself.

• 8+ years of software engineering experience spanning frontend and backend systems, and 3+ years managing engineers.

• Experience building and scaling consumer-facing products and the APIs and backend systems that power them.

• Strong product judgment and a track record of partnering with business and product leaders to delivery .

• Experience leading ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from early definition through launch and iteration.

• Strong understanding of distributed systems, service architecture, reliability, and data integrity.

• Experience owning production services with high standards for uptime, correctness, and operational readiness.

• A track record of growing engineers, developing technical l with strong ownership and accountability.

• Ability to influence technical direction across teams and balance the needs of a new business line with shared company-wide capabilities.

Preferred

• Experience building or operating consumer fintech, payments, banking, or lending products.

• Experience launching a new product or business line from early experimentation through adoption and scale.

• Familiarity with customer onboarding, bill management, payment workflows, or other consumer financial experiences.

• Experience using product analytics and experimentation to i, engagement, or retention.

• Experience partnering with Risk and Compliance teams in a regulated environment.

• Background scaling high-growth consumer platforms.

Compensation

Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, and compensation may vary depending on your primary work location. Work locations are categorized into one of three tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be commensurate with their experience, qualifications, and Flex ’s internal leveling guidelines and benchmarks.

Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle)

$240,000—$300,000 USD

Tier 2 (Austin, Washington D.C. Philadelphia, San Diego, Chicago, Atlanta)

$216,000—$270,000 USD

Tier 3 (Salt Lake City, all other USA cities)

$200,000—$255,000 USD

Life at Flex

Building a successful company takes a diverse team of intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self-aware people. Our headquarters is in New York City, with employees across the US, Australia, Canada, and South America. We’re growing quickly and deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. We value the perspectives our people bring and take pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

View our benefits and more at getflex.com/careers.
