ISO Manager, InfoSec Solutions

Working at Thoropass

At Thoropass , we are revolutionizing the compliance and audit industry by integrating cutting-edge AI technology with expert human insight. Our team is dedicated to delivering
exceptional customer experiences and high-quality outcomes.
We’re driven by our mission to build a world that’s safer for consumers and ensuring compliance is never a blocker to innovation. By bringing together remarkably talented individuals, we’re looking to help the industry see compliance as an advantage. Join us as we collaborate to establish our platform as the world's leading choice for compliance and audit solutions.

Our Values
These are the behaviors and skills we look for in our people. Living by these values ensures we are building a team that can grow together and deliver the best possible outcomes for each other and our customers.
Take thoughtful risk: We solve for today while being considerate of tomorrow—creatively leveraging our tools and abilities to hit ambitious goals.
Be curious, ask, and learn: We always seek to better understand our industry and our customers. We don’t shy away from mistakes—using every bit of data to learn and iterate.
Win together: Compliance is a team sport. We proactively engage with one another and check our egos at the door in search of the best ideas.
Move the needle: Our goals are lofty for a reason. We set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and challenge ourselves to close the gap between those goals and results.

What We Do
Thoropass is transforming the landscape of security compliance and audits. As the only all-in-one platform that combines compliance automation software with a tech-enabled audit firm and pentest services, we offer a modern approach to information security compliance and audit. Our AI-powered solutions, such as First Pass AI, are designed to streamline compliance and accelerate audits for frameworks like SOC, PCI, ISO, HITRUST, HIPAA, and more. Thousands of companies trust Thoropass for high-quality audit and assessment services, delighting in a truly differentiated experience.
Founded in 2019 and headquartered in New York, Thoropass has rapidly expanded with $97M in funding from top investors including J.P. Morgan, PayPal Ventures, Fin Capital, Centana, Canapi, and Bain Capital. We operate as a virtual, global company with a presence in over 18 countries. With substantial growth in both customers and revenue, we are strategically positioned for continued expansion in 2025 and beyond.

About the Role
Forget everything you think you know about information security auditing. We’re on a mission to reinvent the outdated, clunky audit process—and we’re doing it with cutting-edge AI, automation, and a relentless commitment to customer success.
At Thoropass , auditing isn’t about manually sifting through endless evidence or checking boxes—it’s about solving complex security problems for our customers in smarter, faster, and more innovative ways. Investments in our AI-powered auditor tech stack and industry leading audit process, are designed to support you and drive efficiency in your work so you can focus on what matters the most.
As a Manager, InfoSec Solutions , you’ll own a portfolio of accounts, manage a high-performing team, and help shape the future of audit technology. In this role, you’ll not only ensure the delivery of exceptional ISO audits for emerging technology companies but also collaborate directly with our Labs team to advance our AI-powered audit engine.
This isn’t your typical audit job—it’s a chance to lead innovation, tackle complex challenges, and make a lasting impact on the industry.

What You'll Do
In this role, you’ll combine your audit expertise with a drive for innovation to execute audits at scale and advance our cutting-edge technology.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

•
Deliver World-Class Audits: Oversee the performance of ISO audits and ensure the accuracy, quality, and timely delivery of audit reports.

•
Lead and Mentor: Manage a team of junior to mid level auditors, fostering a culture of innovation, excellence, and customer focus.

•
Drive Efficiency: Execute and iterate processes that make it possible to perform ISO audits at scale without sacrificing quality.

•
Enhance Customer Experience: Collaborate cross-functionally to improve the integrated audit experience for customers, making audits more seamless and insightful.

•
Be a Thought Leader: Provide expert guidance on information security and ISO standards, while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation.

Skillsets/ Requirements
You’re not just an auditor—you’re a problem solver, innovator, and leader who thrives in a fast-paced, tech-forward environment.
Here’s what makes you a perfect fit for this role:

•
ISO Expertise: Deep expertise in ISO reporting standards (ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001 etc), with 7+ years of experience performing ISO audits in an audit or consulting firm.

•
Technology Enthusiast: Familiarity with advanced cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure) and a passion for leveraging technology to solve problems.

•
Collaborative Leader: Proven ability to manage and mentor a team, while working cross-functionally to achieve big-picture goals.

•

postings.title: Strategic WFM Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

Role Overview

The Strategic WFM Analyst lives in the Core Workforce Management (WFM) Planning & Operations Strategy team and is responsible for owning centralized forecast, capacity planning, workforce cost optimization, and strategic headcount trade-offs across all lines of business (LOBs). Moving beyond traditional scheduling and intraday monitoring, this role acts as a high-judgment governance function, translating complex demand forecasts into defensible FTE, BPO, and overtime spend strategies, modelling capacity risks, and aligning executive stakeholders across Finance, Product, and Operations. You are exceptionally strong in WFM maths and financial analytics, exhibit deep strategic curiosity, navigate messy raw data effortlessly, and communicate recommendations with executive-level clarity.

What You’ll Do

•
Translating multi-LOB demand forecasts into monthly and quarterly capacity, headcount, and budget requirements.

•
Modelling workforce and financial trade-offs across internal FTEs, BPO partners, overtime spend, bonus hours, productivity shifts, and shrinkage.

•
Analyzing demand-funnel changes (e.g., product feature roll outs, AI bot deflection shifts) and quantifying their exact capacity and dollar blast radius.

•
Partnering directly with Finance, Product, and Operations to validate baseline assumptions, enforce input SLAs, and align on staffing commitments.

•
Drafting concise, decision-ready executive memos and Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) for Directors and leadership.

•
Conducting deep-dive root-cause analyses whenever operational actuals deviate from capacity plans and establishing corrective action paths.

•
Standardizing capacity planning frameworks, modeling templates, and operating standards across LOBs.

•
Maintaining deep forecasting competency to audit models, challenge underlying assumptions, and provide seamless coverage across the broader central WFM engine.

What We’re Looking For

•
Strategic WFM Maths: Exceptionally strong quantitative background with deep expertise in WFM fundamentals (capacity modelling, Erlang, shrinkage, AHT, SLA/ASA trade-offs) and advanced proficiency in Google Sheets, SQL, or Python.

•
Business & Financial Judgement: Demonstrated ability to connect operational queue dynamics directly to dollar exposure, hiring velocity, BPO costs, and SLA risk.

•
Executive Communication: Superior strategic writing skills with a natural instinct to distil complex, multi-variable workforce analytics into scannable, 1-2 page decision memos.

•
Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to establish governance frameworks, challenge bad assumptions with back tested data, and align Finance, Product, and Operations leadership without formal authority.

•
Blank-Page Ownership: High comfort operating in ambiguous environments with incomplete data, verifiably isolating what materially matters without requiring step-by-step direction.

•
WFM Analyst Profile: Strong core WFM domain expertise with a strategic/Ops spike, not a generalist and not a passive traditional scheduler.

Hiring Process

•
Application

•
Diagnostic Case Study

•
Case Study Interview - Technical & Capacity Interview

•
Executive Judgement & Strategic Interview

•
Culture Interview (People Ops)

•
Offer

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here .

postings.title: Billing Representative
postings.descriptionText:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role

The Collections team under Billing is responsible for collecting payments from workplaces (e.g., healthcare facilities). The Billing Representative (BR) is responsible for ensuring that the assigned workplaces pay their invoices quickly and on time. Cash is the lifeline of any company. This is a very critical role to ensure that the cash flows for the company are smooth. The BR will reach out to the workplaces through phone and email to follow up on payments, get a commitment of payment ("promise to pay"), and ensure that the workplaces honor these commitments. The BR will work with the workplaces and the respective internal teams to ensure any roadblocks in collecting the payments are removed. The role will require cross-functional collaboration with Billing Disputes, Sales, Customer Support, and other teams to achieve the desired goals.

Responsibilities

•
Monitor accounts to identify outstanding debts.

•
Call and email accounts payable contacts, administrators, and others as needed to ask about their overdue payments and upcoming dues.

•
Build relationships with workplaces (e.g., properly set expectations about our billing policy, explain NET & Dispute Terms, etc.).

•
Identify the root cause of non-payment and resolve billing concerns.

•
Report on collections updates and accounts receivable status.

•
Identify critical accounts and devise SMART action plans to address issues.

Requirements and Skills

General

•
Professional and clear communication (verbal and written).

•
High attention to detail.

•
Receptive to feedback (highly coachable).

•
Preferred: experience with Google Drive suite, Slack, Salesforce, soft phone software like Amazon Connect.

Technical

•
Comfortable with math and data (e.g., calculating payment plan instalments).

•
Ability to build relationships with customers.

•
Strong judgment in customer-facing decisions and live interactions.

•
Negotiating skills.

Qualifications

•
Open to candidates of all experience levels—what matters most is your ability to handle business customers professionally and solve problems effectively.

•
No specific degree required—we care about what you can do, not just what’s on your résumé.

Why Join Clipboard?

•
100% Remote. Work from anywhere in the world.

•
Fast-Paced Startup Environment. Join a company that values curiosity, independence, and growth.

•
A hiring process that rewards skills, not just experience. Every applicant gets a fair shot—our selection is based on real-world problem-solving ability, not just credentials.

•
Opportunity to make a significant impact with our workplace customers.

System Requirements

To succeed in this role, you must have:

•
A reliable laptop/desktop (no Chromebooks or Linux OS).

•
Minimum 20 Mbps wired internet connection.

•
Wired headset for clear communication.

•
A quiet, distraction-free workspace.

•
Stable power and internet connectivity.

Hiring process

•
Application form: This includes basic billing rep skill-based questions. Some questions result in automatic rejection, so please approach these with diligence as they assess your ability to handle real problems and client situations.

•
Case Study: Collections scenarios (identifying at-risk accounts, action plans, email writing)

•
Interview 1: Collections simulation

•
Interview 2: Collections simulation

•
Offer

You will receive an email with the next steps in the process within 2 days of your application. Please check your spam folder! If you don’t see the email, make sure it hasn’t been filtered out or blocked.

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here .

postings.title: Creative Director
postings.descriptionText:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.
This role will own the complete creative direction of the brand across paid advertising, website and landing pages, email, organic social media, marketplaces, product launches, and other customer-facing channels.
The Creative Director will be responsible not only for maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity, but also for improving commercial performance. The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Key Outcomes

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

• Develop creative strategies that improve conversion across paid media, websites, product pages, marketplaces, and email.

• Turn customer insights, performance data, and competitor research into clear briefs and testable concepts.

• Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.

• Establish a structured process for creative testing and optimisation.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

• Own creative strategy across paid social, video, display, and other acquisition channels.

• Build a consistent pipeline of concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and formats.

• Ensure sufficient creative volume and variation for testing and scaling.

• Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.

• Balance direct-response effectiveness with strong brand presentation.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

• Lead creative direction across the website, landing pages, collection pages, and product pages.

• Improve how product benefits, differentiation, use cases, and customer proof are communicated.

• Create clear visual and messaging hierarchies that make pages more persuasive.

• Collaborate with ecommerce, UX, development, copywriting, and CRO teams on improvements and testing.

• Ensure consistency between advertising and onsite customer experience.

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

• Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.

• Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.

• Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.

• Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.

• Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

• Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.

• Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.

• Provide constructive feedback and support team development.

• Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.

• Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

• Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.

• Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.

• Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.

• Maintain an organised creative asset library.

• Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.

• Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

• Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.

• Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.

• Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.

• Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.

• Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

• Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.

• Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.

• Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.

• Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.

• Review and approve high-priority creative assets.

• Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.

• Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.

• Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.

• Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.

• Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.

• Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

• Website and landing-page conversion rate.

• Product-page conversion rate.

• Advertising creative performance.

• Customer acquisition cost.

• Return on advertising spend.

• Click-through rate and hook rate.

• Creative testing volume and testing velocity.

• Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.

• Revenue generated from new creative concepts.

• Email engagement and conversion performance.

• On-time completion of creative projects.

• Creative production efficiency.

• Brand consistency and quality across channels.

• Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.
They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.
They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

• Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.

• Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.

• Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.

• Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.

• Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.

• Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.

• Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.

• Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

• Experience working with physical consumer products.

• Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.

• Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.

• Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.

• Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.

• Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.

• Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like
Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.
Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.
Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

• Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.

• A senior leadership role with direct ownership of the company's ecommerce creative direction and growth.

• High level of autonomy and the opportunity to shape creative strategy, processes, and team development.

• Direct impact on ecommerce performance, conversion, and creative effectiveness across multiple channels.

• Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary creative team.

• A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture where creative decisions are connected to business results.

• Competitive compensation based on experience.

• Bonuses.

• Paid Time Off.

• Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Creative Director who wants to take ownership of a growing ecommerce creative function, combine creative leadership with performance-driven decision-making, and build a scalable creative operation with a direct impact on business growth.

postings.title: Freelance Recruiter – Commission Only (€400–2,400 per placement) – Buenos Aires
postings.descriptionText:
Recruit for Europe from home, paid in euros per placement. Your own hours, your own methods. Open to recruiters based in Buenos Aires and across Argentina.
Read all of this before you apply. It's long on purpose. If this isn't you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are
BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.
We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.
You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for
People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.
We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

• You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.

• You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.

• You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.

• You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.

• You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.

• You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.

This is NOT for you if

• You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.

• You want something to try "when you have time".

• You need someone to tell you what to do every day.

• You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.

• Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.

• You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.

What you earn

•
Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.

• You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.

• A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.

• Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.

•
Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back
Nothing is given up front. Everything grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

• Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.

• Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.

• Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

• Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.

• Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.

• Direct contact with us whenever you have a question about a role or a candidate.

• Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

• The first weeks are about building your pipeline.

• Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.

• We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

• You answer the questions below. We read every answer.

• If your answers are strong, we have a video call.

• If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

•
Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?

•
The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.

•
Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?

•
Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.
Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.
Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

postings.title: Visa & Consular Processing Analyst (E-2)
postings.descriptionText:
If you have worked in the visa section of a U.S. Embassy or Consulate and want to bring that expertise to the private sector, this role is for you. Visa Franchise is looking for a Visa & Consular Processing Analyst to own consular expertise end to end for our clients, with a primary focus on E-2 treaty investor cases. You will be the in-house reference for how U.S. consulates work: protocols, documentation standards, appointment logistics and wait times. You will guide clients through the DS-160 and MRV steps, prepare them for their consular interview, make sure every package meets each consulate's requirements, and turn this knowledge into SOPs so it lives in the company and not in one person. This is not a legal role: Visa Franchise is not a law firm, and legal matters are handled by the independent attorney each client engages.
We are a remote-first experience done right. Join our rapidly growing team of over 20+ fully remote staff who are mostly located in Buenos Aires, Argentina. At the same time receive exceptional opportunities for career growth working on products and features with a direct impact on the success of our companies.

Required Qualifications:

• 1 to 3 years of experience in the consular section of a U.S. Embassy or Consulate (locally engaged staff, consular assistant, or similar)

• Demonstrated experience with E-2 treaty investor visas from the consular side, in processing or adjudication support

• Working knowledge of the nonimmigrant visa process from the applicant side: DS-160, MRV fee payment, appointment scheduling platforms (U.S. Travel Docs / AIS), document requirements and interview logistics

• Fully bilingual in English and Spanish, able to run client meetings and write client-facing instructions in both

• Strong attention to detail on documentation: forms, names, dates and consistency across a case file

• Client-facing communication skills: able to explain a high-stakes process clearly and keep clients calm and prepared

• Highly organized, able to track dozens of cases in parallel with hard deadlines and no dropped steps

• Comfortable with CRM and project management tools (HubSpot, Jira) and the Office 365 suite

• Proficient in using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to support daily work and optimize workflows

• Ability to follow and improve upon set processes in a fast-paced, flexible environment

• Ability to work Monday to Friday within U.S. Eastern Time (ET) hours, ~9:00 to 17:30

Preferred Qualifications:

• Strong ability to work and communicate with clients, prospects, attorneys and their staff

• Experience at a U.S. consulate in Latin America, with familiarity across multiple posts

• Additional E-2 exposure from an immigration law firm or consultancy handling E-2 caseloads

• Exposure to other investor or business visa categories (E-1, L-1, O-1)

• Portuguese language skills

• Track record of writing SOPs, checklists or training material (Trainual or similar)

• Comfort working with data: wait times, appointment availability and case throughput in spreadsheets or dashboards

Responsibilities:

• Own the company's knowledge of U.S. consulate protocols and documentation standards, post by post, with depth on the posts that handle our E-2 volume

• Act as the internal reference on consular operations, and communicate changes in consular requirements to the team

• Set the standard for DS-160 and consulate-facing form accuracy, and own the final review before submission

• Guide clients through DS-160 completion, MRV fee payment and the appointment booking platform

• Prepare clients for the consular interview end to end, and debrief them afterwards to feed outcomes back into the knowledge base

• Work with the package creation team and the filing attorney so each package and filing meets the specific consulate's requirements, flagging gaps before filing

• Maintain a tracker of consular wait times and appointment availability, and optimize interview dates to shorten time to interview

• Document consular processes into clear SOPs and checklists (Trainual), and keep case status updated in HubSpot and Jira

• Propose and support improvements to the consular workflow

Location: Remote, Latin America. Full-time, Monday to Friday, within U.S. Eastern Time hours.

Compensation, Perks and Benefits:

• Very competitive salary package in US dollars

• Quarterly bonus (based on targets’ achievements) and annual profit-sharing

• 15 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year

• Holidays between Christmas and New Year

• Health Benefits: health insurance and gym pass

• English lessons

• Work From Home (WFH) allowance setup ($500) to start then up to $500 a year to be used towards WFH equipment and services

• Additional offerings: a dynamic work environment, a high level of autonomy, the ability to continue developing your career and skills, and clear expectations for success

Organization Description:
Our organization is comprised of two companies under one umbrella. Our team is 100% remote based, with our headquarters in the U.S. and the majority of our team located in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
Our vision is to foster the largest community of data-focused entrepreneurs and investors in the world.

• Vetted Biz converts analytical data and complex business material into clear, easy-to-understand information to power the business buying process for new and experienced entrepreneurs alike.

•
Visa Franchise is a business consulting firm that, since 2015, has helped over 1,200 families from more than 80 countries establish their businesses and build their lives in the United States. We act as the project manager for our clients' move to the U.S., coordinating everything it involves, from business setup and immigration to real estate, banking, tax, and schools, and connecting them with a curated network of independent specialists and service providers. Visa Franchise is not a law firm; legal work is handled by independent attorneys our clients engage directly.

We have been a founder-led and self-funded organization since our initial founding in 2015, with a long-term vision to be the largest community of data-focused entrepreneurs and investors in the world.

A producer role developing and producing exceptional journalist-led content with a globally traveling on-camera presenter, across short, medium and long formats.

Location: Fully remote – open to candidates anywhere in the world

The opportunity
Our client's co-founder is an on-camera journalist and presenter who is constantly moving between countries, communities and stories. The client is looking for a producer to develop and produce exceptional content with him as the presenter.
He is the talent. You will work closely with him behind the scenes to shape the strategy, find the stories, develop the angles, research the facts and write the scripts that bring his journalism to life. As co-founder of a media company that helps people tell the stories traditional media overlooks, he is building a presenter-led output across short, medium and long formats: everything from one-minute reactions and recurring explainer series to podcasts, interviews and documentaries.
You will help decide what he should cover, why it matters and how he should tell the story on camera.

About the organization
Our client is a media company that helps the 99% be seen by empowering people to tell their own stories, because traditional media focuses on the 1%. Its co-founder presents the journalism this role will build.

What you will do

• Build a strategy for presenter-led content around his voice, interests, travel and access.

• Proactively pitch original stories, timely reactions and unexpected angles, particularly around social justice.

• Research subjects thoroughly, find credible sources and identify the details that make a story compelling.

• Write scripts for on-camera delivery, with natural spoken language, strong hooks and clear storytelling.

• Develop distinctive shows and repeatable formats the presenter hosts, including explainers, podcasts and documentaries.

• Identify contributors, interview opportunities and stories in the places the presenter is visiting.

• Prepare presenter briefs, interview questions, filming plans and story outlines so he arrives ready to shoot.

• Produce his on-camera delivery, whether remotely or on location, with feedback on clarity, pacing and performance.

• Work with editors to shape his footage into strong finished stories, including supporting footage, graphics and sound.

• Develop titles, thumbnails and social copy that make people want to watch.

• Study performance and audience retention, then apply what you learn to the next piece.

• Protect factual accuracy and editorial integrity from the first pitch through to publication.

What you bring

• A proven track record in digital journalism, video production or documentary storytelling.

• Experience producing presenter-led content and working directly with on-camera talent.

• Published work that has generated millions of views , with a clear explanation of your contribution.

• Excellent research, scripting and storytelling skills.

• A strong understanding of how audiences behave across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook.

• The ability to write both a sharp short-form hook and a sustained narrative for a longer film.

• The initiative and organization to keep projects moving around a demanding travel schedule.

• A deep commitment to social justice and a decolonial understanding of power, politics and representation: you question whose perspective is treated as authoritative, whose experiences are overlooked and who benefits from the way a story is told, while keeping the journalistic discipline to interrogate your own assumptions, check every claim and follow the evidence.

How the engagement works

• You will contract directly with Apricot, which manages contracting, invoicing/payroll, payments, and administrative support.

• Contracting arrangements, monthly compensation, time-zone overlap and the exact start date will be confirmed before an offer.

• Your work will be based on the agreed scope and deliverables.

Apricot is a nonprofit sourcing firm connecting displaced and underserved professionals from Palestine and the wider MENA region with global employment opportunities. We combine a social-impact mission with high-quality recruitment delivery for international clients.

• Develop integrations with enterprise systems, including HR, ERP, and workforce-management platforms, ensuring reliable data exchange and safe execution of write-back operations.

• Implement robust integration patterns, including idempotency, retries, event-driven processing, dead-letter queues, and reconciliation mechanisms to ensure data consistency.

• Build and maintain decision services, business rules, and outcome-tracking capabilities that help translate operational insights into actionable decisions.

• Develop and support data services and pipelines that process, transform, and make operational data available to the platform.

• Design and implement secure multi-tenant services, ensuring strict data isolation and appropriate access controls across customer environments.

• Build and maintain cloud-native services using Azure, AWS, or GCP, including containerized applications and automated CI/CD pipelines.

• Implement comprehensive unit, integration, and contract tests to maintain service reliability, performance, and compatibility.

• Collaborate with front-end engineers, data engineers, platform engineers, and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions.

• Use AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate implementation while maintaining code quality, security, and engineering standards.

• Take ownership of services throughout their lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to production deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing improvements.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Have Experience

• Senior TypeScript and Node.js experience. At least 5 years building production back-end services, with recent hands-on experience using TypeScript and Node.js. You have built, launched, and supported services in production.

• Contract-first API development. You have designed REST APIs using OpenAPI specifications and generated server types, clients, and tests from API contracts. You understand API versioning and how to maintain compatibility across consumers.

• Enterprise system integrations. You have built integrations that write data back into external enterprise systems, such as HR, ERP, or vendor-management platforms. You understand idempotency, retries, backoff, outbox patterns, dead-letter queues, and reconciliation.

• Multi-tenant SaaS architecture. You have built services with strict tenant isolation across the data layer, authorization, and testing. You understand the importance of preventing cross-tenant data exposure.

• Cloud and security experience. You have production experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, containers, and CI/CD. Azure and Entra ID experience is a strong advantage.

• Testing discipline. You regularly implement unit, integration, and contract testing as part of your development process.

• AI-assisted development. You use AI coding assistants or agents in your daily development workflow and know how to review, test, and validate the code they generate.

• Strong English communication. You are fluent in written and spoken English and comfortable collaborating directly with US-based engineers and client stakeholders.

• Available around December 1, 2026.
Nice-to-haves

• Java experience or familiarity with rules and decision engines, such as DMN decision tables or Drools.

• Experience with Snowflake, dbt, SQL Server, Azure SQL, or other modern cloud data platforms.

• Graph database experience, particularly Neo4j and Cypher.

• Experience with event-driven architectures and message queues, such as Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, or equivalent technologies.

postings.title: Associate Client Partner (Digital Ads Sales) - Criteo
postings.descriptionText:
About Aleph

Aleph is a global leader accelerating digital advertising, and fintech solutions across more than 130 high-growth markets. With more than 20 years of experience and strategic partnerships with over 50 of the world's leading digital platforms, Aleph connects media, payments, and local market expertise to enable platforms and businesses to grow and operate globally with speed and compliance. With teams in more than 90 offices worldwide, Aleph combines global scale with deep local execution. Beyond business impact, Aleph drives digital inclusion through its education initiative, Digital Ad Expert, member of UNESCO’s Global Skills Academy.


We are looking for an Associate Client Partner to support our digital advertising sales team in Buenos Aires.
The Associate Client Partner is responsible for training, promoting, presenting, and driving digital advertising product sales to agencies and direct advertisers through live client engagement. The ideal person is charismatic, motivated, and internally driven, with strong attention to detail. They are an outstanding public speaker and a natural storyteller.
This is a performance-driven role focused on delivering measurable business growth for our clients and the company.

What You Will Do
• Evangelize the digital platform you will be educating on.

• Drive digital advertising sales while educating advertisers and agencies on product features and benefits.

• Generate excitement and brand awareness, and increase product sales, through creative solutions.

• Continuously engage and communicate with clients about the platform.

• Represent the company positively within the Argentine market.

• Drive customer satisfaction among both agencies and direct clients.

• Meet and exceed performance KPIs such as sales growth, client retention, and platform adoption.

• Use insights and analytics to measure campaign performance and to optimize outreach and strategy.

What We Are Looking For
Experience and skills

• 2 years of experience selling digital advertising (display, video, native ads, and programmatic) to advertising agencies and direct clients.

• Energetic, goal-oriented, and outgoing.

• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Strong understanding of the digital online advertising industry, including the underlying technology, major companies, and research.

• Understanding of best practices and emerging trends within the digital, social, and creative environment.

• Proven track record of delivering results and hitting or exceeding revenue and performance targets.

• Ability to leverage data and analytics to influence social marketing activity and strategy.

• Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills that support team development.

• Aptitude, creativity, and a preference for working in collaborative teams and across business units.

• Comfortable operating in a highly dynamic environment.

• Established relationships with decision-makers in the local market.

• Fluent in English.

Your profile

• You bring a track record of success in a similar role, with hands-on experience.

• You are not afraid to challenge the status quo and bring fresh, out-of-the-box ideas to the table.

• You anticipate challenges before they arise and take initiative to find effective solutions.

• You have an eye for detail.

• You thrive on teamwork but also bring a driven, goal-oriented spirit.

• You are genuinely enthusiastic about advertising, ad-tech, and staying ahead of industry trends.

• You engage and communicate with internal and external stakeholders in a positive and approachable way.

Why Join Aleph
• Impact: Your work directly connects brands and consumers in meaningful ways and helps shape the future of digital advertising.

• Growth: You get the freedom to grow and create within the company, regardless of your position, plus workshops that keep you current on the latest digital advertising insights.

• Team culture: You join a diverse, multicultural team that values different perspectives, experiences, and talents, and celebrates creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas.

• Market context: You work with leading brands, platforms, and publishers through a company with a truly global footprint, from a Buenos Aires advertising community that is active and well connected.

• Flexibility: Our hybrid model in CABA gives you time with the team in the office and time to focus remotely.

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, and our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.
We use Lever, our recruitment management platform, which includes AI-powered features that may assist our hiring team in reviewing applications, analyzing CVs, and identifying relevant qualifications. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people. For more information about how your personal data is processed, including your rights in relation to AI-assisted processing, please see our Candidate Privacy Policy or contact us at privacy@alephdigital.com.

postings.descriptionText:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
The Senior Strategic Sourcing Specialist is a role responsible for driving end-to-end sourcing events, commercial negotiations, and contract structuring across key technology spend categories, including IT infrastructure, software, IT services, and staffing agencies. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders, owning the entire sourcing lifecycle from initial market analysis and RFP execution to final contract drafting and vendor onboarding, ensuring optimal value and mitigated risk for the business.
“Negotiates high-value tech contracts and ensures we only pay for delivered results”

Responsibilities

• Lead single-source negotiations and competitive RFPs across multiple technology and services spend categories.

• Negotiate and secure favorable tier discounts, pricing models, and commercial terms with key technology and service vendors.

• Structure complex Statements of Work (SOWs), ensuring that agency fee disbursements are strictly tied to measurable delivery milestones and performance metrics.

• Standardize contractor rate cards and implement labor caps across all staff augmentation and external consulting engagements.

• Conduct comprehensive market analysis to inform sourcing strategies and benchmark pricing.

• Draft, review, and refine contract terms in close collaboration with Legal, Security, and Finance teams.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, aligning sourcing strategies with broader organizational goals.

• 5+ years of proven experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or vendor management, with specific expertise in technology categories (Cloud, SaaS, IT Services, Staffing).

• Exceptional negotiation skills with a history of driving cost savings and favorable commercial terms.

• Deep understanding of contract structures, particularly in milestone-based SOWs and standardized labor rate cards.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate market trends, pricing models, and total cost of ownership.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

• Comfortable managing end-to-end sourcing processes without relying on heavy, legacy ERP systems.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

evidence: 100% remoto, sin restricción de país (según la fuente o la empresa).

About the role:
You will own the inference backbone behind QVAC's local AI stack: the C++ systems layer that makes models run fast, reliably, and predictably on real user hardware. The role is centered on engineering quality at runtime level, including startup behavior, memory pressure, throughput/latency balance, and long-session stability. You will define and evolve the core abstractions that inference features depend on, so new capabilities can be added without sacrificing performance or maintainability. This is a role for someone who enjoys low-level problem solving, clear technical ownership, and building infrastructure that other teams trust in production. Your work directly enables private, on-device AI experiences and helps set the technical foundation for QVAC's next generation of peer-to-peer AI products.

About the job
You'll work on the C++ layer that powers local AI, porting and enhancing inference engines like llama.cpp or similar, to run efficiently on edge devices. Your focus is on the runtime: making models load faster, run leaner, and perform well across different hardware. You'll ensure that the inference layer is stable, optimized, and ready for integration with the rest of the stack.
This role is for engineers who want to work close to the metal, enabling private and fast on-device AI without relying on cloud infrastructure.

Responsibilities

• Work on deploying machine learning models to edge devices using the frameworks: llama.cpp, ggml

• Collaborate closely with researchers to assist in coding, training and transitioning models from research to production environments

• Integrate AI features into existing products, enriching them with the latest advancements in machine learning

• Strong programming skills in C++

• Strong experience with Llama.cpp and ggml inference engines, which facilitates the deployment of models to specific GPU architectures

• Experience with any GPU framework between Cuda, Vulkan, Metal, OpenCL

• Good understanding of deep learning concepts and model architectures

• Experience with transformers, LLMs, Diffusion models

• Demonstrated ability to rapidly assimilate new technologies and techniques

• A degree in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D

Bonus points if:

• You know how to train/fine-tune a LLM

• You have productionized models

• You have research experience in new model architectures

• You have experience with distributed systems

• Javascript experience

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

postings.title: Jefe Mantenimiento Mecánico
postings.descriptionText:
Jefe/a de Mantenimiento Mecánico

Acerca del Rol:
Buscamos personas que vivan nuestros valores, que no tengan miedo de desafiar, innovar, experimentar y desenvolverse en un entorno dinámico. Siempre estamos buscando nuevas formas de mejorar nuestros productos y de seguir desarrollándonos. Si esto te representa, nos encantaría conocerte.
Como Jefe/a de Mantenimiento Mecánico , serás responsable de liderar y gestionar el mantenimiento mecánico y neumático de las líneas de producción y de los servicios auxiliares de nuestra planta de Wilde, asegurando la continuidad operativa, la confiabilidad de los equipos y el cumplimiento de los objetivos de seguridad, calidad, productividad y costes.
Se trata de una posición de liderazgo con un fuerte componente técnico y de gestión. Requiere combinar conocimientos sólidos de mantenimiento, planificación, análisis de información, liderazgo de equipos y orientación a la mejora continua , manteniendo siempre la seguridad como prioridad.
El rol liderará un equipo de mecánicos y cuchilleros/afiladores que brinda soporte a una operación de producción continua. Por ello, buscamos a una persona cercana a la operación, capaz de acompañar técnicamente al equipo, tomar decisiones ante situaciones críticas y desarrollar una gestión de mantenimiento cada vez más planificada y preventiva.

Responsabilidades del Puesto:

• Liderar el proceso de mantenimiento mecánico y neumático de las líneas de producción y de los servicios auxiliares de la planta, gestionando personas, máquinas y sistemas para asegurar el cumplimiento de los indicadores de productividad establecidos.

• Coordinar las tareas de mantenimiento correctivo, preventivo y programado, asegurando una respuesta eficaz ante averías y la correcta ejecución de las intervenciones durante paradas de equipos y planta.

• Liderar, acompañar y desarrollar al equipo de mecánicos y cuchilleros/afiladores, promoviendo su autonomía, desempeño, formación técnica y crecimiento profesional.

• Gestionar la cobertura operativa del equipo, incluyendo la planificación de turnos, vacaciones, recursos, capacitaciones y matrices de habilidades.

• Impulsar la implementación y mejora del pilar de Mantenimiento Preventivo dentro de la metodología TPM, realizando seguimiento de los planes, análisis de averías y acciones de mejora.

• Planificar y administrar el mantenimiento mediante SAP, incluyendo la creación y seguimiento de órdenes de trabajo, relevamiento y actualización de equipos, planificación de tareas y gestión de la información de mantenimiento.

• Gestionar el mantenimiento de servicios auxiliares y equipos de planta, coordinando rutinas preventivas, registros técnicos y servicios tercerizados con proveedores.

• Administrar la estrategia de repuestos, identificando necesidades, criticidad y niveles de stock para asegurar la disponibilidad de componentes y minimizar riesgos para la operación.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de los estándares y procedimientos relacionados con seguridad, salud, medioambiente, higiene, calidad, productividad y costes.

• Promover una cultura de seguridad, asegurando que todas las tareas de mantenimiento se ejecuten de acuerdo con las normas, procedimientos y comportamientos definidos por Essity.

• Trabajar de manera transversal con Operaciones, Ingeniería, Seguridad, Calidad, Compras y proveedores, asegurando una adecuada coordinación de las actividades de mantenimiento.

• Participar en investigaciones de causa raíz, análisis de incidentes y fallos, así como en la definición y seguimiento de acciones correctivas y preventivas.

• Acompañar ensayos, iniciativas de innovación y mejoras de equipos orientadas a incrementar la eficiencia, velocidad, confiabilidad y productividad de las líneas.

• Gestionar los recursos y presupuestos asociados al área, participando en su planificación, seguimiento y control.

• Participar activamente en los sistemas de reuniones de la compañía, presentando avances, indicadores, necesidades y planes de acción del área.

• Brindar soporte técnico y liderazgo ante contingencias relevantes de la operación, considerando las necesidades propias de una planta de producción continua.

Quién eres:

• Eres profesional de Ingeniería Mecánica, Ingeniería Electromecánica, Ingeniería Industrial o una carrera técnica/profesional afín.

• Cuentas con al menos 3 a 5 años de experiencia en mantenimiento de líneas de producción, preferiblemente en plantas industriales de proceso continuo.

• Posees conocimientos técnicos sólidos en mecánica, neumática y mantenimiento de equipos industriales.

• Tienes experiencia liderando equipos técnicos y gestionando su desempeño, planificación, capacitación y desarrollo.

• Cuentas con experiencia en planificación y gestión de mantenimiento mediante SAP, incluyendo órdenes de trabajo, equipos y planes de mantenimiento.

• Tienes conocimientos y experiencia en metodologías de gestión de manufactura y mejora continua, especialmente TPM. Se valorarán también conocimientos de Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen y/o Six Sigma.

• Posees experiencia gestionando mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo, análisis de averías, causa raíz y planes de acción.

• Sabes trabajar con indicadores de mantenimiento y productividad, utilizando datos e información técnica para establecer prioridades y tomar decisiones.

• Cuentas con conocimientos de seguridad industrial, normas de calidad y buenas prácticas aplicables a entornos de manufactura.

• Tienes experiencia en gestión de repuestos, proveedores, servicios tercerizados, costes y presupuestos de mantenimiento.

• Destacas por tu liderazgo cercano, comunicación, capacidad de negociación y toma de decisiones, pudiendo construir relaciones de confianza con equipos de amplia experiencia técnica.

• Eres una persona planificada, analítica y orientada a resultados, con capacidad para gestionar prioridades y responder con criterio ante contingencias operativas.

• Tienes una marcada orientación a la seguridad y comprendes que ninguna urgencia operativa justifica omitir los procedimientos o estándares establecidos.

• Te caracterizas por un estilo de trabajo hands-on: puedes liderar desde la gestión y, cuando la situación lo requiere, involucrarte y acompañar técnicamente al equipo en planta.

• Cuentas con disponibilidad para brindar soporte ante contingencias críticas, intervenciones programadas o necesidades excepcionales propias de una operación de producción continua.

• El conocimiento de inglés será valorado para participar en reuniones e iniciativas regionales y globales.

Qué podemos ofrecerte
En Essity, creemos que el aprendizaje y el desarrollo profesional de cada persona son únicos, y queremos brindar a nuestros colaboradores las herramientas y oportunidades necesarias para alcanzar su máximo potencial dentro de una cultura ganadora, inspirada por un propósito poderoso.

postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.


Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.



Overview


📍 Remote Global - Caribbean

 

We are seeking a WFM Central - Real Time Analyst to serve as the central governance layer for live operations across multiple Lines of Business (LoB). This is not a traditional monitoring role; it is designed for a high-caliber, forensic operator who functions as an operational architect. You will be a trusted partner to operational leadership, responsible for continuing to evolve our operations to a standardized, and fiscally sound control model.


The ideal candidate possesses the technical "know-how" of a forensic analyst and the communication prowess of a business consultant, capable of telling a compelling story through data to stakeholders ranging from Team Leads to Directors. You won't just report that a queue is at risk; you will diagnose the business impact, identify the root cause, and prescribe the specific levers leadership must pull to preserve SLA and the customer experience. You will be the owner of all aspects of the support queues and ensure we are meeting our customers where they need us.


Responsibilities

 - Stakeholder Storytelling: Distill complex, "noisy" operational signals into high-impact narratives. You must be able to share in-depth observations and supporting data that tell a clear story to stakeholders, at all levels of leadership, on exactly what actions must be taken.

 - Business-Level Analysis: Go beyond the "what" and the "why" to analyze long-term business trends. Evaluate the financial efficiency of SLA safeguarding and the fiscal impact of current staffing vs. demand density.

 - Operational Control & Forensic Auditing: Serve as the authoritative "voice of reason" during incidents. Conduct forensic audits of agent behaviors such as "On Hold" abuse or status irregularities to ensure hidden capacity drains are eliminated.

 - Centralized Core Governance: Enact queue management playbooks for real-time levers across multiple LoBs, ensuring aggressive SLAs are preserved through structured accountability.

 - Strategic Planning & Optimization: Partner with WFM to create a concise feedback loop for continued improvement in planning and scheduling.


Qualifications

 - Exceptional Communication: Proven ability to translate complex data into a clear jargon-free business story. You must be comfortable presenting actionable insights to senior leadership under high-pressure conditions.

 - Advanced Forensic Analysis: Expert proficiency in Google Sheets is required, familiarity with Metabase preferred. You must be able to build complex, automated tracking tools and forensic audits from scratch. Not just for basic queue health, but also analyzing business data that influences our operations.

 - Strategic Judgment: Demonstrated experience making high-judgment decisions that impact the entire business, particularly in environments with aggressive SLAs and fluctuating volume patterns.

 - Operational Architecture: Take ownership in documenting best practices into governed frameworks and playbooks.

 - Resilient Mindset: Comfortable operating autonomously in a 24/7 environment, with the flexibility to adapt to operational needs as part of a high-impact, interdependent team.

 - Systems Fluency: Familiarity with Amazon Connect, Zendesk Omnichannel routing, and Assembled WFM is highly preferred.


What Success Looks Like

 - Operational anomalies are quickly investigated, with root causes clearly identified and communicated, reducing repeat issues and leadership uncertainty

 - You evolve queue management processes from reactive to a documented, standardized, and predictive operating model.

 - Champion of the team’s brand with Operational Leadership. You are looked to as the primary source of truth, relying on your data-driven stories to make critical staffing and operational decisions.

 - Live queues remain stable, governed, and resilient across all supported lines of business, even during unexpected spikes, outages, or incidents

 - Stakeholders receive timely, clear updates during incidents that explain impact, cause, and corrective actions in a concise and actionable manner.



HIRING PROCESS

 - Interview with Head of Core Services

 - Final Culture Interview with Executive Leadership

• Acting as a product champion and point of contact for named cloud partners.

• Creating partner- and customer-facing materials like webinars, presentations, videos, and white papers.

• Driving Ubuntu adoption across cloud products, advocating its benefits to stakeholders.

• Delivering first-party offerings with subscription components with cloud providers.

• Leading in making Canonical products the default choice for our cloud partners to build on and accelerating adoption of our technology by end users on their platforms.

• Working understanding and strong interest in public cloud technologies.

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, with an undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.

• Confidence to respectfully speak up and exchange ideas without hesitation.

• Driven to meet commitments and achieve results, evidenced by a track record of delivering beyond expectations.

• A commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.

• Passion for technology evidenced by personal as well as business pursuits.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.

• Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.

• Appreciative of diversity, effective in a multicultural, multi-national organisation

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. postings.descriptionText:
For ambitious, culturally diverse, curious minds seeking booming careers, Job Duck unlocks and nurtures your potential. We connect you with rewarding, remote job opportunities with US-based employers who recognize and appreciate your skills, allowing you to not just survive but thrive.
As a lifestyle company, we ensure that everybody working here has a fantastic time, which is why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work Certification every year since 2022!

Job Description:
The Billing Specialist is the person who walks beside the client through
the financial side of the hardest experience of their life. You are their guide. You help them understand where their money is going, why it matters, and how every dollar they invest connects to the outcome they're working toward for themselves and their family. You are part of their walk, connecting their payment to their goal.

Teaching people how to use the service, showing them the value of what their legal team is doing, and making the financial side of their case feel manageable instead of terrifying. When you do that well, collections happen naturally. Clients who feel informed and cared for pay.

The people who thrive in this role are someone who genuinely likes people and is energized, organized without being rigid, and does not wait to

be told what needs to happen,

• Compensation Range: 1,015 USD to 1,100 USD

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• When a client says they cannot pay, walk through every available option: credit cards, personal loans, family support, employer assistance, legal fee financing programs. Explore before you accept.

• When attorneys communicate retainer reductions or billing pauses, document the instruction in Clio at the matter level the same day.

• Flag any matter below the trust threshold to the assigned attorney the same day.

• Within five (5) business days of a new client retaining the firm, deliver a billing tutorial covering retainer structure, evergreen replenishment, invoice format, and what to expect at each stage of their case.

• Maintain accounts receivable below 2% of total billings.

• Lead every collections conversation with a brief case update: what was accomplished, what is upcoming, how the work moves the client closer to their goal. Then address the balance.

• Log every billing complaint in the tracker with a documented timestamp and route it to the responsible attorney via email.

• Keep Trust Accounts Funded and Clients Informed

• Provide specific dollar ranges for upcoming cost events, so the client is never surprised.

• Produce a weekly deliverable every Friday: complaints resolved this week and

complaints still awaiting attorney response.

• Check attorney calendars for upcoming hearings, mediations, and trials. Initiate

additional retainer requests.

• Call every client before sending a replenishment request. No replenishment email goes out without a phone call attempt.

• Confirm all credits, write-offs, and billing holds in writing before any related bill is finalized.

Requirements:

• 2+ years in billing, collections, or accounts receivable in a professional services environment. Law firm experience strongly preferred.

• Comfort with outbound phone calls and client-facing conversations.

• Proficiency with practice management software (Clio Manage preferred)

• Ability to read and interpret legal invoices, time entries, trust account statements, and engagement agreements.

• Strong written communication for documented escalations, client correspondence, and weekly deliverables.

• Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Calendar, Drive).

• Prior use of LawPay, Dialpad, or Clio Grow.
