postings.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Product
postings.descriptionText:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Data Product team collaborates with an experienced group of data scientists, engineers, and product managers to build highly scalable features that power TRM's products and services. As a Data Engineer on the Data Product team, you will be responsible for designing and building mission-critical data services. These features analyze and provide insights into blockchain transaction activity at petabyte scale, and ultimately work to build a safer financial system for billions of people..

The impact you’ll have here:

•
Build highly scalable features that integrate with dozens of blockchains.

•
Design and architect intricate data models for optimal storage and retrieval to support sub-second latency for querying blockchain data.

•
Collaborate across departments, partnering with data scientists, backend engineers, and product managers to design and implement novel data models that enhance TRM’s products.

What we’re looking for:

•
Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related field.

•
A proven track record, with 5+ years of hands-on experience in architecting scalable API development, distributed system architecture, guiding projects from initial ideation through to successful production deployment.

•
Exceptional programming skills in Python, as well as adeptness in SQL or SparkSQL.

•
Versatility that spans the entire spectrum of data engineering in one or more of the following areas:

•
In-depth experience with data stores such as BigQuery and Postgres.

•
Proficiency in data pipeline and workflow orchestration tools like Airflow and DBT.

•
Expertise in data processing technologies and streaming workflows including Dataflow, Spark, Kafka, and Flink.

•
Competence in deploying and monitoring infrastructure within public cloud platforms, utilizing tools such as Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Datadog.

•
Proven ability in loading, querying, and transforming extensive datasets

About the Team:

•
Our team is spread out over several countries and time zones. To leverage the opportunities and address challenges that come with this working model, we've built a culture grounded in trust, transparency, and adaptability. Even though we're scattered across different time zones, we stay closely connected through open communication and regular check-ins. Our use of digital tools helps us collaborate seamlessly and work at an impressive pace, delivering results at TRM speed while staying in sync.

•
The diversity of perspectives and expertise within our team sparks creative exchanges and enhances our problem-solving capabilities, allowing us to leverage our global synergy to drive innovation and efficiency.

•
We're driven by a deep sense of ownership, constant pursuit of improvement and an obsession with delivering magical experiences to our customers; these are a core part of our culture.

•
We're driven by the desire to continuously hone our craft and to this end, we regularly assess our processes, seek feedback, and embrace iterative development to refine what we do.

•
We structure problems and use the 80/20 rule(for many outcomes, roughly 80% of consequences come from 20% of causes) to identify where to direct our razor-sharp focus.

•
Each of us is passionate about excellence and growth, and we're encouraged to challenge the status quo and experiment with new methods. This mindset creates an environment where innovation is part of our daily routine and every team member is an impact-oriented trailblazer.

•
By celebrating our successes and learning from our setbacks, we stay agile and forward-thinking, always striving to elevate our performance and impact.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

•
The team received a request from customers to show the running balance for assets tied to an address within the product. They brainstormed to determine the minimal viable solution that could be delivered within two weeks. The team decided to develop a framework that would facilitate enabling this feature for each chain (such as BTC, ETH, etc.) individually. They successfully implemented and tested this solution for the BTC chain and delivered it to customers within the two-week timeframe. This approach allowed the team to quickly provide value to customers and establish a repeatable process.

•
The team was tasked with implementing a new feature that would enable TRM to gather feedback from the user community swiftly. Due to the company's goal of showcasing the feature at an upcoming event, the timeline was tight. The team quickly adjusted to the request, assessed the requirements, and developed a solution that addressed 80% of the needs and could be executed within a very short timeframe. They successfully delivered the feature on schedule, impressing customers with both the functionality and the speed of execution.

•
The team was tasked with developing a solution to reveal Indirect Exposure through cross-chain swaps in response to a competitor's similar feature. Before choosing the technical approach, the team consulted with stakeholders to establish a feasible timeline for the implementation. With this input, the team devised a solution that fit the timeline, communicated the tradeoffs to stakeholders, and successfully delivered the solution as promised.

About TRM's Engineering Levels:

Engineer: Responsible for helping to define project milestones and executing small decisions independently with the appropriate tradeoffs between simplicity, readability, and performance. Provides mentorship to junior engineers, and enhances operational excellence through tech debt reduction and knowledge sharing.

Senior Engineer: Successfully designs and documents system improvements and features for an OKR/project from the ground up. Consistently delivers efficient and reusable systems, optimizes team throughput with appropriate tradeoffs, mentors team members, and enhances cross-team collaboration through documentation and knowledge sharing.

Staff Engineer: Drives scoping and execution of one or more OKRs/projects that impact multiple teams. Partners with stakeholders to set the team vision and technical roadmaps for one or more products. Is a role model and mentor to the entire engineering organization. Ensures system health and quality with operational reviews, testing strategies, and monitoring rigor.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

•
Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

•
Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

•
First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

•
Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

•
References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

•
Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

•
Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

•
Accelerate repeatable workflows

•
Structure and solve problems

•
Improve output quality

•
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

•
Priorities and targets to change quickly

•
Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

•
A high level of personal ownership and accountability

•
Close collaboration across teams and functions

•
Frequent, high-touch communication

•
Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

•
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

•
Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

•
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

•
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman…

postings.title: Head of Marketing - Argentina / Uruguay
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .


About the role

We're searching for an exceptional marketing leader to grow Halter in Argentina and Uruguay - one of the biggest cattle regions in the world. You’ll be building recognition for Halter’s brand that reaches every farming community, with revenue performance to match. We're making our first moves on the ground and we need a senior leader to build the marketing foundation and be part of our core team.

This role is a key driver of full-funnel revenue performance: acquisition, expansion, and retention, all through marketing. You're not running events and content on instruction or directive from HQ. You are accountable for the local marketing strategy to achieve our revenue outcomes. That means thinking like a revenue owner first, and a marketer second.

Your job is to make sure marketing shows up as a genuine lever across that whole funnel: helping win new farmers, and also feeding the stories, proof points and community that keeps existing farmers expanding and retained. You, in tight collaboration with go-to-market leadership, will build this strategy, build the team to deliver against it, and own the demand and pipeline that drives Halter's growth for years to come.

We want you to own marketing for this region. You will have full support from Halter’s global marketing team based in New Zealand HQ, with the brand and strategic frameworks you need to do your job - think of this as our DNA and standardised thinking and that lets every region move fast without reinventing the wheel. We are building the feedback loop to take your feedback and wins, and globalise them, to make Halter’s marketing brilliant in all of our key markets. But ultimately the buck stops with you in Argentina and Uruguay - acquire, expand and retain the best farms in one of the best farming regions globally.



Who we are looking for:



• 
A full-funnel revenue thinker, not a channel specialist. You've owned acquisition, expansion, and retention outcomes, not just top-of-funnel demand generation. You think in pipeline and revenue contribution first, achieved through strategically driving brand awareness




• 
Deeply customer-led. You're energised by time on farm with cattle farmers, and you turn that firsthand understanding into commercial decisions such as messaging, proof points, and channel choices, not just generic content ideas.




• 
A builder and world-class operator. You will build and lead a high-performing, efficient team, ideally with experience scaling a marketing or growth function in a fast paced environment. You will be comfortable rolling your sleeves up and playing ‘executor’, while also knowing the right time to give space to your team to win (or loose) and learn from that experience




• 
Genuinely commercial. You’re not just comfortable being measured on a revenue number - you demand it from yourself and your team. You move fast on real bets, you’re allergic to decisions not backed by data, and you thrive on seeing real results in real time.




• 
First-principles by instinct . You use Halter's global frameworks because they're smart, not because you're told to, and you know exactly when the local market demands something different, and can make that case with evidence, not opinion.




• 
A strong operator across both brand and demand . You’re equally comfortable in a tone-of-voice conversation and a CAC/ROI conversation, and you’re able to move between the two with ease




• 
Comfortable with ambiguity. You'd rather own the outcome and figure out the path than wait for a fully specified brief.




• 
AI-forward as a default operating mode, not a tool you occasionally reach for. You and your team use AI to draft and iterate content, personalise outreach at a scale a human team couldn't match manually, and analyse campaign and funnel data faster than a traditional team would. You treat headcount as a last resort after you've pressure-tested what AI can already do, not the other way around.






What the role looks like:



• 
Strategy & ownership: Own the marketing strategy and budget end to end, setting the vision and the plan to take Halter from early-market entry to category leadership and one of our largest revenue markets.




• 
Organic growth & content. Build content that compounds: SEO-driven farmer resources, owned channels, and organic social that establishes Halter as the trusted voice in cattle, not just a paid acquisition function.




• 
Events strategy. This sits at the heart of our territory manager regional model. You'll partner with sales leadership to decide which field days, expos, and farmer gatherings actually move pipeline in AU, and how they connect directly into the territory manager's patch and pipeline, not run as a separate marketing calendar.




• 
Case studies & proof . Build a library of farmer stories and results that do double duty: acquisition proof points for new farmers, and expansion/retention proof points for existing ones.




• 
Paid traffic. Work with the global Performance Marketing function running paid channels in-region with a sharp eye on customer acquisition costs (CAC) and pipeline contribution, not just reach or impressions.




• 
Enterprise motion. Support and drive the enterprise/larger-account pipeline in AU specifically, where the buying committee, proof requirements, and sales cycle look different from owner-operator farms.




• 
Accountability for the numbers: Own and report on pipeline, CAC, brand awareness and the complete revenue picture. Marketing is one of the most critical levers that sits right across the funnel, so it’s expected you will design the marketing strategy around each metric from acquisition through to net dollar retention.




• 
Brand and tone of voice in-region. Use Halter's global brand as the foundation, and make the judgment calls on how it lands with Argentinian and Uruguayan farmers specifically: language, imagery, humour, what plays and what doesn't in this market.




• 
Objection handling through stories, not just spec sheets. Build ROI case studies and compelling storytelling, delivered through the right channels at the right point in the funnel, that neutralise the objections AU farmers actually raise (price, proof, switching risk), not generic feature messaging.






Our Office First Approach:

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.


Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram .




Why our team loves working at Halter:



• 
Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.




• 
Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.




• 
You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.




• 
This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

As a Strategic Sourcer, you’ll be part of a new global sourcing hub focused on finding the right contributors for complex AI projects that require specialized or hard-to-reach talent across a wide range of domains, from translation and localization to legal, medical, scientific, and technical fields.

This is a strategic, hands-on role within Fulfillment. You will partner closely with the Sourcing Lead, Recruitment, and Delivery to turn complex requirements into effective searches, find creative ways to reach the right contributors, and rapidly scale sourcing efforts when projects require high volumes. The team will work in a data-informed and AI-enabled environment, using technology to enhance human judgment, creativity, and connection.

Your Impact

• Design and execute creative sourcing strategies for specialized, hard-to-reach, and high-volume needs.

• Explore communities, networks, referrals, and non-traditional channels to find and engage contributors.

• Translate project requirements into targeted searches and adapt strategies as needs evolve.

• Communicate sourcing progress, challenges, and market feedback, and flag potential risks.

• Use sourcing and conversion data to identify bottlenecks, test approaches, and improve performance.

• Use AI and automation in research, outreach, analysis, and sourcing workflows to improve efficiency.

What You Bring

• 3+ years of experience in sourcing, recruitment, talent acquisition, or a related field.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

• Strong research and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop new approaches when traditional sourcing methods are not effective.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Experience using sourcing data and funnel metrics to inform decisions and improve results.

Nice to Haves

• Experience sourcing for AI, data, or crowdsourcing projects.

• Experience sourcing linguists, translators, or other language profiles across markets.

• Experience working with global or distributed teams across time zones.

• Flexibility to work regular U.S. hours or provide U.S. overlap when working in a different time zone.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer, Observability (Go)
postings.descriptionText:
Must-have requirements
Apply if all of these describe you. Listing Go as a skill isn't enough: we're looking for Go you've written and run in production.

• 5+ years as a software engineer.

• Go as your main production language, ideally for 3+ years. You write idiomatic Go and can point to services, CLIs or agents you built with it.

• Protobuf APIs with gRPC and/or Connect RPC.

• PostgreSQL in production, including schema migrations.

• Redis and RabbitMQ, or an equivalent message broker you can map to RabbitMQ.

• Multi-tenant services and OAuth2/OIDC.

• Event-driven systems: at-least-once delivery, idempotent consumers, retries.

• Hands-on instrumentation: you've added traces, metrics and logs to services yourself, with OpenTelemetry. Reading dashboards someone else built doesn't count.

• Fluent spoken and written English.

Strong pluses
None of these are required, but they usually mark the people who do best in this team.

• Deep Linux: you've debugged real production Linux issues and know your way around systemd, containers and VMs (KVM, QEMU).

• Networking: VPNs (WireGuard), proxies, DNS, TLS and certificates, or protocols like SNMP, gNMI and BGP.

• Shipping software that runs on customer infrastructure: agents, CLIs, on-prem or air-gapped installs, VM appliances.

• Packaging: RPM and Deb packages, Yum and Apt repositories, container images.

• Kubernetes and infrastructure as code: Terraform, Pulumi or Ansible.

• Open source: you maintain or contribute to projects, and have a GitHub we can look at.

• Working with customers: you've helped customers deploy and debug your software, or supported sales as an engineering contact.

This role is probably not for you if
We'd rather be upfront, to save your time and ours.

• Most of your recent work is in Python, TypeScript, Java or Kotlin, and Go is a secondary language.

• Your focus is frontend, full-stack product work, or AI/LLM applications.

• Your background is mainly data engineering or ML pipelines.

• You're looking for a people-management role. This one is hands-on coding.

• You've used observability tools (Datadog, Grafana) but haven't instrumented services yourself.

• You aren't comfortable working day to day in English.

Responsabilidades:
What you'll do
This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role. You'll write production Go most days.

• Build and evolve backend services in Go for network discovery, monitoring and agent fleet management.

• Design protobuf APIs with gRPC and Connect RPC.

• Build multi-tenant, event-driven services with PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ, including at-least-once delivery and idempotent consumers.

• Secure services with OAuth2/OIDC.

• Instrument everything you build with OpenTelemetry, and make the systems easy to debug in production.

• Help shape how agents running on customer infrastructure are deployed, configured and kept healthy.

• Contribute to the team's open source projects.

Beneficios:
What we offer:

• Fully remote opportunity with an international engineering team.

• Opportunity to work with a US-based technology company.

• Challenging projects involving distributed systems, network automation, and observability.

• Modern technology stack: Go, Python, React, TypeScript, and AI development tools.

• Opportunity to influence architecture and technical decisions.

• Collaborative environment with experienced engineers.

• Professional growth and opportunities to take ownership of complex technical projects.

postings.title: Full-Cycle Marketing Recruiter (Agency | Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
Overview

Do you love talking to people all day? Do you get a little thrill when the right person says yes? Have you spent 3+ years finding great marketers on LinkedIn, then getting them on the phone?

If so, we'd love to meet you. We're looking for a high-energy marketing recruiter to help us find and hire the marketers who'll grow our agency.

You'll be the first voice most candidates hear from ProperExpression . We want that voice to be warm, sharp, and glad to be there.

The Basics

This role is for a people person first. You'll spend most of your day talking: on calls with candidates, in messages on LinkedIn, and with our hiring team about who's great and why.

It's also a craft role. You'll run 3 or more open roles at once: finding people who aren't applying, writing outreach they want to answer, running screening calls that tell good from great, and keeping every candidate in the loop from first hello to offer.

You're a marketing recruiter, and it's what you do today. We hire paid media strategists, designers, project managers, RevOps specialists, and more, and you already know what great looks like in those roles. You've hired marketers in the US, and you know what they expect.

Our team spans several continents, and most of our clients are US based. We require C1/C2 English fluency and at least 6 hours a day of overlap with US East Coast business hours.

About Us

ProperExpression is a boutique growth marketing agency specializing in wealth management. For 7 years, we've been the behind-the-scenes growth engine for some of the most innovative firms in the space.

We're a HubSpot Platinum Partner, recognized by Excellence.com and Clutch. We're growing fast, and every hire matters.

We also laugh a lot, don't take ourselves too seriously, and look for any excuse to eat good food. Sharing food experiences has become an internal culture with a life of its own.

Why ProperExpression ?

• Real impact: the people you find will build our next chapter.

• Real growth: we're expanding fast, and strong performers rise quickly.

• A culture that works: fast-paced, collaborative, supportive, and built for people who love winning together.

• Fully remote: work from Canada, Latin America, or Ukraine, with at least 6 hours of overlap with US East Coast time.

Requirements

The Fundamentals:

• High energy. You genuinely love talking to people, and it shows on the 8th call of the day.

• Great judgment. You enjoy leading meetings and know when to pause, set boundaries, or take a different approach.

• A great listener. You ask the follow-up question, and you notice what people don't say.

• Organized. You know where every candidate stands, and nobody goes dark on your watch.

• Honest. You tell candidates the truth about the role, even when it's a no.

• Driven, self-starting, and always looking to get better.

Direct Experience (The Must-Haves):

• 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting: sourcing, screening, scheduling, and offers.

• You're a marketing recruiter. Most of your recent hires have been marketers.

• You've hired marketers based in the US.

• You use LinkedIn Recruiter (Lite, Pro, or Corporate).

• You source candidates and run candidate calls yourself, every day.

• You've run hiring for 3 or more open roles at once.

• You've worked in an applicant tracking system and kept it up to date.

• C1/C2 English, written and spoken.

Direct Experience (Preferred but Not Required):

• Upwork sourcing. We use it every week, so this puts you ahead.

• You've worked at a marketing agency.

• AI-curious. Experience with AI tools is a plus. If you're new to them, show us how quickly you learn and adapt.

• Breezy HR or ClickUp. These are the tools we run hiring in.

You're Probably a Fit If

• You leave a great call with more energy than you started with.

• You bring fresh ideas, spot ways to make a process better, and love letting the data show you what's working.

• You've found a great marketer on LinkedIn that nobody else spotted.

• You've told a candidate "this isn't the right fit" and they thanked you for it.

You're Probably Not a Fit If

• You'd rather send emails than pick up the phone.

• Your recruiting has been mostly posting jobs and waiting.

• Marketing is one of many areas you've hired for, or you last hired a marketer years ago.

Responsibilities

Find great people

• Source marketers on LinkedIn Recruiter and Upwork, plus job boards and referrals, for 3 or more open roles at a time.

• Write and send outreach people want to answer.

• Write and refresh our job postings, and post them where the right people will see them.

• Build real relationships with strong candidates, and keep a bench warm for the roles we'll open next.

Run a great process

• Review applications and move candidates through our pipeline.

• Run screening calls, score them against our written bar, and guide tricky conversations with confidence.

• Schedule interviews, case studies, and assessments with the hiring team.

• Help prepare offers and extend them to candidates.

Keep everyone in the loop

• Keep candidates updated, fast, at every stage. Nobody waits in the dark.

• Give hiring managers and the team clear updates on where every role stands.

• Keep every candidate's card in Breezy and ClickUp current.

Make hiring better

• Track the numbers for each role (replies, screens, time to hire, where hires come from) and bring one fix each month.

• Stay current on the US marketing talent market and the countries we hire from: pay, where great marketers are, and what they want.

• Find ways to make our hiring faster and better, without costing more.

Benefits

• Flexible working hours

• Generous PTO

• Professional development

• Annual company retreat

• Fully remote work environment

Application Instructions

Please read and follow these instructions so your application is considered.

1. This role requires marketing recruiting as your current focus, US marketing hires, and LinkedIn Recruiter. If you don't have all three, your application won't be considered.

2. Submit your resume in PDF format.

3. In the "Additional Comments" field, tell us: what is your favorite food and why?

4. Please don't email or message us on LinkedIn until we've reached out to you.

5. If we schedule an intro call, be sure to ask how a bison became the spirit animal of ProperExpression .

We're looking forward to getting to know you!

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.

• Extreme Ownership: We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

• The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.

• Methodology & Rigor: We don’t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.

• Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.

• The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

• Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

• Unlimited Leaves: We don’t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.

• Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.

• Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the implementation owner of a customer’s success with SAFE, from the first onboarding call to a working, trusted deployment delivering value as a key part of their business processes. You sit between the customer's implementation teams and SAFE's engineering teams, understanding all sides well enough to translate between them. You have detailed product knowledge to be able to implement customers' business needs using existing features, and create customisations as needed.

In this role you will have a strong understanding of SAFE/Industry best practice, guiding the customer to achieve their outcomes on the SAFE Platform, This will include educating and enabling the customer, as well as a technical implementation.

You build the scripts, configure the platform, integrations, agents and automations that get a customer live. You diagnose what stands in the way of a customer's success, and where necessary engage internal teams with a clear, evidenced problem statement with an agreed outcome. You hold the end-to-end picture of how SAFE works, so a conversation between a customer and SAFE teams reaches a decision quickly.

You use AI tooling every day to engage with customers more effectively, work with more autonomy and enable others, improving existing processes and tooling to achieve rapid deployments and value realisation.

What you'll do:

Own customer onboarding and delivery

• Lead technical onboarding for assigned customers: scope, plan, configure, integrate and confirm the customer is getting value.

• Own each engagement to a defined outcome. Keep the customer and internal teams informed on progress, risks and next steps.

• Travel to customer sites for workshops, deployments and escalations.

• Write scripts and lightweight automations that speed up onboarding, data loading, integration set-up and repeat tasks.

Technical implementation

• Collect technical details from customers about their environment, data sources and integrations: authentication, permissions, network constraints, payload formats and expected behaviour.

• Configure and customise the SAFE platform to meet customer business needs, making direct product fixes where appropriate.

• Build and test customer-specific workflows and AI agents, using SAFE and third-party APIs as needed.

• Build custom solutions to achieve customer outcomes where product gaps exist.

• Create tooling to accelerate delivery processes and automate repetitive tasks.

• Diagnose failed or incomplete integrations and data flows.

Debug and troubleshoot

• Reproduce and investigate issues using logs, platform telemetry and platform knowledge. Work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, with or without AI tooling

• Present each issue to engineering with the evidence: what happens, what should happen, who it affects, and what you have already ruled out.

• Stay with the issue until the customer has a resolution or an agreed workaround.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:
We're seeking a Senior Business Architect (Canada) for ACCC: someone who can go deep on brokerage operations across accounts, trading, clearing, settlement, custody, and asset servicing, and can turn that operating knowledge into clear requirements and turn that into clear requirements Product and Engineering can build.
You are the bridge between how the Canadian brokerage actually works and the product roadmap. You lead structured discovery with counterparts and work out how partner firms, account opening, clearing, custody, and day-to-day operations fit together, then write that down as epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and open decisions.
Success is measured by: requirements and designs teams can build without guessing; a clear split between what the system does and what people still do at launch; solution options that Product and Engineering can sequence; and a backlog tied to ACCC milestones and capabilities.

What You'll Walk Into
You won't be starting from zero. You'll be owning live problems:

•
Operations scope: defining what ACCC must support across accounts, trading, clearing, settlement, custody, books and records, and asset servicing.

•
Partner firm handoffs: what partners send us, what we send back, and who does what across accounts, trades, cash, and securities.

•
Account and trade lifecycle: account opening, settlement in Canada through CDS, failed trades, transfers, and corporate actions such as dividends and splits.

•
Platform gap analysis: comparing today's Alpaca platform with Canadian brokerage operations requirements to decide what we reuse, change, or build.

•
Launch scope: separating what must work on day one from what follows, including registered accounts (TFSA, RRSP, RESP), more products, and more partner services.

•
Open decisions: logging each one with an owner so it gets closed or consciously deferred.

What you’ll own
Requirements across ACCC’s brokerage operations, and what comes next:

• Map brokerage operations end to end across these areas: broker onboarding, account carrying, trade clearing/settlement, custody of cash/securities, books & records, financing (if in scope), corporate actions, transfers, exceptions, and reporting

• Help define target operating models and capability designs: what the platform must do, what stays manual (for now), what is control vs. feature, what is Canada-specific vs. reusable globally

• Turn regulatory and operational obligations into product requirements: what the platform must do, what stays manual (for now), what is control vs. feature, what is Canada-specific vs. reusable globally

• Write epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that Product and Engineering can build against.

• Produce the artifacts teams actually use: process maps, capability matrices, requirement specs, data/field definitions, state machines, exception catalogs, RACI for build vs. run, and decision logs

• Work with Product Managers and Engineering to sequence MVP → launch → scale: must-haves for go-live vs. post-launch backlog across these operating areas (e.g. additional account types, asset classes, IB services, automation)

• Interface across Product, Engineering, Ops, and Compliance: translate business need into buildable scope; escalate open decisions with clear owners and options

• Run structured discovery: workshops, SME interviews, gap analysis vs. current Alpaca platform, peer operating models where useful

• Keep requirements automation- and AI-aware : flag where STP, rules, and AI-assisted exception handling should be designed in—not bolted on later

• Flag where straight-through processing, rules, and AI-assisted exception handling should be designed from the start.

• Maintain a living requirements backlog tied to ACCC milestones, risks, and open decisions

Who you are (Must-Haves)

• Excited about what Alpaca is building and about standing up Canadian brokerage operations.

• Comfortable operating as a senior IC reporting to the President — driving clarity across Product, Engineering, Ops, and Compliance without needing a formal team.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent.

• 8+ years as a business architect, business analyst, consultant or in product operations within brokerage, clearing, custody, or capital markets.

• Comfortable translating brokerage operating processes and regulatory requirements into product language (you don’t need to be a lawyer or CCO)

• Strong structured analysis: flows, entities, states, exceptions, controls, and what breaks if a step is missing.

• Clear writing: specs, diagrams, and decisions others can execute against.

• Collaborative with Ops SMEs, PMs, Engineering, and Compliance; curious enough to dig; disciplined enough to close loops

• Bias to precision over vague “requirements fluff”; you know when something is a product change vs. an ops procedure vs. a policy decision

• Judgment to tell a product change from an operating procedure or a policy decision.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills across operations, product, engineering, and compliance.

Who you might be (Nice-to-Haves)

• Experience on a carrying, self-clearing, or custody build.

• Canadian dealer, carrying broker, or introducing broker experience.

• Prior business architecture or enterprise/solution architecture exposure in capital markets

• Familiarity with CDS or Canadian settlement workflows.

• Experience with registered accounts or Canadian tax requirements (TFSA, RRSP, RESP).

• Background with API or platform brokerage products.

• Experience working at a fintech, startup, or greenfield launch.

• AI-native workflow: recurring use of tools like Cursor, Claude, or ChatGPT in spec drafting, discovery synthesis, and gap analysis.

• Experience shaping greenfield capability roadmaps with executive sponsors

How We Take Care of You:

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

postings.title: Creative Director, AI Brand Production
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

We're looking for a creative director who has already moved past the deck and the agency roster: someone who turns "how should Clara look and sound here?" into a shipped campaign, a visual system, or a production workflow — by next week, not next quarter — and is accountable for Clara being recognizable and consistent everywhere our customers, prospects and candidates encounter us, across MX, BR, CO and AR.

This is an in-house brand governance role, and a hands-on one, with a manager path. You set the standard and you make the defining work yourself — no roster to delegate to. You also build the AI-powered production that lets everyone else — the design team, marketing, sales, agencies and freelancers — ship on-brand work at volume without losing the craft. As the brand practice grows, leading Clara's brand designers is part of the plan.

You'll report to the Head of Design and partner closely with Product, Marketing and Clara's founders on the moments that define the brand.

What you'll do

• Own Clara's brand identity end to end: visual system, voice and tone, motion, and the narrative that ties product, marketing and culture together.

• Lead by making: concept development, art direction and hands-on craft on Clara's highest-stakes brand moments — launches, campaigns, the website, major events.

• Build AI-powered brand production: the workflows, templates and guardrails that let designers, non-designers and external partners produce on-brand assets without bottlenecking through you — built and iterated, not just imagined.

• Set the quality bar for AI-assisted output and the review loop that keeps it on brand. AI-made should never look AI-made.

• Prototype fast, validate faster: go from brief to working asset in days, test it against real usage and perception, kill what doesn't work and scale what does.

• Make the brand show up consistently across every touchpoint, from the website to the sales deck to the app itself, working with Product Marketing, Growth and Sales.

• Level up Clara's brand designers on craft and AI-native ways of working, and grow into leading the team.

What you'll bring

• A portfolio of brand and campaign work you made yourself, recently, that shaped how a company was perceived.

• Excellent craft across visual identity, typography, voice and motion. You're the person others go to for how something should look.

• Hands-on experience using generative AI in creative production — not a point of view on it, but workflows you've built and shipped that others use to produce at scale without diluting quality.

• Enough comfort with AI-assisted building tools to prototype, template and automate on your own. You don't need to be an engineer; you need to not depend on one.

• Experience evolving or scaling a brand across markets, channels or partners, and the operational instincts to explain how it worked.

• A bias toward building and shipping over speccing and aligning: you'd rather put a rough version in front of people this week than circulate a perfect brief next month.

• Strong written and verbal communication in English.

Experience that could help

• Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese, given Clara's footprint across MX, BR, CO and AR.

• In-house experience, or a clear reason for wanting to move in-house.

• Experience working directly with founders or C-level on brand-defining moments.

• Background in fintech, B2B SaaS, or another trust-driven category. What matters most is a track record of building brands people remember, but the context helps.

Where you'll work

This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

• Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

• Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

• Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

• Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

postings.title: Treasury Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
At EBANX, you’ll help expand access to payments and technology in some of the world’s most dynamic markets. We’re a unicorn-status fintech, AI-powered, and scaling fast across 29 countries and counting.

Our platform connects leading global companies to more than 1 billion consumers, enabling seamless cross-border payments where it matters most. We build with purpose, move with speed, and create solutions that are both innovative and inclusive.

If you’re looking to be part of a company that’s transforming the future of payments with clarity, ambition, and real-world impact — we’d love to meet you.

As Treasury Solutions & Expansion Specialist , your mission will be to shape how EBANX enters and scales in new markets from a Treasury and FX perspective. Treasury is responsible for the liquidity, FX and banking structures that make cross-border payments possible across our markets, and in this role you will design and execute them for new countries, products and partners, including stablecoin solutions.

What your day-to-day will look like

• Lead expansion projects into new markets from a Treasury and FX perspective: settlement structure, funds flows, local and correspondent banks, and providers.

• Structure and analyze deals and partnerships, including financial modeling, financial risk assessments and the impact on liquidity, cash flow and FX.

• Build and manage relationships with banks, FX providers, acquirers and other financial institutions, and negotiate fees, spreads and service levels.

• Support contract review and negotiation with Legal and Compliance, and the regulatory analysis of each new market.

• Contribute to stablecoin initiatives (on/off ramps, custody, providers, Treasury use cases), focusing on analysis and structuring.

• Partner with Product, Legal, Compliance and Treasury to drive projects from definition to execution, tracking deliverables and deadlines.

• Ensure governance, internal controls and compliance with local regulations in the structures you set up.

• Prepare memos, presentations and materials for internal stakeholders, banks and partners, including directors and C-level executives.

What you need to shine in this role

• Proven experience in Treasury, FX, Cash Management, corporate finance or banking.

• Track record leading or actively contributing to multi-team projects, ideally in new markets or complex structures.

• Strong financial modeling skills.

• Solid understanding of cross-border flows and working with financial institutions.

• Working knowledge of crypto and stablecoins.

• Fluent English, spoken and written.

• Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills, with the autonomy to work through ambiguity.

Bonus points if you have

• Experience in fintechs, payments companies, banks or high-growth technology companies.

• Participation in banking integration projects, the structuring of new legal entities or M&A due diligence.

• Experience in emerging markets or across several Latin American countries.

• Experience with offshore operations and global treasury processes.

• Familiarity with SQL, Python or BI tools, and a track record of automating or improving processes.

• Spanish or Portuguese, depending on the location.

EBANX offers

• Performance Bonus: Annual bonus program based on company results.

• Meal Allowance: Monthly allowance to support your meals.

• EBANX Education: Financial assistance for undergraduate, graduate, and MBA programs to support your professional growth.

• EBANX Skills: Dedicated budget for courses, certifications, and workshops to encourage continuous learning.

• Language Classes: Language classes to support your personal and professional development.

• Health & Well-being: Medical and dental plans with extensive coverage, including support for dependents and wellness programs.

• Flexible Work Culture: Semi-flexible hours, additional day off on your birthday, and year-end break to support work-life balance.

• Well-being Program: Access to activities and resources that promote physical and mental health.

Learn more about our #ebanxlife on LinkedIn and Instagram , and see what it’s like to be part of a global team that breaks barriers, creates opportunities, and celebrates every achievement together.

✨ An Out Of The Ordinary career is waiting for you here!

About Aleph

Aleph is a global leader accelerating digital advertising, and fintech solutions across more than 130 high-growth markets. With more than 20 years of experience and strategic partnerships with over 50 of the world's leading digital platforms, Aleph connects media, payments, and local market expertise to enable platforms and businesses to grow and operate globally with speed and compliance. With teams in more than 90 offices worldwide, Aleph combines global scale with deep local execution. Beyond business impact, Aleph drives digital inclusion through its education initiative, Digital Ad Expert, member of UNESCO’s Global Skills Academy.


We are looking for a Senior Client Partner (Digital Advertising Sales) to support our team in Argentina.
 
Are you an experienced digital advertising sales professional - a senior account executive, key account manager or client partner - with a passion for building strong client relationships and driving business growth? Join us to represent a leading digital platform, working closely with advertisers, media agencies, and decision-makers in the Argentine market.

What You Will Do
• Evangelize and promote the digital platform through live client and agency engagement.

• Drive advertising sales (ventas de publicidad digital) while educating customers on product features, benefits, and best practices.

• Build excitement, awareness, and interest in the platform through creative, consultative solutions.

• Foster and maintain strong, lasting relationships with decision-makers at media agencies and direct advertisers.

• Represent the company positively within the market and actively contribute to customer satisfaction.

• Stay ahead of digital advertising trends and use data and insights to guide client strategies.

• Collaborate with internal teams to continuously improve the client experience.

What We Are Looking For
• 5+ years of experience in digital advertising sales (display, video, native, programmatic) with a strong portfolio of agency and direct advertiser clients.

• Strong understanding of the digital advertising landscape - platforms, ad products, ad tech, and market trends.

• Proven ability to deliver engaging presentations and tell a compelling story.

• Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills - written, verbal, and interpersonal.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

• Energetic, goal-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Existing, close relationships with key decision-makers in the local market (agencies and advertisers in Buenos Aires and Argentina).

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or Business.

• Fluent in English.

What Will Make Us Really Love You
• You bring a track record of success in a similar role, with hands-on experience.

• You are not afraid to question the status quo and bring fresh, out-of-the-box ideas to the table.

• You anticipate challenges before they arise and take initiative to find effective solutions.

• You have an eye for detail.

• You thrive on teamwork and also bring a driven, goal-oriented spirit.

• You are genuinely enthusiastic about advertising, ad tech, and staying ahead of industry trends.

• You communicate with internal and external stakeholders in a positive and approachable way.

Why Join Aleph
• Impact: your work directly connects brands and consumers in meaningful ways, shaping the future of digital advertising in Argentina and beyond.

• Growth: we give you the freedom to grow and create within the company, whatever your position, and our internal talent gets real growth opportunities.

• Learning: our state-of-the-art workshops keep you on top of the latest insights in digital advertising.

• Team culture: join a diverse, multicultural team that values different perspectives, experiences, and talents, and where creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas are celebrated.

• Market context: work with leading brands, platforms, and publishers in a global footprint, in one of Latin America’s most dynamic digital advertising markets.

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, and our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.
We use Lever, our recruitment management platform, which includes AI-powered features that may assist our hiring team in reviewing applications, analyzing CVs, and identifying relevant qualifications. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people. For more information about how your personal data is processed, including your rights in relation to AI-assisted processing, please see our Candidate Privacy Policy or contact us at privacy@alephdigital.com.

postings.title: GTM, Compensation Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.  

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

As our Compensation Manager, you will own how Profound pays and motivates its go-to-market team. Sitting within GTM Operations, you will partner with Sales and Post-Sales leadership to design incentive plans that drive the right behavior, and you will run the comp engine behind them: calculations, systems, and payouts. You will work very closely with our Payroll team so every rep is paid accurately and on time, and with Finance so plans are modeled, budgeted, and accounted for correctly. This is a 0-to-1 role: you will build the comp function's systems, processes, and controls as our GTM team scales.

What you’ll do

Incentive design

 - Own incentive plan design across GTM roles, including Account Executives, SDRs, Account Managers, Engagement Managers, and other Post-Sales and Sales roles

 - Partner with Sales and Post-Sales leadership to translate GTM strategy (new logo, expansion, retention) into plan mechanics: pay mix, rates, accelerators, ramps, and SPIFs

 - Partner with GTM Ops on quota setting, capacity, and territory alignment so targets, coverage, and plans fit together each planning cycle

 - Partner with Finance to model plan cost, attainment scenarios, and earnings distribution, and to keep comp within budget

Comp operations and payouts

 - Run the commissions cycle end to end: crediting, calculations, review, approvals, and payout

 - Partner very closely with Payroll on payout files, timing, and reconciliation so commissions and SPIFs are paid accurately and on schedule

 - Own plan documents, participant acknowledgments, and the comp calendar

 - Communicate plans and changes to the field clearly and simply, and be the go-to resource for comp questions

 - Run a consistent process for inquiries, disputes, and exceptions, and flag recurring exceptions as plan-design issues rather than one-off fixes

Systems, reporting, and compliance

 - Build and own our comp systems, including selecting, implementing, and administering a commission platform integrated with Salesforce, HRIS, and payroll

 - Partner with Revenue Systems and GTM Engineering to keep bookings, roster, and crediting data clean and in sync across systems

 - Build reporting and dashboards on attainment, payout cost, and plan effectiveness for reps, leaders, and Finance

 - Partner with Accounting on monthly commission accruals, with documentation and controls that hold up to audit

 - Use AI and automation to remove manual work, such as data validation, discrepancy checks, and payout estimates for reps


WHO YOU ARE

 - 3 to 5+ years of experience in sales compensation, GTM or revenue operations, or FP&A, with hands-on ownership of both plan design and comp operations

 - Deep understanding of incentive mechanics, including quotas, accelerators, ramps, draws, clawbacks, and SPIFs, across both new business and post-sales roles

 - Strong Salesforce knowledge, especially how opportunity and booking data flows into commission calculations

 - Track record partnering with Payroll and Finance to deliver accurate, on-time payouts and clean month-end close

 - Highly analytical, with advanced Excel or Sheets modeling skills; SQL experience is a plus, not required

 - A natural business partner who builds trust quickly with sales leaders and reps and can explain comp mechanics simply

 - Exceptional attention to detail and sound judgment handling confidential pay data

 - Thrives in ambiguity with a 0-to-1 mindset, and is energized by building structure, processes, and tools where none exist yet

 - Practical AI fluency: you have used AI assistants or automation tools to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience standing up a comp function or commission platform at a fast-growing, early-stage SaaS or AI company

 - Experience with HRIS and payroll integrations, and with multi-country or international comp plans


LOCATION

NYC preferred; remote or other locations (SF, Boston, London) considered. This role is for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

For this role, the expected base salary range is $200,000 to $220,000 (US) and £100,000 to £140,000 (UK). Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.

Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

Our client is a family-owned Part 135 private aviation operator based in Nashville, Tennessee. The company focuses on operational excellence and customer service, offering a collaborative work environment with individual recognition, stability, growth potential, and internal opportunities.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Charter Sales Representative will manage private aviation charter inquiries from initial quoting through booking and trip coordination, supporting wholesale and retail customers. This role involves working with brokers, direct customers, and internal teams to maximize fleet utilization while delivering responsive customer service.

The ideal candidate has charter sales or relevant aviation experience, strong relationship-building skills, and the ability to manage time-sensitive requests. TRIP SCHEDULING & COORDINATION

CUSTOMER & BROKER RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Our client provides managed services involving Cin7 Core implementation, inventory management, production costing, and accounting system reconciliation.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Cin7 Core Consultant (Managed Services) will implement, optimize, and maintain Cin7 Core for managed services clients, ensuring accurate inventory management, production costing, and integration with QuickBooks Online or Xero.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role involving work within live client accounts, troubleshooting system issues, supporting implementations, and providing training and documentation. The ideal candidate has extensive Cin7 Core experience, strong inventory accounting knowledge, and the ability to resolve complex operational and financial discrepancies.




LOCATION

Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM EST | Full-Time




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


CIN7 CORE IMPLEMENTATION & OPTIMIZATION

 - Lead Cin7 Core implementations, system cleanups, and ongoing client account management.

 - Configure and maintain products, SKUs, inventory locations, opening stock balances, and user accounts.

 - Identify and resolve configuration issues within live client environments.
   
   


PRODUCTION & INVENTORY COSTING

 - Configure production costing for brands working with contract manufacturers.

 - Manage Bills of Materials (BOMs), assemblies, production orders, and service purchase orders for manufacturing fees.

 - Support landed cost allocation, FIFO inventory costing, and Goods Received Not Invoiced (GRNI) processes.
   
   


ACCOUNTING INTEGRATION & RECONCILIATION

 - Manage Cin7 Core integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero.

 - Configure account mappings and troubleshoot failed accounting postings.

The Expansion Manager will play a pivotal role in identifying and executing new business opportunities, establishing strategic partnerships, and navigating regulatory landscapes. This role requires close collaboration with internal teams to develop and implement go-to-market strategies in South Asia and across the region.

This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate professional who believes in financial inclusion, digital currencies, and driving innovation in APAC’s financial ecosystem. Frequent local and international travel is required.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and entrepreneurial leader with a proven track record in business development, market expansion, and partnership management. You have:

• A degree in Business, Management, or Finance (MBA preferred).

• A proactive, independent, and well-organized approach to work.

• The ability to thrive autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

• A history of successfully building and managing strategic partnerships.

Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

Market Strategy & Execution

Market Research & Competitive Analysis

• Monitor regulatory changes and assess their business impact.

Stakeholder & Government Engagement

• Manage relationships with regulators, government agencies, and industry bodies.

• Represent the company at key meetings and industry events.

Marketing & Community Engagement

• Support and participate in fintech events, conferences, and meetups to enhance brand visibility.

Requirements:

• Deep knowledge of the South Asia market, culture, and regulations in blockchain, fintech, finance, remittances, and payments.

• Analytical, strategic, and results-driven with problem-solving skills.

• Entrepreneurial background and project management expertise.

• Comfortable in fast-paced, evolving environments with international travel readiness.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
