Job Title: GDS Account Support Leader
Grade: Associate Director
Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

Role Overview
The GDS Account Support Leader is accountable for all GDS Account Support priorities across every GDS location, with a primary focus on operational excellence and service delivery excellence. The role holds end-to-end accountability for operational performance, service quality, stakeholder experience, and talent.
Drawing on deep operational insight, the role identifies opportunities for process improvement and transformation. Working in strong collaboration with Global and Regional Account Support teams, it takes learnings from operational excellence to inform key design decisions on process improvements, technology implementation, and the workforce of the future, supporting delivery of the Global Account Support Strategy and EY's growth agenda.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Excellence
• Own operational performance across all GDS locations, including productivity, utilization, cost, quality, and efficiency.
• Build a culture of operational excellence through standardized ways of working, performance management, and continuous improvement.
• Optimize organizational structure, delivery economics, and globally integrated delivery models while maintaining quality, risk, and compliance standards.

Service Delivery Excellence
• Own end-to-end service delivery performance, quality, KPIs, and stakeholder satisfaction, aligned with business and client-serving needs.
• Embed service management disciplines, including service catalogs, service levels, and customer experience measures, to deliver globally consistent, scalable services.
• Lead governance forums and serve as the primary escalation point for significant service, operational, or stakeholder issues.

Process Improvement & Transformation Insight
• Identify process improvement and transformation opportunities using operational data, root-cause analysis, and frontline insight.
• Working with Global and Regional Account Support teams, use learnings from operational excellence to inform design decisions on process improvements, technology implementation, and the workforce of the future.
• Partner with Global Process Owner (GPO) and transformation teams to pilot and embed improvements, including AI and automation, ensuring solutions are operationally ready, scalable, and deliver measurable benefits.

Strategy & Stakeholder Partnership
• Translate the Global Account Support Strategy into operational plans and priorities across all GDS locations.
• Work with Global and Regional Account Support Leaders and Finance leadership as one aligned leadership team and trusted advisor.

Talent & Organization Leadership
• Lead and develop a large, globally distributed, inclusive, and high-performing organization, driving talent and performance management, engagement, retention, and succession.
• Ensure compliance with GDS talent policies, regulatory requirements, and mandatory learning obligations.

Workforce of the Future
• Use operational insight to inform strategic workforce planning, identifying future skill and role needs arising from process change, AI, and automation.
• Champion investment in upskilling and reskilling in digital, data, analytical, and advisory capabilities, with clear career pathways toward higher-value roles.

Success Measures
• Sustained improvement in productivity, utilization, cost efficiency, and quality.
• Consistent achievement of service levels and KPIs, with strong stakeholder satisfaction.
• Process improvement opportunities identified and delivered with measurable benefits, including successful adoption of AI and automation.
• Operational learnings demonstrably informing process, technology, and workforce design decisions.
• Workforce upskilled in future-critical capabilities, with high engagement, retention, and succession readiness.
• Trusted partnerships with Global and Regional Account Support and Finance leadership.
• Effective governance, risk management, and compliance across all operations.

Skills & Experience
Essential
• Significant leadership experience within Finance or professional services environments, leading large, geographically dispersed teams in complex matrix organizations.
• Proven track record delivering operational excellence and service delivery excellence across multi-location shared services or GDS environments.
• Strong continuous improvement capability, with experience identifying improvement opportunities through data, root-cause analysis, and performance insight, and translating them into process and technology change.
• Strong financial and operational management capabilities, including productivity, cost, and workforce planning.
• Experience managing senior stakeholder relationships and building collaborative leadership partnerships across global and regional organizations.
• Experience building future-ready capabilities through upskilling and reskilling, with a strong understanding of how AI and GenAI reshape roles, services, and operating models.
• Demonstrated success leading change with measurable business outcomes, supported by excellent executive communication, influencing, and leadership skills.

Preferred
• Experience leading Account Support, Engagement Support, Quote-to-Cash, or related Finance operations within a global professional services environment.
• Exposure to large-scale automation, AI, analytics, and digital transformation programs.
• Knowledge of global operating models, service management, shared services governance, and enterprise transformation frameworks.
• Certifications or experience in Lean Six Sigma, Agile, Change Management, or Digital Transformation methodologies.

Why This Role Matters
This role is critical to enabling EY's Global Finance strategy and the Global Account Support Strategy. By driving operational excellence and service delivery excellence across all GDS locations, and working in strong collaboration with Global and Regional Account Support teams to turn operational learnings into better process, technology, and workforce design decisions, the GDS Account Support Leader ensures Account Support delivers consistent, scalable, and high-quality services that create exceptional value for Finance stakeholders.

Apply now »

postings.title: Regional Information Security Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Ciudad : San Isidro 
Estado : Buenos Aires (AR-B) 
País : Argentina (AR) 
Número de Requisición : 49070 






En Bunge buscamos un/a Regional Information Security Manager para sumarse al equipo de Business Technology. La posición será el principal referente de ciberseguridad para Argentina, impulsando la implementación de la estrategia global de seguridad de la información y actuando como socio estratégico de los equipos de tecnología y del negocio.



La persona será responsable de identificar y mitigar riesgos de ciberseguridad, acompañar iniciativas regionales y globales, coordinar actividades vinculadas a incidentes de seguridad, promover la adopción de controles y fortalecer la cultura de ciberseguridad dentro de la organización. Se trata de una posición con alta exposición y fuerte interacción con stakeholders regionales y globales, que requerirá influencia, colaboración y capacidad para impulsar proyectos tecnológicos.


Principales responsabilidades:



• Ejecutar iniciativas y programas regionales de ciberseguridad alineados con la estrategia global de seguridad de la información de Bunge.
• Realizar evaluaciones de riesgo, revisiones de vulnerabilidades y análisis de controles para identificar oportunidades de mitigación.
• Liderar y coordinar proyectos de seguridad enfocados en la adopción de nuevas capacidades, tecnologías y controles de ciberseguridad.
• Brindar soporte y coordinación ante incidentes de seguridad, participando en actividades de investigación, contención, remediación y análisis de causa raíz.
• Asesorar a equipos de tecnología y líderes de negocio respecto de riesgos, controles y mejores prácticas de seguridad de la información.
• Promover programas de concientización y cultura de ciberseguridad dentro de la organización.
• Monitorear, analizar y reportar métricas, riesgos y planes de remediación a stakeholders regionales y globales.



Perfil técnico requerido:



• Título universitario en Ingeniería en Sistemas de Información, Ingeniería Informática, Licenciatura en Ciberseguridad o carreras afines (excluyente).
• Experiencia en ciberseguridad, gestión de riesgos tecnológicos, seguridad de la información o disciplinas relacionadas (excluyente).
• Conocimiento de marcos y estándares de seguridad como NIST, ISO 27001 u otros frameworks reconocidos de la industria (deseable).
• Experiencia participando en programas de gestión de riesgos, seguridad corporativa, compliance o gestión de incidentes (excluyente).
• Capacidad para liderar proyectos e influenciar equipos en la toma de decisiones (excluyente).
• Inglés avanzado (excluyente).
• Certificaciones como CISSP, CISM, Security+, GIAC o equivalentes (deseable).



Ubicación:



San Isidro, Buenos Aires.

En Bunge (NYSE: BG), nuestro propósito es conectar a los agricultores con los consumidores para entregar alimentos, piensos y combustibles esenciales al mundo. Como proveedor líder de soluciones agroindustriales, nuestro equipo de ~34,000 empleados dedicados se asocia con agricultores de todo el mundo para trasladar los productos agrícolas desde donde se cultivan hasta donde se necesitan, de manera más rápida, inteligente y eficiente. Somos un líder mundial en originación, almacenamiento, distribución, procesamiento y refinación de oleaginosas, que ofrece una amplia cartera de aceites, grasas y proteínas de origen vegetal. Trabajamos junto con nuestros clientes en ambos extremos de la cadena de valor para ofrecer productos de calidad y desarrollar soluciones innovadoras y personalizadas que aborden las necesidades cambiantes de los consumidores. Con más de 200 años de experiencia y presencia en más de 50 países, estamos comprometidos a fortalecer la seguridad alimentaria mundial, promover la sostenibilidad y ayudar a las comunidades a prosperar donde operamos. Bunge tiene su domicilio social en Ginebra, Suiza, y su sede corporativa en St. Louis, Missouri. Obtenga más información en Bunge.com.



Cada día, nuestra gente ejemplifica estos valores, que representan la esencia de Bunge:


• SOMOS UN ÚNICO EQUIPO – Colaborativos, respetuosos, inclusivos
• LIDERAMOS EL CAMINO – Ágiles, empoderados, innovadores
• HACEMOS LO CORRECTO – Con seguridad, sustentabilidad e integridad



Reconocemos que nuestro éxito depende de las diversas perspectivas que cada uno de nuestros colaboradores aporta a Bunge. Nos esforzamos por promover acciones que fomenten una cultura de pertenencia. A nivel global, apoyamos iniciativas como los Principios para el Empoderamiento de las Mujeres, de ONU Mujeres. Colaboramos con organizaciones como Disability:IN, un referente en la inclusión de personas con discapacidad y trabajamos continuamente en pro de nuestro compromiso de dejar un legado positivo en todas las comunidades en las que operamos.

Si esto le suena bien, ¡únase a nosotros! Valoramos e invertimos en personas que creen en nuestro propósito y están entusiasmadas por vivirlo cada día: personas que están #OrgullosasDeSerBunge.

postings.descriptionText:

Senior Designer

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Designer to create thoughtful, visually compelling digital experiences and campaigns for a global sports brand. This role combines strong design craft, digital expertise, and independent creative thinking, helping translate brand ideas and business objectives into polished, cohesive experiences across digital touchpoints.

You’ll work closely with Creative Directors, designers, strategists, copywriters, UX, technology, production, and account teams to develop work from early concepts through final execution. You’ll bring a strong point of view to the work, contribute meaningfully to creative direction, and take ownership of design projects while collaborating closely with the broader team.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished designer with excellent visual judgment, strong digital and UI sensibility, and a high level of craft. You’re comfortable taking a design problem from a blank page to a polished solution, presenting your thinking to clients and internal teams, giving and receiving thoughtful feedback, and getting hands-on in Figma to bring ideas to life. You’re curious about emerging technologies, AI, culture, and new approaches to design, and you’re interested in how they can expand what’s possible creatively.

Responsibilities:

• Develop high-quality visual concepts and design solutions across digital campaigns, websites, mobile experiences, e-commerce, products, and other digital touchpoints.

• Translate creative briefs, brand strategy, business objectives, and creative direction into clear, compelling visual solutions.

• Take ownership of design projects from initial exploration and concept development through refinement, prototyping, and final delivery.

• Establish a strong visual point of view and contribute to the overall creative direction of assigned projects.

• Apply a high level of craft across typography, composition, hierarchy, layout, color, imagery, interaction, and digital storytelling.

• Create polished designs and prototypes in Figma, working across responsive layouts, components, interactions, and digital experiences.

• Explore multiple creative approaches to a problem, knowing when to push an idea further and when to refine and simplify.

• Collaborate with Creative Directors and other designers to develop work that is strategically grounded, visually distinctive, and appropriate to the brand.

• Partner with strategy, copy, account, UX, technology, production, and other disciplines to develop integrated creative solutions.

• Participate actively in brainstorms, design critiques, creative reviews, workshops, and collaborative working sessions.

• Respond to feedback and evolving project requirements while maintaining the integrity and quality of the design.

• Design within established brand systems while also identifying opportunities to evolve visual language and create new expressions of the brand.

• Work with existing design systems, component libraries, and digital guidelines, contributing improvements when appropriate.

• Consider usability, accessibility, performance, scalability, localization, translation, and technical constraints throughout the design process.

• Collaborate with developers and production teams to ensure design intent is accurately translated into final experiences.

• Provide thoughtful feedback and informal mentorship to more junior designers, helping strengthen their design thinking, craft, and attention to detail.

• Stay informed about contemporary design, digital experiences, visual culture, technology, and emerging creative trends.

• Contribute to a collaborative, curious, and high-performing design culture.

About You

The essentials:

• 5+ years of experience in digital design, visual design, art direction, or a related creative discipline.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating sophisticated design craft, visual thinking, and high-quality digital work across multiple channels and formats.

• Demonstrated experience taking digital design projects from concept through final execution.

• Strong proficiency in Figma, including hands-on experience with visual design, prototyping, responsive layouts, and component-based design.

• Advanced understanding of design fundamentals, including typography, grid, hierarchy, composition, layout, color, imagery, interaction, and visual storytelling.

• Strong digital and UI sensibility, with an understanding of UX principles and the ability to create experiences that are both visually compelling and intuitive.

• Experience translating brand identities and creative direction into cohesive digital experiences.

• Strong conceptual thinking and the ability to develop multiple creative approaches in response to a brief or business challenge.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently, make sound design decisions, and take ownership of projects with appropriate creative guidance.

• Ability to balance creative ambition with practical considerations including usability, accessibility, technical requirements, timelines, and production constraints.

• Experience working closely with multidisciplinary teams, including creative, strategy, UX, copy, technology, production, and account.

• Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design decisions and creative rationale to both creative and non-creative audiences.

• Ability to give and receive constructive feedback and use critique to strengthen the work.

• Experience collaborating with developers and production partners to bring digital designs through implementation.

• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and evolving project requirements.

• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Hands-on experience with AI tools or emerging technologies as part of the creative and design process.

• Strong cultural curiosity and an informed perspective on contemporary design, technology, digital behavior, and visual culture.

• Collaborative, low-ego approach with a genuine interest in contributing to the growth and quality of the broader design team.

Not a must, but a plus:

• Experience working with athletic, apparel, footwear, fashion, lifestyle, retail, or other culturally relevant consumer brands.

• Experience designing for large-scale global brands and complex digital ecosystems.

• Experience working across e-commerce, product launches, seasonal campaigns, and high-traffic consumer digital experiences.

• Experience using AI beyond image generation, including AI-assisted prototyping, code, or emerging creative workflows and automation.

• Experience with motion design, 3D, WebGL, or other forms of interactive design.

• Experience developing or governing enterprise-scale design systems.

Overview

We are looking for a highly analytical Senior Specialist, FP&A who thrives at the intersection of Corporate Finance, Strategic Analysis, and Data Engineering. In this role, you will report numbers and will be the strategic voice that interprets them.

You will bridge the gap between complex financial processes and executive decision-making. Your mission is to maintain a robust global financial data pipeline while providing deep-dive analyses that help stakeholders understand the "why" behind the results.

Key Responsibilities

• Strategic Reporting & Analysis: Lead the month-end closing analysis, providing clear commentary on variances (Actuals vs. Budget/Forecast). You will transform raw data into executive-level reports that highlight trends, risks, and opportunities for the NAMER and Global regions.

• Stakeholder Management: Act as a key finance partner for Regional Directors and Department Heads. You will translate complex technical logic and financial data into actionable insights, helping non-finance leaders manage their budgets and headcount effectively.

• P&L Architecture & Profitability: Build and optimize multi-dimensional P&L reporting. You will analyze profitability down to the Client and Departmental level, ensuring that global allocations and intercompany markups are both accurate and strategically aligned.

• Systems Integration & Automation: Develop and maintain API connections (Workday, Salesforce, Greenhouse) to automate data flow.

• Data Ingestion & SQL Modeling: Architect complex SQL queries within BigQuery to consolidate global data. You will ensure that the "Actuals vs. Forecast" reconciliations are seamless and require minimal manual intervention.

• Process Integrity & Governance: Act as the final gatekeeper for data accuracy. You will identify logic errors or "noise" in financial models before they reach executive reviews, ensuring 100% confidence in the numbers presented to the CFO.

Technical & Professional Requirements

• Finance Foundations: Advanced understanding of P&L structures, Budgeting/Forecasting cycles, and the nuances between Management and Statutory reporting.

• Data Engineering & Scripting: Proficiency in SQL (BigQuery) is essential. Experience with Python or Javascript/Apps Script for API handling and workflow automation is highly valued.

• BI & Visualization: Proven track record of designing executive dashboards in Looker Studio (or similar) that drive strategic decision-making.

• Systems Expertise: Familiarity with ERPs ( Netsuite/Lucanet ) and CRM/HRIS tools ( Salesforce, Workday, Greenhouse ).

• Advanced English.

postings.title: Associate Audience Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

This role focuses on delivering high-quality audience analyses to support new business appraisals. You will gain an understanding of the business and goals to identify the target audience including behavior, preferences, and trends. These insights will be used to inform planning, targeting, and creative strategies for campaigns. You play a critical role in the Power Digital new business process and will work collaboratively across multiple teams. Success is measured by meeting deadlines, delivering analysis with minimal revisions, effective task management in Asana, and contributing to a collaborative, innovative work environment.

Responsibilities:

• Own New Business Audience Analyses - Manage all new business appraisal audience analysis requirements

• Ensure timely and accurate delivery to support the revenue division

• Support Existing Client Needs - help the team complete audience analyses for existing clients (based on new business appraisal demand)

• Support Tool Integration - Help research, onboard, and optimize new tools and technologies to enhance the audience development process and improve efficiency

• Support Output Enhancement - Help refine and improve the new business audience analysis process(es) and template(s) to increase efficiencies

• Contribute to a collaborative environment by actively participating in team projects, sharing ideas, and providing constructive feedback

• Demonstrate a willingness to learn, stay informed about industry trends, and proactively develop new skills

• Prioritize tasks, manage multiple assignments, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

• Ownership of tasks, identify challenges, and suggest solutions to improve processes or outcomes

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

• Experience working with large datasets to analyze audience behavior, preferences, and trends, and leveraging these insights to guide planning, targeting, and creative strategies for advertising campaigns

• Foundational understanding of media fundamentals: funnel/campaign structures, tracking, optimization approaches, and channels

• Highly dependable, self-starter, high energy, positive attitude with good organization, and time management skills

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, collaborate across different teams, and function in a fast-paced environment

• Team-oriented and collaborative, effective interpersonal skills, organized, detail-oriented, and punctual

• Familiarity with audience platforms like Nielsen, MRI-Simmons, Global Web Index, or Comscore. (Ideal but not required)

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• ~25 new business audience requests completed per month

• New business audience analyses + slides completed within 3 business days of request

• Active communication of timelines, roadblocks + delays, pending workflow, days out of office

• Satisfaction of analyst and revenue teams with analysis + slides completed (minimal revisions needed)

• 100% usage of Asana for task and project management

Most Important Things (MITs)

• On time completion of audience analyses for new business

• Clear, proactive communication regarding deadlines and roadblocks ahead of time

• 100% usage of Asana for task and project management

• Growth mindset - open to feedback and always identifying opportunities to improve deliverable output and/or grow skillset

Perks:

• Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities

• Unlimited Time Off available on day one

• Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid

• Offices in Buenos Aires, Medellin, San Diego, New York, Atlanta

• Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs

• National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year

• Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm

• Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)

• Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance

• Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/ . If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at recruiting@powerdigital.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .

The Role

At WPP Production, Senior Front-End Developers deliver rich, immersive, and performant digital interactions that bring our clients' storytelling to life. You will help create sophisticated consumer experiences by building and maintaining a mature, large-scale design system and a proprietary ecosystem of shared libraries and global elements (headers, footers, media galleries, analytics wrappers) used by multiple independent development teams using advanced HTML, CSS, and Javascript.

Embedded in a hybrid US and Argentina team, you will manage interdependent code repositories, resolve cross-repository dependencies, and collaborate with designers and engineers to define interaction behaviors.

Above all, your technical voice is just as important as your code. We thrive on open debate and live collaboration—As a Senior Developer we expect you to actively share your technical perspectives, challenge assumptions, and help drive design and engineering decisions.

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

• Expert knowledge of HTML, CSS-SASS, JavaScript, and associated web development/production tools.

• Strong experience maintaining and extending libraries using Vanilla JavaScript

• Proven experience using, actively building, and maintaining a mature, large-scale design system.

• Experience developing website global elements and custom shared libraries - video , analytics, gallery

• Experience building web experiences fully compliant with WCAG 2.2 AA

• Experience with templates and task automation including handlebars, NPM, Gulp and Vite

• Advanced knowledge of responsive web design

• Experience with translating comps and wireframes into flexible and usable code

• Experience implementing pixel perfect designs across a broad range of browsers and devices

• Experience using version control software (git) in multi-developer team

• Experience with developing large customer-facing websites

QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS

• 5+ years’ experience working as a front-end developer

• Desire to assist, guide and coach more junior team members.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, ability to articulate technical concepts to clients and non-technical colleagues

• Experience with web application development

• Thrives when facing new challenges in improving client deliverables

• Relentless attention to detail

• A passion for quality, receptive to feedback, and a desire to write code that produces a bug-free user experience

• Wants to work in a process rich, quality driven organization.

With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

postings.title: Group Creative Director
postings.descriptionText:
Superside is seeking a visionary Group Creative Director to lead creative excellence in an AI-powered studio environment serving enterprise customers. In this senior leadership role, you guide a globally distributed creative organization across branding, advertising, social, presentations, print, and digital experiences. You shape how generative AI is integrated into creative strategy and delivery in ways that elevate quality, increase efficiency, and strengthen customer trust.
 
As a Group Creative Director, you operate as a core leader within a Creative Studio, partnering closely with the General Manager and Account Director. You bring a laser-focus on retention, growth, and customer satisfaction, ensuring creative leadership, delivery quality, and AI-enabled workflows consistently exceed customer expectations. Your leadership helps standardize the customer experience from onboarding through ongoing delivery, while still allowing space for creativity, flexibility, and innovation. This role is ideal for a senior creative leader who believes the future of creativity is human-led and AI-enabled, and who knows how to operationalize that belief at enterprise scale.

What You'll Do
• Set and uphold creative standards for AI-enabled work across all formats and channels.

• Ensure creative output aligns with customer goals, brand strategy, and business outcomes.

• Provide senior-level creative direction and feedback to Creative Directors, ACDs, and Leads.

• Act as a visible creative leader for customers, building confidence and trust over time.

• Partner with the General Manager and Account Director to support retention and account growth goals.

• Ensure creative leadership contributes directly to strong customer satisfaction and renewal outcomes.

• Help standardize the creative experience customers receive from onboarding through delivery.

• Identify opportunities where AI-enabled creativity can unlock additional value for customers.

• Champion thoughtful, practical use of generative AI across concept development, production, and iteration.

• Guide teams in applying AI to improve speed, quality, and consistency without compromising craft.

• Partner with Automation, Web, and AI specialists to align creative vision with tooling and workflows.

• Ensure AI usage supports repeatable, scalable delivery models suitable for enterprise customers.

• Build confidence and autonomy across leadership layers to reduce dependency on your direct involvement.

• Support leaders in balancing creative ambition, operational realities, and customer needs.

• Foster a culture of accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

• Help define what excellent AI-enabled creativity looks like at Superside.

• Promote inclusive, psychologically safe leadership during periods of change.

• Reinforce shared creative standards, review practices, and delivery expectations across teams.

• Connect creative vision to studio-level operating rhythms and priorities.

What You'll Need to Succeed
• 15+ years of experience leading creative teams and large-scale creative work.

• Proven success operating at a Group or Executive Creative Director equivalent level.

• Strong background in enterprise creative delivery across multiple channels.

• Deep understanding of how AI fits into modern creative workflows from concept through production.

• AI Specialist or Advanced Advocate. You are fluent in generative AI tools and workflows such as Krea, Flora, Weavy, Nano Banana, Sora, and similar platforms, and you apply them intentionally as part of creative leadership.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating vision, storytelling, and creative systems thinking.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience partnering with senior clients and executive leadership.

Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.
Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.
Global team, local impact.
Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.
High performance, low ego.
Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.
Impact meets opportunity.
We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.
Grow fast. Lead well.
You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension 
of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance. 
Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

postings.descriptionText:
Capchase is on a mission to transform how hardware and software companies sell and get paid, revolutionizing the equipment financing space. Recently named a 2026 Monitor Best Company in Innovation, we're recognized for embedding flexible payment terms directly into the sales workflow, helping teams close faster without the friction of a separate financing system.



We're the modern platform for financing leading enterprise solutions: built for direct and channel sales motions, with $2B+ funded, approvals in seconds, and a seamless experience for both sellers and buyers. Backed by leading fintech investors including 01A, Thomvest, QED, SciFi, and Invesco, we've raised $700M+ in equity and debt to fuel our growth.



In just over five years, we've scaled from four co-founders to 80+ Capchasers across 10 markets, supporting thousands of companies globally and processing billions in payment volume.



Since our launch in 2020, we've achieved several milestones:
 ➡ 10K+ active vendors, channel partners and buyers
 🙌 Built a team representing over 15 nationalities
 🌎 Active in 10 markets
 📈 Top decile YoY growth
 👫 Built an awesome culture https://www.notion.so/9f798084322a4a719654b38ac108645a?pvs=21.



In December 2024 we reached the top of the Installment Payment, BNPL category on G2 https://www.capchase.com/lp/g2-installment-payment-bnpl-software-report, #1 in B2B.



Why work with us?



Help accelerate an industry!



At Capchase, we are transforming how software and tech-enabled hardware equipment gets financed, we move and innovate fast. We’re always looking for the brightest minds to join us. We’re a diverse team of 15+ nationalities with a shared passion for helping innovative companies thrive. Join the climb with us!



We’re hiring a Product Manager to own critical business outcomes at Capchase: operational efficiency, usage stickiness, new revenue lines and products, etc. You’ll work with tech, design, ops, and our go-to-market teams to ship fast, learn from customers, and raise the quality bar. This is a high-potential role: you don’t need 5+ years - show crisp thinking, strong writing, and the ability to deliver.



What you’ll do:

 - Own a problem space end-to-end: define the customer, the jobs to be done, the metrics, and the roadmap.

 - Ship iteratively: small bets, tight feedback loops, measurable outcomes.

 - Write clearly: PRDs, project tracking, decision logs, and pre-/post-launch reviews.

 - Partner across functions (tech, design, risk/underwriting, ops, legal, go-to-market) to unblock execution.

 - Instrument analytics and guardrail metrics; set success criteria before build; hold the line after launch. Impact is the name of the game.

 - Run discovery with customers and internal experts; translate insights into simple, high-leverage solutions.

 - Communicate trade-offs and priorities to executives; create alignment across time zones.



What we’re looking for:

 - 2–5 years total experience in product or equivalent; high-potential profiles welcome.

 - Consulting + technical backgrounds encouraged (e.g. ~2 years at McKinsey plus engineering/tech experience).

 - Strong writing and structured problem solving; you make complex topics simple.

 - Technical fluency: comfortable with concepts like APIs, data models, and systems constraints; you collaborate deeply with techies.

 - Bias to action and ownership; you measure impact, not activity.

 - Customer-obsessed judgment; you balance speed with quality and risk.

 - Nice to have: fintech/payments, credit/risk, SaaS, experimentation, or AI-driven products.

 - Excellent level of spoken and written English.



📍 If you live in Madrid, you can work hybrid from our office. If you don’t, no problem: this role is open to remote candidates.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

postings.title: Workforce Management - Real Time Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.


Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.



Overview


📍 Remote Global - Central and South America

 

We are seeking a WFM Central - Real Time Analyst to serve as the central governance layer for live operations across multiple Lines of Business (LoB). This is not a traditional monitoring role; it is designed for a high-caliber, forensic operator who functions as an operational architect. You will be a trusted partner to operational leadership, responsible for continuing to evolve our operations to a standardized, and fiscally sound control model.


The ideal candidate possesses the technical "know-how" of a forensic analyst and the communication prowess of a business consultant, capable of telling a compelling story through data to stakeholders ranging from Team Leads to Directors. You won't just report that a queue is at risk; you will diagnose the business impact, identify the root cause, and prescribe the specific levers leadership must pull to preserve SLA and the customer experience. You will be the owner of all aspects of the support queues and ensure we are meeting our customers where they need us.


Responsibilities

 - Stakeholder Storytelling: Distill complex, "noisy" operational signals into high-impact narratives. You must be able to share in-depth observations and supporting data that tell a clear story to stakeholders, at all levels of leadership, on exactly what actions must be taken.

 - Business-Level Analysis: Go beyond the "what" and the "why" to analyze long-term business trends. Evaluate the financial efficiency of SLA safeguarding and the fiscal impact of current staffing vs. demand density.

 - Operational Control & Forensic Auditing: Serve as the authoritative "voice of reason" during incidents. Conduct forensic audits of agent behaviors such as "On Hold" abuse or status irregularities to ensure hidden capacity drains are eliminated.

 - Centralized Core Governance: Enact queue management playbooks for real-time levers across multiple LoBs, ensuring aggressive SLAs are preserved through structured accountability.

 - Strategic Planning & Optimization: Partner with WFM to create a concise feedback loop for continued improvement in planning and scheduling.


Qualifications

 - Exceptional Communication: Proven ability to translate complex data into a clear jargon-free business story. You must be comfortable presenting actionable insights to senior leadership under high-pressure conditions.

 - Advanced Forensic Analysis: Expert proficiency in Google Sheets is required, familiarity with Metabase preferred. You must be able to build complex, automated tracking tools and forensic audits from scratch. Not just for basic queue health, but also analyzing business data that influences our operations.

 - Strategic Judgment: Demonstrated experience making high-judgment decisions that impact the entire business, particularly in environments with aggressive SLAs and fluctuating volume patterns.

 - Operational Architecture: Take ownership in documenting best practices into governed frameworks and playbooks.

 - Resilient Mindset: Comfortable operating autonomously in a 24/7 environment, with the flexibility to adapt to operational needs as part of a high-impact, interdependent team.

 - Systems Fluency: Familiarity with Amazon Connect, Zendesk Omnichannel routing, and Assembled WFM is highly preferred.


What Success Looks Like

 - Operational anomalies are quickly investigated, with root causes clearly identified and communicated, reducing repeat issues and leadership uncertainty

 - You evolve queue management processes from reactive to a documented, standardized, and predictive operating model.

 - Champion of the team’s brand with Operational Leadership. You are looked to as the primary source of truth, relying on your data-driven stories to make critical staffing and operational decisions.

 - Live queues remain stable, governed, and resilient across all supported lines of business, even during unexpected spikes, outages, or incidents

 - Stakeholders receive timely, clear updates during incidents that explain impact, cause, and corrective actions in a concise and actionable manner.



HIRING PROCESS

 - Application

 - Intro Call with Recruiter

 - Case Study

 - Interview with Central WFM - RTA Team Lead

 - Interview with Queue Operations Manager - Core Services

 - Interview with Head of Core Services

 - Final Culture Interview with Executive Leadership
   
   

Quick Note on Scammers: 

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.

postings.title: JD Edwards Data & ERP Consultant
postings.descriptionText:
JD Edwards Data & ERP Consultant

Particle41 is seeking a talented and versatile JD Edwards Data & ERP Consultant to join our innovative team. We are staffing a dedicated consultant for a large enterprise client that runs JD Edwards as its core ERP. The client needs someone who knows the JDE data model inside and out and can build reliable data pipelines around it. This is a working seat on the client team, not a short advisory project. You will work shoulder to shoulder with their ERP, IT, and business teams every day.

In This Role, You Will:
Own JDE data work: Extract, model, and transform data from JD Edwards tables (Address Book, Item Master, Sales Order, General Ledger, and related files).
Build data pipelines: Design and maintain ETL/ELT flows from JDE into the client's data warehouse or reporting platform.
Support ERP implementation work: Lead data mapping, conversion, cleansing, and reconciliation for implementation, upgrade, or migration efforts. Support cutover planning and execution.
Enable reporting: Build clean, trusted datasets for BI dashboards and finance and operations reporting.
Protect data quality: Set up validation and reconciliation checks between JDE and downstream systems. Find and fix root causes.
Partner with the business: Work with finance, distribution, and manufacturing users to turn their questions into data requirements.
Document as you go: Keep data flows, mappings, and conversion rules clear and current for the client team.

Skills and Experience We Value:
5+ years of hands-on JD Edwards experience (EnterpriseOne and/or World). Deep knowledge of the JDE data model and table structures is required for this role.
Strong SQL on Oracle, SQL Server, or DB2 / IBM i (AS400).
Data engineering experience: ETL/ELT development, pipeline design, and data modeling.
At least one full-cycle ERP implementation, upgrade, or migration where you owned data conversion or data migration work.
Working knowledge of core JDE modules: Financials, Distribution / Logistics, and Manufacturing.
Able to work full-time during US business hours.
Clear, confident written and spoken English. Comfortable working directly with client stakeholders.
Able to work as an independent contractor.

Nice to Have
JDE technical tools: Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), UBEs / Report Design Aid, Table Conversion, and Form Design Aid.
Cloud data platforms: Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS (Glue, Redshift), or dbt.
BI tools: Power BI, Tableau, or OBIEE.
Python for data processing and automation.
Industry background in manufacturing, distribution, or automotive aftermarket.
Oracle JD Edwards certification.
Prior consulting or staff augmentation experience.

What Success Looks Like
First 30 days: You understand the client's JDE footprint, key tables, and current data flows. You deliver a first pipeline or dataset fix.
First 90 days: The client team trusts your data. Reporting and conversion work runs on documented, repeatable pipelines.
Ongoing: You are the go-to person for JDE data questions on the client team.

About Particle41
Our core values of Empowering, Leadership, Innovation, Teamwork, and Excellence drive everything we do to achieve the ultimate outcomes for our clients. Empowering Leadership for Innovation in Teamwork with Excellence ( ELITE )

E - Empowering: Enabling individuals to reach their full potential.
L - Leadership: Taking initiative and guiding each other toward success.
I - Innovation: Embracing creativity and new ideas to stay ahead.
T - Teamwork: Collaborating with empathy to achieve common goals.
E - Excellence: Striving for the highest quality in everything we do.

We seek team members who embody these values and are committed to contributing to our mission. Particle41 welcomes individuals from all backgrounds who are committed to our mission and values. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, ensuring that hiring and employment decisions are based on merit and qualifications without discrimination based on race, color, religion, caste, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, local, or international laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment and hiring.
We appreciate your interest and encourage applicants from these regions to apply. If you need any assistance during the application or interview process, please feel free to reach out to us at careers@particle41.com. This role is specifically for LATAM Region only.

• Strong React and TypeScript: routing, data fetching and caching, forms, and Tailwind or a component library.

• Experience with third-party APIs and webhooks: OAuth, signature checks, retries, rate limits, and partial failures.

• Stripe experience: subscriptions, Checkout, webhooks, and ideally usage-based billing.

• Comfort deploying and debugging containers in the cloud (Cloud Run, Docker, Vercel), and reading traces and logs to find a root cause.

• Good judgment with personal data and email: privacy rules, consent, and why one wrong send matters.

• Clear written communication: plans on issues, PRs that explain what changed and why, and honest status.

Your first 90 days
By day 90 you own one area of each product and can ship to either without help. 1. Days 1–30: Run Zipisa and WebHawk locally with their full test suites passing. Ship 3–5 small fixes to production in both. Learn the send guardrails, the task drains and the billing flows. 2. Days 31–60: Own a mid-sized feature end to end, such as a new CRM integration or a dashboard screen, from Linear plan to production. Help debug and fix production issues as they come up. 3. Days 61–90: Lead a cross-product piece of work, such as WebHawk visitor data inside Zipisa or metered billing. Leave a runbook or regression test behind for each incident you handle.

Responsabilidades:
• Build features end to end. Take a Linear issue from plan to production: FastAPI routes, Mongo models and indexes, React screens, tests, and a clear PR.

• Keep the email pipelines safe and deliverable. Work on Zipisa's mail queue and WebHawk's KumoMTA sending: idempotent jobs, send guardrails, warm-up ramps, unsubscribe handling, bounce and reply processing.

• Ship and maintain integrations. Build and fix CRM and calendar connections (Follow Up Boss, kvCORE, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Calendly, Zapier, webhooks) and the data providers behind lead sourcing and validation.

• Own billing flows. Implement Stripe subscriptions for Zipisa and metered, pay-per-use charging for WebHawk, with a usage ledger that is correct under retries.

• Build the dashboards. Visitors, inbox, campaigns, domains, integrations and settings screens in React and TypeScript, wired to the API with loading, empty and error states handled.

• Work on the AI layer. Wire LLM features (reply drafting, lead decisions, the in-app assistant) into the product, with evals that catch regressions before customers do.

• Run what you ship. Deploy to Cloud Run and Vercel, watch Logfire traces, run scheduled task drains, debug production issues, and leave behind a regression test or runbook for every incident.

• Protect personal data. Handle PII, consent signals and do-not-contact rules carefully, and keep secrets and raw payloads out of logs.

Deseable:

• LLM product work: prompt design, tool-using agents, evals, and controlling cost per conversation.

• Real estate tech: Follow Up Boss, kvCORE/BoldTrail, MLS data, or how agents and brokerages work leads.

• Ad-tech or identity resolution: pixels, first-party data, consent signals such as GPC, and match rates.

• TanStack Start or Next.js, server-side rendering, and technical or programmatic SEO.

• Infrastructure: Cloudflare (Workers, R2, cron), Redis, queues, Terraform, or running a Linux box.

• Experience as an early engineer at a startup, owning a product with little hand-holding.

• Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, with the habit of reviewing their work skeptically.

It also means you get to become part of a community that values your experience, supports your ambition, and invests in your ongoing professional growth.
Whether you are looking for your next challenge, seeking greater flexibility, or ready to elevate your career, Jobsity gives you the platform and partnership to thrive on your terms.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build and maintain production applications in Go, Python or Node.js on AWS, working closely with the Tech Lead and the infrastructure/DevOps teams. You will troubleshoot issues directly in the codebase, contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployments, and use Terraform day to day to author, modify and maintain the infrastructure behind those applications.

postings.title: Full-Stack Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About Onfleet

Onfleet 's mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully. Our product includes intuitive smartphone apps for drivers, a powerful modern web application and dashboard for logistics teams, and automatic notifications and real-time tracking for recipients. Onfleet powers millions of deliveries every week for thousands of businesses around the world across a range of industries, from grocery and prepared meals to pharmacy, flowers, and furniture.

About the role

Onfleet is hiring a Full-Stack Engineer based in Latin America or Canada to join one of our cross-functional teams as we build out our Orchestration capabilities. You'll be a core contributor across new feature development, architectural improvements, and system integrations. Your work will span our core platforms, APIs, webhooks, and other integration surfaces, evolving courier and orchestration functionality, and improving internal tooling and developer experience.

The majority of backend work is in Node.js, with a growing Rust codebase in our newer projects. Front-end work is in React, with a mix of JavaScript and TypeScript. You'll work across a blend of greenfield development and continual, thoughtful development and refinement of existing systems: creating high-quality, well-tested code, contributing to a healthy Scrum cadence, and helping tame legacy complexity by putting code under test, isolating change boundaries, and simplifying tangled implementations.

Everyone on the team owns quality. Automated tests are part of our Definition of Done, and nothing goes to production without being well reviewed by humans and AI agents. If you bring deeper testing or automation experience, that is a real advantage in this seat and we will put it to work, but it is not a prerequisite.

If you have strong Computer Science fundamentals, care deeply about quality and craft, and bring a scrutinizing, questioning mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

How we work

Our engineers combine Computer Science fundamentals with a principled approach to software development that sets a high bar for quality. We're pragmatic, quality-driven, and deliberate about the tools and practices we adopt.

We code using agents, and nearly 100% of our code is written this way. Success here takes a scrutinizing, questioning mindset: the engineers who thrive are the ones who avoid slop, catch the wrong call before it ships, and drive quality and the right engineering choices forward. Generating code is the easy part; knowing what good looks like, and holding the bar, is the job. To be successful in this role you will need enough expertise in the languages we use to challenge both the code an agent writes and the architecture it proposes.

We also expect every engineer to be an active contributor to how we work, not just a consumer of existing workflows. Improving our agentic workflows, orchestration, and tooling is a core part of the role; we're always looking for ways to raise the team's quality and efficiency, and that's expected from everyone. Desire and excitement for the application of AI to software development are critical to this role. We are seeking candidates who want to work in and maintain leading-edge agentic workflows, and stay there as the models and tools evolve.

What you'll do

• Build and continually improve your own agentic development workflow, and help raise the team's. This goes far beyond prompting for code: we use AI across the whole path, from PRDs to technical specs, epics, and tickets, into development plans, and finally into high-quality code with thorough unit and integration tests.

• Drive quality through disciplined verification and both agentic and human code review, on your own code and your teammates'. Extend our agentic review tooling as you go, and hold the bar on what gets merged.

• Apply your agentic workflow in both greenfield and legacy code, meeting the different challenges each presents.

• Design and implement high-quality, scalable software in parallel with the tests that validate it.

• Drive and show ownership of features end to end: research/planning, design, implementation, validation, deployment and monitoring in production.

• Continuously refactor and simplify code to improve clarity, maintainability, and long-term system health, including making hard-to-reach code testable.

• Develop and refine our APIs, webhooks, and other integration surfaces.

• Work in a healthy Agile/Scrum cadence: reliable estimates, proactive and clear communication, and follow-through on commitments.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, including participation in the on-call rotation.

• Collaborate with product and cross-functional partners to prioritize features and bug fixes, and lift the people around you through pairing, thorough reviews, and writing things down.

What you'll bring (required)

•
A scrutinizing, questioning mindset: you don't accept output, your own or an agent's, at face value, and you surface problems early. You’re open and honest when you see a problem, and seek opportunities to help all of us improve.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, and strong CS fundamentals: data structures, database fundamentals, API design, testing, and an instinct for clean, maintainable code.

• Front-end and back-end experience, having shipped multiple features that cross the full application stack from ideation to production use by real customers.

• Automated testing experience across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, including hands-on experience with a browser or end-to-end framework such as Playwright or Selenium.

• 4 or more years of hands-on professional software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating production-quality, reliable systems.

• At least 3 years of professional experience in our core stack: Node.js and React, in TypeScript or JavaScript.

• Experience with creating software using disciplined agentic flows, from prompt-instructing to complete development orchestrations.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You can work entirely in English on a distributed team, explain complex technical ideas clearly, and write docs and code reviews your teammates rely on. This is roughly equivalent to a C1 level of English.

Nice to have

Especially valuable for this seat. We don't require these, but candidates who bring them will stand out from the crowd.

• Prior experience building comprehensive automated test suites, going beyond testing your own tickets to building coverage a team relied on. Bonus points for having worked as a Software Developer in Test (SDET).

• Hands-on CI ownership: you have created, configured, fine-tuned, or troubleshot a CI pipeline (GitHub Actions or equivalent), not just consumed one that someone else built.

• Test-Driven Development (TDD) experience.

• Experience with test data and environment management: getting a realistic system into a known state quickly and repeatably.

• Experience with a statically typed, compiled language other than TypeScript, for example Rust, Go, Java, C#, or C++.

• Deeper front-end specialization in React, for example design systems, accessibility, or performance work.

• Familiarity with cloud service design patterns and modern software architecture.

• Familiarity with AWS and cloud-native services; microservices and containerization.

• Proficiency with NoSQL and other modern data-storage technologies.

• Experience working remotely as part of an international team whose common working language is English, collaborating day-to-day with teammates in other countries.

Location and Benefits

• This is a remote role, open only to candidates based in Latin America or Canada.

•
Onfleet offers flexible work arrangements; you can work from home or anywhere with a reliable internet connection.

• The team works on US Pacific Time. You'll need to reliably work a schedule that frequently matches US Pacific business hours (9am–5pm PT).

• Flexible PTO

• Laptop and work-from-home setup stipend

• Monthly technology stipends (internet and AI tooling)

Onfleet is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Onfleet 's culture is one that strongly values diversity in its workplace and we are committed to working with potential team members who can bring diverse perspectives and experience to our company and culture.

We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply and we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $60K USD to $80K USD per year, depending on experience, skills, and background. Where an offer lands within that range reflects the engineering level and the depth of experience a candidate brings to the role.

How we hire

You need an identity-verified LinkedIn profile to apply. That's the free "Verified" badge, the shield icon next to your name. We check for it, and applications without it don't move forward.

Before any offer, we verify your identity and work history. That includes a live video ID check and reference calls. We use AI, automated systems, and a person to review applications: every application that meets the requirements is also read by an engineering leader or a recruiter. If you misrepresent your identity or experience, the process ends.

Stand.earth is seeking a Research Manager to play a key role in Stand.earth campaigns and research projects. If you are passionate about Stand.earth's mission, like taking on big challenges, and have a depth and breadth of experience in investigative research, then read on! This might be the perfect role for you.

We encourage applicants to apply by Monday, November 30th, 2026. This position is open until filled.

About Stand.earth

Stand.earth is a nonprofit environmental organization working to create a world where respect for people and the environment comes first. Our campaigns challenge destructive corporate and governmental practices, demand accountability, and create solutions that support all of us — and the environment and climate upon which we depend. Stand’s strategic approach and fierce determination have yielded extraordinary results: Since 2000, we’ve secured the protection of millions of acres of wilderness, shifted billions of dollars of corporate purchasing toward responsible options, and transformed the environmental practices of more than 100 major U.S. corporations. Stand.earth operates in the United States and Canada.

Stand recognizes and respects the sovereignty of First Nations and tribes, and the rights of Indigenous Peoples and frontline communities. These communities are often first and most directly impacted by environmental pollution and climate change, and they provide critical leadership in developing solutions.

Pollution, climate change, and corporations’ bad behavior disproportionately hurts the most marginalized people in society — including people of colour, people from working-class backgrounds, people with disabilities, women, and LGBTQ+ people. To develop transformative solutions, these communities must be centered in the work we do. Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other historically marginalized communities. If you require assistance applying to this opportunity, please contact .

The Position

The Research Manager is responsible for conducting comprehensive research on a variety of topics related to Stand’s work. This includes designing research plans, collecting and analyzing data, writing reports, and drafting data visualizations. The ideal candidate has deep experience in relevant research fields and a passion for holding governments and corporations accountable for their impacts on climate and the environment.

Stand.earth offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package including excellent health and dental insurance, 4 weeks paid vacation in the first year (increases in future years), 20 paid holidays, 4-day workweek, and a 3-month paid sabbatical after 7 years of continuous full-time employment. We also encourage employees to make use of our mindfulness sessions and professional development training opportunities that we offer. All staff can expect to travel periodically for in-person team meetings, retreats, and work events.

postings.descriptionText:
Category: IT Services

Location:

This is a hands-on role. We are not looking for someone to only advise us and leave the work to our team: you will do a large part of the security work yourself, working inside our repositories, pipelines and cloud accounts alongside our engineers. You will configure tools, fix and harden things, write the processes and documents, and run the sessions, while showing our team how it is done along the way.

Our goal is a company that runs a secure development lifecycle on every project, has its own house in order, is well on the way to ISO/IEC 27001 certification, and has an internal Security Lead who can work with you and gradually take over day-to-day ownership. This is a part-time role.

Responsibilities

Assessment and governance

• Run the security maturity assessment yourself (for example OWASP SAMM), review our repositories, pipelines and cloud setup, and turn the findings into a prioritized roadmap.

• Write our core security policies and procedures: access control, acceptable use, secure development, incident response, vendor and AI tool usage.

• Set up and maintain the security backlog, risk register and progress metrics, and report progress to management monthly.

Company security ("secure the house")

• Configure and enforce SSO and MFA across email, Git hosting, cloud consoles, CI/CD and Passbolt.

• Review and fix access rights, and set up onboarding and offboarding checklists.

• Harden our Passbolt setup and implement a secrets manager for applications and pipelines, including migrating existing secrets out of code and CI variables.

• Implement baseline hardening for laptops, cloud accounts, backups and logging.

• Write the incident response plan and run tabletop exercises with the team.

Secure software development

• Build our standard Secure SDLC, based on OWASP ASVS and OWASP SAMM, and roll it out on real client projects.

• Configure and tune our SecOps platform: reduce false positives, set up pipeline quality gates and triage findings together with the teams.

• Add the missing scanning to our CI/CD pipelines yourself: SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC and container scanning, DAST and SBOM generation.

• Run threat modeling sessions on active projects and document the results.

• Do security code reviews of high-risk changes and help developers fix vulnerabilities.

• Perform internal security testing of our applications before releases, and scope and coordinate external penetration tests.

Regulation and compliance

• Map how the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2 and relevant local regulations affect us and our clients.

• Write and implement our vulnerability handling and disclosure process, including support for clients' CRA reporting obligations.

• Do the hands-on ISO/IEC 27001 preparation work: scope, risk assessment, Statement of Applicability, policies and evidence, and work with the certification body.

Client offering

• Help define security service tiers we can include in client proposals.

• Fill in client security questionnaires and build a reusable answer set.

• Join selected client meetings or calls as a senior security voice when needed.

People and knowledge

• Work side by side with our internal Security Lead so they learn by doing.

• Run short internal workshops on key topics (for example OWASP Top 10, threat modeling, secure CI/CD).

• Recommend training and certification paths for developers, Security Champions and DevOps engineers.

Requirements

Must have

• 8+ years of experience in information security, with recent hands-on work in application security, DevSecOps or cloud security.

• Comfortable doing the work yourself: configuring security tools, writing pipeline configuration, reviewing code, testing applications and writing policies.

• Practical experience setting up a secure development lifecycle and integrating security tools into CI/CD pipelines.

• Good knowledge of cloud security in at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP).

• Ability to explain security risks in plain language to both engineers and management.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

• Kubernetes and container security experience.

• Knowledge of security risks in AI and LLM-based applications.

Nice to have

• Experience with the EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2 and GDPR in a software vendor or supplier context.

• Experience building security offerings for clients in an agency or outsourcing environment.

• Experience implementing or auditing ISO/IEC 27001 (or a comparable framework such as SOC 2).

Certifications (one or more preferred)

• Hands-on certifications such as OSCP, BSCP, CDP or CKS

• ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor

• Cloud security certification (AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer)

• CISSP, CISM or CSSLP

The Secret Ingredients That Make Us Special:

Down to Business!

The business has experienced significant growth since launching and is now entering its next stage of expansion. With an ambitious growth trajectory, the company is looking for an experienced operations leader who can build the infrastructure, systems, and processes needed to support continued scale.
The team operates with a lean structure and a strong execution-oriented culture. This is an opportunity to join at a critical growth stage and take ownership of the operational backbone of the business.
We are seeking a hands-on Head of Operations to take full ownership of the company’s operational functions and work directly with the founder. This person will serve as the founder’s right hand for operations, taking over day-to-day operational responsibilities while building a scalable operating structure that supports rapid business growth.
You will oversee the entire operational ecosystem, including supply chain, inventory planning, manufacturing, quality and compliance, fulfillment, customer experience operations, vendor management, and cross-functional execution.

This position reports directly to the Founder and will serve as the company’s senior operational leader, with responsibility for building and leading the operations function.

Responsibilities

• Ensure cross-functional teams are aligned and products are ready for launch timelines.

• Improve operational processes for existing products and packaging.

• Monitor and improve key operational CX metrics, particularly return rates, refund rates, and payment chargebacks.

• Develop processes that protect customer experience while minimizing unnecessary operational costs.

• Lead cross-functional execution across operations, customer experience, creative, and other business functions.

• Build and develop the operations team as the business expands.

• Take full ownership of operational execution and remove operational bottlenecks before they impact growth.

• Identify opportunities to reduce COGS and negotiate improved supplier pricing and payment terms.

• Improve production planning and reduce manufacturing lead times.

• Work with the customer support team to identify and reduce returns and chargebacks.

• Audit agency and software expenses and implement cost-saving measures.

• Establish a scalable operational structure with clear ownership, SOPs, and accountability.

Requirements

• Significant experience leading operations at high-growth DTC brands, ideally businesses generating multiple eight-figure or nine-figure annual revenues.

• Direct experience in the supplement, nutraceutical, or wellness industry, with a strong understanding of manufacturing, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance.

• Proven experience managing end-to-end supply chain operations, including demand forecasting, inventory management, purchase orders, and 3PL oversight.

• Demonstrated experience sourcing and negotiating with manufacturers, particularly across the US and China.

• Strong knowledge of supplement manufacturing requirements, including COAs, cGMP standards, certifications, and quality control processes.

• Experience managing customer support operations and improving returns, refunds, and chargeback performance.

• Previous experience leading teams and managing other functional leaders.

• Strong commercial negotiation skills and a track record of reducing operational costs.

• Experience implementing AI-powered dashboards, automation, and operational reporting systems.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Job Description
We are looking for an experienced AI Security Engineer to support an Enterprise AI Security Program, acting as a technical security advisor to teams adopting and building AI solutions. In this role, you will review AI workflows, agents, tool integrations, and AI products to identify security risks and recommend practical controls to address them. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with AI/LLM technologies and security, and can independently assess new AI tools, architectures, and protocols as they evolve, communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

• Act as a technical security advisor to teams adopting and building AI solutions within an Enterprise AI Security Program

• Review AI workflows, agents, tool integrations, and AI products to identify security risks and recommend what should change

• Independently assess new AI tools, architectures, workflows, and protocols (e.g., MCP/A2A) as they evolve

• Evaluate risks such as prompt injection, unsafe outputs, tool/agent abuse, data leakage, identity misuse, and agentic workflow escalation

• Translate identified risks into practical security controls and clear, actionable recommendations

• Advise internal AI teams on securing their solutions, clearly explaining why a workflow is not secure and what needs to change

• Apply AI security frameworks, red teaming, guardrails, AI gateways, DLP, and runtime security approaches where relevant

• Communicate findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Key Requirements

•
Strong AI/LLM security experience

• Ability to review an AI workflow, agent, tool integration, or AI product, identify where the security risks are, and recommend what should change

• Strong practical knowledge of AI-specific risks, including prompt injection, unsafe outputs, tool and agent abuse, data leakage, identity misuse, and privilege escalation in agentic workflows

• Skill in turning those risks into practical security controls and actionable recommendations, not just flagging theoretical vulnerabilities

• Experience with AI security frameworks, AI gateways, guardrails, red teaming, DLP, MCP/A2A, and runtime security is a plus

• Comfortable working as a consultant/advisor to an internal AI team

• Strong communication skills and independent judgment, since the environment is fast-moving and not every answer will be predefined

What We Offer

● Opportunities to collaborate with international teams
