Description
The eCOA and RTSM Application Specialist is responsible for supporting the design, deployment, configuration, and oversight of electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment (eCOA) solutions—including ePRO, eConsent, and other patient-centric electronic data capture tools— and of Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) across global clinical studies.
This role collaborates with cross-functional teams, Sponsors, and external vendors to ensure that eCOA and RTSM systems are implemented in alignment with study protocols, regulatory expectations, and industry standards. The eCOA and RTSM Specialist acts as a subject matter expert throughout the study lifecycle to ensure reliable data collection, optimal user experience, and data integrity.

RESPONSIBILITIES
More specifically, the eCOA and RTSM Application Specialist must:

• Act as cCOA and RTSM subject matter expert during study start-up, maintenance, and close-out.

• Define functional requirements and participate in the design and configuration of eCOA and RTSM solutions.

• Draft and maintain system specifications, user requirements, edit checks, notifications, and reporting requirements.

• Assist with the design of eCOA-related Case Report Forms (CRFs).

• Create User Acceptance Testing (UAT) test scripts and coordinate or perform system validation testing.

• Validate eCOA logic, rules, and study calculations against protocol requirements.

• Support CDISC-compliant data mapping and collaborate with Clinical Data Standards teams.

• Contribute to the development of data cleaning strategies and review relevant plans (e.g., DMP, edit check specifications).

• Prepare study-specific training materials (site guides, participant instructions, etc.) and support training delivery as needed.

• Lead or participate in internal and sponsor meetings related to system setup, changes, and issue management.

• Document system configuration and file eCOA and RTSM deliverables into the Trial Master File (TMF).

• Manage updates, amendments, and change requests throughout the study lifecycle.

• Troubleshoot issues, escalate risks, and ensure timely resolution with vendors and project teams

• Ensure eCOA and RTSM activities comply with ICH-GCP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory standards.

• Contribute to SOPs, work instructions, process improvement initiatives, templates, and eCOA and RTSM standards.

• Support continuous improvement, training, and knowledge sharing within Clinical Data Management.

• Stay current on emerging eCOA and RTSM technologies, regulatory trends, and best practices.

• Support vendor evaluation, standardization, and relationship management when applicable.

• Act as a resource for cross-functional teams regarding cCOA and RTSM processes, timelines, and risks.

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training

Requirements

PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Health Sciences, or related field.

• 3–5 years of experience in eCOA, EDC, IRT, or eClinical solutions within a CRO, pharma, or health-technology environment.

• Strong knowledge of eCOA systems and patient-reported outcomes (ePRO).

• Solid understanding of clinical trial processes and data management principles (CDISC knowledge is an asset).

• Experience with system configuration, UAT, edit checks, and validation activities.

• Ability to collaborate in cross-functional settings and manage multiple priorities.

• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Global trial experience and knowledge of regulatory expectations (FDA, EMA, GDPR, HIPAA).

• Attention to quality and data integrity

• Technical curiosity and digital mindset

• Problem solving and escalation awareness

• Stakeholder communication and collaboration

• Organization, accountability, and autonomy

Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

• Flexible work schedule

• Permanent full-time position

• Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.
Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale..

For one multi-site US cardiology group, we have placed about 21 people: registered nurses, care coordinators, care and patient navigators, chronic care management and remote patient monitoring staff, a pharmacist, and a program director — most of them in local, onsite roles.
We interview every candidate ourselves before an employer ever sees them. That standard is at the core of what you will be selling.

The role
You will be the person who brings new healthcare employers to Seamless Assist . You will find US employers with open roles, start the conversation, sell them on us as their recruiting agency, and win their job orders — for both local onsite roles and remote roles.
This is a high-activity outbound role. You will build your own lead lists and work them every day with cold calls, email and text follow-up, and LinkedIn. Once you win a job order, you run the discovery call, capture exactly what the employer needs, and brief our recruiting team. Then you stay the employer's point of contact through to placement.
You will report directly to our Founder & CEO. Our recruiting team handles sourcing and screening, so you can focus on selling.

What you will do

Generate leads

• Build target lists of US healthcare employers hiring nurses, care coordinators, navigators, care management staff, pharmacists and clinical leaders

• Use hiring signals — open job postings, roles that stay open for weeks, new programs, new locations — to find who needs help now

• Reach the people who own hiring: practice administrators, directors of nursing, HR and talent leaders, operations and program directors

Reach out — calls, email and text

• Make cold calls every day and follow up every warm lead by phone

• Run email sequences in Apollo and text message follow-up through our CRM

• Run LinkedIn outreach through Sales Navigator

• Write outreach that sounds like a person, not a template

Sell and close

• Show employers what we have already delivered for healthcare clients

• Handle objections and negotiate fee agreements within approved terms

• Where it fits, also offer our remote VA and medical admin talent

Run discovery and brief the recruiting team

• Lead discovery calls to capture every detail of each role — duties, onsite or remote, licensure, systems, schedule, pay, must-haves and why it has been hard to fill

• Turn each call into a clear written brief our recruiters can act on right away

Own the account

• Stay the employer's single point of contact from job order to start date

• Relay feedback on candidates quickly so searches stay on track

• Grow each account — the next opening, the next location, the next department

• Track your activity and pipeline in our CRM and send a short weekly update to the Founder & CEO

What you bring

Required

• 3+ years in sales or business development at a US recruiting or staffing agency, winning job orders from employers

• Experience selling recruiting or staffing services to US healthcare employers

• Proven sales results — quota attainment, job orders won and revenue closed, with numbers you can share and a former manager who can confirm them

• Strong outbound skills — daily cold calling, email sequences and text outreach

• Working knowledge of US healthcare roles and the basics of state licensure and credentialing

• Experience running discovery calls and turning them into clear written requirements

• Hands-on experience with Apollo.io and LinkedIn Sales Navigator

• Daily AI tool user (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) for research, outreach and writing — be ready to show us how

• Excellent written and spoken English, and confident on calls with US decision-makers

• Able to work US business hours, Pacific Time, full-time

Nice to have

• Background at a US healthcare staffing agency — permanent placement, travel nursing, per diem or allied health

• Familiarity with chronic care management or remote patient monitoring programs

• Knowledge of agency fee models — contingency, retained, contract and contract-to-hire

• Experience with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Bullhorn or Manatal

• HIPAA basics

• Startup or fast-moving remote team experience

You will thrive here if you

• Love the phone and build pipeline from nothing

• Take rejection in stride and keep dialing

• Ask sharp questions before you pitch

• Sweat the details so recruiters never chase the wrong profile

• Own your numbers and speak up early when something is off

Your first 90 days

•
Day 30: set up in our tools, know our track record and the roles we fill, target lists built, outreach running, first discovery calls held

•
Day 60: discovery calls every week, first job orders won and briefed to the recruiting team

Day 90: a steady flow of job orders across local and remote roles, repeat business from at least one employer, and your first placement in sight

Why join

postings.title: GEO Expert - Hybrid
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

GEO Expert

Location: Mexico, Brasil, Colombia or Argentina

What you'll do

The way people find companies is changing: search is increasingly a conversation with an LLM. You'll own how Clara shows up in that conversation, making sure Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI engines surface Clara accurately and favorably when people ask about corporate cards, bill pay, or spend management in LatAm. You'll work alongside our website and SEO team to build this function from the ground up, using AI not just as a research aid but as the core engine of how you build, test, and ship.

Your responsibilities

• Own GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) for clara.com and other sites: how our content, structure, and data get cited, summarized, and recommended by AI search and answer engines.

• Audit how Clara currently appears (or doesn't) across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and other LLM-powered search surfaces, and build a baseline to measure against.

• Design and run experiments: structured data, content formatting, citation-worthy page design, llms.txt-style approaches, and other emerging GEO tactics, then measure what actually moves the needle.

• Build AI agents and automated pipelines to do this at scale: automated citation and brand-mention tracking across LLM engines, agents that audit and rewrite content for machine readability, and automation tools (n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar) that turn one-off tasks into repeatable systems.

• Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, v0, or similar) to build your own tooling: scrapers, dashboards, scoring scripts, or internal apps that track GEO performance.

• Use AI daily as your core workflow: prompting LLMs to audit how they currently see Clara, orchestrating multi-step agent workflows for content analysis, and generating or restructuring content at scale, not just using AI to speed up manual work.

• Build growth-hacking style tests, fast, scrappy, and quantified, to find what earns visibility in AI answers before best practices are established industry-wide.

• Create benchmarks and reporting that show leadership what's working, so we can judge whether this function should grow, ideally through a self-serve dashboard you build yourself.

• Stay ahead of a field that changes monthly: new engines, new ranking signals, new agent frameworks, and new ways AI models decide what to cite.

Must haves

• Experience optimizing a website or content for search, whether traditional SEO, content growth hacking, or early GEO work, with a track record of experiments that moved real metrics (traffic, rankings, citations, qualified leads).

• Real AI-building experience , not just prompting: you've built agents, automations, or pipelines (n8n, Make, Zapier, custom scripts, or AI coding tools) that do real work without you in the loop every time.

• Active, daily use of AI tools as part of your real workflow: using LLMs to research, test hypotheses, audit content, and build at speed.

• Analytical: comfortable setting up your own tracking, reading results honestly, and killing tests that don't work.

• Creative: this field has no playbook yet. You'll generate hypotheses nobody has tried, not just apply someone else's checklist.

• Able to move fast and scrappy: this is a new, unproven function, and you're building the process as you go.

• Comfortable communicating results and tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to haves

• Engineering background or comfort with code: structured data (schema.org), working with APIs, or writing your own scripts and tools. Not mandatory, but a real advantage in a field this technical.

• Experience with AI agent frameworks or orchestration (multi-step agents, MCP-based workflows, custom GPTs, or similar).

• Experience with llms.txt, structured data, or other emerging standards for AI-readable content.

• Experience building programmatic content pipelines (content generated and published at scale via automation).

• Traditional SEO experience (technical SEO, content strategy, link building) as a foundation to build GEO on top of.

• Fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS experience.

• Fluency in more than one of Spanish, Portuguese, or English, given the multi-market, multi-language nature of clara.com.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

• Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

• Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

• Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

• Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

postings.title: Grupo QuintoAndar I Sr Revenue and Pricing Management Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina . Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven , creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .

Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo

Nuestro equipo de Estrategia trabaja bajo el modelo “híbrido”, siendo necesario estar presencialmente en la oficina, ubicada en Buenos Aires, 2 veces por semana.

Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío

El rol de un Sr de Revenue and Pricing Management Analyst es fundamental dentro de la empresa, enfocado en maximizar los ingresos y la rentabilidad mediante la toma de decisiones basada en datos. Este objetivo se logra a través de un enfoque estratégico que combina el análisis cuantitativo, la previsión de la demanda ( forecasting ), la optimización dinámica de precios, la gestión de inventario y el despliegue efectivo en el mercado.

El Revenue Management trasciende el simple ajuste de tarifas: se trata de vender el producto o servicio adecuado, al cliente adecuado, en el momento oportuno, por el canal de distribución más rentable y al precio óptimo.

Tus Responsabilidades

• Análisis y Previsión (Forecasting)

• Análisis de Datos: Recopilar, depurar y analizar grandes volúmenes de datos históricos (ventas, precios, demanda, elasticidad y comportamiento del consumidor) para identificar patrones y tendencias clave.

• Previsión (Forecasting): Proyectar la demanda futura por segmento, canal y producto/servicio para diferentes ventanas temporales, considerando estacionalidad, eventos especiales y condiciones del mercado.

• Monitoreo de la Competencia: Rastrear y evaluar de manera continua las estrategias de precios, promociones y ofertas del mercado para sostener una ventaja competitiva.

• Estrategia de Precios, Canales y Go-to-Market (GTM)

• Optimización de Precios: Diseñar y aplicar esquemas de pricing dinámico y estructuras tarifarias adaptadas a la demanda prevista y a los movimientos del sector.

• Estrategia y Liderazgo de Go-to-Market: Diseñar y liderar el lanzamiento ( Go-to-Market ) de nuevas propuestas y esquemas de precios, definiendo el cómo , cuándo y a quién se presentan para maximizar la adopción, la retención y la captura de valor.

• Gestión y Rentabilidad de Canales: Evaluar el rendimiento, las comisiones y los márgenes de los distintos canales de distribución (directo, intermediarios, digital, etc.) para priorizar los de mayor rentabilidad.

• Ejecución, Colaboración e Informes

• Implementación Operativa: Asegurar la correcta parametrización y despliegue de las reglas y tarifas en los sistemas de gestión pertinentes.

• Colaboración Interdepartamental: Trabajar de manera estrecha con los equipos de Producto, Comercial, Operaciones y Finanzas para alinear el lanzamiento de precios con el roadmap de producto y los objetivos comerciales de la compañía.

• Métricas y Rendimiento: Desarrollar tableros de control y reportes de KPIs de ingresos, evaluando el impacto posterior al lanzamiento de cada estrategia para presentar hallazgos y ajustes a la dirección.

Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)

• Educación: Licenciatura o grado en Economía, Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Finanzas, Marketing Cuantitativo o carreras afines.

• Experiencia previa:

• 3 a 5 años de experiencia comprobable en roles de Revenue Management, Pricing, Commercial Strategy o Analytics.

• Deseable experiencia en industrias dinámicas (Tech, SaaS, Startups, Consultoría).

¿Cómo es nuestro Proceso de Selección?

Diseñamos un proceso transparente, directo y enfocado en evaluar tu potencial técnico y comportamental, dándote la oportunidad de conocer a nuestros equipos y rutas de carrera:

•
Postulación y Revisión de Perfil

•
Entrevista de Alineación (Equipo de Reclutamiento)

•
Evaluación Técnica (Caso Práctico, Desafío o Evaluación de Código)

•
Entrevista de Encaje Cultural y Liderazgo

•
Propuesta y ¡Bienvenido/a!

Importante: Evaluamos todas las postulaciones de manera individual y garantizamos respuesta para todas las personas. Toda la comunicación se realiza por correo electrónico, así que asegúrate de revisar tu bandeja de entrada y permitir los correos del dominio @quintoandar.com.br .

Beneficios

• Plan médico.

• Wellhub.

• Licencia parental extendida.

• Reintegro de Guardería.

• Gastos de teletrabajo (monto mensual).

• Descuentos en servicios del día a día.

• Día libre por cumpleaños, Día del Padre y Día de la Madre.

Diversidad e Inclusión en Grupo QuintoAndar

Durante la inscripción, verás algunas preguntas sobre diversidad. Estas son confidenciales y tienen como objetivo apoyar nuestras acciones de diversidad e inclusión. En vacantes afirmativas, la información podrá ser utilizada para verificar el alineamiento con el público objetivo de la oportunidad y, en estos casos, podría tener carácter eliminatorio. Para vacantes no afirmativas, esta información no afecta tu postulación y se utiliza únicamente para ayudarnos a mejorar continuamente nuestras prácticas e iniciativas de inclusión a lo largo de tu trayectoria con nosotros.

Privacidad y Protección de Datos

El Grupo QuintoAndar actúa de conformidad con las leyes de privacidad y protección de datos, y garante la seguridad de sus datos personales. Para saber más, consulte nuestro Aviso de Privacidad para Personas Candidatas . Si tiene dudas o desea ejercer sus derechos como titular de los datos, póngase en contacto con nosotros a través de nuestro Canal de Atención .

postings.title: Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As Operations Analyst for Market Data, you will be responsible for managing the data licensing, usage reporting and entitlements that underpin Alpaca’s market data product, keeping us compliant with all of our data sources while we deliver market data to millions of users.

After successful and rapid growth with our Trading API and Broker API, Alpaca is now building out our market data product. The team is rapidly growing, and we work with a growing number of exchange groups and data providers, as well as brokers and partners who redistribute our data to their own customers.

We’re looking for someone highly organized and detail-oriented to own the operational backbone of our market data business. You’ll work closely with our data sources and broker/partner customers, as well as internal teams across market data, sales, legal, finance and engineering.

Things You Get To Do:

• Manage new data licenses and renewals with all of our data sources, including exchange groups and other data providers

• Track license terms, renewal dates and obligations so that nothing lapses

• Prepare and submit accurate, on-time monthly usage reporting for each data feed to each of our data sources

• Monitor the licensing of brokers/partners redistributing our data, maintaining current evidence of distribution licensing/authorization for each one

• Enable and disable data feeds for broker/partner customers in line with their licensing and contracts

• Respond to data source audits and inquiries, keeping our licensing records and documentation complete and up to date

• Identify opportunities to improve and automate our licensing, reporting and entitlement processes

• Assist with customer support queries regarding data feeds or licensing

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• 2+ years of experience in operations, ideally in market data administration, data licensing or vendor management within financial services

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills

• Highly organized, able to manage many recurring deadlines across multiple counterparties

• Ability to read and interpret contract and licensing terms

• Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

• Familiarity with exchange market data policies and usage reporting (e.g. NYSE, Nasdaq, Cboe, OPRA, CTA/UTP)

• Experience with market data inventory and usage reporting tools

• SQL or scripting experience to help automate reporting

• Experience or understanding of financial markets

• Experience working in a fast-paced environment and able to self-manage

• Comfortable working remotely

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Reference Data team, you will build services that form the data backbone of Alpaca’s brokerage infrastructure. Almost every service at Alpaca needs information about the assets it operates on. Our team provides that information and supports the events that affect those assets throughout their lifecycle.

The team owns two core areas: Security Master , the central source of information about tradable assets, their characteristics and whether, when, and how they can be traded; and corporate actions , which involves ingesting third-party information about dividends, stock splits, mergers and other events, then calculating the changes and transactions needed to reflect them in customer and partner holdings.

You will work across both areas, helping Alpaca enter new markets, expand its portfolio of products and improve the reliability, performance and operability of existing systems. This is a hands-on backend engineering role focused on distributed systems, data modelling and correctness across interconnected services. You will take open-ended problems from scoping and design through implementation, rollout and production support, working closely with the teams that depend on reference data.

Things You Get To Do

•
Design, build and maintain distributed backend services, APIs and data models for Security Master and corporate actions.

•
Extend reference data systems to support new instruments, asset classes and market-specific requirements, including futures and prediction markets.

•
Build reliable workflows for ingesting, validating and processing third-party instrument and corporate action information.

•
Develop internal tools and automation that reduce manual work and improve the reliability of reference data operations.

•
Help redesign how foundational asset information is structured and shared across Alpaca, contributing to architectural decisions with company-wide impact.

•
Work closely with engineering and business teams that consume reference data, coordinating changes across services.

•
Own complex features and technical decisions from design through production, including testing, troubleshooting and continuous improvement.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

•
Strong experience building and operating event-driven, distributed backend systems.

•
Strong database and data-modelling skills, with an understanding of eventual consistency and data replication.

•
Excellent system design fundamentals, including designing and evolving APIs.

•
Proficiency in a strongly typed programming language and willingness to work in Go.

•
Experience taking complex or ambiguous problems from initial requirements through delivery and production operation.

•
Ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly, collaborate across teams and reason through cross-system dependencies.

•
Senior-level engineering judgement and ownership; we assess capability and impact rather than applying a fixed years-of-experience threshold.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

•
Experience in trading, brokerage, capital markets, crypto infrastructure or related financial technology.

•
Experience with reference data, Security Master, instrument or asset data, or corporate action processing.

•
Understanding of financial instruments, particularly options, futures and other derivatives.

•
Experience with third-party data ingestion, internal tooling and workflow automation.

•
Experience guiding other engineers and working across interconnected services and teams.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

postings.title: Senior IBM BPM / IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) Developer
postings.descriptionText:
Join Our Team
 
Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.
 
As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.
 
We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.


About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Senior IBM BPM / IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) Developer to design, develop, enhance, and maintain business-critical workflow applications in complex enterprise environments.
This role focuses on building and supporting scalable business process solutions, integrating workflow applications with enterprise systems, and ensuring the reliability, performance, security, and maintainability of existing applications.
The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with IBM BPM and/or IBM BAW, business process modeling, enterprise integrations, and production support.
You will collaborate with developers, business analysts, architects, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions within an Agile development environment.

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, enhance, and maintain applications using IBM BPM and/or IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW).

• Translate business and technical requirements into scalable workflow and business process solutions.

• Develop and maintain process applications, workflows, services, business objects, and user interfaces.

• Design and implement business processes using BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation).

• Build and maintain integrations between IBM BPM/BAW and enterprise applications using REST APIs, Web Services, and related technologies.

• Troubleshoot application defects, workflow failures, integration issues, and production incidents.

• Perform application maintenance, bug fixes, technical enhancements, and continuous improvements.

• Participate in application testing, deployment, release management, and production support.

• Conduct root-cause analysis and resolve technical issues affecting business-critical applications.

• Review existing BPM solutions and contribute to performance optimization, modernization, and application improvements.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation.

• Participate in code reviews and ensure compliance with development, security, and quality standards.

• Collaborate with developers, business analysts, architects, and distributed engineering teams.

• Participate in Agile ceremonies, technical discussions, estimation, and sprint planning.

• Contribute to application reliability, maintainability, performance, and security.

Requirements:
• Strong professional experience in software development and enterprise application environments.

• Extensive hands-on experience with IBM BPM and/or IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW).

• Experience developing, enhancing, maintaining, and supporting enterprise workflow applications.

• Strong understanding of business process modeling and BPMN.

• Experience developing process applications, workflows, services, business objects, and user interfaces.

• Experience with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating applications through REST APIs and Web Services.

• Working knowledge of XML and JSON.

• Experience working with SQL and relational databases.

• Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

• Experience supporting production applications and resolving technical incidents.

• Familiarity with software development lifecycle practices.

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

• Experience collaborating with global and cross-functional teams.

Must Have:
• Strong hands-on development experience with IBM BPM and/or IBM BAW.

• Proven experience building and maintaining enterprise BPM applications.

• Strong knowledge of BPMN and business process modeling.

• Experience developing:

• Process applications and workflows.

• Business objects and services.

• User interfaces.

• Enterprise application integrations.

• Experience with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience with REST APIs and Web Services.

• Working knowledge of XML and JSON.

• Experience with SQL and relational databases.

• Experience integrating IBM BPM/BAW with external enterprise applications.

• Strong debugging and troubleshooting capabilities.

• Experience with application testing, deployment, maintenance, and production support.

• Experience performing root-cause analysis.

• Experience working in large-scale enterprise environments.

• Experience working throughout the software development lifecycle.

• Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Nice to Have:
• Experience in Financial Services or Banking.

• Experience with Wealth & Asset Management applications.

• Experience working in highly regulated industries.

• Experience supporting business-critical enterprise applications.

• Experience modernizing or optimizing existing IBM BPM/BAW solutions.

• Experience working with complex enterprise integration environments.

• Experience collaborating with U.S.-based stakeholders.

• Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams.

• Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and application governance standards.

Benefits & Perks:
 
Home office;
Competitive compensation based on experience;
Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company;
International Projects;
Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational);
Games and Competitions;

postings.descriptionText:
🚀 Join Our Data Products and Machine Learning Development Remote Startup! 🚀
 
Muttdata is a dynamic startup committed to crafting innovative systems using cutting-edge Big Data and Machine Learning technologies.
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Cloud Platform Engineer to join a strategic initiative focused on deploying and operating Data & AI platforms.
You will join the client's platform team and own the cloud infrastructure that its product and data teams deploy on. The work centers on Kubernetes clusters on AWS, GitOps delivery with ArgoCD, and reliability for regulated, high availability financial workloads🚀

🚀 What We Do
• Leveraging our expertise, we build modern Machine Learning systems for demand planning and budget forecasting.

• Developing scalable data infrastructures, we enhance high-level decision-making, tailored to each client.

• Offering comprehensive Data Engineering and custom AI solutions, we optimize cloud-based systems.

• Using Generative AI, we help e-commerce platforms and retailers create higher-quality ads, faster.

• Building deep learning models, we enhance visual recognition and automation for various industries, improving product categorization, quality control, and information retrieval.

• Developing recommendation models, we personalize user experiences in e-commerce, streaming, and digital platforms, driving engagement and conversions.

🌟 Our Partnerships
• Amazon Web Services

• Astronomer

• Databricks

🌟 Our Values
• 📊 We are Data Nerds

• 🤗 We are Open Team Players

• 🚀 We Take Ownership

• 🌟 We Have a Positive Mindset

🔍 Curious about what we’re up to? Check out our case studies and dive into our blog post to learn more about our culture and the exciting projects we’re working on! 🚀

Responsibilities 🤓
•

Infrastructure as Code on AWS

• Deploy and maintain infrastructure using Terraform on AWS.

• Ensure infrastructure complies with enterprise security, networking, and governance standards.

• Collaborate with Infrastructure and Enterprise Architecture teams on platform requirements and integrations.

Administration & Operations of Data & AI Platforms

• Operate and govern production-grade platforms running on Kubernetes / EKS.

• Manage platforms such as Langfuse, LiteLLM, ClickHouse, Redis, and future Data & AI tooling.

• Design and maintain:

• Backup & restore strategies

• High Availability (HA) configurations

• Shared cache and distributed rate limiting mechanisms

• Horizontal and vertical scaling strategies

• Platform upgrades and dependency management

• Integrate secrets and credentials management through Vault.

• Troubleshoot production incidents and improve operational recovery processes.

• Read and understand platform documentation to ensure optimal deployment and operation on Kubernetes environments.

DevOps / SRE Automation

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.

• Automate operational workflows and deployment processes.

• Improve observability, monitoring, and operational reliability.

• Create operational runbooks and reduce manual toil through automation.

• Continuously improve platform stability, scalability, and developer experience.

Required Skills 💻
• 4+ years in DevOps, SRE or cloud platform engineering, with at least 3 years running Kubernetes in production.

• Deep hands-on AWS experience: EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS and related networking.

• Production experience with ArgoCD and GitOps practices.

• Strong Terraform skills, including reusable modules and remote state.

• Helm, Docker and CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins or AWS CodePipeline.

• Scripting in Bash and Python.

• Observability and incident management experience on high traffic, high availability systems.

• Experience in financial services, payments or another regulated industry.

• Advanced English, written and spoken, to work directly with US based teams.

Nice to have

• AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional), or the CKA or CKAD certification.

• Experience with Azure, GCP, OpenShift or on-prem Kubernetes (for example VMware Tanzu).

• Progressive delivery with Argo Rollouts, plus policy as code with OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno.

• Cost optimization for AWS and Kubernetes workloads.

• Experience leading or mentoring a DevOps team.

• Spanish, to work with Muttdata's LATAM teams

🎁 Perks
• 🚀 In-Company English Lessons.

• 🚀 AWS & Databricks certifications fully covered

• 🎂 Birthday off + an extra vacation week (Mutt Week! 🏖️)

• 🤝 Referral bonuses – help us grow the team & get rewarded!

• ✈️ 🏝️ Annual Mutters' Trip – an unforgettable getaway with the team!

value.text:
Coderio designs and develops scalable digital solutions for global companies. We combine deep technical expertise with a product-driven mindset to lead complex software initiatives end-to-end. Working with international clients, we value autonomy, clear communication, and long-term relationships built on technical excellence. 🌍 Learn more:coderio.com
Role Overview
We are looking for an MLOps Engineer to take ownership of the full lifecycle of our Machine Learning models. In this strategic role, you will face a key technical challenge: managing and supporting our legacy processes (based on AWS SageMaker and Apache Flink) while driving the transition and adoption of our new tech ecosystem based on Databricks (Lakehouse, Feature Store, and Model Serving).
What To Expect In This Role (Responsibilities)
Feature Management & Deployment: Coordinate the creation, deployment, and rollout of new features and variables to strengthen core business models (Fraud, Payments, FX).
Maintenance & Lifecycle: Design strategies for the preventive and corrective maintenance of production models, ensuring their retraining, stability, and performance.
Continuous Monitoring: Oversee model observability to detect anomalies, performance degradation (data/concept drift), and real-time latency issues.
Legacy Support: Ensure the operational continuity of current pipelines built on AWS SageMaker and streaming data flows with Apache Flink.
Migration Strategy: Plan a secure, frictionless transition of legacy processes and infrastructure toward the company's newly defined technologies.
Requirements
Experience: 4+ years of experience working with Machine Learning models in large-scale production, ideally in transactional or data streaming environments.
SageMaker Stack: Hands-on experience managing and implementing flows in AWS SageMaker (pipelines, training, endpoints).
Familiarity or experience with real-time data processing using Apache Flink (or similar streaming tools like Kafka / Spark Streaming).
DevOps & Infrastructure: Solid experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD automation tools.
Language Proficiency: Fluent English (mandatory) for seamless daily communication with global, multicultural teams.
Nice to Have
New Tech Ecosystem: Highly desirable experience working within the Databricks ecosystem focused on Machine Learning, including knowledge/implementation of Databricks Feature Store, Lakehouse architectures, and deploying models via Databricks Model Serving.
Industry Background: Coming from the Fintech, Payment Processing, or Fraud Prevention industries.
Certifications: Holding official Databricks certifications (e.g., Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional).
Benefits
Long-term commitment with autonomy and impact on global, high-scale projects.
Strategic, high-visibility role within a modern engineering culture.
Collaborative, multicultural environment with strong technical leadership.
Career growth path and continuous learning opportunities within Coderio.

postings.title: Senior Project Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About Welocalize 
Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 


Overview 
The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for managing assigned accounts end-to-end, including project planning, execution, monitoring, delivery, and closure in line with Welocalize’s standard processes and tools. In addition, the Senior Project Manager will partner with the Operations Squad Lead to support large enterprise accounts.
This role will serve as the primary project-level contact for clients, building strong customer relationships while collaborating closely with Welocalize account directors and production teams to maximize delivery performance, client satisfaction, quality, and profitability.
The ideal candidate is a motivated and dependable professional with strong relationship-building skills across cross-functional teams. They should bring the adaptability, resilience, and energy needed to succeed in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
 
Main Duties
Lead and supervise global teams, including internal and external stakeholders, with responsibility for both direct and indirect reports.
Prepare, analyze, and implement project plans in alignment with Welocalize standards, including project initiation, workflow management, completion, status updates, invoice approvals, and client information maintenance.
Develop and manage detailed project schedules to ensure timely and efficient delivery.
Prepare project estimates and proposals for client review and approval.
Conduct risk assessments and implement strategic plans to minimize potential issues and ensure successful outcomes.
Oversee QA projects, including resource allocation, defect management, reporting, and overall quality performance.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to achieve project and client objectives.
Create and maintain process documentation as required.
Operate independently with moderate support, proactively identifying and escalating issues outside of scope in a timely manner.
Partner with production teams to drive continuous improvement in project delivery, efficiency, and profitability.
Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including colleagues across departments and vendors.
Develop trusted client relationships at the project level, achieving measurable success in customer satisfaction ratings.
Ensure clear, effective, and timely communication with all project stakeholders, including clients and production teams.
Maintain accuracy and timeliness of all financial systems data.
Prepare and deliver reporting, including weekly project status updates, budget-to-actual analysis, time management, and client/vendor-related issues.
Protect project profitability through effective margin management.
Plan, prepare, and lead quarterly business reviews with clients in face-to-face settings.
 
Requirements
Education Level: Master’s degree, or Bachelor’s degree with relevant industry experience in lieu of a Master’s degree.
Proven track record in Localization Project Management.
Experience working internationally or directly with global product development teams.
Experience within a technology-driven company or environment.
Experience with AI-related projects is a huge plus.
Demonstrated success managing large enterprise clients.
Proven ability to lead and deliver large-scale accounts and complex projects successfully.
Experience creating client-facing documentation, including Statements of Work (SOWs), proposals, process documentation, and post-project reviews.
Proven record of contributing to process improvements, operational initiatives, and new ideas.
Experience supporting new client sales cycles, including presentations, analysis, recommendations, and relationship development.
Strong experience managing financial budgets, reconciliations, and budget reporting.
Hands-on experience with CAT and TMS tools, including GlobalSight, Idiom World Server, or SDL TMS.
 
Additional Skills

postings.title: Sales Closer B2C – Ventas & Admisiones
postings.descriptionText:
(100% Remoto – LATAM | Ventas Consultivas)

Rol:

Desde Rehire acompañamos a una compañía de educación y desarrollo profesional en Latinoamérica en la búsqueda de un/a Sales Closer B2C para impulsar las admisiones y el crecimiento comercial de sus programas de formación en liderazgo.

Buscamos un perfil comercial con experiencia en cierre de ventas consultivas, gestión de pipeline y análisis de métricas, capaz de generar confianza, identificar oportunidades y convertir prospectos en clientes.

La posición requiere una persona con mentalidad emprendedora, pensamiento crítico y fuerte orientación a resultados, que disfrute trabajar en un entorno dinámico, con objetivos exigentes y un alto volumen de conversaciones comerciales.

Responsabilidades:

 - Conducir llamadas comerciales individuales con potenciales participantes, identificando sus necesidades y evaluando su adecuación a los programas.

 - Gestionar un volumen aproximado de 10 llamadas diarias de 35 minutos, combinando evaluación de candidatos, asesoramiento y cierre de ventas.

 - Ejecutar estrategias de cierre comercial con un enfoque consultivo, persuasivo y orientado a la conversión.

 - Realizar seguimiento de prospectos mediante llamadas, WhatsApp y videollamadas.

 - Gestionar y priorizar oportunidades comerciales según su nivel de interés, calidad y probabilidad de conversión.

 - Reactivar leads antiguos, prospectos que no asistieron a reuniones y oportunidades que no avanzaron en el proceso comercial.

 - Implementar estrategias de reoferta, seguimiento y nutrición de prospectos.

 - Identificar oportunidades de referidos a través de clientes y participantes actuales.

 - Mantener actualizado el pipeline comercial en HubSpot, registrando interacciones, avances y resultados.

 - Analizar indicadores de ventas, tasas de conversión, evolución del funnel y desempeño semanal.

 - Interpretar dashboards y reportes automatizados para identificar cuellos de botella y oportunidades de mejora.

 - Detectar patrones de conversión por segmento de clientes y evaluar hipótesis comerciales.

 - Optimizar guiones de venta, manejo de objeciones y estrategias de seguimiento.

 - Elaborar reportes de desempeño comercial y proponer acciones concretas para mejorar resultados.

 - Colaborar con el equipo de liderazgo comercial en la optimización de procesos y estrategias de crecimiento.

 

Requisitos:

 - 4+ años de experiencia profesional, con trayectoria en ventas B2C, cierre comercial, desarrollo de negocios, admisiones o posiciones similares.

 - Experiencia comprobable realizando ventas consultivas y cierre de oportunidades comerciales.

 - Experiencia gestionando pipelines comerciales y realizando seguimiento estructurado de prospectos.

 - Manejo de HubSpot u otros CRM, incluyendo registro de actividades, seguimiento de oportunidades y análisis de reportes.

 - Capacidad para interpretar métricas comerciales, funnels, tasas de conversión y KPIs.

 - Experiencia trabajando con objetivos comerciales exigentes y esquemas de compensación variable.

 - Excelentes habilidades de negociación, persuasión y manejo de objeciones.

 - Capacidad para generar confianza rápidamente y conducir conversaciones comerciales efectivas.

 - Pensamiento analítico y estructurado para identificar problemas y proponer soluciones basadas en datos.

 - Buen manejo de Excel, Google Sheets y herramientas digitales de gestión.

 - Capacidad para organizar y priorizar múltiples oportunidades comerciales.

 - Excelente comunicación oral y escrita en español.

 - Autonomía, proactividad y alto nivel de responsabilidad sobre los resultados.

 - Disponibilidad para trabajar en horario LATAM y gestionar un alto volumen de llamadas comerciales.

• Horario: Lunes a viernes, de 08:30 a 17:30 h. (Bogotá, Colombia)

• Modalidad: 100% remota.

Nubank is scaling rapidly across Latin America, and our Mexico division is central to empowering millions of people with intuitive, transparent, and accessible financial services. To support our sustained customer growth and expand our product ecosystem reliably, we need senior technical leaders who can translate high-level business vision into resilient, scalable distributed architectures.

In this role, you will serve as a strategic technical anchor across the Mexico division, collaborating closely with engineering leadership and cross-functional teams spanning Growth, Operations, and Core Value Proposition. You will bridge local market dynamics with Nubank's global platform ecosystem, steering architectural decisions that directly impact how prospects seamlessly transition into engaged Nubank customers.

Operating with a country-wide horizontal perspective, you will guide technical roadmaps across multiple business units and squads, untangle complex domain boundaries, and elevate engineering standards across chapters. By pairing architectural vision with pragmatic delivery, you will ensure our systems remain resilient, extensible, and prepared for exponential scale.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define and execute the long-term architectural vision for the Mexico division using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles to decouple complex systems and eliminate single points of failure.

 - Steer technical strategy across squads in Growth, Operations, and Core Value Prop, ensuring local business flows integrate seamlessly with Nubank’s global platform foundation.

 - Mentor and develop senior engineering talent across chapters, cultivating technical excellence, architectural rigor, and operational best practices.

 - Partner with engineering directors and executive leadership to translate commercial objectives into scalable system designs and actionable execution roadmaps.

 - Drive cross-team technical consensus on mission-critical initiatives, advocating for sound trade-offs between delivery velocity and platform extensibility.

 - Champion operational resilience and observability across customer acquisition funnels, proactively identifying bottlenecks to optimize conversion latency and system reliability.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Demonstrated track record of technical leadership as a Staff-level engineer (or equivalent scope) guiding distributed systems architecture across multi-team engineering organizations.

 - Deep practical expertise applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to design, decouple, and scale event-driven microservices.

 - Proven ability to influence cross-functional technical roadmaps across globally distributed platform and product teams without direct hierarchical authority.

 - Experience architecting mission-critical, high-throughput systems where fault tolerance, reliability, and low-latency performance are essential.

 - Professional working proficiency in English, with demonstrated success communicating complex architectural concepts to both technical and executive audiences.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Hands-on experience with modern cloud-native ecosystems, functional programming paradigms (e.g., Clojure, Scala), or distributed event streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka).

LOCATION & WORK MODEL

This role is based in Buenos Aires, Argentina on a Hybrid model at our Buenos Aires office. Work model: Hybrid,3 times per week.

Willingness and ability to travel to our Mexico City office approximately once per quarter for cross-team planning and collaboration.

postings.title: Marketing Data Analyst (Python & SQL)
postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client is a marketing analytics technology company that runs marketing mix models (MMM) for hundreds of brands across Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and retail channels. Its platform helps brands evaluate marketing performance through automated modeling, data analysis, and channel-level insights.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Marketing Data Analyst (Python & SQL) will investigate production model alerts, troubleshoot data and modeling issues, and optimize marketing mix model configurations to maintain accurate and reliable results.

This role sits within the Data Science team and focuses on investigating anomalies, validating model performance, and using AI coding agents to accelerate analysis. The ideal candidate has strong analytical judgment, familiarity with statistical modeling concepts, and the ability to interpret Python and SQL while translating complex findings into actionable recommendations.




LOCATION

Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


MODEL MONITORING & INVESTIGATION

 - Investigate production model alerts, including declining model fit, unusual Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) spikes.

 - Develop hypotheses, analyze relevant data, test potential causes, and document findings and recommendations.

 - Distinguish modeling issues from data problems such as broken feeds, incorrect campaign labels, or reporting delays.

 - Prioritize investigations and maintain accurate records of findings and resolutions.
   
   


MARKETING MIX MODEL OPTIMIZATION

 - Review and adjust production model configurations, including priors, seasonality, holidays, promotions, trends, and channel labeling.

 - Evaluate adstock, Hill saturation, and other modeling parameters when investigating performance issues.

 - Compare candidate configurations against live models based on model fit and channel plausibility.

 - Promote validated configurations or document why proposed changes were rejected.

 - Maintain accurate records of model changes and configuration decisions.
   
   


AI-ASSISTED DATA ANALYSIS

 - Use AI coding agents, including Claude Code, to investigate model behavior and data discrepancies.

 - Review Python and SQL code to understand modeling pipelines and troubleshoot issues.

 - Validate AI-generated analyses, calculations, and recommendations against underlying data.

 - Use AI-assisted workflows to accelerate investigations while maintaining analytical accuracy.
   
   


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION & DOCUMENTATION

 - Collaborate with Data Science and Customer Success teams to communicate investigation findings.

 - Translate complex modeling issues into practical recommendations for marketing stakeholders.

 - Track investigation queues and technical issues in Jira.

 - Maintain concise investigation notes, model change logs, and documentation to support follow-up and handoffs.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - 3+ years of professional experience in marketing analytics, data analysis, applied data science, or a related analytical role.

 - Experience investigating data discrepancies, performance anomalies, or issues within analytical systems.

 - Experience reviewing Python and SQL code to understand data pipelines and analytical workflows.

 - Experience working with statistical modeling concepts, including Bayesian regression, seasonality, attribution, adstock, or saturation.

 - A degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

 - Experience in marketing analytics or media buying, including evaluating channel-level ROAS, is preferred.

 - Experience with marketing mix modeling (MMM) or causal inference in a vendor, agency, or in-house environment is preferred.

 - Experience analyzing e-commerce and advertising data from Shopify, Amazon Ads, TikTok Shop, Meta, or Google Ads is a plus.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong ability to read, interpret, and lightly modify Python code and work with SQL.

 - Understanding of Bayesian regression, marketing attribution, seasonality, adstock, and saturation concepts.

 - Ability to investigate complex modeling pipelines and identify potential sources of errors.

 - Strong analytical judgment when distinguishing data quality issues from modeling problems.

 - Proficiency in directing AI coding agents through investigations and validating their findings.

 - Ability to evaluate model configurations based on statistical fit and business plausibility.

 - Familiarity with PyMC and Bayesian marketing mix modeling concepts.

 - Ability to document hypotheses, investigation findings, and recommendations concisely.

 - Strong attention to detail and ability to prioritize investigations based on business impact.

 - Familiarity with Jira and AWS S3 is preferred.

 - Familiarity with tools such as AWS Athena, BigQuery, Hex, Claude Code, and GitHub is a plus.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Alert Triage: Every new model alert is reviewed, with an initial hypothesis documented within 1 business day.

 - Alert Resolution: Root causes and recommendations are documented within 3 business days.

 - Investigation Accuracy: At least 90% of investigations are correctly classified as data-related or model-related issues.

 - Configuration Documentation: Every approved or rejected model configuration change is documented with model fit and plausibility comparisons.

 - Independence: Independently manage the complete model alert investigation process by day 60.

 - Cross-Functional Trust: Data Science and Customer Success teams can rely on accurate, timely investigation findings and recommendations.
   
   


OPPORTUNITY

The Marketing Data Analyst (Python & SQL) will have the opportunity to work directly with production marketing mix models used by hundreds of brands, investigating complex analytical issues and improving model reliability.

This role offers hands-on exposure to Bayesian modeling, AI-assisted analysis, and marketing performance measurement while contributing directly to the accuracy of customer-facing insights.


APPLICATION PROCESS:


TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE THESE STEPS NEED TO BE FOLLOWED:

 - Fill in the application form

 - Record a video showcasing your skill sets

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET, microservices architecture, SQL databases, and Microsoft Azure, along with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices.

• Implement automated unit and integration tests to ensure software quality and reliability.

• Collaborate with the Tech Lead and other engineers to identify technical challenges and propose effective solutions.
• Contribute to CI/CD improvements and automated build and deployment processes.
• Support application monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
• Follow secure software development practices and established SDLC procedures.
• Contribute to technical documentation and maintain traceability throughout the development lifecycle.
• Participate in all Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
• Demonstrate completed work during sprint showcases.
• Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools to support coding, testing, code reviews, and documentation.
Required Technical Skills & Experience
• 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
• Strong hands-on experience with C# and .NET in production environments.
• Proven experience designing and developing microservices-based applications.
• Solid experience developing and integrating RESTful APIs.
• Experience working with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based application environments.
• Strong knowledge of SQL databases, particularly SQL Server.
• Experience with Docker and containerized application environments.
• Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated software delivery, preferably using Azure DevOps.
• Experience with Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code review workflows.
• Strong understanding of software design principles, architecture patterns, and clean code practices.
• Experience writing automated unit and integration tests.
• Familiarity with TypeScript and React Native for cross-platform integration and collaboration when required.
• Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Nice-to-Have Skills
• Experience with monolithic application modernization and incremental migration strategies.
• Familiarity with the Strangler Pattern.
• Experience with event-driven architecture and asynchronous messaging.
• Knowledge of API gateways and service-to-service communication.
• Experience with distributed tracing, logging, observability, and monitoring tools.

AI-Assisted Engineering & Regulatory Compliance
Our client is an AI-forward engineering organization. The Senior Software Engineer is expected to incorporate approved AI tools into daily engineering workflows, including:

Engineers remain fully accountable for all delivered code and engineering artifacts. AI-generated outputs must follow the same code review, automated testing, SonarCloud analysis, and Definition of Done requirements as any other contribution.
Given the regulated nature of the platform, the engineer must also work within established compliance and governance requirements, including:

What this Journey Looks Like
At Pearster , we connect talented professionals from around the world with exciting opportunities at international companies. We are a dynamic, people-oriented team passionate about building meaningful professional connections and creating a positive employee experience.
We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our growing international team and work closely with clients to design, develop, and implement innovative technical solutions that solve real business challenges.
This role combines software engineering, solution architecture, and client-facing collaboration . You will work directly with stakeholders to understand their needs, translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, and take ownership of projects from initial discovery through deployment and optimization.
We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise, problem-solving skills, adaptability, and a hands-on mindset to deliver impactful solutions in dynamic environments.
What You'll Lead and Build

• Work directly with clients and stakeholders to understand business challenges, technical requirements, and operational needs.

• Design, develop, and deploy customized software solutions that address complex business problems.

• Take ownership of end-to-end technical implementations, from requirements gathering and solution design to deployment and ongoing optimization.

• Build scalable applications, APIs, integrations, and automation solutions using modern technologies.

• Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, and business teams to translate client requirements into actionable technical solutions.

• Integrate internal platforms with third-party systems, databases, APIs, and cloud services.

• Troubleshoot complex technical issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.

• Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions to validate technical approaches and accelerate delivery.

• Adapt existing products and platforms to meet specific client requirements while maintaining scalability and performance.

• Support cloud-based deployments, system integrations, and production environments.

• Create clear technical documentation, implementation guidelines, and solution architecture diagrams.

Job Overview
Perform daily administrative activities, in conjunction with the Clinical Research Associates and Regulatory and Start-Up teams, to ensure a complete and accurate Trial Master File delivery.

Essential Functions

• Assist Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) and Regulatory and Start-Up (RSU) team with accurately updating and maintaining clinical documents and systems (e.g., Trial Master File (TMF)) that track site compliance and performance within project timelines.

• Collaborate with clinical team on the preparation, handling, distribution, filing, and archiving of clinical documentation and reports according to the scope of work and standard operating procedures.

• Assist with periodic review of study files and completeness.

• Collaborate with CRAs and RSU on the preparation, handling and distribution of Clinical Trial Supplies and maintenance of tracking information.

• Coordinate the tracking and management of Case Report Forms (CRFs), queries and clinical data flow.

• Act as a central contact for the clinical team for designated project communications, correspondence and associated documentation.

• Act as a mentor for less experienced Clinical Trial Assistants (CTAs).

• Assist with training and onboarding of new CTAs.

• May serve as subject matter expert for business processes.

• May lead CTA study teams.

• May assist with interviewing and screening of potential new team members

• May accompany CRAs on site visits to assist with clinical monitoring duties upon completion of required training.

• May participate in departmental quality or process improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Life sciences or a related field.

• 1 year in clinical research experience strongly preferred.

• Advanced level of English.

• Computer skills including proficiency in use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills.

• Effective time management and organizational skills.

• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers, and clients.

• Knowledge of applicable clinical research regulatory requirements, i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines as provided in company training.

• Knowledge of applicable protocol requirements as provided in company training.

postings.descriptionText:
Job Overview
Under general supervision, perform tasks at a country level associated with site activation activities in accordance with applicable local and/or international regulations, standard operating procedures (SOPs), project requirements and contractual/budgetary guidelines.
The Contract Specialist is responsible for independently managing the preparation, review, and negotiation of clinical site agreements in support of study start-up activities. This role contributes directly to achieving study timelines by ensuring efficient contract execution while maintaining compliance with applicable regulations, sponsor requirements, and internal policies.

Essential Functions

• Independently draft, review, and negotiate standard clinical trial agreements (e.g., CTAs, CDAs, amendments) with investigative sites and institutions.

• Manage assigned contract portfolio to support site activation deliverables and study timelines.

• Act as a primary point of contact for sites and internal teams for contract-related matters, ensuring clear and timely communication.

• Apply approved negotiation parameters and escalate non-standard terms or higher-risk issues to senior team members or Legal as needed.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Site Activation, Clinical Operations, Finance) to align contract terms, including budget-related provisions.

• Track contract progress and maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation in relevant systems and tools.

• Identify and proactively address contract-related delays, working to resolve issues and minimize impact on study timelines.

• Ensure all contracts comply with applicable regulatory requirements, sponsor guidelines, and company policies.

• Support audit and inspection readiness by maintaining complete and accurate contract files.

• Contribute to continuous process improvements aimed at enhancing contract cycle times and quality.

• Manage multiple priorities simultaneously while meeting established timelines and quality expectations.

• Provide regular status updates and metrics to stakeholders and project teams.

Qualifications
• Based in Brazil or Argentina.
• Bachelor's degree.
• 2 to 4 years of experience in clinical research (CRO or pharma) supporting the contract and budget negotiation with sites: direct contract/BGT negotiation experience.
