postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

El Associate Sales Executive será responsable de impulsar el crecimiento de nuevos negocios dentro del segmento Mid Market Legal de Thomson Reuters en Argentina. Esta posición está enfocada en la venta de soluciones legales a estudios jurídicos pequeños y medianos, incluyendo productos habilitados con inteligencia artificial, contenido de investigación jurídica y soluciones de software adaptadas al mercado legal.

Esta posición requiere un profesional altamente proactivo, con fuerte orientación comercial, capaz de gestionar el ciclo completo de ventas de principio a fin, desde la prospección en frío y la generación de oportunidades, hasta las demostraciones de producto, negociación y cierre. La persona ideal deberá sentirse cómoda trabajando en un entorno comercial dinámico, donde el éxito depende de una actividad de prospección constante, resiliencia y capacidad para construir relaciones sólidas con profesionales del sector legal.

Key Responsibilities

• Generar nuevas oportunidades de negocio dentro del mercado legal en Argentina.

• Prospectar y contactar clientes potenciales mediante llamadas en frío, correos electrónicos y reuniones virtuales.

• Gestionar el ciclo completo de ventas, incluyendo generación de leads, calificación, demostraciones de producto, conversaciones de precio, negociación y cierre.

• Construir y mantener un pipeline comercial sólido, con foco en adquisición de nuevos clientes.

• Dar seguimiento a leads entrantes generados por marketing o equipos de prospección, cuando aplique.

• Comercializar soluciones legales de Thomson Reuters, incluyendo herramientas con inteligencia artificial, bases de datos jurídicas y software para estudios jurídicos pequeños y medianos.

• Desarrollar relaciones sólidas con clientes y representar a Thomson Reuters de manera profesional en todas las interacciones.

• Participar en eventos comerciales, actividades con universidades, colegios de abogados y visitas de campo ocasionales cuando sea necesario.

• Utilizar herramientas CRM como Salesforce para gestionar actividades, oportunidades y visibilidad del pipeline.

• Aplicar herramientas de inteligencia artificial y recursos digitales para mejorar la productividad, la preparación y la efectividad comercial.

• Colaborar de manera cercana con el manager y stakeholders internos para alcanzar los objetivos de facturación y negocio.

Required Qualifications

• Experiencia comprobable en ventas, desarrollo de negocio o adquisición de nuevos clientes.

• Fuerte perfil comercial, con capacidad para generar oportunidades de manera proactiva.

• Experiencia gestionando o participando en el ciclo completo de ventas, desde la prospección hasta el cierre.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación.

• Alto nivel de resiliencia y capacidad para manejar el rechazo en un entorno comercial de alta actividad.

• Comodidad en el uso de sistemas CRM como Salesforce o similares.

• Interés y apertura para utilizar inteligencia artificial como parte del trabajo diario.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experiencia vendiendo soluciones legales, tecnología, SaaS u otros servicios intangibles.

• Experiencia vendiendo a estudios jurídicos o profesionales del sector legal.

• Formación académica en Derecho o estudios jurídicos.

• Conocimiento o exposición previa al mercado legal argentino.

• Experiencia en entornos de ventas outbound con fuerte expectativa de prospección.

#LI-AC1

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

• Modelo de Trabajo Híbrido: Hemos adoptado un entorno de trabajo híbrido y flexible para nuestros roles en oficina, ofreciendo una experiencia fluida que está conectada digital y físicamente.

• Flexibilidad y Equilibrio entre Trabajo y Vida Personal: "Flex My Way" Consiste en un conjunto de políticas de apoyo en el entorno laboral, diseñadas para facilitar la gestión de las responsabilidades personales y profesionales, ya sea atendiendo a la familia, participando en actividades comunitarias o dedicando tiempo al descanso y la renovación personal. Estas políticas se basan en nuestro enfoque flexible de trabajo, que permite a los empleados trabajar desde cualquier lugar hasta 8 semanas al año, promoviendo así un equilibrio ideal entre sus compromisos laborales y personales.

• Desarrollo y Crecimiento Profesional: Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo de habilidades, preparando a nuestro talento para enfrentar los desafíos del futuro y ofrecer soluciones reales. Nuestro programa "Grow My Way" y el enfoque en habilidades garantizan que tengas las herramientas y conocimientos para crecer, liderar y prosperar en un futuro habilitado por la inteligencia artificial.

• Beneficios Competitivos del Sector: Ofrecemos planes de beneficios integrales que incluyen seguros de gastos médicos, dos días de descanso por salud mental a nivel de la empresa, programas de incentivos para empleados y recursos para el bienestar mental, físico y financiero.

• Cultura: Reconocida globalmente con una reputación premiada por inclusión y pertenencia, flexibilidad, equilibrio entre trabajo y vida personal, y más. Vivimos nuestros valores: Obsesión por nuestros Clientes, Competir para Ganar, Desafiar nuestro Pensamiento, Actuar Rápido / Aprender Rápido, y Más Fuertes Juntos.

• Impacto Social: Genera un impacto en tu comunidad con nuestro Instituto de Impacto Social. Ofrecemos a los empleados dos días de voluntariado pagados anualmente y oportunidades para involucrarse en proyectos de consultoría pro bono e iniciativas de Medio Ambiente, Sociales y de Gobernanza (ESG).

• Haciendo un Impacto Real en el Mundo: Somos una de las pocas compañías a nivel global que asiste a sus clientes en la búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Trabajando en conjunto con los profesionales e instituciones a los que servimos, contribuimos a sostener el estado de derecho, fomentar el comercio, detectar a los infractores, informar sobre los hechos y ofrecer información confiable e imparcial a personas en todo el mundo.

Quiénes somos

Thomson Reuters marca el camino hacia el futuro al reunir contenido confiable y la tecnología que las personas y organizaciones necesitan para tomar decisiones correctas. Servimos a profesionales en los sectores legal, fiscal, contable, de cumplimiento, gubernamental y de medios. Nuestros productos combinan software altamente especializado e información para capacitar a los profesionales con los datos, inteligencia y soluciones necesarias para tomar decisiones informadas y ayudar a las instituciones en su búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Reuters, parte de Thomson Reuters, es un proveedor líder mundial de periodismo y noticias confiables.

Contamos con el talento de 26,000 colaboradores en más de 70 países, donde todos tienen la oportunidad de contribuir y crecer profesionalmente en entornos de trabajo flexibles. En un momento en el que la objetividad, precisión, equidad y transparencia están bajo ataque, nos comprometemos a buscarlos. ¿Suena emocionante? Forma parte de nuestro equipo y contribuye a moldear las industrias que impulsan el progreso de la sociedad.

Como empresa global, confiamos en los antecedentes únicos, perspectivas y experiencias de todos los empleados para cumplir con nuestros objetivos comerciales. Para asegurarnos de poder hacerlo, buscamos colaboradores talentosos y calificados en todas nuestras operaciones alrededor del mundo, sin importar raza, color, sexo/género, incluyendo embarazo, identidad y expresión de género, origen nacional, religión, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad, estado civil, estado de ciudadanía, condición de veterano u otra clasificación protegida bajo la ley aplicable. Thomson Reuters se enorgullece de ser un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades laborales, proporcionando un ambiente de trabajo libre de drogas.

Asimismo, ofrecemos adaptaciones razonables para personas calificadas con discapacidades y para aquellas con creencias religiosas sinceras, conforme a la legislación vigente. Puedes encontrar más información sobre cómo solicitar una adaptación aquí .

Descubre cómo protegerte de anuncios de empleo fraudulentos aquí . Para obtener más información sobre Thomson Reuters, visita nuestro sitio web en thomsonreuters.com

¿Qué buscamos?

Un/a profesional de Ingeniería proactiva, autónoma y con alta capacidad de adaptación a contextos dinámicos. Se necesita sólidas habilidades de trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva, orientadas a desempeñarse en el rol de Ingeniera/o de Estimulación dentro de la Vicepresidencia de P&WO del Upstream.



¿Cuál será su desafío?

Serás responsable de realizar las tareas que componen todo el proceso de Estimulación: definición de candidatos, definición de diseños, planificación y ejecución de programas de estimulación, evaluación de performance de producción, seguimiento de pilotos e implementación de nuevas tecnologías.

Brindarás soporte a los equipos transversales: completación, sala de monitoreo, equipo de Estudios y equipo de proyectos. Asegurando que se cumplan con los KPI de Estimulación, los diseños planificados, siguiendo los estándares de YPF y que las operaciones se realicen velando por la integridad del reservorio.



¿Cuáles serán sus principales tareas?

Participar en los proyectos de Desarrollo y Exploración en los que se haya determinado la necesidad de estimulación, definiendo diseños y mejores prácticas.

Participar en la elaboración de los entregables de Estimulación para cada una de las fases de los proyectos de desarrollo (ej: base de diseño y playbook de Estimulación), en línea con los estándares técnicos definidos.

Participar, con ingenieros de reservorios, geomecánicos y geólogos de estudios, en la evaluación y selección de pozos a estimular. Utilizar todos los datos disponibles de las zonas de interés para definir la metodología y estrategia de estimulación adecuada, incluyendo la definición y revisión de la posición, altura y la metodología de punzado.

Analizar la respuesta del reservorio a la estimulación integrando todas las variables de subsuelo (geofísica, geomecánica, petrofísica, relaciones padre/hijo, etc.).

Evaluar las operaciones ya realizadas y ajustar el plan de estimulación estipulado en caso de desvíos.

Dar soporte al equipo de Terminación para la confección de los programas de terminación, basándose en los programas de estimulación y de punzados establecidos por PDDP (ej: definición de cañería, cabezal de pozo, método de aislamiento entre etapas).

Buscar e introducir nuevas tecnologías, monitorear sus resultados para contribuir a la excelencia operacional. Mantenerse actualizado a través de papers, conferencias, workshops, etc.

Colaborar en la revisión técnica de los estudios realizados en las áreas no operadas dentro su ámbito, en coordinación con la Gerencia de Relación con Socios y No Operadas, emitiendo las recomendaciones y alertas pertinentes. Participar de workshops y comités técnicos a los cuales sea convocado.

Colaborar con WO en propuestas de optimización de modalidades contractuales de estimulación, que capturen beneficios técnico-económicos acordes con nuevas tendencias de diseño basadas en un mejor entendimiento del subsuelo.

Coordinar la actividad de ensayos y control de calidad de fluidos y agente sostén. Organizar capacitaciones para supervisores y/o personal asignado al monitoreo de estimulaciones de YPF.

Validar y resguardar en bases de datos corporativas los entregables de la operación de Estimulación (programa del trabajo, ASCII de la operación, reporte de campo, informe final).

postings.title: ANALISTA CIBERSEGURIDAD
postings.descriptionText:
Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país.






En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.






¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!






¿Qué buscamos?






Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un Analista de Ciberseguridad de Datos e Inteligencia Artificial con visión integral, pensamiento analítico y orientación a riesgos, capaz de integrar controles de seguridad, privacidad y uso responsable de IA en todo el ciclo de vida de los productos digitales, articulando con negocio, producto, datos, arquitectura, desarrollo, operaciones y ciberseguridad.






¿Cuál será tu misión?






Integrarse a las torres y células de productos y plataformas digitales como referente de ciberseguridad de datos e IA, coordinando la incorporación oportuna de controles y actividades de seguridad durante todo el ciclo de vida del producto.

Su desafío será actuar como facilitador entre los equipos de negocio; tecnología, datos y las especialidades de ciberseguridad, promoviendo una colaboración efectiva, dando visibilidad a los riesgos y compromisos, y contribuyendo a que los productos evolucionen de manera segura, ágil y sostenible














¿Cuáles serán tus principales tareas?









Desempeñarse como facilitador y punto de referencia de ciberseguridad de datos e IA en el desarrollo, implementación y operación de soluciones de datos e IA en la Vicepresidencia de Tecnología.



· Acompañar productos de datos y soluciones de IA durante ideación, diseño, construcción, pruebas, despliegue, operación y retiro, asegurando identificación temprana de riesgos y evidencias de control.



· Participar en el diseño y evaluación de controles de ciberseguridad para aplicaciones, datos e integraciones, tanto on-premise como cloud.



· Definir requerimientos de seguridad y criterios de aceptación para cada etapa del ciclo de vida, verificando evidencias antes de las decisiones de avance o puesta en producción.



· Coordinar la ejecución de las actividades necesarias de las áreas de la Dirección de Ciberseguridad, planificar las actividades, realizar el seguimiento de la ejecución en base a las prioridades acordadas y con una visión transversal en la implementación de los requerimientos respecto a ciberseguridad.



· Analizar casos de uso, flujos de información, fuentes de datos, modelos, prompts, agentes, herramientas, permisos e integraciones para evaluar exposición, privacidad, confidencialidad y uso responsable.



· Realizar evaluaciones de riesgo para nuevos casos de uso de datos e IA y recomendar controles proporcionales que habiliten la innovación de manera segura. Proponer alternativas que permitan adoptar IA de forma segura, con controles de acceso, minimización de datos, protección de información sensible, monitoreo, trazabilidad y supervisión humana según el riesgo.



· Evaluar riesgos asociados a LLMs, agentes y automatizaciones, tales como prompt injection, fuga o uso indebido de datos, respuestas no confiables, abuso de herramientas, permisos excesivos y dependencia de terceros.



· Promover pruebas de seguridad, validaciones de privacidad, revisión de accesos, monitoreo y automatización de controles en los procesos de desarrollo y entrega.



· Relevar y mantener actualizado el backlog de requerimientos, riesgos, controles, decisiones, excepciones y evidencias por producto.



· Coordinar con Product Owners, arquitectura, desarrollo, datos, operaciones y especialistas de ciberseguridad el alcance, responsables, prioridades, dependencias y fechas objetivo.



· Gestionar riesgos, registrar y seguir vulnerabilidades, hallazgos, desvíos y planes de remediación; escalar bloqueos o riesgos que excedan los umbrales acordados, y dar visibilidad a responsables técnicos y de negocio.



· Ser nexo entre los proyectos/los responsables de los productos digitales y las áreas técnicas de ciberseguridad, favoreciendo una comunicación clara y una resolución ágil de necesidades en base a las prioridades definidas.



· Analizar e implementar casos de uso de IA aplicados a ciberseguridad, automatización de controles y eficiencia operativa.



· Participar en iniciativas de gobierno de datos: clasificación, resguardo, tratamiento, retención, trazabilidad y definición de lineamientos de uso seguro. Colaborar en la evaluación de plataformas cloud y servicios SaaS (ecosistema Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio, etc).



· Preparar métricas y reportes sobre cobertura de controles, criticidad, vencimientos, riesgos aceptados, remediaciones y decisiones pendientes.



· Identificar oportunidades de mejora en procesos, estándares, herramientas y formas de trabajo, fomentando prácticas reutilizables entre productos.



· Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre amenazas, tendencias, marcos y buenas prácticas de seguridad de IA y datos, y traducirlas en mejoras aplicables a los productos.














¿Qué valoramos como diferencial?







Formación académica: Recibidos en i ngeniería/Licenciatura en Sistemas, Informática, Ciberseguridad, Administración de Tecnología o carreras afines, con capacidad para articular necesidades de negocio, producto, tecnología y seguridad.

Se valorarán cursos, especializaciones o certificaciones en ciberseguridad, gestión de proyectos, metodologías ágiles, seguridad de aplicaciones, gestión de riesgos o marcos como ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, OWASP, ITIL, CISM, CISSP o equivalentes.

Conocimiento de enfoques de desarrollo seguro y gestión de controles a lo largo del ciclo de vida de productos digitales.




Idioma: Ingles intermedio/avanzado

Conocimientos:

Experiencia mínima de 5 años en ciberseguridad, seguridad de aplicaciones o datos, tecnología y productos digitales.

· Experiencia en implementación o evaluación de soluciones y servicios de IA, automatización y colaboración, incluyendo soluciones de IA generativa, LLMs, agentes y modelos de lenguaje.

· Experiencia en seguridad de aplicaciones y APIs, protección de información sensible, clasificación de datos y controles de acceso, privacidad, trazabilidad y prevención de fuga de información.

· Experiencia coordinando tareas, dependencias y entregables entre equipos multidisciplinarios de producto, desarrollo, arquitectura, datos, infraestructura, operaciones y ciberseguridad. Gestión y seguimiento de tareas, riesgos y planes de acción.

· Participación en iniciativas gestionadas con metodologías ágiles, híbridas o tradicionales, con manejo de backlog, prioridades, hitos, riesgos y compromisos.

· Capacidad para interpretar arquitecturas, flujos de datos y requerimientos funcionales y técnicos; identificar impactos de seguridad y traducirlos en acciones concretas a lo largo del ciclo de vida del producto.



Seguridad de la información, ciberseguridad de datos e IA aplicada al ciclo de vida de productos digitales.

· Gestión de aspectos y controles de ciberseguridad desde la ideación y el diseño hasta la construcción, pruebas, despliegue, operación y retiro del producto, aplicando enfoques Secure SDLC y DevSecOps.

· Gobierno y seguridad de datos: inventario y clasificación de información, acceso, cifrado, retención, trazabilidad, privacidad, resguardo y tratamiento seguro.

· Seguridad y uso responsable de IA: evaluación de casos de uso, datos de entrenamiento y contexto, modelos, LLMs, agentes, integraciones, automatizaciones y controles de supervisión.

· Análisis de riesgos propios de IA generativa, incluyendo exposición o uso indebido de datos, prompt injection, fuga de información, respuestas no confiables, abuso de herramientas, accesos excesivos y riesgos de terceros.

· Seguridad de aplicaciones web y móviles, APIs, identidades y accesos, nube, componentes de terceros y gestión de secretos.

· Gestión de vulnerabilidades y riesgos: identificación, análisis, priorización, tratamiento, aceptación, seguimiento de remediaciones y registro de evidencias.

· Marcos y estándares como ISO 27001, NIST CSF, NIST AI RMF, CIS, OWASP, OWASP para aplicaciones con LLM, PCI DSS y normativa aplicable.

· Entornos Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 y Copilot Studio; conocimientos generales de AWS o Google Cloud y servicios SaaS.

· Metodologías Agile/Scrum/Kanban y herramientas de gestión como Azure DevOps, Jira o equivalentes.

· Conocimiento en SW y HW de mercado, y nuevas tecnologías emergentes.

· Conocimientos generales en herramientas y sistemas que soporten la Ciberseguridad de la empresa

· Conocimientos de desarrollo y automatización, preferentemente Python, para comprender integraciones, validar controles y apoyar pruebas.

· Elaboración de métricas, tableros, reportes ejecutivos y comunicaciones adaptadas a audiencias técnicas y de negocio.















Información del puesto

Sumarte a la #ExperienciaYPF es:

Discipline



Operations & Reporting






Role Type



Account Operations Manager






Role Rank



Assistant Director | 63






Current Rank CS



63








The opportunity

Our purpose, at EY, is building a better working world. The Operations and Reporting within EY GDS is a dynamic and multi-offering function consisting of 300+ employees across India, the Philippines, Argentina, and Poland with six global support centers. We provide operational excellence through methodologies and tools to build sustainable processes and practices. With functions such as global and regional operations, go-to-market enablers and business enablement, the Operations and Reporting continually supports EY’s growth endeavors. Our work aims to help reinforce our purpose of building a better working world for our people, our customers, and communities.

As an Account Operations Manager you will provide your strategic voice and perspective to elevate ideas, streamline, simplify, and improve business impact and efficiency. This role serves as the center of the wheel, liaising with essential interdependencies and leveraging resources to drive account contextual operational excellence. The AOM serves as the primary point of contact for Account Operations on the US Firm’s largest and fastest growing Sales and Strategic Pursuit accounts. This role involves working directly with the GCSP, Service Line Leaders and other Executive Leaders to assess Account Operational needs and driving delivery with timely and accurate resolution.

Your key responsibilities



• Serve as a trusted advisor to the Account Leadership team on all operational matters, proactively connecting to ensure value delivery


• Work along with the stakeholders in the execution of essential projects that are critical to business, handling sensitive information with meticulous care and strict confidentiality.


• Maintain a deep understanding of the Account’s goals, environment and requirements to provide additional context to new requests with minimal guidance .


• Participate in Account Team meetings, synthesizing new information to make relevant action recommendations where applicable and appropriate.


• Ensure timely and accurate delivery of reoccurring work products, including accountability for quality control, value and impact.


• Maintain broad familiarity with Firm functions to identify and engage the appropriate resources.


• Work directly on external and internal client required insights


• Analyse stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for enhancement and implement corrective action plans to steer continuous improvement efforts


• Contribute to recommendations for process optimization, identifying opportunities for increased efficiency and effectiveness.


• Manage collaborative tools and platforms that support efficient and effective operations, fostering a culture of seamless teamwork and communication.





Skills and attributes for success



• Proven ability to work in collaborative environment and lead team members


• Consultative Approach: Utilize effective questioning to identify needs and propose tailored solutions.


• Project Management: Expertise in crafting and steering project plans, overcoming obstacles to meet objectives.


• Strategic Presentation & Analysis: Skilled in creating presentations and leveraging insights for strategic business decisions.


• Networking: Forge strategic relationships across functions, sharing insights to advance account objectives.


• Entrepreneurial Drive: Take ownership, innovate, and pursue opportunities for significant business impact.


• Decisive Decision-Making: Confident in making informed decisions that guide and benefit the team.


• Empowerment and Development: Invests in the growth of team members, empowering them to excel and innovate.


• Analytical: Ability to analyze complex or unusual problems and able to deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions


• Emotional Intelligence: Recognize diverse work styles and cultures and adapt engagement methods accordingly.


• Effective Communication: Excel in clear communication at all organizational levels, with a global perspective.





To qualify for the role, you must have



Experience



• 10+ years of work experience


• Exposure with Big 4, leading consulting firms, professional services or similar industries is a plus


• Proven ability to manage complex processes and projects at a global level


• Must have worked in one or more areas listed below:





• 


• Sales Operations


• Client Services & Relationship Management


• Operations Management & Excellence


• Project & Program Management


• Process Design & Improvement


• C-Suite & Leadership Enablement









Tools & Technologies



• MS Office — demonstrated strong experience in MS Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint)


• Knowledge of using data visualization tools like Power BI, Tableau


• Knowledge of Project Management concepts and tools is desirable.







Number of interviews rounds and types



• HR Interview


• Technical Assessment


• Hiring Manager interaction


• 2 stakeholder interviews





What we offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.



• Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.


• Success, as defined by you : We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.


• Transformative leadership : We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.


• Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.



About EY

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers to the complex issues facing our world today.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

Apply now »

Asistir a las demás áreas de tecnología de la compañía, mediante reuniones técnicas y/o funcionales, con el objetivo de comprender los requerimientos y así poder adecuar las redes.

Gestionar y asegurar la resolución de casos críticos en los equipos del área de redes mediante el acceso remoto o físico, a fin de garantizar la continuidad operativa al negocio.

Cargar horas aplicadas a cada nueva investigación o proyecto en la herramienta Redmine (herramienta de gestión de horas) para registrar el tiempo invertido en cada tarea.

🎯  Requisitos

• 
Protocolos de ruteo dinámico, preferentemente OSPF y BGP.










• 
Segmentación de red mediante VLANs, VRFs, subredes y políticas de conectividad.










• 
Administración y troubleshooting de equipamiento de red: Cisco, Huawei, Fortinet o tecnologías equivalentes.










• 
Soluciones SD-WAN, conectividad distribuida y gestión de enlaces de telecomunicaciones.










• 
Conocimientos de firewalling, políticas de seguridad, NAT, VPN, publicación de servicios, segmentación y análisis de reglas.










• 
Monitoreo de red y análisis de disponibilidad/performance mediante herramientas como Nagios, LibreNMS, Zabbix, Grafana o similares.










• 
Gestión de incidentes, cambios y documentación técnica.










• 
Gestión de servicios DNS en entornos corporativos, incluyendo administración de zonas, registros, resolución interna/externa y troubleshooting, con herramientas como BIND, Route 53 o similares.










• 
Uso de herramientas de gestión ágil y trazabilidad de trabajo como Jira, Redmine, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps o similares.










• 
Conocimiento de metodologías ágiles, tableros de trabajo, priorización de backlog, seguimiento de tareas y registro de avances.










• 
Buen manejo de proveedores, carriers y áreas internas de tecnología.










• 
Conocimientos de cloud networking, preferentemente AWS, GCP, Azure, deseable.










• 
Experiencia en ambientes críticos, idealmente en organizaciones de salud, servicios financieros, seguros o empresas con operación distribuida.










• 
Uso de herramientas de inteligencia artificial, automatización, scripting o APIs para análisis, documentación, troubleshooting, generación de reportes o mejora operativa.













🧩 Nos orientamos a una persona que pueda




Analizar problemas complejos de conectividad y resolverlos con criterio técnico.




Trabajar en equipo, documentar y compartir conocimiento.






Participar en proyectos de evolución tecnológica, no solo en operación diaria.




Proponer mejoras, automatizaciones y buenas prácticas.

✅ Se valorará especialmente




Experiencia en redes distribuidas con múltiples sedes, clínicas, sanatorios, sucursales o edificios corporativos.




Conocimiento en administración de enlaces MPLS, Internet, LAN to LAN, VPN y conectividad híbrida.




Experiencia en procesos de obsolescencia tecnológica, migraciones, reemplazo de equipamiento y normalización de infraestructura.




Conocimiento de buenas prácticas de seguridad de red y trabajo conjunto con equipos de Seguridad Informática.




Experiencia en administración o interacción técnica con firewalls corporativos, políticas de acceso, troubleshooting de tráfico y segmentación segura.




Experiencia en documentación, inventario técnico, direccionamiento IP, VLANs y gestión de cambios.

Uso práctico de herramientas de IA para acelerar tareas técnicas, mejorar documentación, analizar información o asistir en diagnósticos.




Experiencia trabajando con tableros ágiles, épicas, historias/tareas, seguimiento de iniciativas y reporting de avances.









💫  Beneficios

🏋️‍♀️🏋️‍♂️ Cobertura en Gimnasios a través de la red Wellhub

postings.title: Especialista en Financiamiento Comercial
postings.descriptionText:
Ciudad : San Isidro 

País : Argentina (AR) 
Número de Requisición : 49181 








Objetivo del puesto

Potenciar las ventas y la rentabilidad de la compañía mediante el desarrollo de herramientas financieras, la generación de alternativas de financiamiento para clientes y la originacion y gestión activa de una cartera de créditos y activos financieros. La posición actuará como nexo entre las áreas comerciales, clientes y entidades financieras, transformando necesidades del negocio en soluciones que generen valor, reduzcan riesgos y contribuyan a los resultados económicos de la compañía.



Principales responsabilidades:



Gestión y desarrollo de herramientas financieras



• Administrar convenios y programas de financiamiento comercial con bancos, SGR, ALyCs, fintechs y fondos de inversión.


• Mantener una relación activa con entidades financieras para negociar condiciones comerciales e identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.


• Evaluar la conveniencia económica y el impacto comercial de diferentes alternativas de financiamiento.


• Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar nuevas soluciones financieras, coordinando su puesta en marcha con las áreas de Créditos, Finanzas, Contabilidad, Legales y Sistemas.



Originación y gestión de cartera de créditos



• Identificar, estructurar y ejecutar oportunidades de financiamiento que generen rentabilidad para la compañía.


• Originar, administrar y monitorear una cartera de créditos y activos financieros, maximizando el retorno ajustado por riesgo.


• Coordinar con las áreas Comercial, Créditos y Finanzas el análisis, instrumentación y seguimiento de operaciones.


• Definir estrategias de pricing, fondeo, renovación y distribución de riesgo.


• Detectar oportunidades de negocio que permitan generar soluciones de financiamiento innovadoras para clientes y para la compañía.



Soporte comercial y desarrollo de negocios



• Asesorar a clientes internos y externos sobre herramientas y alternativas de financiamiento.


• Participar en reuniones, visitas a clientes y eventos del sector para identificar oportunidades comerciales.


• Colaborar en el diseño e implementación de acciones comerciales vinculadas a soluciones financieras.


• Fortalecer el vínculo entre el negocio comercial y las herramientas financieras disponibles.



Reporting y mejora continua



• Elaborar reportes de gestión, utilización, rentabilidad y desempeño de programas financieros y cartera administrada.


• Gestionar la relación con plataformas financieras y herramientas tecnológicas vinculadas al negocio.


• Brindar soporte y capacitación a usuarios internos.


• Proponer e implementar mejoras operativas y de gestión que contribuyan a la eficiencia y al crecimiento del negocio.





Perfil técnico requerido





• Graduado/a en Economía, Administración de Empresas, Finanzas, Contador Público o carreras afines (Excluyente).


• Maestría en Finanzas finalizada o en curso (Excluyente).


• Experiencia mínima de 4 a 5 años en posiciones vinculadas a finanzas corporativas, financiamiento, mercado de capitales, banca, créditos o negocios financieros (Excluyente).


• Experiencia en análisis financiero, estructuración de operaciones de financiamiento y gestión de cartera de créditos (Excluyente).


• Manejo avanzado de Excel (Excluyente).


• Disponibilidad para realizar viajes frecuentes (aproximadamente 2 veces al mes) (Excluyente).


• Licencia de conducir vigente (Excluyente).


• Conocimientos de SAP (Deseable).


• Conocimientos de Tableau o herramientas de Business Intelligence (Deseable).





Competencias valoradas





• Fuerte iniciativa y orientación a la acción.


• Perfil analítico y capacidad para identificar oportunidades de negocio.


• Interés por desarrollar nuevas soluciones y desafiar procesos existentes.


• Excelentes habilidades de relacionamiento interpersonal y negociación.


• Orientación a resultados y visión comercial.


• Curiosidad, dinamismo y actitud proactiva.





Ubicación:



San Isidro, Buenos Aires.
Modalidad de trabajo híbrida. Disponibilidad para realizar viajes frecuentes dentro del país (aproximadamente dos veces al mes).

En Bunge (NYSE: BG), nuestro propósito es conectar a los agricultores con los consumidores para entregar alimentos, piensos y combustibles esenciales al mundo. Como proveedor líder de soluciones agroindustriales, nuestro equipo de ~34,000 empleados dedicados se asocia con agricultores de todo el mundo para trasladar los productos agrícolas desde donde se cultivan hasta donde se necesitan, de manera más rápida, inteligente y eficiente. Somos un líder mundial en originación, almacenamiento, distribución, procesamiento y refinación de oleaginosas, que ofrece una amplia cartera de aceites, grasas y proteínas de origen vegetal. Trabajamos junto con nuestros clientes en ambos extremos de la cadena de valor para ofrecer productos de calidad y desarrollar soluciones innovadoras y personalizadas que aborden las necesidades cambiantes de los consumidores. Con más de 200 años de experiencia y presencia en más de 50 países, estamos comprometidos a fortalecer la seguridad alimentaria mundial, promover la sostenibilidad y ayudar a las comunidades a prosperar donde operamos. Bunge tiene su domicilio social en Ginebra, Suiza, y su sede corporativa en St. Louis, Missouri. Obtenga más información en Bunge.com.



Cada día, nuestra gente ejemplifica estos valores, que representan la esencia de Bunge:


• SOMOS UN ÚNICO EQUIPO – Colaborativos, respetuosos, inclusivos
• LIDERAMOS EL CAMINO – Ágiles, empoderados, innovadores
• HACEMOS LO CORRECTO – Con seguridad, sustentabilidad e integridad



Reconocemos que nuestro éxito depende de las diversas perspectivas que cada uno de nuestros colaboradores aporta a Bunge. Nos esforzamos por promover acciones que fomenten una cultura de pertenencia. A nivel global, apoyamos iniciativas como los Principios para el Empoderamiento de las Mujeres, de ONU Mujeres. Colaboramos con organizaciones como Disability:IN, un referente en la inclusión de personas con discapacidad y trabajamos continuamente en pro de nuestro compromiso de dejar un legado positivo en todas las comunidades en las que operamos.

Si esto le suena bien, ¡únase a nosotros! Valoramos e invertimos en personas que creen en nuestro propósito y están entusiasmadas por vivirlo cada día: personas que están #OrgullosasDeSerBunge.

postings.descriptionText:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website ( monks.com/careers ).

About the Role

You will play a key role in ensuring both the visual quality and functional integrity of deliverables before release. You’ll work across design, content, and development stages to make sure every asset is not only pixel-perfect and on-brand, but also works as intended across devices, browsers, and user journeys. We’re looking for someone detail-oriented, collaborative, and proactive—someone who can spot inconsistencies, validate functionality, and help improve the overall quality and consistency of our outputs.

Responsibilities:

• Review and QA designs, animations, and edits for pixel perfect execution, consistency, copy accuracy, and adherence to strict branding and platform specifications.

• Test user flows, interactions, layouts, and behaviors across devices and browsers to ensure seamless execution.

• Provide detailed, constructive feedback to creative teams, acting as the final checkpoint before public release.

• Use Jira, or other project management tools to document, track, and report bugs or visual inconsistencies, and ensure timely resolution.

• Continuously refine and integrate QA processes within the wider production workflow, identifying opportunities to boost efficiency and quality.

• Maintain accurate, insightful QA documentation to track trends and guide improvements.

• Collaborate with producers, designers, and developers to ensure the highest creative standards are met in a fast-paced environment

About You

The essentials:

• 2–3 years of hands-on QA experience, ideally with exposure to both functional and visual testing.

• Strong eye for design, layout, spacing, composition, consistency, and detail, with working proficiency in Figma or comparable design tools.

• Experience reviewing digital deliverables across multiple devices and browsers.

• Good understanding of digital media specs and cross-device requirements

• Excellent organization and prioritization skills—able to manage multiple projects while maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality.

• Clear communicator, adept at providing thorough and actionable feedback to creative and production teams.

• Versed in QA and production tracking tools, particularly Jira and Excel.

• Positive, solutions-oriented mindset with a natural drive for continuous improvement

• Previous experience in a marketing, advertising or digital production environment.

Not a Must but a Plus:

• Knowledge and interest in learning about generative agentic AI, automation processes and tech.

postings.descriptionText:
Join Nortal for your next big adventure. We are seeking a Senior Fullstack Engineer to join our team, grow with us, and teach us a few things along the way.

Why join Nortal

• Say Goodbye to Micromanagement: We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.

• Outcomes Over Hours: We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being.

• Vibrant Community: Join our close-knit LATAM remote team and connect through tech talks, virtual coffee breaks, and team-building activities.

• Support from Day One: Our People Care team is here to support you throughout your journey, from wellness check-ins to professional growth.

Our benefits ✨

• Competitive USD salary.

• 100% remote work: While you can work from anywhere, you’re always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM.

• Paid time off & national holidays: Take the time you need according to your country’s regulations while receiving your full salary.

• Sick leave: Focus on your health without stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better.

• Annual credit: Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance.

• Team-building activities: Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community.

• Birthday off: Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family.

About the project

You’ll do full-stack engineering for a US client in an AI-accelerated delivery model. You’ll own features from requirements through production and pick up planned roadmap work. The stack includes Python, FastAPI, Vue.js (the client is moving to it), React, Kubernetes, GCP, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, and Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools. We’re looking for someone who works independently and is glad to share the AI setups and practices that work for them with the rest of the team.

What you’ll do

• Own features end to end, from requirements through production, across the frontend and backend.

• Deliver planned roadmap work on microservices and REST APIs, using Python and FastAPI.

• Build and evolve frontend applications in Vue.js and React, supporting the client’s move to Vue.js.

• Deploy and run services on Kubernetes in GCP, working with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and MySQL.

• Use Claude Code or similar tools in your daily development, and critically review AI-generated code for quality and correctness.

• Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code reviews, and observability practices.

• Share effective AI setups and practices with the team to improve how everyone delivers.

• Take part in Nortal’s Technical Interviewer Program, conducting technical interviews for your account and other accounts to help build the teams behind Nortal’s growth.

What makes you a great fit

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field

• Strong full-stack engineering background

• Deep expertise in at least one backend language and working knowledge of others. Python is preferred, but Java or Node.js with Python exposure also works.

• Frontend experience with Vue.js and/or React

• Experience with microservices and REST APIs (FastAPI is a plus)

• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes

• Cloud experience, ideally GCP.

• Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL)

• Solid CI/CD, automated testing, code review, and observability practices

• Real, day-to-day experience with AI-assisted development using Claude Code or similar tools

• Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

Nice to have

• Experience modernizing Java applications toward Python

• GKE and other GCP-native services

• Edge or on-premises Kubernetes

• Experience with healthcare, medical, or regulated software

• AI/ML, computer vision, or video processing experience

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.

We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.

Apply now and let’s shape the future of technology together! 🧑‍💻

postings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we’ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don’t just provide data; we provide certainty .

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don’t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500 , protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria’s Secret .

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.

•
Extreme Ownership: We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

•
The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.

•
Methodology & Rigor: We don’t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.

•
Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.

•
The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

•
Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

•
Unlimited Leaves: We don’t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.

•
Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.

•
Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the implementation owner of a customer’s success with SAFE, from the first onboarding call to a working, trusted deployment delivering value as a key part of their business processes. You sit between the customer's implementation teams and SAFE's engineering teams, understanding all sides well enough to translate between them. You have detailed product knowledge to be able to implement customers' business needs using existing features, and create customisations as needed.

In this role you will have a strong understanding of SAFE/Industry best practice, guiding the customer to achieve their outcomes on the SAFE Platform, This will include educating and enabling the customer, as well as a technical implementation.

You build the scripts, configure the platform, integrations, agents and automations that get a customer live. You diagnose what stands in the way of a customer's success, and where necessary engage internal teams with a clear, evidenced problem statement with an agreed outcome. You hold the end-to-end picture of how SAFE works, so a conversation between a customer and SAFE teams reaches a decision quickly.

You use AI tooling every day to engage with customers more effectively, work with more autonomy and enable others, improving existing processes and tooling to achieve rapid deployments and value realisation.

What you'll do:

Own customer onboarding and delivery

•
Lead technical onboarding for assigned customers: scope, plan, configure, integrate and confirm the customer is getting value.

•
Own each engagement to a defined outcome. Keep the customer and internal teams informed on progress, risks and next steps.

•
Travel to customer sites for workshops, deployments and escalations.

•
Write scripts and lightweight automations that speed up onboarding, data loading, integration set-up and repeat tasks.

Technical implementation

•
Collect technical details from customers about their environment, data sources and integrations: authentication, permissions, network constraints, payload formats and expected behaviour.

•
Configure and customise the SAFE platform to meet customer business needs, making direct product fixes where appropriate.

•
Build and test customer-specific workflows and AI agents, using SAFE and third-party APIs as needed.

•
Build custom solutions to achieve customer outcomes where product gaps exist.

•
Create tooling to accelerate delivery processes and automate repetitive tasks.

•
Diagnose failed or incomplete integrations and data flows.

Debug and troubleshoot

•
Reproduce and investigate issues using logs, platform telemetry and platform knowledge. Work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, with or without AI tooling

•
Present each issue to engineering with the evidence: what happens, what should happen, who it affects, and what you have already ruled out.

•
Stay with the issue until the customer has a resolution or an agreed workaround.

Bridge the customer and engineering

•
Talk to engineering stakeholders as a peer. Define the outcome a customer needs, not the implementation.

•
Join customer and internal technical calls to provide expert guidance and drive project deliverables to completion.

•
Spot patterns across customers. Raise them as product feedback with the customer's business outcome and their own words.

•
Act as an internal customer, working closely with Product teams to ensure that new features are understood and have a clear route to deliver customer value.

Use AI tooling to scale your work

•
Use AI tools to analyse logs, draft scripts, summarise issues and prepare customer-facing material, using your experience to refine outcomes.

•
Turn repeated tasks into reusable scripts, AI skills or automations that the wider team can use.

What you'll bring:

Essential

•
Ownership and accountability. You take a problem as yours until it is closed, and you say so early when something slips.

•
Creative thinking and problem-solving. You find a route to success, resolving issues as you hit them.

•
Curiosity. Not everything is documented. You explore, discover and experiment to achieve an outcome.

•
Experience in script building, product delivery and working directly with customers. This can come from a customer-facing technical role or substantial project work.

•
Product onboarding experience. You have taken customers or users from set-up to live use of a technical product.

•
API fluency. You can read API documentation, call and chain endpoints, handle authentication, and interpret responses and errors.

•
Debugging and troubleshooting skills. You work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, respecting customer data handling requirements.

•
Excellent written/verbal communication. You explain technical findings and concepts clearly to the level of the target audience, backed by an expert understanding of the system architecture.

•
Development. You write scripts that call APIs, process data, and automate customer tasks using Python as a preferred language. You understand code generated by AI tools for human review and challenge.

•
Cloud Services. You understand core cloud-based services and how they can be implemented at customers and used by SAFE.

•
Demonstrable use of AI tooling. You can show real examples of using AI to troubleshoot, script or automate, and you can say where it fell short.

•
Ability to travel to customer sites.

Nice to have

•
Exposure to cybersecurity, risk management or security-tool integrations (for example, vulnerability scanners, SIEM, asset inventories or identity providers).

•
Bash or PowerShell.

•
Experience in a customer-facing technical role (forward deployed, solutions, customer or support engineering) at a SaaS or enterprise software company.

•
Experience working in distributed, multi-time-zone teams.

Why this role is exciting:

•
Own customer outcomes at the point where SAFE meets real enterprise environments.

•
Work with engineering, product and customer teams on problems that shape the platform.

•
Build creative solutions to problems, both customer facing and internal

•
Learn cyber risk, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM), a growing part of cybersecurity.

•
Use Python, APIs and AI tooling to remove manual work for yourself and the team.

Compensation

Additional Information

If you’re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that’s redefining security, we want to hear from you! 🚀

postings.title: Enterprise Sales Executive, AI Solutions
postings.descriptionText:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce .

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our AI Solutions business. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges through forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software and platforms, AI services, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients move from AI strategy and experimentation into production, combining Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to achieve measurable business outcomes.

This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who have successfully sold enterprise AI solutions and are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and establish Toptal as a core AI services provider embedded in your clients’ most critical initiatives.

Enterprise AI has shifted rapidly from experimentation to execution. Companies are investing in models, agents, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled applications, but many are struggling to translate those investments into production systems and measurable business outcomes.

The challenge is no longer simply selecting an AI model or platform. Enterprises must identify the right workflows, connect AI to their proprietary data and knowledge, integrate existing systems, build and deploy agents and applications, establish evaluation and control frameworks, drive adoption, and continuously operate and improve AI in production.

Toptal brings together world-class AI and domain talent, forward-deployed solution delivery, AI platforms and capabilities, strategic technology partners, expert-in-the-loop operations, and managed services to help enterprises move from AI promise to production.

This role exists to convert that market opportunity into new enterprise relationships and position Toptal as a strategic partner for companies deploying AI across their organizations.

This is a remote position with significant client-facing fieldwork across the US. Applicants who reside within commutable distance of a major metropolitan area are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

*The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.

Net new accounts may begin with a specific AI initiative, workflow, platform implementation, or business problem requiring a disciplined approach to defining the opportunity and matching the right Toptal capabilities to the client’s needs. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units, workflows, technology platforms, and senior executive relationships.

These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, understanding the client’s AI and technology environment, aligning solutions to evolving business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account while consistently driving measurable client value and long-term growth.

• Own and build a portfolio of enterprise AI accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.

• Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.

• Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.

• Lead AI solution development and deal execution in partnership with AI Services leadership, Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Partnerships, and Delivery teams.

• Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.

• Shape AI solutions that apply Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to clients’ most important business and operating challenges.

• Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.

• Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first week, expect to:

• Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.

• Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.

• Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.

• Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.

• Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

In the first month, expect to:

• Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.

• Learn about the Toptal AI Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, solution portfolio, partner ecosystem, and client engagement model.

• Work with AI Services leadership to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.

• Shadow key calls and client meetings.

• Begin to meet with clients, leveraging your existing enterprise AI network and relationships, to articulate Toptal’s capabilities and identify where we can help organizations move AI into production.

• Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.

• Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.

• Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design AI engagements.

In the first three months, expect to:

• Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage with Toptal’s AI capabilities and specialists.

• Begin shaping AI solutions that resonate with your target accounts, including forward-deployed AI solutions, Outcome Agents, agentic workflows, enterprise data and knowledge solutions, AI platforms, and managed AI services, demonstrating your comfort and ability in working with ambiguity and directly innovating alongside your clients.

• Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their AI priorities, business workflows, existing technology investments, and desired outcomes.

• Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.

• Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.

• Actively contribute to team rituals, best practice sharing, and win/loss reviews.

In the first six months, expect to:

• Have an initial base of active clients while continuing to build your overall portfolio.

• Expand your buyer network and deepen executive engagement across your accounts.

• Drive net new opportunities by introducing additional AI capabilities, platforms, solutions, partners, and managed services and displacing incumbent providers.

• Shape and influence client priorities, aligning Toptal’s AI solutions to critical business objectives and measurable, validated outcomes.

• Execute against a defined growth plan tied to measurable outcomes.

In the first year, expect to:

• Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize Toptal’s AI capabilities to address their priorities and key business challenges.

• Establish and expand a strong executive network across your portfolio, building a foundation of advocates and sponsors.

• Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our AI model, and how to successfully grow their territory.

• Be recognized for your subject matter expertise in enterprise AI solutions, leveraging your existing network and relationships as well as your proven consultative selling skills to drive meaningful results for your clients and the overall AI Services team.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree is required.

• 7-10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, AI software, professional services, or consulting sales, with a strong foundation in enterprise account development and complex solution selling.

• Direct experience selling enterprise AI solutions is required, ideally including forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software or platforms, AI consulting and professional services, or managed AI services.

• Extensive experience in consultative customer engagement and selling service-oriented, technology-enabled, or outcome-based solutions to enterprise clients.

• Demonstrated success building a book of business from the ground up, i.e. self-sourcing, prospecting, and developing new enterprise relationships rather than relying on an inherited portfolio.

• Proven track record managing a $5M+ annualized gross portfolio and closing $250K-$1M+ complex, multi-phase deals with enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.

• Must be comfortable engaging C-level executives on how AI is changing their business, technology environment, operating model, workforce, and competitive landscape.

• A well-rounded understanding of enterprise AI challenges and trends, including generative AI, agentic AI, AI applications and platforms, enterprise data and knowledge, models, workflow automation, governance, evaluation, controls, and managed AI operations.

• Ability to have informed discussions about how AI moves from strategy and experimentation into real enterprise workflows and production environments, including the importance of context, data, integration, validation, governance, adoption, and ongoing operations.

• Experience selling solutions involving leading AI, cloud, data, or enterprise technology platforms, and the ability to work in a platform-flexible environment across client technology ecosystems.

• Exposure to hybrid talent models, forward-deployed delivery models, or alternative consulting delivery models.

• Ability to build and execute account plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.

• Proven success in collaborative prospecting, running virtual and on-site sales calls, and leading sales pursuits backed by a multidisciplinary team.

• Experience negotiating complex service agreements with procurement and legal departments within enterprise accounts.

• Ability to partner effectively across multiple internal teams to shape innovative solutions that drive client success.

• Willingness and ability to travel to client sites, conferences, and team events (up to 25%).

postings.descriptionText:
YAMU Media is looking for a Talent Recruiter located outside of the United States to join our team. The role is open to people located in Latin America, Asia or Africa.
Job title: Recruiter

Job Overview
YAMU Media is a performance marketing agency working with B2B SaaS, ecommerce, and local businesses across the US market. We are a remote-first team of people who move fast, hold high standards, and care about building something worth working at.
We are looking for a mid-level recruiter to own hiring execution across YAMU. This is not a coordinator role. You will be the person who sources, screens, and moves candidates through the process with structure and speed, reporting directly to the Head of People. You will typically work across three to four open roles at once, all within marketing and paid media. You are the one who protects the pipeline by making sure only candidates who actually meet the bar get to the hiring manager, and that every candidate who touches YAMU leaves with a good impression of us, regardless of outcome.

Key Responsibilities
You will own sourcing across platforms including LinkedIn, Upwork, and our ATS, running both inbound screening and outbound outreach depending on the role. You will conduct screening calls that go beyond logistics: your job is to gather the information the hiring manager actually needs, flag misalignments early, and make a clear recommendation. You will coordinate technical tests and schedule interviews, making sure every step of the process is clean and no candidate falls through the cracks.
A big part of this role is calibration. You will work closely with the hiring manager to understand what each role actually requires, and you will make sure every candidate you advance has been evaluated against the full job description and the technical expectations set by the hiring manager. You will not pass someone through because they seemed nice. You will not advance someone because they interviewed well but can't do the work.
You will also take candidate experience seriously. That means timely updates, clear communication about next steps, and closing every candidate loop, including the ones who don't move forward. You will track pipeline activity and report on the status of open roles so that leadership always has visibility without having to ask.

Requirements

• At least 5 years of total recruiting experience, with a minimum of 2 years focused on marketing, paid media, or digital agency roles

• Experience hiring for the US market, with international recruiting exposure in Latam, Asia, or Africa

• Familiarity with AI tools used in recruiting workflows (HireEZ, SeekOut, ChatGPT/Claude for sourcing and screening support, AI-assisted ATS features)

• Prior experience working in a startup environment, comfortable with fast-paced, evolving priorities

• Demonstrated experience in end-to-end recruitment, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer management.

• Strong skills in candidate sourcing through job boards, social platforms, networking, boolean search, and talent pipeline development.

• Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), recruitment CRMs, and basic analytics or reporting tools. (BullHorn, Ashby, Greenhouse, Workable or any ATS)

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to conduct structured, unbiased interviews.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple requisitions, and prioritize effectively.

• Familiarity with SaaS, digital marketing, or tech-enabled service environments is highly beneficial.

• Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and experience implementing fair, non-discriminatory hiring practices.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Your Attributes
You have a structured process and you follow it. You do not wait to be told something is wrong. If you notice a gap between what a hiring manager is asking for and the candidates coming in, you flag it before it becomes a problem. You are thorough without being slow. You know the difference between screening and selling, and you do not oversell roles to candidates in order to keep the pipeline full.
You are genuinely curious about people. You ask follow-up questions when an answer feels thin, and you know the difference between a real example and a framework answer. You take candidate experience personally because you understand that every interaction with a candidate is a reflection of the company you represent.
You are comfortable working across multiple roles at once without losing the thread on any of them. You do not need a lot of oversight to stay organized, but you communicate proactively and keep the people you report to informed.

We Offer You
Salary: discussable based on experience. Salaries at YAMU are uncapped and are periodically reviewed and increased based on performance and market conditions .
You will work directly at a remote-first company that moves fast and values doing things right.
This is a role where you will see the full picture of how a high-performance team gets built, and your work will have a direct impact on the quality of every team we grow.
Become part of a team of smart, open-minded people with individual qualities
You'll be a part of a rapidly growing company, with plentiful opportunities to grow into leadership roles. And you'll face a steep learning curve & daily data science, technological, and business challenges.
Work-Life Balance:We understand the importance of balancing work with personal life and offer supportive, flexible work arrangements to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.
Yamu Media provides a start-up environment and culture; fast-paced and agile with quick decision-making. It's an honest and open environment where team members at all levels can make a difference and have a say.
We believe in life-long learning and supporting the development of our team. We are committed to internal promotions, offering clear pathways for advancements as your skills are developed and experience is gained.

About YAMU
YAMU Media is a US-based demand-generation agency. We work with B2B SaaS companies, ecommerce brands, and local businesses from $1M to $20M ARR. Our services include paid media, SEO, CRO, email marketing, and web development. We are fully remote and operate on EST hours.
