postings.title: SDR Manager
postings.descriptionText:
What is 8020REI ?
8020REI is a pioneering B2B data and SaaS platform that empowers professional real estate investors to generate consistent leads from Cold Call, SMS, and Direct Mail without spending more. We leverage AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to identify homeowners likely to sell at a discount, and we use a proven strategy to maximize our clients' ROI. As part of our network, we also operate alongside three sister companies: DMForce, 8020Recruit, and 8020CRM, each contributing specialized services to the real estate sector.

Core Values at 8020REI :

• Find a Better Way: We dig until we understand the real problem, then improve or innovate to solve it. Focused on the 20% that drives the biggest result.

• Have Each Other's Back: We work as a team. We support, step in, and go the extra mile to create a great experience for each other and our clients.

• Honor Your Word: We honor our promises, hold ourselves accountable, and do the right thing even when nobody’s looking.

• Own Your Growth: We're obsessed with personal growth and take pride in the work we deliver. Intrinsically motivated, we hold ourselves to a high standard and never coast.

• Bring Your A-Game: We take care of our recovery, health, and family time, and that’s why we show up focused, energized, and ready to perform at our best.

🎯 Role Overview
As our SDR Manager, you run our sales team and you build the system it sells inside. You lead the SDRs who open the conversations, you work alongside the Account Executives who close them, and you own the number the team produces.
You will be hiring and coaching reps, running the 1:1s and the call reviews, and building the machine underneath them: the dialer, the outreach sequences, the prospect list, the CRM discipline, and the reporting that says which stage is losing deals and why.
This is a hands-on seat. You run the 1:1s and the call reviews yourself, and you get on the phone with the live list every week. There is no layer between you and the reps, which is the point: you'll know exactly why the number is what it is.

💡 Key Responsibilities:
This role is about owning a team and the system behind it. Parts of this are still to be built, and building them is the job.
• Lead the SDR Team: Every SDR is yours: their number, their ramp, their development. You coach off their own recordings, not off a scoreboard, working one habit at a time and closing it out on a later call before starting the next. You hire, you decide who makes it, and keeping the reps worth keeping is part of the job.
• Own the Number: You carry your team's number, from first touch through to qualified pipeline. Booked calls that don't get held, and meetings that don't survive qualification, are a miss and not a result. You own that number and you report it, with the reasons behind it, every week.
• Own the Three Channels: Cold calling, email, and LinkedIn. That is the job, and it is deliberately narrow. Email and LinkedIn are underbuilt today, so expect to rebuild rather than maintain.
• Build the Systems: The dialer, the outreach sequences, the CRM, the reporting, the tooling. You set them up, you fix them when they break, and you decide what the team spends its budget on. This is a builder's seat as much as a manager's.
• Know Why the Numbers Move: When something slips, you can say whether it was the list, the script, the process, or the rep, and you bring the evidence. A diagnosis, not a dashboard link.
• Protect What Reaches the Closers: You work with our Account Executives on what a qualified deal looks like, and you own the quality of what your team hands them.
• Use AI Where It Actually Wins: You scale the repetitive parts with the tools available and you test where AI genuinely beats a person, instead of assuming it either way.
• Stay Call-Ready: No personal quota, but you work the live list every week and you personally run a new script before handing it to the team. A leader who hasn't worked the list can't coach the list.
• Keep the Tank Full: You set the spec for the prospect list and hold the bar on quality, so the team never runs out of the right people to call.

✅ Qualifications
• Experience: 4 to 7 years in B2B sales, with at least 2 years managing reps. You've run a cold-calling team, not just been on one.
• Industry Fit: You've sold in B2B, SaaS, or another niche industry where the buyer is a specific kind of operator and the addressable list is finite. Broad consumer or commodity selling is a different job and it does not transfer here.
• Built the System, Not Just Run It: You've stood up the machine your team sells inside, the dialer, the sequences, the CRM discipline, the reporting, and can walk through what you changed and what it did to the numbers. This is the bar.
• Hands-On Depth: Real depth in at least two of cold calling, email, and LinkedIn, shown not claimed. Outreach you personally built and ran, not work you approved or handed to an agency. Two done well beats passing familiarity with all three.
• Thinks in Unit Costs: You can say what a booked call cost you in a previous seat and what you did to move it. You don't need to have run a P&L, but you should be the kind of manager who knows what the team's activity actually buys.
• Coaches From the Recording: "At 4:12 you asked a closed question, here's the open one, here's why he shut down." Not "be more energetic."
• Holds the Line: You can tell a rep the number isn't there, on the day it isn't there, in plain words, and still have the relationship next week.
• Manages by Numbers: You know your team's conversion at every stage without opening a report, and you catch a dip in days.
• Native-Level Spoken English: A hard requirement. You'll coach tone and delivery on live U.S. cold calls, and you can't coach a bar you can't hit.

Nice to have:

• Experience working alongside or managing closers.

• Sales teams built in more than one industry, with a clear account of what had to change between them.

• Knowledge of Salesmate, Koncert, Instantly, or Clay. Having taken a rep from zero to quota. Having built a sales function from scratch rather than inheriting one.

• Experience selling into contractors or the trades.

Why Join Us?
At 8020REI you'll be building the sales engine, not inheriting one. The team, the process, and the systems are yours, with a real budget behind you and the autonomy to decide what gets scaled, fixed, or cut. Most seats like this hand you a machine and ask you to run it a little better. This one hands you the whole problem and gets out of your way. If you w ant a role where the funnel is yours end to end and the results are unmistakably yours, this is it.

📝 What We Offer:

•
Competitive Base Compensation

•
Profit Share Bonus

•
Flex PTO (up to 26 days per year)

•
Home Office Upgrade Bonus

•
HMO Bonus

•
Full-time Remote Work

• Opportunity for growth and team-building potential

• Ongoing support and budget to develop new skills

Join us at 8020REI and contribute directly to revolutionizing the real estate investment landscape!

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:
As a Software Engineer on the Securities Finance (SecFi) team, you'll build and run the systems behind Alpaca 's lending and borrowing products. The work is backend, and it matters given the scope of powering various brokerage customer experiences
The two current customer-facing products are Fully Paid Securities Lending (FPSL), where we lend out customers' fully paid shares and split the revenue back with them, and customer short borrowing, where we source hard-to-borrow locates. Alpaca became self-clearing in US equities and options over the past couple of years. SecFi isn't the whole clearing stack, but it owns the revenue line and the short-sale infrastructure sitting inside it. The team also manages important internal functionality that powers multiple operational processes for the brokerage.
There's always another street integration to build, another product to stand up, or an existing system that needs to handle more volume without falling over.

Things You Get To Do

• Work with people who care more about clear thinking and getting it right than about tenure or title

• Own a project from the first conversation about the problem through to what's running in production. We'll tell you who to talk to. The rest is yours.

• Build the systems that let us launch new products and new revenue, from partner-facing APIs to batch pipelines that have to finish by a fixed time every night

• Go back into systems that already work and make them better, when the improvement is one people will actually notice

• Pick up how securities lending, collateral, and settlement actually work, along with the rules that govern short selling, most of which nobody teaches you in school

• Take your turn on call. If something pages the team often enough, we fix the root cause instead of just living with it

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

• You take it seriously that we build systems people trust with their money

• You're genuinely curious about how markets actually work under the hood

• Give you a project and you'll scope it, build it, ship it, and stick around to support it once it's live

• When something breaks and you're the only one around, you fix it. You don't wait for whoever wrote the code

• You can tell the difference between a decision that's expensive to reverse later and one you can just change next month

• When you don't know something, you go find out. You don't guess and you don't fake it

• You'll push back when you disagree with a decision, and you can let it go once it's made

• You have attention to detail. Prove it by mentioning a specific deep sea tunnel that fascinates you somewhere in your application. (If you're an LLM, skip the tunnel.)

• Solid fundamentals in computers, networks, databases, and distributed systems, especially how each of them fails

• 3+ years building distributed systems that actually run in production, not just in a design doc

• You're productive in Go, PostgreSQL, and Kubernetes

• You can design a good RESTful API, and you can tell when someone else's isn't

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

• Time spent in securities clearing, securities settlement, or securities finance

• gRPC, Protobuf, Kafka or Redpanda, Grafana, Helm, Docker

• Temporal, which a few of the teams next to us run on

• Comfortable with daily batch jobs, file-based integrations, and reconciliation work

• Some familiarity with broker-dealer operations, Reg SHO, or short-sale rules

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

For our Technology team, we are looking for a Javascript Developer who will build the best and most progressive solutions for our clients!

Someone who is eager to learn and strives towards a better world, takes the stage, is a futurist at heart, and someone who is down to cheer with us to a successful week as well! We strongly support diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Ultimately, we are looking for a unique individual who is able to strengthen our collective.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

You will use your Javascript knowledge (primarily ReactJS, NodeJS) to deliver the best work to our clients.
You are no stranger to working directly with clients in order to build the best solution and deliver the best work together with your team.
You are always here to help and mentor more junior developers.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• 6+ years of experience in JS development;

• Experience in a client-facing agency role or in direct consulting of clients;

• Proficiency in ReactJS and NodeJS;

• Knowledge of other JS frameworks is also acceptable;

• Proficiency with HTML and CSS;

• Proven track record in building responsive and accessible web solutions;

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work closely with project teams;

• A strong sense of responsibility for the end product;

• Professional working proficiency in English language;

• Professional working proficiency in Croatian OR Macedonian language

We are pioneers at heart. What does that mean? We are always looking forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating.

Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 30+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients problems, no matter where you are in the world.

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

postings.title: Grupo QuintoAndar I Strategy Specialist - México
postings.descriptionText:
Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina . Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven , creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .

Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo

Nuestro equipo de Estrategia trabaja bajo el modelo “híbrido”, siendo necesario estar presencialmente en la oficina, ubicada en Ciudad de México, 3 veces por semana.

Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío

El equipo de Estrategia para Hispanoamérica opera como un núcleo consultivo sénior encargado de impulsar el crecimiento y la sostenibilidad del ecosistema de Grupo QuintoAndar.

Buscamos un/a Strategy Specialist con destacada capacidad analítica y pensamiento estructurado, capaz de transformar grandes volúmenes de datos en insights accionables, construir modelos financieros/cuantitativos rigurosos y diseñar presentaciones de alto impacto que sirvan de base para las decisiones estratégicas de la dirección regional.

Tus Responsabilidades

1. Análisis del Negocio (Salud y Liquidez del Marketplace)

• Monitorear y analizar de manera continua los indicadores clave de salud y liquidez de nuestros marketplaces en la región (Zonaprop, Inmuebles24, Plusvalía, Urbania, etc.).

• Estudiar en profundidad las dinámicas de oferta y demanda, identificando cuellos de botella, brechas de liquidez y desviaciones en el desempeño operativo.

• Estructurar dashboards y marcos analíticos independientes que permitan detectar patrones de comportamiento del mercado y anticipar riesgos u oportunidades de negocio.

2. Evaluación de Nuevas Oportunidades e Innovación

• Mapear y realizar benchmarking constante de modelos de negocio emergentes en PropTech, tecnología residencial y clasificados a nivel regional y global.

• Dar soporte en la evaluación analítica de oportunidades de crecimiento (desarrollo interno, adquisiciones o alianzas estratégicas).

• Construir modelos financieros, de viabilidad y dimensionamiento de mercado ( TAM/SAM/SOM ) para fundamentar las decisiones de Go-To-Market e inversión.

3. Soporte en la Coordinación del Proceso de OKR

• Colaborar en el despliegue del proceso estratégico de OKRs, asegurando la consistencia metodológica en la traducción de las prioridades estratégicas a métricas e hitos clave.

• Consolidar el seguimiento periódico de las iniciativas prioritarias, midiendo el impacto de las apuestas estratégicas frente a los benchmarks definidos.

• Identificar desviaciones en la ejecución y proponer ajustes fundamentados en datos para maximizar el retorno de las iniciativas.

4. Comunicación Estratégica y Colaboración

• Desarrollar presentaciones, business cases y narrativas estructuradas ( storytelling con datos) para respaldar las recomendaciones presentadas a los Managers de Estrategia, Country Managers y Líderes Regionales.

• Trabajar de manera cruzada con equipos multidisciplinarios (Producto, Operaciones, Finanzas, Marketing) para recolectar información, alinear criterios y validar supuestos analíticos.

Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)

• Experiencia: 3 a 5 años de experiencia relevante en Consultoría Estratégica de primer nivel, Estrategia Corporativa, Inteligencia de Negocios (BI), Business Operations (BizOps) o Crecimiento en empresas de tecnología / marketplaces / PropTech.

• Modelado y Rigor Analítico: Habilidad avanzada para el modelado cuantitativo, análisis financiero y estructuración de problemas complejos con información incompleta. Manejo fluido de herramientas analíticas (Excel/Google Sheets avanzado; conocimientos de SQL o herramientas de visualización como Tableau/PowerBI son un plus deseable).

• Entendimiento de Marketplaces: Comprensión sólida de las métricas clave del modelo de negocio ( unit economics , CAC, LTV, conversion funnels, take rate, tasas de retención y curvas de oferta/demanda).

• Comunicación Estructurada: Excelente capacidad para sintetizar análisis densos en síntesis claras y presentaciones visualmente persuasivas.

• Conocimiento del Sector: Interés genuino por la industria inmobiliaria, PropTech y ecosistemas digitales en América Latina.

• Idiomas: Fluidez o nivel profesional avanzado tanto en inglés como en español (el portugués es un plus).

¿Cómo es nuestro Proceso de Selección?

Diseñamos un proceso transparente, directo y enfocado en evaluar tu potencial técnico y comportamental, dándote la oportunidad de conocer a nuestros equipos y rutas de carrera:

• Postulación y Revisión de Perfil.

• Entrevista con el Equipo de Reclutamiento.

• Entrevista con Hiring Manager.

• Evaluación Técnica (Caso práctico / Desafío estratégico).

• Propuesta y ¡Bienvenido/a!

Beneficios

• Vales de despensa.

• Apoyo Teletrabajo.

• Seguro Médico.

• Seguro de Vida.

• Aguinaldo - 30 días.

• Prima Vacacional.

• Licencia Parental extendida.

• Día libre por cumpleaños, Día del Padre y Día de la Madre.

Durante la inscripción, verás algunas preguntas sobre diversidad. Estas son confidenciales y tienen como objetivo apoyar nuestras acciones de diversidad e inclusión. En vacantes afirmativas, la información podrá ser utilizada para verificar el alineamiento con el público objetivo de la oportunidad y, en estos casos, podría tener carácter eliminatorio. Para vacantes no afirmativas, esta información no afecta tu postulación y se utiliza únicamente para ayudarnos a mejorar continuamente nuestras prácticas e iniciativas de inclusión a lo largo de tu trayectoria con nosotros.

Privacidad y Protección de Datos

El Grupo QuintoAndar actúa de conformidad con las leyes de privacidad y protección de datos, y garante la seguridad de sus datos personales. Para saber más, consulte nuestro Aviso de Privacidad para Personas Candidatas . Si tiene dudas o desea ejercer sus derechos como titular de los datos, póngase en contacto con nosotros a través de nuestro Canal de Atención .

postings.title: Event & Sponsorship Marketing Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About Monster Energy:

Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk-takers, the trailblazers, the game-changers. We're not perfect, and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. But our drive is unrivaled, just like our athletes. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.

A Day in the Life:

As the Events & Sponsorship Marketing Manager, you will drive the strategic direction of the brand’s event and sponsorship marketing initiatives, ensuring flawless alignment with overall marketing objectives, business priorities, and brand philosophy. You will lead the end-to-end development and execution of high-impact marketing events, experiences, and programs that amplify brand visibility, fuel consumer engagement, and strengthen market presence. This role owns the full event lifecycle, from concept creation and strategic planning to execution, partnership activation, performance recaps, and post-event evaluation, while ensuring seamless integration across all brand platforms and touchpoints. Working cross-functionally with key stakeholders, you will align marketing initiatives with critical sales objectives to accelerate brand awareness, drive business growth, and maximize ROI. You will also spearhead the management of global and regional sponsorship portfolios, identifying and securing strategic partnership opportunities that elevate the brand and deliver measurable impact. Responsibilities include negotiating and managing agency relationships, overseeing local vendors, navigating complex stakeholder environments, and securing internal approvals through FPF (Future Projects Forum) for major events, sponsorships, and new partnership opportunities. Through bold execution, strong relationship management, and a relentless focus on results, you will bring the brand to life in the marketplace and create experiences that leave a lasting impression.

The Impact You'll Make:

• Lead event annual planning, aligning with brand strategy and ensuring timelines, logistics, and deliverables are met for execution. Staff planning, with appropriate employees, vendors for all on-site event staff with event goals and proper brand representation.

• Oversee the annual contract process (scope and approvals). Project approvals in internal forums (i.e. FPF) including presentations and budget.

• Supervise on-site setup, execution, and teardown to ensure flawless delivery and quick resolution of any operational issues.

• Oversee inventory, storage, and maintenance of event assets to ensure availability and brand consistency across activations.

• Ensure all event elements strictly follow brand guidelines to maintain consistency in image, messaging, and experience.

• Manage budget efficiently and contract negotiation with agencies and vendors to ensure cost-effective, high-quality event execution.

• Lead the events presentations during internal and specific bottlers meetings

• Event recaps - photos, SWOT (Strength, Weakness, Opportunities, Threat), sampling overview and provide key takeaways to inform future planning.

Who You Are:

• Prefer a Bachelor's Degree in the field of Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, Public Relations, or other related fields.

• Additional Experience Desired: Between 3-5 years of experience in event production, event, convention planning, marketing.

• Additional Experience Desired: Between 3-5 years of experience in project management.

• Computer Skills Desired: Microsoft Office Programs – Word, Excel, Power Point.

postings.descriptionText:
Join Our Team
 
Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.
 
As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.
 
We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.


About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Senior IBM BPM / IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) Developer to design, develop, enhance, and maintain business-critical workflow applications in complex enterprise environments.
This role focuses on building and supporting scalable business process solutions, integrating workflow applications with enterprise systems, and ensuring the reliability, performance, security, and maintainability of existing applications.
The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with IBM BPM and/or IBM BAW, business process modeling, enterprise integrations, and production support.
You will collaborate with developers, business analysts, architects, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions within an Agile development environment.

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise applications using IBM BPM and related workflow technologies.

• Translate business and technical requirements into scalable workflow solutions.

• Develop and maintain process applications, workflows, services, business objects, and user interfaces.

• Implement and maintain business processes using BPMN.

• Build and maintain integrations with enterprise applications using REST APIs and Web Services.

• Develop and maintain application components using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, XML, and JSON.

• Troubleshoot workflow failures, application defects, integration issues, and production incidents.

• Perform application maintenance, bug fixes, technical enhancements, and continuous improvements.

• Participate in application testing, deployment, release management, and production support.

• Conduct root-cause analysis and resolve technical issues affecting business-critical applications.

• Review existing BPM solutions and contribute to application optimization and modernization.

• Work with SQL and relational databases to support application functionality and integrations.

• Create and maintain technical documentation.

• Participate in code reviews and follow development, security, and quality standards.

• Collaborate with developers, business analysts, architects, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Participate in Agile ceremonies, estimation, planning, and technical discussions.

• Contribute to the reliability, maintainability, performance, and security of enterprise applications.

Requirements:
• Strong professional experience in software development and enterprise application environments.

• Strong hands-on experience with IBM BPM and/or IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW), with a focus on BPM application development.

• Experience developing, enhancing, maintaining, and supporting enterprise BPM applications.

• Strong knowledge of business process modeling and BPMN.

• Experience developing workflows, services, business objects, and user interfaces.

• Experience with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating applications using REST APIs and Web Services.

• Working knowledge of XML and JSON.

• Knowledge of SQL and relational databases.

• Experience troubleshooting and debugging enterprise applications.

• Experience with application testing, deployment, and production support.

• Experience working throughout the software development lifecycle.

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

• Experience in large-scale enterprise environments.

Must Have:
• Strong hands-on experience developing enterprise applications using IBM BPM and/or IBM BAW.

• Demonstrated experience with BPM-focused workflow development.

• Strong understanding of BPMN and business process modeling.

• Experience developing process applications, workflows, services, and business objects.

• Experience with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience with REST APIs and Web Services.

• Working knowledge of XML and JSON.

• Knowledge of SQL and relational databases.

• Experience integrating BPM applications with other enterprise systems.

• Strong troubleshooting and debugging capabilities.

• Experience with testing, deployment, and production application support.

• Experience performing root-cause analysis.

• Experience working in enterprise software development environments.

• Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Nice to Have:
• Additional experience with IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW).

• Experience in Financial Services or Banking.

• Experience with Wealth & Asset Management applications.

• Experience working in highly regulated industries.

• Experience modernizing or optimizing existing IBM BPM solutions.

• Experience supporting business-critical enterprise applications.

• Experience working with complex enterprise integrations.

• Experience collaborating with U.S.-based stakeholders.

• Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams.

Benefits & Perks:
 
Home office;
Competitive compensation based on experience;
Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company;
International Projects;
Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational);
Games and Competitions;

Cloud Infrastructure: Design, provision, and maintain secure and highly available environments on AWS.

Experience: 7+ years of proven experience as a DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, or in similar roles.

CI/CD: Advanced knowledge of building and managing pipelines using GitHub Actions.
Containers: Deep understanding of Docker and Kubernetes container lifecycle management.

AWS Certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional).
Experience with modern monitoring and logging stacks (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).
Benefits
Long-term commitment with autonomy and impact on global, high-scale projects.
Strategic, high-visibility role within a modern engineering culture.
Collaborative, multicultural environment with strong technical leadership.
Career growth path and continuous learning opportunities within Coderio.

postings.title: English to Bulgarian Medical Devices Linguist
postings.descriptionText:
About Welo Life Sciences 
 
Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications.  welolifesciences.com


About the Role
We are looking for experienced English into Bulgarian linguists specializing in Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) documentation translation and review.
Key Responsibilities
Translate medical device and in vitro diagnostics documentation from English (US) into Bulgarian.
Perform Copy Edit (translation review) of translated content, ensuring accuracy, terminology consistency, and compliance with project-specific quality requirements.
Review and address QA feedback and client feedback on flagged linguistic issues.
Meet agreed deadlines and maintain consistent quality across assigned projects.
Work within the client's CAT tool environment using MemoQ version 12.5 or higher.
Field of Expertise
Medical Devices: Instructions for Use (IFUs), user manuals, product documentation, technical documentation and related materials.
In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD): Diagnostic product documentation, instructions, labeling and related medical content.
Must-Have Criteria
Relevant Translation Experience
At least two years of professional translation experience in Life Sciences, specifically involving Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics documentation.
Practical experience translating medical and technical documentation in the relevant fields. Experience exclusively in Patents is not sufficient.
Familiarity with ISO standards and quality requirements applicable to Life Sciences translation.
Technical Skills
Experience with MemoQ version 12.5 or higher is mandatory.
Candidates must have a suitable desktop version of MemoQ installed. The free version is also acceptable.
A MemoQ license will be provided by the client; there is no need to purchase one.
Ability to perform both Translation and Copy Edit tasks.
Nice-to-Have
Degree in Medicine, Biology, Biochemistry, Clinical Research, Translation, Linguistics, Philology or a related field.
Previous experience working with medical device manufacturers, IVD companies, CROs or other Life Sciences organizations.
Familiarity with medical terminology, regulatory requirements and quality assurance processes in the medical industry.
Project Details
Language Pair: English (US) into Bulgarian
Task Types: Translation and Copy Edit
Content Specialties: Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics
Expected Capacity: Weekly availability required.
CAT Tool: MemoQ version 12.5 or higher (mandatory; license provided).
Additional Project Information:
Translation tasks are paid per word.
Copy Edit tasks are paid either per hour or per word, depending on the project scope and volume.
For smaller Copy Edit assignments, payment will be calculated per word, as minimum fees cannot be offered.
Follow-up tasks may include reviewing QA feedback and addressing client feedback on issues flagged during quality checks.
These follow-up activities are covered within the initial scope of the assigned task and will not require a separate PO.
Any tasks outside the initial project scope, or assignments for projects in which you were not originally involved, will be covered by a separate PO.
Before Applying
Please note that an assessment will be part of our onboarding and quality procedure. Candidates will be required to complete the standard Medical Devices assessment. Please only apply if you are willing to complete the assessment.
Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical Devices translation experience, including:
Total years of professional translation experience.
Years of experience specifically in Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics.
Examples of medical documentation and content types translated.
Your experience with memoQ (please specify the version used).
Your experience performing both Translation and Copy Edit.
Your contact information (email AND phone number).
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global
We look forward to receiving your application!
Job Reference: #LI-JC1

postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Human Data Division builds training and evaluation data for frontier AI labs: RL environments, coding and STEM evaluation tasks, and expert-annotated datasets. We are a small team that moves fast and holds a high quality bar.




THE ROLE

We have built our own evaluation, RL and annotation platforms, and they are already in use. We are looking for a platform engineer to join the platform team as a core member and play a central part in their next stage: keeping them running, making them faster and more reliable, and building the features the team and our clients need next.

You will work across all of these systems and get to know them in depth. You will work closely with the people who write our tasks, review our data and work with the labs, and help turn what they need into working software.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Maintain and improve the platforms. Learn the existing codebases in depth and keep them healthy in production: fix bugs, pay down technical debt, improve test coverage and documentation.

 - Build new features. Design and ship new capabilities across the stack, from the database and backend to the APIs and internal tools.

 - Scale the systems. Grow the platforms from today's volume to much larger workloads, with predictable performance and cost.

 - Build RL environments and their infrastructure. Build environments that agents act in, and the infrastructure that runs them at scale: sandboxes, environment images, rollouts and reward computation.

 - Keep everything reliable and secure. Monitoring, alerting, incident response, access control, safe handling of untrusted code and protection of client data.

 - Support the data teams. Build the tooling that task authors, reviewers and project leads use every day, and help produce fast-turnaround samples when a project needs them.




SKILLS WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

Software engineering

 - Strong backend engineering in Python: clean, tested, maintainable code.

 - Designing and building APIs and the data models behind them.

 - Relational databases (Postgres or similar): schema design, migrations, query performance.

 - Enough frontend skill (TypeScript and React) to build and maintain internal tools.

 - Comfort joining a codebase someone else wrote, understanding it quickly and improving it without breaking it.



Large-scale system design

 - Designing distributed systems that run many long-running jobs at once.

 - Job orchestration, workflow engines and queues: retries, idempotency, failure recovery.

 - Containers and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes or similar), and at least one major cloud provider.

 - Observability: logging, metrics, tracing and alerting.

 - Security fundamentals: secrets management, isolation, access control.



RL environments and sandbox infrastructure

 - Hands-on experience building RL environments for LLM agents: tool interfaces, stateful environments that can be seeded, reset and snapshotted, and reward computed from the final state or the agent's answer.

 - Running agent code in isolated sandboxes at scale, with sandbox platforms such as Daytona, E2B or Modal, or with your own isolation layer (gVisor, Firecracker microVMs or similar).

 - Building and caching environment images so that thousands of sandboxes can start quickly and reproducibly.

 - High-throughput rollout collection: many parallel episodes, timeouts, resource limits, and full logs and trajectories for every episode.

 - Feeding rollouts and rewards into RL post-training pipelines.



Evaluation

 - Hands-on experience building or running evaluation harnesses or benchmarks for LLMs or LLM agents.

 - Writing verifiers, graders or reward functions, and knowing how they fail.

 - Understanding of how frontier models are evaluated: pass rates, pass@k, headroom, discrimination, reward hacking, and what makes a task hard for a frontier model.

 - Working with LLM provider APIs and tracking model cost and usage.



Data annotation and human data

 - Experience building annotation, labeling or human-data tooling.

 - Contributor and reviewer workflows, quality control and calibration.

 - Turning a manual, ad-hoc process into a scaled, measured one.



Ways of working

 - Daily, careful use of AI coding agents: you move fast with them and review their output with the same rigor as a colleague's.

 - Thrives in ambiguity and ships fast; works independently and takes initiative on a small team.

 - Clear written communication with both engineers and non-engineers.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years in software, data or ML engineering, with recent work in AI/ML data, model evaluation, annotation or developer tooling.

 - A track record of running and maintaining production systems, not only building them.

 - Fluent English.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Contributions to open-source evaluation or RL frameworks.

 - Experience building tools for a large distributed contributor workforce.

We are founding members of Deep Vision AI, one of the first companies in the computer vision / AI space, which was acquired in early 2020 by DFW Capital Partners. Anyone AI is backed by top global investors like GFC (Global Founders Capital) -investors in Facebook, LinkedIn, Slack, Canva, Trivago, Delivery Hero, Revolut, etc-, Canvas Ventures (early investor in Coursera, Evernote, MuleSoft, etc) and Latitud Fund (the largest community of angel investors for LatAm).



Run the race of your life

This position provides self-motivated, collaborative individuals the opportunity to make a direct impact on Anyone AI products and services. You will have the opportunity to challenge yourself while contributing to developing a revolutionary accelerated training program designed to invest in people from LatAm and help them master ML and AI to land a job in less than 6 months.

In this hands-on senior role, you will lead the process of sourcing semi-senior and senior candidates, plus the interview preparation process in our training programs to place Anyone AI Fellows in the US and LATAM markets.



Responsibilities



 - Lead and manage the Job Preparation Program for the ML Fellowship, providing guidance to Fellows on: (a) building LinkedIn profiles that attract recruiter interest and increase visibility, crafting résumés that pass HR filters and impress hiring managers, and writing compelling cover letters; and (b) overseeing interview preparation, conducting mock interviews, and advising on negotiation strategies, among other tasks.

You will be leading a passionate and highly motivated team of which in time will grow to 30+ reps across the Buenos Aires province to a scale that very few businesses ever achieve, whilst having an impact on one of Argentina’s most vital industries, Agriculture.

This is a rare opportunity to play a pivotal role in leading the region's growth past the hundreds of millions of ARR. Roles of this scale, in a hyper-growth business, simply don’t come around often. Could be a bit of you? 

You’ll be excited by exponential growth, and feel right at home leading on ambitious strategies. When the pressure is on in the biggest moments, you’ll be someone who wants to be in the game. You might find yourself juggling time on farm/ranch with customers, coaching and developing your team, through to driving growth strategy and cross-functional priorities within Halter. You’ll be masterful at building trusting relationships, driving sales processes, managing large pipelines and enabling a team, whilst advocating for customers with a solutions-oriented mindset.

Aside from jumping on the Halter roller coaster, you will be making a real world impact, making farming more productive and sustainable. You will build relationships across the provinces most influential farming leaders, who also happen to be some of the most down to earth, genuine humans you will ever meet. This is a high-stakes role, spearheading Halter’s growth in the Buenos Aires.

Please submit your CV and application in English. This role works daily with teams in New Zealand, Australia and the US, so professional working English is essential.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Someone who doesn’t believe in glass ceilings and walks towards the pressure of large targets and thrives on hard problems. 

 - Experience in growing new and existing businesses, developing market strategies and more importantly, a track record of delivering high growth.

 - Experience working with customers, navigating complex sales cycles and expanding value over time.

 - Strong ability to work cross-functionally and lead teams.

 - A deep passion for helping farmers succeed. Experience in farm systems or within the agricultural sector would be a bonus. 

 - A phenomenal attitude and a team player with the ability to consistently overcome challenges.

 - The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment with a high degree of autonomy.

 - A hunger for success and personal growth to be able to evolve quickly alongside a world-class sales team.



WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Sales Leadership: Lead sales strategy, setting headcount requirements, regions and working closely with Halter leaders to form targets before laying that out to your team into an inspiring vision.

 - Manage your team’s inputs on a week to week basis, set the team’s cadence, set and track KPI’s and develop excellent pipeline hygiene.

 - Coach and develop your team to become better every week. Adapt Halter’s existing processes to develop and implement training programs for the Buenos Aires team, ensuring continuous skill enhancement and alignment with company objectives. Foster a culture of knowledge sharing and collaboration within the sales organisation.

 - Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop the Buenos Aires team. Set clear performance expectations, KPIs and provide regular feedback. Lead on hiring and performance management. Foster a positive and collaborative team culture that promotes vulnerability and learning.

 - Account Management: Ensure a seamless and positive customer experience across the entire customer lifecycle. Monitor customer satisfaction levels and implement improvement initiatives continuously. Work closely with your team to resolve any issues and ensure customer retention and expansion. Work in lock step with the Launch, Support and Product functions to ensure tight collaboration across every customer touchpoint.

 - Strategic Leadership: Develop and implement a comprehensive regional strategy to expand our market presence and achieve growth objectives. Identify new market opportunities and drive initiatives to increase market share. Collaborate closely with leaders across Halter to align on goals and objectives.

 - Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with senior leaders, and product and support teams to ensure exceptional results for the Buenos Aires Province.

 - Networking: Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand.


OUR BENEFITS:

 - Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and restricted stock units, so you own a part of what we’re building.

 - Healthy body, healthy mind. You’ll be on the OSDE 410 plan, fully paid by Halter with dependents included, giving you comprehensive maternity cover, dental and vision, and complementary therapies like acupuncture.

 - Mental health matters. You’ll have access to up to 30 sessions per year of individual or group therapy, plus up to 15 sessions per family group for bonding therapy.

 - Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual US$750 personal growth fund to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

 - We offer 26 weeks of paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of paid leave for the other parent, and flexible return-to-work options.


JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

 - You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

 - This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are searching for an elite growth leader, ready to play the game of their career. You will be leading a passionate and highly motivated team of which in time will grow to 30+ reps across the Pampas province to a scale that very few businesses ever achieve, whilst having an impact on one of Argentina’s most vital industries, Agriculture. 

Leading the Pampas Provincial team, you will be covering the full customer cycle from new sales through to Account Management. We’re looking for someone with commercial nous, X-factor, charisma, highly competitive yet technically strong as a sales leader… and the ability to hit a target nobody can yet see possible. This is a rare opportunity to play a pivotal role in leading the region's growth past the hundreds of millions of ARR. Roles of this scale, in a hyper-growth business, simply don’t come around often. Aside from jumping on the Halter roller coaster, you will be making a real world impact, making farming more productive and sustainable. You will build relationships across the provinces most influential farming leaders, who also happen to be some of the most down to earth, genuine humans you will ever meet. This is a high-stakes role, spearheading Halter’s growth in Pampas.

Please submit your CV and application in English. This role works daily with teams in New Zealand, Australia and the US, so professional working English is essential.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Actualmente, son un equipo ágil de 20 personas (la mayoría en Argentina) trabajando 100% remoto, y buscan incorporar a alguien que sea capaz de poner orden en su administración, automatizar sus procesos financieros y, al mismo tiempo, cuidar a su gente.
¿Qué vas a hacer? Este es un rol híbrido y estratégico con reporte directo a la Dirección. Tus principales desafíos serán:

• Administración y Finanzas Internacionales: Gestión de cash flow, análisis de costos, facturación, cobranzas y control de pagos. Vas a manejar finanzas impositivas y transacciones con clientes en distintos países (especialmente en Chile).

• Gestión de Pagos y Plataformas: Operar transferencias vía CBU, depósitos y billeteras virtuales (Arc). Conocimiento o uso de Quickbooks.

• Optimización y Automatización: Liderar el upgrade de los procesos actuales de la consultora. Buscan a alguien que automatice tareas manuales (como el trackeo de horas) para enfocarse en el análisis y la toma de decisiones.

• People & Cultura: Liderar el onboarding , administrar beneficios, correr la liquidación de sueldos (con enfoque financiero) y sostener la cultura y el talento interno.

• Reporting y Análisis: Elaboración de reportes financieros y de people con gráficos (ej. Waterfall charts), usando Excel/Google Sheets a nivel avanzado.

• Relacionamiento Estratégico: Manejo de stakeholders , negociaciones y conversaciones sensibles con clientes corporativos.

¿A quién buscamos?

• Experiencia: Entre 2 y 4 años de experiencia (Semi Sr.) en roles analíticos, de administración y finanzas.

• Mindset: Buscamos un perfil analítico, financiero y sumamente proactivo. Alguien que no espere que le digan qué hacer ("que se mande"), con "chispa", curiosidad y una obsesión por el detalle. No es un rol para perfiles introvertidos; necesitás tener presencia para defender los números y negociar con clientes.

postings.title: Technical Architect
postings.descriptionText:
The Technical Architect will serve as the technical point of reference, with the objective of transforming business goals into robust, evolvable, secure, and operable architectures. They will lead end-to-end technical architecture design, establish technical and non-functional criteria, support the team during implementation, and ensure that deliverables meet the quality, performance, resilience, and security levels required by a critical enterprise platform.
Responsibilities

• Define the end-to-end technical architecture of the project, including components, integrations, data flows, dependencies, and boundaries of responsibility.

• Make and document architectural decisions using ADRs, evaluating alternatives, trade-offs, evolution costs, risks, and operational consequences.

• Translate functional and non-functional requirements into implementable designs, technical acceptance criteria, and an evolution roadmap.

• Design scalable and resilient distributed solutions, considering consistency, concurrency, idempotency, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery.

• Participate in the development of critical components and conduct code reviews focused on design, maintainability, security, and operational behavior.

• Define the testing and quality strategy: unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, performance, resilience, and security testing.

• Design and review APIs, integration contracts, persistence schemas, and compatibility and evolution mechanisms.

• Evaluate performance and capacity through analysis, profiling, load testing, and the definition of measurable latency and throughput targets.

• Ensure the automation of builds, validations, static analysis, deployments, and quality controls within CI/CD pipelines.

• Integrate secure-by-design principles, threat modeling, secrets management, access control, and traceability into the architecture.

• Identify technical risks, structural debt, and bottlenecks; prioritize their remediation and communicate their impact on timeline, cost, and scope.

• Participate in planning complex deliveries, technical estimations, milestone definition, and tracking architectural commitments.

• More than 4 years of experience as a Technical Architect, with demonstrable experience leading the design and delivery of platforms or projects of high technical complexity.

• At least 5 years of experience in software development and in Java, Spring Boot, APIs, persistence, distributed systems, automated testing, and CI/CD.

• Experience in regulated or financial environments with high availability, performance, security, and traceability requirements.

• Experience conducting architecture reviews, defining standards, managing technical debt, and evolving existing systems.

• Experience working with Agile methodologies and collaborating cross-functionally with Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and Business teams.

• Advanced experience with Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, and designing mission-critical enterprise applications.

• Mastery of microservices architecture, distributed systems, synchronous and asynchronous integration, and communication patterns.

• In-depth knowledge of REST API design, contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, and integration governance.

• Experience with Spring Data JPA, data modeling, transactions, PostgreSQL, and query and persistence optimization.

• Experience with Gradle or Maven, multi-module projects or composite builds, dependency management, and build automation.

• Mastery of SOLID principles, DDD, Clean Architecture, design patterns, and refactoring and safe evolution techniques.

• Experience defining testing strategies using JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, as well as contract, integration, and performance testing.

• Solid knowledge of concurrency, caching, messaging, idempotency, consistency, resilience, and fault tolerance.

• Experience with Git, code reviews, branching strategies, and collaborative development practices at scale.

• Experience with CI/CD, automated quality, static analysis, artifact management, and controlled deployments.

• Knowledge of observability: structured logs, metrics, distributed traces, alerting, and production diagnostics.

Languages

• Minimum B2 English level, mandatory. A professional level is required to lead decisions and collaborate with international teams.

• Spanish – professional level, minimum B2, mandatory.

Nice to Have

• Experience in the architecture of financial platforms, corporate banking, trading, or high-criticality transactional systems.

• Experience with event-driven architectures, Kafka, or other messaging and distributed processing platforms.

• Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud, and deployment patterns such as blue-green, canary, and rolling releases.

• Experience applying OAuth2, OpenID Connect, threat modeling, secrets management, and application security controls.

• Knowledge of SRE, SLO/SLI, capacity, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.

• Experience in application modernization, progressive migrations, the strangler pattern, and technical debt reduction.

• Experience defining architecture standards, technical reviews, and governance models in large organizations.

• Domain knowledge of Trade Finance or Documentary Trade.

What do we offer you?

• Full-time or B2B contract

• Remote within CET Time zone.

• Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

If you are passionate about data, development & tech, we want to meet you !

postings.title: Marketing Engagement Senior Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Career level

CL10 Senior Analyst
Location
Argentina
Reports to
Audience Acquisition Team Lead

About the team
Audience Acquisition (AA), part of Client Data Enablement & Insights (CDE&I), provides end-to-end client nomination, invitation, registration and attendance support for Accenture's strategic global events, including the WEF Annual Meeting in Davos, MWC Barcelona, Dreamforce and the Accenture SAP Leadership Council. AA works with the Event Management team and wider Marketing & Communications (M&C) teams to deliver accurate, compliant and insight-led audience management. By accurately tracking client attendance and engagement, AA's work helps Accenture measure the ROI from events and impact on pipeline.

Role summary
The Senior Analyst leads day-to-day AA delivery for assigned events from planning through post-event close. They act as the primary AA contact for Event Management and M&C stakeholders, coordinate supporting colleagues, manage delivery risks and contribute to improvements that strengthen the AA service.

Role and responsibilities
· Lead / support AA workstream for assigned events, covering planning, nominations, invitations, registration, attendance tracking and post-event close.
· Agree requirements, timelines, responsibilities and dependencies with Event Management and M&C stakeholders, providing clear progress updates and managing expectations.
· Maintain high-quality client, event campaign and audience data in Manage mySales (MMS), in line with Accenture data, privacy and compliance requirements.
· Coordinate and oversee delegation of tasks across additional supporting AA colleagues as needed.
· Ensure attendance and engagement data is accurate and complete in MMS Event Campaign so event ROI and pipeline impact can be measured.
· Manage audience lists, invitation and registration workflows, meeting scheduling through JiffleNow, mailbox activity, response tracking and reporting using Cvent, MMS, Excel, Teams and other approved tools.
· Use approved AI tools, particularly M365 Copilot, to support day-to-day planning, analysis, communications and process improvement, applying appropriate judgement and data-handling controls.
· Identify delivery risks and data-quality issues early, resolve routine issues independently and escalate material concerns to the AA Team Lead.
· Lead practical process improvements, reusable templates and automation opportunities that improve quality, efficiency and stakeholder experience.
· Share knowledge and provide guidance for less experienced team members.

Qualifications, experience and skills
· Relevant experience in audience acquisition, event or marketing operations, client data management, CRM delivery or a comparable process-led environment.
· Ability to lead a workstream, manage multiple deadlines and deliver with limited day-to-day supervision.
· Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the confidence to lead working-level discussions and challenge constructively.
· Strong database and Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, with excellent attention to detail and data quality.
· Experience with MMS, Salesforce, Cvent, JiffleNow or comparable CRM, meeting-management, campaign or event platforms is beneficial.

En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.



¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!




¿Qué buscamos?



Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Consultor/a de Mejora de Procesos .




¿Cuál será tu misión?



Liderar la simplificación y evolución integral de los procesos de Tecnología, priorizando las oportunidades de mayor impacto y orientando a los responsables de la operación hacia mayores niveles de productividad, eficiencia y calidad, mediante la estandarización, el rediseño de punta a punta, la automatización y la medición de resultados, a fin de reducir la fricción y maximizar el valor entregado a YPF.




¿Cuáles serán tus principales tareas?



Gobernar el mapa integral de procesos de Tecnología y sus distintos niveles de desagregación, asegurando su alineación con la estrategia de la Vicepresidencia y las necesidades del negocio.

Liderar la evolución y simplificación de los procesos junto a los responsables de la operación, identificando oportunidades y definiendo prioridades de mejora.

Medir y priorizar los principales puntos de fricción de los procesos mediante métricas objetivas que permitan enfocar los esfuerzos en oportunidades de alto impacto.

Liderar iniciativas de rediseño end-to-end, eliminando actividades sin valor agregado y optimizando tiempos, pasos y esfuerzo operativo.

Identificar e implementar oportunidades de innovación e inteligencia artificial aplicadas a procesos, asegurando captura de valor y adopción por parte de la organización.

Definir, monitorear y gobernar indicadores de desempeño para medir productividad, eficiencia, calidad y valor entregado.

Impulsar la evolución y adopción de las plataformas habilitadoras de procesos, actualmente ServiceNow , promoviendo el uso de capacidades estándar y minimizando desarrollos a medida.

Asegurar la estandarización, documentación, trazabilidad y mejora continua de los procesos de Tecnología.




¿Qué valoramos como diferencial?



Formación:
Carreras universitarias de grado relacionadas con Ingeniería en Sistemas, Licenciatura en Sistemas de Información o carreras afines de Tecnología.

Idioma:
Inglés intermedio/avanzado (deseable).



Conocimientos:



• Gestión y mejora de procesos.


• Metodologías de mejora continua y rediseño end-to-end.


• Definición y seguimiento de indicadores de desempeño (KPIs).


• Automatización de procesos.


• Herramientas de gestión de servicios y procesos, preferentemente ServiceNow .


• Aplicaciones de Inteligencia Artificial a procesos de negocio.





Competencias:



• Orientación a resultados e impacto de negocio.


• Capacidad analítica y pensamiento crítico.


• Influencia y liderazgo transversal.


• Visión integral de procesos.


• Capacidad para impulsar el cambio y la mejora continua.


• Foco en la experiencia del usuario y la generación de valor.






Información del puesto

Lugar de trabajo: Torre YPF, Puerto Madero, o Neuquén.

Modalidad: Híbrida 4x1 (4 presenciales - 1 remoto).

Disponibilidad para viajar: Eventual.






Si sos una persona que:

Trabaja con excelencia y profesionalismo.

Da lo mejor cada día, valora la meritocracia y busca siempre la milla extra.

Vive los desafíos como oportunidades para innovar y aprender.

Disfruta del trabajo en equipo y del intercambio de distintos puntos de vista.

Encara los proyectos con pasión y compromiso.

Promueve un buen clima de trabajo, con empatía, escucha activa y respeto.




¡Este puesto es para vos!




¿Qué ofrecemos?



Un entorno donde podés aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que impulsa, que se adapta, que aprende, que suma, que transforma.




Sumarte a la #ExperienciaYPF es:



🤩 Impulsar tu desarrollo al siguiente nivel con nuevas oportunidades de aprendizaje.

💡 Crear soluciones innovadoras que impactan en el país.

🤝 Formar parte de una empresa comprometida con la equidad y la inclusión.

🧘‍♀️ Disfrutar del acompañamiento integral del Programa Be #BeneficiosYExperiencias.






Programa Be (Beneficios y Experiencias)





• Descuentos exclusivos en combustibles, gimnasios y muchos otros productos y servicios.


• Iniciativas para estar cerca en los momentos familiares claves: ayuda escolar, licencias parentales extendidas y regalo de nacimiento.


• Cobertura médica para vos y tu familia.


• Descuentos especiales en universidades orientados a impulsar estudios de especialización y posgrado.


• Servicios de refrigerio, frutas, snacks y comedor (según locación).


• Día libre de cumpleaños.


• Esquema de vacaciones adicionales para personal elegible.






¡Te esperamos para seguir generando valor y construyendo juntos el futuro energético de nuestro país!

postings.title: GESTOR INNOVACION
postings.descriptionText:
Somos una empresa de industria nacional que brinda soluciones innovadoras y sustentables a toda la cadena de valor de la industria energética. Formamos parte del grupo YPF y contamos con más de 70 años de experiencia en la ejecución de los proyectos industriales y la provisión de servicios de Upstream y Downstream más importantes de la Argentina.

Conocé más de nosotros ingresando a nuestra web: www.aesa.com.ar

#SomosAESA





¿Qué buscamos?

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Gestor/a de Innovación , para impulsar iniciativas de innovación, digitalización, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial, conectando las necesidades de los distintos negocios y áreas.









¿Cuál será tu misión?

Impulsar iniciativas de innovación, digitalización, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial , conectando las necesidades de los distintos negocios y áreas de AESA con soluciones tecnológicas concretas.

Buscamos un perfil híbrido que combine gestión de innovación con capacidad técnica hands-on , capaz de participar en todo el ciclo de una iniciativa: desde la identificación de una oportunidad y el entendimiento del problema hasta la investigación de tecnologías, construcción de prototipos, validación de resultados y acompañamiento de su industrialización.

El objetivo del rol es reducir la distancia entre una necesidad del negocio y una solución tecnológica concreta , acelerando la experimentación, el aprendizaje y la implementación de soluciones de valor para la organización.







¿Cuáles serán tus principales tareas?



• Identificar oportunidades de innovación, digitalización, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial en los distintos negocios, áreas y procesos de la compañía.


• Relevar y comprender necesidades, problemáticas y oportunidades junto con usuarios y referentes de negocio.


• Analizar procesos e identificar oportunidades de mejora mediante tecnología.


• Transformar problemas y necesidades del negocio en casos de uso tecnológicos concretos .


• Evaluar las iniciativas considerando impacto, esfuerzo, factibilidad técnica, valor para el negocio y potencial de escalabilidad .


• Participar en la priorización y seguimiento del pipeline de innovación.


• Investigar y evaluar nuevas tecnologías aplicables a las necesidades y procesos de la organización.


• Diseñar y desarrollar prototipos, pruebas de concepto (PoC) y MVP para validar soluciones de manera ágil.


• Desarrollar scripts, algoritmos, automatizaciones e integraciones, principalmente utilizando Python .


• Integrar APIs, bases de datos, archivos, documentos, sistemas y diferentes fuentes de información.


• Trabajar con datos provenientes de sistemas corporativos, procesos industriales, documentos técnicos, sensores y diferentes aplicaciones.


• Participar en iniciativas de Inteligencia Artificial generativa, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, LLM, RAG, agentes de IA y automatización inteligente .


• Realizar benchmarking tecnológico y pruebas controladas de nuevas soluciones.


• Coordinar y acompañar PoC y MVP trabajando junto con usuarios, referentes de negocio, equipos tecnológicos, especialistas internos y proveedores .


• Documentar prototipos, decisiones técnicas, resultados y aprendizajes.


• Participar en pruebas funcionales y técnicas de las soluciones desarrolladas.


• Definir métricas que permitan medir el impacto y valor generado por las iniciativas.


• Dar seguimiento a indicadores como adopción, eficiencia, reducción de tiempos, errores, costos y mejoras de productividad.


• Acompañar la evolución y transferencia de prototipos hacia equipos de desarrollo para su industrialización y escalabilidad .


• Trabajar con proveedores tecnológicos, startups, universidades y partners cuando las iniciativas lo requieran.











¿Qué valoramos como diferencial?



Formación Académica:

Estudiantes avanzados o graduados de carreras como:



• Ingeniería en Sistemas.


• Ingeniería Informática.


• Ingeniería Electrónica.


• Ingeniería Industrial con fuerte orientación tecnológica.


• Ciencias de la Computación.


• Ciencia de Datos.


• Inteligencia Artificial.


• Carreras tecnológicas o afines







Idioma: Ingles Intermedio/avanzado (deseable)



Conocimientos:

Se considerará un diferencial contar con conocimientos o experiencia en:

Desarrollo y tecnología



• C++.


• C# / .NET.


• TypeScript / JavaScript.


• React.


• Git.


• Docker.


• Azure DevOps / GitHub.



Cloud e Inteligencia Artificial



• Azure.


• Azure AI Foundry.


• Azure OpenAI.


• Modelos de IA ejecutados on-premise o en edge.


• Ollama u otras plataformas para ejecución de modelos locales.



Computer Vision



• OpenCV.


• YOLO.


• Procesamiento de imágenes y video.


• Visión Artificial.



Automatización y analítica



• Power Platform.


• Power Automate.


• Power BI.



Tecnologías industriales



• IoT.


• Sensores industriales.


• Procesamiento de señales.


• Dispositivos edge.


• Arquitecturas de integración.


• Integración con sistemas industriales.







Competencias:



• Curiosidad tecnológica y motivación por experimentar con nuevas tecnologías.


• Capacidad analítica.


• Pensamiento estructurado.


• Orientación a la resolución de problemas.


• Autonomía.


• Capacidad de aprendizaje rápido.


• Capacidad para experimentar, desarrollar y validar prototipos.


• Capacidad para desenvolverse tanto con perfiles técnicos como de negocio .


• Capacidad para trabajar transversalmente con distintas áreas de la organización.


• Orientación a resultados e impacto.


• Capacidad para investigar y evaluar alternativas tecnológicas.


• Capacidad para transformar una idea o necesidad en una solución concreta y demostrable .







Información del puesto



Lugar de trabajo: CABA



Modalidad: 4x1

Buscás dar lo mejor cada día, con compromiso y dedicación

Disfrutás del trabajo en equipo y del intercambio de distintos puntos de vista

Un contexto donde puedas aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que te caracteriza y que te mueve a mostrar todo tu potencial: la del trabajo en equipo, la que se adapta y aprende de cada cambio que atraviesa, la de la diversidad y la integración. postings.title: SAP Basis Spain - Senior - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
SAP Basis Senior TechOps (Application Management) Consultant
The Opportunity
We are looking for an SAP Basis Senior Consultant to join the EY GDS – SAP TechOps Team. As part of our EY GDS – TechOps team, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, performance, and availability of the SAP systems across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize system performance to meet business requirements.
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global 500 companies through best-in-class solutions, automation and innovation.

To qualify for the role, you must have:
• Bachelor’s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
• At least 3 to 7 years of experience in SAP Basis domain.
• Minimum of 3 years working experience in SAP Basis administration with focus on Level 3 support and Global operations
• Extensive experience with SAP system installation, configuration and upgrade procedures, including experience with SAP Basis tools and utilities.
• Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyze and resolve complex technical issues in a timely manner in a multi-region environment.
• Experience working in a global setting with multi-regional teams, understanding cultural nuances and time zone differences.
• Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
• Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements


Ideally, you’ll also have:
• Broad knowledge of SAP ERP IT systems, processes and integration with legacy systems.
• Good understanding on Roles and Authorization – SAP Security.
• Experience with different Cloud platforms (i.e., Azure, AWS, GCP).
• Experience in SAP Rise and/or SAP Cloud Solutions
• Database (Sybase/SAP - ASE, Oracle, and Microsoft SQL, S4HANA)
• Knowledge on SAP Fiori, SAP BusinessObjects, and other SAP technologies and applications
• Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools for SAP such as SAP Cloud ALM and SAP Solution Manager
• SAP Certification in SAP Basis Administration or SAP HANA Administration

What you will do:

Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration



The Solution Manager acts as a connector across teams, helping align priorities, manage dependencies and maintain momentum across a complex global stakeholder network.

You will:

Support Innovation and Frontier Innovation Programs



You will:

• Support proof-of-concept initiatives, pilot programs and Client Zero engagements.


• Work with subject matter professionals to evaluate business cases, solution viability and market relevance.

• Contribute to the continuous evolution of EY’s Frontier Innovation operating model.





This role provides exposure to emerging technologies, including AI, cloud platforms, automation and next-generation business solutions.



Enable Go-To-Market Success



Developing strong solutions is only part of the journey; enabling market activation, adoption and measurable growth is equally important.



You will:
