• Coordinate development of solution collateral, demos, case studies, enablement content and marketplace assets.


• Support readiness and enablement activities for client-facing and business development teams.


• Track adoption, pipeline contribution, commercialization progress and related performance metrics.


• Contribute to co-sell initiatives and strategic growth programs with Microsoft.





Deliver Insight Through Governance and Reporting



Responsibilities include:





• Prepare executive reporting, leadership updates and portfolio dashboards.


• Monitor key metrics related to solution maturity, activation, adoption, funding and business impact.


• Support business reviews, governance meetings and leadership decision forums.


• Maintain reporting accuracy, governance discipline and compliance with agreed operating standards.


• Provide insights and recommendations that support prioritization, investment decisions and strategic growth.






Skills and Attributes for Success





We are looking for someone who brings a balance of strategic thinking, execution excellence, and relationship-building capabilities.





• Thrive in fast-paced, evolving and ambiguous environments.


• Enjoy turning ideas into tangible plans, outputs and measurable outcomes.


• Are comfortable managing multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholder groups in parallel.


• Can influence outcomes without direct authority.


• Have a passion for innovation, technology, alliances and business transformation.


• Bring strong organizational, communication, governance and program management skills.


• Have a continuous improvement mindset, with a focus on simplifying, automating and scaling ways of working.














To qualify for the role, you must have







• 12+ years of relevant professional experience.


• Experience in program management, product management, solution management, consulting, technology transformation, innovation management or alliances.


• Proven experience working across complex, global and matrixed stakeholder environments.


• Strong communication, governance, project management and executive reporting capabilities.


• Experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives with clear outcomes, measurable impact and disciplined follow-through.





What we look for





• We are looking for individuals who are curious, collaborative and passionate about innovation. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys connecting strategy with execution, can navigate ambiguity and is energized by working with diverse teams to create meaningful business outcomes.


• This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to one of EY’s most important alliance ecosystems while helping shape innovative solutions that drive growth, transformation and long-term client value.

In GDS, you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, collaborate with diverse teams and build capabilities across an expanding ecosystem of people, learning, technology and insights that support long-term career growth.

• Diverse and inclusive culture: Be valued for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.






About EY





EY | Building a better working world



EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

postings.title: Ejecutivo de Soluciones Digitales - Mendoza
postings.descriptionText:
En Claro promovemos una cultura de respeto e igualdad de oportunidades. Seleccionamos a nuestros talentos basándonos en el valor que pueden agregar a nuestro negocio.

Buscamos personas que impulsen resultados con foco en la satisfacción de nuestros clientes con impacto en el negocio, manteniendo altos estándares de calidad y actuando con integridad en cada decisión.



Tu rol será: 

Identificar y cerrar oportunidades de negocio, impulsando la venta consultiva de soluciones tecnológicas avanzadas (Cloud, Datacenter, Desarrollo de Software, Consultoría, ERP, CRM, Ciberseguridad, IA, Integraciones y su aplicación en soluciones empresariales), superando los objetivos comerciales definidos, contribuyendo significativamente al crecimiento y éxito de la empresa.

 

Tus principales desafíos serán: 



• Identificar, calificar y cerrar nuevas oportunidades de negocio en el ámbito de soluciones digitales.


• Administrar cuentas por proyecto, incluyendo todo el proceso de ventas desde el desarrollo de negocios y especificaciones hasta las negociaciones contractuales y firma.


• Liderar negociaciones comerciales y contractuales, asegurando acuerdos mutuamente beneficiosos.


• Colaborar con equipos técnicos y de marketing para definir estrategias de mercado.


• Establecer y mantener relaciones sólidas con tomadores de decisiones clave y clientes empresariales.


• Elaborar reportes de gestión con indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPIs) para monitorear y evaluar el desempeño de las ventas y las estrategias implementadas.


• Asegurar que las contrataciones y operaciones cumplan con regulaciones de seguridad y normativas de la industria.


• Proponer y desarrollar soluciones innovadoras que respondan a las necesidades cambiantes del mercado y mejoren la oferta de servicios digitales de la empresa.



 

¿Qué necesitamos de vos?



• Contar con 4 años de experiencia en ventas de soluciones tecnológicas en algunas de las siguientes áreas: Cloud, Ciberseguridad, Desarrollo de Software, servicios de Outsourcing, Staffing y Consultoría. 


• Formación académica en Informática, Sistemas, Ingeniería, Administración de Empresas y/o afines.


• Priorizaremos formación tanto comercial como técnica que le permitan impulsar un compromiso tanto a nivel de CXO como con desarrolladores de software y arquitectos de TI.


• Contar con excelentes habilidades de comunicación, negociación y presentación. Capacidad para desarrollar y ejecutar planes estratégicos de cuentas y territorios.


• Sólidos conocimientos en tecnología y software, incluyendo Cloud Computing, Integración de Sistemas, Desarrollo de Software, ERP, e Inteligencia Artificial (IA) y su aplicación en soluciones empresariales.


• Disponibilidad para realizar viajes


• Movilidad propia (auto) y carnet de conducir al día.





¿Que esperamos de vos?



• Orientación a Resultados : Que orientes tu gestión y tus esfuerzos al logro de los objetivos del negocio, manteniendo un compromiso permanente con la calidad del servicio y la satisfacción de los clientes. Que impulses el avance de tu gestión definiendo prioridades y haciéndote responsable por los resultados alcanzados, buscando permanentemente oportunidades para generar valor y mejorar la experiencia de nuestros clientes.


• Excelencia : Que trabajes con altos estándares de calidad. Que planifiques tus acciones con precisión, realizando el seguimiento necesario para asegurar resultados sostenibles promoviendo la mejora continua de procesos.


• Integridad : que actúes con honestidad y coherencia, cumpliendo compromisos y haciéndote responsable por las decisiones y acciones que asumas.



El puesto tiene sede en CAC Godoy Cruz



#LI-LC1

postings.title: ESPECIALISTA MINERAÇÃO (ENGENHEIRO SR)
postings.descriptionText:
Quem somos



A AngloGold Ashanti é uma empresa global de mineração de ouro com um portfólio diversificado e de alta qualidade de operações, projetos e atividades de exploração em 10 países em quatro continentes. Buscamos oportunidades que criem valor envolvendo outros minerais, onde possamos alavancar nossos ativos, participações acionárias, habilidades e experiência existentes.



Na AngloGold Ashanti, garantimos um trabalho significativo que gera resultados tangíveis. O que fazemos vai além da mineração. Construímos meios de subsistência nas comunidades, defendemos a gestão ambiental responsável e fortalecemos as economias locais e nacionais. Nossos líderes e equipes estão comprometidos em ouvir e apoiar uns aos outros, valorizando as diferenças e promovendo a equidade. Estamos convencidos de que a grandeza só acontece quando priorizamos esses comportamentos e o bem-estar de cada pessoa.



Saiba mais sobre nossa visão, propósito e valores - AngloGold Ashanti  
Visão geral da posição
Responsável por desdobrar o plano de lavra de médio prazo, validando o plano trimestral e detalhando o horizonte D+7, assegurando que as metas estejam integradas à execução. Monitora a aderência do plano, ajustando-o quando necessário, e atua como elo entre planejamento e operação, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia da mina. Coordena a integração entre áreas, antecipando gargalos, identificando riscos e propondo soluções que mantenham produtividade, segurança e qualidade. Participa de reuniões de alinhamento, acompanha indicadores e fornece suporte técnico para decisões táticas e estratégicas.

postings.title: Creative Quality & Compliance Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As a Creative Quality & Compliance Specialist , you’ll play an integral part in the overall quality and regulatory integrity of creative output across the Healthcare division, serving as the quality and compliance checkpoint within the creative production workflow. In this role, you’ll report directly to the Creative department and work alongside Creative Project Managers who own delivery timelines and task trafficking.

You will act as the gate through which every piece of creative passes before it reaches client Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) reviewers and again before it goes live. You'll review ads, landing pages, emails, social content, and video for MLR regulatory compliance, brand and design standards, and copy accuracy. Additionally, you’ll operate hands-on inside Veeva Vault PromoMats—managing claims, annotations, references, and submission packages—while building and refining the quality standards the creative team works against to raise the bar across the healthcare portfolio.

While your primary authority is quality and compliance, you’ll also support the creative production workflow by maintaining deliverable trackers, coordinating feedback cycles with client stakeholders, and trafficking tasks between the creative team and client POCs. As the Creative Project Manager and Account PM lead delivery management at scale, you will keep the creative lane organized and moving while ensuring nothing ships that shouldn’t.

Key Responsibilities:

• Pre-Submission Compliance QA: Review all creative assets against MLR requirements — claims accuracy, fair balance, ISI placement, reference linking, branded vs. unbranded vs. disease-awareness rules — before they enter client Medical, Legal, and Regulatory review.

• Post-Approval Launch QA: Final quality proof of approved assets — landing pages, ads, emails, creative — before they go live, confirming that approved content was implemented correctly and no errors were introduced in production.

• Veeva Vault PromoMats Operations: Own the hands-on Veeva workflow — annotating assets, entering and linking claims, managing references, tracking submission status, and packaging 2253 filings.

• Brand & Design Standards Enforcement: Review creative output for visual consistency, spec adherence, and style guide compliance across all healthcare client deliverables.

• Copy Quality Review: Review all copy for grammar, tone, messaging accuracy, and alignment with approved claims and client brand voice.

• QA Process Documentation & Refinement: Build, maintain, and continuously improve the quality and compliance standards, checklists, and review processes the creative team follows.

• Creative Workflow Coordination: Support creative production operations alongside the Creative Project Manager and Account PM — maintaining Asana boards and deliverable trackers, communicating timelines and managing feedback cycles with client stakeholders, trafficking tasks between the creative team and client POCs, coordinating with cross-channel PMs on shared deliverables, and organizing client-provided assets within Power Digital’s file structure.

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes.

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital’s Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department.

• Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements:

• 4+ years in healthcare or pharmaceutical creative production, agency or in-house, with direct exposure to MLR review workflows

• Demonstrated understanding of FDA OPDP guidance and 21 CFR 202, including fair balance, ISI placement, branded vs. unbranded vs. disease-awareness content rules, and 2253 filing requirements

• Veeva Vault PromoMats experience (annotating, claims management, submission tracking) highly preferred

• Strong eye for brand consistency, design quality, and copy accuracy across digital formats (paid social, display, landing pages, email)

• Process-oriented with the ability to document, maintain, and improve QA standards without external direction

• Comfortable reviewing and providing clear, actionable feedback on creative work from designers, copywriters, and freelancers

• Proficiency with Asana or comparable project management platforms

• Experience working alongside project management teams in a fast-paced agency environment

• Bonus: Veeva PromoMats certification, experience with modular content strategies, or prior work across both pharma-regulated and non-regulated healthcare clients

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• First-pass approval rate: 80%+ of assets cleared by client M/L/R reviewers on first submission

• QA turnaround time: internal reviews completed within defined SLA (e.g. 24–48 hours)

• Pre-launch error rate: <2% of launched assets requiring post-launch correction

• 100% accuracy on 2253 filings and regulatory submission packaging

• Documented QA standards maintained and current across all supported accounts

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Establish the pre-submission and pre-launch QA checkpoints as defined, repeatable stages in the creative workflow.

• Own the Veeva PromoMats workflow for assigned accounts — claims, annotations, references, and submissions operating cleanly from day one.

• Build and maintain the QA standards documentation (checklists, compliance reference guides, brand review criteria) the creative team works against.

• Develop a working rhythm with Creative Project Managers so that QA is a checkpoint in the pipeline, not a bottleneck.

Benefits & Perks:

• Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities

• Unlimited Time Off available on day one

• Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid

• Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs

• National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year

• Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm

• Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)

• Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance

• Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/ . If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at recruiting@powerdigital.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

postings.title: AI, Automation & Tech Lead
postings.descriptionText:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .

Role Overview

The LATAM AI, Automation & Tech Lead is responsible for driving the technical strategy, architecture, adoption, and end-to-end implementation of AI-powered solutions and automation initiatives across the Buenos Aires operation and the broader LATAM region.

This role represents a dual leadership capability : combining deep hands-on technical expertise and software architecture with operational vision and cross-functional leadership leveraging WPP's resources and platforms. The Lead will identify opportunities for process optimization, design robust and scalable technical architectures, lead the development of automated workflows and tools, and ensure that all technical implementations adhere to enterprise-grade engineering and security standards.

Working closely with Project Management, Design, Development, QA, and operational leaders, the Lead will translate complex operational challenges into reliable, automated, and scalable software solutions, while fostering a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI & Automation Strategy & Technical Roadmap

• Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and automation to optimize workflows and increase production capacity across the entire region.

• Define and execute the technical roadmap for AI and automation, aligning business priorities with technical feasibility, maintainability, and scalability.

• Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, AI Agents, LLM frameworks, and APIs to determine practical, secure applications across the organization.

2. Technical Leadership, Architecture & Governance (Tech Lead Focus)

• Act as the ultimate technical authority for all automation, scripting, and AI implementations within the LATAM operation.

• Define the technical architecture, technology stack, and engineering standards for internal tools, scripts, APIs, and automated pipelines.

• Establish best practices for code quality, version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, error handling, and comprehensive technical documentation.

• Ensure all solutions comply with global technology, data privacy, and information security standards (including API key management, data governance, and intellectual property protection).

• Conduct architecture and code reviews, ensuring solutions are robust, reusable, modular, and maintainable.

3. Hands-On Solution Design & Development

• Lead and actively participate in the hands-on architecture, prototyping, and development of complex automations, custom scripts, integrations, and AI agent-based workflows.

• Develop and deploy custom AI solutions leveraging modern LLM orchestration frameworks, system architectures, and API-based integrations.

4. Operational Efficiency & Process Optimization

• Analyze end-to-end production workflows across Design, Development, Project Management, and QA to pinpoint inefficiencies and manual friction.

• Partner with other functional leads to quantify operational pain points and prioritize high-ROI automation initiatives.

• Standardize and document modular workflows that can be replicated across different accounts and projects.

• Directly impact production KPIs: turnaround times ( cycle times ), error rates, delivery volume, and operational costs.

5. AI Adoption, Enablement & Technical Mentorship

• Act as a technical mentor for developers, technical PMs, and contributors, elevating the overall technical capabilities of the team.

• Promote the practical, effective, and responsible use of WPP-provided AI tools across all disciplines.

• Organize training sessions, workshops, and technical documentation to drive self-serve automation and widespread tool adoption.

6. Cross-Functional Leadership & Discipline Ownership

• Act as the regional benchmark and owner of the AI, Automation & Technology discipline.

• Coordinate with local, regional, and global technology and innovation teams to align local developments with global WPP platforms, avoiding duplication of efforts.

• Clearly communicate technical concepts, progress, roadmaps, and ROI metrics to both business leaders and non-technical audiences.

7. Performance Measurement, Reliability & Continuous Improvement

• Define and monitor metrics for system reliability, performance, and automation uptime, alongside business metrics (time saved, productivity gains).

• Establish a continuous improvement lifecycle: gathering user feedback, refining prompts/models, refactoring code, and decommissioning obsolete scripts.

• Provide visibility into automation ROI, demonstrating tangible impact on production targets and operational capacity.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

• Achieve Operational Automation Targets: Lead technical execution toward operational milestones (e.g., 60% of total delivery automated by 2026; 80% target by 2027).

• Technical Robustness & Reliability: High availability ( uptime ), maintainable codebases, zero security/data breaches, and reusable technical components across accounts.

• Measurable ROI: Demonstrated time savings, reduced turnaround times, and lower production error rates.

• Adoption & Cultural Impact: Measurable increase in daily active usage of AI tools and automated pipelines across Design, PM, Dev, and QA.

• Discipline Maturation: Establish modular repositories, clear documentation, and solid technical governance for all automations developed in Buenos Aires and the region.

Key Qualifications & Technical Skills

• Technical Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Programming & Scripting: Strong hands-on experience in modern languages used for automation and AI integration (e.g., Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js).

• AI & LLM Ecosystem: Hands-on experience working with OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, prompt engineering, agentic frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents), and vector/embedding workflows.

• APIs & Integrations: Extensive experience consuming and building RESTful APIs, webhooks, and integrations with third-party tools (Figma API, Jira API, Slack, cloud storage buckets, etc.).

• Automation Platforms: Familiarity with orchestration/low-code platforms (Make, n8n, Power Automate, Zapier), as well as custom code-based orchestrators.

• DevOps & Standards: Experience with Git workflows, CI/CD, cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerization (Docker), and automated testing.

• Leadership & Communication: Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical architecture and communicate seamlessly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

postings.title: Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.

Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.

Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.

As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

The role entails

• Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers

• Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team

• Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training

• Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS

• Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions

• Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders

• Advocate and advance modern software development practices

• Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value

• Collaborate with other teams in the organisation

• Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

• Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar

• You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development

• Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes

• Experience with version control systems such as git

• Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other

• Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality

• Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written

• Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu

• Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models

• People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Employee Assistance Programme

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About CookUnity

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, Shopping Experience to own the consumer-facing surfaces that connect eaters with the meals they'll love.

This is the most-trafficked real estate in the product. From the moment a subscriber opens the app to the moment they complete their order, every screen they touch — the home screen, search, menu, collections, product detail pages, and cart — falls within this role's remit. You'll own the product vision, roadmap, and execution across all of it.

You'll work closely with Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Merchandising to make the discovery experience feel effortless, personal, and exciting.

What You'll Do

Own the Discovery Surface End-to-End

• Set and drive the product vision and roadmap across Home Screen, Search, Menu, Swimlanes, Collections, Product Tile & Detail, Cart & Checkout, and Core UI Components.

• Define a coherent discovery experience across web and mobile that scales with catalog complexity and evolving user needs.

• Manage a large, diverse surface area with competing priorities without losing coherence or momentum.

Ship High-Impact Consumer Features

• Partner with Engineering and Design to build, iterate, and launch features that meaningfully improve how eaters find and choose meals.

• Own the product layer of CookUnity's server-driven UI (SDUI) system — thinking critically about how the component architecture enables flexibility for merchandisers while maintaining a great eater experience.

• Drive experimentation across discovery surfaces with rigorous metric frameworks.

Elevate the UX

• Partner tightly with Design to create discovery experiences that reduce friction, build confidence, and feel intuitive across every entry point.

• Own the quality and consistency of core UI components (loading states, error screens, coachmarks, modals) as a shared foundation across the product.

• Maintain a high bar for mobile and web parity, while allowing for platform-native patterns where they matter.

Navigate the Frontend/Intelligence Seam

• Work as a close counterpart to the Sr. PM, Personalization & AI — jointly owning decisions that live at the intersection of how surfaces are designed and what intelligence powers them.

• Translate what the personalization and AI systems are capable of into frontend experiences that make that intelligence visible and useful to eaters.

• Bring a clear point of view to surface-level decisions even when the upstream inputs are probabilistic, evolving, or contested.

Drive Measurable Business Impact

• Improve conversion across browse surfaces (home, search, swimlanes, collections, full menu).

• Reduce checkout abandonment and cart-to-order friction.

• Lift overall funnel CVR and contribution to weekly order frequency and reduction of subscriber churn.

You Are

• A senior, frontend-first product thinker with deep instincts for consumer UX and a track record of owning high-traffic discovery or browsing surfaces.

• Comfortable holding a wide, complex surface area — you can zoom out to set coherent strategy across many screens while staying close enough to the details to make good product decisions.

• A strong design partner who can elevate the quality of an experience, not just spec it.

• Technically grounded enough to work fluently with frontend engineers, understand component architecture, and reason about how system-level decisions affect the user experience.

• Genuinely excited by the challenge of making a large, dynamic food catalog feel simple and delightful to browse.

• Collaborative and low-ego at the seam between your work and adjacent PM domains; you know how to maintain shared ownership without losing accountability.

• Rigorous about experimentation and metrics without being paralyzed by them.

Qualifications

• 8+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of consumer-facing mobile and/or web surfaces at scale.

• Demonstrated experience with discovery, browsing, search, or shopping experiences, ideally in a marketplace or catalog-heavy product.

• Strong UX instincts and a proven track record of close collaboration with design teams.

• Comfortable with frontend product systems (component libraries, server-driven UI, feature flags) and able to partner effectively with frontend engineers.

• Experience running A/B experiments, defining metrics, and making data-informed decisions in ambiguous situations.

• Excellent cross-functional communication; able to influence design, engineering, and business stakeholders across a complex organization.

• Proven ability to manage a large roadmap across multiple surfaces simultaneously.

Learn More About CookUnity

We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.

We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!

Benefits

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays

🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefit platform

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach

postings.title: Host Account Manager (Offshore)
postings.descriptionText:
The Role We Need

PadSplit is hiring a Host Account Manager to serve as the dedicated strategic partner and primary point of contact for a portfolio of PadSplit hosts. This is a newly created role at the heart of our Host Success model, designed to shift how we support all hosts from reactive problem-solving to proactive, relationship-driven account management.

You will own the full host relationship from activation through long-term retention. But owning the relationship means more than managing check-ins and reviewing dashboards. It means being a trusted partner and the person your hosts call when something goes wrong, someone who knows the platform, the policies, and the fee structures well enough to provide clear answers on the spot. You will be measured on the outcomes that matter most: your response times, occupancy performance, host satisfaction, churn reduction, and portfolio retention.

This role is critical to ensuring every host in your book of business has what they need to thrive on the platform, and that they feel it.

The Person We Are Looking For

We are looking for a relationship-first operator who leads with data, follows through with hustle, and knows the product, policies, and PadSplit member outcomes well enough to earn a host’s trust in the first conversation. You are proactive by nature, the kind of person who spots a problem in a dashboard before a host ever has to call about it. You are also comfortable in the reactive moments: a confused host on the phone about a payout deduction, a complex situation involving a member that requires judgment and empathy in equal measure, a policy question that does not have a clean answer. You handle those moments with the same professionalism you bring to your scheduled portfolio reviews.

You understand that being a trusted partner requires genuine knowledge. You do not escalate everything, and you do not guess. You build the platform and policy fluency to be the person who actually resolves the issue, and you know when escalation is the right call.

You believe in PadSplit’s mission and understand what it means to work in the affordable housing space, where the stakes for both hosts and members are real.

Here’s What You’ll Do Day-to-Day

ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT AND RELATIONSHIP OWNERSHIP

• Own and manage a dedicated portfolio of PadSplit hosts, serving as their primary named point of contact for support ticket escalation and resolution, policy adherence and understanding, and overall portfolio direction

• Provide the right information at the right time, becoming a partner and strategic advisor of PadSplit

• Build proactive, trust-based relationships that reduce churn and increase host lifetime value.

• Conduct regular performance check-ins, including structured reviews aligned to host goals and PadSplit benchmarks.

• Drive host accountability on key metrics including attainable occupancy, bookability flags, rejection rates, move-in ratings, and member retention.

• Partner with hosts on portfolio growth, including conversations about adding new properties and expanding their PadSplit footprint.

• Serve as the host’s internal advocate, surfacing feedback and trends to product, operations, and leadership.

PLATFORM, POLICY, AND FINANCIAL FLUENCY

• Maintain deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s platform, fee structures, payout mechanics, and host-facing policies, with the ability to explain decisions clearly and confidently.

• Serve as a knowledgeable, trusted point of contact for hosts navigating financial questions, policy inquiries, and operational challenges.

• Apply PadSplit policies thoughtfully, explaining both the “what” and the “why” in a way that builds understanding and trust rather than resentment.

• Guide hosts on pricing strategy, occupancy optimization, listing quality, rejection rate management, and platform best practices using both data and platform knowledge.

• Monitor host and property performance using PadSplit’s data tools, identifying risks and opportunities before they become problems.

NEW HOST ACTIVATION

• Lead an intro call for every new host in your portfolio, establishing the relationship and setting expectations from day one.

• Guide new hosts from the beginning, covering pricing, room standards, rejection rate drivers, and mission-critical success requirements.

• Prepare hosts for their first members: responsiveness standards, room readiness expectations, and move-in experience requirements.

• Educate new hosts on member outcome drivers including safety compliance, pricing discipline, and platform behaviors that directly improve member, host and company outcomes.

ISSUE RESOLUTION AND ESCALATION

• Navigate complex, nuanced host situations that require investigation, sound judgment, and fair resolution.

• Escalate and coordinate resolution of issues that require cross-functional support, working with member support, trust and safety, payments, and legal teams where appropriate.

• Manage emotionally charged conversations with empathy, composure, and directness, holding firm on policy while maintaining the relationship.

• Document ticket details and resolutions accurately, maintaining clear records across all host interactions.

• Identify patterns in host concerns and flag systemic issues to inform process, policy, or product improvements.

TEAM AND PROGRAM DEVELOPMENT

• Contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, talk tracks, macro responses, and best practices as this function matures.

• Participate in weekly team syncs to share what is working, surface friction points, and iterate on the program in real time.

Here’s What You’ll Need to Be Successful

• Account Management or Customer Success Background: 3+ years of account management, customer success, or high-touch client relationship experience. Background in real estate, property management, hospitality, or a platform-based marketplace is strongly preferred.

• Platform and Policy Fluency: Ability and willingness to develop deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s product, fee structures, and policies, and to use that knowledge in live host conversations.

• Proactive Portfolio Management: Proven ability to manage a large book of relationships with a proactive, not reactive, approach. You spot the problem before the host calls.

• Data-Driven Communication: Comfortable using data to tell a story and drive a conversation. You can translate performance metrics into clear, actionable guidance a host can act on today.

• Critical Thinking and Sound Judgment: Ability to analyze incomplete or conflicting information, apply policies thoughtfully in nuanced scenarios, and arrive at fair, defensible decisions.

• Empathetic Directness: Skill in balancing compassion with clarity, especially when delivering difficult or unpopular outcomes. You hold firm on policy while making the host feel heard.

• Strong Communication: Clear, confident written and verbal communication tailored to diverse audiences. You build trust quickly and handle difficult conversations without escalating unnecessarily.

• Organization and Follow-Through: Highly organized with the ability to prioritize across a large portfolio without dropping the ball on high-value or high-risk relationships.

• Mission Alignment: Genuine belief in PadSplit’s mission and an understanding of what it means to operate in the affordable housing space.

• Growth Mindset: Motivated by the idea of building something new and improving it as you go. This function is being built from the ground up and you will help shape it.

The Interview Process:

• Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by a real human being from the PeopleOps team.

• If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video interview with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.

• If warranted, the next stage is a video interview and meeting with our Senior Host Experience Manager for about forty-five (45) minutes, where the candidate will participate in a live case interview.

• If warranted, the final step would be a video interview with our Regional Host Experience Manager for thirty minutes (30)

• If warranted, we move to an offer!

Compensation

Compensation is based on the role's scope, national market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals. In addition to salary, there is a variable compensation component based on performance.

Additional Information

Notice to Applicants:

PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process.

PadSplit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

postings.title: Senior Product Data Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
About CookUnity :

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Role

As a Senior Product Data Analyst , you will be an analytical partner to Product, Design, Engineering, and User Research. You will help teams understand both sides of CookUnity's marketplace: how customers find meals that fit their lives and how chef supply, variety, and merchandising shape that experience. You will own measurement and analysis for a product area, turn ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses, and use evidence to guide product decisions.

Our teams operate through clear success metrics, rapid learning, and controlled experiments. You will help them distinguish meaningful customer and business outcomes from activity, evaluate tradeoffs across the funnel and customer lifecycle, and make insights accessible in day-to-day decisions. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with meaningful autonomy and close cross-functional partnership.

What You'll Do in 12 Months

• Make the marketplace easier to discover and more relevant: Study how customers browse chefs, meals, cuisines, dietary options, and price points. Analyze the relationship between local assortment, variety, personalization, and ordering behavior. Help Product identify where better discovery or merchandising can improve repeat ordering and retention.

• Improve the journey from first visit to lasting habit: Map the customer funnel from acquisition through first order, early repeat orders, and longer-term retention. Find friction in onboarding, menu exploration, checkout, and weekly ordering. Segment customers thoughtfully so teams can improve conversion and retention without hiding weak experiences behind averages.

• Measure product bets with credible experiments: Partner with Product and Engineering to define hypotheses, primary metrics, guardrails, sample sizes, and holdouts for changes to the funnel, personalization, loyalty, and in-product interventions. Analyze heterogeneous effects and uncertainty, and recommend whether to launch, iterate, or stop. When a randomized test is impractical, use the strongest available observational approach and explain its limits.

• Connect customer value to marketplace economics: Help teams evaluate how product changes affect order rate, churn, revenue per customer, discounts, chef engagement, and unit economics together. For new categories and ordering formats, define the measures that show whether customers find value and whether the model can scale.

• Reduce the work and stress of ordering: Combine behavioral data with research and customer feedback to understand where subscriptions, delivery information, account management, or support journeys create friction. Measure whether self-service and product improvements solve the underlying problem, not just move contacts to another channel.

• Build a trusted measurement foundation: Define and document product metrics, cohorts, event tracking, and dashboards. Work with Engineering and Data partners to validate instrumentation and maintain reliable behavioral data. Create compelling dashboards that let product teams explore results, spot meaningful patterns, and monitor outcomes after launch.

• Shape a focused learning agenda: Work with Product, Design, and User Research to prioritize the most consequential unknowns, design analyses and tests, and tell a clear story about what the team learned. Share methods and review work with other analysts to raise the quality of product analytics across the team.

What Success Looks Like

• Product teams use clear metrics and guardrails to make decisions about discovery, conversion, ordering, and retention.

• Major launches are supported by credible tests or well-explained evidence, including their impact on different customer segments.

• Insights lead to measurable improvements in customer experience and repeat ordering while accounting for marketplace and financial tradeoffs.

• Stakeholders trust and regularly use self-service reporting, and core behavioral data is sufficiently complete to diagnose product performance.

Core Competences/Requirements

• Approximately 5–7 years in product analytics or a closely related analytical role, with demonstrated ownership of complex analyses and influence on product decisions. Equivalent experience and evidence of impact are welcome.

• Practical fluency with AI tools for accelerating analysis, coding, research synthesis, documentation, and repeatable workflows; able to verify outputs and handle company and customer data responsibly.

• Strong SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large, complex behavioral datasets; ability to validate data and write clear, reusable analyses.

• Practical command of product metrics, funnel and cohort analysis, segmentation, and marketplace or subscription dynamics.

• Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, including holdouts, guardrails, uncertainty, and tradeoffs; sound judgment about causal claims.

• Ability to turn an ambiguous product problem into a focused learning plan, work independently, and communicate an actionable recommendation.

• Clear data storytelling and constructive partnership with Product, Design, Engineering, User Research, and business teams.

• Ability to build powerful, intuitive dashboards in any tool that answer important product questions, reveal actionable insights, and enable trustworthy self-service analysis.

• Ability to evaluate AI-enabled product experiences through clear success metrics, experiments, user feedback, and appropriate quality and safety checks.

• Curiosity about food, chefs, customer behavior, and the practical constraints of operating a local marketplace.

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD.

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want.

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date.

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays.

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider.

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical.

🐣 Paid family leave.

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises.

🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: a prepaid card you can use on wellness, learning, food, and more.

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach.

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

• Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page .

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

postings.title: Analista de Finanzas Estratégicas
postings.descriptionText:
¡Hola! Somos Cashea 👋 y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocios BNPL. Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy día tenemos más de 11 millones de usuarios activos, tanto para consumidores como para comercios, y nos hemos convertido en una marca de confianza en Venezuela, conquistando mentes y corazones

Resumen del role
Buscamos un Analista Financiero para Cashea , una fintech en crecimiento. La posición tendrá como foco principal la planificación financiera y el análisis del negocio, y apoyará las actividades de investor relations y la preparación de materiales para la gerencia, el directorio e inversionistas.
Formará parte del equipo de Finanzas Estratégicas y trabajará en modelos, proyecciones y análisis que permitan entender el desempeño de la compañía, evaluar oportunidades y apoyar decisiones de crecimiento, financiamiento y asignación de capital. Si esto resuena contigo, ¡sigue leyendo!

Responsabilidades

• Apoyar los procesos de planificación financiera, presupuesto y actualización de proyecciones de la compañía.

• Desarrollar y mantener modelos financieros para proyectar resultados, flujos de caja y necesidades de capital.

• Analizar el desempeño financiero y operativo, explicar desviaciones frente al plan e identificar riesgos y oportunidades.

• Realizar análisis de negocio y rentabilidad para apoyar la evaluación de productos, iniciativas y nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento.

• Preparar análisis de escenarios y sensibilidad para evaluar el impacto de distintos supuestos en los resultados y la posición financiera.

• Apoyar análisis de costo de capital, alternativas de financiamiento y asignación de recursos.

• Preparar reportes, presentaciones y otros materiales financieros para la gerencia, el directorio e inversionistas.

• Apoyar las actividades de investor relations, incluyendo la actualización de información financiera y la atención de requerimientos de inversionistas y potenciales proveedores de capital.

• Colaborar con distintas áreas para consolidar información y mejorar los procesos de análisis y reporte financiero.

Requisitos

• Título universitario en Economía, Finanzas, Contaduría, Ingeniería o carrera afín.

• De 1 a 4 años de experiencia en planificación financiera, finanzas corporativas o consultoría financiera.

• Conocimientos sólidos de finanzas corporativas, planificación y análisis financiero.

• Comprensión de los estados financieros y su relación con el desempeño del negocio.

• Excel avanzado y experiencia en modelación financiera.

• Capacidad para trabajar con datos, identificar tendencias y convertir hallazgos en conclusiones útiles para el negocio.

• Dominio avanzado de inglés y español, con capacidad para hablar, leer y escribir en ambos idiomas, participar en reuniones y preparar materiales financieros.

• Habilidad para preparar presentaciones y comunicar información financiera de forma clara y estructurada.

• Capacidad analítica, atención al detalle y organización para manejar varias prioridades.

• Criterio para cuestionar supuestos, validar resultados y trabajar con distintas áreas de la compañía.

Por qué te encantará trabajar en Cashea

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si necesitas una pista de por qué somos una buena opción, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:

• No trabajamos en piloto automático. Todo lo que hacemos es intencional. Nos encanta elaborar ideas plenamente conscientes del impacto que pueden tener en nuestros usuarios.

• Tu creatividad y curiosidad son el activo más Importante.

• Valoramos la transparencia. La claridad nos mantiene conectados y con los pies en la tierra.

• Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real.

Si quieres trabajar con nosotros, llena la aplicación. ¡Nos encantaría conocerte!

Product Strategy & Lifecycle Ownership: Define and execute the multi-product roadmap across Face2Gene , Family Health Checker , and FDNA’s Provider/Pharma Data Clearinghouse , balancing clinician utility, patient engagement, and B2B/life sciences monetization.

FDA & SaMD Parameters: Navigating FDA guidance on Clinical Decision Support (CDS) software, SaMD classifications, and non-diagnostic informational labeling.

US EHR Integrations: Hands-on experience shipping integrations with major US EHRs (e.g., Epic, Oracle Cerner, athenahealth) utilizing HL7, FHIR, SMART on FHIR, or clearinghouse APIs.

US Clinical Workflows: Deep familiarity with US provider intake, referral management, care coordination, and specialty clinical environments.

postings.title: Engineering Manager - Developer Tools (Starcraft)
postings.descriptionText:
We are hiring a software engineering manager with a passion for developer experience and build tooling to have a positive impact on the day-to-day workflow of thousands of snap and charm publishers. To be successful on this team you'll need to be interested in packaging formats, build systems and automation that can simplify the lives of developers and engineers trying to ship software to the widest possible audience.
We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps, charms and more recently, rocks (OCI images).
Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognized names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft. Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.
Your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
This Engineering Management role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for developer experience to build a career with Canonical and drive the success of the business. If you have an affinity for open source development, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical .
Location: This is a remote role, we are considering candidates in AMER time zones.

The role entails

• Leading your team to elevate the Linux developer experience.

• Demonstrating sound engineering principles through architecture, development and code reviews.

• Being responsible for planning, estimation and execution.

• Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders.

• Building and leading a distributed regional team of engineers.

• Offering coaching, mentoring, technical feedback and hands-on career development.

• Designing, embracing, and evangelizing great engineering and organizational practices.

• Being an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organization.

postings.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Identity
postings.descriptionText:
Why TrueML ?

TrueML is a mission-driven financial software company that aims to create better customer experiences for distressed borrowers. Consumers today want personal, digital-first experiences that align with their lifestyles, especially when it comes to managing finances. TrueML ’s approach uses machine learning to engage each customer digitally and adjust strategies in real time in response to their interactions.
The TrueML team includes inspired data scientists, financial services industry experts and customer experience fanatics building technology to serve people in a way that recognizes their unique needs and preferences as human beings and endeavoring toward ensuring nobody gets locked out of the financial system.

About the Role
The Identity team (IDNT) owns the systems that manage account state, client configuration, platform authentication, contact data, and credit bureau reporting at TrueML .
We support both of TrueML 's legacy products: a digital-first third-party collections platform and a white-label, first-party SaaS product. We're also building their replacements on a new platform. Our new platform removes the duplicate functionality between the legacy two products, supports future offerings, and lets us retire legacy components.

What You'll Do:

• Debt Management : account state, serviceability, and lifecycle events, in both the legacy systems and new platform

• Entity management : a platform-level hierarchical configuration store. Attributes can be defined at any level of the entity hierarchy and overridden further down, so client behavior can be customized without code changes.

• Authentication: machine-to-machine authentication using OAuth 2.0 client credentials, plus end-user login, token issuance, and authorization integrated with a third-party identity provider

• Contact Verification : the people accountable for an account, their contact information and communication preferences, and verification of phone numbers, email addresses, and mailing addresses

• Credit bureau reporting : a new capability being built in-house. It generates Metro 2 formatted files, manages reporting cycles, handles disputes and corrections, and tracks submissions to the three major credit bureaus.

• Design and build reliable, scalable backend services and event processors for account state and lifecycle

• Maintain and evolve legacy event-processing services and a legacy monolith while building their new platform replacements

• Drive the technical roadmap for the Identity domain as the platform moves from legacy systems to the new platform

• Own services end-to-end: design, implementation, deployment, and on-call support

• Build platform-level services, like configuration and authentication, that other domain teams depend on

• Work with other domain teams on cross-domain integration

• Build and maintain internal tools for client configuration and testing

• Mentor engineers and contribute to TrueML 's engineering culture

Who You Are (Required):

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 2+ years as a senior engineer or tech lead

•
Strong proficiency in Go

• Experience with AWS, including Lambda and Cognito

• Experience with event-driven systems, including processing event streams and building an account's current state from its event history

• Solid understanding of authentication and authorization: OAuth 2.0 client credentials, token issuance and validation, and identity provider integration

• Experience designing APIs that other teams consume

• Experience operating production services, including logs, traces, performance monitoring, and incident response (we use Datadog and Observe)

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines (we use Jenkins)

How You Could Stand Out:

• Experience with hierarchical configuration systems or parameter stores (e.g., AWS SSM Parameter Store, Consul)

• Experience with building phone and email features

• Experience migrating functionality out of a legacy monolith onto a new platform (micro services)

• Experience building internal tools with Retool or similar low-code platforms

• Background in debt collection or financial services

Recruiting Fraud Notice:

We’re aware of fraudulent recruiters posing as TrueAccord or TrueML and contacting job seekers. To protect yourself, here’s how our real hiring process works:

•
Official channels only. Our recruiters email only from @trueaccord.com [If you’ve received an InMail, you should verify the recruiter’s @ email]

•
No payments or financial info during hiring. We will never ask you to pay fees, buy equipment, or share banking information during the hiring process.

•
No text or chat-app interviews. We do not conduct interviews by text message or messaging apps.

•
No “portals” or access keys. We do not send PDF portals or access keys, or ask for passwords or login credentials.

•
No resume services. We will never require an “ATS-friendly” resume rewrite or recommend paid resume services.

If someone contacting you on our behalf does any of the above, it is fraud.

Stay safe:

• Don’t open attachments, click links, or share personal information.

• Report the message as phishing to your email provider, and report fake profiles to LinkedIn.

• Not sure? Verify by emailing before responding.

If you’ve already shared information with suspected scammers: Contact your bank, visit identitytheft.gov, and report the fraud at reportfraud.ftc.gov or ic3.gov.

We are a dynamic group of people who are subject matter experts with a passion for change. Our teams are crafting solutions to big problems every day. If you’re looking for an opportunity to do impactful work, join TrueML and make a difference.
Our Dedication to Diversity & Inclusion

postings.title: Pearl Talent - Sales Development Representative
postings.descriptionText:
We're hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) for Pearl, working with the top startups in SF, NYC and broder US. We hire for our clients offering key roles in their company to exceptional talent in the US and internationally. We support the onboarding, best in class AI-native skills and training. We're 3x founders with previous exits and we’ve bootstrapped our company to 8 figures in revenue and multiplying in annual growth. Our clients span venture-backed tech and healthcare, including fast-growing startups and phenomenal US-based businesses that have raised over $5B in funding from Sequoia, a16z, Founders Fund, Y Combinator, and other top VC firms.
Today we're roughly 60 people managing a few hundred international hires and close to 100 US based roles and growing fast and into new verticals. We started Pearl because we believe that even though opportunity isn’t created equal in the world, ambitious talent is. And our goal is to scale Pearl past our previous 100m in ARR bootstrapped goal to placing ten thousand great hires with the highest quality reputation.
Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we’re building for: Watch here
Location: LATAM, Philippines, Remote

Purpose of Your Role
Booking meetings with Qualified leads who have shown intent (inbound), and managing the lead touches through signature of contract and handoff.
You'll be part of Pearl's internal sales organization, working directly with US-based founders, executives, and business owners who are looking to hire exceptional talent both US based and international.
You'll own the sales process from the moment a prospect expresses interest through discovery, qualification, negotiation, and signed agreement alongside the account executives and founders. You'll respond quickly, follow up consistently, and make it easy for qualified customers to start working with Pearl by being in touch with them and confirming they are attending agreed upon calls and timelines.
This isn't a traditional SDR role where you simply book meetings and hand prospects to an Account Executive. You'll take ownership of getting the call attended, managing customer touches alongside the AE or Founder on call, and get the agreement signed will full ownership of touches.
Your success will be measured by qualified inbound leads who attended calls, sending next steps and getting agreements signed in coordination with the AE’s and Founders.

What You'll Own

1. Turn Every Inbound Lead Into a Booked Meeting

• Respond to every inbound lead the same day, using email, phone, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp to engage prospects and secure discovery meetings.

• Qualify referral, inbound and chatbot leads against Pearl’s ideal customer profile, identifying genuine hiring needs, budgets, timelines, and decision-makers.

• Maintain a discovery meeting show rate at our high KPI rate or higher through effective scheduling, confirmation, and follow-up.

• Keep every lead moving through the sales funnel. No opportunity should go cold in HubSpot without a documented reason or next step.

• Identify unqualified prospects early, ensuring discovery calls are focused on businesses with a strong likelihood of becoming successful Pearl customers.

2. Run Deals From Discovery to Close

• Own opportunities from the first discovery conversation through proposal, negotiation, and signed agreement actioning AE direction.

• Build credibility with founders and business leaders by understanding their hiring challenges and demonstrating how Pearl’s talent solutions can help them scale.

• Qualify prospects carefully, reject poor-fit customers who are unlikely to succeed or retain.

• Protect Pearl’s pricing and margins by focusing on value proposition by mastering our product offering and objection handling. Where appropriate, offer risk-reducing terms or encourage multi-role commitments.

• Re-engage stalled opportunities through thoughtful follow-up, investor introductions, customer referrals, and other relationship-driven approaches.

• Work independently to move deals forward, involving Pearl’s founders when their participation can materially improve the likelihood of closing.

3. Keep the CRM and Sales Operations Running Cleanly

• Maintain accurate, same-day records in HubSpot, including deal stages, call notes, next steps, and follow-up commitments per lead.

• Ensure every opportunity has a clearly defined status and action plan so leadership can understand pipeline health without requesting updates.

• Manage timely start-of-day updates, pre-call briefs, and pipeline reports that are accurate and require minimal revisions.

• Build and maintain HubSpot sequences and AI-powered workflows to automate follow-ups, re-engagement, reporting, and repetitive administrative tasks.

• Identify inefficiencies in the sales process and continuously improve lead response times, qualification, pipeline management, and conversion rates.

What Success Looks Like

In Your First 90 Days
You've learned Pearl's services, ideal customer profile, pricing, and sales process. You're independently managing lead flow to handoff owning at best in class standards the responsibilities listed above. Your pipeline is accurate, you’re hitting best in class conversions in each part of the funnel you own, and you're closing business without relying on the founders to lead every conversation.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

• Experience in a B2B sales development, account executive, or full-cycle sales role managing a high volume of deals.

• Demonstrated success converting inbound leads into qualified opportunities and signed customers.

• Experience setting discovery calls, being on the phone with leads with strong English language, qualifying business needs, handling objections while booking calls, following up to move the deal forward negotiating commercial terms, and closing deals.

• Confidence engaging directly with US-based founders, executives, and business owners.

• Strong follow-up discipline and the ability to manage multiple active opportunities without letting prospects fall through the cracks.

• Commercial judgment to recognize strong-fit customers, identify potential retention risks, and protect pricing.

• Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable CRM, including pipeline management, reporting, and sales automation.

• Familiarity with AI tools and a willingness to automate repetitive work and improve sales productivity.

• Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

• The ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced startup environment with overlapping US business hours.

Bonus Points If You Have

• Experience selling staffing, recruiting, offshore talent, or managed services to US businesses.

• Experience selling to venture-backed startups, particularly in healthcare or health technology.

• Experience building HubSpot sequences, automated follow-up campaigns, or AI-powered sales workflows.

• A track record of closing multi-role or recurring-revenue agreements.

Benefits

Why Join Pearl?
You'll join a fast-growing, founder-led company with ambitious goals and the opportunity to make a direct impact on revenue.
You'll work closely with Pearl's leadership, develop relationships with US startup founders, and take meaningful ownership of the sales process. As Pearl grows, you'll have the opportunity to help shape how we qualify, convert, and close new customers.
We're looking for someone who moves quickly, takes ownership, embraces AI, and wants to build something exceptional.

Benefits

•
Build and Grow Quickly - We're scaling fast, and we trust that you'll know best on the ground what needs to be done. You'll have the opportunity to step into leadership early and own decisions that shape how our company grows.

•
Global Retreats - We create space for our teammates to get to know each other as people, rather than just to-do lists. We've shared meals, laughs, and sunrises across the world in places like Cancun, El Nido, Boracay, and Siargao.

•
Unlimited PTO - We trust that you'll get your work done, and we want to create space for you to take time away with the people you care about.

•
Ambitious and Caring Team - We build with the most competent people we know, and we maintain a low-ego, no-assholes policy. We're looking for people who are sharp, kind, and open to being vulnerable when it matters.
