• User Acquisition: Design, execute, and scale aggressive multi-channel acquisition campaigns to consistently flood the ecosystem with high-value users.

• Performance Marketing: Oversee paid acquisition budgets with surgical efficiency, constantly optimizing ad spend, targeting vectors, and creative assets to drive down CAC.

• Growth Experiments: Maintain a relentless, high-velocity testing cadence—running rapid experiments across landing pages, copy, hooks, and product flows to discover hidden growth levers.

The Requirements

• The "Growth Engineer": Proven experience managing growth, performance marketing, or data-driven acquisition for a fast-moving technology or digital platform.

• Remote Excellence: Self-motivated and highly organized; you can manage massive marketing budgets and complex cross-department testing pipelines without losing track of a single metric.

Operational Details

• Location: Fully Remote.

• Schedule: On-call 7 days a week (Requires high flexibility to handle real-time campaign optimizations and 24/7 market cycles).

• Payment: All compensation is processed in digital assets (USDC/USDT).

Why Join Us?
We offer more than just a marketing role; we offer the keys to a high-powered growth engine.

• Extreme Autonomy: We value output over red tape. You will have the freedom to build, test, and ship your own growth frameworks within a high-speed, high-trust environment.

• Uncapped Leverage: Bring your scaling strategies to a powerhouse that has the distribution, technical talent, and budget to realize them instantly.

• A Culture of Momentum: Join a team that moves at the speed of light. You will be constantly building, analyzing, and scaling new acquisition loops.

• High-Growth Upside: We value "potential over pedigree." For a Growth Lead who consistently moves the needle and hits aggressive targets, there is a clear, unrestricted runway into senior leadership.

About the Role:
We're looking for a Staff IT Engineer to own and operate the systems that keep SecurityScorecard running — and to be a force multiplier for a deliberately lean security and GRC function. This is a hands-on, senior-level role reporting directly to the CISO. You will be the primary technical owner of corporate identity, endpoint, collaboration, and AI workflow tooling and the IT budget; you will also be the third operating leg of a small InfoSec team, carrying daily security operations and turning IT telemetry into the audit evidence our SOC 2, GovRAMP, FedRAMP and ISO 27001 programs run on. You'll hit the ground running on IT operations from day one and own the full stack within 90 days.
This is not a ticket-taker role. We need someone who identifies problems before they're assigned, builds automation that makes the whole organization faster, turns control gaps into evidence and fixes rather than findings, and holds the technical bar for the team around them. The way we work: security and GRC specify what good looks like and by when; you own how it gets built and operated in the corporate estate.

What You Will Own:

•
Identity & Access Management — Administer Okta as primary IdP including SSO, MFA, lifecycle management, and Workflows. Own joiner/mover/leaver processes end-to-end integrated with BambooHR and Google Workspace. Govern service accounts, API keys, and secrets lifecycle. Run periodic access reviews and produce the evidence they generate.

•
Endpoint & Device Management — Manage the macOS fleet via Intune and Level. Enforce security baselines and patch compliance. Serve as escalation point for device issues and coordinate with CrowdStrike Falcon for endpoint security. Own hardware procurement, provisioning, and retirement.

•
Collaboration & SaaS Administration — Administer Google Workspace and Atlassian (Jira, Confluence). Serve as technical owner for corporate SaaS, including onboarding new tools and maintaining an approved software register with a lightweight security review process. Keep the sub-processor and vendor inventory inputs current for GRC.

•
Automation Engineering — Design and build automations that meaningfully improve how teams across the org operate — Finance, HR, Security, Engineering, GTM. Integrate across the SaaS stack using APIs, Zapier, BlinkOps, Okta Workflows, and AI-assisted tooling. Maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities and drive it forward without being asked. Prioritize automations that remove manual evidence collection and access-review toil for the security and GRC team.

•
IT Finance & Budget — Own the IT budget end-to-end across SaaS, hardware, and vendors. Manage contracts and renewal cycles, negotiate pricing, right-size licenses, and proactively reclaim unused seats. Build cost visibility for the CISO and forecast annual spend.

•
Security Operations — Partner daily with the security team as a first responder: endpoint compromise, account takeover, and suspicious-access events, under the Security Incident Response Plan. Own DLP policy at the endpoint, email, and collaboration layers, and administer email security infrastructure including DMARC, DKIM, and SPF. Take corporate-IT vulnerability findings (identity, SaaS, endpoint, Google Workspace) from the vulnerability queue and drive them to verified closure — you fix the corporate-estate findings, not just triage them.

•
GRC & Compliance Engineering — Turn the systems you run into continuous audit evidence. Automate and maintain the IT control evidence our frameworks depend on — access reviews, MFA and EDR coverage, offboarding completeness, least-privilege attestations, change and patch records — and wire those feeds into the GRC tooling (Secureframe) and the InfoSec reporting so coverage metrics are live rather than assembled at audit time. Support SOC 2, GovRAMP, FedRAMP, and ISO 27001 evidence requests end-to-end, and own the IT-owned controls within them.

•
AI Governance & Shadow-AI Controls — Administer and govern corporate AI tooling: maintain the AI tool inventory, enforce the acceptable-use policy in the stack, and build discovery and controls for shadow AI. Partner with the Chief AI Officer function on technical enforcement of AI governance across identity, SaaS, and endpoint.

•
Privileged Access Management — Own governance of highly privileged accounts including break-glass accounts and service accounts. Enforce just-in-time access, session recording, and periodic privileged access reviews, and produce the review evidence.

•
Mentorship & Team Development — Actively mentor IT peers through 1:1s, workflow reviews, and hands-on pairing. Identify skill gaps, design development plans, and model the engineering and operational standards you want the team to grow into.

•
On-Call & Incident Response — This role carries on-call responsibilities. You're expected to be reachable and responsive during active infrastructure, identity, or endpoint incidents outside business hours.

Required Qualifications:

• 8 or more years of experience operating at a Staff or Principal level in a hands-on infrastructure or IT engineering role, with a track record of owning systems and functions fully, not just contributing within them.

• Expert-level Okta administration, including Lifecycle Management, Workflows, and API integration.

• Hands-on experience managing macOS fleets at scale, including MDM tooling and device compliance enforcement.

• Strong Google Workspace administration experience in an enterprise environment.

• Proficiency in building and maintaining integrations and automations via APIs, scripting, and workflow platforms — with a portfolio of cross-functional tooling that other teams depend on.

• Experience with workflow automation platforms such as Zapier, BlinkOps, or equivalent.

• Experience owning an IT or SaaS budget, including vendor contract negotiation, renewal management, and license optimization.

• Familiarity with endpoint security tooling — CrowdStrike Falcon or equivalent EDR platform experience required.

• Experience producing audit evidence and operating within a SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent compliance framework, and comfort owning the IT-side controls and evidence directly.

• Hands-on security operations experience: access reviews, incident first-response, DLP, and email security (DMARC/DKIM/SPF), and a willingness to remediate corporate-IT vulnerability findings yourself.

• Prior experience mentoring or actively developing engineers, with demonstrated impact on their growth and ownership.

• Comfort operating in a security-focused environment where access control, auditability, and least-privilege are non-negotiable.

• Ability to manage competing priorities and operate independently in a lean, high-trust environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior experience at a cybersecurity company or similarly regulated environment — you understand the cultural weight of security-first infrastructure without needing it explained.

• Experience administering and governing AI tools in a corporate environment, including acceptable-use policy enforcement and shadow-AI controls.

• Experience with a GRC / compliance-automation platform (Secureframe, Vanta, Drata or equivalent) and with automating control evidence.

Location: Remote

About the Role
We are seeking an organized, proactive, and results-driven Project Manager to oversee projects from planning and initiation through completion. The ideal candidate will be responsible for coordinating timelines, resources, vendors, stakeholders, budgets, and day-to-day project execution while ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to scope. The successful candidate should be comfortable managing multiple priorities, resolving issues proactively, maintaining accurate project documentation, and communicating effectively with clients, vendors, contractors, and internal teams.

Responsibilities

Project Planning & Execution

• Manage projects from initiation and planning through completion and closeout.

• Develop and maintain project schedules, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.

• Coordinate project activities to ensure work progresses according to plan.

• Track project scope, priorities, dependencies, and deadlines.

• Identify potential risks, delays, and issues and implement solutions proactively.

Budget & Financial Management

• Develop and track project budgets, estimates, and costs.

• Monitor invoices, expenses, payments, and overall project profitability.

• Review project financial performance and identify discrepancies or cost risks.

Vendor & Resource Coordination

• Coordinate material, equipment, and service deliveries according to project schedules.

• Ensure resources are available when needed to prevent project delays.

Stakeholder Communication

• Organize project meetings and follow up on action items.

• Prepare project updates, reports, and documentation for leadership and stakeholders.

Documentation & Process Management

• Maintain accurate project documentation, schedules, budgets, contracts, and records.

• Develop and maintain SOPs, workflows, and project processes.

• Track project deliverables and ensure required documentation is completed.

• Identify opportunities to improve project management processes and operational efficiency.

Problem Solving & Operations

• Resolve scheduling conflicts, operational issues, and project obstacles.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams to keep projects moving forward.

• Balance multiple projects and competing priorities effectively.

• Support leadership with special projects and operational initiatives when required.

Required Experience & Skills (Must-Have)

• Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and take ownership of project outcomes.

postings.title: Technical Support Specialist (L2)
postings.descriptionText:
About the project
You will join a long-term support engagement for an enterprise client. The product is a web platform that runs a formal, multi-stage review process from end to end: organisations submit applications, work through a structured evaluation, exchange supporting documents, answer requests for information and track their progress over a long cycle. It is used daily by the client's own staff, by the organisations going through the process, and by the external specialists who assess them.
The platform is a C# / .NET API with an Angular front end on SQL Server, hosted in Azure. Around it sits a set of connected systems: single sign-on, a secure document store for sensitive data, transactional email, a learning platform and several public websites.
Trinetix supports, maintains and develops the platform. You will be the engineer dedicated to the service desk: the person who owns the queue, keeps the system healthy, and hands the development team work that is already reproduced and understood.

What the work looks like
The queue is steady rather than overwhelming, and more than half of it is not code at all: access and log-in, how-to questions, data corrections, document handling. The rest are defects that need reproducing, then either fixing at configuration level or passing to development with the evidence attached.
Volume is seasonal. Scheduled events and large annual gatherings bring a rush of access requests in real time, and major releases bring periods of hypercare. You will feel both.

Responsibilities

Tickets and escalation

• Resolve issues escalated from first-level support.

• Triage the incoming queue: reproduce the reported behaviour, gather evidence, and separate user error, configuration and genuine defects.

• Communicate and coordinate with L1 support and the L3 / development team. Write bug reports and user stories the development team can act on without going back to the reporter.

• Correspond directly with the client's staff and with end users in clear, non-technical English, within agreed response and resolution targets.

• Handle user administration and access issues: account provisioning, single sign-on, two-factor codes, duplicate and orphaned accounts.

System health and incidents

• Monitor system performance and stability.

• Sort, filter and analyse system logs.

• Perform system recovery after failures.

• Manage incidents end to end: response, analysis and post-mortems.

• Respond to on-call alerts, investigate issues, and escalate when necessary.

Data and compliance

• Write diagnostic SQL queries against the production schema, and run approved data-correction scripts with verification and a rollback plan.

• Handle incidents involving sensitive personal data: delete mistakenly uploaded documents quickly, retrieve access logs, and record who accessed or downloaded the file. The platform operates under a strict regulatory regime.

Knowledge

• Maintain runbooks and technical documentation, and build them out where they do not yet exist. A good deal of the operational knowledge is not written down yet.

• Support releases, including hypercare after major launches.

Requirements

• At least 2 years in application support (L1-L3) for a business-critical web application.

• Jira and Jira Service Management: service-desk triage, SLA-driven ticket handling, clear bug and story writing.

• SQL Server: reading a relational schema, writing diagnostic queries, and running prepared data-fix scripts safely.

• Azure: Application Insights log queries, and a working understanding of App Services and Key Vault. Awareness of Azure DevOps releases.

• Troubleshooting single sign-on: SAML and OAuth.

• Incident management: triage, root-cause analysis, post-mortems.

• Clear written and spoken English, B2-C1. You will write to the client's staff and to end users every day.

• Daily overlap with the client's working hours, 10:00-19:00 US Central, Monday to Friday.

Nice to have

• FusionAuth administration, Umbraco CMS, SendGrid, or a managed secure document-storage service.

• Experience with regulated personal data (HIPAA, GDPR or an equivalent regime).

• Experience with certification, audit or other regulated compliance systems.

Why this role is worth taking

• You are the first dedicated support engineer on the account, not the fifth. The queue, the runbooks and the way triage works are yours to shape.

• A structured onboarding, with time to learn the system from the people who have been running it.

• A small team, two developers and a QA engineer, and direct contact with the client rather than three layers of process.

• Work that carries weight: the organisations on this platform cannot do without the process it supports.

What we offer

• Continuous learning and career growth opportunities

• Professional training and English/Spanish language classes

• Comprehensive medical insurance

• Mental health support

• Specialized benefits program with compensation for fitness activities, hobbies, pet care, and more

• Flexible working hours

• Inclusive and supportive culture

About Us
Established in 2011, Trinetix is a dynamic tech service provider supporting enterprise clients around the world.
Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, we have a global team of over 1,000 professionals and delivery centers across Europe, the United States, and Argentina. We partner with leading global brands, delivering innovative digital solutions across Fintech, Professional Services, Logistics, Healthcare, and Agriculture.
Our operations are driven by a strong business vision, a people-first culture, and a commitment to responsible growth. We actively give back to the community through various CSR activities and adhere to international principles for sustainable development and business ethics.
To learn more about how we collect, process, and store your personal data, please review our Privacy Notice:

postings.title: Account Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Who Are Massive Rocket ?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.
Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

We’re looking for an Account Manager to own and grow relationships with our strategic clients. You’ll be the senior day-to-day contact, connecting client priorities with our Strategy, Delivery, Programme Management, and specialist teams.

This role combines client leadership, commercial ownership, and account growth , ensuring clients see measurable value while identifying opportunities to deepen our partnerships.

What Will You Do?

• Own strategic client relationships, building trusted connections across senior, regional, and market stakeholders.

• Act as the primary commercial and strategic point of contact , managing priorities, risks, escalations, and opportunities.

• Lead client status meetings, account reviews, governance forums, and Executive Business Reviews .

• Coordinate internal teams to ensure client priorities are clearly understood, appropriately scoped, and delivered effectively.

• Develop strategic account plans covering stakeholders, client priorities, renewals, risks, and growth opportunities .

• Identify and lead renewals, upsells, extensions, and expansion opportunities across markets, brands, teams, and capabilities.

• Maintain visibility of account health, pipeline, revenue, profitability, client satisfaction, and commercial risks.

• Translate complex delivery, data, marketing, and technical work into clear business outcomes and recommendations for senior clients.

What Makes You a Great Fit

• Strong experience in Account Management, Client Services, Customer Success, or Strategic Account Management .

• Proven experience managing enterprise or strategic client relationships and senior stakeholders.

• Strong commercial acumen with experience across renewals, upsells, forecasting, and account profitability .

• Experience managing complex, multi-workstream client programmes in an agency, consultancy, MarTech, SaaS, or technology environment.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

• Commercially minded with a track record of identifying growth opportunities and expanding client relationships .

• Comfortable translating technical and delivery topics into clear business outcomes and ROI.

• Highly organised, proactive, and able to manage multiple strategic accounts and competing priorities.

Desirable

• Experience selling Braze, Snowflake, Hightouch, Databricks, CDPs, or related Martech and data solutions

• Experience selling into QSR, Retail, Hospitality, Financial Services, or Enterprise Digital Transformation programmes

• Experience working within partner-led sales motions and co-selling with technology vendors

• Existing network of enterprise buyers within the US market

• Familiarity with modern customer engagement, loyalty, and composable data architectures

Why You’ll Love Working Here
• Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else
• A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win
• A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond
• Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best
• Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter
• Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work

Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment

ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)

References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready

For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required

A Quick Note on Applications
We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

postings.title: Portfolio Management Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
YOUR POSITION WITH TNC
Within TNC´s global program, Provide Food and Water, TNC’s Zero Conversion Commodities (ZCC) is a global and mature strategy with the goal of transforming the food system for soy, cattle, and palm oil, primarily but not limited to, by enabling producers in critical ecosystems of South America to meet growing demand without converting additional land for farming. We work in partnership with value chain actors to halt habitat conversion caused by commodity production in highly biodiverse and threatened biomes, including the Brazilian Amazon, the Brazilian Cerrado, the Gran Chaco of Argentina and Paraguay, and Indonesia.
The ZCC Portfolio Management Specialist helps strengthen strategy management and implementation through two complementary areas: (1) strategy operations, monitoring, evaluation, and learning; and (2) portfolio and project management. The role organizes performance information, management processes, planning, and internal coordination to support accountability, timely delivery, decision-making, knowledge sharing and learning, and adaptive management. The Specialist also provides project management support to selected initiatives based on evolving needs and priorities.
The position is flexible within South America, preferably Brazil, or North America. Fluency in English is required; Portuguese proficiency is highly desired.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The ZCC Portfolio Management Specialist reports to the ZCC Strategy Associate Director and supports effective management, execution, performance and continuous improvement of the ZCC Strategy across the following areas:

1. Strategy Operations, Performance, and Learning

• Support effective strategy execution, performance management, learning, and adaptive management across the ZCC Strategy.

• Maintain the management systems and processes needed for coordination, performance visibility, and leadership decision-making.

• Support strategy operations and oversee relevant operational and administrative resources.

2. Portfolio and Project Management

• Provide portfolio and project management support to selected ZCC projects and strategic initiatives.

• Strengthen consistent and adaptive project management practices and portfolio-level visibility across the Strategy.

• Coordinate and guide project management resources as portfolio needs evolve.

RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

• Translate direction from the ZCC Strategy Associate Director and ZCC Strategy leadership into concrete work plans, milestones, management calendars, processes, and tools that enable coordinated execution across global program staff, functions, and country business units.

• Establish and maintain systems to track strategic objectives, KPIs, intermediate results, outcomes, annual milestones, and other agreed performance measures; coordinate timely data collection and promote consistency and analytical rigor across teams and regions.

• Lead the development, implementation, and continuous refinement of the Strategy’s monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) approach, aligned with the Strategy’s results chain, intermediate results, and assumptions.

• Manage and maintain the ZCC HUB and related strategy dashboards, ensuring that results, evidence, methodologies, and performance information are current, consistent, accessible, and decision-useful; work with relevant teams to address information and evidence gaps.

• Synthesize information from the HUB, MEL plan, quarterly milestone reporting, collaboration surveys, and other sources into clear presentations, briefings, dashboards, reports, and recommendations for leadership.

• Coordinate quarterly milestone reporting and other periodic strategy performance processes; identify and elevate significant progress, emerging issues, dependencies, risks, and critical-path considerations requiring leadership attention.

• Facilitate periodic learning and adaptive management discussions to assess progress, test assumptions, capture lessons, and inform potential adjustments to implementation.

• Develop and continuously improve strategy management tools, templates, presentations, dashboards, briefings, decision analyses, reporting processes, and good practices in collaboration with the ZCC Strategy Associate Director and Strategy leadership.

• Coordinate cross-cutting strategy operations, including annual and periodic work planning, management calendars, internal communications, knowledge sharing, contracts and agreements, and related administrative workflows.

• For selected projects and initiatives, establish and maintain fit-for-purpose project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risk registers, governance arrangements, meeting cadences, and reporting processes in collaboration with project leads and teams.

• Monitor selected projects against agreed plans and internal, donor, and contractual requirements; coordinate narrative reporting and key project management processes while preserving the accountability of project leads for project delivery and results.

• Support the identification and management of portfolio-level risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and capacity needs, and elevate issues requiring management attention.

• Promote consistent, adaptive, and collaborative project management practices across selected ZCC initiatives and contribute to strengthening project management capabilities across the portfolio.

• Provide day-to-day guidance, quality control, mentorship, and coordination for direct reports, particularly in structured thinking, analytical approaches, contracts, and administrative workflows; coordinate with dotted-line supervisors where applicable.

• Supervise administrative staff and, as the portfolio evolves, potentially supervise or coordinate additional project management resources assigned to selected ZCC initiatives.

• Build effective working relationships across functions, regions, and business units, communicating complex information clearly and influencing teams without relying solely on formal authority.

• Handle confidential and sensitive information with appropriate discretion.

• Travel domestically and internationally on occasion and work flexibly across time zones, as needed.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree and 5 years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.·

• At least 2 years of project management experience or 1 year acting as a project lead.·

• Completed coursework or other training in project management principles.·

• Experience managing and tracking projects with cross-functional teams using project management standards and tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Notion, Planner, Mural, or comparable software.·

• Experience developing management reports and presentation materials.· Experience supervising staff.·

• Fluency in English.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Multilingual skills and experience working across cultures.·

• Portuguese proficiency is highly desired·

• Experience facilitating virtual team meetings and working across different time zones.·

• Experience with Power BI.·

• Proficiency in interpreting guidelines and manipulating, analyzing, and interpreting data.·

• Project management certification.·

• Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, including the ability to negotiate, influence, and persuade.·

• Demonstrated success implementing strategic program goals.·

• Ability to work effectively from a home office.

Salary Information:

USA

In this role, you will help shape the visual mood, atmosphere, and storytelling impact of a feature animation project by partnering closely with creative and technical teams and contributing to work that meets a high bar for artistic and production quality.

As a Lighting Artist , you will play an essential role in bringing our animated worlds to life. In this role, you will help shape the visual mood, atmosphere, and storytelling impact of a feature animation project by partnering closely with creative and technical teams and contributing to work on various marketing materials that meet a high standard of artistic and production quality.

Responsibilities
Ce que vous ferez :

• Créer et affiner les configurations d’éclairage pour les personnages, les accessoires et les environnements dans Blender , en veillant à ce que les plans respectent la vision artistique, le style visuel et les objectifs narratifs du projet.

postings.title: Quantitative Trading Analyst (part-time, equity-only)
postings.descriptionText:
About Qompyl

Qompyl is an early-stage fintech startup building a no-code, mobile-first platform that enables users to create, backtest, analyze, and monitor trading strategies.
Our mission is to make sophisticated quantitative trading tools more intuitive, visual, and accessible. We help traders turn ideas into rules they can test, understand how indicators behave, and evaluate strategy performance.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Quantitative Trading Analyst to research indicators, build and backtest systematic trading strategies, and validate the financial logic behind Qompyl ’s tools.
You will turn trading ideas into explicit, testable rules, evaluate how those rules perform across different assets and market conditions, and investigate results that don’t match expectations. You will work closely with our Product and Trading teams to document what you find and turn it into improvements to our indicator library, Strategy Builder, and backtesting experience.
You will also engage with traders and beta users to understand how they use the platform, where they run into friction, and what would help them test and interpret their strategies more effectively.

Core Responsibilities

Indicator Research & Validation

• Research and develop indicators for Qompyl . Specify their formulas, inputs, parameters, signal rules, and expected behavior.

• Verify indicator calculations and outputs against reference calculations or known examples. Investigate discrepancies and edge cases, including insufficient data, missing values, and signal timing.

• Evaluate how indicators behave across assets, timeframes, and market regimes. Document their limitations and the conditions that affect how traders should interpret them.

• Work with Product and Trading to translate validated indicator logic into functionality that traders can use in the Strategy Builder.

Systematic Strategy Research & Backtesting

• Translate trading hypotheses into rule-based strategies with clear entry, exit, execution, and position-sizing logic. Build and test them in Qompyl ’s Strategy Builder.

• Analyze returns, P&L, drawdowns, volatility, and risk-adjusted performance in the context of the strategy’s objectives and assumptions.

• Review how fees, slippage, and execution assumptions affect results. Identify potential sources of bias, including look-ahead bias and overfitting.

• Assess whether results hold across different market regimes, parameter settings, and out-of-sample periods where appropriate.

• Investigate unexpected results to determine whether they stem from market behavior, strategy assumptions, data quality, or platform logic. Document the steps needed to reproduce findings and propose improvements.

Product & Trader Collaboration

• Bring quantitative findings and a trader’s perspective to decisions about new indicators, Strategy Builder features, and how Qompyl presents backtest results.

• Engage with traders and beta users to understand how they formulate strategies, interpret metrics, and use the platform.

• Translate recurring questions and pain points into proposals for indicators, product improvements, or educational resources.

• Explain indicator behavior, performance metrics, and backtest limitations clearly to both traders and non-technical teammates.

Required Skills & Experience

• Practical knowledge of financial markets and trading mechanics, including order logic, position sizing, risk, returns, P&L, and drawdowns.

• Hands-on experience developing and backtesting systematic, rules-based trading strategies using historical market data.

• Ability to define and validate quantitative indicators or trading signals, including how they are calculated and when they trigger.

• Ability to interpret performance metrics, assess the assumptions behind a backtest, and identify results that warrant further investigation.

• Ability to document methodology, results, and limitations so others can reproduce your work and act on it.

• Strong communication skills and an interest in working with traders and product teams in a remote, asynchronous startup.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience using Python, Pine Script, SQL, or similar tools to analyze market data, prototype indicators, or independently verify calculations.

• Familiarity with TradingView or other strategy-building and backtesting platforms.

• Experience working across asset classes such as equities, ETFs, futures, forex, cryptocurrencies, or other derivatives.

• Experience contributing to a fintech or trading product, or supporting a community of traders.

Working Style & Culture
You enjoy following a trading idea from hypothesis to test results, investigating why something behaves unexpectedly, and making your findings clear enough for others to use. You take ownership of your work, are comfortable challenging assumptions, and collaborate with a globally distributed team as Qompyl ’s product and community evolve.

Time Commitment & Compensation
This is a fully remote, part-time role requiring approximately 12–15 hours per week, with scheduling flexibility.
Compensation is currently equity-only. Our goal is to introduce cash compensation alongside equity as Qompyl reaches key funding, product, and business milestones.

Join Nortal for your next big adventure. We are seeking Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our team, grow with us, and teach us a few things along the way.

Why join Nortal

•
Say Goodbye to Micromanagement: We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.

•
Outcomes Over Hours: We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being.

•
Vibrant Community: Join our close-knit LATAM remote team and connect through tech talks, virtual coffee breaks, and team-building activities.

•
Support from Day One: Our People Care team is here to support you throughout your journey, from wellness check-ins to professional growth.

Our benefits ✨

• Competitive USD salary.

•
100% remote work: While you can work from anywhere, you’re always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM.

•
Paid time off & national holidays: Take the time you need according to your country’s regulations while receiving your full salary.

•
Sick leave: Focus on your health without stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better.

•
Annual credit: Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance.

•
Team-building activities: Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community.

•
Birthday off: Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family.

About the project
We’re looking for a senior, hands-on Site Reliability Engineer to help modernize and scale a business-critical customer-data caching platform. The platform supports more than 20 consuming applications across frontend and backend tools and currently handles approximately 3,000 requests per second.
You’ll work with SRE, DevOps, engineering, architecture, and client-side teams to improve reliability, performance, automation, observability, and deployment practices. The team is working toward substantially higher traffic capacity, stronger resilience, and more repeatable operations. Success requires technical depth, independence, and the initiative to identify and move forward on work with limited direction.

What you’ll do

• Design, build, and operate highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems and caching platforms.

• Assess the existing architecture and identify ways to scale toward six times current traffic while protecting performance and reliability.

• Improve caching strategies, including TTLs, refresh patterns, cache placement, performance, and downstream dependency management.

• Help evolve the platform toward active-active resiliency and validate failure, recovery, and capacity scenarios.

• Design and implement automated CI/CD pipelines with appropriate rolling, blue/green, or canary deployments, checks, and quality gates.

• Establish version-controlled, automated practices for infrastructure, configuration, secrets, and application deployments.

• Build performance and load-testing capabilities and define meaningful performance gates for releases.

• Improve monitoring, alerting, and observability for latency, throughput, availability, errors, and other reliability indicators.

• Define and improve SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and operational KPIs where appropriate.

• Automate operational work and reduce manual intervention through scripting, tooling, and infrastructure automation.

• Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive reliability improvements through blameless post-incident reviews.

• Provide technical guidance and practical engineering guardrails to SRE and development teams.

• Collaborate with Java/Spring Boot engineers, architects, client-side engineers, and other technical teams.

• Take ownership of ambiguous problems, identify useful work, explain technical decisions, and make progress without close day-to-day direction.

• Take part in Nortal 's Technical Interviewer Program, conducting technical interviews for your account and other accounts to help build the teams behind Nortal 's growth.

What makes you a great fit

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field

• Strong experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or a similar production infrastructure role.

• Experience operating and scaling distributed systems in production.

• Strong understanding of caching architectures, performance optimization, and high-availability systems.

• Hands-on AWS experience and familiarity with cloud-native architecture.

• Experience designing and implementing automated CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies for highly available systems.

• Experience with infrastructure, configuration, and secrets as code, with a preference for automated and repeatable processes.

• Strong understanding of observability, monitoring, alerting, performance metrics, and production troubleshooting.

• Experience with performance testing, capacity planning, and identifying system bottlenecks.

• Strong programming or scripting skills for automation and tooling.

• Ability to work independently, take ownership of ambiguous technical problems, and move work forward with limited direction.

• Ability to provide technical guidance and establish practical engineering standards within a small team.

• Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.
We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.
Apply now and let’s shape the future of technology together! 🧑‍💻

postings.title: Financial Crime Expert
postings.descriptionText:
Description

Financial Crime Expert

Argentina, Brazil
We are seeking an experienced Financial Crime Expert with deep subject-matter expertise in Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CFT), sanctions compliance, and financial crime risk management. In this role, you will partner with customers, compliance leaders, risk teams, and internal technical stakeholders to design, configure, validate, and optimize financial crime detection solutions.
The successful candidate will translate complex regulatory requirements and business objectives into effective transaction monitoring strategies, detection scenarios, AI-driven models, and risk-based controls. This role requires a combination of regulatory expertise, analytical thinking, model validation experience, and customer advisory capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Compliance & Advisory

• Serve as a subject-matter expert on global AML/CFT and sanctions regulations, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, EU AML Directives, OFAC requirements, and other applicable regulatory frameworks.

• Provide guidance to customers on regulatory expectations, financial crime risks, and effective compliance monitoring strategies.

• Support customers in aligning monitoring programs with regulatory obligations and industry best practices.

Financial Crime Detection & Risk Management

• Apply deep knowledge of money laundering, fraud, sanctions evasion, terrorist financing, and emerging financial crime typologies to enhance detection capabilities.

• Assess customer risk profiles and identify gaps in existing monitoring frameworks and controls.

• Evaluate detection coverage and recommend enhancements to improve effectiveness and mitigate financial crime risks.

Transaction Monitoring & Solution Optimization

• Translate business, operational, and regulatory requirements into transaction monitoring scenarios, sanctions screening rules, alert thresholds, and AI-driven detection models.

• Configure and optimize monitoring solutions to improve risk coverage, investigative efficiency, and alert quality.

• Support continuous enhancement of detection strategies based on evolving threats, regulatory changes, and customer requirements.

Model Validation & Performance Analysis

• Conduct model testing, validation, back-testing, and Above-the-Line/Below-the-Line (ATL/BTL) analysis to evaluate model effectiveness.

• Analyze detection performance, false-positive rates, and alert quality to improve monitoring outcomes.

• Validate AI and analytics-driven financial crime detection models and recommend tuning adjustments to enhance performance.

Banking & Payments Expertise

• Apply knowledge of banking operations, customer behavior, and payment processing workflows to support effective transaction monitoring.

• Utilize expertise in payment messaging standards and banking data structures, including SWIFT, ISO 20022, ACH, and wire transfers.

• Collaborate with technical teams to ensure accurate ingestion, mapping, and interpretation of financial transaction data.

Documentation & Model Governance

• Develop Model Methodology Guides (MMGs), model validation reports, risk assessments, and governance documentation.

• Ensure compliance with Model Risk Management (MRM) frameworks, validation standards, audit requirements, and internal governance processes.

• Support regulatory reviews, internal audits, and customer documentation needs.

Customer Engagement & Stakeholder Management

• Act as a trusted advisor to customer compliance, risk, and financial crime teams.

• Present findings, recommendations, validation results, and risk assessments to business and executive stakeholders.

• Lead workshops and discussions on financial crime trends, detection effectiveness, regulatory expectations, and monitoring best practices.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with Compliance, Risk, First Line of Defense (1LoD), Second Line of Defense (2LoD), Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Customer Success teams.

• Support the design, implementation, validation, and continuous optimization of financial crime detection solutions.

• Contribute to product enhancements and innovation initiatives focused on AML, sanctions screening, and transaction monitoring.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in AML, CFT, sanctions compliance, financial crime risk management, transaction monitoring, or regulatory compliance.

• Strong knowledge of global AML/CFT regulations and sanctions frameworks, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, EU AML Directives, and OFAC requirements.

• Deep understanding of financial crime typologies, including money laundering, sanctions evasion, fraud, terrorist financing, and suspicious transaction behaviors.

• Hands-on experience with transaction monitoring systems, sanctions screening platforms, detection scenarios, and AI-driven monitoring solutions.

• Proven experience in model testing, tuning, validation, back-testing, and ATL/BTL analysis.

• Strong understanding of banking products, financial transaction data, payment systems, and messaging standards, including SWIFT, ISO 20022, ACH, and wire transfers.

• Experience conducting financial crime risk assessments and evaluating monitoring and detection coverage.

• Knowledge of Model Risk Management (MRM), model governance frameworks, validation methodologies, and audit requirements.

• Experience creating Model Methodology Guides (MMGs), validation reports, risk assessments, and audit-ready documentation.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

• Excellent customer-facing communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management abilities.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with compliance, risk, business, data science, and technical teams.

• Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken, are required.

Preferred Qualifications

• CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist), CGSS, CFE, ICA, or equivalent financial crime certifications.

• Experience working within banks, fintech companies, payment providers, consulting firms, or financial crime technology vendors.

• Familiarity with machine learning, AI-powered risk detection, and model governance frameworks.

• Experience supporting regulatory examinations, independent validations, and model risk reviews.

• Knowledge of customer risk rating methodologies, KYC, CDD, EDD, sanctions screening, and adverse media monitoring.

Why Join Us?
You will work alongside a global team of technology and financial crime professionals helping leading financial institutions strengthen their AML, sanctions, and transaction monitoring capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to influence innovative AI-powered compliance solutions, partner directly with customers, and contribute to the evolution of financial crime detection technology.
Matrix is a global technology services and consulting company with over 17,000 employees worldwide. We specialize in the design, development, and implementation of advanced technologies, software solutions, and digital products across industries including Finance, Healthcare, Telecom, High Tech, Defense, and Security.
At Matrix, our people are at the center of our success. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional development.
Join a winning team where your expertise will help organizations combat financial crime, improve compliance effectiveness, and drive meaningful business impact.
Learn more: www.matrix-ifs.com

About the Role
Seamless Assist is hiring a part-time Academic Coach & Student Assistant for a US-based family. You will work one-on-one, online, with their daughter, a motivated high-school student taking classes a year ahead of her grade, including several college-level Advanced Placement (AP) courses. This role reports to the student's parent.

Why This Role Exists
The student doesn't need to be taught from scratch. She is carrying a demanding, writing-heavy course load, and the pressure is in the volume: essays, problem sets, labs, tests and extracurricular deadlines all landing in the same week. This role exists to give her a sharp, organised partner who can keep up with advanced material, help her work through the hardest parts, and keep her schedule under control so nothing slips.

Her Current Classes

• AP Microeconomics & Macroeconomics

• AP Biology

• AP English Language & Composition

• AP US History

• Pre-Calculus

• Spanish 4

• Journalism & News Production

You don't need to be an expert in every subject. You do need to be strong in several of them, especially writing-heavy courses (AP English Language, AP US History) and at least one of economics, biology or maths.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Academic coaching (about 70% of your time)

• Run live one-on-one video sessions to work through homework, problem sets, essays and test preparation.

• Explain difficult concepts clearly and check that she can explain them back.

• Review essays and written work for argument, structure, evidence and citations, including AP-style timed essays.

• Build practice questions, review plans and study guides ahead of tests and the AP exams in May.

• Learn how each course is taught and graded (syllabi, teacher rubrics, the College Board AP course frameworks) and coach to them.

• Coach, never complete. Her work must always be her own, in line with her school's academic integrity rules.

Planning and student assistant support (about 30% of your time)

• Run a weekly planning session: map every class's assignments, tests and deadlines into a shared calendar and task list.

• Keep her schedule current across classes, activities and appointments, with study time blocked in.

• Send short reminders before deadlines and confirm work was actually submitted.

• Track grades and flag early when something starts to slip.

• Send the parent a short weekly progress update.

Schedule
About 10 hours per week. Sessions fall on weekday afternoons and evenings, US Pacific Time (roughly 3:30–8:30 pm PT), plus one short weekend planning session. You must be reliably available in that window.

Who Will Succeed in This Role
This is a high-trust role with a bright, busy teenager. You will need real subject depth, patience, and the organisational discipline of a strong executive assistant.

• You explain things clearly and can tell the difference between "I get it" and actually getting it.

• You are a strong writer and can give specific, useful feedback on an argumentative essay.

• You run your own life from a calendar and a task list, and you follow up without being asked.

• You are warm, steady and encouraging, and you hold a high standard.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree or higher, ideally in education, English, history, economics, biology, mathematics or a related field.

• At least 2 years of tutoring or teaching high-school or first-year university students.

• Strong command of the material in several of the subjects listed above.

• Excellent written and spoken English. Your writing will be assessed during screening.

• Uses AI tools in your daily work (for example Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini) to build study materials and plan faster, and can teach a student to use them responsibly and within school rules.

• Able to work US Pacific Time afternoons and evenings, about 10 hours per week.

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a webcam and a backup power or internet plan.

• Willing to complete a national police clearance or background check and provide two professional references before starting.

Nice to have

• Experience with the US Advanced Placement (AP) programme, or strong AP, SAT, IB or A-Level results of your own.

• Conversational or better Spanish.

• Journalism, editing or newsroom experience.

• Comfortable in Google Workspace (Calendar, Docs, Drive) and a task tool such as Notion or Todoist.

How We Work
Because this role involves working one-on-one with a teenager, clear safeguards apply. All sessions run on a family-owned video account and are recorded. All messages go through a group channel that includes a parent. There is no private messaging or social-media contact with the student. A background check and references are required before the first paid session.

Pay
Competitive hourly pay, paid monthly in USD. Pay varies by country.

How to Apply
Apply with your CV. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short AI-led video interview, a written subject task, an interview with the family and a paid trial session.

Smartphone

The role
We are hiring a Customer Service Manager to lead uPhone's support operation.
Travellers contact us when they are about to fly, when they have just landed, or when a plan will not activate. - Lead day-to-day customer service across live chat and email, including coverage planning for 24/7 support, on a small remote team.
- Set and track service standards (response time, resolution time, quality, refund accuracy, and tone). Protect the published typical response time of under two minutes, or recommend an honest change if that standard cannot be met.
- Coach and develop support staff, including onboarding, macros and quality reviews, feedback, and performance management, and contribute to hiring as the team grows.
- Own the support knowledge base and macros so answers about installation, device compatibility, coverage, top-ups, refunds, and troubleshooting stay accurate as plans and policies change.
- Handle and escalate complex cases: failed activations, APN or device issues, carrier locks, payment or refund disputes, and supplier outages — and make sure travellers are not left mid-trip without a path to a fix.
- Apply the 30-day unused-eSIM refund policy consistently (full refund only if the QR code has not been scanned and the eSIM has not been installed or activated; installed or activated eSIMs are non-refundable even if no data was used), and flag edge cases.
- Report volume, themes, and product or supplier issues to the rest of the team, and propose changes that reduce repeat contacts.
- Use the team's live-chat, email, and knowledge-base tools to keep quality and reporting consistent.
Requirements
- Experience leading or supervising a customer service or support team, preferably in a 24/7, chat-and-email, or travel / e-commerce / telecom environment.
- Able to design rotas, quality standards, and simple processes that still work when the team is small and remote.
- Excellent written English and a calm, precise tone with customers who may be stressed or offline at an airport.
- Strong judgement on refunds, policy exceptions, and when to escalate a technical or supplier issue.
- Comfortable being hands-on with tickets as well as managing the function.
- You can be based anywhere in the world; there is no country restriction. You should have the legal right to work from where you live. Because support is 24/7, you should be comfortable coordinating coverage across time zones.
Nice-to-haves
- Experience with eSIM, mobile connectivity, travel, or consumer marketplaces.
- Additional languages, especially those used by travellers in Europe and Asia.
- Experience running QA, help-centre content, or support-to-product feedback loops.
- Familiarity with support platforms and reporting (for example live chat, a shared inbox, or an ITSM / helpdesk tool).
- Experience handling payments, chargebacks, or refund operations.
What we offer
- This is a fully remote, full-time role. You can work from anywhere in the world; there is no country restriction.
- Flexible hours, with the coordination needed to cover 24/7 support across time zones.
- Travel perks, as described on uPhone's careers page.
- Real ownership and impact on a small team, with little unnecessary process.
- Competitive pay, negotiable based on experience.
Reference: UPH-CSM-2611
How to apply
Email . Applications sent without the code word in the subject line will not be considered — this is how we check that candidates follow directions.
How to find the code word
1. Search uPhone eSIM on Google.
2. Open the official site, ().
3. Go to the About Us () page.
4. Find the code word on that page.
5. Put that exact word in your email subject line.
Subject line format: UPH-CSM-2611 — Customer Service Manager — [code word from the About Us page]
Please include
- A short note on why you want to work at uPhone, and what you would do in this role.
- Your CV / résumé (PDF).
- Optional: a LinkedIn profile, portfolio, or relevant work samples.
Do not ask us to tell you the code word. If you have followed the steps above, you will have it.

If you want to be part of a company that values work-life balance and supports your professional development, you’re in the right place.

Our Core Values

• Put our Talent first

• Pursuit of excellence/continuous learning

• Integrity and transparency

• Ownership mentality

The Ideal Candidate
You have advanced English proficiency at a C1 or C2 level and value work-life balance and remote flexibility. A remote HR Coordinator will support employee lifecycle operations by executing onboarding/offboarding workflows, maintaining accurate HR records, and ensuring HR processes are completed consistently and on time. This role is operational and detail-heavy, requiring strong documentation skills, confidentiality, and the ability to coordinate across employees, managers, and HR leadership in a remote setting.While your duties will depend on the specific needs of your client, they will include, but not be limited to:

• Respond to routine HR inquiries by providing accurate information, routing complex cases to HR leadership, and ensuring employees receive timely, professional responses.

• Support benefits administration coordination by tracking eligibility changes, enrollment deadlines, and documentation needs, ensuring employees understand next steps.

Please note that devices such as MacBook Neos and Chromebooks are not fit for our roles.

•
After 3 years: Salary increases to $1,540 USD/month

Two Annual Adjustments: Every year, you benefit from two salary increases: one on your work anniversary, recognizing your continued tenure with WorkBetterNow, and one at the start of each calendar year, when all salary ranges are updated company-wide.

postings.descriptionText:
WHO WE ARE
Seagull Software , LLC, is a global leader in real-time, item-level visibility and label management solutions, dedicated to powering the world’s most complex supply chains with innovative tools for traceability, authentication, and automated inventory management. Our BarTender™️ platform enables businesses across all industries to design, manage, print, and automate the production of labels, barcodes, and RFID tags, ensuring seamless tracking and compliance for over 100 billion unique identifiers each year. Leveraging the Mojix™️ high-security, scalable SaaS traceability platform, Seagull delivers end-to-end intelligence, harmonizing data to drive operational efficiency, enhance customer experiences, and reduce risk. Learn more at
We’re a growing, profitable, mid-size business with a nearly 40-year history of leading in our field. Headquartered in Redmond, Washington, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia, Seagull empowers businesses worldwide to keep their products moving, traceable, and safe.  You’ll work with global, talented, and diverse teams, passionate about what they do and its impact on everyone, everywhere.  Join us and help shape the way the world works.
LOCATION

This direct contractor position is remote from LATAM, working for a US company and requires both written and verbal English fluency.

WHO YOU ARE

You are detail-oriented, analytical problem solver who enjoys building practical processes, improving data quality, and turning sales data into clear insights. You are fluent in English and work well with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations partners, communicate findings clearly, and are comfortable learning new systems in a fast-paced global SaaS environment.

JOB SUMMARY

The Sales Analyst supports the day-to-day operating rhythm of Seagull’s sales organization. The role builds and maintains reporting, performs recurring and ad hoc analysis, improves sales processes and data quality, and provides reliable insights that help sales teams make informed decisions across the customer lifecycle for our subscription and license customers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Key responsibilities of the Sales Analyst include:
•
Sales Planning and Forecasting Support

• Forecasting Support: Maintain forecast templates, consolidate pipeline inputs, analyze historical trends, and highlight changes, risks, and data gaps for review by Sales and Finance leaders.

• Target and Territory Analysis: Prepare data and analysis used to support sales targets, quotas, territories, and capacity planning.

• Planning Models: Build and maintain practical models for pipeline coverage, bookings, revenue, renewals, and sales productivity.

• Revenue Risk Analysis: Identify potential contraction, churn, or forecast risks and support root-cause analysis with clear, actionable data.

•
Sales Operating Rhythm and Collaboration

• Operating Cadence: Prepare recurring weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales reports, meeting materials, and follow-up trackers.

• Cross-Functional Support: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Operations to gather requirements, validate data, and deliver analysis and process improvements.

• Documentation and Follow-Through: Document definitions, workflows, decisions, and action items to improve consistency and accountability.

•
Data Management and Analytics

• Data Quality: Monitor CRM and related data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency; investigate issues and coordinate corrections with process owners.

• Data Analysis: Analyze pipeline, bookings, revenue, retention, and customer data to identify trends, variances, and business drivers.

• Reporting and Dashboards: Provide the BI team with business requirements to build, maintain, and improve recurring reports and dashboards that provide clear visibility into sales performance and key SaaS metrics.

• Business Insights: Summarize findings in concise presentations and written updates tailored to business stakeholders.

•
Performance Management

• KPI Monitoring: Track funnel conversion, pipeline coverage, sales velocity, win rates, productivity, customer acquisition cost, churn, and retention metrics.

• Variance Analysis: Compare actual performance with targets, forecasts, prior periods, and relevant benchmarks; explain key drivers.

• Continuous Improvement: Recommend practical improvements to reports, metrics, and workflows based on recurring analysis and stakeholder feedback.

•
Process Optimization

• Workflow Improvement: Map current sales and customer-success workflows, identify manual steps or control gaps, and help implement simpler, more scalable processes.

• Process Standardization: Create and maintain process documentation, templates, definitions, and standard operating procedures.

• Sales Enablement Support: Build simple tools, reference materials, and reporting views that help sales teams use processes and systems effectively.

•
Sales Technology and Automation

• CRM and Tools: Support day-to-day use of Salesforce and related sales tools by testing reports, documenting requirements, and helping troubleshoot data or workflow issues. Partner with the BI team so the single source of truth is clear and well-defined.

• System Support: Work with Operations and BI teams to validate integrations and ensure data moves accurately across platforms.

• Automation: Build or support lightweight automation for recurring reports, data preparation, quality checks, and routine workflows.

•
Customer Lifecycle Management

• Customer Lifecycle Analysis: Analyze customer acquisition, onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion, and retention data.

• Renewal and Expansion Support: Maintain tracking and reporting that helps account teams prioritize upcoming renewals and expansion opportunities.

• Churn Analysis: Support analysis of churn and contraction drivers, including recurring root-cause reporting and data validation.

•
Compliance and Risk Management

• Data and Process Compliance: Follow established controls and data handling practices.

• Risk Identification: Flag material data issues, process gaps, and revenue risks to the appropriate business owners.

WHAT WE REQUIRE

• 2–4 years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, business analytics, FP&A, or a related analytical role; Subscription software experience is required.

• Strong analytical skills, with experience working with sales, pipelines, bookings, revenue, or customer data.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel; experience building repeatable models and analyses.

• Working knowledge of Salesforce or another CRM, including reports, dashboards, and core data structures.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English is required.

• Experience with business intelligence or data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik) is highly desired

• Ability to translate business questions into structured analysis and communicate findings clearly.

• Identify and implement process improvements that increase operational efficiency and productivity, including the practical use of AI tools.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, and ownership of recurring deliverables.

• Comfort working through ambiguity, learning new tools, and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Collaborative working style and willingness to perform hands-on data, reporting, documentation, and process-building work.

• Be adaptable, take ownership of deliverables, and build practical, scalable solutions that get results.

EDUCATION
• Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, analytics, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

TERMS OF CONTRACT

• This is a direct contractor position and therefore not eligible for benefits.

• Prior to the start of your contract, you must provide documentation proving authorization to work as an independent contractor (self-employed) as well as a Police Clearance Certificate.

OUR CULTURE

We offer a dynamic, culturally diverse, and fun environment where people with energy, creativity, and passion work together to deliver amazing product experiences for our customers. Join a team where your background is valued and respected, and your unique insights and ideas contribute to building a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Seagull Software , LLC, is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of recruiting and employment.

postings.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Remote, Latin America (minimum 4-hour overlap with US Eastern hours) | Engineering | Reports to: Technical Lead
Time Doctor is hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to run and scale the cloud infrastructure behind our platform. Most of it runs on Google Cloud, with our main workloads on Cloud Run, all defined in Terraform across 40+ environments. Some legacy systems still run on AWS. Your job is to keep it secure, available and quick to change, and to give our DevOps coverage a base in the Americas so that issues during US business hours have an owner in the room.

Who we are
Time Doctor is a workforce analytics platform that gives distributed teams the visibility they need to improve trust and performance. We serve remote, hybrid and outsourced organisations worldwide, with particular strength in BPO, healthcare and tech services. We are bootstrapped, profitable and fully remote, with team members across 30+ countries. We built a durable business on customer revenue rather than venture capital, and we are now focused on growing it.

The role
You will design, build and operate the infrastructure behind our production, staging, sandbox and customer-specific deployments. You own it hands-on, from Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines to monitoring, security and your place on the on-call roster.

Three things define this seat.

• The platform. Google Cloud is home. Our main workloads run on Cloud Run, alongside GKE, Cloud Functions, Cloud Build, VPC networking, Cloud Armor and Load Balancers, all managed as code. You need real depth on a major cloud. If that depth is on AWS or Azure, we expect it to carry over to GCP quickly.

• The coverage. Our DevOps team works from time zones a long way from most of our customers. This seat exists to cover US Eastern hours, which is why we are hiring in Latin America.

• The operating model. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and automation by default. If a task gets done twice, it gets scripted.

Who you are

• You treat production as yours. When something breaks, you own it until it is fixed and written up.

• You design, not just build. You pick the right services for each workload, with cost and security in mind, and you can explain the trade-offs.

• You stay calm in an incident and you are clear in the follow-up afterwards.

• You think in modules and environments, not one-off changes.

• You automate repetitive work in Bash, Python or Go.

• You care about security: least-privilege access, secrets in Secret Manager, nothing sensitive in code.

• You communicate clearly in English, live and async.

• You are organised and self-directed. You thrive fully remote.

What you will own

• Infrastructure as code. Terraform across 40+ environments, reusable modules that follow DRY principles, and multi-environment management through GitOps workflows and Terraform Cloud.

• GCP services. Cloud Run, where our main workloads run, plus GKE, Cloud Functions, Cloud Build, VPC networking, Cloud Armor and Cloud Load Balancers. Debugging serverless services in production is part of the job.

• CI/CD. Pipelines in GitHub Actions, Helm or Cloud Deploy that let our engineers ship safely and often.

• Data infrastructure. Redis (Cloud Memorystore) for caching, session management and real-time features.

• Security. IAM, Secret Manager and our security services, and acting on what security scans find.

• Observability and on-call. Proactive monitoring and alerting with GCP Monitoring, Grafana and similar tools, and a place on the on-call support roster.

• Our AWS footprint. Keeping the legacy systems we still run on AWS stable.

This role may not suit you if

• You've touched many cloud services but haven't designed and run production infrastructure end to end yourself.

• You prefer clicking through a console to defining infrastructure as code.

• You want to work purely async. This seat needs real overlap with US Eastern hours.

• You are not willing to be part of an on-call roster.

• You need detailed direction before you can move.

What a realistic week looks like
A Terraform module refactor that lets a new customer-specific environment come up from a pull request. A pipeline change that cuts deploy time. A secret moved out of code and into Secret Manager without breaking the services that read it. An alert tuned so it fires before customers notice anything. A handover with teammates in New Zealand, and live collaboration during US Eastern hours.

Requirements

Your experience

• 5+ years of hands-on DevOps experience running production cloud environments, including designing infrastructure yourself, not only building to someone else's design.

• Deep production experience on at least one major cloud, ideally Google Cloud. That includes running and debugging serverless container workloads (Cloud Run, or an equivalent such as AWS ECS Fargate or Azure Container Apps), Kubernetes, VPC networking, load balancing, IAM and secrets management.

• Terraform for complex multi-environment setups, including writing your own modules.

• CI/CD with tools such as GitHub Actions, Helm or Cloud Deploy.

• Scripting in Bash, Python or Go to automate infrastructure work.

• Setting up proactive monitoring and observability with GCP Monitoring, Grafana or similar tools.

• Fluent English for technical discussions and incident calls.

• A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Based in Latin America, with at least four hours of daily overlap with US Eastern hours, and available for the on-call roster.

Nice to have

• Google Cloud as your main production platform.

•
AWS experience, for our legacy systems.

•
Terraform Cloud and GitOps workflows.

• Google Cloud certifications, such as Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.

• Experience running customer-specific or single-tenant deployments for a B2B SaaS product.

The team you are joining
You will report to our Technical Lead and join a small DevOps team working from other time zones, including New Zealand. You will be the team's first member in the Americas, and you will work closely with the engineering teams who rely on the platform every day.

How we will measure success

• Platform availability and incident response during your coverage hours.

• Infrastructure changes delivered as code: reviewed, repeatable and documented.

•
Faster, safer deployments through CI/CD.

• A stronger security posture across secrets, access and scan findings.

• Less manual work because of the automation you build.

Why this role

• You own real production infrastructure for a SaaS platform used by thousands of organisations.

• A modern GCP stack, all in Terraform, across 40+ environments.

• We are profitable and bootstrapped. Your budget comes from customers, not from a burn rate.

• Professional development resources and a learning budget.

• Fully remote and flexible, working with talented people in 30+ countries.

Our hiring approach
This is a full-time, 100% remote role. We are an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability.
We hire globally, and this particular role requires you to be based in Latin America with at least four hours of daily overlap with US Eastern hours. Our Talent Attraction team will walk you through the details during your first conversation.
Learn more about us at

At PlanITROI, the opportunity goes beyond producing accurate financial statements: you will lead the accounting team, tackle difficult problems, and help talented people grow into bigger roles. We want a technically strong, highly organized leader who takes pride in reliable reporting and gets real satisfaction from improving how work gets done.
Your first move will be to get close to the work: learn our operations, see what works, and find the gaps yourself. Then you will put that understanding to work by standardizing processes, strengthening controls, introducing practical AI and automation, and coaching teammates to run the function with confidence.
The measure of success is simple: a stronger team and better systems that keep performing without the Controller having to do everything personally.
This is a remote role based in Latin America, working U.S. Eastern Standard Time.
