postings.descriptionText:
Grow our AI image service.
Before you apply, spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital . Answers that could be about any company will not pass.

The role
We are Drop Zero Digital , a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.
You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

• The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.

• Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.
This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.
We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

• You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.

• You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.

• You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.

• You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.

• You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.

• You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience
We do not ask for a number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.
Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

• Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.

• A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.

• A 15 minute call with the founder.

• A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.

• Aptitude tests. These inform us, they do not decide.

• A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

• Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.

• Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.

• Strong written English.

• Based in Argentina.

• You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits
2100 USD per month from day one, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

On top of that:

• A one-month annual bonus.

• 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.

• Paid sick leave.

• A health allowance.

• A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

postings.title: Medical Records Clerk | LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
All candidates from LATAM countries are welcome to apply!!!

About the Role
You’ll take ownership of medical records and billing requests, from initial submission through follow-up, receipt, and review. This role supports the documentation needs of our personal injury practice, helping case teams obtain the information required for demand preparation. You’ll manage your assigned requests independently, work through provider delays, and coordinate with department leads and case managers to close documentation gaps. Working hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. PST.

Responsibilities

• Obtain medical records and itemized bills from U.S. hospitals, physicians, clinics, and other healthcare providers to support complete case documentation.

• Prepare and submit HIPAA-compliant records requests and authorizations with the information providers need to process them.

• Keep outstanding requests moving through consistent outbound calls and follow-ups, identifying next steps when providers are unresponsive or records are delayed.

• Maintain accurate request statuses, follow-up dates, and case notes in internal tracking tools and spreadsheets so pending items remain visible.

• Review incoming records and bills for completeness, accuracy, and relevance to the client’s accident and treatment.

• Resolve missing records, billing discrepancies, and incomplete documentation by coordinating corrections with healthcare providers.

• Help prepare cases for the demand stage by ensuring required medical records and billing documentation are available.

• Keep records department leads, case managers, and other internal teams informed of progress, delays, and unresolved documentation needs.

• Meet departmental productivity and quality standards while prioritizing a high volume of requests and follow-up deadlines.

• Assist with opening claims and related administrative processes as needed, keeping supporting information accurate and organized.

Requirements

Must-Have:

• Prior hands-on experience requesting and retrieving medical records and medical bills from U.S. healthcare providers.

• Working knowledge of medical records retrieval processes, including HIPAA authorizations and confidential information handling.

• Strong written and spoken English, with confidence making frequent outbound calls to U.S. medical offices, hospitals, and insurance-related contacts.

• Demonstrated ability to manage high volumes of requests, prioritize deadlines, maintain accurate records, and follow through independently until completion.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and digital tracking systems, with the attention to detail needed to identify missing documentation and billing discrepancies.

• Availability to work full-time remotely during the stated 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. PST schedule.

Nice to Have:

• Experience supporting California-based personal injury law firms.

• Familiarity with medical billing, liens, and subrogation.

• Experience using ProScan or similar medical records retrieval platforms.

• Experience using Filevine, CASEpeer, or other legal case management software.

• Experience opening insurance claims and navigating medical provider billing processes.

We're looking for a Customer Success Specialist who genuinely enjoys working with people, understands sales and knows how to build strong customer relationships.
iClosed is a profit maximizer for high-ticket sales teams, helping them capture more leads, book more calls, and close more deals. We work with customers like Hyros.com, Iman Gadzhi, Whop, Instantly.ai, and thousands of users.
As we grow, we're expanding our Customer Success team to make sure our customers don't just use iClosed , but actually get great results and grow their businesses with us.

What You'll Own

Onboarding & Success Calls

• Lead customer onboarding and success calls, helping teams get set up and see value in iClosed .

Retention

• Reach out to canceled and at-risk accounts, understand what is going wrong, and work toward a meaningful resolution.

• Follow up on failed and overdue payments before they become avoidable account interruptions.

Expansion

• Help customers navigate plan questions, expansion opportunities, and add-ons such as Multi-Booking.

Coordination & Account Notes

• Spot recurring blockers, coordinate with Support and Billing, and keep every customer follow-up moving.

• Keep accurate account notes so the next person always knows what happened and what comes next.

Who We're Looking For

Required

• At least two years of experience in SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, or a similarly customer-facing role.

• Comfortable having difficult conversations about churn, price, missed expectations, or overdue payments.

• Able to understand a new software workflow, ask useful questions, and explain the next step without drowning people in technical detail.

• You follow through. When you say you will check something and get back to a customer, you own it.

• Familiarity with CRM tools and automations (HubSpot, Close, Pipedrive, Zapier, Make, Stripe, etc.).

• Experience running onboarding demos or building retention processes.

Success in This Role

• New customers are set up quickly and see real value in iClosed early.

• At-risk and canceled accounts get a fast, thoughtful response and a clear path forward.

• Failed and overdue payments are resolved before they turn into account interruptions.

• Customers are on the plan and add-ons that fit how they actually sell.

• Every account has clear, up-to-date notes, so nothing gets lost between teams.

What We Offer

• Work directly with a growing team and make a meaningful difference for our customers.

• A fully remote role with a flexible working environment.

• Performance bonuses and opportunities for growth.

• Competitive compensation and the opportunity for long-term collaboration.

Why is this one different?
You're not here to close tickets. You're the person customers trust to make iClosed work for their sales team, from the first onboarding call to the conversation that saves an account.
Nail it, and you'll become a key part of how iClosed keeps and grows its customers.
We would love to see how you think, communicate, and take ownership. Apply and show us what great Customer Success looks like! As part of your application, we'll ask for a short 2-3 minute Loom video.

postings.descriptionText:
Fundada en 2004, OLIVER es la primera y única empresa del mundo especializada en diseñar, crear y gestionar agencias internas, como así también ecosistemas de marketing a medida para las distintas marcas con las que trabajamos. Actualmente, contamos en nuestro haber con más de 300 clientes, situados en más de 40 países. Nuestro modelo único impulsa la creatividad y la eficiencia, lo que nos permite ofrecer soluciones personalizadas que impactan de forma positiva en el público.

Como parte de The Brandtech Group, estamos a la vanguardia del desarrollo de la tecnología a través de la IA más avanzada para revolucionar la forma en que creamos y realizamos nuestro trabajo. Nuestras soluciones de IA mejoran la eficiencia, despiertan la creatividad e impulsan la toma de decisiones acertadas, lo que permite a nuestros equipos producir resultados innovadores e impactantes.

Sobre OLIVER

Somos una agencia de marketing y creatividad que trabaja como extensión del equipo de marcas líderes en el mundo. Combinamos estrategia, creatividad, producción y tecnología para ayudar a nuestros clientes a conectar con sus consumidores de forma relevante y eficiente.

Sobre el rol

Buscamos un/a Account Manager para integrarse a un equipo dedicado a una de las compañías de consumo masivo más importantes del mundo. Serás el vínculo clave entre el cliente y los equipos creativos, de producción y estrategia, asegurando que los proyectos se entreguen con excelencia, a tiempo y dentro del presupuesto.

Responsabilidades

• Gestionar la relación del día a día con los equipos de marketing del cliente, siendo un socio estratégico de confianza.

• Liderar el ciclo completo de los proyectos: brief, planificación, ejecución, entrega y seguimiento.

• Traducir las necesidades del negocio en briefs claros para los equipos creativos y de producción.

• Coordinar equipos multidisciplinarios (diseño, contenido, producción, digital, estrategia).

• Gestionar presupuestos, forecasts, órdenes de compra y facturación.

• Anticipar riesgos y proponer soluciones proactivas ante cambios de alcance, plazos o prioridades.

• Garantizar la calidad y el cumplimiento de lineamientos de marca y procesos del cliente.

• Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y mejora dentro de la cuenta.

• Preparar reportes de avance, status updates y presentaciones para el cliente y la dirección interna.

Requisitos

• Título universitario en Marketing, Comunicación, Publicidad, Administración o carreras afines.

• 3–5 años de experiencia en gestión de cuentas en agencias, o en roles de marketing en empresas de consumo masivo.

• Experiencia en gestión de proyectos con múltiples stakeholders y plazos exigentes.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, negociación y gestión de relaciones.

• Capacidad de organización, atención al detalle y orientación a resultados.

• Manejo de presupuestos y conocimientos básicos de finanzas de proyecto.

• Inglés avanzado (trabajo con equipos regionales/globales).

• Dominio de herramientas de gestión (Excel, PowerPoint, Jira, Asana, Monday o similares).

Deseable

• Experiencia previa con clientes de consumo masivo, retail o FMCG.

• Conocimiento de marketing digital, social media, e-commerce o producción de contenidos.

• Experiencia trabajando en modelos in-house o con equipos globales.

Habilidades clave

Pensamiento estratégico · Proactividad · Liderazgo colaborativo · Adaptabilidad · Gestión de prioridades · Mentalidad de servicio.
Nuestros valores dan forma a todo lo que hacemos, puntualizando:

• Ser ambiciosos para alcanzar el éxito.

• Ser imaginativos para superar los límites de lo posible.

• Ser inspiradores para realizar un trabajo innovador.

• Estar siempre aprendiendo y escuchando para comprender.

• Estar enfocado en los resultados para superar las expectativas.

• Ser activamente pro inclusivos y antirracistas en nuestra comunidad, clientes y creaciones

Nosso processo de recrutamento não utiliza inteligência artificial para seleção. Utilizamos a IA para apoiar a eficiência e a consistência, e não para substituir o julgamento humano. A avaliação e a seleção de candidatos são realizadas sem o uso de IA para triagem ou tomada de decisão. Estamos comprometidos com uma experiência justa, cuidadosa e equitativa para cada candidato.

OLIVER, que forma parte del Grupo Brandtech, es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a crear entornos de trabajo inclusivos en los que se motive a todos los empleados a alcanzar su máximo potencial, valorando y respetando las diferencias individuales. Todos los candidatos serán tenidos en cuenta sin distinción de raza, etnia, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, edad, neurodivergencia, estado de discapacidad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la legislación local.

OLIVER ha establecido ambiciosos objetivos medioambientales en torno a la sostenibilidad, con objetivos de reducción de emisiones basados en la ciencia. Colectivamente, trabajamos para cumplir nuestra misión, integrando la sostenibilidad en todos los departamentos y en todas las fases del ciclo de vida de los proyectos.

postings.title: DAR - OAI Principal, Art Direction
postings.descriptionText:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a talented and strategic Principal, Art Director to join a fast-paced, high-performing team supporting one of our most visible, dynamic clients. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who brings conceptual thinking, sharp visual design capabilities, and video-first experience to the table.

As a key leader within the creative department, you will not only translate strategy into smart, engaging creative but also mentor a multidisciplinary team of designers and creators. You’ll partner closely with Copywriters, Video Editors, and Content Creators, reporting to the Creative Director to ensure design excellence from kickoff through delivery. You’ll play a crucial role in owning your workstream, managing junior talent, and consistently raising the creative bar.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in creative collaboration, is autonomous in ideation, enjoys rolling up their sleeves to execute, and has a strong point of view on what makes effective content in the digital world.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Deliver High-Impact Creative: Concept and design best-in-class digital creative across social, and video, with a strong focus on visual storytelling and performance.

• Mentor & Lead: Act as a direct supervisor and mentor to junior and mid-level Art Directors and Designers. Provide clear, constructive feedback to creatives across disciplines (for example, to copy) to elevate the team's output and foster professional growth.

• Support Video + Content Production: Contribute to pre-production planning, support on-set shoots, and collaborate with editors and designers in post to ensure work comes to life as intended.

• Partner Across Disciplines: Work closely with copywriters, strategists, producers, project managers, and client teams to ensure creative aligns with brief goals, brand voice, and business objectives.

• Manage Creative Execution: Own the work from end to end. Concepting and producing polished on-brand, performance-minded assets that meet timelines and briefs. As an Associate Director, Art Direction, you will lead by doing, driving execution while strategically delegating portions of our projects to our junior team members to support efficiency, mentorship and delivery while remaining accountable for the final output.

• Be a Problem Solver: Navigate ambiguity with CD support, adapt to shifting priorities, and bring proactive solutions to creative and production challenges. These solutions should come in the form of daily brainstorming and inspiration sharing with the team.

• Cultivate Culture: Foster an inclusive, high-energy environment. Lead daily brainstorms and inspiration-sharing sessions to keep the team’s creative pulse sharp.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• 5+ years of experience in visual design with a strong portfolio showcasing digital campaigns, social-first content, and video-driven work.

• Prior social agency experience or relevant experience with a track record of navigating high-volume, high-visibility accounts.

• On-set and content production experience (domestic or international), including working with video directors, editors, and producers.

• Strong client presentation and communication skills - you can confidently present ideas, take feedback in stride, and advocate for great creative.

• Excellent design sensibility and a strategic eye for layout, typography, motion, and branding. Additionally, deep knowledge of social best practices for optimal performance.

• A proactive, collaborative mindset - you bring energy to brainstorms, jump in where needed, and support your teammates with generosity and respect.

• A creative portfolio that shows your eye for design, your range in digital, video, and ability to turn strategy into scroll-stopping creative.

TAKE INTO ACCOUNT:

• You will have to communicate with your team members abroad, therefore fluency in English and excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) are a must for this role.

• This role will require you to work EST hours .

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!

• Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members

• Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases

• Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses

• Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes

• 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub

• Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda

• A flexible vacation policy

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work . Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here .

JOB PURPOSE

We’re looking for a strategic and experienced Resource Manager to lead capacity planning and resourcing for our Experience & Engineering Nearshore Teams. This role is essential in ensuring efficient resource allocation, optimizing utilization, and aligning with business growth in a fast-paced digital environment.

You’ll be responsible for matching the right talent to the right projects - balancing team skills, availability, and project needs to deliver high-quality work, on time and on budget. This includes managing billable headcount, supporting dynamic staffing needs, and planning ahead with the Commercial team to align with the business pipeline.

A strong understanding of digital project delivery (e.g., websites, e-commerce, mobile apps) and the data and engineering roles involved - such asFull-Stack and Software Development, QA, UX/UI Designers - is key.

postings.descriptionText:
Greenhouse is the first Orchestrated Hiring Ecosystem: a single place that brings the right person and the right role together at the right time. Our mission is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse has partnered with Deel to be its Employer of Record in Argentina (more information here ). Through this arrangement, Deel is hiring a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to provide services to Greenhouse.

This role will support the design, development, and evolution of the Company’s web-based applications. In this role, you will work across the entire application stack to deliver high-quality features for the Company.

Your work will range from building net-new functionality to improving how data flows across the Company’s services at scale. This is a collaborative role where you will work closely with product, design, and engineering partners to ensure the platform remains performant, reliable, and user-friendly.

Who will love this job

• A Pragmatic Architect - You don’t just write code, you think about how systems connect. You enjoy refining data models and improving system architecture to support long-term scalability.

• A Full-Stack Specialist - You are equally comfortable navigating a PostgreSQL query, styling a React component, or building a robust controller in Rails.

• A Quality Advocate - You believe “done” includes comprehensive automated tests and clear documentation. You take pride in leaving the codebase better than you found it.

• A Collaborative Problem-Solver - You thrive in an environment where code reviews are a dialogue and cross-functional collaboration is the norm.

• An AI fluent engineer – you already use tools like Claude to move faster, and you're excited to build on that experience

What you’ll do

• Build, modify, and maintain features using Ruby on Rails, modern JavaScript frameworks (React), HTML, and CSS

• Execute on high-impact projects

• Ensure code is maintainable and aligned with established engineering standards

• Contribute to the evolution of system architecture, including improvements to data transfer across services and ingestion pathways

• Design and maintain RESTful APIs, webhook-driven integrations, and data exchange pathways with third-party systems

• Diagnose and resolve complex integration issues to improve information flow

• Design and update PostgreSQL data models, refactoring legacy models to improve performance and reduce complexity

• Participate in production support during working hours, addressing bugs and escalations as needed

• Use monitoring and observability tools to maintain application stability and support performance tuning

• Participate in peer code reviews and provide constructive feedback

• Produce technical documentation, including architecture notes, implementation guides, and runbooks

• Write automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) to ensure reliability and coverage

You should have

• 5+ years of experience writing and maintaining production-level code in a professional environment

• Strong experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails

• Experience with JavaScript and React, plus solid HTML and CSS fundamentals

• Deep understanding of MVC architecture and backend optimization

• Proven ability to write efficient SQL, design relational data models, and optimize PostgreSQL performance

• Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and managing third-party integrations via webhooks

• Proficiency with automated testing frameworks (e.g., RSpec, Jest, Cypress) and a commitment to test-driven practices

• Ability to contribute to architectural discussions and implement solutions that operate effectively at scale

• Comfort working in agile environments using standard development tools such as Git, CI/CD pipelines, and observability platforms

• Fluency in agentic coding and with leveraging and configuring AI tooling

Who we are

At Greenhouse, we live by our mission through using our own product to help us hire the right person for the job, every time. We’re committed to designing and responsibly using AI tools to transform how we work while keeping people at the center. We are a remote-first company and have shared office spaces in New York City and Ireland, and optional co-working spaces that give us flexibility to do our best work anywhere. We take an active role in our growth through a performance review program that’s committed to providing actionable feedback, and a bonus structure that rewards great performance. We believe that bringing together a variety of perspectives makes us a stronger company – and we nurture leaders who create an inclusive culture and invest into employee resource groups that celebrate our differences and life experiences. We’re proud to have built an award-winning culture that’s been recognized as Fortune’s Best Places to Work and Inc.’s Best Workplaces multiple years in a row.

postings.title: Senior Data Scientist, Research
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist, Research who is versatile: you model high-stakes business problems—revenue optimization, risk management, and related questions—and you use AI to scale that work. You'll be a senior individual contributor who can go deep statistically, learn a new domain quickly, and rethink how data science problems get solved in the age of AI: not only classical models, but agents and other AI systems that multiply what a small research team can do.

This role is for someone who is deeply curious, strong at analytical thinking and problem solving, and a fast learner—with formal training and a strong statistical foundation. You have tackled revenue and risk problems with modeling before, and you are excited to solve them differently now: building AI agents, automating research workflows, and using modern tools so the science scales. If you want ownership over modelizable, revenue- and risk-critical problems and you already leverage AI to move faster, this is the role.

What You'll Do

• Tackle revenue and risk problems with modeling. Frame ambiguous business questions as quantitative problems; build models that improve revenue, manage risk, and inform decisions.

• Solve them differently in the age of AI. Use AI—including agents and other automation—to scale data science work: accelerate research, extend coverage, and change how models get built, tested, and used.

• Stay statistically rigorous. Bring a strong foundation in statistics and inference so AI-accelerated work is still trustworthy—you know when a result is solid and when it is not.

• Learn the business fast. Ramp quickly across new domains and problems; stay versatile rather than attached to a single method or subject area.

• Turn research into decisions. Communicate findings and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical partners, including senior leadership.

• Raise the bar. Share practices that help the team use AI to scale DS work without lowering the quality of the science.

• Mentor and set standards. Mentor other data scientists and help grow a culture of curiosity, rigor, and high leverage.

What We're Looking For

• Versatile applied data scientist with experience modeling business problems such as revenue optimization and risk management—not just analyses or dashboards.

• Strong statistical foundation from formal training (statistics, mathematics, or a related quantitative field) and the judgment to apply it under real-world, messy conditions.

• Deeply curious, with strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills; a fast learner who picks up new domains, tools, and methods quickly.

• Practical experience leveraging AI to scale data science work—for example building AI agents, automating research workflows, or otherwise changing how modeling work gets done.

• Strong programming skills in Python and SQL; able to go from question to working analysis or model without a large support structure.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills; able to work with Finance, Risk, Product, and Engineering.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and ship work that gets used.

• Master's or PhD in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, engineering, economics, physics, or a related discipline, and at least 6–10 years of relevant experience. Equivalent industry experience is welcome.

Nice to Have

Background in brokerage, trading, fintech, or another domain where revenue and risk decisions have real consequences.
Experience putting models or agents into production with engineering partners.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Recruitment Privacy Policy

About the Role

Alpaca is seeking a highly motivated and analytical Tokenization Analyst to join our Tokenization department.

This individual will work directly with the General Manager of Tokenization, supporting the development, commercialization, and execution of Alpaca's tokenization strategy.

The role sits at the intersection of strategy, product, business development, and operations. The ideal candidate is a versatile problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can navigate ambiguity, and is comfortable taking ownership of projects from conception through execution.

This is a unique opportunity to gain exposure to multiple facets of a rapidly emerging industry while helping build the infrastructure powering the future of tokenized financial markets.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Business Operations

• Work directly with the GM of Tokenization to execute the department's strategic priorities and business objectives.

• Track key departmental initiatives, product milestones, and cross-functional dependencies, ensuring accountability and timely execution.

• Monitor departmental KPIs and develop recurring reporting on business performance, including revenue, transaction volumes, partner adoption, and other strategic metrics.

• Prepare executive presentations, business reviews, strategic updates, and other materials for senior leadership.

• Support annual and quarterly planning, including prioritization, business case development, and resource planning.

• Lead special projects and strategic initiatives as assigned by the GM.

Product & Go-to-Market Enablement

• Partner closely with Product teams to develop sales collateral, product presentations, integration guides, FAQs, and other client-facing materials.

• Translate complex technical product capabilities into clear, compelling commercial narratives for prospective clients and partners.

• Support product launches by coordinating internal readiness, external communications, and go-to-market deliverables.

• Gather feedback from Sales, partners, and ecosystem participants to help inform product strategy and prioritization.

Market Research & Ecosystem Development

• Conduct in-depth research on the global tokenization ecosystem, including token issuers, blockchain networks, exchanges, broker-dealers, market makers, custodians, and other infrastructure providers.

• Identify, research, and evaluate prospective clients, strategic partners, and emerging commercial opportunities.

• Monitor competitive developments, market trends, regulatory changes, and technological innovations impacting tokenized securities.

• Develop market maps, competitive analyses, and strategic recommendations to support business development and product decisions.

Commercial & Partnership Support

• Support the evaluation and execution of strategic partnerships and commercial opportunities.

• Prepare partner briefings, meeting materials, commercial proposals, and supporting analyses.

• Coordinate internal and external stakeholders throughout partnership discussions, integrations, and launches.

• Track commercial opportunities, partnership progress, and follow-up actions to help accelerate execution.

Cross-Functional Execution

• Serve as a central point of coordination across Product, Engineering, Sales, Legal, Compliance, and Operations for key tokenization initiatives.

• Proactively identify risks, blockers, and dependencies, escalating issues and recommending solutions.

• Establish and improve internal reporting, documentation, and operating processes to increase departmental efficiency.

Qualifications

Required

• 1–3 years of experience in strategy, business operations, product, consulting, financial services, fintech, or a related field.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop actionable recommendations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create polished presentations and communicate complex concepts clearly.

• Exceptional organizational and project management abilities, with strong attention to detail.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate stakeholders, and independently drive projects forward.

• Strong proficiency in spreadsheets, presentations, and analytical tools.

• Genuine interest in financial markets, digital assets, blockchain technology, and tokenization.

Preferred

• Experience in capital markets, brokerage infrastructure, fintech, digital assets, or blockchain-related businesses.

• Familiarity with securities markets, market structure, trading, clearing, custody, or settlement.

• Exposure to tokenized securities, stablecoins, DeFi, or blockchain infrastructure.

• Experience working closely with senior executives or within a strategy, business operations, or Chief of Staff function.

• Experience developing business cases, financial models, KPI dashboards, or commercial analyses.

What Success Looks Like

• Key departmental initiatives are clearly tracked, with proactive identification and resolution of blockers.

• Product and Sales teams have high-quality, up-to-date materials to support commercialization and partner integrations.

• Leadership has consistent visibility into departmental performance, strategic priorities, and execution progress.

• New partnership opportunities and ecosystem developments are systematically evaluated and translated into actionable recommendations.

• The GM and broader Tokenization team can operate more effectively, with greater coordination, faster decision-making, and stronger execution.

Our Commitment to Our Team

At Pipe17, our values aren’t just words on a wall. They’re how we operate every day.

We are a high-performance team built around ownership , urgency , curiosity , and a strong bias for action .

We set bold goals, hold ourselves accountable, and move fast to solve customer problems. Every team member owns their decisions and drives outcomes. No one waits for permission.

We operate with urgency , but not recklessly. We focus on what matters most, take initiative, and course-correct quickly when needed. We value people who speak up, follow through, and take pride in their work.

Curiosity is how we get better. We ask questions, challenge assumptions, and stay open to new ideas. We don’t default to “how it’s always been done.” We explore, test, and learn. That mindset helps us adapt quickly, solve harder problems, and continuously raise the bar.

We also embrace AI as a force multiplier . We believe great operators don’t compete with AI - they partner with it. We use AI to move faster, think deeper, and remove friction from our work, while still applying human judgement, creativity, and context where it matters most. Thoughtful use of AI is part of how we scale ourselves and our impact.

Finally, teamwork is at our core. We win together, support each other, and celebrate our shared victories. Collaboration across functions is a daily practice, not just something we talk about. We learn from each other, improve constantly, and rally around our mission: unify commerce after the buy button.

If these values resonate with how you like to work, you’ll fit right in.

Type: Individual Contributor · Location: Remote (US) · Reports to: VP Marketing
Experience: 3–5 years · Target OTE: $105k–$115k

This is a hands-on build role, and acts as the connective tissue to our cross-functional GTM team. You will work daily with Sales and Partnerships, because the programs you build feed their pipeline across mid-market brands, enterprise order management, and 3PL.

About the role

Pipe17’s Order Operations Platform is the connected OMS that unifies orders, inventory, products and fulfillment across selling channels (DTC, B2B, retail and agentic), ERPs and fulfillment locations. We sell a technical product to operators, their bosses and the rest of the enterprise buying group, and generic marketing does not work on them.

We need someone who can build the systems that put the right message in front of the right account at the right moment, then run those systems without babysitting. You are part engineer, part marketer: comfortable in APIs, automation platforms, and LLM tooling, and equally comfortable judging whether a play will actually grow qualified pipeline. You will be the only person in this function, reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, with the latitude to build what does not exist yet.

What you'll do

Run account-based marketing execution.

• Build the named account lists for our enterprise and 3PL programs, and map the people inside each account.

• Keep account evidence current, built with agents rather than by hand: what each account runs, who runs it, what it costs them, and what changed.

• Run the mechanics: multi-touch sequences, executive outreach, dinner and event invitations, gifting, and follow-up.

• Own event and conference follow-up as a system. Target list and meetings booked before anyone travels, follow-up inside 72 hours.

• Give Sales and Partnerships what they need to work each account, when they need it.

Build custom nurtures. Replace the single nurture track with custom paths, where treatment rises with intent and decays with time. High-intent visitors get a human fast, light engagement gets agent-drafted outreach keyed to what they did, and stalled or previously-too-small accounts get re-scored and re-contacted on a schedule.

Own HubSpot. Own the roadmap and the admin. Fix the data model so it matches how we actually sell across three segments, clean up source attribution so we can say what produced pipeline, and build reporting the business trusts. Keep the stack small. We are not looking for someone who adds tools.

Build the outbound engine.

• Build automated outbound end to end: signal detection, enrichment, sequencing, reply handling, and CRM sync, using the tools we have in house today (HubSpot, Clay, Propensity, Artisan, Gong).

• Detect the events that mean an account is in play: a replatform, an ERP migration, a 3PL change, a new channel, a second warehouse, a bad peak season, a new operations or technology leader.

• Use LLMs and agents to personalize at volume, grounded in real research about each account.

• Make it run without babysitting, and make it measurable.

Must-have qualifications

• 3+ years in marketing operations, demand gen operations, GTM operations, or revenue operations at a B2B SaaS company.

• You have built an outbound engine from scratch, and can tell us what it produced in meetings or pipeline.

• You have run account-based programs, including building the target list when it did not exist, and are familiar with implementing and enabling use of ABM platforms.

• You have built custom nurtures with differentiated paths, and can show what they did to conversion.

• Deep HubSpot. You have designed the data model around how a business sells, and you are happy doing the admin yourself.

• You build. APIs, data manipulation, LLM tooling, and real depth in automation platforms such as Clay, n8n, Zapier, or Make. You can read API docs and debug when something breaks.

• You did it unprompted. You saw the gap and shipped the fix before anyone asked.

• Commercial instinct. You understand pipeline and conversion, and why reps ignore tools that technically work.

• A doer. Comfortable as the only person in the function, with direct exposure to the founders.

• Fluent in using AI to do the work, not just to talk about it.

Nice to have

• Experience in ecommerce, retail technology, or logistics.

• Enterprise account-based marketing into retail or supply chain buyers.

• Agents or LLM workflows in production against a pipeline outcome.

• Built the function from nothing at a Series A to C company.

• Ran a long enterprise cycle and a fast mid-market cycle in the same system.

• Supported a partner or channel motion, including partner-sourced attribution.

Compensation (US FTE)

• Competitive salary

• Great healthcare + dental + vision coverage

• Retirement plan

• Pick your own equipment. We'll set you up with whatever Apple laptop + monitor combo you want plus any software you need.

• Unlimited vacation policy. Plus we require you to take at least 2 weeks off each year. We see most employees take 4 weeks off per year. This isn't a vague policy where unlimited vacation means no vacation

About Us

Pipe17 is the AI-native Enterprise Order Operations Platform for brands and 3PLs. We replace the fragmented stack of iPaaS, middleware, and legacy OMS with one unified operational layer that manages orders, inventory, products, fulfillment, and exceptions across every channel and partner.

With 300+ managed connectors, AI-powered workflows, and an industry-first MCP Server for agentic commerce, Pipe17 lets brands go live in weeks, scale into new channels in days, and run post-checkout operations without developer dependency or systems integrators.

Our customers reduce operational costs by up to 85%, cut fulfillment errors by 99%, and launch new channels in days instead of months. Pipe17 is trusted by enterprise brands including Estée Lauder, Allbirds, e.l.f. Beauty, Made In Cookware, Wyze, Olly, Black Rifle Coffee Company, and Dude Wipes, as well as leading 3PLs including Ryder, FedEx, and Barrett Distribution.

Pipe17 is a venture-funded software company headquartered in Seattle, WA with a significant presence in the San Francisco Bay Area. The company is backed by GLP Capital Partners, a leading investor in ecommerce logistics, and with Series A funding.

postings.title: Jr. Firmware Test Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About Celero

Celero Communications is building the next generation of intelligent optical connectivity for AI infrastructure.

Founded in 2024 by industry pioneers from Broadcom, Inphi, Marvell, and ClariPhy, Celero brings together decades of coherent DSP innovation with a focused mission to deliver the optical performance, power efficiency, and scalability required for tomorrow's AI-driven data centers.

We believe the future of AI infrastructure will be defined not only by speed, but by intelligence, energy efficiency, and the ability to seamlessly move massive amounts of data across increasingly complex networks.

Our mission is to build the technology foundation that makes this possible.

Headquartered in Irvine, California, with engineering teams in Canada and Argentina, Celero develops advanced coherent Digital Signal Processing (DSP) solutions that enable high-bandwidth, low-power optical connectivity for hyperscale AI infrastructure.

About the job

Celero is seeking an enthusiastic, detail-oriented Jr. Firmware Test Engineer to verify and validate the low-level firmware that runs on our coherent optical DSP ASICs for AI data center and hyperscale connectivity. Based in Córdoba, Argentina, you will work closely with hardware, firmware, systems and verification teams to bring up new platforms, test firmware features and debug complex hardware-software interactions on both pre-silicon and post-silicon platforms. Day to day, you will write automated Python tests, run them on boards and lab setups, and track failures down to their root cause, with guidance from senior engineers. This is an early-career role with a clear path to grow into firmware verification and QA, and your work will help get coherent DSP silicon from tape-out through bring-up and into optical modules shipping to hyperscaler customers.

Key Responsibilities

You will write and maintain automated pytest-based tests that verify firmware features on the embedded processors and SoC of our coherent DSP silicon, implementing them from test plans and building on the existing test framework. You will support firmware bring-up and validation on new hardware platforms and silicon revisions, running tests, analyzing results and debugging failures with logs, traces and debuggers, then reporting issues and following them through to resolution. You will set up and maintain test environments, including boards and lab instruments, and implement board-level and SoC-level firmware pieces such as initialization code and basic drivers that support test and validation. You will also contribute to test utilities, regression testing, CI infrastructure and test reporting, follow firmware coding standards, and document tests, procedures, firmware behavior and debugging steps while collaborating with hardware, verification and application teams under the guidance of senior engineers.

Basic Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer or Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience

• Experience: 1-3+ years of experience in embedded/firmware development, verification or QA, including basic experience developing and debugging firmware for embedded systems or SoCs

• Programming and Fundamentals: Strong hands-on C/C++, working knowledge of Python for scripting and test automation (pytest or a similar framework), and an understanding of memory management, pointers, data structures and register-level hardware access in embedded environments

• Verification and Tools: Working knowledge of SystemVerilog and UVM-based verification, Git and modular coding practices, DSP and control systems fundamentals, comfort in Linux and Windows, and fluent written and spoken English

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with one or more of the following:

• pytest fixtures, parametrization and markers

• CI/CD and test automation with Jenkins (pipelines, build agents, test reports)

• I2C, SPI, UART and GPIO interfaces, RTOS-based firmware or RISC-V

• Semiconductor validation, chip bring-up or FPGA prototyping

• Coherent optical systems or silicon photonics, and Python data analysis (numpy, pandas) or calling C libraries from Python

What Makes You Successful:

• You are a strong problem solver who stays curious and keeps digging until you find the root cause

• You are eager to learn and welcome feedback from senior engineers

• You work well across hardware, firmware and verification teams

• You are self-driven and comfortable with ambiguity and limited infrastructure in a startup

• You document your work clearly and follow tests through to resolution

Why Join Celero?

You will get hands-on experience across the full firmware lifecycle on real coherent optical DSP silicon, from pre-silicon platforms to post-silicon bring-up. As part of a small, fast-moving team with colleagues in Córdoba, Irvine and Canada, you will see your tests and tools make a direct difference to the chips that power AI data center connectivity, while growing toward firmware verification and QA.

If you're energized by innovation, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to help define the future of AI connectivity, we'd love to hear from you.

Headquartered in Irvine, California, with engineering teams in Canada and Argentina, Celero develops advanced coherent Digital Signal Processing (DSP) solutions that enable high-bandwidth, low-power optical connectivity for hyperscale AI infrastructure.

About the job

Celero is seeking a hands-on, self-driven Senior Firmware Test Automation & Validation Engineer to extend and evolve the Python-based test framework we use to validate our coherent optical DSP silicon. Reporting the Firmware team in Córdoba, Argentina, you will turn test plans into automated tests, run them on pre-silicon and post-silicon platforms, and drive failures to resolution alongside hardware, firmware, verification and application engineers. Your work sits at the boundary between software and hardware: register-level access to devices, lab instruments and boards, CI regression infrastructure, and cross-functional debugging. The faster and more reliably we validate our coherent DSP ASICs, the faster we can bring up silicon and ship it in optical modules for hyperscale AI data centers. Engineers at any seniority level are welcome to apply.

Key Responsibilities

• Test Framework: Extend and evolve the existing Python-based test automation framework for silicon validation

• Test Implementation: Implement automated tests from test plans, building on existing infrastructure, and keep them current as the silicon and firmware evolve

• Test Execution: Own test execution by running tests, analyzing results, and driving failures to resolution with cross-functional teams

• Failure Debug: Debug failures across software and firmware using logs, traces and debuggers

• Test Environments: Set up and maintain test environments on pre-silicon and post-silicon platforms, including boards and lab instruments

• CI and Reporting: Grow the CI regression and test reporting infrastructure

• Analysis Tools: Contribute to tools for test result analysis and failure categorization

• Improvement and Documentation: Propose improvements to test tools, and document tests, procedures and results

• Collaboration: Collaborate with hardware, firmware, verification and application teams

Basic Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer or Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience

• Experience: 2+ years of professional Python development with object-oriented design (classes, inheritance, reusable modules)

• Test Automation: Experience writing and maintaining automated tests with pytest (fixtures, parametrization, markers) or a similar framework

• Lab Hardware Testing: Experience testing hardware in the lab, including register-level access to devices and communication protocols

• Version Control: Experience with Git/GitHub

• CI/CD: Experience with CI/CD and test automation tools, preferably Jenkins (pipelines, build agents, test reports)

• Environments: Comfortable working in both Linux and Windows environments

• Communication: Fluent written and spoken English

• Debugging: Ability to analyze results and debug failures across software and firmware

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with one or more of the following:

• Controlling instruments such as power supplies, multimeters and oscilloscopes from Python (PyVISA/SCPI)

• C and C++, including memory management and pointers

• Databases, preferably non-relational (e.g., MongoDB, Elasticsearch)

• Semiconductor validation, chip bring-up, embedded firmware (RISC-V, RTOS-based firmware) or FPGA prototyping

• Hardware interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART and GPIO

• UVM-based verification environments and SystemVerilog test methodologies

• DSP fundamentals and control systems

• Coherent optical systems or silicon photonics

What Makes You Successful:

• You have strong problem-solving skills and a real eagerness to learn

• You own tasks end to end and follow them through to resolution

• You propose improvements instead of waiting to be asked

• You work effectively with hardware, firmware, verification and application engineers

• You stay productive in a startup environment with ambiguity and evolving infrastructure

Why Join Celero?

As a Senior Firmware Test Automation & Validation Engineer in Córdoba, you will sit at the center of how we validate coherent optical DSP silicon, from pre-silicon platforms through post-silicon bring-up. Your automation and debugging will directly shape how quickly we find issues and ship chips for AI data center connectivity. You will work onsite alongside firmware, hardware and verification engineers in a small, fast-moving team where your ideas get built.

If you're energized by innovation, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to help define the future of AI connectivity, we'd love to hear from you.

postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for
• Senior Laravel & PHP Expertise: 5+ years of production experience with Laravel, including modern versions (Laravel 10–13) and PHP 8.3+.

• Core Framework Mastery: Deep command of Eloquent ORM (including query optimization and complex relationships), Laravel’s authentication/authorization ecosystem (Sanctum, Policies, Gates), queues, caching, and database architecture.

• Cloud & AWS Infrastructure: Hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and maintaining Laravel applications on AWS (e.g., EC2, ECS, RDS, S3, SQS, ElastiCache, or Laravel Vapor), including managing CI/CD pipelines and production observability.

• Automated Testing Culture: Strong commitment to code quality with extensive experience writing unit, feature, and end-to-end tests using Pest PHP, PHPUnit, Playwright, or Laravel Dusk.

• API & Full-Stack Architecture: Proven track record designing and building resilient RESTful APIs (or JSON:API) alongside modern reactive frontends using Inertia.js, React, Vue.js, or Laravel Livewire.

• UI Craftsmanship (Bonus): Proficiency with Tailwind CSS and building accessible, responsive component libraries.

• Extreme Ownership: You take end-to-end accountability for your code—from architectural decisions and accurate estimation to deployment and production stability.

• Client-Centric Mindset: Ability to align closely with Bluelight’s clients’ business objectives, translating complex requirements into reliable, on-time deliverables.

• Collaborative & High-Bar Engineering: A proactive, solutions-oriented attitude paired with forensic attention to detail in code reviews, security, and edge-case handling.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Senior Laravel Developer + React - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for
• Senior Laravel & PHP Expertise: 5+ years of production experience with Laravel, including modern versions (Laravel 10–13) and PHP 8.3+.

• Core Framework Mastery: Deep command of Eloquent ORM (including query optimization and complex relationships), Laravel’s authentication/authorization ecosystem (Sanctum, Policies, Gates), queues, caching, and database architecture.

• Cloud & AWS Infrastructure: Hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and maintaining Laravel applications on AWS (e.g., EC2, ECS, RDS, S3, SQS, ElastiCache, or Laravel Vapor), including managing CI/CD pipelines and production observability.

• Automated Testing Culture: Strong commitment to code quality with extensive experience writing unit, feature, and end-to-end tests using Pest PHP, PHPUnit, Playwright, or Laravel Dusk.

• API & Full-Stack Architecture: Proven track record designing and building resilient RESTful APIs (or JSON:API) alongside modern reactive frontends using Inertia.js, React, Vue.js, or Laravel Livewire.

• UI Craftsmanship (Bonus): Proficiency with Tailwind CSS and building accessible, responsive component libraries.

• Extreme Ownership: You take end-to-end accountability for your code—from architectural decisions and accurate estimation to deployment and production stability.

• Client-Centric Mindset: Ability to align closely with Bluelight’s clients’ business objectives, translating complex requirements into reliable, on-time deliverables.

• Collaborative & High-Bar Engineering: A proactive, solutions-oriented attitude paired with forensic attention to detail in code reviews, security, and edge-case handling.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Senior Laravel Developer + React - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for
• Senior Laravel & PHP Expertise: 5+ years of production experience with Laravel, including modern versions (Laravel 10–13) and PHP 8.3+.

• Core Framework Mastery: Deep command of Eloquent ORM (including query optimization and complex relationships), Laravel’s authentication/authorization ecosystem (Sanctum, Policies, Gates), queues, caching, and database architecture.

• Cloud & AWS Infrastructure: Hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and maintaining Laravel applications on AWS (e.g., EC2, ECS, RDS, S3, SQS, ElastiCache, or Laravel Vapor), including managing CI/CD pipelines and production observability.

• Automated Testing Culture: Strong commitment to code quality with extensive experience writing unit, feature, and end-to-end tests using Pest PHP, PHPUnit, Playwright, or Laravel Dusk.

• API & Full-Stack Architecture: Proven track record designing and building resilient RESTful APIs (or JSON:API) alongside modern reactive frontends using Inertia.js, React, Vue.js, or Laravel Livewire.

• UI Craftsmanship (Bonus): Proficiency with Tailwind CSS and building accessible, responsive component libraries.

• Extreme Ownership: You take end-to-end accountability for your code—from architectural decisions and accurate estimation to deployment and production stability.

• Client-Centric Mindset: Ability to align closely with Bluelight’s clients’ business objectives, translating complex requirements into reliable, on-time deliverables.

• Collaborative & High-Bar Engineering: A proactive, solutions-oriented attitude paired with forensic attention to detail in code reviews, security, and edge-case handling.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Senior Laravel Developer + React - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for
• Senior Laravel & PHP Expertise: 5+ years of production experience with Laravel, including modern versions (Laravel 10–13) and PHP 8.3+.

• Core Framework Mastery: Deep command of Eloquent ORM (including query optimization and complex relationships), Laravel’s authentication/authorization ecosystem (Sanctum, Policies, Gates), queues, caching, and database architecture.

• Cloud & AWS Infrastructure: Hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and maintaining Laravel applications on AWS (e.g., EC2, ECS, RDS, S3, SQS, ElastiCache, or Laravel Vapor), including managing CI/CD pipelines and production observability.

• Automated Testing Culture: Strong commitment to code quality with extensive experience writing unit, feature, and end-to-end tests using Pest PHP, PHPUnit, Playwright, or Laravel Dusk.

• API & Full-Stack Architecture: Proven track record designing and building resilient RESTful APIs (or JSON:API) alongside modern reactive frontends using Inertia.js, React, Vue.js, or Laravel Livewire.

• UI Craftsmanship (Bonus): Proficiency with Tailwind CSS and building accessible, responsive component libraries.

• Extreme Ownership: You take end-to-end accountability for your code—from architectural decisions and accurate estimation to deployment and production stability.

• Client-Centric Mindset: Ability to align closely with Bluelight’s clients’ business objectives, translating complex requirements into reliable, on-time deliverables.

• Collaborative & High-Bar Engineering: A proactive, solutions-oriented attitude paired with forensic attention to detail in code reviews, security, and edge-case handling.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

About Coderio

Coderio designs and delivers scalable digital solutions for global companies. With a strong technical foundation and a product-oriented mindset, our teams lead complex software projects from architecture to execution. We value autonomy, clear communication, and technical excellence. We work closely with international teams and partners, building technology that creates real impact. 🌍 More information: coderio.com

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a systems, backend and platform focus: a T-shaped engineer with deep expertise in one area who understands software end to end. You will work side by side with a small, highly technical team on a large monorepo that handles sensitive data, where security and privacy shape every design decision. You will report to a lead engineer who sets direction without micromanaging, so we value autonomy and sound judgment over a rigid list of tools.

What You Can Expect (Responsibilities)

• Backend & Systems Engineering: Design, build, and maintain backend services, with Go as a main language, in a distributed environment that includes Kafka.

• Runtime Security: Understand, harden, and secure the Go and Python runtimes the team uses to execute code on networks that are not always fully restricted.

• Cross-Layer Ownership: Work across a large monorepo that spans Python, Go, React, Terraform, and network configuration, stepping outside your main specialty when the problem requires it.

• Platform & Cloud: Contribute to platform decisions while services move from AWS to Azure, keeping security and privacy at the center.

• Design & Technical Judgment: Explain why systems are designed the way they are, identify risks early, and propose improvements.

• Responsible AI Use: Use AI tools, including Claude, with care for the data you share and for the quality of what you hand to the team.

• Collaboration & Learning: Support teammates, share knowledge, and pick up new areas as the work demands.

Requirements

• Senior-level software engineering experience, with the autonomy to move forward with light direction.

• Strong system design skills: ability to reason about a whole system, its design decisions, and their consequences.

• In-depth, hands-on experience with Go and Python, enough to work on securing their runtimes.

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.

• Solid understanding of security and privacy practices when working with sensitive data.

• A real specialty in backend, systems, or platform engineering, with the curiosity and willingness to work outside it.

• Strong communication skills, able to explain technical decisions clearly to the team.
