postings.descriptionText:
About Welo Global 
Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com 


The Role 
We are seeking an experienced English into Belarusian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. 
You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. 
Project Details 
- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Belarusian 
What You Will Do 
-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.
What You Will Own
-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality 
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking
Requirements
- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Belarusian and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools
Additional Key Information 
- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.
Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.  
Why Join Us 
This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing learning, and access to established linguistic resources. 
If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you. 
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global

postings.descriptionText:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 100,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.


Manager, Production Quality
Location: Remote (US and LATAM)
Team: Product Fulfillment Team
Reports to: Manager, Pro Production
Why This Role Matters
The Manager, Production Quality leads the Quality team and sets the standard for every website we deliver. This isn't just a QA management job. You'll shape how Quality and Production work together as one connected pipeline, with shared expectations around quality, efficiency, SLAs, and the final client experience.
You'll work closely with Production leadership and use what you learn from QA reviews, performance metrics, and recurring production challenges to build training, improve workflows, and put scalable solutions in place. The best version of this role combines a strong eye for design, deep knowledge of the Presence platform, people leadership, and a drive to keep raising the bar.
What You'll Own
Quality Leadership and Design Excellence
Establish and maintain high standards for website design, functionality, compliance, brand consistency, and overall client experience.
Apply strong design judgment to evaluate visual hierarchy, layouts, typography, imagery, usability, and overall cohesion.
Lead quality calibrations and independent website audits, so expectations stay consistent and the team improves quality beyond catching errors.
Team Leadership, Coaching, and Development
Lead, coach, and develop the Quality team, setting clear performance expectations and holding the team accountable for quality, productivity, and turnaround times.
Develop and deliver design workshops, trainings, and best-practice initiatives for the Product Fulfillment Team.
Partner with Production leadership to identify recurring skill gaps, give actionable feedback, and improve quality at the source.
QA Operations and Production Alignment
Own daily QA operations, workload distribution, capacity planning, SLA adherence, and team performance.
Work with Production leadership to improve handoffs, reduce friction between Production and QA, and share accountability for the final product.
Monitor and analyze KPIs, including Website Draft Quality Score, Handling Time, On Time delivery, Pro Passback, and Passback Scores, to drive measurable improvement.
Identify bottlenecks and recurring quality issues, then implement solutions that reduce rework and improve delivery speed without lowering quality.
Innovation and Tooling
Partner with Product Development and Engineering to find opportunities for automation, improve existing tools, and test new solutions.
Help shape how Production and QA roles, responsibilities, and workflows evolve as new technologies arrive.
Turn day-to-day production challenges into scalable improvements that strengthen quality, efficiency, and the production experience.
Cross-Functional Collaboration and Client Experience
Collaborate with Production, Design, Onboarding, and other cross-functional leaders to close quality gaps and improve delivery.
Partner with Quality leadership across Pro Production and DREC to align standards, share learnings, and build organization-wide initiatives.
Champion a quality-first mindset, so every website is polished, functional, aligned with client expectations, and ready to deliver an exceptional experience.
What We're Looking For
Skills and Experience
Experience leading, coaching, and developing teams in website production, quality assurance, design, or a related environment.
A strong understanding of website design principles, including visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, layout, branding, and user experience.
The ability to evaluate website quality, spot opportunities for improvement, and give clear, actionable design feedback.
Experience managing operational performance, SLAs, team capacity, and productivity in a fast-paced environment.
Strong analytical skills and experience using KPIs, quality trends, and performance data to drive improvements.
The ability to design and deliver effective training, workshops, and coaching.
Experience finding process inefficiencies and working on tools, automation, or workflow improvements.
Strong communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Comfort navigating change, adapting to new technologies, and helping teams evolve as the business grows.
Mindset
Strong design eye: You recognize what makes a website polished, cohesive, and effective, and you can explain clearly how to improve it.
Ownership and accountability: You take responsibility for team outcomes, address challenges early, and follow through.
Quality-first leadership: You believe quality means delivering an exceptional product, not only finding mistakes.
Coaching mentality: You enjoy developing others and raising the capabilities of the whole production team.
Operational excellence: You balance high standards with efficiency, productivity, and timely delivery.
Innovation and adaptability: You embrace new tools, automation, and evolving workflows, and you help shape the future of Website Production.
Hands-on leadership: You lead by example, stay close to the work, and are comfortable reviewing websites, giving feedback, and solving problems directly.
Data-driven thinking: You use metrics, feedback, and trends to make decisions and drive continuous improvement.


Important note: Please ensure your CV is in English.

You build with AI daily and expect your team to do the same.
You hold strong opinions, loosely. You have a view on how AI changes architecture, team structure, and engineering culture.
You think in systems and connect technical decisions to customer outcomes and business value.
You are energized by ambiguity and speed. Ownership here is real.
You like to have fun at work. We take our craft seriously, but not ourselves.
Skills and Experience
8+ years of professional software engineering experience with meaningful senior or staff-level time, plus 2+ years managing engineering teams.
Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solution engineering, scoping, or vetting customer requirements before a sale.
Track record of turning custom or one-off work into reusable platform capabilities.
Deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with the full-stack fluency to reason about the request path from UI to data.
Experience designing and operating scalable microservice architectures in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred).
Strong understanding of GraphQL, event-driven systems (Kafka), and PostgreSQL.
Experience operating production systems with SLOs and incident response, and familiarity with DORA metrics.
Experience leading high-impact initiatives from concept through production in a SaaS environment.
Tech Stack
Frontend: React, Tailwind, Apollo
Backend: Node.js / TypeScript microservices
Data: PostgreSQL
Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Lambda
Messaging: Kafka, Redis

THE ROLE:


As a Service Desk Engineer, you'll play a critical role in ensuring the reliability and performance of our clients' digital platforms. Reporting into the Managed Services team, you will be responsible for triaging issues, diagnosing problems, and providing exceptional technical support to our enterprise clients. You will help maintain platform stability and deliver outstanding customer care while working with modern SaaS e-commerce platforms and supporting dynamic, enterprise-level applications.

RESPONSIBILITIES

postings.title: Territory Manager (Southern California)
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers.

Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups.

 


WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattleman's, Stockman's associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities.

 - In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers.

 - Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals.

 - Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights.

 - Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

 - Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups.

 - Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible. You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter.

 - Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need.

 - Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

 - Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.

 - Contributing to the US Sales Strategy: You strongly believe that a team can only be stronger when they work together. You strive to work with the broader team to optimize and evolve the sales process, ensuring it fits the US market. As we scale, your input will help drive greater efficiencies.



YOU’LL BE GREAT IF YOU EXHIBIT

 - Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act.

 - Ranching / Cattle Experience: You know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.

 - Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You have a strong history of creating new business opportunities, negotiating a value-based sales conversation, and have a background in building lasting customer relationships. You build relationships versus transactional sales, aiming for the long-term success stories and can expand existing relationships through upsell opportunities.

 - Territory Management experience: Experience managing a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, ideally within agriculture or technology.

 - Problem Solving & Collaboration ability: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

 - Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.



BONUS THINGS YOU COULD BRING ALONG TO THE ROLE

 - Familiarity with precision agriculture or virtual fencing technologies.

 - Background in customer-facing roles within agriculture technology.

 - Background in selling software (SaaS) solutions in a B2B environment.



OUR BENEFITS

 - Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): Own a part of Halter and share in our growth and success

 - 401(k): 100% match on the first 3% contributed, plus 50% match on the next 2% (up to a 4% employer match), with immediate vesting

 - Comprehensive health benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first day of the month after you join (with most premiums covered, including 100% of employee-only health premiums on select plans)

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP) & paid wellness leave: Access confidential support through JustWorks plus 3 paid wellness days per year

 - Personal growth fund: $750 USD per year to support learning, development, or personal growth goals

 - Unlimited PTO: Take time off when you need it—no accrual required, available from day one

 - Parental leave: 16 weeks paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks paid leave for non-birthing parents

 - Onboarding travel to New Zealand: Fly to NZ for onboarding at Halter HQ in Auckland—meet the team, visit a test farm, and immerse yourself in all things Halter

The annual OTE salary range for this role is $140,000 - $165,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Halter and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.


JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

 - You'll grow here. Autonomy, mas

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are searching for an elite growth leader, ready to play the game of their career. You will be leading a passionate and highly motivated team of which in time will grow to 30+ reps across the Central Argentina to a scale that very few businesses ever achieve, whilst having an impact on one of Argentina’s most vital industries, Agriculture. 

Leading the Central Argentina team, you will be covering the full customer cycle from new sales through to Account Management. We’re looking for someone with commercial nous, X-factor, charisma, highly competitive yet technically strong as a sales leader… and the ability to hit a target nobody can yet see possible. This is a rare opportunity to play a pivotal role in leading the region's growth past the hundreds of millions of ARR. Roles of this scale, in a hyper-growth business, simply don’t come around often. Could be a bit of you? 

You’ll be excited by exponential growth, and feel right at home leading on ambitious strategies. When the pressure is on in the biggest moments, you’ll be someone who wants to be in the game. You might find yourself juggling time on farm/ranch with customers, coaching and developing your team, through to driving growth strategy and cross-functional priorities within Halter. You’ll be masterful at building trusting relationships, driving sales processes, managing large pipelines and enabling a team, whilst advocating for customers with a solutions-oriented mindset.

Aside from jumping on the Halter roller coaster, you will be making a real world impact, making farming more productive and sustainable. You will build relationships across the provinces most influential farming leaders, who also happen to be some of the most down to earth, genuine humans you will ever meet. This is a high-stakes role, spearheading Halter’s growth in Central Argentina.

Please submit your CV and application in English. This role works daily with teams in New Zealand, Australia and the US, so professional working English is essential.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Someone who doesn’t believe in glass ceilings and walks towards the pressure of large targets and thrives on hard problems. 

 - Experience in growing new and existing businesses, developing market strategies and more importantly, a track record of delivering high growth.

 - Experience working with customers, navigating complex sales cycles and expanding value over time.

 - Strong ability to work cross-functionally and lead teams.

 - A deep passion for helping farmers succeed. Experience in farm systems or within the agricultural sector would be a bonus. 

 - A phenomenal attitude and a team player with the ability to consistently overcome challenges.

 - The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment with a high degree of autonomy.

 - A hunger for success and personal growth to be able to evolve quickly alongside a world-class sales team.



WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Sales Leadership: Lead sales strategy, setting headcount requirements, regions and working closely with Halter leaders to form targets before laying that out to your team into an inspiring vision.

 - Manage your team’s inputs on a week to week basis, set the team’s cadence, set and track KPI’s and develop excellent pipeline hygiene.

 - Coach and develop your team to become better every week. Adapt Halter’s existing processes to develop and implement training programs for the Central Argentina team, ensuring continuous skill enhancement and alignment with company objectives. Foster a culture of knowledge sharing and collaboration within the sales organisation.

 - Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop the Central Argentina team. Set clear performance expectations, KPIs and provide regular feedback. Lead on hiring and performance management. Foster a positive and collaborative team culture that promotes vulnerability and learning.

 - Account Management: Ensure a seamless and positive customer experience across the entire customer lifecycle. Monitor customer satisfaction levels and implement improvement initiatives continuously. Work closely with your team to resolve any issues and ensure customer retention and expansion. Work in lock step with the Launch, Support and Product functions to ensure tight collaboration across every customer touchpoint.

 - Strategic Leadership: Develop and implement a comprehensive regional strategy to expand our market presence and achieve growth objectives. Identify new market opportunities and drive initiatives to increase market share. Collaborate closely with leaders across Halter to align on goals and objectives.

 - Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with senior leaders, and product and support teams to ensure exceptional results for the Central Argentina.

 - Networking: Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand.


OUR BENEFITS:

 - Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and restricted stock units, so you own a part of what we’re building.

 - Healthy body, healthy mind. You’ll be on the OSDE 410 plan, fully paid by Halter with dependents included, giving you comprehensive maternity cover, dental and vision, and complementary therapies like acupuncture.

postings.title: Senior Recruitment Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
Join Hire Hangar and work with fast-growing global companies while building a long-term career.

Job Title: Senior Recruiter (Client-Facing, Full-Cycle)
Location: Remote
Time Zone: US Time Zones (EST)



Role Overview
We’re looking for a Senior Recruiter to own a set of client accounts and run every search on them from start to finish, on their own. You’ll be your clients’ main point of contact. You’ll take the brief, set expectations, present candidates and close hires. The ideal candidate comes from a recruitment agency or a high-volume hiring environment, has hired for technical roles, and is comfortable running many open roles across several clients at once.



Key Responsibilities

 - Own your client relationships: run intake calls, agree on role requirements, give regular pipeline updates and manage expectations

 - Run the full recruiting cycle on your own: source, screen, interview, coordinate, present candidates and close

 - Manage a high-volume pipeline across multiple open roles and clients at the same time

 - Run structured and technical interviews that test candidates against each client’s needs

 - Advise clients on market conditions, salary ranges and what candidates expect

 - Keep candidates engaged with clear, timely updates at every stage

 - Keep ATS records accurate and report on pipeline progress to clients

 - Suggest process improvements that cut time-to-hire and raise hire quality
   
   

Required Qualifications

 - 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting, ideally at a recruitment or staffing agency, or in high-volume hiring

 - Proven success hiring for technical roles (engineering, data, product or similar)

 - Direct, client-facing experience: comfortable leading calls with hiring managers and senior stakeholders

 - Track record of managing multiple roles and clients at the same time without supervision

 - Strong written and spoken English

 - Prior remote work experience and fluency with Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace and Asana (or similar). Ideally has worked with US or UK-based companies; applications without this experience will not be considered
   
   

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience in client account management or acting as the main contact for client relationships

 - Experience with recruitment metrics and reporting

 - Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean sourcing and modern ATS platforms (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever)
   
   

Please NOTE
It is crucial that you complete the application form in full. As part of the application process, you will be required to record a video. If your application is successful, you will receive an email confirming next steps. The video is the first step of the interview process. If you do not record a video, we will not be able to consider you for ANY open roles.

We connect top talent with vetted employers, competitive pay, and real growth opportunities.

Job Title: Business Systems Analyst (NetSuite)

Location | Remote

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Business Systems Analyst with expert-level NetSuite knowledge to own and improve our business systems. This is a full-time, hands-on role. Your first focus will be helping to lead a chart of accounts and department code restructuring in NetSuite. postings.title: Marketing and Production Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client is a digital advertising and marketing company providing creative production, media buying, and campaign management services across multiple clients and industries. The company works with creative, media, and technology partners to deliver marketing campaigns and is expanding its use of AI-driven creative and asset management tools.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Marketing and Production Coordinator will manage production workflows while creating graphic design assets, social media content, and short-form videos for client campaigns.

This hybrid role combines project coordination with hands-on creative execution. The ideal candidate is organized, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple client projects while producing marketing assets, coordinating vendors, and supporting the Creative Director and company leadership.




LOCATION

Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST | 30 hours a week




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


PRODUCTION COORDINATION & PROJECT MANAGEMENT

 - Coordinate client projects from initial proposals through production and invoicing.

 - Collect and organize client creative assets, campaign specifications, and setup requirements.

 - Place vendor orders and support media buying activities alongside company leadership.

 - Track project deadlines, deliverables, and production status across multiple clients.

 - Participate in internal production meetings and progressively take ownership of meeting coordination.

 - Collaborate with media and programmatic advertising partners.
   
   


GRAPHIC DESIGN & CREATIVE PRODUCTION

 - Create and adapt digital advertising assets, including display ads, social graphics, presentations, and marketing collateral.

 - Produce creative variations through resizing, color adjustments, calls to action, and A/B testing versions.

 - Follow client brand guidelines and style guides to maintain consistency across deliverables.

 - Develop reusable templates and creative workflows to improve production efficiency.

 - Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate creative ideation, production, and asset versioning.
   
   


SOCIAL MEDIA & SHORT-FORM VIDEO

 - Create short-form videos for Reels, Stories, TikTok, and digital advertising campaigns.

 - Repurpose existing footage and event content into multiple short-form assets.

 - Support the Creative Director with social media calendars, captions, carousels, and publishing coordination.

 - Produce social content for client accounts and advertising initiatives.

 - Coordinate creative deliverables across graphic design and video production teams.
   
   


AI TOOLS & MARKETING OPERATIONS

 - Support the rollout of an AI-driven creative and asset management platform.

 - Organize client brand guidelines, campaign objectives, and creative assets within the platform.

 - Help develop campaign roadmaps, production workflows, and repeatable processes.

 - Learn programmatic advertising workflows and client onboarding processes.

 - Develop familiarity with Meta advertising to support potential future in-house campaign management.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - Experience in marketing, creative production, or project coordination across multiple clients or industries.

 - Hands-on experience creating graphic design assets, social media content, and short-form videos.

 - Experience coordinating client deliverables, project timelines, and production workflows.

 - Experience working with client brand guidelines and adapting creative assets across different formats.

 - Experience using project management tools to track deadlines and deliverables.

 - Experience supporting creative or marketing teams in a fast-paced environment.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong graphic design skills for digital advertising, social media, presentations, and marketing collateral.

 - Ability to create and edit short-form videos for Reels, Stories, TikTok, and advertising campaigns.

 - Proficiency in adapting creative assets through resizing, versioning, and A/B testing variations.

 - Ability to organize and manage multiple client projects, deadlines, and production requirements.

 - Understanding of social media content planning, captions, carousels, and publishing workflows.

 - Ability to work with brand guidelines and develop reusable creative templates.

 - Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools and willingness to learn new production technologies.

 - Interest in Meta advertising and programmatic media buying.

 - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

 - Proactive problem-solving skills with the ability to recommend solutions.

 - Ability to coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams.

 - Adaptability and ability to manage changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
   
   


PORTFOLIO RECOMMENDATION

A portfolio demonstrating hands-on experience in graphic design, social media content creation, and short-form video production. Relevant samples include digital advertisements, social graphics, Reels, TikToks, carousels, and creative variations across different brands or campaigns.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 30 DAYS

 - Support the Creative Director in implementing the new AI-driven creative and asset management platform.

 - Organize client brand guidelines, style guides, and campaign objectives within the platform.

 - Begin producing short-form videos, social content, and other creative assets for existing clients.

 - Develop an understanding of programmatic advertising and client onboarding workflows.

 - Support the development of quarterly campaign roadmaps and production workflow documentation.
   
   


OPPORTUNITY

The Marketing and Production Coordinator will have the opportunity to combine creative execution with production management while working closely with the Creative Director and company leadership.

The role is expected to expand within 3–4 months, potentially into a management position or with additional creative support. It offers a long-term growth path toward director-level responsibilities as the company expands.

postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client is a rapidly growing, private equity-backed company specializing in vacant property security solutions, including steel door and window guard systems for commercial and residential properties. As the company expands, it is strengthening its marketing operations, campaign execution, and reporting capabilities to support continued revenue growth.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Growth Marketing Specialist will lead marketing campaign execution, optimize lead generation and nurturing workflows, improve marketing reporting, and support revenue-focused growth initiatives across multiple channels.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, email marketing, and marketing analytics. This individual will work closely with leadership and sales teams to execute campaigns, improve marketing operations, and identify opportunities to increase performance and efficiency.




LOCATION

Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT & EXECUTION

 - Build, launch, and optimize email marketing campaigns across multiple ideal customer profiles and buyer journeys.

 - Coordinate campaign execution within HubSpot and Salesforce, ensuring proper segmentation, scheduling, tracking, and optimization.

 - Manage event campaigns, outbound marketing sequences, and other ongoing marketing initiatives.

 - Maintain the company's LinkedIn presence and weekly social media posting schedule.

 - Identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness through testing and optimization.
   
   


MARKETING ANALYTICS & REPORTING

 - Build and maintain live marketing dashboards and reporting systems within HubSpot and other reporting tools.

 - Track campaign performance metrics, including open rates, click-through rates, bounce rates, unsubscribe rates, conversions, and pipeline attribution.

 - Provide leadership with actionable insights into marketing performance and ROI.

 - Support accurate campaign tracking and lead management across marketing systems.
   
   


PPC & CAMPAIGN OPTIMIZATION

 - Independently manage marketing projects and drive initiatives through completion.

 - Coordinate with external agencies or vendors when needed.

EXPERIENCE

 - Experience supporting lead generation, marketing funnels, and campaign optimization.

 - Experience in B2B marketing environments is preferred.

 - Experience supporting private equity-backed or high-growth companies is a plus.

 - Experience with SEO optimization and blog publishing workflows is preferred.

 - Experience collaborating with external agencies or marketing vendors is a plus.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong proficiency in HubSpot marketing automation, campaign tracking, lead nurturing, and reporting.

 - Ability to maintain CRM workflows, lead routing processes, and marketing attribution systems.

 - Strong understanding of email marketing, audience segmentation, and campaign optimization.

 - Ability to analyze marketing performance metrics and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

The Growth Marketing Specialist will have the opportunity to take ownership of marketing initiatives within a rapidly expanding company, working directly with leadership to improve campaign execution, marketing operations, and revenue performance.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role centered on graphic design, digital creative production, and short-form video editing, rather than copywriting or specialized 3D modeling. The ideal candidate is versatile, detail-oriented, and comfortable transforming existing product imagery, creative briefs, and brand assets into polished marketing content.




LOCATION

DIGITAL & MARKETING CREATIVE

 - Adapt existing product imagery, creative concepts, and brand assets across different channels and formats.

 - Translate marketing briefs into engaging, visually consistent creative materials.

 - Incorporate feedback and revisions while maintaining brand consistency.
   
   


PAID ADVERTISING & CAMPAIGN ASSETS

 - Produce creative variations across different formats, layouts, and visual treatments.

 - Translate product benefits and campaign direction into compelling visuals.

VIDEO EDITING & CONTENT PRODUCTION

 - Transform existing footage, product imagery, and graphics into polished video assets.

WEBSITE & DIGITAL COLLATERAL

 - Develop visual materials supporting product promotions and marketing campaigns.

 - Follow established brand guidelines and design systems to ensure consistency.
   
   


CREATIVE WORKFLOW & COLLABORATION

 - Collaborate with marketing teams and creative resources to understand project briefs, priorities, and deadlines.

 - Manage multiple creative requests while maintaining quality and meeting delivery timelines.

 - Organize working files, source materials, and final creative assets.

QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - Experience creating visual assets for digital marketing, paid advertising, email campaigns, websites, or social media.

 - Hands-on experience editing short-form videos and promotional content.

 - Experience adapting existing imagery and creative assets for different marketing channels.

 - A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, digital marketing creative, and video editing work.

 - Experience with consumer products, e-commerce, home improvement, or related brands is preferred.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Proficiency with Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Canva, or similar design platforms.

postings.title: Head Social Commerce
postings.descriptionText:
En Bidcom, empresa líder en E-commerce y tecnología, impulsamos constantemente el desarrollo digital a través de marcas de gran alcance como Gadnic. Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un Head Social Commerce para sumarse a un entorno altamente dinámico, innovador y orientado a resultados, ideal para profesionales que buscan desafiar sus límites y marcar un impacto directo en el negocio.

Tareas y Responsabilidades
Articulación, Gestión y Resultados

• Definir y reportar los KPIs clave del área a la Dirección: venta atribuida a contenido, creators y afiliados; CTR y conversión desde social; costo por contenido; ROI por creator; y crecimiento de comunidad.

• Establecer la verticalización del contenido por categoría de producto, acordando con el área Comercial qué productos empujar, con qué precio y en qué momento.

• Alinear con Performance qué piezas orgánicas y de creators se amplifican con pauta publicitaria, integrando los aprendizajes de los formatos que convierten al plan de contenido.

• Gestionar la relación con agencias y proveedores de contenido: negociar contratos y costos, fijar estándares de calidad y plazos, y escalar en caso de desvíos.

• Liderar y desarrollar al equipo de 3 personas a cargo: definir prioridades y objetivos, revisar resultados, brindar feedback continuo y acompañar su crecimiento.

• Impulsar la incorporación de herramientas y automatizaciones que permitan escalar los programas (plataformas de influencers, tracking de afiliados, flujos de DM).

Estrategia Creativa

• Definir y liderar la estrategia creativa de Social: conceptos, formatos, narrativas y tono de cada plataforma, con contenido pensado nativamente para redes.

• Construir y mantener un sistema de formatos comerciales escalables (hooks, estructuras de video, demos de producto, comparativas, reviews, tendencias y series recurrentes) con lineamientos claros para el equipo, la agencia y los creators.

• Detectar tendencias y formatos emergentes, asegurando que el equipo los capitalice de manera ágil y con criterio de marca.

• Liderar una dinámica de test & learn creativo: plantear hipótesis, probar variantes, analizar resultados y escalar lo que funciona en orgánico, creators y pauta.

• Definir los briefs y la dirección creativa para creators UGC/EGC e influencers, equilibrando la libertad creativa con los mensajes comerciales y claims de producto.

• Elevar la vara creativa del área: revisar piezas, dar feedback de idea y ejecución, y combinar producción de estudio con contenido espontáneo según los objetivos.

Contenido, Creators y Afiliados

• Definir y liderar el plan de contenido comercial en video vertical (TikTok, Reels, Shorts), asegurando que el equipo y proveedores sostengan una salida diaria de alto volumen con calidad y alineada a la marca.

• Liderar el programa de creators UGC/EGC e influencers: definir perfiles, criterios de selección, esquemas de contratación y evaluación por resultados, garantizando que el equipo gestione el scouting y las entregas.

• Diseñar y liderar el programa de afiliados: definir el modelo de comisiones, premios por objetivos, reglas del programa y metas de crecimiento, supervisando al equipo a cargo del reclutamiento, activación y seguimiento.

• Armar la estrategia de Live Shopping y de los canales de venta nativos (TikTok Shop, Instagram Shopping, YouTube Shopping): definir formatos, calendario y recursos, y asegurar su correcta ejecución.

Requisitos

• Experiencia: Más de 4 años en Social Media, Influencer Marketing o Social Commerce dentro del rubro E-commerce o Consumo Masivo.

• Liderazgo: Experiencia previa liderando equipos directos y gestionando agencias o proveedores de contenido.

• Conocimientos técnicos: Dominio en estrategia creativa para video vertical, analítica y métricas de atribución (GA4, Meta Business Suite, TikTok Analytics) y gestión de programas de afiliados o creators.

• Deseable: Experiencia previa en agencias creativas, manejo de herramientas/plataformas de influencers (Modash, Influencity), automatizaciones (ManyChat, Zapier) o TikTok Shop / Live Shopping.

• Competencias: Orientación a resultados medibles de conversión, capacidad de adaptación a cambios de algoritmo, mentalidad hands-on y pensamiento innovador.

Beneficios Corporativos

• Cobertura médica prepaga de primer nivel.

• Descuentos corporativos en productos de la compañía.

• Posibilidades reales de crecimiento y desarrollo en una empresa líder.

Información de la Vacante

postings.title: Analista de Influencers y Afiliados
postings.descriptionText:
El/La Analista de Influencers y Afiliados es responsable del seguimiento operativo y analítico de los programas de afiliados de la compañía. Estos se componen de: El Programa de Mercado Libre y el Programa propio de la nuestra tienda online.

La persona responsable lleva el registro de afiliados, links, códigos y comisiones, consolida las ventas atribuidas a cada uno y reporta los resultados al equipo.

Es el punto de contacto diario de los afiliados: los acompaña en el alta, les comparte materiales y novedades de producto y detecta oportunidades para que vendan más. A partir de los datos, propone mejoras al tracking y a la operación de ambos programas.
Responsabilidades y Funciones:

• Administrar la base de afiliados de Mercado Libre y del programa propio: datos de contacto, perfil, canal, links y códigos asignados, nivel de comisión y estado (activo, en pausa o baja).

• Gestionar el alta y onboarding de nuevos afiliados en ambos programas: invitación, generación de links y códigos de seguimiento, y envío de lineamientos de marca y materiales.

• Hacer el seguimiento de ventas atribuidas por afiliado, canal y SKU, cruzando los reportes de Mercado Libre con los datos de la tienda propia.

• Controlar que el tracking funcione: links rotos, códigos que no registran ventas, pedidos sin atribuir o duplicados.

• Escalar los problemas a Tecnología cuando corresponda.

• Calcular y validar las comisiones del programa propio, preparar las liquidaciones y gestionar la facturación de los afiliados (recepción de facturas, alta de proveedores) junto a Administración.

• Armar reportes semanales y mensuales de performance: ventas, conversión, ticket promedio, comisiones pagadas y retorno por afiliado, comparando Mercado Libre y canal propio.

• Mantener el contacto diario con los afiliados y llevar el calendario de comunicaciones del programa: lanzamientos, promociones y fechas comerciales (Hot Sale, CyberMonday, Black Friday).

• Identificar a los afiliados con mejor desempeño y proponer incentivos o premios por objetivos para escalar sus ventas; detectar afiliados inactivos y planificar su reactivación.

• Monitorear que el contenido de los afiliados respete los lineamientos de marca y las condiciones de cada programa.

• Coordinar con Comercial los productos y precios a empujar en cada programa, y con Social, Paid Media e Influencers para alinear contenidos y acciones.

Requisitos excluyentes:

• 1 a 2 años de experiencia en afiliados, e-commerce, marketplaces o marketing de performance; gestión operativa de programas de afiliados (altas, links, códigos y comisiones)

• Conocimiento del ecosistema de Mercado Libre (publicaciones, ventas y reportes)

• Excel o Google Sheets intermedio-avanzado (tablas dinámicas, BUSCARV, cruce de bases)

• Métricas de e-commerce (conversión, ticket promedio, ventas atribuidas, comisiones)

• Experiencia en análisis de datos en hojas de cálculo

• Suite Google Workspace / Office.

Competencias y habilidades:

• Comunicación escrita clara y profesional

• Atención al detalle y follow-up

• Prolijidad en conciliación de datos y liquidaciones.

Requisitos deseables:

• Experiencia con plataformas de afiliados o tracking (Dub, Impact, Awin, UTMs)

• Inglés intermedio

• Looker Studio u otra herramienta de dashboards y nociones de SQL

• Nociones de Influencer Marketing y Social Commerce

• Familiaridad con herramientas de IA para automatizar reportes y ordenar datos.

Modalidad de Trabajo:

• Full-time: 9 a 18 hrs

• Modelo Híbrido (Presencial 2 veces a la semana en barrio Saavedra)

postings.title: ANALISTA DE OFICINA TECNICA - ESPECIALIDAD PIPING
postings.descriptionText:
¡En PECOM Ingeniería y Construcción , nos gustan los desafíos! Desarrollamos soluciones para la industria energética, basadas en el conocimiento y la tecnología. Formamos parte del grupo de empresas de Pilar, Rosario y Luis Pérez Companc. Somos un equipo diverso que lleva adelante proyectos desafiantes, siempre con foco en las necesidades de nuestros clientes. Es por eso que queremos sumar a nuestro equipo un ANALISTA DE OFICINA TECNICA - ESPECIALIDAD PIPING, para un Proyecto en Rincon de los Sauces.
Nos orientamos a perfiles con formación técnica y experiencia en Oficina Técnica, Ingeniería de Obra o documentación técnica, preferentemente en proyectos de Oil & Gas, que cuenten con capacidad para interpretar documentación de ingeniería y brindar soporte a los equipos durante las distintas etapas de ejecución de obra.

Principales responsabilidades

• Brindar soporte técnico a la obra mediante el seguimiento, control y actualización de planos y documentación de ingeniería.

• Realizar relevamientos en campo, confeccionar croquis y recopilar información para el desarrollo de ingeniería constructiva.

• Revisar planos y documentación técnica, identificando inconsistencias, faltantes o posibles desvíos y proponiendo alternativas de solución.

• Asegurar la disponibilidad y utilización de la documentación vigente para la ejecución de los trabajos.

• Registrar y comunicar modificaciones en la documentación de ingeniería una vez emitida para construcción.

• Preparar paquetes de documentación técnica para talleres de prefabricado y premoldeado.

• Gestionar y realizar el seguimiento de órdenes de trabajo, materiales y documentación asociada.

• Participar en reuniones de coordinación con las áreas de Obra, Ingeniería, Programación, Precomisionado y Comisionado.

• Realizar el seguimiento de observaciones y restricciones (HOLDs), verificando su liberación antes de la ejecución de los trabajos.

• Brindar soporte técnico y documental a los equipos de obra, prefabricado y comisionado.

• Participar en la elaboración de Red Marks y documentación Conforme a Obra (CAO).

• Utilizar herramientas de diseño y modelado para realizar consultas y aclaraciones técnicas.

Requisitos

• Formación como Técnico, Maestro Mayor de Obras, Técnico Mecánico, Proyectista o carreras afines.

• Experiencia previa en Oficina Técnica, Ingeniería de Obra, Piping, prefabricados o gestión de documentación técnica.

• Experiencia en interpretación, revisión y actualización de planos y documentación de ingeniería.

• Conocimientos de procesos constructivos e interacción con equipos de obra y/o talleres de prefabricado.

• Manejo de AutoCAD. Se valorará experiencia en CadWorx y herramientas de modelado 3D.

• Conocimientos en gestión de documentación técnica, órdenes de trabajo y control de materiales.

• Se valorará experiencia en proyectos de Oil & Gas, especialmente en Upstream/Midstream, ductos, líneas de captación, inyección de agua o gas lift.

• Inglés técnico, preferentemente.

• Licencia de conducir vigente.

• Disponibilidad para realizar desplazamientos y traslados a obra según los requerimientos del proyecto.

Competencias valoradas

• Capacidad de organización, planificación y seguimiento.

• Orientación al detalle y análisis de documentación técnica.

• Autonomía para identificar desvíos, inconsistencias y necesidades de información.

• Comunicación efectiva y habilidades de coordinación con equipos multidisciplinarios.

• Trabajo en equipo y orientación a resultados.

postings.title: Customer Growth Specialist, Americas
postings.descriptionText:
Suessa is looking for a Customer Growth Specialist, Americas for a Global B2B SaaS Company
About the Company
Our client is a compliance-grade fixed asset depreciation and lease accounting platform built for CFOs, Financial Controllers, and Finance Directors. Their customers are compliance-driven, relying on the platform for critical regulatory requirements such as IFRS 16, IRS depreciation schedules, and year-end close. They are an Australian-founded, fully remote company trusted by over a thousand businesses and accounting firms across the US, Canada, the UK, Australia, New Zealand, and South Africa. They are growing rapidly and intentionally building out their commercial team.
About the Role
If you have worked as an Account Executive, Account Manager, or Business Development Manager in SaaS or fintech and want a role where the commercial result is the primary focus, this is for you.
This is a quota-carrying, commercial role within their Customer Success team, covering the Americas. You will own a book of business, convert inbound leads into customers, get them live, and grow existing accounts to make renewals straightforward. You will be engaging directly with senior finance buyers in the US and Canada on multi-year deals where their product sits at the center of the customer's compliance and year-end close process.
What You'll Do

• Convert Trials and Inbound Enquiries: Own the 30-day trial experience for North American prospects. Identify the compliance deadlines driving their evaluation, connect the product to their needs, and close the deal before inertia sets in.

• Get New Customers Live: Manage the implementation process from signed deal to first value. You will run the kick-off, assist with setting up and importing asset registers and leases, and collaborate with their support and product teams when specialist help is needed.

• Retain and Grow Your Book: Manage a portfolio of North American accounts across their full lifecycle. Run regular check-ins, spot expansion signals early (e.g., untapped lease portfolios, upgrading monthly users to annual plans), and ensure there are no surprises at renewal time.

• Maintain CRM Accuracy: Meticulously keep your pipeline, activities, and forecast updated in HubSpot.

What You Bring

• Commercial Background: Proven experience as an Account Executive, Account Manager, Sales Development Rep, or CSM with a quota attached to your name.

• Accounting/Finance Qualification: A degree in accounting or a Contador Público qualification is highly desirable to give you instant credibility with finance buyers.

• Finance Engagement: Experience having commercial conversations with CFOs, Financial Controllers, or Finance Directors. You know what creates urgency for them and how year-end decisions are made.

• Tech/SaaS Experience: Background in a SaaS, fintech, or software company with the ability to confidently learn and demonstrate a product (experience with tools like Xero, QuickBooks Online, or Sage Intacct is a plus).

• Clear Communication: Fluent professional English (written and spoken) is required, as you will write proposals and lead video calls with North American clients daily.

• Strategic Thinking & Reliability: You know the difference between a champion and an economic buyer, can manage your own pipeline independently, and consistently do what you say you will do.

Working Hours

• 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, aligned to cover the North American business day

• Standard shifts (3 days a week): 10:00 to 18:00 ART

• Overlap shifts (2 fixed days a week): 12:00 to 20:00 ART (to facilitate coaching and pipeline reviews with the Head of Customer Success in Queensland, Australia)

Location: Argentina.

postings.title: Senior ServiceNow CMDB & Discovery Specialist (Remote-LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
Spoiler: This is where your next big move begins.
What this Journey Looks Like
At Pearster , we connect talented professionals from around the world with exciting opportunities at international companies. We are a dynamic, people-oriented team passionate about building meaningful professional connections and creating a positive employee experience.
We are looking for a Senior Configuration Management Analyst (CMDB & Discovery) to join our growing international team and support the administration, governance, and continuous improvement of enterprise Configuration Management processes.
This role combines ServiceNow CMDB administration, Discovery, Service Mapping, ITSM governance, and cloud infrastructure management . You will be responsible for ensuring accurate, complete, and reliable configuration data across complex enterprise environments, supporting critical IT operations and service management processes.
We are looking for someone with strong technical expertise in ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery, and Configuration Management , along with excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve data quality, operational visibility, and ITSM efficiency.
What You'll Lead and Build

• Define and maintain CMDB standards, policies, Configuration Item (CI) classifications, ownership models, and lifecycle processes.

• Lead the administration, governance, and continuous improvement of the ServiceNow Configuration Management Database (CMDB).

• Coordinate Configuration Control Board (CCB) meetings and drive the resolution of configuration data quality issues.

• Administer, configure, and optimize ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, MID Servers, discovery patterns, and integrations .

• Identify and resolve discovery gaps across infrastructure, cloud environments, networks, databases, and enterprise applications.

• Troubleshoot discovery failures, CI identification issues, and reconciliation conflicts to ensure accurate configuration records.

• Maintain accurate service maps, CI relationships, and dependencies across enterprise technology environments.

• Monitor CMDB health and implement controls to improve data completeness, correctness, compliance, and overall reliability.

• Proactively identify and remediate duplicate CIs, outdated records, missing ownership information, and orphaned relationships.

• Develop dashboards, reports, and performance metrics to monitor CMDB effectiveness and support governance decisions.

• Support discovery and configuration governance across AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud environments .

• Improve visibility and tracking of external-facing assets, including public IP addresses, DNS records, URLs, and third-party hosted services.

• Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, Network, Database, and Application teams to maintain accurate enterprise asset information.

• Ensure CMDB data effectively supports Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, and Service Management processes .

• Identify opportunities to automate configuration management activities and improve operational efficiency.

• Provide technical guidance, training, and consultation on Configuration Management best practices.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, governance standards, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.

• Work closely with international stakeholders to drive CMDB maturity, data integrity, and continuous process improvement.

What You Bring to the Table

• Advanced English (C1) – excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 5+ years of experience in Configuration Management, ServiceNow CMDB administration, Discovery, or related ITSM roles.

• Degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow CMDB , including configuration governance, CI lifecycle management, and data quality processes.

• Experience administering ServiceNow Discovery and/or Service Mapping , including MID Servers, discovery patterns, and integrations.

• Solid understanding of CMDB Health, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE) , and configuration data reconciliation.

• Strong knowledge of ITIL Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM) principles and best practices.

• Experience defining and maintaining CI classifications, ownership models, relationships, and configuration standards.

• Familiarity with AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud infrastructure environments .

• Good understanding of Windows, Linux, networking, databases, and enterprise infrastructure technologies.

• Experience troubleshooting discovery issues, duplicate configuration items, and data integrity challenges.

• Ability to develop reports, dashboards, and KPIs to monitor CMDB performance and data quality.

• Experience integrating CMDB processes with Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management.

• ITIL Foundation Certification (required).

• Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.

• Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and make sound decisions in complex technical environments.

• Strong ownership mindset, organizational skills, and commitment to continuous improvement.

• Experience working with international teams in dynamic enterprise environments.

At Pearster, your journey matters, and we’re here to help you go further than you imagined.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an IP Lawyer to own the protection of our brands. You will handle escalated infringement cases and manage our IP portfolio – mainly trademarks and copyright – from filing to enforcement. You will work closely with our brand protection team, which handles first-line monitoring and complaints, and with external IP agents. This is a hands-on role with a high level of ownership: you will make decisions on cases yourself and help build how IP protection works across our brands.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Escalated IP cases. Take over infringement cases that the first line cannot resolve: copies of our websites and content, misuse of our trademarks, infringing ads and domains. Prepare legal letters and cease-and-desist demands, file UDRP and similar domain complaints, and choose the right route for non-standard cases.

 - IP portfolio. Manage our trademarks and copyright: prepare and support filings and registrations, track deadlines, renewals and office actions, and keep the portfolio up to date.

 - Brand strategy. Build an IP protection strategy for each brand: where and what to register, what to monitor and how to enforce.

 - External counsel. Work with external IP agents and lawyers in different countries: set tasks, check the quality of their work and keep track of deadlines and costs.

 - Support the team. Help the first-line team handle more complex cases and review open cases with them regularly.

 - Processes. Keep templates, playbooks and case records up to date, and suggest ways to automate routine work.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2+ years of legal practice, ideally in intellectual property, brand protection or a tech or e-commerce company.

 - Experience drafting legal letters, complaints and other legal documents in English.

 - A law degree.

 - English at B1 level or higher – written and spoken.

 - Strong attention to detail and accuracy with deadlines.

 - Ownership: you take a case from start to finish without being reminded.

 - Ability to work independently, prioritise many cases at once and explain legal risk in plain language.

 - Comfortable using AI tools and online research in daily work.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Background in intellectual property: trademark filing, copyright, online enforcement or domain disputes (UDRP).

 - Experience with trademark offices such as USPTO, EUIPO and UKIPO.

 - Experience in a subscription, tech or e-commerce business.


LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.




BENEFITS

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

 - Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance. 

 - Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days. 

 - Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge. 

 - Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them. 

 - Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!




INTERVIEW PROCESS

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

 - Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

 - Final Interview with the Hiring Manager (60 minutes)




LIFE AT RUBY LABS

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

Analizar y procesar insumos necesarios para calculo de factores de importación para mercancías y proporcionar soporte a equipo comercial de importaciones para la toma de decisiones basada en información precisa y en tiempo.

postings.title: Senior Business Analyst – Fixed Income / Interest Rate Swaps
postings.descriptionText:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to join the team and contribute to a key project within the Fixed Income markets.
In this role, you will work closely with Front Office stakeholders, particularly traders, as well as technical teams, to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions that meet business needs. You will be responsible for gathering, analysing, documenting and communicating business requirements, ensuring alignment between business stakeholders and software development teams.
The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Interest Rate Swaps (IRS), electronic pre-trade and post-trade flows, and Fixed Income markets , together with proven experience as a Business Analyst within Front Office development teams, ideally in a trading floor environment.
You will collaborate with teams across LATAM (Mexico, Brazil and Chile) and the UK , playing a key role in ensuring effective communication and successful project delivery.
Key Responsibilities

• Work closely with Front Office business users, particularly traders, to understand, gather and analyse business requirements.

• Translate business needs into clear and structured functional requirements, user stories and use cases.

• Collaborate with project teams to ensure business requirements are properly reflected in project planning, priorities and roadmaps.

• Work closely with software development teams to communicate requirements, clarify business needs and ensure solutions are delivered as expected.

• Facilitate communication between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring a shared understanding of project objectives and deliverables.

• Apply industry best practices for requirements gathering, documentation and business analysis.

• Establish and maintain Business Analysis governance processes.

• Provide backup support as a local Subject Matter Expert (SME) to the existing Level 1 Trading Floor Support teams.

Requirements

• At least 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst within Financial Markets, preferably in Fixed Income.

• At least 5 years of experience and expert-level product knowledge of Interest Rate Swaps (IRS) .

• Strong understanding of electronic pre-trade and post-trade workflows.

• Solid knowledge of Fixed Income trading concepts and terminology, including:

• Interest Rate Swaps (IRS).

• Request for Quote (RFQ).

• Bid/Ask pricing.

• Client Tiering.

• Trading Venues.

• Swap valuation and pricing mechanisms.

• Proven experience working as a hands-on Business Analyst within Front Office development teams, ideally in a trading floor environment.

• Experience working in Agile environments, with strong expertise in writing user stories, use cases and functional specifications.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with Front Office traders and technical teams.

• English level: C1 or above.

Nice to Have

• Previous experience as a Business Analyst in Fixed Income projects.

• Experience working with Middle Office and Back Office stakeholders.

• Experience supporting trading floor environments and interacting with Level 1 support teams.

What do we offer you?

• B2B contract

• 100% Remote

• Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

If you have read this far and you are looking forward to joining this challenge, do not hesitate to apply... we would be delighted to meet you!

In this role, you will work on innovative AI-driven automation initiatives, building intelligent and self-sufficient agents capable of integrating with enterprise systems and supporting complex business processes.
You will be involved throughout the full development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design to implementation, testing, deployment, and optimization. You will also collaborate closely with technical and business stakeholders to identify opportunities where agentic AI can improve workflows, decision-making, operational efficiency, and overall business value.

• Design, develop, and deploy advanced agentic AI solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio.

• Build intelligent and autonomous AI agents capable of integrating with different enterprise systems and business applications.

• Lead the architectural design and implementation of complex conversational AI and autonomous agent workflows.

• Collaborate with product managers, technical teams, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

• Integrate AI agents with Microsoft and Azure services, APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.

• Implement robust testing strategies, including unit, integration, and user acceptance testing, to ensure reliability and high performance.
