Analista de Supply Chain





En ARAUCO re­conocemos a la persona desde su individualidad y diversidad. Creemos que la contribución de cada una es única, y que los equipos se enriquecen cuando son capaces de integrar miradas y capacidades diferentes. Consider a m os la inclusión y la diversidad como aspectos fundamentales para el logro de los desafíos presentes y futuros.













Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un nuevo talento para la Gerencia de Supply Chain. Se incorporará al área desempeñándose en las oficinas corporativas ubicadas en Vicente López, Buenos Aires.



Sus principales responsabilidades serán:

•Administrar y realizar la comunicación de proyectos, controlando su avance y creando presentaciones de follow-up.

•Optimizar la eficiencia de los procesos logísticos, mejorar el servicio al cliente interno y externo e identificar oportunidades de mejora.

•Analizar y controlar costos logísticos.

•Gestionar y mantener las aplicaciones de la gerencia en Qliksense.



Qué buscamos?




•Formación universitaria en curso o finalizada en Comercio Internacional, Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas, o afín al sector logístico.

•Experiencia previa en el rol (deseable).

•Nivel de Inglés Intermedio.

•Conocimientos en Qliksense y Python (no excluyente)

•Competencias: Planificación y organización, Flexibilidad, Iniciativa y Capacidad de análisis.




Ofrecemos:





• Cobertura de salud prepaga


• Bono anual, sujeto a resultados de compañía y objetivos.


• Modalidad hibrida 3x2


• Beneficio de Almuerzo, snacks y frutas todos los días.


• Regalos y sorteos en fechas especiales.


• Alianzas con instituciones educativas.


•



Sumate!

#LI-GM1









En ARAUCO trabajamos día a día para desarrollar productos forestales renovables que permitan mejorar la vida de las personas, tarea que nos desafía a tener equipos comprometidos, entusiastas y creativos. Somos una empresa global con mas de 50 años de trayectoria, con operaciones y clientes en distintos países, única por una misma cultura organizacional. Por ello, trabajamos en propiciar las condiciones necesarias para atraer y desarrollar personas en ambientes laborales basados en el respeto, la colaboración, y la comunicación permanente.


Somos la primer empresa forestal CARBONO NEUTRAL y esto significa un aporte concreto en la lucha contra el cambio climático. En Arauco el cuidado del planeta y las personas es prioridad.

postings.title: Ingeniero de excelencia operacional
postings.descriptionText:
Quiénes somos



AngloGold Ashanti es una compañía minera global de oro con una cartera diversificada de operaciones de alta calidad, proyectos y actividades de exploración en 10 países a lo largo de cuatro continentes. Buscamos constantemente oportunidades para crear valor a través de otros minerales, apalancando nuestros activos, habilidades y sólida experiencia en el sector.



En AngloGold Ashanti, aseguramos un entorno de trabajo significativo que genera resultados tangibles, entendiendo que nuestra labor trasciende la minería:





• Impacto Social y Económico: Construimos medios de vida en las comunidades, defendemos una gestión ambiental responsable y fortalecemos las economías tanto locales como nacionales.


• Cultura Colaborativa: Nuestros líderes y equipos están comprometidos con la escucha activa y el apoyo mutuo, valorando la diversidad y promoviendo la equidad en cada acción.


• Bienestar Integral: Estamos convencidos de que la excelencia solo se alcanza cuando priorizamos el bienestar de cada persona y fomentamos comportamientos basados en el respeto.





Sobre Cerro Vanguardia



Cerro Vanguardia es una empresa minera argentina dedicada a la exploración y tratamiento de oro y plata en la provincia de Santa Cruz. Desde 1998, funciona como un motor de desarrollo regional, promoviendo la explotación responsable de recursos y el crecimiento de comunidades como Puerto San Julián. Su misión se centra en generar valor para sus empleados y accionistas garantizando un ambiente seguro y protegido.



Conozca más sobre nuestra visión, propósito y valores - AngloGold Ashanti




Visión general del puesto:

Contribuir a la eficiencia y productividad de las operaciones mineras mediante el diseño, implementación y seguimiento de iniciativas de mejora continua. La función implica identificar oportunidades de optimización en los procesos de mina, planta y mantenimiento, reducir costos operativos y fortalecer los estándares de seguridad. A través del análisis de indicadores, la estandarización de procesos y la gestión de proyectos, se busca promover la excelencia operacional y una cultura de mejora continua en la organización.

Propósito del rol:

Impulsar la mejora continua de las operaciones mediante la identificación de oportunidades, optimización de procesos y gestión de proyectos orientados a incrementar la productividad, reducir costos y mejorar la seguridad. Promover la implementación de metodologías y herramientas que contribuyan a la eficiencia operacional y al cumplimiento de los objetivos de la compañía.

Principales responsabilidades:

- Diseñar, implementar y realizar el seguimiento de iniciativas y proyectos de mejora continua.
- Identificar pérdidas, ineficiencias y cuellos de botella en los procesos de mina, planta y mantenimiento.
- Definir, medir y analizar indicadores clave de desempeño (KPI).
- Liderar proyectos de optimización de costos, productividad y eficiencia operacional.
- Estandarizar procesos y procedimientos operativos, promoviendo buenas prácticas de trabajo.
- Aplicar metodologías Lean y Six Sigma para identificar oportunidades de mejora.
- Capacitar y acompañar a los equipos en la implementación de herramientas y cultura de mejora continua.
- Coordinar reuniones de seguimiento y articulación con las distintas áreas operativas.
- Elaborar informes y presentar avances, resultados e indicadores de gestión a la gerencia.
- Evaluar el impacto de las mejoras implementadas y asegurar el seguimiento de los resultados obtenidos.

Requisitos obligatorios:

- Título universitario de Ingeniero/a Mecánico/a o Electromecánico/a.
- Experiencia mínima de 2 años en minería o industria pesada.
- Experiencia en gestión de proyectos de mejora continua o excelencia operacional.
- Conocimientos de metodologías Lean y Six Sigma.
- Manejo avanzado de Microsoft Excel y herramientas de análisis de datos.
- Capacidad para coordinar proyectos con múltiples áreas y presentar resultados a niveles gerenciales.
- Disponibilidad para trabajar bajo régimen en sitio.
- Residencia en Santa Cruz o disponibilidad para radicarse en la provincia.

Cualificaciones deseables:

- Certificaciones en Lean Management, Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt o TPM.
- Experiencia específica en operaciones mineras.
- Manejo de Power BI y otras herramientas de análisis de datos.
- Conocimientos de SAP.
- Inglés intermedio/avanzado.
- Experiencia en gestión del cambio organizacional.
- Capacidad analítica y pensamiento crítico.
- Liderazgo, comunicación efectiva y trabajo en equipo.
- Proactividad, orientación a resultados y resolución de problemas.

Condiciones de la posición:

- Modalidad de trabajo bajo régimen en sitio.
- Lugar de trabajo: provincia de Santa Cruz.
- Residencia en la provincia o disponibilidad para relocalizarse a San Julian, Santa Cruz.
- Diagrama 12x9, jornada de 12 horas, turno diurno.
- Responsabilidad sobre la coordinación y seguimiento de proyectos de mejora continua y excelencia operacional.


Beneficios y Compromiso con el Colaborador y la Comunidad



Cerro Vanguardia prioriza la calidad de vida y el bienestar integral de sus colaboradores, ofreciendo iniciativas orientadas al desarrollo, salud, apoyo familiar y fortalecimiento del ambiente laboral. Entre las principales acciones se destacan programas de vínculo familiar, monitoreo ambiental participativo, asistencia integral al empleado, bienestar personal, asesoramiento técnico y gestión de liderazgo.



Además, la compañía brinda acceso a servicios especializados de salud, apoyo psicológico, nutricional y asesoramiento profesional para empleados y sus familias, reforzando su compromiso con un entorno seguro, colaborativo y sostenible. Los programas e iniciativas están sujetos a las políticas internas y criterios aplicables de Cerro Vanguardia.



Declaración de Igualdad de Oportunidades de Empleo



Estamos transformando la minería con una cultura de equidad, inclusión y respeto. Valoramos a cada persona y creemos que la diversidad de historias, ideas y perspectivas impulsa nuestro crecimiento.

postings.title: Optomechanical Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Mechanical Department - Optomechanics Team

Optomechanical Engineer (f/m/d)

About Satellogic

Satellogic is a vertically integrated Earth Observation company that designs, manufactures, and operates satellite systems, delivering decision-grade insights at scale to government and commercial customers.

We build space systems end-to-end, from satellite design and manufacturing to launch and on-orbit operations, giving us the ability to deploy quickly, operate reliably, and support persistent monitoring across regions and priority areas. Our approach moves customers beyond one-off imagery toward continuous awareness and alert-driven decision-making, with flexible pathways that can evolve from managed monitoring to full satellite ownership and sovereign control.

Our technology supports a wide range of use cases across climate monitoring, agriculture, energy, infrastructure, defense and intelligence, helping organizations detect change, manage risk, and plan with confidence.

With a team distributed across five countries, Satellogic brings together expertise in satellite engineering, software development, data science, manufacturing, operations, and go-to-market. We’re a group of purpose-driven builders who value ownership, curiosity, and execution—and who work with humility, honesty, and empathy.

About the team

Our Optomechanics team is responsible for the design, analysis, and verification of the optomechanical systems of the satellite's payload. This includes lens and mirror mounts, telescope support and metering structures, focus mechanisms, and the alignment of optical assemblies, ensuring that optical performance is preserved during launch and in the harsh conditions of space.

The team works at the intersection of optics, mechanical design, analysis, and testing, collaborating closely with the Mechanical Design, Structural and Thermal teams to deliver high-performance, space-qualified hardware. From early-stage concept design through to final alignment and environmental testing, we take a hands-on approach to engineering, ensuring our systems are robust, manufacturable, and aligned with the company's production and mission timelines.

Key responsibilities of the team include:

• Definition of optomechanical requirements, error budgets, and verification & validation plans.

• Designing optical mounts, telescope structures and focus mechanisms for lenses and mirrors.

• Performing structural, thermal and STOP (Structural-Thermal-Optical Performance) analyses to predict optical performance under launch and on-orbit conditions.

• Defining optomechanical interfaces and ensuring proper integration with the optical design and other satellite subsystems.

• Working closely with mechanical design, structural and thermal teams to ensure proper system integration and manufacturability.

• Supporting manufacturing and AIT (Assembly, Integration, and Testing) teams during alignment, integration and environmental testing of optical payloads.

• Continuously improving optomechanical design methodologies and product reliability based on flight heritage and manufacturing feedback.

We value engineers who combine technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and a strong attention to detail. The work we do has a direct impact on mission success—and we're looking for people who are ready to make that impact.

The team is always learning and trying to push the limits, relying in part on the large diversity of people’s profiles and backgrounds.

About the position

We are seeking an Optomechanical Engineer with proven experience in the aerospace sector and a strong background in space optical instruments and telescopes to join our Optomechanics team. You will own the optomechanical design of our telescopes and optical assemblies, including optics of up to 600 mm in diameter, from concept through detailed design, alignment, environmental qualification and flight acceptance. You will work closely with the entire Mechanical Department, absorbing know-how and leveraging capabilities.

The position has strong growth potential, with the possibility of assuming greater responsibilities in the future within the Optomechanics area.

Location

Preferably based in Argentina (hybrid work). Candidates based anywhere in Europe will also be considered. Satellogic’s office locations include Buenos Aires, Barcelona, Montevideo, Cordoba (ARG).

Due to export control regulations (ITAR), this position is not open to U.S. persons.

Willingness and ability to travel domestically and/or internationally to company offices, laboratories, client sites, potential clients, or suppliers as needed. This role will also require travel to our laboratory in Uruguay for alignment, integration and test activities.

Responsibilities

• Design optomechanical assemblies for space telescopes and optical instruments (mirrors, lenses, windows, filters, focal plane interfaces), from conceptual design to detailed design and qualification.

• Design lens and mirror mounts (kinematic, semi-kinematic, flexure-based and bonded) that minimize mount-induced distortion, including large mirrors of up to 600 mm in diameter.

• Design low-distortion flexures, bipods, metering structures and manual/motorized focus mechanisms, applying athermal design principles.

• Select materials and adhesives for precision space optics (CTE matching, dimensional stability, outgassing, bond-line design), such as Zerodur, ULE, SiC, aluminium, titanium, Invar and CFRP.

• Perform structural and thermal finite element analyses of optical systems (modal, quasi-static, random vibration, thermo-elastic) and support STOP analyses together with the Structural and Thermal teams.

• Define and run optomechanical tolerance analyses and error budgets (decenter, tilt, despace, surface figure, stability) in close collaboration with the optical designers.

• Define alignment and integration strategies and support hands-on alignment, integration and environmental testing (vibration, thermal vacuum) in the clean room, correlating test results with analysis models.

• Generate detailed drawings and specifications of optical and mechanical parts applying GD&T and ISO 10110, and act as technical interface with optics and precision-mechanics suppliers.

• Document analyses, generate technical reports, and keep the PLM/CAD system up to date with optomechanical data.

• Work as a team with the mechanical design, structural and thermal teams to ensure an integrated and consistent design.

About you

Experience

• Degree in Mechanical/Aeronautical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics or a related field, with a specialization in Optomechanics or Precision Engineering.

• 3 to 6 years of proven experience as an optomechanical engineer in the aerospace sector.

• Demonstrable participation in at least one space or airborne optical instrument project (telescope, camera, spectrometer, radiometer, LIDAR or similar), ideally covering the full cycle from design to qualification testing.

• Proven experience designing optical mounts for lenses and mirrors and telescope support structures.

• Hands-on experience with FEA of optical systems and with environmental test campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum).

Skills

• Advanced knowledge of optomechanical design principles: kinematic and semi-kinematic mounting, flexure design, athermalization, bonding of optical elements and mount-induced stress control.

• Proficiency in 3D CAD (preferably Siemens NX) and FEA with NASTRAN-compatible solvers.

• Ability to perform STOP (Structural-Thermal-Optical Performance) analyses, including Zernike polynomial fitting of FEA surface deformations and rigid-body motions (e.g., SigFit or in-house tools).

• Strong understanding of materials for precision instruments (thermal expansion, dimensional stability, specific stiffness) and space-qualified adhesives.

• Proficiency in GD&T and optical drawing standards (ISO 10110).

• Ability to work hands-on in the lab with alignment and metrology equipment (interferometers, autocollimators, CMM, alignment telescopes).

• Ability to work in a team, strong interpersonal communication skills, and a willingness to learn.

• Capacity to learn continuously and passion for pushing the limits of space technology.

• Advanced English proficiency levels.

What we value

• Experience with large optics, ideally mirrors and telescopes of up to 600 mm in diameter (large mirror mounting, lightweighted mirrors, gravity sag and 1-g offloading during alignment and test).

• Experience with reflective telescope architectures (Cassegrain, Ritchey-Chrétien, Korsch, Three-Mirror Anastigmat).

• Experience correlating STOP predictions with interferometric measurements on space telescopes.

• Knowledge of Zemax OpticStudio.

• Experience working with the Siemens Simcenter 3D user interface for FEA pre- and post-processing.

• Specialized training in optomechanics (e.g., SPIE courses on optomechanical design and tolerancing, integrated optomechanical analysis, FEA of optics or adhesive bonding of optical elements).

• Technical publications, conference presentations (e.g., SPIE) or patents in optomechanics.

• Knowledge of ECSS / NASA standards, cleanliness and contamination control for space optics.

• Experience in NewSpace or small-satellite environments and design for manufacturability at volume.

Diversity Commitment

Satellogic values diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. We are convinced that hiring and developing top talent from around the world for any given discipline will drive innovation, generate new solutions, and deliver a superior product to our global customer base. We work to build an equitable and inclusive environment in which all people, regardless of gender, race, religion, or background, can come together to do their best work.

Please feel free to specify your pronouns following your name on the application.

Learn more about Satellogic

To learn more about us please visit satellogic.com and follow us on twitter ( @Satellogic ) and LinkedIn

Applicant Data Privacy Statement

As part of your application you will be required to confirm Satellogic's Applicant Data Privacy Policy which is available for your review here .

By applying to this position you express, affirmative consent to our collection of your name, address, email address, phone number and relevant application information and the processing of that information. It is important to understand that Satellogic will store your data for the purpose of processing your application for the position, and possibly other compatible positions. You also understand that you have rights to access your Personal Data, as well as rights to request their rectification, completion, update or erasure. You may exercise your rights by sending an email to compliance@satellogic.com.

Consenting to our Applicant Data Privacy Policy is required in order for Satellogic to process your employment application.

postings.title: Transfer of Knowledge & Technology Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Transfer of Knowledge & Technology Manager

About Satellogic

Satellogic (NASDAQ: SATL) builds the infrastructure for Persistent Global Intelligence (PGI): continuous, proactive awareness of the places, assets, and activities that matter. We're leading the transition from episodic Earth observation — buying an image after something happens — to persistent monitoring programs that give customers earlier awareness, faster decisions, and greater control over mission-critical information.

We do it through a coordinated stack that combines high-cadence satellite collection, fit-for-purpose satellite economics, AI-accelerated workflows, and sovereign-trusted architecture. Our vertically integrated approach and patented optical design make our satellites 10x more affordable with 10x more capacity than industry standard, which is what makes persistent monitoring at global scale economically viable in the first place.

We serve allied defense and intelligence agencies, civil governments, and select commercial markets that manage large portfolios of mission-critical sites, assets, and operations. Customers can begin with discovery, expand into persistent monitoring, and build toward dedicated capacity or sovereign-controlled infrastructure as their mission requirements grow.

With a globally distributed team, we bring together expertise in satellite engineering, software, data science, manufacturing, operations, and go-to-market. We're purpose-driven builders who value ownership, curiosity, and execution — and who work with humility, honesty, and empathy.

Role overview

The Transfer of Knowledge and Technology (ToK/ToT) Manager will lead the design, planning, and execution of customer capability-development programs.

The role will translate Satellogic’s technical knowledge and real-world experience into customer’s organizational know-how and enduring capabilities (ToK); and Satellogic’s cutting edge technology into customer’s full sovereign capability to design, manufacture and operate space missions (ToT). More than classroom-based training, ToK programs may cover the full lifecycle of an Earth observation mission, including space systems engineering, satellite design and qualification, assembly, integration and testing, mission design, satellite and mission operations, ground systems, and data processing.

The ToT/ToK Manager will work closely with Satellogic’s engineering, operations, product, program management, IP, Compliance and commercial teams, as well as customer organizations, universities, and other external partners.

Key responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end planning and delivery of customer ToT, ToK, and sovereign capability-development programs.

• Develop structured curricula covering relevant areas of the satellite and mission lifecycle, including:

• Space systems engineering principles and processes.

• Mission analysis and mission design.

• Satellite architecture and subsystem design.

• Design reviews and technical decision-making.

• Qualification and verification methodologies.

• Assembly, integration, and testing engineering.

• Satellite commissioning and in-orbit validation.

• Satellite and mission operations.

• Ground-segment systems and operations.

• Payload data processing and product generation.

• Program management, configuration management, and quality assurance.

• Design OJT programs based on practical engineering activities, representative scenarios, and lessons learned from the development, qualification, manufacturing, launch, and operation of Satellogic’s Newsat platform.

• Convert the knowledge held by Satellogic subject-matter experts into repeatable training modules, practical exercises, case studies, technical documentation, and evaluation materials.

• Coordinate technical instructors and mentors across Satellogic, ensuring that their contributions are properly planned and that training commitments do not create unmanaged disruption to ongoing programs.

• Define learning objectives, competency frameworks, participant prerequisites, assessment methods, and completion criteria for each program.

• Tailor curricula and delivery models to customer objectives, starting capabilities, facilities, regulatory environment, and desired level of operational or industrial autonomy.

• Manage all logistics associated with training execution, including scheduling, facilities, travel, access requirements, equipment, training environments, materials, and participant coordination.

• Develop and manage partnerships with universities, research institutions, and specialized training organizations to complement Satellogic’s internal expertise and support long-term customer capability development.

• Work with program managers to ensure that training activities, contractual deliverables, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and milestones are properly defined and tracked.

• Establish metrics to evaluate training effectiveness, knowledge retention, participant progression, and readiness to perform the targeted functions independently.

• Support commercial and proposal teams in defining ToT/ToK scope, delivery schedules, resource requirements, assumptions, and pricing.

• Ensure that training programs comply with Satellogic’s intellectual-property, export-control, security, confidentiality, and technology-transfer requirements.

• Capture lessons learned and continuously improve Satellogic’s standard ToT/ToK offering.

Qualifications

Required

• Professional experience in the space industry or a closely related aerospace or high-technology sector.

• Strong understanding of satellite programs and the lifecycle of space-system development, integration, qualification, deployment, or operations.

• Experience managing complex technical programs involving multiple disciplines and stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to structure complex technical knowledge into clear learning paths, work plans, and deliverables.

• Strong planning, coordination, and project-management capabilities.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with engineers, executives, government customers, academic institutions, and international partners.

• Ability to manage multiple workstreams, instructors, locations, and customer dependencies simultaneously.

• Professional fluency in English and willingness to travel internationally.

Preferred

• Academic, teaching, technical-training, or curriculum-development experience.

• Experience developing or delivering OJT programs in engineering or operational environments.

• Experience with systems engineering, satellite AIT, mission operations, ground systems, or Earth observation data processing.

• Experience working on international technology-transfer, industrialization, localization, or sovereign capability-development programs.

• Experience establishing partnerships with universities or research institutions.

• Familiarity with export controls, intellectual-property protections, and security constraints affecting international space programs.

• Advanced degree in aerospace engineering, systems engineering, another relevant technical field, education, or program management.

Profile

The ideal candidate combines enough technical depth to understand a complete space program with the organizational and educational skills required to turn that knowledge into an effective capability-development journey. They should be comfortable coordinating senior technical experts without needing to be the leading specialist in every domain.

postings.title: Engineering Manager - Developer Tools (Starcraft)
postings.descriptionText:
We are hiring a software engineering manager with a passion for developer experience and build tooling to have a positive impact on the day-to-day workflow of thousands of snap and charm publishers. To be successful on this team you'll need to be interested in packaging formats, build systems and automation that can simplify the lives of developers and engineers trying to ship software to the widest possible audience.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps , charms and more recently, rocks ( OCI images ).

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognized names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft. Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub , home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.

Your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

This Engineering Management role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for developer experience to build a career with Canonical and drive the success of the business. If you have an affinity for open source development, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

Location: This is a remote role, we are considering candidates in AMER time zones.

The role entails

• Leading your team to elevate the Linux developer experience.

• Demonstrating sound engineering principles through architecture, development and code reviews.

• Being responsible for planning, estimation and execution.

• Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders.

• Building and leading a distributed regional team of engineers.

• Offering coaching, mentoring, technical feedback and hands-on career development.

• Designing, embracing, and evangelizing great engineering and organizational practices.

• Being an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organization.

• Engaging with the wider open source community for feedback and collaboration.

What we are looking for in you

• An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.

• Knowledge of modern high-level languages (Python, Go) as well as containerization technologies and primitives (Snaps, Docker, etc.).

• Experience in the design and architecture of command-line and server-side applications

• Software project management skills, encompassing risk assessment and resource allocation.

• Ability to balance technical leadership with effective team management.

• A passion for technology and a drive to work with intelligent, motivated colleagues.

• A track record of open source leadership and collaboration.

• Curiosity, flexibility, and a strong sense of accountability.

• A focus on soft skills, including passion, enterprise, and self-motivation.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.

• Bi-annual compensation review.

• Company recognition rewards.

• 40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.

• Maternity and paternity leave.

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Graduate Software Engineer, Open Source and Linux, Canonical Ubuntu
postings.descriptionText:
We are hiring 2026 and 2027 Graduate Software Engineers into engineering teams around the world. As a global platform company we offer a wide range of software engineering challenges, in both open source products and commercial business systems. We have teams that work in a variety of languages, typically Python, Golang, Rust, C/C++, JavaScript and of course... Bash. We work from the very lowest levels of the Linux system - BIOS and boot loaders, firmware, kernel and drivers, all the way up to desktop applications and containers. We work on tiny devices like the Raspberry Pi and new RISC-V boards, all the way up to supercomputers, clouds and Kubernetes clusters. We work on compilers and toolchains, and we work on security, cryptography, performance and documentation. Some of our teams focus on packaging thousands of pieces of software, others focus on deep contributions to a single body of code.

If you are excited about the potential that open source has for humanity and the enterprise, you have outstanding results in your academic career, and you are excited to contribute to the open source stack, this is the best way to apply to Canonical. We will work with you to identify teams and projects that would be interesting and a good fit for your skills and motivations. The process is highly competitive, it will require effort and excellence to succeed if you apply here.

Most of our engineering teams work from home. We try to align a single team in a single time zone - EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa), APAC (Asia Pacific and Indian Ocean), and AMER (North, South and Central Americas). Even though you work from home, we try to ensure you always have colleagues alongside to coach and mentor you, and for the companionship of shared problem solving and pair programming. Larger projects have multiple teams and might span the globe. We work with the open source community and specialize in building teams that work well in the 'fishbowl' of open source engineering. This is full time work, five days a week, often solving hard problems with significant responsibility. We don't generally work weekends and nights and we do enjoy good holidays but we also expect productive and intense engagement Monday to Friday.

We bring all our engineering teams together in person twice a year for a deep 'sprint' with other teams to stimulate discussion and enable a wide range of career development paths. This is a fantastic way to demonstrate and develop your skill in software, learn about a wide range of technologies, make a meaningful impact to open source, and see some very interesting new cities that you might never otherwise get to visit.

If you find the open source stack amazing, and you have been a consistent high-performing student in your school and university, then this will be a challenging and exciting start to your career.

Location: This is a Globally remote role.

The role entails

• Shaping the roadmap for your product at global sprints every six months

• Focusing on design and user experience, even for developer tooling and command line apps

• Writing high quality, resilient and performant code, potentially serving millions of demanding daily users

postings.descriptionText:
We are hiring a Security Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Manager to lead the team that keeps Canonical's security and compliance credible to the Enterprises, Clouds, Telcos and Governments that run on Ubuntu, and to bring our controls and risk management to the standard a public company requires.

Location : EMEA or Americas — fully remote (home-based), with the option to work from our London office.

About our Team

Canonical's customers trust Ubuntu with critical systems. That trust rests on evidence: our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications, how we manage risk, and how we respond as security regulation such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act reaches open source software. The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team produces that evidence and makes it real across the company. As Canonical prepares to list on a public exchange, the team is also central to the controls and risk reporting our Audit Committee and Board rely on.

The team is part of Operations and reports to the Chief Operating Officer. It covers both sides of the discipline: keeping us certified and compliant today, and looking ahead at risk across corporate IT, infrastructure and products. It works closely with Engineering, Security Operations, Information Systems, Legal, Finance and Sales.

You will lead the team, set its priorities and operating rhythm, and be the first escalation point for security and compliance decisions.

What you'll do

• Lead and develop a team of GRC engineers: hire, coach and set priorities, and run a roadmap that balances planned work with operational requests, so the team delivers predictably and reports progress clearly to leadership. You own the team’s budget, vendors and tooling.

• Own our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications end to end: audit readiness, evidence collection, auditor relationships and fieldwork, so certifications are renewed on time with clean outcomes.

• Run the risk management framework across corporate IT, infrastructure and products — asset classification, risk assessments, the risk register and key risk indicators — so leadership and the Board can see and decide on the company’s most important risks.

• Own the information security policy framework — annual reviews, new policies, exceptions and risk acceptance — and make the call, or escalate it, when a policy and a business need conflict.

• Partner with Finance on IT General Controls and internal controls over financial reporting — remediation, control execution and Audit Committee reporting — to make Canonical ready for a public listing.

• Turn security regulation and standards — the EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, DORA, the EU AI Act and IEC 62443 — into practical programmes with Legal and Engineering, including our secure software development lifecycle and penetration testing, so our products meet their obligations as they ship.

• Build business continuity and disaster recovery with Information Systems and business owners — impact analysis, plans and tested recovery — so critical services can be restored when it matters.

• Oversee third-party risk, access reviews and the governance of new tools and AI usage, and support customers and colleagues when it counts — security questionnaires, RFPs, our Trust Center, contract security terms and incident response — alongside Sales, Legal and Security Operations.

What we are looking for in you

• Hands-on ownership of ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 certification through external audit cycles

• Experience designing or running a risk management framework (such as ISO 27005, NIST CSF or ISO 31000), including a risk register and reporting to senior leadership

• Experience with IT General Controls supporting financial audits, under SOX or an equivalent regime

• Experience leading a governance, risk and compliance, security compliance or IT risk team in a software or technology company

• Experience turning regulatory and technical requirements into controls that engineering and business teams you don’t manage actually adopt

• Sound judgement on risk acceptance and policy exceptions, and the confidence to hold a position with senior stakeholders

• Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

• Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

• Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

• Experience preparing a company for a public listing

• Experience with product security compliance for a software vendor (EU Cyber Resilience Act, IEC 62443 or NIST SSDF)

• Business continuity and disaster recovery programme experience

• Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer

How we work

We look for a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results, backed by self-motivation and drive. Our people deliver their work precisely, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity. Reliability is at our core, where colleagues deliver high quality work that builds trust and confidence. We make ourselves accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable. Finally we are adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Priority Pass for travel

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Bi-annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer . Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination, and regardless of your identity we will give your application fair consideration.

About the project

Our client is a leading cross-border payments company operating across multiple international markets.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a small, experienced engineering team responsible for developing and maintaining the technology that supports regulatory compliance across the company's operations.

The platform includes an event-driven rules engine that evaluates transactions against country-specific compliance requirements, a user interface that enables compliance teams to manage rules independently, automated regulatory reporting, identity-data services, and immutable regulatory storage.

You will work primarily with Java, Go, AWS, and event-driven architectures, with opportunities to contribute to React-based frontend applications and data platform integrations.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical ownership, autonomy, collaboration, and commitment to software quality.

You will work closely with the team's Technical Referent, contributing to the delivery of reliable, scalable solutions in a highly regulated environment.

What you'll do

Backend Engineering & Architecture

•
Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java and Go.

•
Build reliable services supporting transaction monitoring, compliance rules, and regulatory processes.

•
Develop and maintain event-driven and queue-based integrations that process high volumes of transactions.

•
Contribute to system design decisions, technical improvements, and application reliability.

•
Work with AWS infrastructure and observability tools to support application operations.

•
Contribute to React-based frontend functionality when required.

Deliver maintainable, well-tested solutions aligned with the team's Definition of Done.

Apply quality-first engineering practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

Support CI/CD processes and help improve engineering standards.

•
Investigate defects, identify root causes, and implement reliable fixes.

•
Communicate proactively about progress, blockers, risks, and technical decisions.

•
Maintain clear technical documentation to support asynchronous collaboration.

•
Take ownership of assigned work and contribute to continuous improvement in a team with lightweight processes.

•
Collaborate effectively with distributed colleagues across time zones.

Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude or Cursor to improve development productivity.

•
Review, validate, and thoroughly test AI-generated code before integrating it into production systems.

•
Apply engineering judgment to ensure security, maintainability, and correctness.

•
Take part in Nortal's Technical Interviewer Program, conducting technical interviews for your account and other accounts to help build the teams behind Nortal's growth.

What makes you a great fit

•
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development expertise.

•
Strong production experience with Java and working knowledge of Go, or strong Go experience with the ability to quickly become productive in Java.

•
Hands-on experience designing and maintaining event-driven or queue-based systems.

•
Experience developing applications that support high-volume data or transaction processing.

•
Strong understanding of software testing, including unit, functional, integration, and end-to-end testing.

•
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and quality-focused code review practices.

•
Hands-on experience with AWS and application observability or monitoring tools.

•
Ability to independently deliver features from requirements through production deployment.

•
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying technical risks and blockers.

•
Experience working in autonomous engineering teams with lightweight processes.

•
Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or above), including clear technical documentation and asynchronous communication.

•
Ability to maintain the required working-hours overlap with European teams (CET/CEST, exact schedule to be confirmed).

Nice to have:

•
Experience with Rust.

•
Frontend development experience using React and TypeScript.

•
Experience with Databricks or other data platforms.

•
Background in fintech, payments, transaction monitoring, compliance automation, or regulatory reporting.

•
Experience collaborating with distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones.

•
Spanish or Portuguese language skills.

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.

We believe complexity doesn't have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That's why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.

You’ll work with SRE, DevOps, engineering, architecture, and client-side teams to improve reliability, performance, automation, observability, and deployment practices. The team is working toward substantially higher traffic capacity, stronger resilience, and more repeatable operations. Success requires technical depth, independence, and the initiative to identify and move forward on work with limited direction.

What you’ll do

• Design, build, and operate highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems and caching platforms.

• Assess the existing architecture and identify ways to scale toward six times current traffic while protecting performance and reliability.

• Improve caching strategies, including TTLs, refresh patterns, cache placement, performance, and downstream dependency management.

• Help evolve the platform toward active-active resiliency and validate failure, recovery, and capacity scenarios.

• Design and implement automated CI/CD pipelines with appropriate rolling, blue/green, or canary deployments, checks, and quality gates.

• Establish version-controlled, automated practices for infrastructure, configuration, secrets, and application deployments.

• Build performance and load-testing capabilities and define meaningful performance gates for releases.

• Improve monitoring, alerting, and observability for latency, throughput, availability, errors, and other reliability indicators.

• Define and improve SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and operational KPIs where appropriate.

• Automate operational work and reduce manual intervention through scripting, tooling, and infrastructure automation.

• Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive reliability improvements through blameless post-incident reviews.

• Provide technical guidance and practical engineering guardrails to SRE and development teams.

• Collaborate with Java/Spring Boot engineers, architects, client-side engineers, and other technical teams.

• Take ownership of ambiguous problems, identify useful work, explain technical decisions, and make progress without close day-to-day direction.

• Experience operating and scaling distributed systems in production.

• Strong understanding of caching architectures, performance optimization, and high-availability systems.

• Hands-on AWS experience and familiarity with cloud-native architecture.

• Experience designing and implementing automated CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies for highly available systems.

Brainlabs is the independent, founder-led agency building the future of media. We have over 1000 Brainlabbers based across the global, all united through the 12 principles laid out in our Culture Code. If you want to help play your part in achieving this for the world's biggest brands in an environment that will support and challenge you in equal measure, this is where you do it.

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

As a Programmatic Manager your focus is delivering high-quality, best-in-class work for clients within your Practice.

So, tell me about the company 🧠

Brainlabs is culture-first. You’ve probably heard other companies describe themselves as people, clients, or profit first – but we see people, clients and profit as the building blocks of our ecosystem. Culture powers all three and we know that when the ecosystem is balanced, we all win! That's why the culture we cultivate is a culture of winning together.

To learn more about what it’s like to be a Brainlabber, check out our culture code.

In this role you will 🖊️

• Using practice knowledge, you will be responsible for delivering and implementing high-quality strategies aligned with client goals and priorities.

• You'll effectively track and measure results across defined performance metrics.

• You’ll be partnering with our clients on day to day tasks and deliverables.

• You’ll develop and implement, as well as follow guidelines and processes contributing to ideas around automation or process improvement.

• You’ll actively contribute to developing a best-practice roadmap so that our Practice offering is continually developing.

• Be an advocate for the practice with Associates and help to grow knowledge and skills across this population. You will also start to build your knowledge of other Practices.

• Develop ideas for process improvements, innovation and automation that drive measurable impact for your client or Practice.

We’re looking for someone who 🔍

• Has a delivery track record with 2+ years of experience with DV360 and Campaign Manager 360. The Trade Desk and Amazon DSP are a plus.

• Is passionate about growing your career in marketing and the knowledge of others around you. Demonstrable skills in strategy, innovation, and client management.

• Has a good understanding about how other channels work and optimise together.

• Is a confident, dynamic, engaging and authentic communicator with excellent presentation skills.

• Has advancing data analysis and storytelling skills.

• Is someone with strong attention to detail, who is methodical and process orientated and has demonstrated a very high quality of work.

• Is fluent in English (as you will be supporting US / EMEA Accounts)

And this is what success looks like in the role 🏅

• You will live our Culture Code every day!

• You're passionate about digital marketing and growing your career.

• Achieving the goals set by your manager

• Internal targets/metrics on technology adoption and process optimisation met.

• You will hit our quality assurance metrics on all accounts you lead.

• Client satisfaction targets being met (internal & external).

• Learning certifications created and met across the practice.

• Active involvement in mentoring less experienced colleagues.

What's in it for you ✨

• This is a full time role (en relación de dependencia)

• Hybrid salary (50% of your net salary in USD)

• 20 working days vacation plus all Argentina public holidays.

• Private healthcare (OSDE 360).

• Adaptive/hybrid working.

• Free breakfast and lunch when in office.

• Access to learning and development opportunities.

• Mobility programmes - work from another country for up to 30 days!

What happens next?

We know searching for a job is tough and that you want to find the best career and employer for you. We also want to ensure that this position is the best fit for both you and us. Therefore, you will participate in a comprehensive interview process that includes skills interviews with our team. The goal of this process is to allow you to get to know us as we learn more about you.

A note on our offices: We pride ourselves in being a company with an office-centric culture and, for the majority of roles we expect people to be in commuting distance of the office and come in for around 3 days per week.

Brainlabs actively seeks and encourages applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and identities. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace: we are committed to equal opportunity for all applicants and employees regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion, or belief, and marriage and civil partnerships. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the application process, please let us know!

For details regarding our data processing activities, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice

Protect Yourself from Job Scams: We've been made aware of fraudulent job offers circulating in Brainlabs' name. Your safety is our priority, so please stay vigilant. Brainlabs will never ask you to transfer money, pay for a job opportunity, or request sensitive information such as Social Security numbers, banking details, or passwords via email, WhatsApp, or unsecured channels. Our official hiring communications only come from verified email domains (@brainlabsdigital.com, @brainlabs.ai, @exverus.com, @jacknimble.com.au, @sparro.com.au) and trusted platforms including Greenhouse, Upwork, Yuno Juno, and Remote. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Brainlabs, do not engage. Instead, forward it immediately to security@brainlabsdigital.com . We're committed to protecting our community and ensuring a safe candidate experience. Thank you for your vigilance.

postings.descriptionText:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Customer Recovery Coach, you will model our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts—the mission for Cloudbeds Customer Success—sitting at the vital intersection of customer retention and product success. You will drive the shift from a reactive support function to an Intelligent Recovery Motion, leveraging early risk detection and firsthand hotel operations experience to turn frustration into loyalty. This role centers on orchestrating the Fire-Team concept—a cross-functional, executive-level intervention designed to deliver decisive issue resolution for our most critical accounts. You will be a Caring Rebel leader who understands that technology should handle the administrative drag, while humans handle the relationship magic. You will leverage AI-driven insights to proactively identify risk and design recovery processes that prove Cloudbeds is central to our customers' business success.

Our Customer Success Team:

Our Customer Success team is where Hospitality Hearts meet Smart Solutions. We are a fully-remote group of former hoteliers and customer experience professionals, focused on removing unnecessary manual work so we can focus on our human magic: building and strengthening relationships with our customers, and ensuring Cloudbeds remains central to their business success and guest service excellence. If you are driven by emotional intelligence, trust building, and delivering deeply personalized hospitality moments instead of repetitive operational work, you will feel right at home here.

What You Bring to the Team:

• Own the customer recovery motion, triaging high-impact queues of at-risk customers with a goal of proactive rescue and structured save motions.
• Champion the core principle: Standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful. Use AI and automation tooling to handle administrative tasks, freeing capacity for deep-dive recovery work.
• Drive momentum to value by acting as an internal consultant, coordinating across Sales, Onboarding, and Product to remove technical or operational blockers.
• Own clear, customer-friendly communication, delivering concise and highly personalized updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
• Maintain clean systems and actionable data, logging activities in Salesforce and capturing "voice of the customer" signals to feed back to leadership.
• Identify patterns of friction and propose systemic process improvements to stop issues before they start, ruthlessly eliminating hero-dependency.
• Orchestrate the Fire-Team motion: Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for at-risk accounts, mobilizing internal stakeholders across Support, Product, and Engineering to restore trust and ensure the customer never has to ask "Who owns this?"
• Execute the "Recovery Becomes Prevention" feedback loop: Treat cancellation requests as systemic failures rather than simple decision points; document root causes to identify and eliminate the friction points that deplete our customers and teams.
• Implement "Rapid Wins": Prioritize immediate operational stabilization for customers by fixing top pain points first to restore confidence before reaching for perfection.

What Sets You Up for Success:

• Hospitality Roots: Significant direct experience in hotel/resort operations (front office, revenue, or property management). You must understand the real business impact when tech fails.
• SaaS & Retention Experience: 2-5+ years in Post-Sales Ops, Onboarding, CS Ops, Renewals, or Customer Success in a B2B SaaS environment.
• AI Smarts: Exceptional technical aptitude. You understand how to leverage AI to unlock time for human-to-human relationships.
• Caring Rebel Spirit: Proven ability in emotional intelligence, trust-building, and high-stakes de-escalation with customers at all levels.
• Process Discipline: Detail-oriented and rigorous about documentation and CRM hygiene.

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

• Deep experience across mid-market, enterprise, or multi-property hospitality (management companies, branded clusters, or large franchise models).
• Fluency in multiple languages supported by Cloudbeds.
Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

postings.descriptionText:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

Cloudbeds is looking for a Senior Customer Support & Onboarding Specialist - Accounting to own our most complex customer accounting work. This role sits at the intersection of hospitality operations, accounting, and technology, guiding properties through the end-to-end accounting flow, from property configuration to integration with their accounting software or ERP.

As the senior member of the team, you’ll take on the hardest implementations and escalations for our key accounts, including multi-property and enterprise customers, joining them from day one as the finance counterpart to the customer’s controller and finance team. You’ll be the go-to expert for Support, Onboarding and Account Management on anything accounting, and help shape how we onboard and support customers’ financial setups as we scale. This is a customer-facing role for someone with deep accounting knowledge at a controller level or equivalent senior level who can legitimately help our customers get their books right.

Our Onboarding & Accounting Integration Team:

Our team thrives at the intersection of hospitality expertise and technical execution. We work alongside Integration Engineering, Support, and Sales to solve real customer challenges with accounting systems. Customers trust us to help them connect their financial backbone to Cloudbeds, and we take that seriously.

What You Bring to the Team:

• Lead complex accounting onboarding engagements for key accounts, including multi-property and enterprise customers: chart of accounts mapping, tax configuration, revenue recognition, reconciliation workflows, and month-end close

• Act as the escalation point for accounting discrepancies, integration sync issues and configuration problems that Support and Onboarding can't resolve, and own them through to resolution

• Guide customers in connecting Cloudbeds to accounting software and ERPs (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, local and regional systems) via native integrations and partner solutions

• Serve as the subject matter expert on hospitality accounting for internal teams and customers, coaching other specialists and training Support, Onboarding and Account Management

• Build and own onboarding playbooks, documentation and best-practice resources for hospitality accounting workflows

• Bring recurring customer pain points and product gaps to Product and Engineering with clear evidence, and help shape the accounting roadmap

• Manage multiple complex engagements at once while keeping implementations moving and customers confident

What Sets You Up for Success:

• Controller-level (or equivalent senior) experience in accounting with 8+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or financial operations, and hotel or resort accounting experience

• Deep understanding of accounting fundamentals: general ledger, accounts receivable/payable, revenue recognition, reconciliation, month-end close, and financial reporting

• Proven track record leading accounting software or ERP implementations end to end, including complex or multi-entity setups, ideally for hotel or hospitality businesses

• Working knowledge of North American (US or Canadian) accounting and tax requirements, including US tax reporting for US-owned properties

• Experience as the go-to expert others escalate to, with the ability to coach and train colleagues

• Strong customer-facing communication skills, confident on calls with owners and senior finance stakeholders, able to explain complex accounting concepts in clear, simple language to hoteliers and translate accountant needs for technical teams

• Strong analytical mindset: trace data flows, identify mapping issues, and troubleshoot integration problems methodically

• Fluent in English, able to communicate clearly in writing and on calls across global time zones

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

• Accounting certification (CPA, ACCA or equivalent) or ERP certifications

• Night audit, folio management or USALI experience

• Knowledge of regional accounting standards and tax requirements in Canada, the Caribbean or Latin America, and Spanish or Portuguese

About AppDirect

Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.

About You

You are a proactive, detail-oriented, and result-driven Collections Analyst. You will be responsible for managing collections activities, tracking outstanding receivables, following up on overdue accounts, and supporting the organization’s cash flow objectives.

You should have hands-on experience in accounts receivable and collections, strong analytical skills, and the confidence to communicate with customers through calls and emails to ensure timely payment follow-ups and resolution of outstanding issues. The candidate should also be proficient in NetSuite (or similar), MS Excel, and Google Sheets.

What you'll do and how you'll have an impact

• Manage end-to-end collection activities for assigned customer accounts.

• Review aging reports and identify overdue invoices/accounts for follow-up.

• Follow up with customers through calls, emails, and other communication channels to collect outstanding payments and secure payment commitments.

• Investigate payment delays, short payments, and disputed invoices in coordination with internal teams such as Finance, Billing, Sales, and Customer Success.

• Maintain accurate records of collection efforts, customer communication, payment commitments, and follow-up actions.

• Perform account reconciliations and ensure proper allocation of incoming payments.

• Prepare periodic reports/MIS on collections performance, overdue accounts, and dispute status.

• Support month-end closing activities related to receivables and collections

What we're looking for

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field.

• 2–3 years of experience in Collections, Accounts Receivable, Credit Control, or Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.

• Experience in customer payment follow-ups, overdue account management, and account reconciliation.

• Prior experience working with NetSuite or a similar ERP/accounting system.

• Strong working knowledge of MS Excel including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, filters, sorting, and basic formulas and proficiency in Google Sheets for maintaining trackers and reports.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills to fell confident and comfortable in making collection calls and speaking with customers professionally.

• Good negotiation and follow-up skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

• Ability to manage multiple accounts, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.

We respect each AppDirector as their own fingerprint; unique with no one alike. As such, we strongly encourage applications from Indigenous peoples, racialized people, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities, and/or people with intersectional identities.

AI tools do not make hiring decisions or solely automated decisions about your candidacy – all decisions are made by our people.
